````````markdown
``````lean
import Calderon.TauMetricDirichlet
import Calderon.TauAffineBallData
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory
open scoped ENNReal InnerProductSpace ContDiff
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.EnergyBridge

/-- Actual weak harmonic extensions for frozen admissible metrics. -/
def metricDirichletSolution (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (f : SmoothData) : BallH1 :=
  affineDirichletSolution g f (memLp_metricEnergyIntegrand g hg) (isCoercive_metricEnergyForm g hg)

/-- The actual variational boundary pairing on all smooth data. -/
def smoothBoundaryPairing (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (f h : SmoothData) : ℝ :=
  TauCeti.PDE.energyFormH1 (principalCoefficient g) (fun _ : R3 => (0 : R3)) (fun _ : R3 => (0 : ℝ))
    (metricDirichletSolution g hg f) (metricDirichletSolution g hg h)

/-- Frozen minimal energy is the diagonal of this genuine pairing. -/
theorem smoothBoundaryPairing_self (hzero : SmoothBoundaryZeroClosure)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (f : SmoothData) :
    smoothBoundaryPairing g hg f f = minimalEnergy g f.1 :=
  (minimalEnergy_eq_affineDirichletSolution_energy hzero g f
    (memLp_metricEnergyIntegrand g hg) (isCoercive_metricEnergyForm g hg)
    (metricEnergy_coefficient_isSymm_ae g hg)).symm

/-- Real polarization is proved on the actual metric harmonic extensions. -/
theorem two_mul_smoothBoundaryPairing (hzero : SmoothBoundaryZeroClosure)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (f h : SmoothData) :
    2 * smoothBoundaryPairing g hg f h =
      minimalEnergy g (f.1 + h.1) - minimalEnergy g f.1 - minimalEnergy g h.1 := by
  rw [← smoothBoundaryPairing_self hzero g hg ⟨f.1 + h.1, f.2.add h.2⟩,
    ← smoothBoundaryPairing_self hzero g hg f, ← smoothBoundaryPairing_self hzero g hg h]
  unfold smoothBoundaryPairing metricDirichletSolution
  rw [affineDirichletSolution_add]
  rw [TauCeti.PDE.energyFormH1_add_left (memLp_metricEnergyIntegrand g hg),
    TauCeti.PDE.energyFormH1_add_right (memLp_metricEnergyIntegrand g hg),
    TauCeti.PDE.energyFormH1_add_right (memLp_metricEnergyIntegrand g hg)]
  have hcomm := TauCeti.PDE.energyFormH1_comm_of_isSymm_ae
    (mu := (volume : Measure R3)) (Omega := ballOpens) (a := principalCoefficient g)
    (c := fun _ : R3 => (0 : ℝ)) (metricEnergy_coefficient_isSymm_ae g hg)
    (affineDirichletSolution g h (memLp_metricEnergyIntegrand g hg) (isCoercive_metricEnergyForm g hg))
    (affineDirichletSolution g f (memLp_metricEnergyIntegrand g hg) (isCoercive_metricEnergyForm g hg))
  simp only [Pi.zero_def] at hcomm
  rw [hcomm]
  ring

/-- The exact frozen equal-energy data implies equality of genuine mixed boundary pairings. -/
theorem smoothBoundaryPairing_eq_of_minimalEnergy_eq (hzero : SmoothBoundaryZeroClosure)
    (g₁ g₂ : MatrixField) (hg₁ : IsAdmissibleMetric g₁) (hg₂ : IsAdmissibleMetric g₂)
    (hΛ : ∀ f : R3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ f → minimalEnergy g₁ f = minimalEnergy g₂ f)
    (f h : SmoothData) : smoothBoundaryPairing g₁ hg₁ f h = smoothBoundaryPairing g₂ hg₂ f h := by
  have h₁ := two_mul_smoothBoundaryPairing hzero g₁ hg₁ f h
  have h₂ := two_mul_smoothBoundaryPairing hzero g₂ hg₂ f h
  rw [hΛ (f.1 + h.1) (f.2.add h.2), hΛ f.1 f.2, hΛ h.1 h.2] at h₁
  linarith

/-- This actual Sobolev harmonic extension depends only on the ordinary sphere boundary value. -/
theorem metricDirichletSolution_eq_of_boundary_eq (hzero : SmoothBoundaryZeroClosure)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (f h : SmoothData)
    (heq : ∀ x : R3, ‖x‖ = 1 → f.1 x = h.1 x) :
    metricDirichletSolution g hg f = metricDirichletSolution g hg h := by
  have hd : smoothSobolev f - smoothSobolev h ∈ TauCeti.w1p0Submodule volume ballOpens 2 := by
    rw [← smoothSobolev_sub]
    apply hzero ⟨f.1 - h.1, f.2.sub h.2⟩
    intro x hx
    simp [heq x hx]
  have hc := (affineDirichletCorrection g h (memLp_metricEnergyIntegrand g hg)
    (isCoercive_metricEnergyForm g hg)).2
  apply Eq.symm
  apply eq_affineDirichletSolution g (memLp_metricEnergyIntegrand g hg) (isCoercive_metricEnergyForm g hg) f
  · have he : metricDirichletSolution g hg h - smoothSobolev f =
        (affineDirichletCorrection g h (memLp_metricEnergyIntegrand g hg)
          (isCoercive_metricEnergyForm g hg) : BallH1) - (smoothSobolev f - smoothSobolev h) := by
      unfold metricDirichletSolution affineDirichletSolution tauAffineSolution affineDirichletCorrection
      abel
    rw [he]
    exact (TauCeti.w1p0Submodule volume ballOpens 2).sub_mem hc hd
  · exact energyForm_affineDirichletSolution_zero g h (memLp_metricEnergyIntegrand g hg)
      (isCoercive_metricEnergyForm g hg)

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.EnergyBridge

``````lean
import Calderon.MetricSmooth
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Exp

set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 10
noncomputable section
open scoped ContDiff Matrix.Norms.Elementwise
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.EnergyBridge

lemma contDiff_matrix_adjugate_entry (g : MatrixField)
    (hs : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => g x i j)) (i j : Fin 3) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => (g x).adjugate i j) := by
  classical
  simp_rw [Matrix.adjugate_apply]
  apply contDiff_matrix_det_of_entries (fun x => (g x).updateRow j (Pi.single i 1))
  intro l m
  by_cases hl : l = j
  · subst l
    simp only [Matrix.updateRow_self]
    exact contDiff_const
  · simpa [Matrix.updateRow_apply, hl] using hs l m

lemma contDiff_matrix_inverse_entry (g : MatrixField)
    (hs : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => g x i j)) (hp : ∀ x, (g x).PosDef)
    (i j : Fin 3) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => (g x)⁻¹ i j) := by
  have hd : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => (g x).det⁻¹) :=
    (contDiff_matrix_det_of_entries g hs).inv (fun x => ne_of_gt (hp x).det_pos)
  simp only [Matrix.inv_def, Ring.inverse_eq_inv', Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  exact hd.mul (contDiff_matrix_adjugate_entry g hs i j)

lemma contDiff_inverse_of_smooth_posDef (g : MatrixField)
    (hs : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => g x i j)) (hp : ∀ x, (g x).PosDef) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => (g x)⁻¹) :=
  contDiff_pi.mpr (fun i => contDiff_pi.mpr (fun j => contDiff_matrix_inverse_entry g hs hp i j))

lemma contDiff_vol_of_smooth_posDef (g : MatrixField)
    (hs : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => g x i j)) (hp : ∀ x, (g x).PosDef) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (vol g) :=
  (contDiff_matrix_det_of_entries g hs).sqrt (fun x => ne_of_gt (hp x).det_pos)

lemma vol_pos_of_posDef (g : MatrixField) (hp : ∀ x, (g x).PosDef) (x : R3) :
    0 < vol g x := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hp x).det_pos

lemma contDiff_principalCoefficient_of_smooth_posDef (g : MatrixField)
    (hs : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => g x i j)) (hp : ∀ x, (g x).PosDef) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (principalCoefficient g) :=
  contDiff_pi.mpr (fun i => contDiff_pi.mpr (fun j =>
    (contDiff_vol_of_smooth_posDef g hs hp).mul (contDiff_matrix_inverse_entry g hs hp i j)))

/-- Exact conformal scalar multiplication, with no exterior-flatness assertion. -/
def conformalMatrix (g : MatrixField) (f : R3 → ℝ) : MatrixField :=
  fun x => Real.exp (2 * f x) • g x

lemma conformalMatrix_smooth_entries (g : MatrixField) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => g x i j)) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (i j : Fin 3) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => conformalMatrix g f x i j) :=
  (Real.contDiff_exp.comp (contDiff_const.mul hf)).mul (hs i j)

lemma conformalMatrix_posDef (g : MatrixField) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ x, (g x).PosDef) (x : R3) : (conformalMatrix g f x).PosDef :=
  (hp x).smul (Real.exp_pos _)

lemma conformalMatrix_inverse (g : MatrixField) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ x, (g x).PosDef) (x : R3) :
    (conformalMatrix g f x)⁻¹ = Real.exp (-2 * f x) • (g x)⁻¹ := by
  letI : Invertible (Real.exp (2 * f x)) := invertibleOfNonzero (Real.exp_ne_zero _)
  have h := Matrix.inv_smul (g x) (Real.exp (2 * f x))
    ((isUnit_iff_ne_zero).mpr (ne_of_gt (hp x).det_pos))
  simpa only [conformalMatrix, invOf_eq_inv, Real.exp_neg, neg_mul] using h

lemma vol_conformalMatrix (g : MatrixField) (f : R3 → ℝ) (x : R3) :
    vol (conformalMatrix g f) x = Real.exp (3 * f x) * vol g x := by
  unfold vol conformalMatrix
  rw [Matrix.det_smul, Fintype.card_fin,
    Real.sqrt_mul (pow_nonneg (Real.exp_nonneg _) _) _]
  have he : Real.exp (2 * f x) ^ 3 = Real.exp (3 * f x) ^ 2 := by
    rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul, ← Real.exp_nat_mul]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [he, Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]

lemma principalCoefficient_conformalMatrix (g : MatrixField) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ x, (g x).PosDef) (x : R3) :
    principalCoefficient (conformalMatrix g f) x = Real.exp (f x) • principalCoefficient g x := by
  unfold principalCoefficient
  rw [vol_conformalMatrix, conformalMatrix_inverse g f hp]
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have he : Real.exp (3 * f x) * Real.exp (-2 * f x) = Real.exp (f x) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  calc
    _ = (Real.exp (3 * f x) * Real.exp (-2 * f x)) * (vol g x * (g x)⁻¹ i j) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [he]

lemma contDiff_conformalMatrix_inverse (g : MatrixField) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => g x i j)) (hp : ∀ x, (g x).PosDef)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => (conformalMatrix g f x)⁻¹) :=
  contDiff_inverse_of_smooth_posDef _ (conformalMatrix_smooth_entries g f hs hf)
    (conformalMatrix_posDef g f hp)

lemma contDiff_vol_conformalMatrix (g : MatrixField) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => g x i j)) (hp : ∀ x, (g x).PosDef)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (vol (conformalMatrix g f)) :=
  contDiff_vol_of_smooth_posDef _ (conformalMatrix_smooth_entries g f hs hf)
    (conformalMatrix_posDef g f hp)

lemma contDiff_principalCoefficient_conformalMatrix (g : MatrixField) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (hs : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => g x i j)) (hp : ∀ x, (g x).PosDef)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (principalCoefficient (conformalMatrix g f)) :=
  contDiff_principalCoefficient_of_smooth_posDef _ (conformalMatrix_smooth_entries g f hs hf)
    (conformalMatrix_posDef g f hp)

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.EnergyBridge
#print axioms OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.EnergyBridge.contDiff_inverse_of_smooth_posDef
#print axioms OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.EnergyBridge.contDiff_vol_of_smooth_posDef
#print axioms OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.EnergyBridge.conformalMatrix_inverse
#print axioms OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.EnergyBridge.vol_conformalMatrix

lemma contDiff_inverseMetricOperator_of_smooth_posDef (g : MatrixField)
    (hs : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => g x i j)) (hp : ∀ x, (g x).PosDef) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (inverseMetricOperator g) := by

lemma inverseMetricOperator_eq_matrix_inverse_of_posDef (g : MatrixField)
    (hp : ∀ x, (g x).PosDef) (x : R3) :

  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := (hp x).isUnit
  change Ring.inverse (MetricOperator.matrixOperatorAlgEquiv (g x)) =
    MetricOperator.matrixOperatorAlgEquiv ((g x)⁻¹)
  rw [← hu, Matrix.nonsing_inv_eq_ringInverse, Ring.inverse_unit]
  change Ring.inverse ((Units.map MetricOperator.matrixOperatorAlgEquiv.toMonoidHom u).val) =

  rw [Ring.inverse_unit]

  have h := Matrix.isSymmetric_toEuclideanLin_iff.mpr (hp x).inv.isHermitian

lemma densityWeightedDivergence_product_rule {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (b : OrthonormalBasis ι ℝ R3) (rho : R3 → ℝ) (A : R3 → R3) (x : R3)
    (hr : DifferentiableAt ℝ rho x) (hA : DifferentiableAt ℝ A x) :
    densityWeightedDivergence b rho A x = ⟪gradient rho x, A x⟫_ℝ +
      rho x * ∑ i, ⟪fderiv ℝ A x (b i), b i⟫_ℝ := by
  have hd (i : ι) : fderiv ℝ (fun y => rho y * ⟪A y, b i⟫_ℝ) x (b i) =
      fderiv ℝ rho x (b i) * ⟪A x, b i⟫_ℝ +
        rho x * ⟪fderiv ℝ A x (b i), b i⟫_ℝ := by
    rw [fderiv_fun_mul hr (hA.inner ℝ (differentiableAt_const (b i)))]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [fderiv_inner_apply ℝ hA (differentiableAt_const (b i))]
    simp only [fderiv_const_apply, zero_apply, inner_zero_right, zero_add]
    ring
  simp only [densityWeightedDivergence, hd, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  congr 1
  calc
    _ = ∑ i, ⟪gradient rho x, b i⟫_ℝ * ⟪b i, A x⟫_ℝ := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [inner_gradient_left, real_inner_comm (A x) (b i)]
    _ = _ := b.sum_inner_mul_inner _ _

lemma densityWeightedDivergence_coefficient_product_rule {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (b : OrthonormalBasis ι ℝ R3) (rho : R3 → ℝ) (C : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (A : R3 → R3) (x : R3) (hr : DifferentiableAt ℝ rho x)
    (hC : DifferentiableAt ℝ C x) (hA : DifferentiableAt ℝ A x) :
    densityWeightedDivergence b rho (fun y => C y (A y)) x =
      ⟪gradient rho x, C x (A x)⟫_ℝ + rho x *
        ∑ i, ⟪fderiv ℝ C x (b i) (A x) + C x (fderiv ℝ A x (b i)), b i⟫_ℝ := by
  rw [densityWeightedDivergence_product_rule b rho _ x hr (hC.clm_apply hA),
    fderiv_clm_apply hC hA]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply, add_comm]

lemma densityWeightedDivergence_mul_density {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (b : OrthonormalBasis ι ℝ R3) (s rho : R3 → ℝ) (A : R3 → R3) (x : R3)
    (hs : DifferentiableAt ℝ s x) (hr : DifferentiableAt ℝ rho x)
    (hA : DifferentiableAt ℝ A x) :
    densityWeightedDivergence b (fun y => s y * rho y) A x =
      s x * densityWeightedDivergence b rho A x + rho x * ⟪gradient s x, A x⟫_ℝ := by
  have hd (i : ι) : (fun y => (s y * rho y) * ⟪A y, b i⟫_ℝ) =
      fun y => s y * (rho y * ⟪A y, b i⟫_ℝ) := by funext y; ring
  have he (i : ι) :
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => s y * (rho y * ⟪A y, b i⟫_ℝ)) x (b i) =
        s x * fderiv ℝ (fun y => rho y * ⟪A y, b i⟫_ℝ) x (b i) +
          (rho x * ⟪A x, b i⟫_ℝ) * fderiv ℝ s x (b i) := by
    have hprofile : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => rho y * ⟪A y, b i⟫_ℝ) x :=
      hr.mul (hA.inner ℝ (differentiableAt_const (b i)))
    rw [fderiv_fun_mul hs hprofile]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  unfold densityWeightedDivergence
  simp only [hd, he, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  congr 1
  calc
    _ = rho x * ∑ i, ⟪gradient s x, b i⟫_ℝ * ⟪b i, A x⟫_ℝ := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [inner_gradient_left, real_inner_comm (A x) (b i)]
      ring
    _ = _ := by rw [b.sum_inner_mul_inner]

lemma densityWeightedDivergence_conformalMatrix {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (b : OrthonormalBasis ι ℝ R3) (g : MatrixField)
    (hs : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => g x i j)) (hp : ∀ x, (g x).PosDef)
    (a f : R3 → ℝ) (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ a) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (x : R3) :
    densityWeightedDivergence b (vol (EnergyBridge.conformalMatrix g a))
        (fun y => inverseMetricOperator (EnergyBridge.conformalMatrix g a) y (gradient f y)) x =
      Real.exp (a x) * (densityWeightedDivergence b (vol g)
        (fun y => inverseMetricOperator g y (gradient f y)) x +
          vol g x * ⟪gradient a x, inverseMetricOperator g x (gradient f x)⟫_ℝ) := by
  have hflux (i : ι) :
      (fun y => vol (EnergyBridge.conformalMatrix g a) y *
        ⟪inverseMetricOperator (EnergyBridge.conformalMatrix g a) y (gradient f y), b i⟫_ℝ) =
      fun y => (Real.exp (a y) * vol g y) *
        ⟪inverseMetricOperator g y (gradient f y), b i⟫_ℝ := by
    funext y
    rw [EnergyBridge.vol_conformalMatrix, inverseMetricOperator_conformalMatrix g a hp]
    simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, inner_smul_left, starRingEnd_apply, star_trivial]
    have he : Real.exp (3 * a y) * Real.exp (-2 * a y) = Real.exp (a y) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]
      congr 1
      ring
    calc
      _ = (Real.exp (3 * a y) * Real.exp (-2 * a y)) *
        (vol g y * ⟪inverseMetricOperator g y (gradient f y), b i⟫_ℝ) := by ring
      _ = _ := by rw [he]; ring
  have hrewrite : densityWeightedDivergence b (vol (EnergyBridge.conformalMatrix g a))
      (fun y => inverseMetricOperator (EnergyBridge.conformalMatrix g a) y (gradient f y)) x =
      densityWeightedDivergence b (fun y => Real.exp (a y) * vol g y)
        (fun y => inverseMetricOperator g y (gradient f y)) x := by
    simp only [densityWeightedDivergence, hflux]
  rw [hrewrite, densityWeightedDivergence_mul_density b _ _ _ x
    ((ha.differentiable (by simp) x).exp)
    ((EnergyBridge.contDiff_vol_of_smooth_posDef g hs hp).differentiable (by simp) x)
    (((contDiff_inverseMetricOperator_of_smooth_posDef g hs hp).clm_apply
      (hf.gradient_right (m := ∞) (by simp))).differentiable (by simp) x)]
  rw [inner_gradient_left, fderiv_exp (ha.differentiable (by simp) x)]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [← inner_gradient_left]
  ring

lemma conformal_metric_divergence_quotient {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (b : OrthonormalBasis ι ℝ R3) (g : MatrixField)
    (hs : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => g x i j)) (hp : ∀ x, (g x).PosDef)
    (a f : R3 → ℝ) (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ a) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (x : R3) :
    (vol (EnergyBridge.conformalMatrix g a) x)⁻¹ *
        densityWeightedDivergence b (vol (EnergyBridge.conformalMatrix g a))
          (fun y => inverseMetricOperator (EnergyBridge.conformalMatrix g a) y (gradient f y)) x =
      Real.exp (-2 * a x) * ((vol g x)⁻¹ * densityWeightedDivergence b (vol g)
        (fun y => inverseMetricOperator g y (gradient f y)) x +
          ⟪gradient a x, inverseMetricOperator g x (gradient f x)⟫_ℝ) := by
  rw [EnergyBridge.vol_conformalMatrix, densityWeightedDivergence_conformalMatrix b g hs hp a f ha hf]
  have hv : vol g x ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (EnergyBridge.vol_pos_of_posDef g hp x)
  have he : (Real.exp (3 * a x))⁻¹ * Real.exp (a x) = Real.exp (-2 * a x) := by
    rw [← Real.exp_neg, ← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [mul_inv_rev]
  calc
    _ = ((Real.exp (3 * a x))⁻¹ * Real.exp (a x)) *
      ((vol g x)⁻¹ * densityWeightedDivergence b (vol g)
        (fun y => inverseMetricOperator g y (gradient f y)) x +
        ⟪gradient a x, inverseMetricOperator g x (gradient f x)⟫_ℝ) := by
      field_simp
    _ = _ := by rw [he]

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.AngularPolynomial

<a id="v011-source-referenceconformaldepth"></a>

### Calderon.ReferenceConformalDepth

Exact source SHA256 `13671508e33487e8ba96117c1d19af6c375c6795f71d11a2918b9db56d164a3d`. The complete module is included to expose every actual premise, conclusion, definition and proof boundary.

``````lean
import Calderon.PositiveMetricDensity
import Calderon.DepthChain

set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 10
noncomputable section
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Gradient Topology Matrix.Norms.Elementwise
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.ConformalDepth
open AngularPolynomial MetricOperator ConnectionError RadiusProfile

/-- The polynomial t₀ of the selected three-dimensional coordinate cylinder. -/
def referenceCoordinateDepth (x : R3) : ℝ := x 2 + x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2

lemma contDiff_referenceCoordinateDepth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ referenceCoordinateDepth :=
  ((EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) (2 : Fin 3)).contDiff.add
    ((EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) (0 : Fin 3)).contDiff.pow 2)).add
    ((EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) (1 : Fin 3)).contDiff.pow 2)

lemma hasFDerivAt_referenceCoordinateDepth (x : R3) :
    HasFDerivAt referenceCoordinateDepth
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) (2 : Fin 3) +
        (2 * x 0) • EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) (0 : Fin 3) +
        (2 * x 1) • EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) (1 : Fin 3)) x := by
  have h0 := (EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) (0 : Fin 3)).hasFDerivAt (x := x)
  have h1 := (EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) (1 : Fin 3)).hasFDerivAt (x := x)
  have h2 := (EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) (2 : Fin 3)).hasFDerivAt (x := x)
  convert (h2.add (h0.mul h0)).add (h1.mul h1) using 1
  · funext y
    simp only [referenceCoordinateDepth, pow_two]
    rfl
  · ext V
    simp only [add_apply, smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    change V 2 + (2 * x 0) * V 0 + (2 * x 1) * V 1 =
      V 2 + (x 0 * V 0 + x 0 * V 0) + (x 1 * V 1 + x 1 * V 1)
    ring

lemma fderiv_referenceCoordinateDepth_normal (x : R3) :
    fderiv ℝ referenceCoordinateDepth x (EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ)) = 1 := by
  rw [(hasFDerivAt_referenceCoordinateDepth x).fderiv]
  simp [EuclideanSpace.proj, PiLp.proj, PiLp.projₗ]

lemma fderiv_referenceCoordinateDepth_ne_zero (x : R3) :
    fderiv ℝ referenceCoordinateDepth x ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  have hn := fderiv_referenceCoordinateDepth_normal x
  rw [h] at hn
  simp at hn

/-- The selected reference gamma, without an exterior-admissibility claim. -/
def referenceMetric (g : MatrixField) (L : ℝ) : MatrixField :=
  EnergyBridge.conformalMatrix g (fun x => -L * referenceCoordinateDepth x)

lemma referenceMetric_smooth_entries (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L : ℝ) (i j : Fin 3) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => referenceMetric g L x i j) :=
  EnergyBridge.conformalMatrix_smooth_entries g _ hg.smooth
    (contDiff_const.mul contDiff_referenceCoordinateDepth) i j

lemma referenceMetric_posDef (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L : ℝ) (x : R3) : (referenceMetric g L x).PosDef :=
  EnergyBridge.conformalMatrix_posDef g _ hg.posDef x

lemma referenceMetric_operator_eq (g : MatrixField) (L : ℝ) (x : R3) :
    metricOperatorField (referenceMetric g L) x =
      Real.exp (-2 * L * referenceCoordinateDepth x) • metricOperatorField g x := by
  change matrixOperatorMap (Real.exp (2 * (-L * referenceCoordinateDepth x)) • g x) = _
  rw [map_smul]
  congr 1
  congr 1
  ring

/-- The transformed depth t, kept distinct from its polynomial input t₀. -/
def referenceDepth (L : ℝ) : R3 → ℝ :=
  depthFunction L (1 / 8) referenceCoordinateDepth

lemma contDiff_referenceDepth (L : ℝ) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (referenceDepth L) := by
  unfold referenceDepth depthFunction depthPrimitive
  exact (contDiff_const.sub
    ((contDiff_const.mul contDiff_referenceCoordinateDepth).exp)).div_const _

lemma hasFDerivAt_referenceDepth (L : ℝ) (hL : L ≠ 0) (x : R3) :
    HasFDerivAt (referenceDepth L)

        fderiv ℝ referenceCoordinateDepth x) x :=
  hasFDerivAt_depthFunction L (1 / 8) referenceCoordinateDepth x _ hL
    (contDiff_referenceCoordinateDepth.differentiable (by simp) x).hasFDerivAt

lemma referenceDepth_zero_neg (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) : referenceDepth L 0 < 0 := by
  change depthPrimitive L (1 / 8) (referenceCoordinateDepth 0) < 0
  simp only [referenceCoordinateDepth, PiLp.zero_apply, zero_pow (by decide : 2 ≠ 0),
    add_zero]
  exact depthPrimitive_zero_neg L (1 / 8) hL (by norm_num)

lemma fderiv_referenceDepth_ne_zero (L : ℝ) (hL : L ≠ 0) (x : R3) :
    fderiv ℝ (referenceDepth L) x ≠ 0 := by
  intro h

    (fun T : R3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => T (EuclideanSpace.single (2 : Fin 3) (1 : ℝ))) h

    zero_apply] at hn

lemma fderiv_referenceMetricOperator (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L : ℝ) (x : R3) :

      conformalMetricDerivative (Real.exp (-2 * L * referenceCoordinateDepth x)) L
        (metricOperatorField g x) (fderiv ℝ (metricOperatorField g) x)
        (fderiv ℝ referenceCoordinateDepth x) := by
  have he : metricOperatorField (referenceMetric g L) =
      fun y => Real.exp (-2 * L * referenceCoordinateDepth y) • metricOperatorField g y :=
    funext (referenceMetric_operator_eq g L)
  rw [he]
  exact (hasFDerivAt_conformalMetric L referenceCoordinateDepth (metricOperatorField g) x _ _
    (contDiff_referenceCoordinateDepth.differentiable (by simp) x).hasFDerivAt
    ((contDiff_metricOperatorField g hg).differentiable (by simp) x).hasFDerivAt).fderiv

lemma referenceMetric_connection (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L : ℝ) (x X Y : R3) :
    coordinateConnectionField (inverseMetricOperator (referenceMetric g L))
        (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric g L)) x X Y =

        (fderiv ℝ (metricOperatorField g) x) (fderiv ℝ referenceCoordinateDepth x) X Y := by
  have hi : inverseMetricOperator (referenceMetric g L) x =
      (Real.exp (-2 * L * referenceCoordinateDepth x))⁻¹ • inverseMetricOperator g x := by
    rw [referenceMetric, inverseMetricOperator_conformalMatrix g _ hg.posDef]
    congr 1
    rw [← Real.exp_neg]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [coordinateConnectionField_apply, hi, fderiv_referenceMetricOperator g hg]
  exact coordinateConnection_conformal _ L _ _ _ _ (Real.exp_ne_zero _)
    (fun V => inverseMetricField_apply_metric _ (isUnit_metricOperatorField g hg) x V)
    (fun V => metric_apply_inverseMetricField _ (isUnit_metricOperatorField g hg) x V)
    (metricOperatorField_symmetric g hg x) X Y

lemma referenceDepth_coordinateHessian (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L : ℝ) (hL : L ≠ 0) (x X Y : R3) :
    coordinateHessian (referenceDepth L)
        (fun V W => coordinateConnectionField (inverseMetricOperator (referenceMetric g L))
          (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric g L)) x V W) x X Y =
      Real.exp (-2 * L * referenceCoordinateDepth x) *
        (coordinateHessian referenceCoordinateDepth
          (fun V W => coordinateConnectionField (inverseMetricOperator g) (metricOperatorField g)
            x V W) x X Y -
            L * (fderiv ℝ referenceCoordinateDepth x
              (metricGradient (inverseMetricOperator g x) (fderiv ℝ referenceCoordinateDepth x))) *
                ⟪metricOperatorField g x X, Y⟫_ℝ) := by
  have hi : inverseMetricOperator (referenceMetric g L) x =
      (Real.exp (-2 * L * referenceCoordinateDepth x))⁻¹ • inverseMetricOperator g x := by
    rw [referenceMetric, inverseMetricOperator_conformalMatrix g _ hg.posDef]
    congr 1
    rw [← Real.exp_neg]
    congr 1
    ring
  have hsecond := (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.mp contDiff_referenceCoordinateDepth).2
  have ht := (contDiff_referenceCoordinateDepth.differentiable (by simp) x).hasFDerivAt
  have hH := (hsecond.differentiable (by simp) x).hasFDerivAt
  have hn : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, DifferentiableAt ℝ referenceCoordinateDepth y :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall (contDiff_referenceCoordinateDepth.differentiable (by simp))
  simp only [coordinateConnectionField_apply]
  change coordinateHessian (depthFunction L (1 / 8) referenceCoordinateDepth)
    (coordinateConnection (inverseMetricOperator (referenceMetric g L) x)
      (fderiv ℝ (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric g L)) x)) x X Y = _
  rw [hi, fderiv_referenceMetricOperator g hg]
  exact coordinateHessian_depthFunction L (1 / 8) referenceCoordinateDepth x _ _ _ _ _ hL ht hH hn
    (fun V => inverseMetricField_apply_metric _ (isUnit_metricOperatorField g hg) x V)
    (fun V => metric_apply_inverseMetricField _ (isUnit_metricOperatorField g hg) x V)
    (metricOperatorField_symmetric g hg x) X Y

lemma exists_referenceCoordinateDepth_hessian_upper_bound_on_compact
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ X : R3,

/-- The true covector norm, using the actual inverse metric and Riesz gradient. -/
def metricDifferentialNorm (g : MatrixField) (u : R3 → ℝ) (x : R3) : ℝ :=

lemma continuous_metricDifferentialNorm (g : MatrixField)

    (((contDiff_inverseMetricOperator_of_smooth_posDef g hs hp).continuous.clm_apply hG).inner hG)

lemma metricDifferentialNorm_pos (g : MatrixField) (hp : ∀ x, (g x).PosDef)
    (u : R3 → ℝ) (x : R3) (hdu : fderiv ℝ u x ≠ 0) :
    0 < metricDifferentialNorm g u x := by
  have hn : gradient u x ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hdu
    rw [← toDual_gradient, h, map_zero]
  unfold metricDifferentialNorm
  apply Real.sqrt_pos.mpr

    TauCeti.PDE.matrixBilinearForm_apply]
  apply (hp x).inv.dotProduct_mulVec_pos
  intro h
  apply hn
  ext i
  exact congrFun h i

    (u : R3 → ℝ) (x : R3) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hu : DifferentiableAt ℝ u x) :
    metricDifferentialNorm g (logProfile δ c p u) x =
      ((p : ℝ) * logSlope δ (u x)) * metricDifferentialNorm g u x := by
  let a : ℝ := (p : ℝ) * logSlope δ (u x)
  have ha : 0 ≤ a := mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg p) (logSlope_pos δ (u x) hδ).le
  have hg : gradient (logProfile δ c p u) x = a • gradient u x := by
    simp only [gradient, fderiv_logProfile δ c p u x hδ hu, profileDifferential]
    simp only [map_smul]
    rfl
  unfold metricDifferentialNorm
  rw [hg]
  have hq : coefficientQuadratic (inverseMetricOperator g) x (a • gradient u x) =
      a ^ 2 * coefficientQuadratic (inverseMetricOperator g) x (gradient u x) := by
    unfold coefficientQuadratic
    simp only [map_smul, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right]
    ring
  rw [hq, Real.sqrt_mul (sq_nonneg a), Real.sqrt_sq ha]

    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ L c0 c1 : ℝ, 0 < L ∧ 0 < c0 ∧ 0 < c1 ∧

  obtain ⟨L, hL, hdepth⟩ := exists_referenceDepth_strict_hessian_bound_on_compact g hg K hK

    dsimp [a]
    apply one_div_pos.mpr
    have hl : 0 < Real.log (1 + Real.exp T) := Real.log_pos (by linarith [Real.exp_pos T])

namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.ConformalDepth
open AngularPolynomial MetricOperator ConnectionError RadiusProfile

/-- The actual manuscript radius from the integrated reference depth. -/
def referenceRadius (δ R : ℝ) (p : ℕ) (L : ℝ) (x : R3) : ℝ :=
  R * (softplus δ (referenceDepth L x)) ^ p

lemma referenceRadius_pos (δ R : ℝ) (p : ℕ) (L : ℝ) (x : R3)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hR : 0 < R) : 0 < referenceRadius δ R p L x :=
  mul_pos hR (pow_pos (softplus_pos δ _ hδ) p)

lemma log_referenceRadius (δ R : ℝ) (p : ℕ) (L : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    (fun x => Real.log (referenceRadius δ R p L x)) =
      logProfile δ (Real.log R) p (referenceDepth L) := by
  funext x
  unfold referenceRadius logProfile
  rw [Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt hR) (pow_ne_zero p (ne_of_gt (softplus_pos δ _ hδ))),
    Real.log_pow]

lemma radius_gradient_power_scale_bound (δ t R C b : ℝ) (p j : ℕ)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hj : j ≤ p)
    (hbound : b ≤ (p : ℝ) * C * logSlope δ t) :
    (R * (softplus δ t) ^ p) * b ^ j ≤
      R * (p : ℝ) ^ j * C ^ j * (softplus δ t) ^ (p - j) := by
  have hs := softplus_pos δ t hδ
  have ha := logSlope_pos δ t hδ
  have hm : 0 ≤ logSlope δ t * softplus δ t := mul_nonneg ha.le hs.le
  have hm1 : logSlope δ t * softplus δ t ≤ 1 := by
    rw [logSlope_mul_softplus δ t hδ]
    exact (softplus_derivative_lt_one δ t).le
  have hpwr : (logSlope δ t * softplus δ t) ^ j ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ hm hm1
  have hpow : (softplus δ t) ^ p = (softplus δ t) ^ (p - j) * (softplus δ t) ^ j := by
    rw [← pow_add]
    congr 1
    omega
  calc
    (R * (softplus δ t) ^ p) * b ^ j ≤
        (R * (softplus δ t) ^ p) * ((p : ℝ) * C * logSlope δ t) ^ j :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ hb hbound j) (by positivity)
    _ = (R * (p : ℝ) ^ j * C ^ j * (softplus δ t) ^ (p - j)) *
        (logSlope δ t * softplus δ t) ^ j := by
      rw [hpow]
      simp only [mul_pow]
      ring
    _ ≤ (R * (p : ℝ) ^ j * C ^ j * (softplus δ t) ^ (p - j)) * 1 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpwr (by positivity)
    _ = R * (p : ℝ) ^ j * C ^ j * (softplus δ t) ^ (p - j) := mul_one _

lemma radius_gradient_power_uniform_scale_bound (δ t T R C b : ℝ) (p j : ℕ)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1) (ht : t ≤ T) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hb : 0 ≤ b) (hj : j ≤ p) (hbound : b ≤ (p : ℝ) * C * logSlope δ t) :
    (R * (softplus δ t) ^ p) * b ^ j ≤
      R * (p : ℝ) ^ j * C ^ j * (Real.log (1 + Real.exp T)) ^ (p - j) := by
  have hbase := radius_gradient_power_scale_bound δ t R C b p j hδ hR hC hb hj hbound
  have hpow := pow_le_pow_left₀ (softplus_pos δ t hδ).le
    (softplus_le_log_exp_upper δ t T hδ hδ1 ht) (p - j)
  exact hbase.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow (by positivity))

theorem exists_referenceRadius_metric_power_bounds_on_compact
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ C T : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 → ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R →
      ∀ p j : ℕ, j ≤ p → ∀ x ∈ K,
      referenceRadius δ R p L x *
          metricDifferentialNorm (referenceMetric g L)
            (fun y => Real.log (referenceRadius δ R p L y)) x ^ j ≤
        R * (p : ℝ) ^ j * C ^ j * (Real.log (1 + Real.exp T)) ^ (p - j) := by
  obtain ⟨m, C, T, hm, hC, hbounds⟩ :=
    exists_referenceDepth_metricNorm_bounds_on_compact g hg L hL K hK
  refine ⟨C, T, hC, ?_⟩
  intro δ hδ hδ1 R hR p j hj x hx
  rw [log_referenceRadius δ R p L hδ hR]
  obtain ⟨hmin, hmax, ht⟩ := hbounds x hx
  have hb : 0 ≤ metricDifferentialNorm (referenceMetric g L)
      (logProfile δ (Real.log R) p (referenceDepth L)) x := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hbound : metricDifferentialNorm (referenceMetric g L)
      (logProfile δ (Real.log R) p (referenceDepth L)) x ≤
      (p : ℝ) * C * logSlope δ (referenceDepth L x) := by
    rw [metricDifferentialNorm_logProfile _ δ (Real.log R) p _ x hδ
      ((contDiff_referenceDepth L).differentiable (by simp) x)]
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmax
      (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg p) (logSlope_pos δ (referenceDepth L x) hδ).le)
    convert h using 1 <;> ring
  exact radius_gradient_power_uniform_scale_bound δ _ T R C _ p j hδ hδ1 ht hR.le hC.le hb hj hbound

lemma referenceRadius_zero_upper_bound (δ R : ℝ) (p : ℕ) (L : ℝ)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hL : 0 < L) :
    referenceRadius δ R p L 0 ≤ R * (δ * Real.log 2) ^ p := by
  apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ hR
  exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (softplus_pos δ _ hδ).le
    (softplus_le_delta_log_two δ _ hδ (referenceDepth_zero_neg L hL).le) p

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.ConformalDepth

``````

/-- The normalized coefficient dilation used by the manuscript. -/
def dilatedMetric (g : MatrixField) (lam : ℝ) : MatrixField := fun x => g (lam • x)

    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) :

lemma exists_referenceDepth_frechet_bounds_on_compact (L : ℝ)

    (hP : 1 ≤ P) (ha0 : 0 < a0) (ha : a0 ≤ a) (hm : 0 < m)
    (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hbeta : P * a * m ≤ beta)

    n ≤ ((B / a0 + A ^ 2) / m ^ 2) * beta ^ 2 := by
  have hapos : 0 < a := ha0.trans_le ha
  have hpa : a0 ≤ P * a := by nlinarith
  have halpha : 0 ≤ P * a := mul_nonneg (by linarith) hapos.le
  have hfirst : P * a * B ≤ (B / a0) * (P * a) ^ 2 := by
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpa (mul_nonneg halpha hB)
    have hr : P * a * B ≤ ((P * a) ^ 2 * B) / a0 :=

    convert hr using 1 <;> ring
  have hp2 : P ≤ P ^ 2 := by nlinarith

      (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : R3 => (lam, y)))
    exact h
  have hbetaDer := hasFDerivAt_metricDifferentialNorm_logProfile G δ (Real.log R) p _
    (contDiff_referenceDepth L) x hδ (hbase.differentiable (by simp) x)
  obtain ⟨hmin, hmax, ht⟩ := hbounds lam hlam x hx
  have hD1 := (hjets x hx).1
  have hDb := hbder lam hlam x hx
  have ha := logSlope_pos δ (referenceDepth L x) hδ
  have halpha : 0 ≤ (p : ℝ) * logSlope δ (referenceDepth L x) := mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg p) ha.le
  have hbetaLower : (p : ℝ) * logSlope δ (referenceDepth L x) * m ≤ beta x := by
    dsimp [beta]
    rw [metricDifferentialNorm_logProfile _ δ (Real.log R) p _ x hδ
      ((contDiff_referenceDepth L).differentiable (by simp) x)]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmin halpha
  have hpR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hp
  have hbetaPos : 0 < beta x := (show 0 < (p : ℝ) * logSlope δ (referenceDepth L x) * m by positivity).trans_le hbetaLower
  have hn := norm_fderiv_metricDifferentialNorm_logProfile_le G δ (Real.log R) p _
    (contDiff_referenceDepth L) x hδ (hbase.differentiable (by simp) x)
  have hproduct : ‖fderiv ℝ (referenceDepth L) x‖ * metricDifferentialNorm G (referenceDepth L) x ≤ A * C :=
    mul_le_mul hD1 hmax (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hA
  have hAC : A * C ≤ (A + C) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg A, sq_nonneg C]
  have hterm1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hproduct.trans hAC)
    (show 0 ≤ (p : ℝ) * (logSlope δ (referenceDepth L x)) ^ 2 by positivity)
  have hterm2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hDb halpha
  have hupper : ‖fderiv ℝ beta x‖ ≤
      (p : ℝ) * logSlope δ (referenceDepth L x) * B +
      (p : ℝ) * (logSlope δ (referenceDepth L x)) ^ 2 * (A + C) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hn, hterm1, hterm2]
  have hbound : ‖fderiv ℝ beta x‖ ≤ S * (beta x) ^ 2 :=
    profile_second_norm_le_beta_square (p : ℝ) _ a0 m (A + C) B (beta x) _ hpR ha0
      (logSlope_uniform_lower_bound δ _ T hδ hδ1 ht) hm (by positivity) hB hbetaLower hupper
  have hfinal : ‖fderiv ℝ beta x‖ ≤ (S + 1) * (beta x) ^ 2 :=
    hbound.trans (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (beta x)])
  refine ⟨hfinal, ?_⟩
  have hinv : fderiv ℝ (fun y => (beta y)⁻¹) x =
      -((beta x) ^ 2)⁻¹ • fderiv ℝ beta x := by
    change fderiv ℝ ((fun y : ℝ => y⁻¹) ∘ beta) x = _
    rw [hbetaDer.fderiv]
    exact ((hasDerivAt_inv (ne_of_gt hbetaPos)).comp_hasFDerivAt x hbetaDer).fderiv
  change ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => (beta y)⁻¹) x‖ ≤ S + 1
  rw [hinv]
  simp only [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_neg, abs_inv, abs_pow,
    abs_of_pos hbetaPos]
  have hr := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfinal (show 0 ≤ ((beta x) ^ 2)⁻¹ by positivity)
  have he : ((beta x) ^ 2)⁻¹ * ((S + 1) * (beta x) ^ 2) = S + 1 := by
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hbetaPos]
  rw [he] at hr
  exact hr

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.ConformalDepth

``````

### Calderon.DilatedRadiusSmallness

Exact source SHA256 `ccd00ce392530d0a3691b028a70225dbaf781777a656f6b131b12d17a12212cc`. The complete module is included to expose every actual premise, conclusion, definition and proof boundary.

``````lean
import Calderon.DilatedProfileBeta

set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 10
noncomputable section
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Gradient Topology Matrix.Norms.Elementwise
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.ConformalDepth
open AngularPolynomial MetricOperator ConnectionError RadiusProfile

lemma hasFDerivAt_referenceRadius (δ R : ℝ) (p : ℕ) (L : ℝ) (x : R3) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    HasFDerivAt (referenceRadius δ R p L)
      ((R * (p : ℝ) * softplus δ (referenceDepth L x) ^ (p - 1) *
        (Real.exp (referenceDepth L x / δ) / (1 + Real.exp (referenceDepth L x / δ)))) •
        fderiv ℝ (referenceDepth L) x) x := by
  have h := (hasDerivAt_softplus δ (referenceDepth L x) (ne_of_gt hδ)).comp_hasFDerivAt x
    ((contDiff_referenceDepth L).differentiable (by simp) x).hasFDerivAt
  convert (h.pow p).const_smul R using 1 <;>
    simp [Function.comp_def, smul_smul, mul_assoc]
  funext y
  rfl

theorem exists_dilated_referenceRadius_uniform_amplitude_bounds
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ L : ℝ, 0 < L ∧ ∀ p : ℕ, 2 ≤ p → ∃ A1 A2 : ℝ, 0 < A1 ∧ 0 < A2 ∧
      ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 → ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → ∀ x ∈ K,
        ‖fderiv ℝ (referenceRadius δ R p L) x‖ ≤ R * A1 ∧
        referenceRadius δ R p L x *
          metricDifferentialNorm (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L)
            (fun y => Real.log (referenceRadius δ R p L y)) x ^ 2 ≤ R * A2 := by
  obtain ⟨L, hL, hdepth⟩ := exists_dilated_referenceDepth_uniform_strict_hessian_bound g hg K hK
  obtain ⟨m, C, T, hm, hC, hbounds⟩ :=
    exists_dilatedReferenceDepth_uniform_metricNorm_bounds g hg L hL K hK
  obtain ⟨A, B, hA, hB, hjets⟩ := exists_referenceDepth_frechet_bounds_on_compact L K hK
  let M := Real.log (1 + Real.exp T)
  have hM : 0 < M := log_exp_add_one_pos T
  refine ⟨L, hL, ?_⟩
  intro p hp
  let A1 := (p : ℝ) * M ^ (p - 1) * A + 1
  let A2 := (p : ℝ) ^ 2 * C ^ 2 * M ^ (p - 2) + 1
  have hA1 : 0 < A1 := by dsimp [A1]; positivity
  have hA2 : 0 < A2 := by dsimp [A2]; positivity
  refine ⟨A1, A2, hA1, hA2, ?_⟩
  intro lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR x hx
  obtain ⟨hmin, hmax, ht⟩ := hbounds lam hlam x hx
  have hs := softplus_le_log_exp_upper δ (referenceDepth L x) T hδ hδ1 ht
  have hq := (softplus_derivative_lt_one δ (referenceDepth L x)).le
  have hs0 := (softplus_pos δ (referenceDepth L x) hδ).le
  have hq0 := (softplus_derivative_pos δ (referenceDepth L x)).le
  have hpow := pow_le_pow_left₀ hs0 hs (p - 1)
  have hn : ‖fderiv ℝ (referenceRadius δ R p L) x‖ ≤
      R * (p : ℝ) * M ^ (p - 1) * A := by
    rw [(hasFDerivAt_referenceRadius δ R p L x hδ).fderiv, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : 0 ≤ R * (p : ℝ) * softplus δ (referenceDepth L x) ^ (p - 1) *
        (Real.exp (referenceDepth L x / δ) / (1 + Real.exp (referenceDepth L x / δ))))]
    have h1 := mul_le_mul hq (hjets x hx).1 (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
    have h2 := mul_le_mul hpow h1 (by positivity) (pow_nonneg hM.le _)
    have h3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (mul_nonneg hR.le (Nat.cast_nonneg p))
    nlinarith [h3]
  refine ⟨hn.trans (by dsimp [A1]; nlinarith), ?_⟩
  rw [log_referenceRadius δ R p L hδ hR]
  have hb : 0 ≤ metricDifferentialNorm (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L)
      (logProfile δ (Real.log R) p (referenceDepth L)) x := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hbound : metricDifferentialNorm (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L)
      (logProfile δ (Real.log R) p (referenceDepth L)) x ≤
      (p : ℝ) * C * logSlope δ (referenceDepth L x) := by
    rw [metricDifferentialNorm_logProfile _ δ (Real.log R) p _ x hδ
      ((contDiff_referenceDepth L).differentiable (by simp) x)]
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmax
      (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg p) (logSlope_pos δ (referenceDepth L x) hδ).le)
    convert h using 1 <;> ring
  have hr := radius_gradient_power_uniform_scale_bound δ _ T R C _ p 2 hδ hδ1 ht hR.le hC.le hb hp hbound
  exact hr.trans (by dsimp [A2, M]; nlinarith)

theorem exists_dilated_referenceRadius_uniform_small_amplitude
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (p : ℕ) (hp : 2 ≤ p) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ L R : ℝ, 0 < L ∧ 0 < R ∧ ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 → ∀ x ∈ K,
        ‖fderiv ℝ (referenceRadius δ R p L) x‖ ≤ ε ∧
        referenceRadius δ R p L x *
          metricDifferentialNorm (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L)
            (fun y => Real.log (referenceRadius δ R p L y)) x ^ 2 ≤ ε := by
  obtain ⟨L, hL, hb⟩ := exists_dilated_referenceRadius_uniform_amplitude_bounds g hg K hK
  obtain ⟨A1, A2, hA1, hA2, hbounds⟩ := hb p hp
  let R := ε / (A1 + A2 + 1)
  have hden : 0 < A1 + A2 + 1 := by positivity
  have hR : 0 < R := div_pos hε hden
  have he : R * (A1 + A2 + 1) = ε := by dsimp [R]; field_simp
  have h1 : R * A1 ≤ ε := by nlinarith
  have h2 : R * A2 ≤ ε := by nlinarith
  exact ⟨L, R, hL, hR, fun lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 x hx =>
    ⟨((hbounds lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR x hx).1).trans h1,
      ((hbounds lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR x hx).2).trans h2⟩⟩

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.ConformalDepth

``````

``````lean
import Calderon.DetIdentity
import Calderon.MetricSmooth
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.StdBasis
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Sqrt
import Mathlib.Tactic

noncomputable section
open scoped Matrix.Norms.Operator ContDiff
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.MetricVolume

abbrev Mat := Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ

def determinantDerivative (M : Mat) : Mat →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  M.det • ((Matrix.traceLinearMap (Fin 3) ℝ ℝ).toContinuousLinearMap.comp
    (LinearMap.mulLeft ℝ (M⁻¹)).toContinuousLinearMap)

lemma determinantDerivative_apply (M H : Mat) :
    determinantDerivative M H = M.det * Matrix.trace (M⁻¹ * H) := rfl

lemma hasFDerivAt_det_of_isUnit (M : Mat) (hM : IsUnit M.det) :
    HasFDerivAt (Matrix.det : Mat → ℝ) (determinantDerivative M) M := by
  let L : Mat →L[ℝ] Mat := (LinearMap.mulLeft ℝ (M⁻¹)).toContinuousLinearMap
  have hL : L M = 1 := Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul M hM
  have hI : HasFDerivAt (Matrix.det : Mat → ℝ)
      (Matrix.traceLinearMap (Fin 3) ℝ ℝ).toContinuousLinearMap (L M) := by
    rw [hL]
    exact Matrix.hasFDerivAt_det_one
  have h := (hI.comp M L.hasFDerivAt).const_mul M.det
  have hprod : M.det * (M⁻¹).det = 1 := by
    rw [← Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv M hM, Matrix.det_one]
  have he : (fun Y : Mat => M.det * Matrix.det (L Y)) = Matrix.det := by
    funext Y
    change M.det * Matrix.det (M⁻¹ * Y) = Matrix.det Y
    rw [Matrix.det_mul, ← mul_assoc, hprod, one_mul]
  change HasFDerivAt (fun Y : Mat => M.det * Matrix.det (L Y))
    (determinantDerivative M) M at h
  rwa [he] at h

def matrixFieldDerivative (g : MatrixField) (x : R3) : R3 →L[ℝ] Mat :=
  ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
    (fderiv ℝ (fun y => g y i j) x).smulRight (Matrix.single i j (1 : ℝ))

lemma matrixFieldDerivative_apply_entry (g : MatrixField) (x V : R3) (i j : Fin 3) :
    matrixFieldDerivative g x V i j = fderiv ℝ (fun y => g y i j) x V := by
  classical
  have h := Matrix.sum_sum_single (fun a b : Fin 3 =>
    fderiv ℝ (fun y => g y a b) x V)
  simpa [matrixFieldDerivative] using congrArg (fun H : Mat => H i j) h

lemma hasFDerivAt_matrixField_of_entries (g : MatrixField) (x : R3)
    (hg : ∀ i j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => g y i j) x) :
    HasFDerivAt g (matrixFieldDerivative g x) x := by
  classical
  have h : HasFDerivAt
      (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, g y i j • Matrix.single i j (1 : ℝ))
      (matrixFieldDerivative g x) x :=
    HasFDerivAt.fun_sum fun i _ => HasFDerivAt.fun_sum fun j _ =>
      (hg i j).hasFDerivAt.smul_const (Matrix.single i j (1 : ℝ))
  have he : (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      g y i j • Matrix.single i j (1 : ℝ)) = g := by
    funext y
    calc
      _ = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Matrix.single i j (g y i j) := by simp
      _ = Matrix.of (g y) := Matrix.sum_sum_single (g y)
      _ = g y := by ext i j; rfl
  rwa [he] at h

lemma hasFDerivAt_metric_determinant (g : MatrixField) (x : R3)
    (hg : ∀ i j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => g y i j) x)
    (hp : (g x).PosDef) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun y => (g y).det)
      ((determinantDerivative (g x)).comp (matrixFieldDerivative g x)) x :=
  (hasFDerivAt_det_of_isUnit (g x) (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hp.det_pos.ne')).comp x
    (hasFDerivAt_matrixField_of_entries g x hg)

lemma fderiv_vol_apply (g : MatrixField) (x V : R3)
    (hg : ∀ i j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => g y i j) x)
    (hp : (g x).PosDef) :
    fderiv ℝ (vol g) x V = (vol g x / 2) *
      Matrix.trace ((g x)⁻¹ * matrixFieldDerivative g x V) := by
  have hd := hasFDerivAt_metric_determinant g x hg hp
  have hs := hd.sqrt hp.det_pos.ne'
  change HasFDerivAt (vol g) ((1 / (2 * vol g x)) •
    (determinantDerivative (g x)).comp (matrixFieldDerivative g x)) x at hs
  have hsq : (vol g x) ^ 2 = (g x).det := Real.sq_sqrt hp.det_pos.le
  have hv : vol g x ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hp.det_pos).ne'
  rw [hs.fderiv]
  simp only [smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
    smul_eq_mul, determinantDerivative_apply]
  change (1 / (2 * vol g x)) * ((g x).det * _) = _
  rw [← hsq]
  field_simp [hv]

lemma fderiv_vol_apply_entries (g : MatrixField) (x V : R3)
    (hg : ∀ i j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => g y i j) x)
    (hp : (g x).PosDef) :
    fderiv ℝ (vol g) x V = (vol g x / 2) *
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        (g x)⁻¹ j i * fderiv ℝ (fun y => g y i j) x V := by
  rw [fderiv_vol_apply g x V hg hp]
  congr 1
  simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Matrix.mul_apply, matrixFieldDerivative_apply_entry]
  exact Finset.sum_comm

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.MetricVolume

``````

import Calderon.MetricVolumeDifferential
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FDeriv.Mul

noncomputable section
open scoped Matrix.Norms.Operator
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.MetricVolume

def inverseMatrixDerivative (M : Mat) : Mat →L[ℝ] Mat :=
  -ContinuousLinearMap.mulLeftRight ℝ Mat M⁻¹ M⁻¹

lemma inverseMatrixDerivative_apply (M H : Mat) :
    inverseMatrixDerivative M H = -(M⁻¹ * H * M⁻¹) := rfl

lemma hasFDerivAt_inverseMatrix_of_isUnit (M : Mat) (hM : IsUnit M) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun Y : Mat => Y⁻¹) (inverseMatrixDerivative M) M := by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hM
  have hi : (↑u⁻¹ : Mat) = M⁻¹ := by
    rw [Matrix.nonsing_inv_eq_ringInverse, ← hu, Ring.inverse_unit]
  have he : (Ring.inverse : Mat → Mat) = fun Y : Mat => Y⁻¹ := by
    funext Y
    exact (Matrix.nonsing_inv_eq_ringInverse Y).symm
  have h := hasFDerivAt_ringInverse (𝕜 := ℝ) u
  rw [he, hi, hu] at h
  exact h

lemma hasFDerivAt_inverseMetric_matrix (g : MatrixField) (x : R3)
    (hg : ∀ i j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => g y i j) x)
    (hp : (g x).PosDef) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun y => (g y)⁻¹)
      ((inverseMatrixDerivative (g x)).comp (matrixFieldDerivative g x)) x :=
  (hasFDerivAt_inverseMatrix_of_isUnit (g x) hp.isUnit).comp x
    (hasFDerivAt_matrixField_of_entries g x hg)

lemma fderiv_inverseMetric_matrix_apply (g : MatrixField) (x V : R3)
    (hg : ∀ i j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => g y i j) x)
    (hp : (g x).PosDef) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun y => (g y)⁻¹) x V =
      -((g x)⁻¹ * matrixFieldDerivative g x V * (g x)⁻¹) := by
  rw [(hasFDerivAt_inverseMetric_matrix g x hg hp).fderiv]
  rfl

lemma fderiv_inverseMetric_entry_apply (g : MatrixField) (x V : R3)
    (hg : ∀ i j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => g y i j) x)
    (hp : (g x).PosDef) (i j : Fin 3) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun y => (g y)⁻¹ i j) x V =
      -∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (g x)⁻¹ i a * fderiv ℝ (fun y => g y a b) x V * (g x)⁻¹ b j := by
  let E : Mat →L[ℝ] ℝ := (Matrix.entryLinearMap ℝ ℝ i j).toContinuousLinearMap
  have h := E.hasFDerivAt.comp x (hasFDerivAt_inverseMetric_matrix g x hg hp)
  change HasFDerivAt (fun y => (g y)⁻¹ i j)
    (E.comp ((inverseMatrixDerivative (g x)).comp (matrixFieldDerivative g x))) x at h
  rw [h.fderiv]
  change -((g x)⁻¹ * matrixFieldDerivative g x V * (g x)⁻¹) i j = _
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, matrixFieldDerivative_apply_entry,
    Matrix.neg_apply, Finset.sum_mul]
  congr 1
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.MetricVolume

import Calderon.MetricVolumeDifferential
import Calderon.MetricOperator

noncomputable section
open scoped Matrix.Norms.Operator InnerProductSpace
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.MetricVolume

def coordinateVector (i : Fin 3) : R3 := EuclideanSpace.single i 1

def matrixOperatorMapOp : Mat →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3 :=
  MetricOperator.matrixOperatorAlgEquiv.toLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap

lemma matrixOperatorMapOp_apply (M : Mat) (V : R3) :
    matrixOperatorMapOp M V = M.toEuclideanLin V := rfl

lemma matrixOperator_coordinate (M : Mat) (V : R3) (i : Fin 3) :
    (MetricOperator.matrixOperatorMap M V) i = ∑ j : Fin 3, M i j * V j := rfl

lemma matrixOperator_basis_inner (M : Mat) (i j : Fin 3) :
    ⟪MetricOperator.matrixOperatorMap M (coordinateVector j), coordinateVector i⟫_ℝ = M i j := by
  simp only [coordinateVector, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right, one_mul, conj_trivial]
  rw [matrixOperator_coordinate]
  simp [PiLp.single_apply]

lemma hasFDerivAt_actualMetricOperator (g : MatrixField) (x : R3)
    (hg : ∀ i j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => g y i j) x) :
    HasFDerivAt (MetricOperator.metricOperatorField g)
      (matrixOperatorMapOp.comp (matrixFieldDerivative g x)) x := by
  exact matrixOperatorMapOp.hasFDerivAt.comp x (hasFDerivAt_matrixField_of_entries g x hg)

lemma metricOperator_derivative_entry (g : MatrixField) (x V : R3)
    (hg : ∀ i j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => g y i j) x) (i j : Fin 3) :
    ⟪fderiv ℝ (MetricOperator.metricOperatorField g) x V (coordinateVector j),
      coordinateVector i⟫_ℝ = fderiv ℝ (fun y => g y i j) x V := by
  rw [(hasFDerivAt_actualMetricOperator g x hg).fderiv]
  change ⟪MetricOperator.matrixOperatorMap (matrixFieldDerivative g x V)
      (coordinateVector j), coordinateVector i⟫_ℝ = _
  rw [matrixOperator_basis_inner, matrixFieldDerivative_apply_entry]

lemma riesz_coordinate (F : R3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (i : Fin 3) :
    ((InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ R3).symm F) i = F (coordinateVector i) := by
  have h := InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) (x := coordinateVector i) (y := F)
  rw [← h]
  simp only [coordinateVector, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right, one_mul, conj_trivial]

def metricChristoffel (g : MatrixField) (x : R3) (i j k : Fin 3) : ℝ :=
  (ConnectionError.coordinateConnectionField
    (fun y => MetricOperator.matrixOperatorMap ((g y)⁻¹))
    (MetricOperator.metricOperatorField g) x (coordinateVector i) (coordinateVector j)) k

lemma metricChristoffel_eq (g : MatrixField) (x : R3)
    (hg : ∀ i j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => g y i j) x) (i j k : Fin 3) :
    metricChristoffel g x i j k = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑ c : Fin 3,
      (g x)⁻¹ k c * (fderiv ℝ (fun y => g y c j) x (coordinateVector i) +
        fderiv ℝ (fun y => g y c i) x (coordinateVector j) -
        fderiv ℝ (fun y => g y j i) x (coordinateVector c)) := by
  unfold metricChristoffel
  rw [ConnectionError.coordinateConnectionField_apply]
  simp only [ConnectionError.coordinateConnection, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [matrixOperator_coordinate]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro c _
  rw [riesz_coordinate, ConnectionError.koszulFunctional_apply]
  rw [metricOperator_derivative_entry g x (coordinateVector i) hg c j,
    metricOperator_derivative_entry g x (coordinateVector j) hg c i,
    metricOperator_derivative_entry g x (coordinateVector c) hg j i]

``````lean
import Calderon.MetricInverseDifferential
import Calderon.MetricKoszulCoordinates

noncomputable section
open scoped Matrix.Norms.Operator InnerProductSpace
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.MetricVolume

lemma inverseMetric_symmetric (g : MatrixField) (x : R3) (hp : (g x).PosDef)
    (i j : Fin 3) : (g x)⁻¹ i j = (g x)⁻¹ j i := by
  simpa using (hp.inv.isHermitian.apply j i)

lemma metricDerivative_symmetric (g : MatrixField) (x V : R3)
    (hp : ∀ y, (g y).PosDef) (i j : Fin 3) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun y => g y i j) x V = fderiv ℝ (fun y => g y j i) x V := by
  have he : (fun y => g y i j) = (fun y => g y j i) := by
    funext y
    simpa using ((hp y).isHermitian.apply j i)
  rw [he]

lemma symmetric_koszul_contraction (Q : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (D : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (rho : ℝ)
    (hQ : ∀ i j, Q i j = Q j i) (hD : ∀ i a b, D i a b = D i b a)
    (j : Fin 3) :
    (∑ i : Fin 3, (((rho / 2) * (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Q b a * D i a b)) * Q i j -
      rho * (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Q i a * D i a b * Q b j))) =
    -rho * ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Q a b * ((1 / 2 : ℝ) *
      ∑ c : Fin 3, Q j c * (D a c b + D b c a - D c b a)) := by
  fin_cases j <;>
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_succ, Finset.univ_eq_empty, add_zero, Finset.sum_empty, Fin.succ_zero_eq_one, Fin.succ_one_eq_two]
  all_goals
    simp only [show (⟨0, by decide⟩ : Fin 3) = 0 from rfl,
      show (⟨1, by decide⟩ : Fin 3) = 1 from rfl,
      show (⟨2, by decide⟩ : Fin 3) = 2 from rfl]
    simp only [hQ 1 0, hQ 2 0, hQ 2 1,
      hD 0 1 0, hD 0 2 0, hD 0 2 1,
      hD 1 1 0, hD 1 2 0, hD 1 2 1,
      hD 2 1 0, hD 2 2 0, hD 2 2 1]
    ring

lemma fderiv_densityInverse_entry (g : MatrixField) (x V : R3)
    (hg : ∀ i j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => g y i j) x)
    (hp : (g x).PosDef) (i j : Fin 3) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun y => vol g y * (g y)⁻¹ i j) x V =
      ((vol g x / 2) * ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (g x)⁻¹ b a * fderiv ℝ (fun y => g y a b) x V) * (g x)⁻¹ i j -
      vol g x * ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (g x)⁻¹ i a * fderiv ℝ (fun y => g y a b) x V * (g x)⁻¹ b j := by
  have hv : DifferentiableAt ℝ (vol g) x :=
    ((hasFDerivAt_metric_determinant g x hg hp).sqrt hp.det_pos.ne').differentiableAt
  let E : Mat →L[ℝ] ℝ := (Matrix.entryLinearMap ℝ ℝ i j).toContinuousLinearMap
  have hi : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (g y)⁻¹ i j) x :=
    (E.hasFDerivAt.comp x (hasFDerivAt_inverseMetric_matrix g x hg hp)).differentiableAt
  rw [fderiv_fun_mul hv hi]
  simp only [add_apply, smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [fderiv_vol_apply_entries g x V hg hp, fderiv_inverseMetric_entry_apply g x V hg hp]
  ring

lemma densityInverse_connection_contraction (g : MatrixField) (x : R3)
    (hg : ∀ i j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => g y i j) x)
    (hp : ∀ y, (g y).PosDef) (j : Fin 3) :
    (∑ i : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (fun y => vol g y * (g y)⁻¹ i j) x (coordinateVector i)) =
      -vol g x * ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        (g x)⁻¹ a b * metricChristoffel g x a b j := by
  simp_rw [fderiv_densityInverse_entry g x _ hg (hp x), metricChristoffel_eq g x hg]
  exact symmetric_koszul_contraction (fun a b => ((g x)⁻¹ : Mat) a b)
    (fun i a b => fderiv ℝ (fun y => g y a b) x (coordinateVector i))
    (vol g x) (inverseMetric_symmetric g x (hp x))
    (fun i a b => metricDerivative_symmetric g x (coordinateVector i) hp a b) j

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.MetricVolume

``````

``````lean
import Calderon.MetricDensityConnection
import Calderon.AngularEuclideanDensity
import Calderon.ProfileChain

noncomputable section
open scoped Matrix.Norms.Operator InnerProductSpace Gradient
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.MetricVolume

lemma inverseMetricField_eq_matrix_inverse_of_posDef (g : MatrixField) (x : R3)
    (hp : (g x).PosDef) :
    ConnectionError.inverseMetricField (MetricOperator.metricOperatorField g) x =
      MetricOperator.matrixOperatorMap ((g x)⁻¹) := by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hp.isUnit
  change Ring.inverse (MetricOperator.matrixOperatorAlgEquiv (g x)) =
    MetricOperator.matrixOperatorAlgEquiv ((g x)⁻¹)
  rw [← hu, Matrix.nonsing_inv_eq_ringInverse, Ring.inverse_unit]
  change Ring.inverse ((Units.map MetricOperator.matrixOperatorAlgEquiv.toMonoidHom u).val) =
    ((Units.map MetricOperator.matrixOperatorAlgEquiv.toMonoidHom u)⁻¹).val
  rw [Ring.inverse_unit]

lemma gradient_coordinate (f : R3 → ℝ) (x : R3) (i : Fin 3) :
    (gradient f x) i = fderiv ℝ f x (coordinateVector i) := by
  rw [← inner_gradient_left]
  simp only [coordinateVector, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right, one_mul, conj_trivial]

lemma covector_coordinate_sum (F : R3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (V : R3) :
    F V = ∑ i : Fin 3, V i * F (coordinateVector i) := by
  nth_rw 1 [← (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).sum_repr V]
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul, EuclideanSpace.basisFun_repr,
    EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply, smul_eq_mul, coordinateVector]

lemma derivative_covector_entry (f : R3 → ℝ) (x V : R3)
    (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x) (j : Fin 3) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y (coordinateVector j)) x V =
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x V (coordinateVector j) := by
  rw [fderiv_clm_apply hf (differentiableAt_const (coordinateVector j))]
  simp

lemma derivative_density_gradient_entry (g : MatrixField) (f : R3 → ℝ) (x : R3)
    (hg : ∀ i j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => g y i j) x) (hp : (g x).PosDef)
    (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x) (i : Fin 3) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun y => vol g y *
      (MetricOperator.matrixOperatorMap ((g y)⁻¹) (gradient f y)) i) x (coordinateVector i) =
      ∑ j : Fin 3, (
        fderiv ℝ (fun y => vol g y * (g y)⁻¹ i j) x (coordinateVector i) *
          fderiv ℝ f x (coordinateVector j) +
        vol g x * (g x)⁻¹ i j *
          fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x (coordinateVector i) (coordinateVector j)) := by
  have he : (fun y => vol g y *
      (MetricOperator.matrixOperatorMap ((g y)⁻¹) (gradient f y)) i) =
    (fun y => ∑ j : Fin 3, (vol g y * (g y)⁻¹ i j) *
      fderiv ℝ f y (coordinateVector j)) := by
    funext y
    simp_rw [matrixOperator_coordinate, gradient_coordinate, Finset.mul_sum, mul_assoc]
  have hv : DifferentiableAt ℝ (vol g) x :=
    ((hasFDerivAt_metric_determinant g x hg hp).sqrt hp.det_pos.ne').differentiableAt
  have hi (j : Fin 3) : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => (g y)⁻¹ i j) x := by
    let E : Mat →L[ℝ] ℝ := (Matrix.entryLinearMap ℝ ℝ i j).toContinuousLinearMap
    exact (E.hasFDerivAt.comp x (hasFDerivAt_inverseMetric_matrix g x hg hp)).differentiableAt
  have hf' (j : Fin 3) : DifferentiableAt ℝ
      (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y (coordinateVector j)) x :=
    hf.clm_apply (differentiableAt_const (coordinateVector j))
  rw [he, fderiv_fun_sum (u := Finset.univ)
    (A := fun j y => (vol g y * (g y)⁻¹ i j) * fderiv ℝ f y (coordinateVector j))
    (fun j _ => (hv.mul (hi j)).mul (hf' j))]
  simp only [sum_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  rw [fderiv_fun_mul (c := fun y => vol g y * ((g y)⁻¹ : Mat) i j)
    (d := fun y => fderiv ℝ f y (coordinateVector j)) (hv.mul (hi j)) (hf' j)]
  simp only [add_apply, smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [derivative_covector_entry f x _ hf j]
  ring

lemma finite_divergence_trace (A Q H : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (G : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (F : Fin 3 → ℝ) (rho : ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ j, (∑ i : Fin 3, A i j) = -rho * ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, Q a b * G a b j) :
    (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (A i j * F j + rho * Q i j * H i j)) =
      rho * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, Q i j * (H i j - ∑ k : Fin 3, G i j k * F k) := by
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm (f := fun i j => A i j * F j)]
  simp_rw [← Finset.sum_mul, hA]
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_succ, Finset.univ_eq_empty, Finset.sum_empty, add_zero,
    Fin.succ_zero_eq_one, Fin.succ_one_eq_two]
  ring

lemma densityWeightedDivergence_eq_metricHessian_trace (g : MatrixField) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (x : R3) (hg : ∀ i j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => g y i j) x)
    (hp : ∀ y, (g y).PosDef) (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x) :
    AngularPolynomial.densityWeightedDivergence (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ)
      (vol g) (fun y => MetricOperator.matrixOperatorMap ((g y)⁻¹) (gradient f y)) x =
    vol g x * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (g x)⁻¹ i j *
      RadiusProfile.coordinateHessian f
        (fun X Y => ConnectionError.coordinateConnectionField
          (ConnectionError.inverseMetricField (MetricOperator.metricOperatorField g))
          (MetricOperator.metricOperatorField g) x X Y) x (coordinateVector i) (coordinateVector j) := by
  have hH (i j : Fin 3) : RadiusProfile.coordinateHessian f
      (fun X Y => ConnectionError.coordinateConnectionField
        (ConnectionError.inverseMetricField (MetricOperator.metricOperatorField g))
        (MetricOperator.metricOperatorField g) x X Y) x (coordinateVector i) (coordinateVector j) =
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x (coordinateVector i) (coordinateVector j) -
        ∑ k : Fin 3, metricChristoffel g x i j k * fderiv ℝ f x (coordinateVector k) := by
    unfold RadiusProfile.coordinateHessian
    rw [covector_coordinate_sum (fderiv ℝ f x)]
    congr 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro k _
    congr 1
    unfold metricChristoffel
    simp only [ConnectionError.coordinateConnectionField_apply,
      inverseMetricField_eq_matrix_inverse_of_posDef g x (hp x)]
  unfold AngularPolynomial.densityWeightedDivergence
  simp only [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right, one_mul,
    conj_trivial]
  change (∑ i : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (fun y => vol g y *
    (MetricOperator.matrixOperatorMap ((g y)⁻¹) (gradient f y)) i) x (coordinateVector i)) = _
  simp_rw [derivative_density_gradient_entry g f x hg (hp x) hf, hH]
  exact finite_divergence_trace
    (fun i j => fderiv ℝ (fun y => vol g y * (g y)⁻¹ i j) x (coordinateVector i))
    (fun i j => ((g x)⁻¹ : Mat) i j)
    (fun i j => fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x (coordinateVector i) (coordinateVector j))
    (metricChristoffel g x) (fun j => fderiv ℝ f x (coordinateVector j)) (vol g x)
    (densityInverse_connection_contraction g x hg hp)

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.MetricVolume

``````

``````lean
import Calderon.MetricVolumeDifferential
import Mathlib.Analysis.Matrix.Order

noncomputable section
open scoped MatrixOrder Matrix.Norms.L2Operator
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.MetricVolume

lemma trace_mul_nonneg_of_posSemidef (A B : Mat) (hA : A.PosSemidef) (hB : B.PosSemidef) :
    0 ≤ Matrix.trace (A * B) := by
  let S : Mat := CFC.sqrt A
  have hS : S.PosSemidef := Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp (CFC.sqrt_nonneg A)
  have hsq : S * S = A := by
    simpa only [S, pow_two] using CFC.sq_sqrt A hA.nonneg
  have ht := (hB.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same S).trace_nonneg
  rw [hS.isHermitian.eq, Matrix.trace_mul_cycle, hsq] at ht
  exact ht

lemma trace_inverse_metric_negative_le (M H : Mat) (a : ℝ) (hM : M.PosDef)
    (hH : (-H - a • M).PosSemidef) :
    Matrix.trace (M⁻¹ * H) ≤ -3 * a := by
  have h := trace_mul_nonneg_of_posSemidef M⁻¹ (-H - a • M) hM.inv.posSemidef hH
  have hunit : IsUnit M.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hM.det_pos.ne'
  rw [Matrix.mul_sub, Matrix.mul_neg, Matrix.mul_smul, Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul M hunit,
    Matrix.trace_sub, Matrix.trace_neg, Matrix.trace_smul, Matrix.trace_one] at h
  norm_num at h
  linarith

lemma trace_inverse_eq_coordinate_contraction (M H : Mat) (hM : M.PosDef) :
    Matrix.trace (M⁻¹ * H) = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M⁻¹ i j * H i j := by
  have hs (i j : Fin 3) : M⁻¹ i j = M⁻¹ j i := by
    simpa using (hM.inv.isHermitian.apply j i)
  simp only [Matrix.trace, Matrix.diag, Matrix.mul_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  rw [hs]

lemma inverse_metric_negative_coordinate_le (M H : Mat) (a : ℝ) (hM : M.PosDef)
    (hH : (-H - a • M).PosSemidef) :
    (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M⁻¹ i j * H i j) ≤ -3 * a := by
  rw [← trace_inverse_eq_coordinate_contraction M H hM]
  exact trace_inverse_metric_negative_le M H a hM hH

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.MetricVolume

``````

``````lean
import Calderon.MetricLocalDivergence
import Calderon.MetricNegativeTrace

noncomputable section
open scoped Matrix.Norms.Operator Gradient Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.MetricVolume

def metricHessianMatrix (g : MatrixField) (f : R3 → ℝ) (x : R3) : Mat :=
  fun i j => RadiusProfile.coordinateHessian f
    (fun X Y => ConnectionError.coordinateConnectionField
      (ConnectionError.inverseMetricField (MetricOperator.metricOperatorField g))
      (MetricOperator.metricOperatorField g) x X Y) x (coordinateVector i) (coordinateVector j)

lemma densityWeightedDivergence_le_of_negative_metricHessian_local
    (g : MatrixField) (f : R3 → ℝ) (x : R3) (a : ℝ)
    (hg : ∀ i j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => g y i j) x)
    (hp : (g x).PosDef) (hs : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, (g y).IsHermitian)
    (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x)
    (hH : (-metricHessianMatrix g f x - a • g x).PosSemidef) :
    AngularPolynomial.densityWeightedDivergence (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ)
      (vol g) (fun y => MetricOperator.matrixOperatorMap ((g y)⁻¹) (gradient f y)) x ≤
      -3 * vol g x * a := by
  rw [densityWeightedDivergence_eq_metricHessian_trace_local g f x hg hp hs hf]
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (inverse_metric_negative_coordinate_le (g x) (metricHessianMatrix g f x) a hp hH)
    (Real.sqrt_nonneg ((g x).det))
  change vol g x * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (g x)⁻¹ i j *
    metricHessianMatrix g f x i j) ≤ vol g x * (-3 * a) at h
  simpa only [metricHessianMatrix, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using h

lemma densityWeightedDivergence_le_of_negative_metricHessian_on_open
    (g : MatrixField) (f : R3 → ℝ) (Y : Set R3) (hY : IsOpen Y)

def coordinateHessianBilinear (f : R3 → ℝ) (Γ : R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (x : R3) : R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x -
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℝ R3 R3 ℝ) (fderiv ℝ f x)).comp Γ

lemma coordinateHessianBilinear_apply (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (Γ : R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (x X Y : R3) :
    coordinateHessianBilinear f Γ x X Y =
      RadiusProfile.coordinateHessian f (fun V W => Γ V W) x X Y := by
  simp [coordinateHessianBilinear, RadiusProfile.coordinateHessian]

lemma bilinear_coordinate_sum (B : R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (X Y : R3) :
    B X Y = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      X i * Y j * B (coordinateVector i) (coordinateVector j) := by
  nth_rw 1 [← (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).sum_repr X,
    ← (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).sum_repr Y]
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul, _root_.sum_apply, _root_.smul_apply,
    EuclideanSpace.basisFun_repr, EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    coordinateVector, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  ring

lemma bilinear_matrix_quadratic (B : R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (X : R3) :
    (X : Fin 3 → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ (Matrix.mulVec (fun i j => B (coordinateVector i) (coordinateVector j))
      (X : Fin 3 → ℝ)) = B X X := by
  rw [bilinear_coordinate_sum B X X]
  simp only [dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  ring

lemma actualMetricConnection_symmetric_local (g : MatrixField) (x : R3)
    (hg : ∀ i j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => g y i j) x)
    (hs : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, (g y).IsHermitian) (X Y : R3) :
    ConnectionError.coordinateConnectionField
      (ConnectionError.inverseMetricField (MetricOperator.metricOperatorField g))
      (MetricOperator.metricOperatorField g) x X Y =
    ConnectionError.coordinateConnectionField
      (ConnectionError.inverseMetricField (MetricOperator.metricOperatorField g))
      (MetricOperator.metricOperatorField g) x Y X := by
  have hm : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, ∀ V W : R3,
      ⟪MetricOperator.metricOperatorField g y V, W⟫_ℝ =
        ⟪MetricOperator.metricOperatorField g y W, V⟫_ℝ := by
    filter_upwards [hs] with y hy
    intro V W
    have h := Matrix.isSymmetric_toEuclideanLin_iff.mpr hy
    change ⟪(g y).toEuclideanLin V, W⟫_ℝ = ⟪(g y).toEuclideanLin W, V⟫_ℝ
    exact (h V W).trans (real_inner_comm _ _)
  simp only [ConnectionError.coordinateConnectionField_apply]
  apply ConnectionError.coordinateConnection_symmetric
  intro U V W
  exact ConnectionError.inverse_metric_derivative_symmetric _ _ x
    (hasFDerivAt_actualMetricOperator g x hg).differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt hm U V W

lemma metricHessianMatrix_isHermitian (g : MatrixField) (f : R3 → ℝ) (x : R3)
    (hg : ∀ i j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => g y i j) x)
    (hs : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, (g y).IsHermitian) (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f x) :

    actualMetricConnection_symmetric_local g x hg hs (coordinateVector j) (coordinateVector i)]

lemma metricHessianMatrix_quadratic (g : MatrixField) (f : R3 → ℝ) (x X : R3) :
    (X : Fin 3 → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ (Matrix.mulVec (metricHessianMatrix g f x) (X : Fin 3 → ℝ)) =
      RadiusProfile.coordinateHessian f
        (fun V W => ConnectionError.coordinateConnectionField
          (ConnectionError.inverseMetricField (MetricOperator.metricOperatorField g))
          (MetricOperator.metricOperatorField g) x V W) x X X := by

    (ConnectionError.inverseMetricField (MetricOperator.metricOperatorField g))
    (MetricOperator.metricOperatorField g) x

      (coordinateVector i) (coordinateVector j)) = metricHessianMatrix g f x := by

    exact coordinateHessianBilinear_apply f Γ x (coordinateVector i) (coordinateVector j)
  have h := bilinear_matrix_quadratic (coordinateHessianBilinear f Γ x) X
  rw [he, coordinateHessianBilinear_apply] at h

      (fun V W => ConnectionError.coordinateConnectionField
        (ConnectionError.inverseMetricField (MetricOperator.metricOperatorField g))
        (MetricOperator.metricOperatorField g) x V W) x X X ≤
      -a * ⟪MetricOperator.metricOperatorField g x X, X⟫_ℝ) :

lemma contDiff_softplus_comp (δ : ℝ) (t : R3 → ℝ) (ht : ContDiff ℝ ∞ t) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => softplus δ (t x)) := by
  have he : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => 1 + Real.exp (t x / δ)) :=
    contDiff_const.add ((ht.div_const δ).exp)
  exact contDiff_const.mul (he.log (fun x => by positivity))

lemma contDiff_logProfile (δ c : ℝ) (p : ℕ) (t : R3 → ℝ)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (ht : ContDiff ℝ ∞ t) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (logProfile δ c p t) :=
  contDiff_const.add (contDiff_const.mul ((contDiff_softplus_comp δ t ht).log
    (fun x => (softplus_pos δ (t x) hδ).ne')))

lemma contDiff_log_referenceRadius (δ R : ℝ) (p : ℕ) (L : ℝ)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hR : 0 < R) :

  rw [log_referenceRadius δ R p L hδ hR]

        (metricOperatorField g) x V W) x X X ≤
      -c1 * metricDifferentialNorm g f x * ⟪metricOperatorField g x X, X⟫_ℝ) :
    densityWeightedDivergence (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ) (vol g)
      (fun y => inverseMetricOperator g y (gradient f y)) x ≤
      -(3 * c1) * (vol g x * metricDifferentialNorm g f x) := by
  have h := densityWeightedDivergence_le_of_quadratic_metricHessian_local g f x

      simpa only [inverseMetricOperator, neg_mul, mul_assoc] using hquad X)

    funext y
    rw [inverseMetricOperator_eq_matrix_inverse_of_posDef g hp]
  rw [← he] at h
  convert h using 1 <;> ring

    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) :

    exists_dilated_referenceRadius_uniform_divergence_bound g hg K hK
  refine ⟨L, c1, hL, hc1, ?_⟩
  intro lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p k hk u hu hc hsupport
  let γ := referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L
  let f := fun y => Real.log (referenceRadius δ R p L y)

theorem exists_dilated_referenceRadius_uniform_first_second_jet_bounds_at
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) :
    ∃ J1 J2 : ℝ, 0 < J1 ∧ 0 < J2 ∧
      ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 →
      ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → ∀ p : ℕ, 1 ≤ p → ∀ x ∈ K,

            (fun y => Real.log (referenceRadius δ R p L y)) x ∧
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (fun y => Real.log (referenceRadius δ R p L y))) x‖ ≤

theorem exists_dilated_referenceRadius_uniform_beta_derivative_bounds_at
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) :
    ∃ D : ℝ, 0 < D ∧ ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 → ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → ∀ p : ℕ, 1 ≤ p → ∀ x ∈ K,
````````
