````````markdown
          D * metricDifferentialNorm (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L)
            (fun y => Real.log (referenceRadius δ R p L y)) x ^ 2 ∧
        ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => (metricDifferentialNorm (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L)
          (fun z => Real.log (referenceRadius δ R p L z)) y)⁻¹) x‖ ≤ D := by
  obtain ⟨m, C, T, hm, hC, hbounds⟩ :=
    exists_dilatedReferenceDepth_uniform_metricNorm_bounds g hg L hL K hK
  obtain ⟨A, E, hA, hE, hjets⟩ := exists_referenceDepth_frechet_bounds_on_compact L K hK
  obtain ⟨B, hB, hbder⟩ := exists_dilatedReferenceDepth_uniform_normDerivative_bound g hg L hL K hK
  let a0 : ℝ := 1 / (1 + Real.log (1 + Real.exp T))
  have ha0 : 0 < a0 := by
    dsimp [a0]
    apply one_div_pos.mpr
    have hl : 0 < Real.log (1 + Real.exp T) := Real.log_pos (by linarith [Real.exp_pos T])
    linarith
  let S : ℝ := (B / a0 + (A + C) ^ 2) / m ^ 2
  have hS : 0 ≤ S := by dsimp [S]; positivity
  refine ⟨S + 1, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp x hx
  rw [log_referenceRadius δ R p L hδ hR]
  let G := referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L
  let beta := metricDifferentialNorm G (logProfile δ (Real.log R) p (referenceDepth L))
  have hbase : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (metricDifferentialNorm G (referenceDepth L)) := by
    have h := (contDiff_dilatedReferenceDepth_metricNorm g hg L hL).comp
      (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : R3 => (lam, y)))
    exact h
  have hbetaDer := hasFDerivAt_metricDifferentialNorm_logProfile G δ (Real.log R) p _
    (contDiff_referenceDepth L) x hδ (hbase.differentiable (by simp) x)
  obtain ⟨hmin, hmax, ht⟩ := hbounds lam hlam x hx
  have hD1 := (hjets x hx).1
  have hDb := hbder lam hlam x hx
  have ha := logSlope_pos δ (referenceDepth L x) hδ
  have halpha : 0 ≤ (p : ℝ) * logSlope δ (referenceDepth L x) := mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg p) ha.le
  have hbetaLower : (p : ℝ) * logSlope δ (referenceDepth L x) * m ≤ beta x := by
    dsimp [beta]
    rw [metricDifferentialNorm_logProfile _ δ (Real.log R) p _ x hδ
      ((contDiff_referenceDepth L).differentiable (by simp) x)]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmin halpha
  have hpR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hp
  have hbetaPos : 0 < beta x := (show 0 < (p : ℝ) * logSlope δ (referenceDepth L x) * m by positivity).trans_le hbetaLower
  have hn := norm_fderiv_metricDifferentialNorm_logProfile_le G δ (Real.log R) p _
    (contDiff_referenceDepth L) x hδ (hbase.differentiable (by simp) x)
  have hproduct : ‖fderiv ℝ (referenceDepth L) x‖ * metricDifferentialNorm G (referenceDepth L) x ≤ A * C :=
    mul_le_mul hD1 hmax (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) hA
  have hAC : A * C ≤ (A + C) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg A, sq_nonneg C]
  have hterm1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hproduct.trans hAC)
    (show 0 ≤ (p : ℝ) * (logSlope δ (referenceDepth L x)) ^ 2 by positivity)
  have hterm2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hDb halpha
  have hupper : ‖fderiv ℝ beta x‖ ≤
      (p : ℝ) * logSlope δ (referenceDepth L x) * B +
      (p : ℝ) * (logSlope δ (referenceDepth L x)) ^ 2 * (A + C) ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hn, hterm1, hterm2]
  have hbound : ‖fderiv ℝ beta x‖ ≤ S * (beta x) ^ 2 :=
    profile_second_norm_le_beta_square (p : ℝ) _ a0 m (A + C) B (beta x) _ hpR ha0
      (logSlope_uniform_lower_bound δ _ T hδ hδ1 ht) hm (by positivity) hB hbetaLower hupper
  have hfinal : ‖fderiv ℝ beta x‖ ≤ (S + 1) * (beta x) ^ 2 :=
    hbound.trans (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (beta x)])
  refine ⟨hfinal, ?_⟩
  have hinv : fderiv ℝ (fun y => (beta y)⁻¹) x =
      -((beta x) ^ 2)⁻¹ • fderiv ℝ beta x := by
    change fderiv ℝ ((fun y : ℝ => y⁻¹) ∘ beta) x = _
    rw [hbetaDer.fderiv]
    exact ((hasDerivAt_inv (ne_of_gt hbetaPos)).comp_hasFDerivAt x hbetaDer).fderiv
  change ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => (beta y)⁻¹) x‖ ≤ S + 1
  rw [hinv]
  simp only [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_neg, abs_inv, abs_pow,
    abs_of_pos hbetaPos]
  have hr := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfinal (show 0 ≤ ((beta x) ^ 2)⁻¹ by positivity)
  have he : ((beta x) ^ 2)⁻¹ * ((S + 1) * (beta x) ^ 2) = S + 1 := by
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hbetaPos]
  rw [he] at hr
  exact hr

theorem exists_dilated_referenceRadius_uniform_amplitude_bounds_at
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) :
    ∀ p : ℕ, 2 ≤ p → ∃ A1 A2 : ℝ, 0 < A1 ∧ 0 < A2 ∧
      ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 → ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → ∀ x ∈ K,
        ‖fderiv ℝ (referenceRadius δ R p L) x‖ ≤ R * A1 ∧
        referenceRadius δ R p L x *
          metricDifferentialNorm (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L)
            (fun y => Real.log (referenceRadius δ R p L y)) x ^ 2 ≤ R * A2 := by
  obtain ⟨m, C, T, hm, hC, hbounds⟩ :=
    exists_dilatedReferenceDepth_uniform_metricNorm_bounds g hg L hL K hK
  obtain ⟨A, B, hA, hB, hjets⟩ := exists_referenceDepth_frechet_bounds_on_compact L K hK
  let M := Real.log (1 + Real.exp T)
  have hM : 0 < M := log_exp_add_one_pos T
  intro p hp
  let A1 := (p : ℝ) * M ^ (p - 1) * A + 1
  let A2 := (p : ℝ) ^ 2 * C ^ 2 * M ^ (p - 2) + 1
  have hA1 : 0 < A1 := by dsimp [A1]; positivity
  have hA2 : 0 < A2 := by dsimp [A2]; positivity
  refine ⟨A1, A2, hA1, hA2, ?_⟩
  intro lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR x hx
  obtain ⟨hmin, hmax, ht⟩ := hbounds lam hlam x hx
  have hs := softplus_le_log_exp_upper δ (referenceDepth L x) T hδ hδ1 ht
  have hq := (softplus_derivative_lt_one δ (referenceDepth L x)).le
  have hs0 := (softplus_pos δ (referenceDepth L x) hδ).le
  have hq0 := (softplus_derivative_pos δ (referenceDepth L x)).le
  have hpow := pow_le_pow_left₀ hs0 hs (p - 1)
  have hn : ‖fderiv ℝ (referenceRadius δ R p L) x‖ ≤
      R * (p : ℝ) * M ^ (p - 1) * A := by
    rw [(hasFDerivAt_referenceRadius δ R p L x hδ).fderiv, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (by positivity : 0 ≤ R * (p : ℝ) * softplus δ (referenceDepth L x) ^ (p - 1) *
        (Real.exp (referenceDepth L x / δ) / (1 + Real.exp (referenceDepth L x / δ))))]
    have h1 := mul_le_mul hq (hjets x hx).1 (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
    have h2 := mul_le_mul hpow h1 (by positivity) (pow_nonneg hM.le _)
    have h3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 (mul_nonneg hR.le (Nat.cast_nonneg p))
    nlinarith [h3]
  refine ⟨hn.trans (by dsimp [A1]; nlinarith), ?_⟩
  rw [log_referenceRadius δ R p L hδ hR]
  have hb : 0 ≤ metricDifferentialNorm (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L)
      (logProfile δ (Real.log R) p (referenceDepth L)) x := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hbound : metricDifferentialNorm (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L)
      (logProfile δ (Real.log R) p (referenceDepth L)) x ≤
      (p : ℝ) * C * logSlope δ (referenceDepth L x) := by
    rw [metricDifferentialNorm_logProfile _ δ (Real.log R) p _ x hδ
      ((contDiff_referenceDepth L).differentiable (by simp) x)]
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmax
      (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg p) (logSlope_pos δ (referenceDepth L x) hδ).le)
    convert h using 1 <;> ring
  have hr := radius_gradient_power_uniform_scale_bound δ _ T R C _ p 2 hδ hδ1 ht hR.le hC.le hb hp hbound
  exact hr.trans (by dsimp [A2, M]; nlinarith)

theorem exists_dilated_referenceRadius_uniform_small_amplitude_at
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (p : ℕ) (hp : 2 ≤ p) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 → ∀ x ∈ K,
        ‖fderiv ℝ (referenceRadius δ R p L) x‖ ≤ ε ∧
        referenceRadius δ R p L x *
          metricDifferentialNorm (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L)
            (fun y => Real.log (referenceRadius δ R p L y)) x ^ 2 ≤ ε := by
  have hb := exists_dilated_referenceRadius_uniform_amplitude_bounds_at g hg K hK L hL
  obtain ⟨A1, A2, hA1, hA2, hbounds⟩ := hb p hp
  let R := ε / (A1 + A2 + 1)
  have hden : 0 < A1 + A2 + 1 := by positivity
  have hR : 0 < R := div_pos hε hden
  have he : R * (A1 + A2 + 1) = ε := by dsimp [R]; field_simp
  have h1 : R * A1 ≤ ε := by nlinarith
  have h2 : R * A2 ≤ ε := by nlinarith
  exact ⟨R, hR, fun lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 x hx =>
    ⟨((hbounds lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR x hx).1).trans h1,
      ((hbounds lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR x hx).2).trans h2⟩⟩

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.ConformalDepth

``````lean
import Calderon.FixedProfileBounds

set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 10
noncomputable section
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Gradient Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.ConformalDepth
open AngularPolynomial MetricOperator ConnectionError RadiusProfile

def referenceLogRadius (δ R : ℝ) (p : ℕ) (L : ℝ) : R3 → ℝ :=
  fun x => Real.log (referenceRadius δ R p L x)

def referenceProfileNorm (g : MatrixField) (lam δ R : ℝ) (p : ℕ) (L : ℝ) : R3 → ℝ :=
  metricDifferentialNorm (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L)
    (referenceLogRadius δ R p L)

def referenceProfileBounds (g : MatrixField) (K : Set R3) (L c0 c1 J1 J2 D : ℝ) : Prop :=
  (∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 → ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R →
    ∀ p : ℕ, 1 ≤ p → ∀ x ∈ K,
      c0 * (p : ℝ) ≤ referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x ∧
      (∀ X : R3, coordinateHessian (referenceLogRadius δ R p L)
        (fun V W => coordinateConnectionField
          (inverseMetricOperator (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L))
          (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L)) x V W) x X X ≤
        -c1 * referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x *
          ⟪metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x X, X⟫_ℝ) ∧
      densityWeightedDivergence (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ)
        (vol (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L))
        (fun y => inverseMetricOperator (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) y
          (gradient (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) y)) x ≤
        -(3 * c1) * (vol (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x *
          referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x) ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) x‖ ≤ J1 * referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (referenceLogRadius δ R p L)) x‖ ≤
        J2 * referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x ^ 2 ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L) x‖ ≤
        D * referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x ^ 2 ∧
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun y => (referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L y)⁻¹) x‖ ≤ D) ∧
  (∀ p : ℕ, 2 ≤ p → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧
    ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 → ∀ x ∈ K,
      ‖fderiv ℝ (referenceRadius δ R p L) x‖ ≤ ε ∧
      referenceRadius δ R p L x * referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x ^ 2 ≤ ε)

theorem exists_referenceProfileBounds (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ L c0 c1 J1 J2 D : ℝ, 0 < L ∧ 0 < c0 ∧ 0 < c1 ∧ 0 < J1 ∧ 0 < J2 ∧ 0 < D ∧
      referenceProfileBounds g K L c0 c1 J1 J2 D := by
  obtain ⟨L, c0, c1, C, T, hL, hc0, hc1, hC, hbounds⟩ :=
    exists_dilated_referenceRadius_uniform_metric_bounds g hg K hK
  obtain ⟨J1, J2, hJ1, hJ2, hjets⟩ :=
    exists_dilated_referenceRadius_uniform_first_second_jet_bounds_at g hg K hK L hL
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hbeta⟩ :=
    exists_dilated_referenceRadius_uniform_beta_derivative_bounds_at g hg K hK L hL
  refine ⟨L, c0, c1, J1, J2, D, hL, hc0, hc1, hJ1, hJ2, hD, ?_⟩
  dsimp [referenceProfileBounds, referenceLogRadius, referenceProfileNorm]
  constructor
  · intro lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp x hx
    obtain ⟨hb, hH, hr⟩ := hbounds lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p 0 (Nat.zero_le p) x hx
    obtain ⟨hj1, hj2⟩ := hjets lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp x hx
    obtain ⟨hb1, hb2⟩ := hbeta lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp x hx
    refine ⟨hb, hH, ?_, hj1, hj2, hb1, hb2⟩
    exact densityWeightedDivergence_le_of_profile_hessian _
      (dilatedReferenceMetric_smooth_entries g hg lam L)
      (dilatedReferenceMetric_posDef g hg lam L) _
      (contDiff_log_referenceRadius δ R p L hδ hR) c1 x hH
  · intro p hp ε hε
    exact exists_dilated_referenceRadius_uniform_small_amplitude_at g hg K hK L hL p hp ε hε

theorem referenceProfileBounds_choose_degree_radius
    (g : MatrixField) (K : Set R3) (L c0 c1 J1 J2 D : ℝ)
    (hc0 : 0 < c0) (hbounds : referenceProfileBounds g K L c0 c1 J1 J2 D)
    (beta0 ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ p : ℕ, 2 ≤ p ∧ ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧
      ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 → ∀ x ∈ K,
        beta0 ≤ referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x ∧
        ‖fderiv ℝ (referenceRadius δ R p L) x‖ ≤ ε ∧
        referenceRadius δ R p L x * referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x ^ 2 ≤ ε := by
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := exists_nat_gt (beta0 / c0)
  let p := max q 2
  have hp : 2 ≤ p := le_max_right _ _
  have hp1 : 1 ≤ p := by omega
  have hqp : (q : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast le_max_left q 2
  have hlarge : beta0 ≤ c0 * (p : ℝ) := by
    have hq' : beta0 / c0 ≤ (p : ℝ) := le_trans hq.le hqp
    have h := (div_le_iff₀ hc0).mp hq'
    simpa only [mul_comm] using h
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hr⟩ := hbounds.2 p hp ε hε
  refine ⟨p, hp, R, hR, ?_⟩
  intro lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 x hx
  exact ⟨hlarge.trans (hbounds.1 lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp1 x hx).1,
    (hr lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 x hx).1, (hr lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 x hx).2⟩

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.ConformalDepth

``````

### Calderon.PrincipalDirectional

Exact source SHA256 `146274a8a9186b05f104d8a36cfc99cf9e38dd0427255ab14c04a4f9c42b5fe5`. The complete module is included to expose every actual premise, conclusion, definition and proof boundary.

``````lean
import Calderon.PrincipalCommutator
import Calderon.AngularEuclideanDensity
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FDeriv.Symmetric

noncomputable section
open scoped ContDiff
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.PrincipalCommutator

variable {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]

def directionalFDeriv (v : R3) (u : R3 → E) : R3 → E := fun x => fderiv ℝ u x v

lemma contDiff_directionalFDeriv (v : R3) (u : R3 → E) (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (directionalFDeriv v u) :=
  (hu.fderiv_right (m := ∞) (by simp)).clm_apply contDiff_const

lemma directionalFDeriv_add (v : R3) (u w : R3 → E)
    (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w) (x : R3) :
    directionalFDeriv v (fun y => u y + w y) x =
      directionalFDeriv v u x + directionalFDeriv v w x := by
  unfold directionalFDeriv
  rw [fderiv_fun_add (hu.differentiable (by simp) x) (hw.differentiable (by simp) x)]
  rfl

lemma directionalFDeriv_smul (v : R3) (a : R3 → ℝ) (u : R3 → E)
    (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ a) (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (x : R3) :
    directionalFDeriv v (fun y => a y • u y) x =
      directionalFDeriv v a x • u x + a x • directionalFDeriv v u x := by
  unfold directionalFDeriv
  rw [fderiv_fun_smul (ha.differentiable (by simp) x) (hu.differentiable (by simp) x)]
  simp only [add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, smul_apply]
  exact add_comm _ _

lemma directionalFDeriv_clm_apply (v : R3) (K : R3 → E →L[ℝ] F) (u : R3 → E)
    (hK : ContDiff ℝ ∞ K) (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (x : R3) :
    directionalFDeriv v (fun y => K y (u y)) x =
      directionalFDeriv v K x (u x) + K x (directionalFDeriv v u x) := by
  unfold directionalFDeriv
  rw [fderiv_clm_apply (hK.differentiable (by simp) x) (hu.differentiable (by simp) x)]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply]
  exact add_comm _ _

lemma directionalFDeriv_commute (i j : R3) (u : R3 → E)
    (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (x : R3) :
    directionalFDeriv i (directionalFDeriv j u) x =
      directionalFDeriv j (directionalFDeriv i u) x := by
  have hD := (hu.fderiv_right (m := ∞) (by simp)).differentiable (by simp)
  unfold directionalFDeriv
  rw [fderiv_clm_apply (hD x) (differentiableAt_const j),
    fderiv_clm_apply (hD x) (differentiableAt_const i)]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply, fderiv_const_apply, zero_apply, map_zero, add_zero, zero_add]
  exact (hu.contDiffAt.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by simp)).eq i j

lemma directionalFDeriv_third_commute (i j l : R3) (u : R3 → E)
    (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (x : R3) :
    directionalFDeriv i (directionalFDeriv j (directionalFDeriv l u)) x =
      directionalFDeriv l (directionalFDeriv i (directionalFDeriv j u)) x := by
  have he : directionalFDeriv j (directionalFDeriv l u) =
      directionalFDeriv l (directionalFDeriv j u) :=
    funext (fun y => directionalFDeriv_commute j l u hu y)
  rw [he]
  exact directionalFDeriv_commute i l _ (contDiff_directionalFDeriv j u hu) x

lemma directionalFDeriv_second_clm_apply (i j : R3) (K : R3 → E →L[ℝ] F)
    (u : R3 → E) (hK : ContDiff ℝ ∞ K) (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (x : R3) :
    directionalFDeriv i (directionalFDeriv j (fun y => K y (u y))) x =
      directionalFDeriv i (directionalFDeriv j K) x (u x) +
      directionalFDeriv j K x (directionalFDeriv i u x) +
      directionalFDeriv i K x (directionalFDeriv j u x) +
      K x (directionalFDeriv i (directionalFDeriv j u) x) := by
  have he : directionalFDeriv j (fun y => K y (u y)) =
      fun y => directionalFDeriv j K y (u y) + K y (directionalFDeriv j u y) :=
    funext (fun y => directionalFDeriv_clm_apply j K u hK hu y)
  rw [he, directionalFDeriv_add i _ _
    ((contDiff_directionalFDeriv j K hK).clm_apply hu)
    (hK.clm_apply (contDiff_directionalFDeriv j u hu))]
  rw [directionalFDeriv_clm_apply i _ _ (contDiff_directionalFDeriv j K hK) hu,
    directionalFDeriv_clm_apply i _ _ hK (contDiff_directionalFDeriv j u hu)]
  abel

theorem scalar_principal_directional_commutator (i j l : R3) (a : R3 → ℝ)
    (K : R3 → E →L[ℝ] F) (u : R3 → E)
    (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ a) (hK : ContDiff ℝ ∞ K) (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (x : R3) :
    K x (directionalFDeriv l (fun y => a y •
      directionalFDeriv i (directionalFDeriv j u) y) x) -
      a x • directionalFDeriv i (directionalFDeriv j
        (fun y => K y (directionalFDeriv l u y))) x =
      directionalFDeriv l a x • K x (directionalFDeriv i (directionalFDeriv j u) x) -
      a x • directionalFDeriv i (directionalFDeriv j K) x (directionalFDeriv l u x) -
      a x • directionalFDeriv j K x (directionalFDeriv i (directionalFDeriv l u) x) -
      a x • directionalFDeriv i K x (directionalFDeriv j (directionalFDeriv l u) x) := by
  rw [directionalFDeriv_smul l a _ ha
    (contDiff_directionalFDeriv i _ (contDiff_directionalFDeriv j u hu)),
    directionalFDeriv_second_clm_apply i j K _ hK (contDiff_directionalFDeriv l u hu)]
  rw [directionalFDeriv_third_commute i j l u hu]
  simp only [map_add, map_smul, smul_add]
  module

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.PrincipalCommutator

``````

### Calderon.ScalarDensityAdjoint

Exact source SHA256 `bee8d75f4b7239029c5e2f60c6097e3fd22e953e62cef7f7b13215db530afc8d`. The complete module is included to expose every actual premise, conclusion, definition and proof boundary.

``````lean
import Calderon.PrincipalDirectional
import Calderon.BaseDensityAdjoint
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Hermitian

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Filter
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.ScalarBaseAdjoint
open PrincipalCommutator

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]

lemma directionalFDeriv_second_smul (i j : R3) (c : R3 → ℝ) (w : R3 → E)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w) (x : R3) :
    directionalFDeriv j (directionalFDeriv i (fun y => c y • w y)) x =
      directionalFDeriv j (directionalFDeriv i c) x • w x +
      directionalFDeriv i c x • directionalFDeriv j w x +
      directionalFDeriv j c x • directionalFDeriv i w x +
      c x • directionalFDeriv j (directionalFDeriv i w) x := by
  have he : directionalFDeriv i (fun y => c y • w y) =
      fun y => directionalFDeriv i c y • w y + c y • directionalFDeriv i w y :=
    funext (fun y => directionalFDeriv_smul i c w hc hw y)
  rw [he, directionalFDeriv_add j (fun y => directionalFDeriv i c y • w y)
    (fun y => c y • directionalFDeriv i w y)
    ((contDiff_directionalFDeriv i c hc).smul hw)
    (hc.smul (contDiff_directionalFDeriv i w hw))]
  rw [directionalFDeriv_smul j _ _ (contDiff_directionalFDeriv i c hc) hw,
    directionalFDeriv_smul j _ _ hc (contDiff_directionalFDeriv i w hw)]
  abel

def scalarSecondBase (v : Fin 3 → R3) (a : R3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (u : R3 → E) (x : R3) : E :=
  ∑ i, ∑ j, a x i j • directionalFDeriv (v i) (directionalFDeriv (v j) u) x

def scalarSecondBaseAdjoint (v : Fin 3 → R3) (mu : R3 → ℝ)
    (a : R3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (w : R3 → E) (x : R3) : E :=
  (mu x)⁻¹ • ∑ i, ∑ j, directionalFDeriv (v j)
    (directionalFDeriv (v i) (fun y => (mu y * a y i j) • w y)) x

lemma compact_scalar_second_pair_integrable (i j : R3) (mu a : R3 → ℝ)
    (u w : R3 → E) (hm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ mu) (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ a)
    (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w) (hc : HasCompactSupport u) :
    Integrable (fun x => mu x * a x *
      ⟪directionalFDeriv i (directionalFDeriv j u) x, w x⟫_ℝ) := by
  have h := BaseDensityAdjoint.compact_inner_integrable
    (fun y => (mu y * a y) • w y) (directionalFDeriv i (directionalFDeriv j u))
    ((hm.mul ha).smul hw).continuous
    (contDiff_directionalFDeriv i _ (contDiff_directionalFDeriv j u hu)).continuous
    ((hc.fderiv_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) j).fderiv_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) i)
  simpa only [inner_smul_left, starRingEnd_apply, star_trivial, real_inner_comm] using h

lemma compact_scalar_second_adjoint_pair_integrable (i j : R3) (mu a : R3 → ℝ)
    (u w : R3 → E) (hm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ mu) (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ a)
    (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w) (hc : HasCompactSupport u) :
    Integrable (fun x => ⟪directionalFDeriv j
      (directionalFDeriv i (fun y => (mu y * a y) • w y)) x, u x⟫_ℝ) := by
  exact BaseDensityAdjoint.compact_inner_integrable _ u
    (contDiff_directionalFDeriv j _
      (contDiff_directionalFDeriv i _ ((hm.mul ha).smul hw))).continuous hu.continuous hc

theorem compact_scalarSecondBase_adjoint (v : Fin 3 → R3) (mu : R3 → ℝ)
    (a : R3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (u w : R3 → E)
    (hm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ mu) (ha : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => a y i j))
    (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w) (hc : HasCompactSupport u)
    (hp : ∀ x, 0 < mu x) :
    (∫ x : R3, mu x * ⟪scalarSecondBase v a u x, w x⟫_ℝ) =
      ∫ x : R3, mu x * ⟪u x, scalarSecondBaseAdjoint v mu a w x⟫_ℝ := by
  have hl : (∫ x : R3, mu x * ⟪scalarSecondBase v a u x, w x⟫_ℝ) =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, ∫ x : R3, mu x * a x i j *
        ⟪directionalFDeriv (v i) (directionalFDeriv (v j) u) x, w x⟫_ℝ := by
    simp only [scalarSecondBase, sum_inner, inner_smul_left, starRingEnd_apply,
      star_trivial, Finset.mul_sum, ← mul_assoc]
    rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => integrable_finsetSum _
      (fun j _ => compact_scalar_second_pair_integrable (v i) (v j) mu
        (fun y => a y i j) u w hm (ha i j) hu hw hc))]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    exact integral_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => compact_scalar_second_pair_integrable
      (v i) (v j) mu (fun y => a y i j) u w hm (ha i j) hu hw hc)
  have hr : (∫ x : R3, mu x * ⟪u x, scalarSecondBaseAdjoint v mu a w x⟫_ℝ) =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, ∫ x : R3, ⟪directionalFDeriv (v j)
        (directionalFDeriv (v i) (fun y => (mu y * a y i j) • w y)) x, u x⟫_ℝ := by
    have he : (fun x => mu x * ⟪u x, scalarSecondBaseAdjoint v mu a w x⟫_ℝ) =
        fun x => ∑ i, ∑ j, ⟪directionalFDeriv (v j)
          (directionalFDeriv (v i) (fun y => (mu y * a y i j) • w y)) x, u x⟫_ℝ := by
      funext x
      simp only [scalarSecondBaseAdjoint, inner_smul_right, inner_sum,
        Finset.mul_sum, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt (hp x)), one_mul]
      simp only [real_inner_comm]
    rw [he, integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => integrable_finsetSum _
      (fun j _ => compact_scalar_second_adjoint_pair_integrable (v i) (v j) mu
        (fun y => a y i j) u w hm (ha i j) hu hw hc))]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    exact integral_finsetSum _ (fun j _ => compact_scalar_second_adjoint_pair_integrable
      (v i) (v j) mu (fun y => a y i j) u w hm (ha i j) hu hw hc)
  rw [hl, hr]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  exact BaseDensityAdjoint.compact_weighted_second_adjoint (v i) (v j) mu
    (fun y => a y i j) u w hm (ha i j) hu hw hc

lemma scalar_second_adjoint_term_difference (i j : R3) (mu a : R3 → ℝ)
    (w : R3 → E) (hm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ mu) (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ a)
    (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w) (x : R3) (hp : mu x ≠ 0) :
    (mu x)⁻¹ • directionalFDeriv j
      (directionalFDeriv i (fun y => (mu y * a y) • w y)) x -
      a x • directionalFDeriv i (directionalFDeriv j w) x =
      (mu x)⁻¹ • (directionalFDeriv j (directionalFDeriv i (fun y => mu y * a y)) x • w x +
        directionalFDeriv i (fun y => mu y * a y) x • directionalFDeriv j w x +
        directionalFDeriv j (fun y => mu y * a y) x • directionalFDeriv i w x) := by
  rw [directionalFDeriv_second_smul i j _ w (hm.mul ha) hw,
    directionalFDeriv_commute j i w hw]
  simp only [smul_add, smul_smul]
  have he : (mu x)⁻¹ * (mu x * a x) = a x := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hp, one_mul]
  rw [he]
  abel

lemma weighted_coefficient_directional_symmetry (v : R3) (mu : R3 → ℝ)
    (a : R3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (x : R3)
    (hs : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, (a y).IsHermitian) (i j : Fin 3) :
    directionalFDeriv v (fun y => mu y * a y i j) x =
      directionalFDeriv v (fun y => mu y * a y j i) x := by
  have he : (fun y => mu y * a y i j) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun y => mu y * a y j i) := by
    filter_upwards [hs] with y hy
    have he : a y j i = a y i j := by simpa only [star_trivial] using hy.apply i j
    rw [he]
  exact congrArg (fun T : R3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => T v) he.fderiv_eq

lemma scalar_adjoint_cross_sum (v : Fin 3 → R3) (mu : R3 → ℝ)
    (a : R3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (w : R3 → E) (x : R3)
    (hs : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, (a y).IsHermitian) :
    (∑ i, ∑ j, directionalFDeriv (v i) (fun y => mu y * a y i j) x •
      directionalFDeriv (v j) w x) =
    ∑ i, ∑ j, directionalFDeriv (v j) (fun y => mu y * a y i j) x •
      directionalFDeriv (v i) w x := by
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  rw [weighted_coefficient_directional_symmetry (v j) mu a x hs j i]

theorem scalarSecondBaseAdjoint_sub (v : Fin 3 → R3) (mu : R3 → ℝ)
    (a : R3 → Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (w : R3 → E)
    (hm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ mu) (ha : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => a y i j))
    (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w) (x : R3) (hp : mu x ≠ 0)
    (hs : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, (a y).IsHermitian) :
    scalarSecondBaseAdjoint v mu a w x - scalarSecondBase v a w x =
      (mu x)⁻¹ • (∑ i, ∑ j, directionalFDeriv (v j)
        (directionalFDeriv (v i) (fun y => mu y * a y i j)) x • w x) +
      (2 * (mu x)⁻¹) • (∑ i, ∑ j,
        directionalFDeriv (v j) (fun y => mu y * a y i j) x •
        directionalFDeriv (v i) w x) := by
  calc
    _ = ∑ i, ∑ j, ((mu x)⁻¹ • directionalFDeriv (v j)
        (directionalFDeriv (v i) (fun y => (mu y * a y i j) • w y)) x -
        a x i j • directionalFDeriv (v i) (directionalFDeriv (v j) w) x) := by
      simp only [scalarSecondBaseAdjoint, scalarSecondBase, Finset.smul_sum,
        Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    _ = ∑ i, ∑ j, ((mu x)⁻¹ •
        (directionalFDeriv (v j) (directionalFDeriv (v i) (fun y => mu y * a y i j)) x • w x +
        directionalFDeriv (v i) (fun y => mu y * a y i j) x • directionalFDeriv (v j) w x +
        directionalFDeriv (v j) (fun y => mu y * a y i j) x • directionalFDeriv (v i) w x)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      exact scalar_second_adjoint_term_difference (v i) (v j) mu
        (fun y => a y i j) w hm (ha i j) hw x hp
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [← Finset.smul_sum, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      rw [scalar_adjoint_cross_sum v mu a w x hs]
      module

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.ScalarBaseAdjoint

``````

### Calderon.ProfileRadiusJets

``````lean
import Calderon.ProfileFrechetJets
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.ExpDeriv

noncomputable section
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Gradient Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.RadiusProfile

lemma norm_iteratedFDeriv_exp (n : ℕ) (s : ℝ) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n Real.exp s‖ = Real.exp s := by
  rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv]
  have he : iteratedDeriv n Real.exp = Real.exp := by
    simpa only [one_mul, one_pow] using iteratedDeriv_exp_const_mul n (1 : ℝ)
  rw [he, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos s)]

lemma norm_iteratedFDeriv_exp_comp_le (u : R3 → ℝ) (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u)
    (n : ℕ) (x : R3) (D : ℝ)
    (hD : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ n → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i u x‖ ≤ D ^ i) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => Real.exp (u y)) x‖ ≤
      (n.factorial : ℝ) * Real.exp (u x) * D ^ n := by
  exact norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_le Real.contDiff_exp hu (by simp) x
    (fun i _ => (norm_iteratedFDeriv_exp i (u x)).le) hD

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.RadiusProfile

namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.ConformalDepth
open RadiusProfile

lemma contDiff_log_referenceRadius_profile (δ R L : ℝ) (p : ℕ)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => Real.log (referenceRadius δ R p L y)) := by
  rw [log_referenceRadius δ R p L hδ hR]
  exact contDiff_const.add (contDiff_const.mul
    ((contDiff_scalar_log_softplus δ hδ).comp (contDiff_referenceDepth L)))

theorem exists_dilated_referenceRadius_fixed_uniform_jet_envelope
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ J : ℝ, 1 ≤ J ∧ ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 → ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R →
      ∀ p : ℕ, 1 ≤ p → ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ n →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun y => Real.log (referenceRadius δ R p L y)) x‖ ≤
          (J * metricDifferentialNorm (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L)
            (fun y => Real.log (referenceRadius δ R p L y)) x) ^ i := by
  classical
  have ht : ∀ i : Fin (n + 1), ∃ J : ℝ, 0 < J ∧ ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 → ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R →
      ∀ p : ℕ, 1 ≤ p → ∀ x ∈ K, 1 ≤ i.val →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i.val (fun y => Real.log (referenceRadius δ R p L y)) x‖ ≤
          J * metricDifferentialNorm (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L)
            (fun y => Real.log (referenceRadius δ R p L y)) x ^ i.val := by
    intro i
    by_cases hi : 1 ≤ i.val
    · obtain ⟨J, hJ, hj⟩ := exists_dilated_referenceRadius_fixed_uniform_frechet_jet_bound
        g hg L hL K hK i.val hi
      exact ⟨J, hJ, fun lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp x hx _ =>
        hj lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp x hx⟩
    · exact ⟨1, by norm_num, fun _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ h => (hi h).elim⟩
  choose Js hJs hbounds using ht
  let J : ℝ := max 1 (∑ i, |Js i|)
  refine ⟨J, le_max_left _ _, ?_⟩
  intro lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp x hx i hi hin
  let k : Fin (n + 1) := ⟨i, by omega⟩
  have hs : Js k ≤ J := by
    exact (le_abs_self _).trans ((Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => abs_nonneg (Js j))
      (Finset.mem_univ k)).trans (le_max_right _ _))
  have hpow : Js k ≤ J ^ i := hs.trans (le_self_pow₀ (le_max_left _ _) (by omega))
  have hb : 0 ≤ metricDifferentialNorm (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L)
      (fun y => Real.log (referenceRadius δ R p L y)) x := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hj := hbounds k lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp x hx hi
  exact hj.trans (by simpa only [mul_pow] using
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hpow (pow_nonneg hb i))

theorem exists_dilated_referenceRadius_fixed_uniform_radius_jet_bounds
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 → ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R →
      ∀ p : ℕ, 1 ≤ p → ∀ x ∈ K,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (referenceRadius δ R p L) x‖ ≤
          C * referenceRadius δ R p L x *
            metricDifferentialNorm (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L)
              (fun y => Real.log (referenceRadius δ R p L y)) x ^ n ∧
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => (referenceRadius δ R p L y)⁻¹) x‖ ≤
          C * (referenceRadius δ R p L x)⁻¹ *
            metricDifferentialNorm (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L)
              (fun y => Real.log (referenceRadius δ R p L y)) x ^ n := by
  obtain ⟨J, hJ, hjets⟩ := exists_dilated_referenceRadius_fixed_uniform_jet_envelope
    g hg L hL K hK n
  refine ⟨(n.factorial : ℝ) * J ^ n, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp x hx
  let f : R3 → ℝ := fun y => Real.log (referenceRadius δ R p L y)
  let beta : ℝ := metricDifferentialNorm (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) f x
  have hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f := contDiff_log_referenceRadius_profile δ R L p hδ hR
  have he : (fun y => Real.exp (f y)) = referenceRadius δ R p L := by
    funext y
    exact Real.exp_log (referenceRadius_pos δ R p L y hδ hR)
  have hei : (fun y => Real.exp (-f y)) = fun y => (referenceRadius δ R p L y)⁻¹ := by
    funext y
    rw [Real.exp_neg]
    exact congrArg Inv.inv (Real.exp_log (referenceRadius_pos δ R p L y hδ hR))
  have hplus := norm_iteratedFDeriv_exp_comp_le f hf n x (J * beta)
    (fun i hi hin => hjets lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp x hx i hi hin)
  have hminus := norm_iteratedFDeriv_exp_comp_le (fun y => -f y) hf.neg n x (J * beta)
    (fun i hi hin => by
      rw [show (fun y => -f y) = -f by rfl, iteratedFDeriv_neg_apply, norm_neg]
      exact hjets lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp x hx i hi hin)
  rw [he] at hplus
  rw [hei] at hminus
  have hp0 : Real.exp (f x) = referenceRadius δ R p L x := congrFun he x
  have hm0 : Real.exp (-f x) = (referenceRadius δ R p L x)⁻¹ := congrFun hei x
  rw [hp0, mul_pow] at hplus
  rw [hm0, mul_pow] at hminus
  constructor
  · convert hplus using 1 <;> ring
  · convert hminus using 1 <;> ring

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.ConformalDepth

``````

### Calderon.ProfileHigherJets

Exact source SHA256 `19d1056d6ffbb16edca6dda3229047f276deaaff1944610c9f991970a810b89b`. The complete module is included to expose every actual premise, conclusion, definition and proof boundary.

``````lean
import Calderon.ProfileUniform
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.IteratedDeriv.Defs
import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Exponential
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Deriv.ZPow
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.IteratedDeriv.Lemmas

noncomputable section
open scoped ContDiff
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.RadiusProfile

def logistic (z : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.exp z / (1 + Real.exp z)

def logisticComplement (z : ℝ) : ℝ := 1 / (1 + Real.exp z)

def logExp (z : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.log (1 + Real.exp z)

lemma logistic_pos (z : ℝ) : 0 < logistic z := by
  unfold logistic
  positivity

lemma logisticComplement_pos (z : ℝ) : 0 < logisticComplement z := by
  unfold logisticComplement
  positivity

lemma logistic_add_complement (z : ℝ) : logistic z + logisticComplement z = 1 := by
  unfold logistic logisticComplement
  field_simp
  <;> ring

lemma logistic_lt_one (z : ℝ) : logistic z < 1 := by
  linarith [logistic_add_complement z, logisticComplement_pos z]

lemma logisticComplement_lt_one (z : ℝ) : logisticComplement z < 1 := by
  linarith [logistic_add_complement z, logistic_pos z]

lemma logExp_pos (z : ℝ) : 0 < logExp z := log_exp_add_one_pos z

lemma logisticComplement_eq_exp_neg (z : ℝ) :
    logisticComplement z = Real.exp (-logExp z) := by
  unfold logisticComplement logExp
  rw [Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log (by positivity)]
  simp only [one_div]

lemma hasDerivAt_logistic (z : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt logistic (logistic z * logisticComplement z) z := by
  have he := Real.hasDerivAt_exp z
  have h := he.div ((hasDerivAt_const z (1 : ℝ)).add he) (by positivity : 1 + Real.exp z ≠ 0)
  convert! h using 1 <;> simp [logistic, logisticComplement]
  field_simp
  <;> ring

lemma hasDerivAt_logisticComplement (z : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt logisticComplement (-logistic z * logisticComplement z) z := by
  have h := (hasDerivAt_const z (1 : ℝ)).div
    ((hasDerivAt_const z (1 : ℝ)).add (Real.hasDerivAt_exp z)) (by positivity : 1 + Real.exp z ≠ 0)
  convert! h using 1 <;> simp [logistic, logisticComplement]
  field_simp
  <;> ring

lemma hasDerivAt_logExp (z : ℝ) : HasDerivAt logExp (logistic z) z := by
  have h := ((hasDerivAt_const z (1 : ℝ)).add (Real.hasDerivAt_exp z)).log
    (by positivity : 1 + Real.exp z ≠ 0)
  change HasDerivAt (fun y => Real.log (1 + Real.exp y)) (Real.exp z / (1 + Real.exp z)) z
  simpa only [Pi.add_apply, zero_add] using h

lemma logExp_le_two_mul_logistic (z : ℝ) (hq : logistic z ≤ 1 / 2) :
    logExp z ≤ 2 * logistic z := by
  have hlog : logExp z ≤ Real.exp z := by
    unfold logExp
    have h := Real.log_le_sub_one_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < 1 + Real.exp z)
    linarith
  have hw : 1 / 2 ≤ logisticComplement z := by
    linarith [logistic_add_complement z]
  have he : Real.exp z * logisticComplement z = logistic z := by
    unfold logistic logisticComplement
    ring
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw (Real.exp_pos z).le
  nlinarith

lemma logExp_pow_mul_complement_le_factorial (z : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    logExp z ^ n * logisticComplement z ≤ (n.factorial : ℝ) := by
  have hf : 0 < (n.factorial : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_pos n
  have h := (div_le_iff₀ hf).mp (Real.pow_div_factorial_le_exp (logExp z) (logExp_pos z).le n)
  have he : Real.exp (logExp z) * logisticComplement z = 1 := by
    unfold logExp logisticComplement
    rw [Real.exp_log (by positivity)]
    field_simp
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h (logisticComplement_pos z).le
  nlinarith

/-- The finite terms in the normalized derivative numerator. -/
structure ProfileJetTerm where
  coeff : ℝ
  qPower : ℕ
  complementPower : ℕ
  logPower : ℕ

def ProfileJetTerm.value (t : ProfileJetTerm) (z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  t.coeff * logistic z ^ t.qPower * logisticComplement z ^ t.complementPower *
    logExp z ^ t.logPower

def ProfileJetTerm.admissible (t : ProfileJetTerm) (j : ℕ) : Prop :=
  t.coeff ≠ 0 → j ≤ t.qPower + t.logPower ∧
    (0 < t.logPower → 0 < t.complementPower)

def ProfileJetTerm.next (j : ℕ) (t : ProfileJetTerm) : List ProfileJetTerm :=
  [⟨t.coeff * t.qPower, t.qPower, t.complementPower + 1, t.logPower + 1⟩,
   ⟨-t.coeff * t.complementPower, t.qPower + 1, t.complementPower, t.logPower + 1⟩,
   ⟨t.coeff * ((t.logPower : ℝ) - j), t.qPower + 1, t.complementPower, t.logPower⟩]

lemma ProfileJetTerm.admissible_next (t : ProfileJetTerm) (j : ℕ)
    (ht : t.admissible j) : ∀ s ∈ t.next j, s.admissible (j + 1) := by
  intro s hs
  simp only [ProfileJetTerm.next, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hs
  rcases hs with rfl | rfl | rfl
  · intro hn
    dsimp only at hn ⊢
    have hc : t.coeff ≠ 0 := by intro h; simp [h] at hn
    obtain ⟨ha, hb⟩ := ht hc
    exact ⟨by omega, by omega⟩
  · intro hn
    dsimp only at hn ⊢
    have hc : t.coeff ≠ 0 := by intro h; simp [h] at hn
    have hb : 0 < t.complementPower := by
      by_contra h
      have hz : t.complementPower = 0 := by omega
      simp [hz] at hn
    obtain ⟨ha, _⟩ := ht hc
    exact ⟨by omega, fun _ => hb⟩
  · intro hn
    dsimp only at hn ⊢
    have hc : t.coeff ≠ 0 := by intro h; simp [h] at hn
    obtain ⟨ha, hb⟩ := ht hc
    exact ⟨by omega, hb⟩

lemma profile_jet_monomial_bound (z : ℝ) (a b c j : ℕ)
    (hdegree : j ≤ a + c) (hlog : 0 < c → 0 < b) :
    logistic z ^ a * logisticComplement z ^ b * logExp z ^ c ≤
      (2 : ℝ) ^ (c + j) * (c.factorial : ℝ) * logistic z ^ j := by
  have hq0 := (logistic_pos z).le
  have hw0 := (logisticComplement_pos z).le
  have hq1 := (logistic_lt_one z).le
  have hw1 := (logisticComplement_lt_one z).le
  have hqp : logistic z ^ a ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ hq0 hq1
  have hwp : logisticComplement z ^ b ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ hw0 hw1
  have hcFact : (1 : ℝ) ≤ c.factorial := by exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_pos c
  have htwo : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ j := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
  by_cases hsmall : logistic z ≤ 1 / 2
  · have hL := pow_le_pow_left₀ (logExp_pos z).le
      (logExp_le_two_mul_logistic z hsmall) c
    have hdegree' : logistic z ^ (a + c) ≤ logistic z ^ j :=
      pow_le_pow_of_le_one hq0 hq1 hdegree
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hL
      (show 0 ≤ logistic z ^ a * logisticComplement z ^ b by positivity)
    have hw := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hwp
      (show 0 ≤ logistic z ^ a * (2 * logistic z) ^ c by positivity)
    have hbase : logistic z ^ a * logisticComplement z ^ b * logExp z ^ c ≤
        2 ^ c * logistic z ^ (a + c) := by
      calc
        _ ≤ logistic z ^ a * logisticComplement z ^ b * (2 * logistic z) ^ c := hm
        _ ≤ logistic z ^ a * (2 * logistic z) ^ c := by nlinarith [hw]
        _ = _ := by rw [mul_pow, pow_add]; ring
    have hfirst := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdegree' (show 0 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ c by positivity)
    have hbig : (2 : ℝ) ^ c ≤ 2 ^ (c + j) * c.factorial := by
      rw [pow_add]
      nlinarith [pow_nonneg (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num) c,
        mul_le_mul htwo hcFact (by norm_num) (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ j)]
    exact hbase.trans (hfirst.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hbig (by positivity)))
  · have hhalf : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ≤ logistic z := le_of_not_ge hsmall
    have hqj := pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2) hhalf j
    have hj : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ j * logistic z ^ j := by
      have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hqj (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ j by positivity)
      have he : (2 : ℝ) ^ j * (1 / 2) ^ j = 1 := by rw [← mul_pow]; norm_num
      rwa [he] at hh
    have hbase : logistic z ^ a * logisticComplement z ^ b * logExp z ^ c ≤ c.factorial := by
      by_cases hc : c = 0
      · simp only [hc, pow_zero, mul_one, Nat.factorial_zero, Nat.cast_one]
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul hqp hwp (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ logisticComplement z ^ b) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1)]
      · have hb := hlog (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hc)
        have hw : logisticComplement z ^ b ≤ logisticComplement z := by
          simpa using pow_le_pow_of_le_one hw0 hw1 hb
        have hm : logistic z ^ a * logisticComplement z ^ b ≤ logisticComplement z := by
          have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hqp (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ logisticComplement z ^ b by positivity)
          nlinarith
        have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hm (pow_nonneg (logExp_pos z).le c)
        exact h.trans (by simpa [mul_comm] using logExp_pow_mul_complement_le_factorial z c)
    have h2c : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ c := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
    have hbig : (c.factorial : ℝ) ≤ 2 ^ (c + j) * c.factorial * logistic z ^ j := by
      rw [pow_add]
      nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hj (show 0 ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ c * c.factorial by positivity),
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2c (show 0 ≤ (c.factorial : ℝ) by positivity)]
    exact hbase.trans hbig

def ProfileJetTerm.bound (t : ProfileJetTerm) (j : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  |t.coeff| * 2 ^ (t.logPower + j) * t.logPower.factorial

lemma ProfileJetTerm.abs_value_le (t : ProfileJetTerm) (j : ℕ)
    (ht : t.admissible j) (z : ℝ) :
    |t.value z| ≤ t.bound j * logistic z ^ j := by
  by_cases hc : t.coeff = 0
  · simp [ProfileJetTerm.value, ProfileJetTerm.bound, hc]
  · obtain ⟨hd, hb⟩ := ht hc
    have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (profile_jet_monomial_bound z t.qPower t.complementPower t.logPower j hd hb)
      (abs_nonneg t.coeff)
    simpa [ProfileJetTerm.value, ProfileJetTerm.bound, abs_mul,
      abs_of_pos (logistic_pos z), abs_of_pos (logisticComplement_pos z),
      abs_of_pos (logExp_pos z), mul_assoc] using h

def profileJetTerms : ℕ → List ProfileJetTerm
  | 0 => [⟨1, 1, 0, 0⟩]
  | n + 1 => (profileJetTerms n).flatMap (ProfileJetTerm.next (n + 1))

lemma profileJetTerms_admissible (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ t ∈ profileJetTerms n, t.admissible (n + 1) := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro t ht
    simp only [profileJetTerms, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at ht
    subst t
    simp [ProfileJetTerm.admissible]
  | succ n ih =>
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨s, hs, ht⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp ht
    exact s.admissible_next (n + 1) (ih s hs) t ht

def profileJetNumerator (n : ℕ) (z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ((profileJetTerms n).map (fun t => t.value z)).sum

def profileJetBound (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ((profileJetTerms n).map (fun t => t.bound (n + 1))).sum

lemma profileJetNumerator_bound (n : ℕ) (z : ℝ) :
    |profileJetNumerator n z| ≤ profileJetBound n * logistic z ^ (n + 1) := by
  unfold profileJetNumerator profileJetBound
  have hgen : ∀ ts : List ProfileJetTerm,
      (∀ t ∈ ts, t.admissible (n + 1)) →
      |(ts.map (fun t => t.value z)).sum| ≤
        (ts.map (fun t => t.bound (n + 1))).sum * logistic z ^ (n + 1) := by
    intro ts
    induction ts with
    | nil => simp
    | cons t ts ih =>
      intro ht
      have hfirst := t.abs_value_le (n + 1) (ht t (by simp)) z
      have hrest := ih (fun s hs => ht s (by simp [hs]))
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
      exact (abs_add_le _ _).trans (by nlinarith)
  exact hgen _ (profileJetTerms_admissible n)

def ProfileJetTerm.normalizedValue (t : ProfileJetTerm) (j : ℕ) (z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  t.coeff * logistic z ^ t.qPower * logisticComplement z ^ t.complementPower *
    logExp z ^ ((t.logPower : ℤ) - j)

lemma ProfileJetTerm.normalizedValue_eq_div (t : ProfileJetTerm) (j : ℕ) (z : ℝ) :
    t.normalizedValue j z = t.value z / logExp z ^ j := by
  unfold ProfileJetTerm.normalizedValue ProfileJetTerm.value
  rw [zpow_sub₀ (ne_of_gt (logExp_pos z)), zpow_natCast, zpow_natCast]
  ring

lemma hasDerivAt_pow_of_mul (f : ℝ → ℝ) (x a : ℝ) (n : ℕ)
    (hf : HasDerivAt f (f x * a) x) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => f y ^ n) ((n : ℝ) * f x ^ n * a) x := by
  cases n with
  | zero => simpa using hasDerivAt_const x (1 : ℝ)
  | succ n =>
    convert! hf.pow (n + 1) using 1
    simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel, pow_succ]
    ring

lemma ProfileJetTerm.hasDerivAt_normalizedValue (t : ProfileJetTerm) (j : ℕ) (z : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (t.normalizedValue j)
      (((t.next j).map (fun s => s.normalizedValue (j + 1) z)).sum) z := by
  have hq := hasDerivAt_pow_of_mul logistic z (logisticComplement z) t.qPower
    (hasDerivAt_logistic z)
  have hw := hasDerivAt_pow_of_mul logisticComplement z (-logistic z) t.complementPower
    (by simpa [mul_comm] using hasDerivAt_logisticComplement z)
  have hL := (hasDerivAt_zpow ((t.logPower : ℤ) - j) (logExp z)
    (Or.inl (ne_of_gt (logExp_pos z)))).comp z (hasDerivAt_logExp z)
  have h := (((hasDerivAt_const z t.coeff).mul hq).mul hw).mul hL
  convert! h using 1
  have h1 : ((t.logPower + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) - ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) =
      (t.logPower : ℤ) - j := by omega
  have h2 : (t.logPower : ℤ) - ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℤ) =
      (t.logPower : ℤ) - j - 1 := by omega
  simp only [ProfileJetTerm.next, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.sum_cons,
    List.sum_nil, ProfileJetTerm.normalizedValue, pow_succ, Function.comp_apply,
    Pi.mul_apply, h1, h2, Int.cast_sub, Int.cast_natCast, zero_mul, zero_add]
  ring

def profileJet (n : ℕ) (z : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ((profileJetTerms n).map (fun t => t.normalizedValue (n + 1) z)).sum

lemma hasDerivAt_profileJet (n : ℕ) (z : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (profileJet n) (profileJet (n + 1) z) z := by
  have hgen : ∀ ts : List ProfileJetTerm,
      HasDerivAt (fun x => (ts.map (fun t => t.normalizedValue (n + 1) x)).sum)
        ((ts.flatMap (ProfileJetTerm.next (n + 1))).map
          (fun t => t.normalizedValue (n + 2) z)).sum z := by
    intro ts
    induction ts with
    | nil => simpa using hasDerivAt_const z (0 : ℝ)
    | cons t ts ih =>
      have h := (t.hasDerivAt_normalizedValue (n + 1) z).add ih
      convert! h using 1
      simp only [List.flatMap_cons, List.map_append, List.sum_append]
  exact hgen (profileJetTerms n)

lemma profileJet_eq_div (n : ℕ) (z : ℝ) :
    profileJet n z = profileJetNumerator n z / logExp z ^ (n + 1) := by
  unfold profileJet profileJetNumerator
  simp only [ProfileJetTerm.normalizedValue_eq_div, div_eq_mul_inv, List.sum_map_mul_right]

lemma profileJet_abs_le (n : ℕ) (z : ℝ) :
    |profileJet n z| ≤ profileJetBound n * (logistic z / logExp z) ^ (n + 1) := by
  rw [profileJet_eq_div, abs_div, abs_of_pos (pow_pos (logExp_pos z) _)]
  have h := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (profileJetNumerator_bound n z)
    (pow_nonneg (logExp_pos z).le (n + 1))
  simpa [div_pow, mul_div_assoc] using h

def logLogExp (z : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.log (logExp z)

lemma contDiff_logLogExp : ContDiff ℝ ∞ logLogExp := by
  have hL : ContDiff ℝ ∞ logExp := by
    apply (contDiff_const.add Real.contDiff_exp).log
    intro z
    positivity
  exact hL.log (fun z => ne_of_gt (logExp_pos z))

lemma hasDerivAt_logLogExp (z : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt logLogExp (profileJet 0 z) z := by
  have h := (hasDerivAt_logExp z).log (ne_of_gt (logExp_pos z))
  change HasDerivAt (fun y => Real.log (logExp y)) (profileJet 0 z) z
  simpa [profileJet_eq_div, profileJetNumerator, profileJetTerms,
    ProfileJetTerm.value] using h

lemma iteratedDeriv_logLogExp_eq_profileJet (n : ℕ) :
    iteratedDeriv (n + 1) logLogExp = profileJet n := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    funext z
    simpa only [Nat.zero_add, iteratedDeriv_one] using (hasDerivAt_logLogExp z).deriv
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, ih]
    funext z
    exact (hasDerivAt_profileJet n z).deriv

theorem abs_iteratedDeriv_logLogExp_le (n : ℕ) (z : ℝ) :
    |iteratedDeriv (n + 1) logLogExp z| ≤
      profileJetBound n * (logistic z / logExp z) ^ (n + 1) := by
  rw [iteratedDeriv_logLogExp_eq_profileJet]
  exact profileJet_abs_le n z

lemma log_softplus_eq_log_delta_add_logLogExp (δ t : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    Real.log (softplus δ t) = Real.log δ + logLogExp (t / δ) := by
  unfold softplus logLogExp logExp
  rw [Real.log_mul (ne_of_gt hδ) (ne_of_gt (log_exp_add_one_pos _))]

lemma logSlope_eq_logistic_div_logExp (δ t : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    logSlope δ t = δ⁻¹ * (logistic (t / δ) / logExp (t / δ)) := by
  unfold logSlope logistic logExp
  field_simp [ne_of_gt hδ]

theorem abs_iteratedDeriv_log_softplus_le (n : ℕ) (δ t : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    |iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (fun s => Real.log (softplus δ s)) t| ≤
      profileJetBound n * logSlope δ t ^ (n + 1) := by
  have he : (fun s => Real.log (softplus δ s)) =
      fun s => Real.log δ + logLogExp (δ⁻¹ * s) := by
    funext s
    rw [log_softplus_eq_log_delta_add_logLogExp δ s hδ]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [he, iteratedDeriv_const_add (by omega),
    iteratedDeriv_comp_const_mul (contDiff_logLogExp.of_le (by simp)) δ⁻¹]
  rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (pow_pos (inv_pos.mpr hδ) _)]
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (abs_iteratedDeriv_logLogExp_le n (δ⁻¹ * t))
    (pow_nonneg (inv_pos.mpr hδ).le (n + 1))
  rw [logSlope_eq_logistic_div_logExp δ t hδ, mul_pow]
  have he : δ⁻¹ * t = t / δ := by ring
  rw [he] at h
  convert h using 1 <;> ring

lemma profileJetBound_nonneg (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ profileJetBound n := by
  unfold profileJetBound
  apply List.sum_nonneg
  intro a ha
  obtain ⟨t, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp ha
  unfold ProfileJetTerm.bound
  positivity

theorem exists_uniform_log_softplus_jet_bound (j : ℕ) (hj : 1 ≤ j) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ δ t : ℝ, 0 < δ →
      |iteratedDeriv j (fun s => Real.log (softplus δ s)) t| ≤
        C * logSlope δ t ^ j := by
  obtain ⟨n, rfl⟩ : ∃ n : ℕ, j = n + 1 := ⟨j - 1, by omega⟩
  refine ⟨profileJetBound n + 1, by linarith [profileJetBound_nonneg n], ?_⟩
  intro δ t hδ
  have h := abs_iteratedDeriv_log_softplus_le n δ t hδ
  have hs := pow_nonneg (logSlope_pos δ t hδ).le (n + 1)
  nlinarith

theorem abs_iteratedDeriv_scalar_logProfile_le (n : ℕ) (δ c t : ℝ)
    (p : ℕ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    |iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (fun s => c + (p : ℝ) * Real.log (softplus δ s)) t| ≤
      profileJetBound n * ((p : ℝ) * logSlope δ t) ^ (n + 1) := by
  rw [iteratedDeriv_const_add (by omega), iteratedDeriv_const_mul_field]
  rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg p)]
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (abs_iteratedDeriv_log_softplus_le n δ t hδ)
    (Nat.cast_nonneg p)
  have hpR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast hp
  have hpPow : (p : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) :=
    le_self_pow₀ hpR (by omega)
  have hr := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hpPow
    (mul_nonneg (profileJetBound_nonneg n) (pow_nonneg (logSlope_pos δ t hδ).le (n + 1)))
  rw [mul_pow]
  nlinarith

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.RadiusProfile

``````

### Calderon.ProfileFrechetJets

import Calderon.ProfileHigherJets
import Calderon.DilatedProfileUniform
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.ContDiff.Bounds

set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 10
noncomputable section
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Gradient Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.RadiusProfile

lemma norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_le_of_positive_orders
    (g : ℝ → ℝ) (u : R3 → ℝ) (hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g) (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (x : R3) (C D : ℝ) (hC0 : 0 ≤ C)
    (hC : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ n → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i g (u x)‖ ≤ C)
    (hD : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ n → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i u x‖ ≤ D ^ i) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (g ∘ u) x‖ ≤ (n.factorial : ℝ) * C * D ^ n := by
  let G : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => g s - g (u x)
  have hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G := hg.sub contDiff_const
  have hsub (i : ℕ) (hi : 1 ≤ i) :
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ i G (u x) = iteratedFDeriv ℝ i g (u x) := by
    change iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (g - fun _ : ℝ => g (u x)) (u x) = _
    rw [iteratedFDeriv_sub_apply (hg.of_le (by simp)).contDiffAt contDiffAt_const,
      iteratedFDeriv_const_of_ne (by omega)]
    simp
  have hGbound : ∀ i : ℕ, i ≤ n → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i G (u x)‖ ≤ C := by
    intro i hi
    by_cases hz : i = 0
    · subst i
      simpa [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero, G] using hC0
    · rw [hsub i (by omega)]
      exact hC i (by omega) hi
  have h := norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_le hG hu (by simp) x hGbound hD
  have he : iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (G ∘ u) x = iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (g ∘ u) x := by
    change iteratedFDeriv ℝ n ((g ∘ u) - fun _ : R3 => g (u x)) x = _
    rw [iteratedFDeriv_sub_apply ((hg.comp hu).of_le (by simp)).contDiffAt
      contDiffAt_const, iteratedFDeriv_const_of_ne (by omega)]
    simp only [Pi.zero_apply, sub_zero]
  rwa [he] at h

lemma contDiff_scalar_log_softplus (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun s => Real.log (softplus δ s)) := by
  have he : (fun s => Real.log (softplus δ s)) =
      fun s => Real.log δ + logLogExp (s / δ) :=
    funext (fun s => log_softplus_eq_log_delta_add_logLogExp δ s hδ)
  rw [he]
  exact contDiff_const.add (contDiff_logLogExp.comp (contDiff_id.div_const δ))

def profileJetBoundSum (n : ℕ) : ℝ := ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, profileJetBound k

lemma profileJetBoundSum_nonneg (n : ℕ) : 0 ≤ profileJetBoundSum n := by
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun k _ => profileJetBound_nonneg k)

lemma profileJetBound_le_sum (n k : ℕ) (hk : k < n) :
    profileJetBound k ≤ profileJetBoundSum n := by
  exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => profileJetBound_nonneg i) (Finset.mem_range.mpr hk)

lemma norm_iteratedFDeriv_log_softplus_le (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n)
    (δ t : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun s => Real.log (softplus δ s)) t‖ ≤
      profileJetBound (n - 1) * logSlope δ t ^ n := by
  have hn' : n - 1 + 1 = n := by omega
  rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  simpa only [hn'] using abs_iteratedDeriv_log_softplus_le (n - 1) δ t hδ

lemma norm_iteratedFDeriv_log_softplus_comp_le (u : R3 → ℝ)
    (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (x : R3) (B D : ℝ) (hB : 1 ≤ B) (hBa : 1 ≤ B * logSlope δ (u x))
    (hD : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ n → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i u x‖ ≤ D ^ i) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => Real.log (softplus δ (u y))) x‖ ≤
      (n.factorial : ℝ) * profileJetBoundSum n *
        (B * logSlope δ (u x)) ^ n * D ^ n := by
  have ha := (logSlope_pos δ (u x) hδ).le
  have hC : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ n →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i (fun s => Real.log (softplus δ s)) (u x)‖ ≤
        profileJetBoundSum n * (B * logSlope δ (u x)) ^ n := by
    intro i hi hin
    have hs := norm_iteratedFDeriv_log_softplus_le i hi δ (u x) hδ
    have hterm := profileJetBound_le_sum n (i - 1) (by omega)
    have hp : logSlope δ (u x) ^ i ≤ (B * logSlope δ (u x)) ^ n := by
      have hmul : logSlope δ (u x) ≤ B * logSlope δ (u x) := by nlinarith
      exact (pow_le_pow_left₀ ha hmul i).trans (pow_le_pow_right₀ hBa hin)
    exact hs.trans (mul_le_mul hterm hp (pow_nonneg ha _) (profileJetBoundSum_nonneg n))
  have h := norm_iteratedFDeriv_comp_le_of_positive_orders
    (fun s => Real.log (softplus δ s)) u (contDiff_scalar_log_softplus δ hδ) hu n hn x
    (profileJetBoundSum n * (B * logSlope δ (u x)) ^ n) D (mul_nonneg (profileJetBoundSum_nonneg n) (pow_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith) ha) n)) hC hD
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, mul_assoc] using h

lemma norm_iteratedFDeriv_logProfile_le (u : R3 → ℝ)
    (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (δ c : ℝ) (p : ℕ)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (x : R3) (B D : ℝ) (hB : 1 ≤ B)
    (hD0 : 0 ≤ D) (hBa : 1 ≤ B * logSlope δ (u x))
    (hD : ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ n → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i u x‖ ≤ D ^ i) :
    ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (logProfile δ c p u) x‖ ≤
      (n.factorial : ℝ) * profileJetBoundSum n * (B * D) ^ n *
        ((p : ℝ) * logSlope δ (u x)) ^ n := by
  have hcomp := (contDiff_scalar_log_softplus δ hδ).comp hu
  have hf : iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (logProfile δ c p u) x =
      (p : ℝ) • iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => Real.log (softplus δ (u y))) x := by
    change iteratedFDeriv ℝ n ((fun _ : R3 => c) +
      fun y => (p : ℝ) * Real.log (softplus δ (u y))) x = _
    rw [iteratedFDeriv_add_apply (f := fun _ : R3 => c)
      (g := fun y => (p : ℝ) * Real.log (softplus δ (u y))) contDiffAt_const
      ((contDiff_const.mul hcomp).of_le (by simp)).contDiffAt,
      iteratedFDeriv_const_of_ne (by omega)]
    simp only [Pi.zero_apply, zero_add]
    simpa only [smul_eq_mul, Function.comp_def] using iteratedFDeriv_const_smul_apply' ((hcomp.of_le (by simp)).contDiffAt) (a := (p : ℝ))
  rw [hf, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg p)]
  have hbase := norm_iteratedFDeriv_log_softplus_comp_le u hu n hn δ hδ x B D hB hBa hD
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbase (Nat.cast_nonneg p)
  have hpR : (1 : ℝ) ≤ p := by exact_mod_cast hp
  have hpPow : (p : ℝ) ≤ (p : ℝ) ^ n := le_self_pow₀ hpR (by omega)
  have ha := (logSlope_pos δ (u x) hδ).le
  have hr := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hpPow
    (show 0 ≤ (n.factorial : ℝ) * profileJetBoundSum n * (B * logSlope δ (u x)) ^ n * D ^ n by
      exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (profileJetBoundSum_nonneg n))
        (pow_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith) ha) n)) (pow_nonneg hD0 n))
  convert h.trans hr using 1 <;> simp only [mul_pow] <;> ring

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.RadiusProfile

namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.ConformalDepth
open RadiusProfile

lemma exists_uniform_depth_jet_bound_on_compact (u : R3 → ℝ) (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u)
    (n : ℕ) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ D : ℝ, 1 ≤ D ∧ ∀ i : ℕ, 1 ≤ i → i ≤ n → ∀ x ∈ K,
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i u x‖ ≤ D ^ i := by
  let S : R3 → ℝ := fun x => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i u x‖
  have hS : Continuous S := by
    apply continuous_finsetSum
    intro i hi
    exact (hu.continuous_iteratedFDeriv (by simp)).norm
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hS.continuousOn
  refine ⟨max A 1, le_max_right _ _, ?_⟩
  intro i hi hin x hx
  have hsingle : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i u x‖ ≤ S x :=
    by
      change ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ i u x‖ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j u x‖
      exact Finset.single_le_sum (s := Finset.range (n + 1)) (a := i)
        (f := fun j => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ j u x‖) (fun j _ => norm_nonneg _)
        (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
  have hb : S x ≤ A := (le_abs_self _).trans (hA x hx)
  exact hsingle.trans (hb.trans ((le_max_left _ _).trans
    (le_self_pow₀ (le_max_right _ _) (by omega))))

theorem exists_dilated_referenceRadius_fixed_uniform_frechet_jet_bound
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    ∃ J : ℝ, 0 < J ∧ ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 → ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R →
      ∀ p : ℕ, 1 ≤ p → ∀ x ∈ K,
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => Real.log (referenceRadius δ R p L y)) x‖ ≤
          J * metricDifferentialNorm (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L)
            (fun y => Real.log (referenceRadius δ R p L y)) x ^ n := by
  obtain ⟨m, C, T, hm, hC, hbounds⟩ :=
    exists_dilatedReferenceDepth_uniform_metricNorm_bounds g hg L hL K hK
  obtain ⟨D, hD, hjets⟩ := exists_uniform_depth_jet_bound_on_compact
    (referenceDepth L) (contDiff_referenceDepth L) n K hK
  let a0 : ℝ := 1 / (1 + Real.log (1 + Real.exp T))
  have ha0 : 0 < a0 := by
    dsimp [a0]
    exact one_div_pos.mpr (by linarith [log_exp_add_one_pos T])
  let B : ℝ := max 1 (1 / a0)
  have hB : 1 ≤ B := le_max_left _ _
  let A : ℝ := (n.factorial : ℝ) * profileJetBoundSum n * (B * D) ^ n
  have hA : 0 ≤ A := by
    exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (profileJetBoundSum_nonneg n))
      (pow_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)) n)
  refine ⟨A / m ^ n + 1, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp x hx
  rw [log_referenceRadius δ R p L hδ hR]
  let a : ℝ := logSlope δ (referenceDepth L x)
  let beta : ℝ := metricDifferentialNorm (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L)
    (logProfile δ (Real.log R) p (referenceDepth L)) x
  obtain ⟨hmin, hmax, ht⟩ := hbounds lam hlam x hx
  have ha : 0 < a := logSlope_pos δ _ hδ
  have haLower : a0 ≤ a := logSlope_uniform_lower_bound δ _ T hδ hδ1 ht
  have hBa : 1 ≤ B * a := by
    have h1 : 1 / a0 ≤ B := le_max_right _ _
    have h2 := mul_le_mul h1 haLower ha0.le (by positivity : 0 ≤ B)
    have he : (1 / a0) * a0 = 1 := by field_simp
    rwa [he] at h2
  have hbase : ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (logProfile δ (Real.log R) p (referenceDepth L)) x‖ ≤
      A * ((p : ℝ) * a) ^ n :=
    norm_iteratedFDeriv_logProfile_le _ (contDiff_referenceDepth L) n hn δ (Real.log R) p
      hδ hp x B D hB (by linarith) hBa (fun i hi hin => hjets i hi hin x hx)
  have hbetaLower : (p : ℝ) * a * m ≤ beta := by
    dsimp [beta]
    rw [metricDifferentialNorm_logProfile _ δ (Real.log R) p _ x hδ
      ((contDiff_referenceDepth L).differentiable (by simp) x)]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmin (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg p) ha.le)
  have hbetaNonneg : 0 ≤ beta := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hratio : (p : ℝ) * a ≤ beta / m := (le_div_iff₀ hm).mpr hbetaLower
  have hpow := pow_le_pow_left₀ (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg p) ha.le) hratio n
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpow hA
  have hfinal : A * ((p : ℝ) * a) ^ n ≤ (A / m ^ n) * beta ^ n := by
    simpa only [div_pow, mul_div_assoc, div_mul_eq_mul_div] using hmul
  have hstep : (A / m ^ n) * beta ^ n ≤ (A / m ^ n + 1) * beta ^ n := by
    nlinarith [pow_nonneg hbetaNonneg n]
  exact hbase.trans (hfinal.trans hstep)

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.ConformalDepth

``````
````````
