````````markdown
### Calderon.ProfileCovariantJets

Exact source SHA256 `b4d29e57cef894736e6dd3dfac3f64e8c8a9a0f22b4326bae33831acb625937d`. The complete module is included to expose every actual premise, conclusion, definition and proof boundary.

``````lean
import Calderon.ProfileFrechetJets
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FDeriv.CompCLM

set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 10
noncomputable section
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Gradient Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.RadiusProfile

abbrev CoordinateConnectionFamily := ℝ × R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3

def jetBasisVector (i : Fin 3) : R3 := EuclideanSpace.single i 1

lemma norm_jetBasisVector (i : Fin 3) : ‖jetBasisVector i‖ = 1 := by
  simp [jetBasisVector, PiLp.norm_single]

def coordinatePartialJet (f : R3 → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (I : Fin n → Fin 3) (x : R3) : ℝ :=
  iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f x (fun i => jetBasisVector (I i))

lemma contDiff_coordinatePartialJet (f : R3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (n : ℕ) (I : Fin n → Fin 3) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (coordinatePartialJet f n I) := by
  exact (ContinuousMultilinearMap.apply ℝ (fun _ : Fin n => R3) ℝ
    (fun i => jetBasisVector (I i))).contDiff.comp (hf.iteratedFDeriv_right (by simp))

lemma abs_coordinatePartialJet_le (f : R3 → ℝ) (n : ℕ) (I : Fin n → Fin 3) (x : R3) :
    |coordinatePartialJet f n I x| ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f x‖ := by
  have h := (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f x).le_opNorm (fun i => jetBasisVector (I i))
  simpa only [coordinatePartialJet, Real.norm_eq_abs, norm_jetBasisVector,
    Finset.prod_const_one, mul_one] using h

lemma fderiv_coordinatePartialJet_apply (f : R3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (n : ℕ) (I : Fin n → Fin 3) (i : Fin 3) (x : R3) :
    fderiv ℝ (coordinatePartialJet f n I) x (jetBasisVector i) =
      coordinatePartialJet f (n + 1) (Fin.cons i I) x := by
  have hDn : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f) := hf.iteratedFDeriv_right (by simp)
  have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f) x := hDn.differentiable (by simp) x
  let J : Fin (n + 1) → Fin 3 := Fin.cons i I
  have h := DifferentiableAt.iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_left' (n := n) (f := f)
    (m := fun j : Fin (n + 1) => jetBasisVector (J j)) hd
  change fderiv ℝ (fun y => iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f y (fun k => jetBasisVector (I k))) x
    (jetBasisVector i) = _
  simpa only [coordinatePartialJet, J, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.tail_cons, Fin.tail_def,
    Fin.cons_succ] using h.symm

def baseCoefficientDerivative (a : ℝ × R3 → ℝ) (i : Fin 3) (z : ℝ × R3) : ℝ :=
  fderiv ℝ (fun y => a (z.1, y)) z.2 (jetBasisVector i)

lemma baseCoefficientDerivative_eq_total (a : ℝ × R3 → ℝ)
    (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ a) (i : Fin 3) (z : ℝ × R3) :
    baseCoefficientDerivative a i z = fderiv ℝ a z (0, jetBasisVector i) := by
  have hp : HasFDerivAt (fun y : R3 => (z.1, y)) (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ R3) z.2 :=
    hasFDerivAt_prodMk_right z.1 z.2
  have h := ((ha.differentiable (by simp) z).hasFDerivAt).comp z.2 hp
  change fderiv ℝ (a ∘ fun y : R3 => (z.1, y)) z.2 (jetBasisVector i) = _
  rw [h.fderiv]
  rfl

lemma contDiff_baseCoefficientDerivative (a : ℝ × R3 → ℝ)
    (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ a) (i : Fin 3) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (baseCoefficientDerivative a i) := by
  have he : baseCoefficientDerivative a i = fun z => fderiv ℝ a z (0, jetBasisVector i) :=
    funext (baseCoefficientDerivative_eq_total a ha i)
  rw [he]
  exact (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.mp ha).2.clm_apply contDiff_const

/-- Actual coordinate covariant derivatives, with one correction per covector slot. -/
def covariantCoordinateJet (Γ : CoordinateConnectionFamily) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (lam : ℝ) : (n : ℕ) → R3 → (Fin n → Fin 3) → ℝ
  | 0, x, _ => f x
  | n + 1, x, I =>
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => covariantCoordinateJet Γ f lam n y (Fin.tail I)) x
        (jetBasisVector (I 0)) -
      ∑ l : Fin n, ∑ k : Fin 3,
        (Γ (lam, x) (jetBasisVector (I 0)) (jetBasisVector ((Fin.tail I) l))) k *
          covariantCoordinateJet Γ f lam n x (Function.update (Fin.tail I) l k)

lemma covariantCoordinateJet_one (Γ : CoordinateConnectionFamily) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (lam : ℝ) (x : R3) (I : Fin 1 → Fin 3) :
    covariantCoordinateJet Γ f lam 1 x I = fderiv ℝ f x (jetBasisVector (I 0)) := by
  simp [covariantCoordinateJet]

lemma covector_jetBasisVector_sum (F : R3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (V : R3) :
    F V = ∑ k : Fin 3, V k * F (jetBasisVector k) := by
  have h := (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).sum_repr V
  calc
    F V = F (∑ k, ((EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).repr V) k •
      (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ) k) := congrArg F h.symm
    _ = _ := by simp only [map_sum, map_smul, EuclideanSpace.basisFun_repr, smul_eq_mul,
      EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply, jetBasisVector]

lemma covariantCoordinateJet_two_eq_coordinateHessian
    (Γ : CoordinateConnectionFamily) (f : R3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (lam : ℝ) (x : R3) (i j : Fin 3) :
    covariantCoordinateJet Γ f lam 2 x (Fin.cons i (Fin.cons j Fin.elim0)) =
      coordinateHessian f (fun V W => Γ (lam, x) V W) x
        (jetBasisVector i) (jetBasisVector j) := by
  have hD := (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.mp hf).2
  have hd : fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y (jetBasisVector j)) x (jetBasisVector i) =
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x (jetBasisVector i) (jetBasisVector j) := by
    rw [fderiv_clm_apply (hD.differentiable (by simp) x) (differentiableAt_const _)]
    simp
  rw [covariantCoordinateJet]
  simp only [covariantCoordinateJet_one, Fin.tail_cons, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.sum_univ_one,
    Function.update_self]
  change fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y (jetBasisVector j)) x (jetBasisVector i) -
    (∑ k : Fin 3, (Γ (lam, x) (jetBasisVector i) (jetBasisVector j)) k *
      fderiv ℝ f x (jetBasisVector k)) = _
  rw [hd, ← covector_jetBasisVector_sum]
  rfl

structure CoordinateJetTerm where
  coeff : ℝ × R3 → ℝ
  order : ℕ
  indices : Fin order → Fin 3

def coordinateTermValue (t : CoordinateJetTerm) (f : R3 → ℝ) (z : ℝ × R3) : ℝ :=
  t.coeff z * coordinatePartialJet f t.order t.indices z.2

def coordinateTermDerivative (i : Fin 3) (t : CoordinateJetTerm) : List CoordinateJetTerm :=
  [⟨baseCoefficientDerivative t.coeff i, t.order, t.indices⟩,
   ⟨t.coeff, t.order + 1, Fin.cons i t.indices⟩]

def coordinateTermMultiply (a : ℝ × R3 → ℝ) (t : CoordinateJetTerm) : CoordinateJetTerm :=
  ⟨fun z => a z * t.coeff z, t.order, t.indices⟩

def connectionCoordinateCoeff (Γ : CoordinateConnectionFamily) (i j k : Fin 3)
    (z : ℝ × R3) : ℝ := (Γ z (jetBasisVector i) (jetBasisVector j)) k

lemma contDiff_connectionCoordinateCoeff (Γ : CoordinateConnectionFamily)
    (hΓ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Γ) (i j k : Fin 3) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (connectionCoordinateCoeff Γ i j k) := by
  exact (PiLp.proj 2 (fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) k).contDiff.comp
    ((hΓ.clm_apply contDiff_const).clm_apply contDiff_const)

def covariantCoordinateExpansion (Γ : CoordinateConnectionFamily) :
    (n : ℕ) → (Fin n → Fin 3) → List CoordinateJetTerm
  | 0, _ => [⟨fun _ => 1, 0, Fin.elim0⟩]
  | n + 1, I =>
      (covariantCoordinateExpansion Γ n (Fin.tail I)).flatMap
        (coordinateTermDerivative (I 0)) ++
      (List.ofFn (fun l : Fin n => l)).flatMap (fun l =>
        (List.ofFn (fun k : Fin 3 => k)).flatMap (fun k =>
          (covariantCoordinateExpansion Γ n (Function.update (Fin.tail I) l k)).map
            (coordinateTermMultiply (fun z => -connectionCoordinateCoeff Γ (I 0) ((Fin.tail I) l) k z))))

lemma covariantCoordinateExpansion_coeff_smooth (Γ : CoordinateConnectionFamily)
    (hΓ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Γ) (n : ℕ) (I : Fin n → Fin 3) :
    ∀ t ∈ covariantCoordinateExpansion Γ n I, ContDiff ℝ ∞ t.coeff := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro t ht
    simp only [covariantCoordinateExpansion, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at ht
    subst t
    exact contDiff_const
  | succ n ih =>
    intro t ht
    simp only [covariantCoordinateExpansion, List.mem_append] at ht
    rcases ht with ht | ht
    · obtain ⟨s, hs, ht⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp ht
      simp only [coordinateTermDerivative, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at ht
      rcases ht with rfl | rfl
      · exact contDiff_baseCoefficientDerivative _ (ih (Fin.tail I) s hs) _
      · exact ih (Fin.tail I) s hs
    · obtain ⟨l, _, ht⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp ht
      obtain ⟨k, _, ht⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp ht
      obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp ht
      exact (contDiff_connectionCoordinateCoeff Γ hΓ _ _ _).neg.mul
        (ih (Function.update (Fin.tail I) l k) s hs)

lemma covariantCoordinateExpansion_order_le (Γ : CoordinateConnectionFamily)
    (n : ℕ) (I : Fin n → Fin 3) :
    ∀ t ∈ covariantCoordinateExpansion Γ n I, t.order ≤ n := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro t ht
    simp only [covariantCoordinateExpansion, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at ht
    subst t
    exact le_rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    intro t ht
    simp only [covariantCoordinateExpansion, List.mem_append] at ht
    rcases ht with ht | ht
    · obtain ⟨s, hs, ht⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp ht
      have h := ih (Fin.tail I) s hs
      simp only [coordinateTermDerivative, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at ht
      rcases ht with rfl | rfl <;> dsimp only <;> omega
    · obtain ⟨l, _, ht⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp ht
      obtain ⟨k, _, ht⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp ht
      obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp ht
      have h := ih (Function.update (Fin.tail I) l k) s hs
      dsimp only [coordinateTermMultiply]
      omega

lemma baseCoefficientDerivative_const (c : ℝ) (i : Fin 3) :
    baseCoefficientDerivative (fun _ => c) i = 0 := by
  funext z
  simp [baseCoefficientDerivative]

lemma covariantCoordinateExpansion_zero_order_coeff (Γ : CoordinateConnectionFamily)
    (n : ℕ) (I : Fin n → Fin 3) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    ∀ t ∈ covariantCoordinateExpansion Γ n I, t.order = 0 → t.coeff = 0 := by
  induction n with
  | zero => omega
  | succ n ih =>
    intro t ht hz
    simp only [covariantCoordinateExpansion, List.mem_append] at ht
    rcases ht with ht | ht
    · obtain ⟨s, hs, ht⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp ht
      simp only [coordinateTermDerivative, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at ht
      rcases ht with rfl | rfl
      · dsimp only at hz ⊢
        by_cases hzero : n = 0
        · subst n
          simp only [covariantCoordinateExpansion, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hs
          subst s
          exact baseCoefficientDerivative_const 1 _
        · rw [ih (Fin.tail I) (by omega) s hs hz]
          exact baseCoefficientDerivative_const 0 _
      · dsimp only at hz
        omega
    · obtain ⟨l, _, ht⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp ht
      obtain ⟨k, _, ht⟩ := List.mem_flatMap.mp ht
      obtain ⟨s, hs, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp ht
      have hpos : 1 ≤ n := by have h := l.isLt; omega
      have hc := ih (Function.update (Fin.tail I) l k) hpos s hs hz
      funext z
      simp only [coordinateTermMultiply, hc, Pi.zero_apply, mul_zero]

def coordinateTermsValue (ts : List CoordinateJetTerm) (f : R3 → ℝ) (z : ℝ × R3) : ℝ :=
  (ts.map (fun t => coordinateTermValue t f z)).sum

lemma coordinateTermsValue_append (as bs : List CoordinateJetTerm) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (z : ℝ × R3) : coordinateTermsValue (as ++ bs) f z =
      coordinateTermsValue as f z + coordinateTermsValue bs f z := by
  simp [coordinateTermsValue]

lemma coordinateTermsValue_flatMap {ι : Type*} (xs : List ι)
    (F : ι → List CoordinateJetTerm) (f : R3 → ℝ) (z : ℝ × R3) :
    coordinateTermsValue (xs.flatMap F) f z =
      (xs.map (fun i => coordinateTermsValue (F i) f z)).sum := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp [coordinateTermsValue]
  | cons x xs ih => simp [List.flatMap_cons, coordinateTermsValue_append, ih]

lemma coordinateTermsValue_multiply (a : ℝ × R3 → ℝ) (ts : List CoordinateJetTerm)
    (f : R3 → ℝ) (z : ℝ × R3) :
    coordinateTermsValue (ts.map (coordinateTermMultiply a)) f z =
      a z * coordinateTermsValue ts f z := by
  simp only [coordinateTermsValue, List.map_map, Function.comp_def,
    coordinateTermValue, coordinateTermMultiply, mul_assoc, List.sum_map_mul_left]

lemma contDiff_coordinateTermsValue_slice (ts : List CoordinateJetTerm)
    (hcoeff : ∀ t ∈ ts, ContDiff ℝ ∞ t.coeff)
    (f : R3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (lam : ℝ) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => coordinateTermsValue ts f (lam, x)) := by
  induction ts with
  | nil => exact contDiff_const
  | cons t ts ih =>
    have ht : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : R3 => coordinateTermValue t f (lam, x)) :=
      ((hcoeff t (by simp)).comp (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id)).mul
      (contDiff_coordinatePartialJet f hf t.order t.indices)
    have hts := ih (fun s hs => hcoeff s (by simp [hs]))
    exact ht.add hts

lemma fderiv_coordinateTermValue_slice_apply (t : CoordinateJetTerm)
    (ht : ContDiff ℝ ∞ t.coeff) (f : R3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (lam : ℝ) (x : R3) (i : Fin 3) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun y => coordinateTermValue t f (lam, y)) x (jetBasisVector i) =
      coordinateTermsValue (coordinateTermDerivative i t) f (lam, x) := by
  have ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : R3 => t.coeff (lam, y)) :=
    ht.comp (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id)
  have hJ := contDiff_coordinatePartialJet f hf t.order t.indices
  unfold coordinateTermValue
  rw [fderiv_fun_mul (c := fun y => t.coeff (lam, y))
    (d := coordinatePartialJet f t.order t.indices)
    (ha.differentiable (by simp) x) (hJ.differentiable (by simp) x)]
  simp only [add_apply, smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [fderiv_coordinatePartialJet_apply f hf]
  simp only [coordinateTermsValue, coordinateTermDerivative, List.map_cons, List.map_nil,
    List.sum_cons, List.sum_nil, coordinateTermValue, baseCoefficientDerivative, add_zero]
  ring

lemma fderiv_coordinateTermsValue_slice_apply (ts : List CoordinateJetTerm)
    (hcoeff : ∀ t ∈ ts, ContDiff ℝ ∞ t.coeff)
    (f : R3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (lam : ℝ) (x : R3) (i : Fin 3) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun y => coordinateTermsValue ts f (lam, y)) x (jetBasisVector i) =
      coordinateTermsValue (ts.flatMap (coordinateTermDerivative i)) f (lam, x) := by
  induction ts with
  | nil => simp [coordinateTermsValue]
  | cons t ts ih =>
    have ht : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => coordinateTermValue t f (lam, y)) :=
      ((hcoeff t (by simp)).comp (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id)).mul
        (contDiff_coordinatePartialJet f hf t.order t.indices)
    have hrest := contDiff_coordinateTermsValue_slice ts
      (fun s hs => hcoeff s (by simp [hs])) f hf lam
    have he : (fun y => coordinateTermsValue (t :: ts) f (lam, y)) =
        fun y => coordinateTermValue t f (lam, y) + coordinateTermsValue ts f (lam, y) := by
      funext y
      simp only [coordinateTermsValue, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons]
    rw [he, fderiv_fun_add (ht.differentiable (by simp) x) (hrest.differentiable (by simp) x)]
    simp only [add_apply, List.flatMap_cons, coordinateTermsValue_append]
    rw [fderiv_coordinateTermValue_slice_apply t (hcoeff t (by simp)) f hf,
      ih (fun s hs => hcoeff s (by simp [hs]))]

theorem covariantCoordinateJet_eq_expansion (Γ : CoordinateConnectionFamily)
    (hΓ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Γ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (lam : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (I : Fin n → Fin 3) (x : R3) :
    covariantCoordinateJet Γ f lam n x I =
      coordinateTermsValue (covariantCoordinateExpansion Γ n I) f (lam, x) := by
  induction n generalizing x with
  | zero => simp [covariantCoordinateJet, covariantCoordinateExpansion,
      coordinateTermsValue, coordinateTermValue, coordinatePartialJet]
  | succ n ih =>
    have he : (fun y => covariantCoordinateJet Γ f lam n y (Fin.tail I)) =
        fun y => coordinateTermsValue (covariantCoordinateExpansion Γ n (Fin.tail I)) f (lam, y) :=
      funext (fun y => ih (Fin.tail I) y)
    rw [covariantCoordinateJet, he,
      fderiv_coordinateTermsValue_slice_apply _
        (covariantCoordinateExpansion_coeff_smooth Γ hΓ _ _) f hf]
    rw [covariantCoordinateExpansion]
    rw [coordinateTermsValue_append, coordinateTermsValue_flatMap]
    simp only [coordinateTermsValue_flatMap, List.map_ofFn, Function.comp_def, List.sum_ofFn,
      coordinateTermsValue_multiply, ih, connectionCoordinateCoeff, neg_mul, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    ring

def covariantExpansionCoeffSum (Γ : CoordinateConnectionFamily) (n : ℕ)
    (I : Fin n → Fin 3) (z : ℝ × R3) : ℝ :=
  ((covariantCoordinateExpansion Γ n I).map (fun t => |t.coeff z|)).sum

lemma covariantExpansionCoeffSum_nonneg (Γ : CoordinateConnectionFamily)
    (n : ℕ) (I : Fin n → Fin 3) (z : ℝ × R3) :
    0 ≤ covariantExpansionCoeffSum Γ n I z := by
  apply List.sum_nonneg
  intro a ha
  obtain ⟨t, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp ha
  exact abs_nonneg _

lemma continuous_covariantExpansionCoeffSum (Γ : CoordinateConnectionFamily)
    (hΓ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Γ) (n : ℕ) (I : Fin n → Fin 3) :
    Continuous (covariantExpansionCoeffSum Γ n I) := by
  have hs := covariantCoordinateExpansion_coeff_smooth Γ hΓ n I
  have hgen : ∀ ts : List CoordinateJetTerm,
      (∀ t ∈ ts, ContDiff ℝ ∞ t.coeff) →
      Continuous (fun z => (ts.map (fun t => |t.coeff z|)).sum) := by
    intro ts
    induction ts with
    | nil => intro _; exact continuous_const
    | cons t ts ih =>
      intro ht
      exact (ht t (by simp)).continuous.abs.add (ih (fun s hs => ht s (by simp [hs])))
  exact hgen _ hs

lemma abs_coordinateTermsValue_le_of_jets (ts : List CoordinateJetTerm)
    (horder : ∀ t ∈ ts, t.order ≤ n)
    (hzero : ∀ t ∈ ts, t.order = 0 → t.coeff = 0)
    (f : R3 → ℝ) (z : ℝ × R3) (beta B J : ℝ)
    (hbeta : 0 ≤ beta) (hB : 1 ≤ B) (hBa : 1 ≤ B * beta) (hJ : 0 ≤ J)
    (hjets : ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ n → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f z.2‖ ≤ J * beta ^ k) :
    |coordinateTermsValue ts f z| ≤
      (ts.map (fun t => |t.coeff z|)).sum * J * (B * beta) ^ n := by
  have hterm : ∀ t ∈ ts, |coordinateTermValue t f z| ≤
      |t.coeff z| * J * (B * beta) ^ n := by
    intro t ht
    by_cases hz : t.order = 0
    · simp [coordinateTermValue, hzero t ht hz]
    · have hp : beta ^ t.order ≤ (B * beta) ^ n := by
        have hmul : beta ≤ B * beta := by nlinarith
        exact (pow_le_pow_left₀ hbeta hmul _).trans (pow_le_pow_right₀ hBa (horder t ht))
      have h := (abs_coordinatePartialJet_le f t.order t.indices z.2).trans
        ((hjets t.order (by omega) (horder t ht)).trans
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp hJ))
      have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (abs_nonneg (t.coeff z))
      simpa only [coordinateTermValue, abs_mul, mul_assoc] using hm
  have hgen : ∀ us : List CoordinateJetTerm,
      (∀ t ∈ us, |coordinateTermValue t f z| ≤ |t.coeff z| * J * (B * beta) ^ n) →
      |coordinateTermsValue us f z| ≤
        (us.map (fun t => |t.coeff z|)).sum * J * (B * beta) ^ n := by
    intro us
    induction us with
    | nil => intro _; simp [coordinateTermsValue]
    | cons t us ih =>
      intro ht
      have hfirst := ht t (by simp)
      have hrest := ih (fun s hs => ht s (by simp [hs]))
      simp only [coordinateTermsValue, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons] at hrest ⊢
      exact (abs_add_le _ _).trans (by nlinarith)
  exact hgen _ hterm

theorem exists_covariantCoordinateJet_compact_bound (Γ : CoordinateConnectionFamily)
    (hΓ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Γ) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ A : ℝ, 0 ≤ A ∧ ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ x ∈ K,
      ∀ I : Fin n → Fin 3, ∀ f : R3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ f →
      ∀ beta B J : ℝ, 0 ≤ beta → 1 ≤ B → 1 ≤ B * beta → 0 ≤ J →
      (∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → k ≤ n → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f x‖ ≤ J * beta ^ k) →
      |covariantCoordinateJet Γ f lam n x I| ≤ A * J * B ^ n * beta ^ n := by
  let S : ℝ × R3 → ℝ := fun z => ∑ I : Fin n → Fin 3, covariantExpansionCoeffSum Γ n I z
  have hS : Continuous S := by
    apply continuous_finsetSum
    intro I _
    exact continuous_covariantExpansionCoeffSum Γ hΓ n I
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (isCompact_Icc.prod hK).exists_bound_of_continuousOn hS.continuousOn
  refine ⟨max C 0, le_max_right _ _, ?_⟩
  intro lam hlam x hx I f hf beta B J hbeta hB hBa hJ hjets
  rw [covariantCoordinateJet_eq_expansion Γ hΓ f hf]
  have h := abs_coordinateTermsValue_le_of_jets _
    (covariantCoordinateExpansion_order_le Γ n I)
    (covariantCoordinateExpansion_zero_order_coeff Γ n I hn)
    f (lam, x) beta B J hbeta hB hBa hJ hjets
  have hcoeff : covariantExpansionCoeffSum Γ n I (lam, x) ≤ max C 0 := by
    have hsingle : covariantExpansionCoeffSum Γ n I (lam, x) ≤ S (lam, x) := by
      exact Finset.single_le_sum (s := Finset.univ) (a := I)
        (f := fun J => covariantExpansionCoeffSum Γ n J (lam, x))
        (fun J _ => covariantExpansionCoeffSum_nonneg Γ n J _) (Finset.mem_univ I)
    exact hsingle.trans (((le_abs_self _).trans (hC (lam, x) ⟨hlam, hx⟩)).trans (le_max_left _ _))
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcoeff
    (show 0 ≤ J * (B * beta) ^ n from
      mul_nonneg hJ (pow_nonneg (mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ B by linarith) hbeta) n))
  have he : (max C 0) * (J * (B * beta) ^ n) = max C 0 * J * B ^ n * beta ^ n := by
    rw [mul_pow]
    ring
  rw [he] at hm
  exact h.trans (by simpa only [covariantExpansionCoeffSum, mul_assoc] using hm)

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.RadiusProfile

    ∃ Cn : ℝ, 0 < Cn ∧ ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 → ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R →
      ∀ p : ℕ, 1 ≤ p → ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ I : Fin n → Fin 3,

``````lean
import Calderon.ReferenceCovariantJets

set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 10
noncomputable section
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Gradient Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.RadiusProfile

def coordinateProductTensor (n : ℕ) (I : Fin n → Fin 3) :
    ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin n => R3) ℝ :=
  (ContinuousMultilinearMap.mkPiAlgebraFin ℝ n ℝ).compContinuousLinearMap
    (fun j => EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) (I j))

lemma coordinateProductTensor_apply (n : ℕ) (I : Fin n → Fin 3) (V : Fin n → R3) :
    coordinateProductTensor n I V = ∏ j, (V j) (I j) := by
  simp [coordinateProductTensor, ContinuousMultilinearMap.mkPiAlgebraFin_apply, List.prod_ofFn]

lemma norm_coordinateProductTensor_le (n : ℕ) (I : Fin n → Fin 3) :
    ‖coordinateProductTensor n I‖ ≤ 1 := by
  have hproj : ∀ i : Fin 3, ‖(EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) i : R3 →L[ℝ] ℝ)‖ ≤ 1 := by
    intro i
    refine (EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) i : R3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).opNorm_le_bound (by norm_num) ?_
    intro V
    change ‖V i‖ ≤ 1 * ‖V‖
    simpa only [one_mul] using (PiLp.norm_apply_le V i)
  have h := ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_compContinuousLinearMap_le
    (ContinuousMultilinearMap.mkPiAlgebraFin ℝ n ℝ)
    (fun j => EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) (I j))
  simp only [ContinuousMultilinearMap.norm_mkPiAlgebraFin, one_mul] at h
  exact h.trans (Finset.prod_le_one₀ (fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _) (fun j _ => hproj (I j)))

lemma coordinateProductTensor_basis (n : ℕ) (I J : Fin n → Fin 3) :
    coordinateProductTensor n I (fun j => jetBasisVector (J j)) = if I = J then 1 else 0 := by
  classical
  rw [coordinateProductTensor_apply]
  by_cases h : I = J
  · subst I
    simp [jetBasisVector]
  · rw [ite_eq_right h]
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp h
    apply Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ j)
    simp [jetBasisVector, hj]

def covariantCoordinateTensor (Γ : CoordinateConnectionFamily) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (lam : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : R3) :
    ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin n => R3) ℝ :=
  ∑ I : Fin n → Fin 3, covariantCoordinateJet Γ f lam n x I • coordinateProductTensor n I

lemma covariantCoordinateTensor_basis (Γ : CoordinateConnectionFamily) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (lam : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : R3) (J : Fin n → Fin 3) :
    covariantCoordinateTensor Γ f lam n x (fun j => jetBasisVector (J j)) =
      covariantCoordinateJet Γ f lam n x J := by
  classical
  simp [covariantCoordinateTensor, coordinateProductTensor_basis, smul_eq_mul]

lemma norm_covariantCoordinateTensor_le (Γ : CoordinateConnectionFamily) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (lam : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : R3) (A : ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ I : Fin n → Fin 3, |covariantCoordinateJet Γ f lam n x I| ≤ A) :
    ‖covariantCoordinateTensor Γ f lam n x‖ ≤ (3 : ℝ) ^ n * A := by
  classical
  calc
    ‖covariantCoordinateTensor Γ f lam n x‖ ≤
        ∑ I : Fin n → Fin 3,
          ‖covariantCoordinateJet Γ f lam n x I • coordinateProductTensor n I‖ :=
      norm_sum_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _I : Fin n → Fin 3, A := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro I _
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_coordinateProductTensor_le n I)
        (abs_nonneg _)).trans (by simpa using hA I)
    _ = (3 : ℝ) ^ n * A := by simp

def tensorFrameSquare (n : ℕ)
    (T : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin n => R3) ℝ) (e : Fin 3 → R3) : ℝ :=
  ∑ I : Fin n → Fin 3, (T (fun j => e (I j))) ^ 2

lemma tensorFrameSquare_nonneg (n : ℕ)
    (T : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin n => R3) ℝ) (e : Fin 3 → R3) :
    0 ≤ tensorFrameSquare n T e := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)

lemma tensorFrameSquare_le (n : ℕ)
    (T : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin n => R3) ℝ) (e : Fin 3 → R3)
    (A : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (h : ∀ I : Fin n → Fin 3, |T (fun j => e (I j))| ≤ A) :
    tensorFrameSquare n T e ≤ (3 : ℝ) ^ n * A ^ 2 := by
  unfold tensorFrameSquare
  calc
    (∑ I : Fin n → Fin 3, (T (fun j => e (I j))) ^ 2) ≤
        ∑ _I : Fin n → Fin 3, A ^ 2 := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro I _
      simpa only [sq_abs] using (sq_le_sq₀ (abs_nonneg _) hA).mpr (h I)
    _ = _ := by simp

lemma sqrt_tensorFrameSquare_le (n : ℕ)
    (T : ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin n => R3) ℝ) (e : Fin 3 → R3)
    (A : ℝ) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (h : ∀ I : Fin n → Fin 3, |T (fun j => e (I j))| ≤ A) :
    Real.sqrt (tensorFrameSquare n T e) ≤ Real.sqrt ((3 : ℝ) ^ n) * A := by
  have hs := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (tensorFrameSquare_le n T e A hA h)
  simpa only [Real.sqrt_mul (pow_nonneg (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 3) n),
    Real.sqrt_sq hA] using hs

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.RadiusProfile

namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.ConformalDepth
open RadiusProfile AngularPolynomial MetricOperator ConnectionError

lemma exists_referenceMetric_uniform_quadratic_lower_bound_on_compact
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ lam : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ V : R3,
      c * ‖V‖ ^ 2 ≤
        ⟪metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x V, V⟫_ℝ := by
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hmetric⟩ := exists_metricOperatorField_global_lower_bound g hg
  obtain ⟨A, hA⟩ := hK.exists_bound_of_continuousOn contDiff_referenceCoordinateDepth.continuous.continuousOn
  refine ⟨Real.exp (-2 * L * A) * d, mul_pos (Real.exp_pos _) hd, ?_⟩
  intro lam x hx V
  have hxA : referenceCoordinateDepth x ≤ A := (le_abs_self _).trans (hA x hx)
  have he : Real.exp (-2 * L * A) ≤ Real.exp (-2 * L * referenceCoordinateDepth x) :=
    Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by nlinarith)
  rw [referenceMetric_operator_eq]
  simp only [smul_apply, real_inner_smul_left]
  change Real.exp (-2 * L * A) * d * ‖V‖ ^ 2 ≤
    Real.exp (-2 * L * referenceCoordinateDepth x) * ⟪metricOperatorField g (lam • x) V, V⟫_ℝ
  simpa only [mul_assoc] using
    mul_le_mul he (hmetric (lam • x) V) (mul_nonneg hd.le (sq_nonneg _))
      (Real.exp_pos _).le

lemma norm_le_sqrt_inv_of_quadratic_unit (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hM : ∀ V : R3, c * ‖V‖ ^ 2 ≤ ⟪M V, V⟫_ℝ)
    (V : R3) (hV : ⟪M V, V⟫_ℝ ≤ 1) : ‖V‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (1 / c) := by
  apply (Real.le_sqrt (norm_nonneg _) (one_div_pos.mpr hc).le).mpr
  exact (le_div_iff₀ hc).mpr (by simpa [mul_comm] using (hM V).trans hV)

theorem exists_dilated_referenceRadius_fixed_uniform_covariant_unit_vectors_bound
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    ∃ Cn : ℝ, 0 < Cn ∧ ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 → ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R →
      ∀ p : ℕ, 1 ≤ p → ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ V : Fin n → R3,
        (∀ j, ⟪metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x (V j), V j⟫_ℝ ≤ 1) →
        |covariantCoordinateTensor (referenceConnectionFamily g L)
          (fun y => Real.log (referenceRadius δ R p L y)) lam n x V| ≤
          Cn * metricDifferentialNorm (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L)
            (fun y => Real.log (referenceRadius δ R p L y)) x ^ n := by
  obtain ⟨J, hJ, hcomponents⟩ :=
    exists_dilated_referenceRadius_fixed_uniform_covariant_components_bound g hg L hL K hK n hn
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hmetric⟩ :=
    exists_referenceMetric_uniform_quadratic_lower_bound_on_compact g hg L hL K hK
  let D : ℝ := Real.sqrt (1 / c)
  have hD : 0 ≤ D := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  refine ⟨(3 : ℝ) ^ n * J * D ^ n + 1, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp x hx V hV
  let f : R3 → ℝ := fun y => Real.log (referenceRadius δ R p L y)
  let beta : ℝ := metricDifferentialNorm (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) f x
  have hbeta : 0 ≤ beta := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  let T := covariantCoordinateTensor (referenceConnectionFamily g L) f lam n x
  have hT : ‖T‖ ≤ (3 : ℝ) ^ n * (J * beta ^ n) :=
    norm_covariantCoordinateTensor_le _ _ _ _ _ _
      (hcomponents lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp x hx)
  have hnorm : ∀ j, ‖V j‖ ≤ D := fun j =>
    norm_le_sqrt_inv_of_quadratic_unit _ c hc (hmetric lam x hx) (V j) (hV j)
  have hprod : (∏ j, ‖V j‖) ≤ D ^ n := by
    calc
      (∏ j, ‖V j‖) ≤ ∏ _j : Fin n, D :=
        Finset.prod_le_prod₀ (fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _) (fun j _ => hnorm j)
      _ = D ^ n := by simp
  have h := (T.le_opNorm V).trans
    (mul_le_mul hT hprod (Finset.prod_nonneg (fun _ _ => norm_nonneg _)) (by positivity))
  change |T V| ≤ _
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
  nlinarith [pow_nonneg hbeta n]

theorem exists_dilated_referenceRadius_fixed_uniform_covariant_frame_norm_bound
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    ∃ Cn : ℝ, 0 < Cn ∧ ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 → ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R →
      ∀ p : ℕ, 1 ≤ p → ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ e : Fin 3 → R3,
        (∀ i, ⟪metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x (e i), e i⟫_ℝ ≤ 1) →
        Real.sqrt (tensorFrameSquare n
          (covariantCoordinateTensor (referenceConnectionFamily g L)
            (fun y => Real.log (referenceRadius δ R p L y)) lam n x) e) ≤
          Cn * metricDifferentialNorm (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L)
            (fun y => Real.log (referenceRadius δ R p L y)) x ^ n := by
  obtain ⟨J, hJ, hunit⟩ :=
    exists_dilated_referenceRadius_fixed_uniform_covariant_unit_vectors_bound g hg L hL K hK n hn
  refine ⟨Real.sqrt ((3 : ℝ) ^ n) * J + 1, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp x hx e he
  let f : R3 → ℝ := fun y => Real.log (referenceRadius δ R p L y)
  let beta : ℝ := metricDifferentialNorm (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) f x
  have hbeta : 0 ≤ beta := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have h := sqrt_tensorFrameSquare_le n
    (covariantCoordinateTensor (referenceConnectionFamily g L) f lam n x) e
    (J * beta ^ n) (by positivity) (fun I =>
      hunit lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp x hx (fun j => e (I j)) (fun j => he (I j)))
  exact h.trans (by nlinarith [pow_nonneg hbeta n])

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.ConformalDepth

set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 10

open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Gradient Topology

def bilinearCoordinateTensor (H : R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) :
    ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin 2 => R3) ℝ :=
  (((continuousMultilinearCurryFin1 ℝ R3 ℝ).symm.toContinuousLinearMap).comp H).uncurryLeft

lemma bilinearCoordinateTensor_apply (H : R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (V : Fin 2 → R3) :
    bilinearCoordinateTensor H V = H (V 0) (V 1) := by
  simp [bilinearCoordinateTensor, ContinuousLinearMap.uncurryLeft_apply, Fin.tail]

def coordinateHessianBilinear (Γ : CoordinateConnectionFamily) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (lam : ℝ) (x : R3) : R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x -
    (ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℝ R3 R3 ℝ (fderiv ℝ f x)).comp (Γ (lam, x))

lemma coordinateHessianBilinear_apply (Γ : CoordinateConnectionFamily) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (lam : ℝ) (x X Y : R3) :
    coordinateHessianBilinear Γ f lam x X Y =
      coordinateHessian f (fun V W => Γ (lam, x) V W) x X Y := by
  rfl

theorem covariantCoordinateTensor_two_eq_bilinearCoordinateTensor
    (Γ : CoordinateConnectionFamily) (f : R3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (lam : ℝ) (x : R3) :
    covariantCoordinateTensor Γ f lam 2 x =
      bilinearCoordinateTensor (coordinateHessianBilinear Γ f lam x) := by
  apply ContinuousMultilinearMap.toMultilinearMap_injective
  apply Module.Basis.ext_multilinear (fun _ : Fin 2 => (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ).toBasis)
  intro I
  simp only [OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis, EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply]
  change covariantCoordinateTensor Γ f lam 2 x (fun j => jetBasisVector (I j)) =
    bilinearCoordinateTensor (coordinateHessianBilinear Γ f lam x) (fun j => jetBasisVector (I j))
  rw [covariantCoordinateTensor_basis, bilinearCoordinateTensor_apply, coordinateHessianBilinear_apply]
  have hI : I = Fin.cons (I 0) (Fin.cons (I 1) Fin.elim0) := by
    ext j
    fin_cases j <;> rfl
  conv_lhs => rw [hI]
  exact covariantCoordinateJet_two_eq_coordinateHessian Γ f hf lam x (I 0) (I 1)

theorem covariantCoordinateTensor_two_eq_coordinateHessian
    (Γ : CoordinateConnectionFamily) (f : R3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (lam : ℝ) (x X Y : R3) :
    covariantCoordinateTensor Γ f lam 2 x (Fin.cons X (Fin.cons Y Fin.elim0)) =
      coordinateHessian f (fun V W => Γ (lam, x) V W) x X Y := by
  rw [covariantCoordinateTensor_two_eq_bilinearCoordinateTensor Γ f hf,
    bilinearCoordinateTensor_apply, coordinateHessianBilinear_apply]
  rfl

def IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3) : Prop :=
  ∀ i j, ⟪M (e i), e j⟫_ℝ = if i = j then 1 else 0

lemma IsMetricOrthonormalFrame_unit (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3)
    (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame M e) (i : Fin 3) : ⟪M (e i), e i⟫_ℝ = 1 := by
  simpa using he i i

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.RadiusProfile

theorem exists_dilated_referenceRadius_fixed_uniform_covariant_metric_frame_bound
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) :
    ∃ Cn : ℝ, 0 < Cn ∧ ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 → ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R →
      ∀ p : ℕ, 1 ≤ p → ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ e : Fin 3 → R3,
        IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x) e →
        Real.sqrt (tensorFrameSquare n
          (covariantCoordinateTensor (referenceConnectionFamily g L)
            (fun y => Real.log (referenceRadius δ R p L y)) lam n x) e) ≤
          Cn * metricDifferentialNorm (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L)
            (fun y => Real.log (referenceRadius δ R p L y)) x ^ n := by
  obtain ⟨Cn, hCn, h⟩ :=
    exists_dilated_referenceRadius_fixed_uniform_covariant_frame_norm_bound g hg L hL K hK n hn
  refine ⟨Cn, hCn, ?_⟩
  intro lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp x hx e he
  exact h lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp x hx e
    (fun i => (IsMetricOrthonormalFrame_unit _ _ he i).le)

theorem exists_dilated_referenceRadius_fixed_uniform_covariant_jets_one_to_eight_bound
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 → ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R →
      ∀ p : ℕ, 1 ≤ p → ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → n ≤ 8 → ∀ e : Fin 3 → R3,
        IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x) e →
        Real.sqrt (tensorFrameSquare n
          (covariantCoordinateTensor (referenceConnectionFamily g L)
            (fun y => Real.log (referenceRadius δ R p L y)) lam n x) e) ≤
          C * metricDifferentialNorm (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L)
            (fun y => Real.log (referenceRadius δ R p L y)) x ^ n := by
  choose J hJ using fun i : Fin 8 =>
    exists_dilated_referenceRadius_fixed_uniform_covariant_metric_frame_bound g hg L hL K hK
      (i.val + 1) (by omega)
  let S : ℝ := ∑ i : Fin 8, J i
  have hS : 0 ≤ S := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => (hJ i).1.le)
  refine ⟨S + 1, by linarith, ?_⟩
  intro lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp x hx n hn hn8 e he
  let i : Fin 8 := ⟨n - 1, by omega⟩
  have hi : i.val + 1 = n := by dsimp [i]; omega
  have h := (hJ i).2 lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp x hx
  rw [hi] at h
  have hbound := h e he
  have hsingle : J i ≤ S :=
    Finset.single_le_sum (s := Finset.univ) (a := i) (f := J)
      (fun j _ => (hJ j).1.le) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  exact hbound.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith)
    (pow_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) n))

``````lean
import Calderon.AngularEuclideanDensity
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Adjoint

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory
open scoped InnerProductSpace ContDiff
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.BaseDensityAdjoint

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]

/-- The actual Frechet directional derivative in a fixed base direction. -/
def directionalDeriv (v : R3) (u : R3 → E) : R3 → E :=
  fun x => fderiv ℝ u x v

lemma contDiff_directionalDeriv (v : R3) (u : R3 → E) (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (directionalDeriv v u) := by
  exact (hu.fderiv_right (m := ∞) (by simp)).clm_apply contDiff_const

lemma hasCompactSupport_directionalDeriv (v : R3) (u : R3 → E)
    (hc : HasCompactSupport u) : HasCompactSupport (directionalDeriv v u) := by
  exact hc.fderiv_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) v

lemma compact_inner_integrable (f g : R3 → E) (hf : Continuous f)
    (hg : Continuous g) (hc : HasCompactSupport g) :
    Integrable (fun x => ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ) := by
  apply (hf.inner hg).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
  apply hc.mono
  intro x hx
  simp only [Function.mem_support] at hx ⊢
  contrapose! hx
  simp [hx]

/-- Actual base integration by parts for a real Hilbert-valued compact section. -/
theorem compact_inner_directionalDeriv (v : R3) (f g : R3 → E)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g) (hc : HasCompactSupport g) :
    (∫ x : R3, ⟪f x, directionalDeriv v g x⟫_ℝ) =
      -(∫ x : R3, ⟪directionalDeriv v f x, g x⟫_ℝ) := by
  apply integral_bilinear_fderiv_right_eq_neg_left_of_integrable
    (B := innerSL ℝ (E := E))
  · exact compact_inner_integrable _ g
      (contDiff_directionalDeriv v f hf).continuous hg.continuous hc
  · exact compact_inner_integrable f _ hf.continuous
      (contDiff_directionalDeriv v g hg).continuous
      (hasCompactSupport_directionalDeriv v g hc)
  · exact compact_inner_integrable f g hf.continuous hg.continuous hc
  · intro x _
    exact hf.differentiable (by simp) x
  · intro x _
    exact hg.differentiable (by simp) x

/-- The full scalar density stays inside the derivative on the adjoint side. -/
theorem compact_weighted_first_adjoint (v : R3) (mu a : R3 → ℝ)
    (u w : R3 → E) (hm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ mu) (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ a)
    (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w) (hc : HasCompactSupport u) :
    (∫ x : R3, mu x * a x * ⟪directionalDeriv v u x, w x⟫_ℝ) =
      -(∫ x : R3, ⟪directionalDeriv v (fun y => (mu y * a y) • w y) x,
        u x⟫_ℝ) := by
  have h := compact_inner_directionalDeriv v (fun y => (mu y * a y) • w y) u
    ((hm.mul ha).smul hw) hu hc
  simpa only [inner_smul_left, starRingEnd_apply, star_trivial, real_inner_comm] using h

/-- Twice integrated genuine second-base term; the adjoint order is reversed. -/
theorem compact_weighted_second_adjoint (i j : R3) (mu a : R3 → ℝ)
    (u w : R3 → E) (hm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ mu) (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ a)
    (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w) (hc : HasCompactSupport u) :
    (∫ x : R3, mu x * a x *
      ⟪directionalDeriv i (directionalDeriv j u) x, w x⟫_ℝ) =
      (∫ x : R3, ⟪directionalDeriv j
        (directionalDeriv i (fun y => (mu y * a y) • w y)) x, u x⟫_ℝ) := by
  have h1 := compact_weighted_first_adjoint i mu a (directionalDeriv j u) w hm ha
    (contDiff_directionalDeriv j u hu) hw (hasCompactSupport_directionalDeriv j u hc)
  have h2 := compact_inner_directionalDeriv j
    (directionalDeriv i (fun y => (mu y * a y) • w y)) u
    (contDiff_directionalDeriv i _ ((hm.mul ha).smul hw)) hu hc
  rw [h1, h2, neg_neg]

lemma directionalDeriv_smul (v : R3) (c : R3 → ℝ) (w : R3 → E)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w) (x : R3) :
    directionalDeriv v (fun y => c y • w y) x =
      directionalDeriv v c x • w x + c x • directionalDeriv v w x := by
  unfold directionalDeriv
  rw [fderiv_fun_smul (hc.differentiable (by simp) x) (hw.differentiable (by simp) x)]
  simp only [add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, smul_apply]
  exact add_comm _ _

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.BaseDensityAdjoint

``````

``````lean
import Calderon.AngularCoefficient
import Calderon.AngularEuclideanDensity
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Constructions.HaarToSphere
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Function.L2Space
import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.MvPolynomial

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory MvPolynomial
open scoped InnerProductSpace
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SphereHarmonic
open AngularPolynomial

abbrev UnitSphere := Metric.sphere (0 : R3) 1

def surfaceMeasure : Measure UnitSphere := (volume : Measure R3).toSphere

lemma surfaceMeasure_ne_zero : surfaceMeasure ≠ 0 :=
  (volume : Measure R3).toSphere_ne_zero

instance surfaceMeasure_neZero : NeZero surfaceMeasure := ⟨surfaceMeasure_ne_zero⟩

instance surfaceMeasure_finite : IsFiniteMeasure surfaceMeasure := by
  unfold surfaceMeasure
  infer_instance

def sphereProbability : Measure UnitSphere := (surfaceMeasure Set.univ)⁻¹ • surfaceMeasure

instance sphereProbability_probability : IsProbabilityMeasure sphereProbability := by
  unfold sphereProbability
  infer_instance

lemma sphereProbability_univ : sphereProbability Set.univ = 1 := measure_univ

abbrev SphereL2 := Lp ℝ 2 sphereProbability

def polynomialSphere (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) : C(UnitSphere, ℝ) :=
  ⟨fun x => p.eval (x.val : Fin 3 → ℝ),
    p.continuous_eval.comp (by fun_prop)⟩

def polynomialSphereLinear : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] C(UnitSphere, ℝ) where
  toFun := polynomialSphere
  map_add' p q := by ext x; simp [polynomialSphere]
  map_smul' c p := by ext x; simp [polynomialSphere]

def polynomialSphereL2 : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] SphereL2 :=
  (ContinuousMap.toLp 2 sphereProbability ℝ).toLinearMap.comp polynomialSphereLinear

lemma polynomialSphereL2_inner (p q : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    ⟪polynomialSphereL2 p, polynomialSphereL2 q⟫_ℝ =
      ∫ x : UnitSphere, p.eval (x.val : Fin 3 → ℝ) *
        q.eval (x.val : Fin 3 → ℝ) ∂sphereProbability := by
  change ⟪(ContinuousMap.toLp 2 sphereProbability ℝ) (polynomialSphere p),
    (ContinuousMap.toLp 2 sphereProbability ℝ) (polynomialSphere q)⟫_ℝ = _
  simpa only [ContinuousMap.coe_mk, polynomialSphere,
    starRingEnd_apply, star_trivial, mul_comm] using
    ContinuousMap.inner_toLp sphereProbability (polynomialSphere p) (polynomialSphere q)

def harmonicHomogeneous (k : ℕ) : Submodule ℝ (MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) where
  carrier := {p | p.IsHomogeneous k ∧ laplacian p = 0}
  zero_mem' := ⟨(MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 3) ℝ k).zero_mem,
    by simp [laplacian]⟩
  add_mem' hp hq := ⟨hp.1.add hq.1, by
    change laplacian (_ + _) = 0
    simp only [laplacian, map_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    change laplacian _ + laplacian _ = 0
    rw [hp.2, hq.2, zero_add]⟩
  smul_mem' c p hp := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [smul_eq_C_mul] using hp.1.C_mul c
    · simpa only [smul_eq_C_mul] using laplacian_C_mul c p |>.trans (by rw [hp.2, mul_zero])

def harmonicSphereSubspace (k : ℕ) : Submodule ℝ SphereL2 :=
  (harmonicHomogeneous k).map polynomialSphereL2

def SphereFischerInner : Prop := ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ p q : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ,
  p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k → q ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k →
    ⟪polynomialSphereL2 p, polynomialSphereL2 q⟫_ℝ = normalizedFischerInner k p q

def OrthogonalSphereHarmonics : Prop := ∀ k m : ℕ, k ≠ m →
  ∀ u ∈ harmonicSphereSubspace k, ∀ v ∈ harmonicSphereSubspace m, ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ = 0

def DenseSphereHarmonics : Prop :=
  (⨆ k : ℕ, harmonicSphereSubspace k).topologicalClosure = ⊤

lemma polynomialSphereL2_norm_sq (hF : SphereFischerInner) (k : ℕ)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hp : p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) :
    ‖polynomialSphereL2 p‖ ^ 2 = normalizedFischerSquare k p := by
  rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hF k p p hp hp]
  rfl

lemma polynomialSphereL2_eq_zero_iff (hF : SphereFischerInner) (k : ℕ)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hp : p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) :
    polynomialSphereL2 p = 0 ↔ p = 0 := by
  rw [← norm_eq_zero, ← sq_eq_zero_iff, polynomialSphereL2_norm_sq hF k p hp]
  exact normalizedFischerSquare_eq_zero_iff k p

lemma polynomialSphereL2_injective_degree (hF : SphereFischerInner) (k : ℕ)
    (p q : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hp : p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k)
    (hq : q ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) :
    polynomialSphereL2 p = polynomialSphereL2 q ↔ p = q := by
  rw [← sub_eq_zero, ← map_sub,
    polynomialSphereL2_eq_zero_iff hF k (p - q) ((harmonicHomogeneous k).sub_mem hp hq),
    sub_eq_zero]

lemma polynomialSphereL2_mem (k : ℕ) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hp : p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) :
    polynomialSphereL2 p ∈ harmonicSphereSubspace k :=
  ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩

lemma polynomialSphereL2_finite_pythagoras (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (s : Finset ℕ)
    (p : ℕ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ k ∈ s, p k ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) :
    ‖∑ k ∈ s, polynomialSphereL2 (p k)‖ ^ 2 =
      ∑ k ∈ s, normalizedFischerSquare k (p k) := by
  classical
  rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, sum_inner]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k hk
  rw [inner_sum]
  have hdiag : (∑ m ∈ s, ⟪polynomialSphereL2 (p k), polynomialSphereL2 (p m)⟫_ℝ) =
      ⟪polynomialSphereL2 (p k), polynomialSphereL2 (p k)⟫_ℝ := by
    apply Finset.sum_eq_single k
    · intro m hm hmk
      exact hO k m (Ne.symm hmk) _ (polynomialSphereL2_mem k (p k) (hp k hk))
        _ (polynomialSphereL2_mem m (p m) (hp m hm))
    · intro hn
      exact False.elim (hn hk)
  rw [hdiag, hF k (p k) (p k) (hp k hk) (hp k hk)]
  rfl

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SphereHarmonic

``````

import Calderon.SphereHarmonicBridge

noncomputable section
open MvPolynomial
open scoped InnerProductSpace
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SphereHarmonic
open AngularPolynomial

def sphereRaising (k : ℕ) (q : Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  C ((Fintype.card (Fin 3) : ℝ) + 2 * (k + 1)) * harmonicRaising k q

lemma pderiv_harmonicHomogeneous (k : ℕ) (i : Fin 3)
    (h : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hh : h ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (k + 2)) :
    pderiv i h ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (k + 1) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [show k + 2 - 1 = k + 1 by omega] using hh.1.pderiv (i := i)
  · rw [laplacian_pderiv, hh.2, map_zero]

lemma polynomialDivergence_harmonicHomogeneous (k : ℕ)
    (q : Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hq : ∀ i, q i ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (k + 1)) :
    polynomialDivergence q ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k := by
  refine ⟨?_, laplacian_polynomialDivergence q (fun i => (hq i).2)⟩
  simpa only [Nat.add_sub_cancel] using
    polynomialDivergence_isHomogeneous q (fun i => (hq i).1)

lemma sphereRaising_harmonicHomogeneous (k : ℕ)
    (q : Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hq : ∀ i, q i ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (k + 1)) :
    sphereRaising k q ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (k + 2) := by
  have hhom := harmonicRaising_isHomogeneous (k := k + 1) (by omega)
    q (fun i => (hq i).1)
  have hΔ := laplacian_harmonicRaising (k := k + 1) q
    (fun i => (hq i).1) (fun i => (hq i).2)
    (by simpa only [Nat.add_sub_cancel] using
      ne_of_gt (radiusSq_laplacian_coefficient_pos (σ := Fin 3) k))
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [sphereRaising, Nat.add_sub_cancel, Nat.add_assoc] using
      hhom.C_mul ((Fintype.card (Fin 3) : ℝ) + 2 * (k + 1))
  · change laplacian (C _ * harmonicRaising k q) = 0
    rw [laplacian_C_mul]
    simpa only [Nat.add_sub_cancel, mul_zero] using congrArg (fun p => C
      ((Fintype.card (Fin 3) : ℝ) + 2 * (k + 1)) * p) hΔ

lemma sphereRaising_inner_adjoint (hF : SphereFischerInner) (k : ℕ)
    (q : Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (h : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hq : ∀ i, q i ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (k + 1))
    (hh : h ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (k + 2)) :
    ⟪polynomialSphereL2 (sphereRaising k q), polynomialSphereL2 h⟫_ℝ =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ⟪polynomialSphereL2 (q i), polynomialSphereL2 (pderiv i h)⟫_ℝ := by
  rw [hF (k + 2) _ h (sphereRaising_harmonicHomogeneous k q hq) hh]
  simp_rw [hF (k + 1) _ _ (hq _) (pderiv_harmonicHomogeneous k _ h hh)]
  exact normalizedFischer_raising_adjoint k q h hh.2

lemma polynomialDivergence_sphere_norm_bound (hF : SphereFischerInner) (k : ℕ)
    (q : Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hq : ∀ i, q i ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (k + 1)) :
    ‖polynomialSphereL2 (polynomialDivergence q)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (((k : ℝ) + 3) * (3 + 2 * k)) *
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ‖polynomialSphereL2 (q i)‖ ^ 2 := by
  rw [polynomialSphereL2_norm_sq hF k _ (polynomialDivergence_harmonicHomogeneous k q hq)]
  simp_rw [polynomialSphereL2_norm_sq hF (k + 1) _ (hq _)]
  simpa using normalizedFischer_divergence_bound k q (fun i => (hq i).1)

lemma sphereRaising_norm_bound (hF : SphereFischerInner) (k : ℕ)
    (q : Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hq : ∀ i, q i ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (k + 1)) :
    ‖polynomialSphereL2 (sphereRaising k q)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ((3 + 2 * ((k : ℝ) + 1)) * ((k : ℝ) + 2)) *
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ‖polynomialSphereL2 (q i)‖ ^ 2 := by
  rw [polynomialSphereL2_norm_sq hF (k + 2) _ (sphereRaising_harmonicHomogeneous k q hq)]
  simp_rw [polynomialSphereL2_norm_sq hF (k + 1) _ (hq _)]
  simpa [sphereRaising] using normalizedFischer_harmonicRaising_bound k q
    (fun i => (hq i).1) (fun i => (hq i).2)

lemma sphere_fock_difference (hF : SphereFischerInner) (k : ℕ)
    (qp qm : Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hqp : ∀ i, qp i ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (k + 1))
    (hqm : ∀ i, qm i ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (k + 1)) :
    ‖polynomialSphereL2 (sphereRaising k qp)‖ ^ 2 -
      ‖polynomialSphereL2 (polynomialDivergence qm)‖ ^ 2 =
      (((3 : ℝ) + 2 * (k + 1)) *
        ((∑ i : Fin 3, fischerInner (qp i) (qp i)) +
          (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, fischerInner (pderiv j (qp i)) (pderiv i (qp j))) -
          (4 / (4 * (k : ℝ) + 2 * 3)) *
            fischerInner (polynomialDivergence qp) (polynomialDivergence qp)) -
        ((3 : ℝ) + 2 * k) *
          fischerInner (polynomialDivergence qm) (polynomialDivergence qm)) /
        sphereNormalization 3 (k + 1) := by
  rw [polynomialSphereL2_norm_sq hF (k + 2) _ (sphereRaising_harmonicHomogeneous k qp hqp),
    polynomialSphereL2_norm_sq hF k _ (polynomialDivergence_harmonicHomogeneous k qm hqm)]
  simpa [sphereRaising] using normalizedFischer_fock_difference k qp qm
    (fun i => (hqp i).1) (fun i => (hqp i).2)

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SphereHarmonic

``````lean
import Calderon.SphereAngularCore

noncomputable section
open MvPolynomial
open scoped InnerProductSpace
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SphereHarmonic
open AngularPolynomial

def raisingComponent (m : ℕ) (i : Fin 3) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ := sphereRaising (m - 1) (Pi.single i p)

lemma pderiv_harmonicHomogeneous_succ (m : ℕ) (i : Fin 3)
    (h : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hh : h ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (m + 1)) :
    pderiv i h ∈ harmonicHomogeneous m := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [Nat.add_sub_cancel] using hh.1.pderiv (i := i)
  · rw [laplacian_pderiv, hh.2, map_zero]

lemma single_harmonicHomogeneous (m : ℕ) (i : Fin 3)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hp : p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous m) (j : Fin 3) :
    (Pi.single i p : Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous m := by
  classical
  by_cases hji : j = i
  · subst j; simpa using hp
  · simpa [Pi.single_apply, hji] using (harmonicHomogeneous m).zero_mem

lemma raisingComponent_harmonicHomogeneous (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (i : Fin 3)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hp : p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous m) :
    raisingComponent m i p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (m + 1) := by
  have h := sphereRaising_harmonicHomogeneous (m - 1) (Pi.single i p)
    (fun j => by simpa only [Nat.sub_add_cancel hm] using single_harmonicHomogeneous m i p hp j)
  simpa only [raisingComponent, show m - 1 + 2 = m + 1 by omega] using h

lemma raisingComponent_inner_adjoint (hF : SphereFischerInner) (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (i : Fin 3) (p h : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hp : p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous m) (hh : h ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (m + 1)) :
    ⟪polynomialSphereL2 (raisingComponent m i p), polynomialSphereL2 h⟫_ℝ =
      ⟪polynomialSphereL2 p, polynomialSphereL2 (pderiv i h)⟫_ℝ := by
  have hadj := sphereRaising_inner_adjoint hF (m - 1) (Pi.single i p) h
    (fun j => by simpa only [Nat.sub_add_cancel hm] using single_harmonicHomogeneous m i p hp j)
    (by simpa only [show m - 1 + 2 = m + 1 by omega] using hh)
  change ⟪polynomialSphereL2 (sphereRaising (m - 1) (Pi.single i p)), polynomialSphereL2 h⟫_ℝ = _
  rw [hadj]
  classical
  calc
    _ = ∑ j : Fin 3, if j = i then
        ⟪polynomialSphereL2 p, polynomialSphereL2 (pderiv i h)⟫_ℝ else 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      by_cases hji : j = i
      · subst j; simp
      · simp [Pi.single_apply, hji]
    _ = _ := by simp

lemma sum_double_raising_pair_eq_zero (hF : SphereFischerInner) (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (p h : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hp : p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous m)
    (hh : h ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (m + 2)) :
    (∑ i : Fin 3, ⟪polynomialSphereL2 (raisingComponent (m + 1) i (raisingComponent m i p)),
      polynomialSphereL2 h⟫_ℝ) = 0 := by
  have hh' : h ∈ harmonicHomogeneous ((m + 1) + 1) := by simpa only [Nat.add_assoc] using hh
  simp_rw [raisingComponent_inner_adjoint hF (m + 1) (by omega) _ _ h
    (raisingComponent_harmonicHomogeneous m hm _ p hp) hh']
  simp_rw [raisingComponent_inner_adjoint hF m hm _ p _ hp
    (pderiv_harmonicHomogeneous_succ (m + 1) _ h hh')]
  rw [← inner_sum, ← map_sum]
  change ⟪polynomialSphereL2 p, polynomialSphereL2 (laplacian h)⟫_ℝ = 0
  rw [hh.2, map_zero, inner_zero_right]

lemma sum_double_raising_eq_zero (hF : SphereFischerInner) (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hp : p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous m) :
    (∑ i : Fin 3, raisingComponent (m + 1) i (raisingComponent m i p)) = 0 := by
  let s := ∑ i : Fin 3, raisingComponent (m + 1) i (raisingComponent m i p)
  have hs : s ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (m + 2) := by
    apply (harmonicHomogeneous (m + 2)).sum_mem
    intro i hi
    simpa only [Nat.add_assoc] using raisingComponent_harmonicHomogeneous (m + 1)
      (by omega) i _ (raisingComponent_harmonicHomogeneous m hm i p hp)
  have hz : ‖polynomialSphereL2 s‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by
    rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
    change ⟪polynomialSphereL2 (∑ i : Fin 3, raisingComponent (m + 1) i
      (raisingComponent m i p)), polynomialSphereL2 s⟫_ℝ = 0
    rw [map_sum, sum_inner]
    simpa only [s, map_sum] using sum_double_raising_pair_eq_zero hF m hm p s hp hs
  have htrace : polynomialSphereL2 s = 0 := by
    exact norm_eq_zero.mp (sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hz)
  exact (polynomialSphereL2_eq_zero_iff hF (m + 2) s hs).mp htrace

lemma raisingComponent_C_mul (m : ℕ) (i : Fin 3) (c : ℝ)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    raisingComponent m i (C c * p) = C c * raisingComponent m i p := by
  classical
  have hsingle : (Pi.single i (C c * p) : Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) =
      fun j => C c * (Pi.single i p : Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) j := by
    funext j
    simp only [Pi.single_apply]
    split_ifs <;> simp
  unfold raisingComponent
  rw [hsingle]
  simp only [sphereRaising, harmonicRaising, polynomialRaising,
    polynomialDivergence, pderiv_mul, pderiv_C, zero_mul, zero_add]
  simp_rw [mul_left_comm (X _) (C c)]
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  ring

lemma raisingComponent_degree_commutator (m : ℕ) (i : Fin 3)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    polynomialSphereL2 (C ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * raisingComponent m i p) -
      polynomialSphereL2 (raisingComponent m i (C (m : ℝ) * p)) =
        polynomialSphereL2 (raisingComponent m i p) := by
  rw [raisingComponent_C_mul, ← map_sub]
  congr 1
  simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one, map_add, map_one]
  ring

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SphereHarmonic

``````

import Calderon.SphereElementaryCore

noncomputable section
open MvPolynomial
open scoped InnerProductSpace
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SphereHarmonic
open AngularPolynomial

def polynomialRotation (i j : Fin 3) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ := X i * pderiv j p - X j * pderiv i p

lemma polynomialRotation_harmonicHomogeneous (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (i j : Fin 3)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hp : p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) :
    polynomialRotation i j p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · have hi := (isHomogeneous_X (R := ℝ) i).mul (hp.1.pderiv (i := j))
    have hj := (isHomogeneous_X (R := ℝ) j).mul (hp.1.pderiv (i := i))
    have hdeg : 1 + (k - 1) = k := by omega
    simpa only [polynomialRotation, hdeg] using hi.sub hj
  · rw [polynomialRotation, laplacian_sub, laplacian_X_mul, laplacian_X_mul,
      laplacian_pderiv, laplacian_pderiv, hp.2, map_zero, map_zero, mul_zero,
      mul_zero, zero_add, zero_add, pderiv_pderiv_comm i j]
    exact sub_self _

lemma fischerInner_X_mul_square (i : Fin 3) (q : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    fischerInner (X i * q) (X i * q) =
      fischerInner q q + fischerInner (pderiv i q) (pderiv i q) := by
  rw [fischerInner_X_mul_left, pderiv_mul, pderiv_X_self, one_mul,
    fischerInner_add_right, ← fischerInner_pderiv_left]

lemma fischerInner_pderiv_square_le (k : ℕ) (i : Fin 3)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hp : p.IsHomogeneous k) :
    fischerInner (pderiv i p) (pderiv i p) ≤ (k : ℝ) * fischerInner p p := by
  rw [← sum_fischerInner_pderiv_self hp]
  exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => fischerInner_self_nonneg (pderiv j p))
    (Finset.mem_univ i)

lemma fischerInner_X_mul_pderiv_square_le (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (i j : Fin 3)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hp : p.IsHomogeneous k) :
    fischerInner (X i * pderiv j p) (X i * pderiv j p) ≤
      (k : ℝ) ^ 2 * fischerInner p p := by
  rw [fischerInner_X_mul_square]
  have hD := fischerInner_pderiv_square_le k j p hp
  have hDD := fischerInner_pderiv_square_le (k - 1) i (pderiv j p) hp.pderiv
  rw [Nat.cast_sub hk] at hDD
  push_cast at hDD
  have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hD (Nat.cast_nonneg k)
  nlinarith

lemma fischerInner_rotation_square_le (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (i j : Fin 3)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hp : p.IsHomogeneous k) :
    fischerInner (polynomialRotation i j p) (polynomialRotation i j p) ≤
      (4 * (k : ℝ) ^ 2) * fischerInner p p := by
  have h1 := fischerInner_X_mul_pderiv_square_le k hk i j p hp
  have h2 := fischerInner_X_mul_pderiv_square_le k hk j i p hp
  have htri := fischerInner_self_add_le (X i * pderiv j p) (-(X j * pderiv i p))
  simp only [fischerInner_neg_left, fischerInner_neg_right, neg_neg,
    ← sub_eq_add_neg] at htri
  change fischerInner (X i * pderiv j p - X j * pderiv i p)
    (X i * pderiv j p - X j * pderiv i p) ≤ _
  nlinarith

lemma fischerInner_rotation_skew (i j : Fin 3) (p q : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    fischerInner (polynomialRotation i j p) q =
      -fischerInner p (polynomialRotation i j q) := by
  simp only [polynomialRotation, fischerInner_sub_left, fischerInner_sub_right,
    fischerInner_X_mul_left, fischerInner_pderiv_left]
  ring

lemma polynomialRotation_sphere_inner_skew (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (i j : Fin 3) (p q : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hp : p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) (hq : q ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) :
    ⟪polynomialSphereL2 (polynomialRotation i j p), polynomialSphereL2 q⟫_ℝ =
      -⟪polynomialSphereL2 p, polynomialSphereL2 (polynomialRotation i j q)⟫_ℝ := by
  rw [hF k _ q (polynomialRotation_harmonicHomogeneous k hk i j p hp) hq,
    hF k p _ hp (polynomialRotation_harmonicHomogeneous k hk i j q hq)]
  unfold normalizedFischerInner
  rw [fischerInner_rotation_skew, neg_div]

lemma polynomialRotation_sphere_norm_sq_le (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (i j : Fin 3) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hp : p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) :
    ‖polynomialSphereL2 (polynomialRotation i j p)‖ ^ 2 ≤
      (4 * (k : ℝ) ^ 2) * ‖polynomialSphereL2 p‖ ^ 2 := by
  rw [polynomialSphereL2_norm_sq hF k _ (polynomialRotation_harmonicHomogeneous k hk i j p hp),
    polynomialSphereL2_norm_sq hF k p hp]
  unfold normalizedFischerSquare normalizedFischerInner
  have h := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (fischerInner_rotation_square_le k hk i j p hp.1)
    (le_of_lt (sphereNormalization_pos (n := Fintype.card (Fin 3)) Fintype.card_pos k))
  convert h using 1 <;> ring

lemma polynomialRotation_sphere_norm_le (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (i j : Fin 3) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hp : p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) :
    ‖polynomialSphereL2 (polynomialRotation i j p)‖ ≤
      (2 * (k : ℝ)) * ‖polynomialSphereL2 p‖ := by
  have h := polynomialRotation_sphere_norm_sq_le hF k hk i j p hp
  have hn : 0 ≤ (2 * (k : ℝ)) * ‖polynomialSphereL2 p‖ := by positivity
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (polynomialSphereL2 (polynomialRotation i j p)),
    norm_nonneg (polynomialSphereL2 p)]

def polynomialRotationCombination (c : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, C (c i j) * polynomialRotation i j p

lemma polynomialRotationCombination_harmonicHomogeneous (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (c : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hp : p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) :
    polynomialRotationCombination c p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k := by
  classical
  apply (harmonicHomogeneous k).sum_mem
  intro i hi
  apply (harmonicHomogeneous k).sum_mem
  intro j hj
  simpa only [smul_eq_C_mul] using (harmonicHomogeneous k).smul_mem (c i j)
    (polynomialRotation_harmonicHomogeneous k hk i j p hp)

lemma polynomialRotationCombination_sphere_norm_le (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (c : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hp : p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) :
    ‖polynomialSphereL2 (polynomialRotationCombination c p)‖ ≤
      (2 * (k : ℝ) * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |c i j|)) * ‖polynomialSphereL2 p‖ := by
  classical
  have hterm (i j : Fin 3) :
      ‖polynomialSphereL2 (C (c i j) * polynomialRotation i j p)‖ =
        |c i j| * ‖polynomialSphereL2 (polynomialRotation i j p)‖ := by
    rw [← smul_eq_C_mul, map_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  calc
    _ = ‖∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        polynomialSphereL2 (C (c i j) * polynomialRotation i j p)‖ := by
      simp only [polynomialRotationCombination, map_sum]
    _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ‖∑ j : Fin 3,
        polynomialSphereL2 (C (c i j) * polynomialRotation i j p)‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        ‖polynomialSphereL2 (C (c i j) * polynomialRotation i j p)‖ := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i hi
      exact norm_sum_le _ _
    _ = ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        |c i j| * ‖polynomialSphereL2 (polynomialRotation i j p)‖ := by simp_rw [hterm]
    _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        |c i j| * ((2 * (k : ℝ)) * ‖polynomialSphereL2 p‖) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i hi
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro j hj
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (polynomialRotation_sphere_norm_le hF k hk i j p hp) (abs_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := by simp only [← Finset.sum_mul]; ring

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SphereHarmonic

``````

``````lean
import Calderon.SphereHarmonicBridge

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory MvPolynomial
open scoped InnerProductSpace
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SphereHarmonic
open AngularPolynomial

lemma C_harmonicHomogeneous (c : ℝ) :
    C c ∈ harmonicHomogeneous 0 := by
  refine ⟨isHomogeneous_C (Fin 3) c, ?_⟩
  simp [laplacian]

def sphereMean : SphereL2 →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  innerSL ℝ (polynomialSphereL2 (C 1))

def meanZeroSphere : Submodule ℝ SphereL2 := sphereMean.ker

lemma meanZeroSphere_isClosed : IsClosed (meanZeroSphere : Set SphereL2) :=
  sphereMean.isClosed_ker

lemma sphereMean_polynomialSphereL2 (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    sphereMean (polynomialSphereL2 p) =
      ∫ x : UnitSphere, p.eval (x.val : Fin 3 → ℝ) ∂sphereProbability := by
  simp [sphereMean, innerSL_apply_apply, polynomialSphereL2_inner]

lemma polynomialSphere_integral_eq_zero (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≠ 0) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hp : p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) :
    (∫ x : UnitSphere, p.eval (x.val : Fin 3 → ℝ) ∂sphereProbability) = 0 := by
  have h := hO k 0 hk (polynomialSphereL2 p) (polynomialSphereL2_mem k p hp)
    (polynomialSphereL2 (C 1)) (polynomialSphereL2_mem 0 (C 1) (C_harmonicHomogeneous 1))
  simpa [polynomialSphereL2_inner] using h

lemma harmonicSphereSubspace_le_meanZero (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≠ 0) : harmonicSphereSubspace k ≤ meanZeroSphere := by
  rintro u ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
  change sphereMean (polynomialSphereL2 p) = 0
  rw [sphereMean_polynomialSphereL2]
  exact polynomialSphere_integral_eq_zero hO k hk p hp

lemma positiveHarmonicSpan_le_meanZero (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) :
    (⨆ k : ℕ, harmonicSphereSubspace (k + 1)) ≤ meanZeroSphere := by
  refine iSup_le fun k => harmonicSphereSubspace_le_meanZero hO (k + 1) ?_
  omega

lemma positiveHarmonicClosure_le_meanZero (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) :
    (⨆ k : ℕ, harmonicSphereSubspace (k + 1)).topologicalClosure ≤ meanZeroSphere := by
  exact Submodule.topologicalClosure_minimal _ (positiveHarmonicSpan_le_meanZero hO)
    meanZeroSphere_isClosed

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SphereHarmonic

### Calderon.ReferenceDensityBounds

Exact source SHA256 `bb92eac9b15582628628d7214cb7b15ccae3ec6a5403a39a6ab7130022ef7393`. The complete module is included to expose every actual premise, conclusion, definition and proof boundary.

``````lean
import Calderon.DilatedDepthUniform
import Calderon.PrincipalDirectional

noncomputable section
open scoped ContDiff Topology Matrix.Norms.Elementwise
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.ReferenceDensityBounds
open ConformalDepth EnergyBridge PrincipalCommutator

def coordinateDirection (i : Fin 3) : R3 := EuclideanSpace.single i 1

def familyDirectionalDeriv (i : Fin 3) (F : ℝ × R3 → ℝ) (z : ℝ × R3) : ℝ :=
  directionalFDeriv (coordinateDirection i) (fun y => F (z.1, y)) z.2

lemma familyDirectionalDeriv_eq (i : Fin 3) (F : ℝ × R3 → ℝ)
    (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F) (z : ℝ × R3) :
    familyDirectionalDeriv i F z = fderiv ℝ F z (0, coordinateDirection i) := by
  have hp : HasFDerivAt (fun y : R3 => (z.1,y))
      (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ R3) z.2 := hasFDerivAt_prodMk_right z.1 z.2
  have h := ((hF.differentiable (by simp) z).hasFDerivAt).comp z.2 hp
  unfold familyDirectionalDeriv directionalFDeriv
  change (fderiv ℝ (F ∘ fun y : R3 => (z.1,y)) z.2) (coordinateDirection i) = _
  rw [h.fderiv]
  rfl

lemma contDiff_familyDirectionalDeriv (i : Fin 3) (F : ℝ × R3 → ℝ)
    (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (familyDirectionalDeriv i F) := by
  have he : familyDirectionalDeriv i F =
      fun z => fderiv ℝ F z (0, coordinateDirection i) :=
    funext (familyDirectionalDeriv_eq i F hF)
  rw [he]
  exact (hF.fderiv_right (m := ∞) (by simp)).clm_apply contDiff_const

def referenceDensityFamily (g : MatrixField) (L : ℝ) (z : ℝ × R3) : ℝ :=
  vol (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g z.1) L) z.2

lemma referenceDensityFamily_eq (g : MatrixField) (L : ℝ) (z : ℝ × R3) :
    referenceDensityFamily g L z = Real.exp (-3 * L * referenceCoordinateDepth z.2) *
      vol g (z.1 • z.2) := by
  unfold referenceDensityFamily referenceMetric
  rw [vol_conformalMatrix]
  congr 1
  ring

lemma contDiff_referenceDensityFamily (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L : ℝ) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (referenceDensityFamily g L) := by
  have he : referenceDensityFamily g L = fun z =>
      Real.exp (-3 * L * referenceCoordinateDepth z.2) * vol g (z.1 • z.2) :=
    funext (referenceDensityFamily_eq g L)
  rw [he]
  exact ((contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_referenceCoordinateDepth.comp contDiff_snd)).exp).mul
    ((contDiff_vol g hg).comp (contDiff_fst.smul contDiff_snd))

lemma referenceDensityFamily_pos (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L : ℝ) (z : ℝ × R3) : 0 < referenceDensityFamily g L z := by
  exact vol_pos_of_posDef _
    (conformalMatrix_posDef _ _ (dilatedMetric_posDef g hg z.1)) z.2

lemma contDiff_referenceDensityFamily_inv (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L : ℝ) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => (referenceDensityFamily g L z)⁻¹) :=
  (contDiff_referenceDensityFamily g hg L).inv
    (fun z => ne_of_gt (referenceDensityFamily_pos g hg L z))

def referenceInverseEntryFamily (g : MatrixField) (L : ℝ) (i j : Fin 3)
    (z : ℝ × R3) : ℝ :=
  ((referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g z.1) L z.2)⁻¹ : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) i j

lemma referenceInverseEntryFamily_eq (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L : ℝ) (i j : Fin 3) (z : ℝ × R3) :
    referenceInverseEntryFamily g L i j z =
      Real.exp (2 * L * referenceCoordinateDepth z.2) * (g (z.1 • z.2))⁻¹ i j := by
  unfold referenceInverseEntryFamily referenceMetric
  rw [conformalMatrix_inverse _ _ (dilatedMetric_posDef g hg z.1)]
  simp only [Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  congr 2
  ring

lemma contDiff_referenceInverseEntryFamily (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L : ℝ) (i j : Fin 3) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (referenceInverseEntryFamily g L i j) := by
  have he : referenceInverseEntryFamily g L i j = fun z =>
      Real.exp (2 * L * referenceCoordinateDepth z.2) * (g (z.1 • z.2))⁻¹ i j :=
    funext (referenceInverseEntryFamily_eq g hg L i j)
  rw [he]
  exact ((contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_referenceCoordinateDepth.comp contDiff_snd)).exp).mul
    ((contDiff_metric_inverse_entry g hg i j).comp (contDiff_fst.smul contDiff_snd))

abbrev JetTag := Sum Unit (Sum (Fin 3) (Fin 3 × Fin 3))

def coordinateJetFamily (F : ℝ × R3 → ℝ) : JetTag → ℝ × R3 → ℝ
  | .inl _ => F
  | .inr (.inl i) => familyDirectionalDeriv i F
  | .inr (.inr (i,j)) => familyDirectionalDeriv j (familyDirectionalDeriv i F)

lemma continuous_coordinateJetFamily (F : ℝ × R3 → ℝ) (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F)
    (t : JetTag) : Continuous (coordinateJetFamily F t) := by
  rcases t with t | (i | ⟨i,j⟩)
  · exact hF.continuous
  · exact (contDiff_familyDirectionalDeriv i F hF).continuous
  · exact (contDiff_familyDirectionalDeriv j _ (contDiff_familyDirectionalDeriv i F hF)).continuous

theorem exists_uniform_bound_finite_family {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (F : ι → ℝ × R3 → ℝ) (hF : ∀ i, Continuous (F i))
    (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ M : ℝ, 1 ≤ M ∧ ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ i, |F i (lam,x)| ≤ M := by
  classical
  have he : ∀ i, ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ×ˢ K, |F i z| ≤ B :=
    fun i => (isCompact_Icc.prod hK).exists_bound_of_continuousOn (hF i).continuousOn
  choose B hB using he
  let M := max 1 (∑ i, |B i|)
  refine ⟨M, le_max_left _ _, ?_⟩
  intro lam hlam x hx i
  exact (hB i (lam,x) ⟨hlam,hx⟩).trans ((le_abs_self _).trans
    ((Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => abs_nonneg (B j)) (Finset.mem_univ i)).trans
      (le_max_right _ _)))

abbrev BackgroundTag := Sum (Fin 2) (Fin 3 × Fin 3)

def referenceBackgroundFamily (g : MatrixField) (L : ℝ) : BackgroundTag → ℝ × R3 → ℝ
  | .inl k => if k = 0 then referenceDensityFamily g L
      else fun z => (referenceDensityFamily g L z)⁻¹
  | .inr (i,j) => referenceInverseEntryFamily g L i j

lemma contDiff_referenceBackgroundFamily (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L : ℝ) (t : BackgroundTag) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (referenceBackgroundFamily g L t) := by
  rcases t with k | ⟨i,j⟩
  · by_cases hk : k = 0
    · simpa [referenceBackgroundFamily,hk] using contDiff_referenceDensityFamily g hg L
    · simpa [referenceBackgroundFamily,hk] using contDiff_referenceDensityFamily_inv g hg L
  · exact contDiff_referenceInverseEntryFamily g hg L i j

/-- One actual fixed compact bound for rho, rho inverse and Qgamma through two base derivatives. -/
theorem exists_referenceBackground_uniform_two_jet_bound (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L : ℝ) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ M : ℝ, 1 ≤ M ∧ ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ t : BackgroundTag, ∀ s : JetTag,
        |coordinateJetFamily (referenceBackgroundFamily g L t) s (lam,x)| ≤ M := by
  obtain ⟨M,hM,hbound⟩ := exists_uniform_bound_finite_family
    (fun t : BackgroundTag × JetTag => coordinateJetFamily (referenceBackgroundFamily g L t.1) t.2)
    (fun t => continuous_coordinateJetFamily _ (contDiff_referenceBackgroundFamily g hg L t.1) t.2)
    K hK
  exact ⟨M,hM,fun lam hlam x hx t s => hbound lam hlam x hx (t,s)⟩

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.ReferenceDensityBounds

``````
````````
