````````markdown
### Calderon.PerturbedDensityAdjoint

Exact source SHA256 `163ea8c233344c26b913f04836539daf9108684f88d7cb2a9926ce0d85468e40`. The complete module is included to expose every actual premise, conclusion, definition and proof boundary.

``````lean
import Calderon.ReferenceDensityBounds
import Calderon.ScalarDensityAdjoint

noncomputable section
open scoped ContDiff Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.PerturbedDensityAdjoint
open PrincipalCommutator ScalarBaseAdjoint ReferenceDensityBounds

def TwoJetBound (i j : R3) (f : R3 → ℝ) (x : R3) (A : ℝ) : Prop :=
  |f x| ≤ A ∧ |directionalFDeriv i f x| ≤ A ∧
    |directionalFDeriv j f x| ≤ A ∧
      |directionalFDeriv j (directionalFDeriv i f) x| ≤ A

lemma directional_mul (i : R3) (f g : R3 → ℝ)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g) (x : R3) :
    directionalFDeriv i (fun y => f y * g y) x =
      directionalFDeriv i f x * g x + f x * directionalFDeriv i g x := by
  simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using directionalFDeriv_smul i f g hf hg x

lemma directional_second_mul (i j : R3) (f g : R3 → ℝ)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g) (x : R3) :
    directionalFDeriv j (directionalFDeriv i (fun y => f y * g y)) x =
      directionalFDeriv j (directionalFDeriv i f) x * g x +
      directionalFDeriv i f x * directionalFDeriv j g x +
      directionalFDeriv j f x * directionalFDeriv i g x +
      f x * directionalFDeriv j (directionalFDeriv i g) x := by
  simpa only [smul_eq_mul] using directionalFDeriv_second_smul i j f g hf hg x

lemma directional_second_add (i j : R3) (f g : R3 → ℝ)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g) (x : R3) :
    directionalFDeriv j (directionalFDeriv i (fun y => f y + g y)) x =
      directionalFDeriv j (directionalFDeriv i f) x +
        directionalFDeriv j (directionalFDeriv i g) x := by
  have he : directionalFDeriv i (fun y => f y + g y) =
      fun y => directionalFDeriv i f y + directionalFDeriv i g y :=
    funext (directionalFDeriv_add i f g hf hg)
  rw [he, directionalFDeriv_add j _ _ (contDiff_directionalFDeriv i f hf)
    (contDiff_directionalFDeriv i g hg)]

lemma twoJetBound_mono (i j : R3) (f : R3 → ℝ) (x : R3) (A B : ℝ)
    (h : TwoJetBound i j f x A) (hab : A ≤ B) : TwoJetBound i j f x B :=
  ⟨h.1.trans hab,h.2.1.trans hab,h.2.2.1.trans hab,h.2.2.2.trans hab⟩

lemma twoJetBound_add (i j : R3) (f g : R3 → ℝ) (x : R3) (A B : ℝ)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g)
    (hF : TwoJetBound i j f x A) (hG : TwoJetBound i j g x B) :
    TwoJetBound i j (fun y => f y + g y) x (A+B) := by
  refine ⟨(abs_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add hF.1 hG.1),?_,?_,?_⟩
  · rw [directionalFDeriv_add i f g hf hg]
    exact (abs_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add hF.2.1 hG.2.1)
  · rw [directionalFDeriv_add j f g hf hg]
    exact (abs_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add hF.2.2.1 hG.2.2.1)
  · rw [directional_second_add i j f g hf hg]
    exact (abs_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add hF.2.2.2 hG.2.2.2)

lemma product_two_jet_bounds (i j : R3) (f g : R3 → ℝ) (x : R3) (A B : ℝ)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g) (hA : 0 ≤ A) (hB : 0 ≤ B)
    (hF : TwoJetBound i j f x A) (hG : TwoJetBound i j g x B) :
    |f x*g x|≤A*B ∧
    |directionalFDeriv i (fun y => f y*g y) x|≤2*A*B ∧
    |directionalFDeriv j (fun y => f y*g y) x|≤2*A*B ∧
    |directionalFDeriv j (directionalFDeriv i (fun y => f y*g y)) x|≤4*A*B := by
  have mulbound (v w : ℝ) (hv : |v|≤A) (hw : |w|≤B) : |v*w|≤A*B := by
    rw [abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul hv hw (abs_nonneg w) hA
  refine ⟨mulbound _ _ hF.1 hG.1,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · rw [directional_mul i f g hf hg]
    have h1 := mulbound _ _ hF.2.1 hG.1
    have h2 := mulbound _ _ hF.1 hG.2.1
    nlinarith [abs_add_le (directionalFDeriv i f x*g x) (f x*directionalFDeriv i g x)]
  · rw [directional_mul j f g hf hg]
    have h1 := mulbound _ _ hF.2.2.1 hG.1
    have h2 := mulbound _ _ hF.1 hG.2.2.1
    nlinarith [abs_add_le (directionalFDeriv j f x*g x) (f x*directionalFDeriv j g x)]
  · rw [directional_second_mul i j f g hf hg]
    have h1 := mulbound _ _ hF.2.2.2 hG.1
    have h2 := mulbound _ _ hF.2.1 hG.2.2.1
    have h3 := mulbound _ _ hF.2.2.1 hG.2.1
    have h4 := mulbound _ _ hF.1 hG.2.2.2
    have habs (a b c d : ℝ) : |a+b+c+d|≤|a|+|b|+|c|+|d| := by
      nlinarith [abs_add_le a b, abs_add_le (a+b) c, abs_add_le (a+b+c) d]
    exact (habs _ _ _ _).trans (by nlinarith)

def principalEntry (r q h : R3 → ℝ) (x : R3) : ℝ := r x * (q x+h x)

def densityPrincipalEntry (mu r q h : R3 → ℝ) (x : R3) : ℝ :=
  mu x * principalEntry r q h x

theorem density_principal_first_second_bounds (i j : R3) (mu r q h : R3 → ℝ)
    (hm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ mu) (hr : ContDiff ℝ ∞ r)
    (hq : ContDiff ℝ ∞ q) (hh : ContDiff ℝ ∞ h) (x : R3)
    (M J1 J2 beta eps : ℝ) (hM : 1≤M) (hJ1 : 0≤J1) (hJ2 : 0≤J2)
    (hb : 1≤beta) (heps : 0≤eps) (heps1 : eps≤1) (hpos : 0<r x)
    (hsmall : r x*beta^2≤eps)
    (hmjet : TwoJetBound i j mu x M) (hqjet : TwoJetBound i j q x M)
    (hhjet : TwoJetBound i j h x (eps*r x))
    (hr1i : |directionalFDeriv i r x|≤J1*r x*beta)
    (hr1j : |directionalFDeriv j r x|≤J1*r x*beta)
    (hr2 : |directionalFDeriv j (directionalFDeriv i r) x|≤J2*r x*beta^2) :
    |directionalFDeriv i (densityPrincipalEntry mu r q h) x|≤
      (J1+2)*M*(M+1)*eps/beta ∧
    |directionalFDeriv j (directionalFDeriv i (densityPrincipalEntry mu r q h)) x|≤
      (J2+4*J1+4)*M*(M+1)*eps := by
  have hbeta : 0<beta := by linarith
  have hM0 : 0≤M := by linarith
  have hr0 : 0≤r x := hpos.le
  have hre : r x≤eps := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (beta-1)]
  have hepr : eps*r x≤1 := by nlinarith
  have hh1 := twoJetBound_mono i j h x _ 1 hhjet hepr
  have hsum := twoJetBound_add i j q h x M 1 hq hh hqjet hh1
  let b : R3 → ℝ := fun y => mu y*(q y+h y)
  have hbS : ContDiff ℝ ∞ b := hm.mul (hq.add hh)
  obtain ⟨hb0,hbi,hbj,hb2⟩ := product_two_jet_bounds i j mu (fun y => q y+h y) x
    M (M+1) hm (hq.add hh) hM0 (by linarith) hmjet hsum
  have he : densityPrincipalEntry mu r q h = fun y => r y*b y := by
    funext y
    unfold densityPrincipalEntry principalEntry b
    ring
  rw [he]
  have hfirst : |directionalFDeriv i (fun y => r y*b y) x|≤
      (J1+2)*M*(M+1)*(r x*beta) := by
    rw [directional_mul i r b hr hbS]
    have h1 : |directionalFDeriv i r x*b x|≤(J1*r x*beta)*(M*(M+1)) := by
      rw [abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul hr1i hb0 (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
    have h2 : |r x*directionalFDeriv i b x|≤r x*(2*M*(M+1)) := by
      rw [abs_mul,abs_of_pos hpos]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbi hr0
    have hlow : r x*(2*M*(M+1))≤r x*beta*(2*M*(M+1)) := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hr0 (show 0≤2*M*(M+1) by positivity)]
    nlinarith [abs_add_le (directionalFDeriv i r x*b x) (r x*directionalFDeriv i b x)]
  have hsecond : |directionalFDeriv j (directionalFDeriv i (fun y => r y*b y)) x|≤
      (J2+4*J1+4)*M*(M+1)*(r x*beta^2) := by
    rw [directional_second_mul i j r b hr hbS]
    have h1 : |directionalFDeriv j (directionalFDeriv i r) x*b x|≤
        (J2*r x*beta^2)*(M*(M+1)) := by
      rw [abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul hr2 hb0 (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
    have h2 : |directionalFDeriv i r x*directionalFDeriv j b x|≤
        (J1*r x*beta)*(2*M*(M+1)) := by
      rw [abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul hr1i hbj (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
    have h3 : |directionalFDeriv j r x*directionalFDeriv i b x|≤
        (J1*r x*beta)*(2*M*(M+1)) := by
      rw [abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul hr1j hbi (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
    have h4 : |r x*directionalFDeriv j (directionalFDeriv i b) x|≤
        r x*(4*M*(M+1)) := by
      rw [abs_mul,abs_of_pos hpos]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb2 hr0
    have hlow : r x*beta≤r x*beta^2 := by nlinarith [mul_nonneg hr0 (show 0≤beta*(beta-1) by positivity)]
    have hlow2 : r x≤r x*beta^2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (beta-1)]
    have hh2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlow (show 0≤2*J1*M*(M+1) by positivity)
    have hh4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlow2 (show 0≤4*M*(M+1) by positivity)
    have habs (a b c d : ℝ) : |a+b+c+d|≤|a|+|b|+|c|+|d| := by
      nlinarith [abs_add_le a b,abs_add_le (a+b) c,abs_add_le (a+b+c) d]
    have ht := habs (directionalFDeriv j (directionalFDeriv i r) x*b x)
      (directionalFDeriv i r x*directionalFDeriv j b x)
      (directionalFDeriv j r x*directionalFDeriv i b x)
      (r x*directionalFDeriv j (directionalFDeriv i b) x)
    nlinarith
  constructor
  · have hs : r x*beta≤eps/beta := (le_div_iff₀ hbeta).mpr (by nlinarith [hsmall])
    have ht := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs (show 0≤(J1+2)*M*(M+1) by positivity)
    exact hfirst.trans (by simpa only [mul_div_assoc] using ht)
  · exact hsecond.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsmall
      (show 0≤(J2+4*J1+4)*M*(M+1) by positivity))

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.PerturbedDensityAdjoint

``````

``````lean
import Calderon.SphereMeanZero
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Projection.Submodule

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory MvPolynomial
open scoped InnerProductSpace
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SphereHarmonic

def positiveHarmonicSpan : Submodule ℝ SphereL2 :=
  ⨆ k : ℕ, harmonicSphereSubspace (k + 1)

def sphereConstantSpan : Submodule ℝ SphereL2 :=
  ℝ ∙ polynomialSphereL2 (C 1)

lemma sphereConstant_inner_self :
    ⟪polynomialSphereL2 (C 1), polynomialSphereL2 (C 1)⟫_ℝ = 1 := by
  rw [polynomialSphereL2_inner]
  simp

lemma sphereMean_constant_one : sphereMean (polynomialSphereL2 (C 1)) = 1 := by
  simpa [sphereMean, innerSL_apply_apply] using sphereConstant_inner_self

lemma harmonicSphereSubspace_zero_eq : harmonicSphereSubspace 0 = sphereConstantSpan := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · rintro u ⟨p,hp,rfl⟩
    have hd : p.totalDegree = 0 := (totalDegree_zero_iff_isHomogeneous (Fin 3)).2 hp.1
    have he := (totalDegree_eq_zero_iff_eq_C (p := p)).mp hd
    rw [he]
    change polynomialSphereL2 (C (p.coeff 0)) ∈ ℝ ∙ polynomialSphereL2 (C 1)
    apply Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mpr
    refine ⟨p.coeff 0, ?_⟩
    rw [← map_smul]
    simp [smul_eq_C_mul]
  · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro u (rfl : u = _)
    exact polynomialSphereL2_mem 0 (C 1) (C_harmonicHomogeneous 1)

lemma sphereConstantSpan_orthogonal_eq : sphereConstantSpanᗮ = meanZeroSphere := by
  ext u
  change u ∈ (ℝ ∙ polynomialSphereL2 (C 1))ᗮ ↔ sphereMean u = 0
  rw [Submodule.mem_orthogonal_singleton_iff_inner_right]
  rfl

lemma sphereConstant_mem_positiveHarmonic_orthogonal (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) :
    polynomialSphereL2 (C 1) ∈ positiveHarmonicSpanᗮ := by
  apply (positiveHarmonicSpan.mem_orthogonal' _).mpr
  intro u hu
  have hm := positiveHarmonicSpan_le_meanZero hO hu
  change sphereMean u = 0 at hm
  simpa [sphereMean, innerSL_apply_apply] using hm

lemma positiveHarmonic_orthogonal_eq_constants (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) : positiveHarmonicSpanᗮ = sphereConstantSpan := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro v hv
    let e := polynomialSphereL2 (C 1)
    let w := v - sphereMean v • e
    have hwmean : sphereMean w = 0 := by
      change sphereMean (v - sphereMean v • polynomialSphereL2 (C 1)) = 0
      rw [map_sub,map_smul,sphereMean_constant_one]
      simp
    have hwP : w ∈ positiveHarmonicSpanᗮ :=
      positiveHarmonicSpanᗮ.sub_mem hv
        (positiveHarmonicSpanᗮ.smul_mem _ (sphereConstant_mem_positiveHarmonic_orthogonal hO))
    have hwAll : w ∈ (⨆ k : ℕ, harmonicSphereSubspace k)ᗮ := by
      apply (Submodule.mem_orthogonal _ _).mpr
      have hle : (⨆ k : ℕ, harmonicSphereSubspace k) ≤ (ℝ ∙ w)ᗮ := by
        refine iSup_le fun k => ?_
        intro u hu
        apply Submodule.mem_orthogonal_singleton_iff_inner_right.mpr
        cases k with
        | zero =>
            have hw0 : w ∈ (harmonicSphereSubspace 0)ᗮ := by
              rw [harmonicSphereSubspace_zero_eq,sphereConstantSpan_orthogonal_eq]
              exact hwmean
            exact (harmonicSphereSubspace 0).inner_left_of_mem_orthogonal hu hw0
        | succ k =>
            have hup : u ∈ positiveHarmonicSpan :=
              (le_iSup (fun k : ℕ => harmonicSphereSubspace (k+1)) k) hu
            exact positiveHarmonicSpan.inner_left_of_mem_orthogonal hup hwP
      intro u hu
      exact inner_eq_zero_symm.mp
        (Submodule.mem_orthogonal_singleton_iff_inner_right.mp (hle hu))
    have hwzero : w = 0 := by
      have hcl : w ∈ (⨆ k : ℕ, harmonicSphereSubspace k).topologicalClosureᗮ := by
        rwa [Submodule.orthogonal_closure]
      rw [hD,Submodule.top_orthogonal_eq_bot] at hcl
      exact hcl
    have heq : v = sphereMean v • e := sub_eq_zero.mp hwzero
    rw [heq]
    exact sphereConstantSpan.smul_mem _ (Submodule.mem_span_singleton_self e)
  · apply Submodule.span_le.mpr
    rintro u (rfl : u = _)
    exact sphereConstant_mem_positiveHarmonic_orthogonal hO

lemma positiveHarmonicClosure_eq_meanZero (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) : positiveHarmonicSpan.topologicalClosure = meanZeroSphere := by
  rw [← positiveHarmonicSpan.orthogonal_orthogonal_eq_closure,
    positiveHarmonic_orthogonal_eq_constants hO hD,sphereConstantSpan_orthogonal_eq]

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SphereHarmonic

### Calderon.ActualScalarPrincipalAdjoint

``````lean
import Calderon.PerturbedDensityAdjoint
import Calderon.ProfileRadiusJets

noncomputable section
open Filter
open scoped ContDiff Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.ActualScalarPrincipalAdjoint
open PrincipalCommutator ScalarBaseAdjoint ReferenceDensityBounds PerturbedDensityAdjoint
open ConformalDepth

lemma norm_coordinateDirection (i : Fin 3) : ‖coordinateDirection i‖ = 1 := by
  simp [coordinateDirection]

lemma abs_coordinate_first_le (i : Fin 3) (f : R3 → ℝ) (x : R3) :
    |directionalFDeriv (coordinateDirection i) f x| ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 f x‖ := by
  simpa [directionalFDeriv, norm_coordinateDirection, norm_iteratedFDeriv_one]
    using (fderiv ℝ f x).le_opNorm (coordinateDirection i)

lemma abs_coordinate_second_le (i j : Fin 3) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (x : R3) :
    |directionalFDeriv (coordinateDirection j)
      (directionalFDeriv (coordinateDirection i) f) x| ≤ ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f x‖ := by
  have hD := (hf.fderiv_right (m := ∞) (by simp)).differentiable (by simp)
  unfold directionalFDeriv
  rw [fderiv_clm_apply (hD x) (differentiableAt_const (coordinateDirection i))]
  simp only [add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply, fderiv_const_apply, zero_apply, map_zero, zero_add]
  have hn := ContinuousLinearMap.le_opNorm₂ (fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x)
    (coordinateDirection j) (coordinateDirection i)
  have he : ‖fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x‖ = ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f x‖ := by
    rw [← norm_iteratedFDeriv_one (fderiv ℝ f), norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv]
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs, norm_coordinateDirection, mul_one, he] using hn

lemma contDiff_referenceRadius_actual (δ R : ℝ) (p : ℕ) (L : ℝ)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hR : 0 < R) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (referenceRadius δ R p L) := by
  have he : (fun y => Real.exp (Real.log (referenceRadius δ R p L y))) =
      referenceRadius δ R p L := by
    funext y
    exact Real.exp_log (referenceRadius_pos δ R p L y hδ hR)
  rw [← he]
  exact (contDiff_log_referenceRadius_profile δ R L p hδ hR).exp

def actualPrincipalMatrix (g : MatrixField) (L lam δ R : ℝ) (p : ℕ)
    (h : MatrixField) (x : R3) : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  fun i j => referenceRadius δ R p L x *
    (referenceInverseEntryFamily g L i j (lam,x) + h x i j)

lemma actualPrincipalMatrix_entry (g : MatrixField) (L lam δ R : ℝ) (p : ℕ)
    (h : MatrixField) (i j : Fin 3) :
    (fun x => actualPrincipalMatrix g L lam δ R p h x i j) =
      principalEntry (referenceRadius δ R p L)
        (fun x => referenceInverseEntryFamily g L i j (lam,x)) (fun x => h x i j) := rfl

/-- All constants are selected from the actual fixed background before shrink parameters or h. -/
theorem exists_actual_weighted_principal_uniform_bounds (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ M C1 C2 : ℝ, 1 ≤ M ∧ 0 < C1 ∧ 0 < C2 ∧
      ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 →
      ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → ∀ p : ℕ, 1 ≤ p → ∀ x ∈ K,
      ∀ eps : ℝ, 0 ≤ eps → eps ≤ 1 → ∀ h : MatrixField,
      (∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => h y i j)) →
      (∀ i j k l, TwoJetBound (coordinateDirection k) (coordinateDirection l)
        (fun y => h y i j) x (eps * referenceRadius δ R p L x)) →
      let beta := metricDifferentialNorm (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L)
        (fun y => Real.log (referenceRadius δ R p L y)) x
      1 ≤ beta → referenceRadius δ R p L x * beta^2 ≤ eps →
      |(referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x))⁻¹| ≤ M ∧
      ∀ i j k l,
        |directionalFDeriv (coordinateDirection k)
          (fun y => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,y) *
            actualPrincipalMatrix g L lam δ R p h y i j) x| ≤ C1 * eps / beta ∧
        |directionalFDeriv (coordinateDirection l) (directionalFDeriv (coordinateDirection k)
          (fun y => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,y) *
            actualPrincipalMatrix g L lam δ R p h y i j)) x| ≤ C2 * eps := by
  obtain ⟨M,hM,hbackground⟩ := exists_referenceBackground_uniform_two_jet_bound g hg L K hK
  obtain ⟨J1,hJ1,hjet1⟩ := exists_dilated_referenceRadius_fixed_uniform_radius_jet_bounds
    g hg L hL K hK 1
  obtain ⟨J2,hJ2,hjet2⟩ := exists_dilated_referenceRadius_fixed_uniform_radius_jet_bounds
    g hg L hL K hK 2
  refine ⟨M,(J1+2)*M*(M+1),(J2+4*J1+4)*M*(M+1),hM,by positivity,by positivity,?_⟩
  intro lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp x hx eps heps heps1 h hh hhjet beta hb hsmall
  have hmi := hbackground lam hlam x hx (.inl 1) (.inl ())
  refine ⟨by simpa [coordinateJetFamily,referenceBackgroundFamily] using hmi,?_⟩
  intro i j k l
  let mu : R3 → ℝ := fun y => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,y)
  let q : R3 → ℝ := fun y => referenceInverseEntryFamily g L i j (lam,y)
  have hslice : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : R3 => (lam,y)) := contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id
  have hm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ mu := (contDiff_referenceDensityFamily g hg L).comp hslice
  have hq : ContDiff ℝ ∞ q := (contDiff_referenceInverseEntryFamily g hg L i j).comp hslice
  have hmu : TwoJetBound (coordinateDirection k) (coordinateDirection l) mu x M := by
    refine ⟨?_,?_,?_,?_⟩
    · simpa [coordinateJetFamily,referenceBackgroundFamily,mu] using
        hbackground lam hlam x hx (.inl 0) (.inl ())
    · simpa [coordinateJetFamily,referenceBackgroundFamily,familyDirectionalDeriv,mu] using
        hbackground lam hlam x hx (.inl 0) (.inr (.inl k))
    · simpa [coordinateJetFamily,referenceBackgroundFamily,familyDirectionalDeriv,mu] using
        hbackground lam hlam x hx (.inl 0) (.inr (.inl l))
    · simpa [coordinateJetFamily,referenceBackgroundFamily,familyDirectionalDeriv,mu] using
        hbackground lam hlam x hx (.inl 0) (.inr (.inr (k,l)))
  have hqq : TwoJetBound (coordinateDirection k) (coordinateDirection l) q x M := by
    refine ⟨?_,?_,?_,?_⟩
    · exact hbackground lam hlam x hx (.inr (i,j)) (.inl ())
    · exact hbackground lam hlam x hx (.inr (i,j)) (.inr (.inl k))
    · exact hbackground lam hlam x hx (.inr (i,j)) (.inr (.inl l))
    · exact hbackground lam hlam x hx (.inr (i,j)) (.inr (.inr (k,l)))
  have hr := contDiff_referenceRadius_actual δ R p L hδ hR
  have h1 := (hjet1 lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp x hx).1
  have h2 := (hjet2 lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp x hx).1
  have h1k := (abs_coordinate_first_le k (referenceRadius δ R p L) x).trans h1
  have h1l := (abs_coordinate_first_le l (referenceRadius δ R p L) x).trans h1
  have h2kl := (abs_coordinate_second_le k l (referenceRadius δ R p L) hr x).trans h2
  have ht := density_principal_first_second_bounds (coordinateDirection k) (coordinateDirection l)
    mu (referenceRadius δ R p L) q (fun y => h y i j) hm hr hq (hh i j) x
    M J1 J2 beta eps hM hJ1.le hJ2.le hb heps heps1
    (referenceRadius_pos δ R p L x hδ hR) hsmall hmu hqq (hhjet i j k l)
    (by simpa only [pow_one] using h1k) (by simpa only [pow_one] using h1l) h2kl
  exact ht

-- These definitions are the actual coefficient functions in the checked scalar formal adjoint.
def adjointFirstCoefficient (v : Fin 3 → R3) (mu : R3 → ℝ)
    (a : MatrixField) (x : R3) (i : Fin 3) : ℝ :=
  2 * (mu x)⁻¹ * ∑ j, directionalFDeriv (v j) (fun y => mu y * a y i j) x

def adjointZeroCoefficient (v : Fin 3 → R3) (mu : R3 → ℝ)
    (a : MatrixField) (x : R3) : ℝ :=
  (mu x)⁻¹ * ∑ i, ∑ j, directionalFDeriv (v j)
    (directionalFDeriv (v i) (fun y => mu y * a y i j)) x

lemma abs_sum_three_le (f : Fin 3 → ℝ) (B : ℝ) (h : ∀ i, |f i| ≤ B) :
    |∑ i, f i| ≤ 3*B := by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i, |f i| := Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ _i : Fin 3, B := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => h i)
    _ = 3*B := by simp

lemma adjointFirstCoefficient_bound (v : Fin 3 → R3) (mu : R3 → ℝ)
    (a : MatrixField) (x : R3) (M B : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hm : |(mu x)⁻¹| ≤ M)
    (h : ∀ i j, |directionalFDeriv (v j) (fun y => mu y*a y i j) x| ≤ B)
    (i : Fin 3) : |adjointFirstCoefficient v mu a x i| ≤ 6*M*B := by
  have hs := abs_sum_three_le _ B (h i)
  unfold adjointFirstCoefficient
  rw [abs_mul,abs_mul,abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0:ℝ)<2)]
  have ht := mul_le_mul hm hs (abs_nonneg _) hM
  nlinarith

lemma adjointZeroCoefficient_bound (v : Fin 3 → R3) (mu : R3 → ℝ)
    (a : MatrixField) (x : R3) (M B : ℝ) (hM : 0 ≤ M)
    (hm : |(mu x)⁻¹| ≤ M)
    (h : ∀ i j, |directionalFDeriv (v j) (directionalFDeriv (v i)
      (fun y => mu y*a y i j)) x| ≤ B) :
    |adjointZeroCoefficient v mu a x| ≤ 9*M*B := by
  have hs := abs_sum_three_le _ (3*B) (fun i => abs_sum_three_le _ B (h i))
  unfold adjointZeroCoefficient
  rw [abs_mul]
  have ht := mul_le_mul hm hs (abs_nonneg _) hM
  nlinarith

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]

theorem scalarSecondBaseAdjoint_coefficient_form (v : Fin 3 → R3) (mu : R3 → ℝ)
    (a : MatrixField) (w : R3 → E) (hm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ mu)
    (ha : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => a y i j)) (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w)
    (x : R3) (hp : mu x ≠ 0) (hs : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, (a y).IsHermitian) :
    scalarSecondBaseAdjoint v mu a w x - scalarSecondBase v a w x =
      adjointZeroCoefficient v mu a x • w x +
      ∑ i, adjointFirstCoefficient v mu a x i • directionalFDeriv (v i) w x := by
  rw [scalarSecondBaseAdjoint_sub v mu a w hm ha hw x hp hs]
  simp only [adjointZeroCoefficient,adjointFirstCoefficient,Finset.mul_sum,Finset.sum_smul,
    Finset.smul_sum,smul_smul]

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.ActualScalarPrincipalAdjoint

``````lean
import Calderon.ActualScalarPrincipalAdjoint

noncomputable section
open Filter
open scoped ContDiff Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.ActualPerturbedDefect
open PrincipalCommutator ScalarBaseAdjoint ReferenceDensityBounds PerturbedDensityAdjoint
open ConformalDepth ActualScalarPrincipalAdjoint EnergyBridge

lemma actualPrincipalMatrix_isHermitian (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam δ R : ℝ) (p : ℕ) (h : MatrixField) (x : R3) (hh : (h x).IsHermitian) :
    (actualPrincipalMatrix g L lam δ R p h x).IsHermitian := by
  have hq : ((referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L x)⁻¹).IsHermitian :=
    (conformalMatrix_posDef _ _ (dilatedMetric_posDef g hg lam) x).isHermitian.inv
  have he : actualPrincipalMatrix g L lam δ R p h x =
      referenceRadius δ R p L x • ((referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L x)⁻¹ + h x) := by
    ext i j
    rfl
  rw [he]
  exact (hq.add hh).smul (by simp [IsSelfAdjoint])

lemma contDiff_actualPrincipalMatrix_entry (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam δ R : ℝ) (p : ℕ) (h : MatrixField)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hR : 0 < R) (hh : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => h y i j))
    (i j : Fin 3) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => actualPrincipalMatrix g L lam δ R p h y i j) := by
  have hq := (contDiff_referenceInverseEntryFamily g hg L i j).comp
    (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : R3 => (lam,y)))
  exact (contDiff_referenceRadius_actual δ R p L hδ hR).mul (hq.add (hh i j))

/-- The actual adjoint coefficients have the precise source smallness classes. -/
theorem exists_actual_adjoint_coefficients_uniform_bounds (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ Cfirst Czero : ℝ, 0 < Cfirst ∧ 0 < Czero ∧
      ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 →
      ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → ∀ p : ℕ, 1 ≤ p → ∀ x ∈ K,
      ∀ eps : ℝ, 0 ≤ eps → eps ≤ 1 → ∀ h : MatrixField,
      (∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => h y i j)) →
      (∀ i j k l, TwoJetBound (coordinateDirection k) (coordinateDirection l)
        (fun y => h y i j) x (eps * referenceRadius δ R p L x)) →
      let beta := metricDifferentialNorm (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L)
        (fun y => Real.log (referenceRadius δ R p L y)) x
      1 ≤ beta → referenceRadius δ R p L x * beta^2 ≤ eps →
      (∀ i, |adjointFirstCoefficient coordinateDirection
        (fun y => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,y))
        (actualPrincipalMatrix g L lam δ R p h) x i| ≤ Cfirst * eps / beta) ∧
      |adjointZeroCoefficient coordinateDirection (fun y => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,y))
        (actualPrincipalMatrix g L lam δ R p h) x| ≤ Czero * eps := by
  obtain ⟨M,C1,C2,hM,hC1,hC2,hbound⟩ :=
    exists_actual_weighted_principal_uniform_bounds g hg L hL K hK
  refine ⟨6*M*C1,9*M*C2,by positivity,by positivity,?_⟩
  intro lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp x hx eps heps heps1 h hh hhjet beta hb hsmall
  obtain ⟨hmi,hentry⟩ := hbound lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp x hx eps heps heps1 h hh hhjet hb hsmall
  constructor
  · intro i
    have ht := adjointFirstCoefficient_bound coordinateDirection
      (fun y => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,y)) (actualPrincipalMatrix g L lam δ R p h)
      x M (C1*eps/beta) (by linarith) hmi (fun a b => (hentry a b b b).1) i
    convert ht using 1 <;> ring
  · have ht := adjointZeroCoefficient_bound coordinateDirection
      (fun y => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,y)) (actualPrincipalMatrix g L lam δ R p h)
      x M (C2*eps) (by linarith) hmi (fun a b => (hentry a b a b).2)
    convert ht using 1 <;> ring

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]

/-- Exact scalar defect with the actual rho and the actual perturbed second coefficient. -/
theorem actual_scalar_adjoint_defect (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam δ R : ℝ) (p : ℕ) (h : MatrixField) (w : R3 → E)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hR : 0 < R) (hh : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => h y i j))
    (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w) (x : R3) (hs : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, (h y).IsHermitian) :
    scalarSecondBaseAdjoint coordinateDirection (fun y => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,y))
      (actualPrincipalMatrix g L lam δ R p h) w x -
      scalarSecondBase coordinateDirection (actualPrincipalMatrix g L lam δ R p h) w x =
      adjointZeroCoefficient coordinateDirection (fun y => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,y))
        (actualPrincipalMatrix g L lam δ R p h) x • w x +
      ∑ i, adjointFirstCoefficient coordinateDirection (fun y => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,y))
        (actualPrincipalMatrix g L lam δ R p h) x i • directionalFDeriv (coordinateDirection i) w x := by
  apply scalarSecondBaseAdjoint_coefficient_form
  · exact (contDiff_referenceDensityFamily g hg L).comp
      (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : R3 => (lam,y)))
  · exact contDiff_actualPrincipalMatrix_entry g hg L lam δ R p h hδ hR hh
  · exact hw
  · exact ne_of_gt (referenceDensityFamily_pos g hg L (lam,x))
  · filter_upwards [hs] with y hy
    exact actualPrincipalMatrix_isHermitian g hg L lam δ R p h y hy

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.ActualPerturbedDefect

### Calderon.DetIdentity

``````lean
/-

Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
Authors: The Tau Ceti contributors
-/

import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Deriv.Comp
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Deriv.Polynomial
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FDeriv.Mul
import Mathlib.Analysis.Matrix.Normed
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Charpoly.Coeff
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Deriv.Mul

/-!
# The derivative of the determinant at the identity

The determinant of a square matrix over a complete nontrivially normed field is a polynomial in
the entries, hence differentiable, and its derivative at the identity matrix is the trace:

`det (1 + H) = 1 + trace H + o(H)`.

This is Jacobi's formula at the identity. Along a line it is the statement that the polynomial
`t ↦ det (1 + t • B)` has linear coefficient `trace B`, which Mathlib records as
`Matrix.derivative_det_one_add_X_smul`; differentiability of the determinant then upgrades that
directional derivative to the Fréchet derivative.

The normed structure on matrices is Mathlib's `L∞` operator norm, available through
`open scoped Matrix.Norms.Operator`; any other norm on the finite-dimensional space of matrices
gives the same derivative.

## Main results

* `Matrix.hasDerivAt_det_one_add_smul`: `t ↦ det (1 + t • B)` has derivative `trace B` at `0`.
* `Matrix.differentiable_det`: the determinant is differentiable.
* `Matrix.hasFDerivAt_det_one`: **the derivative of the determinant at the identity is the
  trace.**
-/


open Polynomial
open scoped Matrix Matrix.Norms.Operator

namespace Matrix

variable {n : Type*} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {𝕜 : Type*} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜]

/-- The determinant along the line through the identity in the direction `B` has derivative
`trace B` at the identity. -/
theorem hasDerivAt_det_one_add_smul (B : Matrix n n 𝕜) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t : 𝕜 => det (1 + t • B)) (trace B) 0 := by
  have h := (det (1 + (X : 𝕜[X]) • B.map C)).hasDerivAt 0
  rw [derivative_det_one_add_X_smul] at h
  convert h using 1
  funext t
  simp [eval_det, ← smul_eq_mul_diagonal]

variable [CompleteSpace 𝕜]

/-- The determinant is differentiable: it is a sum of products of matrix entries. -/
theorem differentiable_det : Differentiable 𝕜 (det : Matrix n n 𝕜 → 𝕜) := by
  have hentry (i j : n) : Differentiable 𝕜 (fun M : Matrix n n 𝕜 => M i j) :=
    (LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (entryLinearMap 𝕜 𝕜 i j)).differentiable
  simp_rw [_root_.funext det_apply, Units.smul_def, zsmul_eq_mul]
  refine Differentiable.fun_sum fun σ _ => Differentiable.const_mul (fun M => ?_) _
  exact (HasFDerivAt.finsetProd fun i _ => (hentry (σ i) i M).hasFDerivAt).differentiableAt

/-- **The derivative of the determinant at the identity is the trace** (Jacobi's formula at the
identity). -/
theorem hasFDerivAt_det_one :
    HasFDerivAt (det : Matrix n n 𝕜 → 𝕜)
      (LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (traceLinearMap n 𝕜 𝕜)) 1 := by
  have hD := (differentiable_det (𝕜 := 𝕜) (n := n) 1).hasFDerivAt
  suffices h : fderiv 𝕜 det (1 : Matrix n n 𝕜) =
      LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (traceLinearMap n 𝕜 𝕜) by rwa [h] at hD
  refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun B => ?_
  have h := hD.comp_hasDerivAt_of_eq (0 : 𝕜)
    (((hasDerivAt_id (0 : 𝕜)).smul_const B).const_add 1) (by simp)
  simp only [id, one_smul] at h
  -- `h` is stated for the operator-norm addition on matrices; restating it with the default
  -- matrix addition, to which it is definitionally equal, lets it meet the line derivative.
  have h' : HasDerivAt (fun t : 𝕜 => det (1 + t • B)) (fderiv 𝕜 det 1 B) 0 := h
  simpa using h'.unique (hasDerivAt_det_one_add_smul B)

end Matrix

``````
````````

``````lean
import Calderon.ActualPerturbedDefect

noncomputable section
open Filter
open scoped ContDiff Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.ActualDefectNorm
open PrincipalCommutator ScalarBaseAdjoint ReferenceDensityBounds PerturbedDensityAdjoint
open ConformalDepth ActualScalarPrincipalAdjoint ActualPerturbedDefect

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]

lemma norm_coordinate_directionalFDeriv_le (w : R3 → E) (x : R3) (i : Fin 3) :
    ‖directionalFDeriv (coordinateDirection i) w x‖ ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ w x‖ := by
  simpa only [directionalFDeriv, norm_coordinateDirection, mul_one]
    using (fderiv ℝ w x).le_opNorm (coordinateDirection i)

lemma norm_scalar_first_order_remainder_le (w : R3 → E) (x : R3)
    (c : ℝ) (b : Fin 3 → ℝ) (beta eps Cfirst Czero : ℝ)
    (hb : 0 < beta) (he : 0 ≤ eps) (hCf : 0 ≤ Cfirst) (hCz : 0 ≤ Czero)
    (hc : |c| ≤ Czero * eps) (hbi : ∀ i, |b i| ≤ Cfirst * eps / beta) :
    ‖c • w x + ∑ i, b i • directionalFDeriv (coordinateDirection i) w x‖ ≤
      (Czero + 3*Cfirst) * eps * (‖w x‖ + ‖fderiv ℝ w x‖ / beta) := by
  have hF : 0 ≤ Cfirst * eps / beta := div_nonneg (mul_nonneg hCf he) hb.le
  have hsum : ‖∑ i : Fin 3, b i • directionalFDeriv (coordinateDirection i) w x‖ ≤
      3 * (Cfirst * eps / beta * ‖fderiv ℝ w x‖) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ‖b i • directionalFDeriv (coordinateDirection i) w x‖ := norm_sum_le _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ _i : Fin 3, Cfirst * eps / beta * ‖fderiv ℝ w x‖ := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i hi
        rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        exact mul_le_mul (hbi i) (norm_coordinate_directionalFDeriv_le w x i)
          (norm_nonneg _) hF
      _ = _ := by simp
  have hc' : ‖c • w x‖ ≤ Czero * eps * ‖w x‖ := by
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc (norm_nonneg _)
  have hU : 0 ≤ ‖w x‖ := norm_nonneg _
  have hV : 0 ≤ ‖fderiv ℝ w x‖ / beta := div_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) hb.le
  calc
    _ ≤ Czero * eps * ‖w x‖ + 3 * (Cfirst * eps / beta * ‖fderiv ℝ w x‖) :=
      (norm_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add hc' hsum)
    _ = Czero * eps * ‖w x‖ + (3*Cfirst*eps) * (‖fderiv ℝ w x‖/beta) := by ring
    _ ≤ _ := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hCz he) hV,
        mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (by positivity : 0 ≤ 3*Cfirst) he) hU]

theorem exists_actual_scalar_adjoint_defect_uniform_norm_bound
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
      ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 →
      ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → ∀ p : ℕ, 1 ≤ p → ∀ x ∈ K,
      ∀ eps : ℝ, 0 ≤ eps → eps ≤ 1 → ∀ h : MatrixField,
      (∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => h y i j)) →
      (∀ i j k l, TwoJetBound (coordinateDirection k) (coordinateDirection l)
        (fun y => h y i j) x (eps * referenceRadius δ R p L x)) →
      (∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, (h y).IsHermitian) →
      let beta := metricDifferentialNorm (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L)
        (fun y => Real.log (referenceRadius δ R p L y)) x
      1 ≤ beta → referenceRadius δ R p L x * beta^2 ≤ eps →
      ∀ w : R3 → E, ContDiff ℝ ∞ w →
      ‖scalarSecondBaseAdjoint coordinateDirection (fun y => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,y))
        (actualPrincipalMatrix g L lam δ R p h) w x -
        scalarSecondBase coordinateDirection (actualPrincipalMatrix g L lam δ R p h) w x‖ ≤
          C * eps * (‖w x‖ + ‖fderiv ℝ w x‖ / beta) := by
  obtain ⟨Cfirst,Czero,hCf,hCz,hcoeff⟩ :=
    exists_actual_adjoint_coefficients_uniform_bounds g hg L hL K hK
  refine ⟨Czero+3*Cfirst, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp x hx eps he he1 h hh hhjet hs beta hb hsmall w hw
  obtain ⟨hfirst,hzero⟩ := hcoeff lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp x hx eps he he1 h hh hhjet hb hsmall
  rw [actual_scalar_adjoint_defect g hg L lam δ R p h w hδ hR hh hw x hs]
  exact norm_scalar_first_order_remainder_le w x _ _ beta eps Cfirst Czero
    (by linarith) he hCf.le hCz.le hzero hfirst

lemma sq_le_twice_sum_sq_of_le (s C eps u v : ℝ)
    (hs : 0 ≤ s) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (he : 0 ≤ eps)
    (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hv : 0 ≤ v) (h : s ≤ C*eps*(u+v)) :
    s^2 ≤ 2*C^2*eps^2*(u^2+v^2) := by
  have hsquare : s^2 ≤ (C*eps*(u+v))^2 :=
    (sq_le_sq₀ hs (by positivity)).2 h
  have huv : (u+v)^2 ≤ 2*(u^2+v^2) := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (u-v)]
  have ht := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left huv (sq_nonneg (C*eps))
  nlinarith

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.ActualDefectNorm
``````

``````lean
    (contDiff_referenceConnectionFamily g hg L).continuous.continuousOn
  obtain ⟨D,hD⟩ := (isCompact_Icc.prod hK).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
    (contDiff_referenceConnection_spatial_fderiv g hg L).continuous.continuousOn

      ‖referenceJacobiCurvature g L lam x v‖ ≤ C * ‖v‖^2 := by
  obtain ⟨C,D,hC,hD,hbounds⟩ := exists_referenceConnection_uniform_bounds g hg L K hK
  refine ⟨2*(D+C^2),by positivity,?_⟩
  intro lam hlam x hx v
  exact norm_curvatureOperator_le_of_bounds _ x v C D ‖v‖ hC.le hD.le (norm_nonneg _)
    (hbounds lam hlam x hx).1 (hbounds lam hlam x hx).2 le_rfl

theorem exists_referenceJacobiCurvature_uniform_metric_unit_bound (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ v : R3,
      ⟪metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x v,v⟫_ℝ ≤ 1 →
      ‖referenceJacobiCurvature g L lam x v‖ ≤ C := by
  obtain ⟨B,hB,hbounds⟩ := exists_referenceJacobiCurvature_uniform_norm_bound g hg L K hK
  obtain ⟨c,hc,hmetric⟩ := exists_referenceMetric_uniform_quadratic_lower_bound_on_compact g hg L hL K hK
  let D := Real.sqrt (1/c)
  refine ⟨B*D^2+1,by positivity,?_⟩
  intro lam hlam x hx v hv
  have hnorm : ‖v‖ ≤ D := norm_le_sqrt_inv_of_quadratic_unit _ c hc (hmetric lam x hx) v hv
  have hs : ‖v‖^2 ≤ D^2 := (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)).2 hnorm
  exact (hbounds lam hlam x hx v).trans ((mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs hB.le).trans (by linarith))

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.ConformalDepth

``````

## Calderon.CurvatureRotation

SHA256 `5f1887d400e693e881f44596439033719d6f29998a04a9885f3949faf8ab42bb`.

``````lean
import Calderon.ReferenceCurvature
import Calderon.SphereRotationCore
import Calderon.ProfileCovariantApplications

set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 10
noncomputable section
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.CurvatureRotation
open RadiusProfile ConformalDepth MetricOperator SphereHarmonic AngularPolynomial MvPolynomial

def coordinateCurvatureAction (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (x v w : R3) : R3 →L[ℝ] R3 :=
  (fderiv ℝ Γ x v) w - (fderiv ℝ Γ x w) v +
    (Γ x v).comp (Γ x w) - (Γ x w).comp (Γ x v)

lemma coordinateCurvatureAction_apply (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (x v w Z : R3) : coordinateCurvatureAction Γ x v w Z =
      (fderiv ℝ Γ x v) w Z - (fderiv ℝ Γ x w) v Z +
      Γ x v (Γ x w Z) - Γ x w (Γ x v Z) := by
  simp [coordinateCurvatureAction]

lemma coordinateCurvatureAction_jacobi (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (x v X : R3) : coordinateCurvatureAction Γ x X v v =
      CoordinateCurvature.curvatureOperator Γ x v X := by
  simp [coordinateCurvatureAction_apply, CoordinateCurvature.curvatureOperator_apply]

lemma norm_coordinateCurvatureAction_le (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (x v w : R3) : ‖coordinateCurvatureAction Γ x v w‖ ≤
      2 * (‖fderiv ℝ Γ x‖ + ‖Γ x‖^2) * ‖v‖ * ‖w‖ := by
  have hd1 := ((fderiv ℝ Γ x v).le_opNorm w).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ((fderiv ℝ Γ x).le_opNorm v) (norm_nonneg w))
  have hd2 := ((fderiv ℝ Γ x w).le_opNorm v).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ((fderiv ℝ Γ x).le_opNorm w) (norm_nonneg v))
  have hg1 := ((Γ x v).opNorm_comp_le (Γ x w)).trans
    (mul_le_mul ((Γ x).le_opNorm v) ((Γ x).le_opNorm w) (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity))
  have hg2 := ((Γ x w).opNorm_comp_le (Γ x v)).trans
    (mul_le_mul ((Γ x).le_opNorm w) ((Γ x).le_opNorm v) (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity))
  have ht1 := norm_sub_le ((fderiv ℝ Γ x v) w) ((fderiv ℝ Γ x w) v)
  have ht2 := norm_add_le ((fderiv ℝ Γ x v) w - (fderiv ℝ Γ x w) v)
    ((Γ x v).comp (Γ x w))
  have ht3 := norm_sub_le
    ((fderiv ℝ Γ x v) w - (fderiv ℝ Γ x w) v + (Γ x v).comp (Γ x w))
    ((Γ x w).comp (Γ x v))
  unfold coordinateCurvatureAction
  nlinarith

def referenceCurvatureAction (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ) (x v w : R3) : R3 →L[ℝ] R3 :=
  coordinateCurvatureAction (fun y => referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,y)) x v w

theorem exists_referenceCurvatureAction_uniform_norm_bound (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L : ℝ) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ v w : R3,
      ‖referenceCurvatureAction g L lam x v w‖ ≤ C * ‖v‖ * ‖w‖ := by
  obtain ⟨C,D,hC,hD,hbounds⟩ := exists_referenceConnection_uniform_bounds g hg L K hK
  refine ⟨2*(D+C^2),by positivity,?_⟩
  intro lam hlam x hx v w
  obtain ⟨hG,hDG⟩ := hbounds lam hlam x hx
  have hsq : ‖referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,x)‖^2 ≤ C^2 :=
    (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) hC.le).2 hG
  exact (norm_coordinateCurvatureAction_le _ x v w).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (norm_nonneg v)) (norm_nonneg w))

def referenceCurvatureRotationCoefficient (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (x : R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3) (a b i j : Fin 3) : ℝ :=
  ⟪metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x
    (referenceCurvatureAction g L lam x (e a) (e b) (e j)), e i⟫_ℝ

theorem exists_referenceCurvatureRotationCoefficient_uniform_bound (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ x ∈ K,
      ∀ e : Fin 3 → R3,
      IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x) e →
      ∀ a b i j, |referenceCurvatureRotationCoefficient g L lam x e a b i j| ≤ C := by
  obtain ⟨R,hR,hcurv⟩ := exists_referenceCurvatureAction_uniform_norm_bound g hg L K hK
  obtain ⟨M,hM⟩ := (isCompact_Icc.prod hK).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
    (contDiff_referenceMetricOperator_joint g hg L).continuous.continuousOn
  obtain ⟨c,hc,hmetric⟩ := exists_referenceMetric_uniform_quadratic_lower_bound_on_compact g hg L hL K hK
  let D := Real.sqrt (1/c)
  let M' := max M 0+1
  have hD : 0 ≤ D := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hM' : 0 < M' := by dsimp [M']; positivity
  refine ⟨M'*R*D^4+1,by positivity,?_⟩
  intro lam hlam x hx e he a b i j
  have hn : ∀ i, ‖e i‖ ≤ D := fun i =>
    norm_le_sqrt_inv_of_quadratic_unit _ c hc (hmetric lam x hx) (e i)
      (IsMetricOrthonormalFrame_unit _ _ he i).le
  let T := referenceCurvatureAction g L lam x (e a) (e b)
  have hT : ‖T‖ ≤ R*D*D := (hcurv lam hlam x hx (e a) (e b)).trans
    (mul_le_mul (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hn a) hR.le) (hn b) (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity))
  have hMnorm : ‖metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x‖ ≤ M' :=
    (hM (lam,x) ⟨hlam,hx⟩).trans (by dsimp [M']; linarith [le_max_left M 0])
  have htj : ‖T (e j)‖ ≤ R*D*D*D := (T.le_opNorm (e j)).trans
    (mul_le_mul hT (hn j) (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity))
  have hMtj : ‖metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x (T (e j))‖ ≤
      M'*(R*D*D*D) :=
    ((metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x).le_opNorm _).trans
      (mul_le_mul hMnorm htj (norm_nonneg _) hM'.le)
  have hi := (abs_real_inner_le_norm _ (e i)).trans
    (mul_le_mul hMtj (hn i) (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity))
  change |⟪metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x (T (e j)),e i⟫_ℝ| ≤ _
  nlinarith [hi]

def referenceCurvatureRotationPolynomial (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ) (x : R3)
    (e : Fin 3 → R3) (a b : Fin 3) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  polynomialRotationCombination (referenceCurvatureRotationCoefficient g L lam x e a b) p

theorem referenceCurvatureRotationPolynomial_harmonicHomogeneous
    (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ) (x : R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3) (a b : Fin 3)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hp : p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) :
    referenceCurvatureRotationPolynomial g L lam x e a b p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k :=
  polynomialRotationCombination_harmonicHomogeneous k hk _ p hp

theorem exists_referenceCurvatureRotationPolynomial_uniform_sphere_norm_bound
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ hF : SphereFischerInner,
      ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ e : Fin 3 → R3,
      IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x) e →
      ∀ a b : Fin 3, ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → ∀ p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ,
      p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k →
      ‖polynomialSphereL2 (referenceCurvatureRotationPolynomial g L lam x e a b p)‖ ≤
        C * (k : ℝ) * ‖polynomialSphereL2 p‖ := by
  obtain ⟨A,hA,hcoef⟩ := exists_referenceCurvatureRotationCoefficient_uniform_bound g hg L hL K hK
  refine ⟨18*A,by positivity,?_⟩
  intro hF lam hlam x hx e he a b k hk p hp
  have hsum : (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      |referenceCurvatureRotationCoefficient g L lam x e a b i j|) ≤ 9*A := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ _i : Fin 3, ∑ _j : Fin 3, A := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro i hi
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro j hj
        exact hcoef lam hlam x hx e he a b i j
      _ = _ := by simp; ring
  have ht := polynomialRotationCombination_sphere_norm_le hF k hk
    (referenceCurvatureRotationCoefficient g L lam x e a b) p hp
  change ‖polynomialSphereL2 (referenceCurvatureRotationPolynomial g L lam x e a b p)‖ ≤ _ at ht
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsum (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2*(k : ℝ))) (norm_nonneg (polynomialSphereL2 p))
  exact ht.trans (by convert hm using 1 <;> ring)

theorem exists_referenceCurvatureRotationPolynomial_uniform_degree_sphere_norm_bound
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ hF : SphereFischerInner,
      ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ e : Fin 3 → R3,
      IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x) e →
      ∀ a b : Fin 3, ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → ∀ p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ,
      p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k →
      ‖polynomialSphereL2 ((k : ℝ) • referenceCurvatureRotationPolynomial g L lam x e a b p)‖ ≤
        C * (k : ℝ)^2 * ‖polynomialSphereL2 p‖ := by
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hbound⟩ := exists_referenceCurvatureRotationPolynomial_uniform_sphere_norm_bound g hg L hL K hK
  refine ⟨C,hC,?_⟩
  intro hF lam hlam x hx e he a b k hk p hp
  simp only [map_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg k : (0 : ℝ) ≤ k)]
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hbound hF lam hlam x hx e he a b k hk p hp)
    (Nat.cast_nonneg k : (0 : ℝ) ≤ k)
  convert h using 1 <;> ring

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.CurvatureRotation
``````

## Calderon.MetricOrthonormalFrame

SHA256 `a030e0579c8634f87c5a01968265f2646d8a7f57b4ae76808b599f170224e566`.

``````lean
import Calderon.ProfileCovariantApplications
import Mathlib.Analysis.Matrix.Order

noncomputable section
open scoped MatrixOrder Matrix.Norms.L2Operator InnerProductSpace
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.MetricFrame
open RadiusProfile MetricOperator ConformalDepth EnergyBridge

lemma sqrt_posDef_det_pos (M : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) (hM : M.PosDef) :
    0 < (CFC.sqrt M).det := by
  rw [hM.posSemidef.det_sqrt]
  simpa using Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hM.det_pos

theorem exists_metricOrthonormalFrame_of_posDef (M : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hM : M.PosDef) :
    ∃ e : Fin 3 → R3, IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (matrixOperatorMap M) e := by
  let S := CFC.sqrt M
  have hS : S.PosSemidef := Matrix.nonneg_iff_posSemidef.mp (CFC.sqrt_nonneg M)
  have hsq : S*S=M := by simpa only [S,pow_two] using CFC.sq_sqrt M hM.posSemidef.nonneg
  have hdet : IsUnit S.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (sqrt_posDef_det_pos M hM).ne'
  let T : R3 →L[ℝ] R3 := matrixOperatorMap S
  let A : R3 →L[ℝ] R3 := matrixOperatorMap S⁻¹
  have hTA : T.comp A = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ R3 := by
    change matrixOperatorAlgEquiv S * matrixOperatorAlgEquiv S⁻¹ = 1
    rw [← map_mul, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv S hdet, map_one]
  have hTT : matrixOperatorMap M = T.comp T := by
    change matrixOperatorAlgEquiv M = matrixOperatorAlgEquiv S * matrixOperatorAlgEquiv S
    rw [← map_mul, hsq]
  have hsym : ∀ X Y : R3, ⟪T X,Y⟫_ℝ = ⟪X,T Y⟫_ℝ := by
    intro X Y
    have hs := Matrix.isSymmetric_toEuclideanLin_iff.mpr hS.isHermitian
    exact hs X Y
  let b := EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ
  refine ⟨fun i => A (b i),?_⟩
  intro i j
  have hTi : T (A (b i)) = b i := by
    have h := congrArg (fun f : R3 →L[ℝ] R3 => f (b i)) hTA
    simpa using h
  have hTj : T (A (b j)) = b j := by
    have h := congrArg (fun f : R3 →L[ℝ] R3 => f (b j)) hTA
    simpa using h
  rw [hTT, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hsym, hTi, hTj]
  exact b.inner_eq_ite i j

theorem exists_referenceMetricOrthonormalFrame (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (x : R3) :
    ∃ e : Fin 3 → R3,
      IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x) e := by
  exact exists_metricOrthonormalFrame_of_posDef _
    (conformalMatrix_posDef _ _ (dilatedMetric_posDef g hg lam) x)

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.MetricFrame

``````

## Calderon.CurvatureSkew

SHA256 `3ec1d09cddda3d9dbaf13a09d1c19944c88ae575c6f64780b52ce2de9f97afce`.

``````lean
import Calderon.CurvatureRotation
import Calderon.PrincipalDirectional
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Calculus

set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 10
noncomputable section
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.CurvatureSkew
open PrincipalCommutator ConnectionError MetricOperator ConformalDepth RadiusProfile
  AngularPolynomial SphereHarmonic CurvatureRotation MvPolynomial

lemma directionalFDeriv_const (v Z x : R3) :
    directionalFDeriv v (fun _ : R3 => Z) x = 0 := by
  simp [directionalFDeriv]

lemma directionalFDeriv_inner (v : R3) (U V : R3 → R3)
    (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U) (hV : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V) (x : R3) :
    directionalFDeriv v (fun y => ⟪U y,V y⟫_ℝ) x =
      ⟪directionalFDeriv v U x,V x⟫_ℝ + ⟪U x,directionalFDeriv v V x⟫_ℝ := by
  unfold directionalFDeriv
  rw [fderiv_inner_apply ℝ (hU.differentiable (by simp) x)
    (hV.differentiable (by simp) x)]
  exact add_comm _ _

lemma directionalFDeriv_metric_pairing (v : R3) (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (U V : R3 → R3) (hM : ContDiff ℝ ∞ M)
    (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U) (hV : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V) (x : R3) :
    directionalFDeriv v (fun y => ⟪M y (U y),V y⟫_ℝ) x =
      ⟪directionalFDeriv v M x (U x) + M x (directionalFDeriv v U x),V x⟫_ℝ +
        ⟪M x (U x),directionalFDeriv v V x⟫_ℝ := by
  rw [directionalFDeriv_inner v _ V (hM.clm_apply hU) hV,
    directionalFDeriv_clm_apply v M U hM hU]

lemma directionalFDeriv_connection_apply (v w Z x : R3)
    (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (hΓ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Γ) :
    directionalFDeriv v (fun y => Γ y w Z) x = (fderiv ℝ Γ x v) w Z := by
  rw [directionalFDeriv_clm_apply v _ _ (hΓ.clm_apply contDiff_const) contDiff_const,
    directionalFDeriv_clm_apply v Γ _ hΓ contDiff_const]
  simp [directionalFDeriv_const, directionalFDeriv]

lemma directionalFDeriv_fixed_metric_pairing (v Z W x : R3)
    (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (hM : ContDiff ℝ ∞ M) :
    directionalFDeriv v (fun y => ⟪M y Z,W⟫_ℝ) x =
      ⟪fderiv ℝ M x v Z,W⟫_ℝ := by
  rw [directionalFDeriv_metric_pairing v M _ _ hM contDiff_const contDiff_const]
  simp [directionalFDeriv_const, directionalFDeriv]

lemma differentiated_metric_compatibility
    (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (hM : ContDiff ℝ ∞ M) (hΓ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Γ)
    (hcomp : ∀ x v Z W, ⟪M x (Γ x v Z),W⟫_ℝ + ⟪M x Z,Γ x v W⟫_ℝ =
      ⟪fderiv ℝ M x v Z,W⟫_ℝ) (x v w Z W : R3) :
    directionalFDeriv v (directionalFDeriv w (fun y => ⟪M y Z,W⟫_ℝ)) x =
      ⟪M x (Γ x v (Γ x w Z)),W⟫_ℝ + ⟪M x (Γ x w Z),Γ x v W⟫_ℝ +
      ⟪M x ((fderiv ℝ Γ x v) w Z),W⟫_ℝ +
      ⟪M x (Γ x v Z),Γ x w W⟫_ℝ + ⟪M x Z,Γ x v (Γ x w W)⟫_ℝ +
      ⟪M x Z,(fderiv ℝ Γ x v) w W⟫_ℝ := by
  have he : directionalFDeriv w (fun y => ⟪M y Z,W⟫_ℝ) =
      fun y => ⟪M y (Γ y w Z),W⟫_ℝ + ⟪M y Z,Γ y w W⟫_ℝ := by
    funext y
    rw [directionalFDeriv_fixed_metric_pairing w Z W y M hM]
    exact (hcomp y w Z W).symm
  have hGZ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => Γ y w Z) :=
    (hΓ.clm_apply contDiff_const).clm_apply contDiff_const
  have hGW : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => Γ y w W) :=
    (hΓ.clm_apply contDiff_const).clm_apply contDiff_const
  rw [he, directionalFDeriv_add v _ _
    ((hM.clm_apply hGZ).inner ℝ contDiff_const)
    ((hM.clm_apply contDiff_const).inner ℝ hGW)]
  rw [directionalFDeriv_metric_pairing v M _ _ hM hGZ contDiff_const,
    directionalFDeriv_metric_pairing v M _ _ hM contDiff_const hGW,
    directionalFDeriv_connection_apply v w Z x Γ hΓ,
    directionalFDeriv_connection_apply v w W x Γ hΓ]
  simp only [directionalFDeriv_const, map_zero, add_zero, inner_zero_right,
    inner_add_left, zero_add]
  change ⟪(fderiv ℝ M x v) (Γ x w Z),W⟫_ℝ +
      ⟪M x ((fderiv ℝ Γ x v) w Z),W⟫_ℝ +
      (⟪(fderiv ℝ M x v) Z,Γ x w W⟫_ℝ +
        ⟪M x Z,(fderiv ℝ Γ x v) w W⟫_ℝ) = _
  rw [← hcomp x v (Γ x w Z) W, ← hcomp x v Z (Γ x w W)]
  ring

theorem coordinateCurvatureAction_metric_skew
    (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (hM : ContDiff ℝ ∞ M) (hΓ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Γ)
    (hcomp : ∀ x v Z W, ⟪M x (Γ x v Z),W⟫_ℝ + ⟪M x Z,Γ x v W⟫_ℝ =
      ⟪fderiv ℝ M x v Z,W⟫_ℝ) (x v w Z W : R3) :
    ⟪M x (coordinateCurvatureAction Γ x v w Z),W⟫_ℝ +
      ⟪M x Z,coordinateCurvatureAction Γ x v w W⟫_ℝ = 0 := by
  have hp : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => ⟪M y Z,W⟫_ℝ) :=
    (hM.clm_apply contDiff_const).inner ℝ contDiff_const
  have hc := directionalFDeriv_commute v w _ hp x
  rw [differentiated_metric_compatibility M Γ hM hΓ hcomp,
    differentiated_metric_compatibility M Γ hM hΓ hcomp] at hc
  simp only [coordinateCurvatureAction_apply, map_sub, map_add, inner_sub_left,
    inner_add_left, inner_sub_right, inner_add_right]
  linarith

theorem coordinateConnectionField_metric_compatible
    (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (hM : ContDiff ℝ ∞ M)
    (hunit : ∀ x, IsUnit (M x))
    (hsym : ∀ x Y Z, ⟪M x Y,Z⟫_ℝ = ⟪M x Z,Y⟫_ℝ) (x X Y Z : R3) :
    ⟪M x (coordinateConnectionField (inverseMetricField M) M x X Y),Z⟫_ℝ +
      ⟪M x Y,coordinateConnectionField (inverseMetricField M) M x X Z⟫_ℝ =
      ⟪fderiv ℝ M x X Y,Z⟫_ℝ := by
  have hk (U V W : R3) := coordinateConnection_koszul (inverseMetricField M x) (M x)
    (fderiv ℝ M x) (fun T => metric_apply_inverseMetricField M hunit x T) U V W
  have h1 := hk X Y Z
  have h2 := hk X Z Y
  have hs := hsym x Y (coordinateConnection (inverseMetricField M x) (fderiv ℝ M x) X Z)
  have hd := inverse_metric_derivative_symmetric M (fderiv ℝ M x) x
    (hM.differentiable (by simp) x).hasFDerivAt
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hsym) X Y Z
  simp only [coordinateConnectionField_apply]
  nlinarith

lemma referenceMetricOperator_symmetric (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (x Y Z : R3) :
    ⟪metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x Y,Z⟫_ℝ =
      ⟪metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x Z,Y⟫_ℝ := by
  have hp := EnergyBridge.conformalMatrix_posDef (dilatedMetric g lam)
    (fun y => -L * referenceCoordinateDepth y) (dilatedMetric_posDef g hg lam) x
  have h := Matrix.isSymmetric_toEuclideanLin_iff.mpr hp.isHermitian
  exact (h Y Z).trans (real_inner_comm _ _)

theorem referenceConnectionFamily_metric_compatible (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (x X Y Z : R3) :
    ⟪metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x
      (referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,x) X Y),Z⟫_ℝ +
    ⟪metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x Y,
      referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,x) X Z⟫_ℝ =
    ⟪fderiv ℝ (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L)) x X Y,Z⟫_ℝ := by
  let M := metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L)
  have hpair : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : R3 => (lam,y)) :=
    contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id
  have hM := (contDiff_referenceMetricOperator_joint g hg L).comp hpair
  have hu : ∀ y, IsUnit (M y) := by
    intro y
    have hp := EnergyBridge.conformalMatrix_posDef (dilatedMetric g lam)
      (fun z => -L * referenceCoordinateDepth z) (dilatedMetric_posDef g hg lam) y
    exact hp.isUnit.map matrixOperatorAlgEquiv.toMonoidHom
  exact coordinateConnectionField_metric_compatible M hM hu
    (fun y V W => referenceMetricOperator_symmetric g hg L lam y V W) x X Y Z

theorem referenceCurvatureAction_metric_skew (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (x v w Z W : R3) :
    ⟪metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x
      (referenceCurvatureAction g L lam x v w Z),W⟫_ℝ +
    ⟪metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x Z,
      referenceCurvatureAction g L lam x v w W⟫_ℝ = 0 := by
  let M := metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L)
  let Γ := fun y => referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,y)
  have hpair : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : R3 => (lam,y)) :=
    contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id
  have hM := (contDiff_referenceMetricOperator_joint g hg L).comp hpair
  have hΓ := (contDiff_referenceConnectionFamily g hg L).comp hpair
  exact coordinateCurvatureAction_metric_skew M Γ hM hΓ
    (fun y U V W => referenceConnectionFamily_metric_compatible g hg L lam y U V W)
    x v w Z W

theorem referenceCurvatureRotationCoefficient_skew (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (x : R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3)
    (a b i j : Fin 3) :
    referenceCurvatureRotationCoefficient g L lam x e a b i j =
      -referenceCurvatureRotationCoefficient g L lam x e a b j i := by
  have h := referenceCurvatureAction_metric_skew g hg L lam x (e a) (e b) (e j) (e i)
  rw [referenceMetricOperator_symmetric g hg L lam x (e j)] at h
  unfold referenceCurvatureRotationCoefficient
  linarith

def polynomialMatrixVectorField (c : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, C (c i j) * X j * pderiv i p

lemma polynomialRotationCombination_eq_neg_two_smul
    (c : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (hc : ∀ i j, c i j = -c j i)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    polynomialRotationCombination c p = (-2 : ℝ) • polynomialMatrixVectorField c p := by
  have hd (i : Fin 3) : c i i = 0 := by have h := hc i i; linarith
  simp only [polynomialRotationCombination, polynomialRotation, polynomialMatrixVectorField,
    Fin.sum_univ_three, smul_eq_C_mul]
  rw [hd 0, hd 1, hd 2, hc 1 0, hc 2 0, hc 2 1]
  simp only [map_neg, map_zero, map_ofNat]
  ring

lemma polynomialMatrixVectorField_eq_neg_half_smul
    (c : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (hc : ∀ i j, c i j = -c j i)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    polynomialMatrixVectorField c p =
      (- (1 / 2) : ℝ) • polynomialRotationCombination c p := by
  rw [polynomialRotationCombination_eq_neg_two_smul c hc p, smul_smul]
  norm_num

def referenceCurvatureVectorFieldPolynomial (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ) (x : R3)
    (e : Fin 3 → R3) (a b : Fin 3) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  polynomialMatrixVectorField (referenceCurvatureRotationCoefficient g L lam x e a b) p

theorem referenceCurvatureVectorFieldPolynomial_eq_neg_half_smul (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (x : R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3)
    (a b : Fin 3) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    referenceCurvatureVectorFieldPolynomial g L lam x e a b p =
      (- (1 / 2) : ℝ) • referenceCurvatureRotationPolynomial g L lam x e a b p := by
  exact polynomialMatrixVectorField_eq_neg_half_smul _
    (fun i j => referenceCurvatureRotationCoefficient_skew g hg L lam x e a b i j) p

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.CurvatureSkew
``````

## Calderon.HorizontalCurvature

SHA256 `e70be097bb24484d83a5f2d51ac65339820bfda0277fdb67bcaf9af3d9794430`.

``````lean
import Calderon.CurvatureSkew

set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 10
noncomputable section
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.HorizontalCurvature
open CurvatureRotation CurvatureSkew ConformalDepth MetricOperator

variable {V E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V]
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]

def vectorFieldDeriv (X : V → V) (u : V → E) : V → E :=
  fun z => fderiv ℝ u z (X z)

theorem vectorFieldDeriv_commutator (X Y : V → V) (u : V → E)
    (hX : Differentiable ℝ X) (hY : Differentiable ℝ Y) (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (z : V) :
    vectorFieldDeriv X (vectorFieldDeriv Y u) z -
      vectorFieldDeriv Y (vectorFieldDeriv X u) z =
      fderiv ℝ u z (fderiv ℝ Y z (X z) - fderiv ℝ X z (Y z)) := by
  have hD := (hu.fderiv_right (m := ∞) (by simp)).differentiable (by simp)
  unfold vectorFieldDeriv
  rw [fderiv_clm_apply (hD z) (hY z), fderiv_clm_apply (hD z) (hX z)]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply]
  rw [(hu.contDiffAt.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by simp)).eq (X z) (Y z), map_sub]
  abel

def horizontalVectorField (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (X : R3) : R3 × R3 → R3 × R3 := fun z => (X,-Γ z.1 X z.2)

lemma contDiff_horizontalVectorField (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (hΓ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Γ) (X : R3) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (horizontalVectorField Γ X) :=
  contDiff_const.prodMk (((hΓ.comp contDiff_fst).clm_apply contDiff_const).clm_apply contDiff_snd).neg

lemma fderiv_horizontalVectorField_apply (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (hΓ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Γ) (X : R3) (z a : R3 × R3) :
    fderiv ℝ (horizontalVectorField Γ X) z a =
      (0, -((fderiv ℝ Γ z.1 a.1) X z.2) - Γ z.1 X a.2) := by
  have hG := (((hΓ.differentiable (by simp) z.1).hasFDerivAt.comp z
    (hasFDerivAt_fst (p := z))).clm_apply (hasFDerivAt_const X z)).clm_apply (hasFDerivAt_snd (p := z))
  have h := (hasFDerivAt_const X z).prodMk hG.neg
  change HasFDerivAt (horizontalVectorField Γ X) _ z at h
  rw [h.fderiv]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.prod_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply, map_zero, zero_add, add_zero, neg_add_rev]
  change (0, -((fderiv ℝ Γ z.1 a.1) X z.2) + -(Γ z.1 X a.2)) = _
  congr 1

theorem horizontalVectorField_bracket (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (hΓ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Γ) (X Y : R3) (z : R3 × R3) :
    fderiv ℝ (horizontalVectorField Γ Y) z (horizontalVectorField Γ X z) -
      fderiv ℝ (horizontalVectorField Γ X) z (horizontalVectorField Γ Y z) =
      (0,-coordinateCurvatureAction Γ z.1 X Y z.2) := by
  rw [fderiv_horizontalVectorField_apply Γ hΓ,
    fderiv_horizontalVectorField_apply Γ hΓ]
  simp only [horizontalVectorField, Prod.mk_sub_mk, sub_self,
    coordinateCurvatureAction_apply, map_neg]
  congr 1
  abel

theorem horizontalVectorField_commutator (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (hΓ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Γ) (X Y : R3) (u : R3 × R3 → E)
    (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (z : R3 × R3) :
    vectorFieldDeriv (horizontalVectorField Γ X)
      (vectorFieldDeriv (horizontalVectorField Γ Y) u) z -
    vectorFieldDeriv (horizontalVectorField Γ Y)
      (vectorFieldDeriv (horizontalVectorField Γ X) u) z =
      fderiv ℝ u z (0,-coordinateCurvatureAction Γ z.1 X Y z.2) := by
  rw [vectorFieldDeriv_commutator _ _ u
    ((contDiff_horizontalVectorField Γ hΓ X).differentiable (by simp))
    ((contDiff_horizontalVectorField Γ hΓ Y).differentiable (by simp)) hu,
    horizontalVectorField_bracket Γ hΓ]

def metricFiberEnergy (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3) : R3 × R3 → ℝ :=
  fun z => ⟪M z.1 z.2,z.2⟫_ℝ

lemma fderiv_metricFiberEnergy_apply (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (hM : ContDiff ℝ ∞ M) (z a : R3 × R3) :
    fderiv ℝ (metricFiberEnergy M) z a =
      ⟪fderiv ℝ M z.1 a.1 z.2 + M z.1 a.2,z.2⟫_ℝ + ⟪M z.1 z.2,a.2⟫_ℝ := by
  have hP := ((hM.differentiable (by simp) z.1).hasFDerivAt.comp z
    (hasFDerivAt_fst (p := z))).clm_apply (hasFDerivAt_snd (p := z))
  have h := hP.inner ℝ (hasFDerivAt_snd (p := z))
  change HasFDerivAt (metricFiberEnergy M) _ z at h
  rw [h.fderiv]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.prod_apply,
    fderivInnerCLM_apply, Function.comp_apply, inner_add_left]
  change ⟪M z.1 z.2,a.2⟫_ℝ + (⟪M z.1 a.2,z.2⟫_ℝ +
    ⟪fderiv ℝ M z.1 a.1 z.2,z.2⟫_ℝ) = _
  ring

theorem horizontalVectorField_metricFiberEnergy_zero
    (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (hM : ContDiff ℝ ∞ M)
    (hcomp : ∀ x X Y Z, ⟪M x (Γ x X Y),Z⟫_ℝ + ⟪M x Y,Γ x X Z⟫_ℝ =
      ⟪fderiv ℝ M x X Y,Z⟫_ℝ) (X : R3) (z : R3 × R3) :
    vectorFieldDeriv (horizontalVectorField Γ X) (metricFiberEnergy M) z = 0 := by
  unfold vectorFieldDeriv
  rw [fderiv_metricFiberEnergy_apply M hM]
  simp only [horizontalVectorField, map_neg, inner_add_left, inner_neg_left, inner_neg_right]
  have h := hcomp z.1 X z.2 z.2
  linarith

theorem reference_horizontalVectorField_commutator (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (X Y : R3) (u : R3 × R3 → E)
    (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (z : R3 × R3) :
    vectorFieldDeriv (horizontalVectorField (fun x => referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,x)) X)
      (vectorFieldDeriv (horizontalVectorField (fun x => referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,x)) Y) u) z -
    vectorFieldDeriv (horizontalVectorField (fun x => referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,x)) Y)
      (vectorFieldDeriv (horizontalVectorField (fun x => referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,x)) X) u) z =
      fderiv ℝ u z (0,-referenceCurvatureAction g L lam z.1 X Y z.2) := by
  have hpair : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : R3 => (lam,x)) := contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id
  exact horizontalVectorField_commutator _ ((contDiff_referenceConnectionFamily g hg L).comp hpair)
    X Y u hu z

theorem reference_horizontalVectorField_metricFiberEnergy_zero (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (X : R3) (z : R3 × R3) :
    vectorFieldDeriv (horizontalVectorField (fun x => referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,x)) X)
      (metricFiberEnergy (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L))) z = 0 := by
  have hpair : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : R3 => (lam,x)) := contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id
  exact horizontalVectorField_metricFiberEnergy_zero _ _
    ((contDiff_referenceMetricOperator_joint g hg L).comp hpair)
    (fun x U V W => referenceConnectionFamily_metric_compatible g hg L lam x U V W) X z

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.HorizontalCurvature

``````

## Calderon.FrameCurvaturePolynomial

SHA256 `cde83f95757f7a6e3596fcb2f96c14615eef827e3e78378939579f143e9d67d2`.

``````lean
import Calderon.HorizontalCurvature
import Calderon.GreenRadialTrace
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.FiniteDimensional.Lemmas

set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 10
noncomputable section
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.FrameCurvaturePolynomial
open RadiusProfile CurvatureSkew CurvatureRotation HorizontalCurvature ConformalDepth
  MetricOperator SphereHarmonic AngularPolynomial MvPolynomial

theorem metricFrame_linearIndependent (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3)
    (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame M e) : LinearIndependent ℝ e := by
  simp only [IsMetricOrthonormalFrame] at he
  rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
  intro c hc j
  have h := congrArg (fun v : R3 => ⟪M v,e j⟫_ℝ) hc
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul, sum_inner, real_inner_smul_left, map_zero,
    inner_zero_left, he] at h
  simpa using h

def metricFrameBasis (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3)
    (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame M e) : Module.Basis (Fin 3) ℝ R3 :=
  basisOfLinearIndependentOfCardEqFinrank (metricFrame_linearIndependent M e he)
    (by simp [R3])

lemma metricFrameBasis_apply (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3)
    (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame M e) (i : Fin 3) : metricFrameBasis M e he i = e i := by
  simp [metricFrameBasis]

lemma metricFrameBasis_repr (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3)
    (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame M e) (v : R3) (i : Fin 3) :
    (metricFrameBasis M e he).repr v i = ⟪M v,e i⟫_ℝ := by
  simp only [IsMetricOrthonormalFrame] at he
  have hb : (metricFrameBasis M e he : Fin 3 → R3) = e :=
    funext (fun j => metricFrameBasis_apply M e he j)
  have hv : ∑ j : Fin 3, (metricFrameBasis M e he).repr v j • e j = v := by
    simpa only [hb] using (metricFrameBasis M e he).sum_repr v
  have h := congrArg (fun w : R3 => ⟪M w,e i⟫_ℝ) hv
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul, sum_inner, real_inner_smul_left, he] at h
  simpa using h

theorem metricFrame_sum_coordinates (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3)
    (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame M e) (v : R3) :
    ∑ i : Fin 3, ⟪M v,e i⟫_ℝ • e i = v := by
  have h := (metricFrameBasis M e he).sum_repr v
  simpa only [metricFrameBasis_apply, metricFrameBasis_repr] using h

def metricFrameCoordinates (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3) :
    R3 →L[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℝ) :=
  ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun i => (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ R3 (e i)).comp M

lemma metricFrameCoordinates_apply (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3)
    (v : R3) (i : Fin 3) : metricFrameCoordinates M e v i = ⟪M v,e i⟫_ℝ := by
  change ⟪e i,M v⟫_ℝ = ⟪M v,e i⟫_ℝ
  exact real_inner_comm _ _

def metricFramePolynomial (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) : R3 → ℝ := fun v => eval (metricFrameCoordinates M e v) p

lemma contDiff_metricFramePolynomial (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (metricFramePolynomial M e p) := by
  unfold metricFramePolynomial
  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C c => simpa only [metricFramePolynomial, eval_C] using
      (contDiff_const : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun _ : R3 => c))
  | add p q hp hq => simpa only [metricFramePolynomial, map_add] using hp.add hq
  | mul_X p i hp =>
    have hi : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun v : R3 => metricFrameCoordinates M e v i) :=
      (ContinuousLinearMap.proj i).contDiff.comp (metricFrameCoordinates M e).contDiff
    simpa only [metricFramePolynomial, map_mul, eval_X] using hp.mul hi

lemma fderiv_metricFramePolynomial_apply (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (v w : R3) :
    fderiv ℝ (metricFramePolynomial M e p) v w =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, metricFrameCoordinates M e w i *
        eval (metricFrameCoordinates M e v) (pderiv i p) := by
  have h := (GreenRadialTrace.hasFDerivAt_eval p (metricFrameCoordinates M e v)).comp v
    (metricFrameCoordinates M e).hasFDerivAt
  change HasFDerivAt (metricFramePolynomial M e p) _ v at h
  rw [h.fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, GreenRadialTrace.polynomialFDeriv_apply]

lemma metricFrameCoordinates_operator_apply (M A : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3)
    (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame M e) (v : R3) (i : Fin 3) :
    metricFrameCoordinates M e (A v) i =
      ∑ j : Fin 3, ⟪M (A (e j)),e i⟫_ℝ * metricFrameCoordinates M e v j := by
  rw [metricFrameCoordinates_apply]
  nth_rw 1 [← metricFrame_sum_coordinates M e he v]
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul, sum_inner, real_inner_smul_left, metricFrameCoordinates_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  ring

theorem fderiv_metricFramePolynomial_operator_apply (M A : R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (e : Fin 3 → R3) (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame M e)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (v : R3) :
    fderiv ℝ (metricFramePolynomial M e p) v (A v) =
      eval (metricFrameCoordinates M e v)
        (polynomialMatrixVectorField (fun i j => ⟪M (A (e j)),e i⟫_ℝ) p) := by
  rw [fderiv_metricFramePolynomial_apply]
  simp only [metricFrameCoordinates_operator_apply M A e he, Finset.sum_mul,
    polynomialMatrixVectorField, map_sum, map_mul, eval_C, eval_X]

def metricFrameAmbientPolynomial (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) : R3 × R3 → ℝ := fun z => metricFramePolynomial M e p z.2

lemma contDiff_metricFrameAmbientPolynomial (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (metricFrameAmbientPolynomial M e p) :=
  (contDiff_metricFramePolynomial M e p).comp contDiff_snd

lemma fderiv_metricFrameAmbientPolynomial_apply (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (z a : R3 × R3) :
    fderiv ℝ (metricFrameAmbientPolynomial M e p) z a =
      fderiv ℝ (metricFramePolynomial M e p) z.2 a.2 := by
  have h := ((contDiff_metricFramePolynomial M e p).differentiable (by simp) z.2).hasFDerivAt.comp z
    (hasFDerivAt_snd (p := z))
  change HasFDerivAt (metricFrameAmbientPolynomial M e p) _ z at h
  rw [h.fderiv]
  rfl

theorem horizontalVectorField_metricFramePolynomial_commutator
    (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (hΓ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Γ)
    (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3) (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame M e)
    (a b : Fin 3) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (x v : R3) :
    vectorFieldDeriv (horizontalVectorField Γ (e a))
      (vectorFieldDeriv (horizontalVectorField Γ (e b)) (metricFrameAmbientPolynomial M e p)) (x,v) -
    vectorFieldDeriv (horizontalVectorField Γ (e b))
      (vectorFieldDeriv (horizontalVectorField Γ (e a)) (metricFrameAmbientPolynomial M e p)) (x,v) =
    eval (metricFrameCoordinates M e v)
      (-polynomialMatrixVectorField (fun i j =>
        ⟪M (coordinateCurvatureAction Γ x (e a) (e b) (e j)),e i⟫_ℝ) p) := by
  rw [horizontalVectorField_commutator Γ hΓ _ _ _ (contDiff_metricFrameAmbientPolynomial M e p),
    fderiv_metricFrameAmbientPolynomial_apply, map_neg,
    fderiv_metricFramePolynomial_operator_apply M _ e he, map_neg]

def referenceHorizontalCurvaturePolynomial (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ) (x : R3)
    (e : Fin 3 → R3) (a b : Fin 3) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ := -referenceCurvatureVectorFieldPolynomial g L lam x e a b p

theorem referenceHorizontalCurvaturePolynomial_eq_half_smul (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (x : R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3)
    (a b : Fin 3) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    referenceHorizontalCurvaturePolynomial g L lam x e a b p =
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) • referenceCurvatureRotationPolynomial g L lam x e a b p := by
  unfold referenceHorizontalCurvaturePolynomial
  rw [referenceCurvatureVectorFieldPolynomial_eq_neg_half_smul g hg]
  simp only [neg_smul, neg_neg]

theorem reference_horizontal_metricFramePolynomial_commutator (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (x v : R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3)
    (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x) e)
    (a b : Fin 3) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    vectorFieldDeriv (horizontalVectorField (fun y => referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,y)) (e a))
      (vectorFieldDeriv (horizontalVectorField (fun y => referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,y)) (e b))
        (metricFrameAmbientPolynomial (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x) e p)) (x,v) -
    vectorFieldDeriv (horizontalVectorField (fun y => referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,y)) (e b))
      (vectorFieldDeriv (horizontalVectorField (fun y => referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,y)) (e a))
        (metricFrameAmbientPolynomial (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x) e p)) (x,v) =
    eval (metricFrameCoordinates (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x) e v)
      (referenceHorizontalCurvaturePolynomial g L lam x e a b p) := by
  have hpair : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : R3 => (lam,y)) := contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id
  exact horizontalVectorField_metricFramePolynomial_commutator _
    ((contDiff_referenceConnectionFamily g hg L).comp hpair) _ e he a b p x v

theorem referenceHorizontalCurvaturePolynomial_harmonicHomogeneous (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (x : R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3)
    (a b : Fin 3) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hp : p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) :
    referenceHorizontalCurvaturePolynomial g L lam x e a b p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k := by
  rw [referenceHorizontalCurvaturePolynomial_eq_half_smul g hg]
  exact (harmonicHomogeneous k).smul_mem _
    (referenceCurvatureRotationPolynomial_harmonicHomogeneous g L lam x e a b k hk p hp)

theorem exists_referenceHorizontalCurvaturePolynomial_uniform_sphere_norm_bound
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ hF : SphereFischerInner,
      ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ e : Fin 3 → R3,
      IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x) e →
      ∀ a b : Fin 3, ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → ∀ p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ,
      p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k →
      ‖polynomialSphereL2 (referenceHorizontalCurvaturePolynomial g L lam x e a b p)‖ ≤
        C * (k : ℝ) * ‖polynomialSphereL2 p‖ := by
  obtain ⟨B,hB,hbound⟩ := exists_referenceCurvatureRotationPolynomial_uniform_sphere_norm_bound g hg L hL K hK
  refine ⟨B/2,by positivity,?_⟩
  intro hF lam hlam x hx e he a b k hk p hp
  have hb := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hbound hF lam hlam x hx e he a b k hk p hp)
    (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1/2)
  rw [referenceHorizontalCurvaturePolynomial_eq_half_smul g hg, map_smul, norm_smul]
  norm_num only [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1/2)]
  convert hb using 1 <;> ring

theorem exists_referenceHorizontalCurvaturePolynomial_uniform_degree_sphere_norm_bound
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ hF : SphereFischerInner,
      ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ e : Fin 3 → R3,
      IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x) e →
      ∀ a b : Fin 3, ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → ∀ p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ,
      p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k →
      ‖polynomialSphereL2 ((k : ℝ) • referenceHorizontalCurvaturePolynomial g L lam x e a b p)‖ ≤
        C * (k : ℝ)^2 * ‖polynomialSphereL2 p‖ := by
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hbound⟩ := exists_referenceHorizontalCurvaturePolynomial_uniform_sphere_norm_bound g hg L hL K hK
  refine ⟨C,hC,?_⟩
  intro hF lam hlam x hx e he a b k hk p hp
  rw [map_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg k)]
  convert mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hbound hF lam hlam x hx e he a b k hk p hp)
    (Nat.cast_nonneg k) using 1 <;> ring

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.FrameCurvaturePolynomial

``````
