## Calderon.CurvatureContraction

SHA256 `1dcb6df5ebd69efeddf6e3000f7717dcb7426ef0324e1cdb3eb6c8603522e164`.

``````lean
import Calderon.FrameCurvaturePolynomial

set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 10
noncomputable section
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.CurvatureContraction
open RadiusProfile ConformalDepth MetricOperator SphereHarmonic AngularPolynomial MvPolynomial
  CurvatureRotation CurvatureSkew FrameCurvaturePolynomial

lemma pderiv_eq_zero_of_isHomogeneous_zero (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hp : p.IsHomogeneous 0) (i : Fin 3) : pderiv i p = 0 := by
  have hs := sum_fischerInner_pderiv_self hp
  simp only [Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul] at hs
  have hz : fischerInner (pderiv i p) (pderiv i p) = 0 := by
    have hle := Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => fischerInner_self_nonneg (pderiv j p))
      (Finset.mem_univ i)
    rw [hs] at hle
    exact le_antisymm hle (fischerInner_self_nonneg _)
  exact (fischerInner_self_eq_zero_iff _).mp hz

lemma polynomialRotation_eq_zero_of_isHomogeneous_zero (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hp : p.IsHomogeneous 0) (i j : Fin 3) : polynomialRotation i j p = 0 := by
  simp only [polynomialRotation, pderiv_eq_zero_of_isHomogeneous_zero p hp, mul_zero, sub_self]

lemma referenceHorizontalCurvaturePolynomial_eq_zero_of_isHomogeneous_zero
    (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ) (x : R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3) (a b : Fin 3)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hp : p.IsHomogeneous 0) :
    referenceHorizontalCurvaturePolynomial g L lam x e a b p = 0 := by
  simp only [referenceHorizontalCurvaturePolynomial, referenceCurvatureVectorFieldPolynomial,
    polynomialMatrixVectorField, pderiv_eq_zero_of_isHomogeneous_zero p hp,
    mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, neg_zero]

lemma fischerInner_scaled_square (t : ℝ) (p q : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    fischerInner (C t * p + q) (C t * p + q) =
      t^2 * fischerInner p p + 2*t*fischerInner p q + fischerInner q q := by
  simp only [fischerInner_add_left, fischerInner_add_right, fischerInner_C_mul_left,
    fischerInner_C_mul_right, fischerInner_symm q p]
  ring

lemma abs_fischerInner_le_of_square_bound (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 < t)
    (p q r : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hq : fischerInner q q ≤ t^2 * fischerInner r r) :
    |fischerInner p q| ≤ (t/2) * (fischerInner p p + fischerInner r r) := by
  have hp := fischerInner_self_nonneg (C t * p + q)
  have hm := fischerInner_self_nonneg (C (-t) * p + q)
  rw [fischerInner_scaled_square] at hp hm
  apply abs_le.mpr
  constructor <;> nlinarith

lemma fischerInner_square_bound_of_sphere_norm_bound (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (m : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (q r : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hq : q ∈ harmonicHomogeneous m) (hr : r ∈ harmonicHomogeneous m)
    (hn : ‖polynomialSphereL2 q‖ ≤ t * ‖polynomialSphereL2 r‖) :
    fischerInner q q ≤ t^2 * fischerInner r r := by
  have hs : ‖polynomialSphereL2 q‖^2 ≤ t^2 * ‖polynomialSphereL2 r‖^2 := by
    have hsq := (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg ht (norm_nonneg _))).2 hn
    nlinarith only [hsq]
  rw [polynomialSphereL2_norm_sq hF m q hq, polynomialSphereL2_norm_sq hF m r hr] at hs
  unfold normalizedFischerSquare normalizedFischerInner at hs
  have hN := sphereNormalization_pos (n := 3) (by norm_num : 0 < 3) m
  have hs' : fischerInner q q / sphereNormalization 3 m ≤
      (t^2 * fischerInner r r) / sphereNormalization 3 m := by
    simpa only [Fintype.card_fin, mul_div_assoc] using hs
  exact (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hN).mp hs' 

lemma exists_referenceHorizontalCurvaturePolynomial_uniform_fischer_square_bound
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ A : ℝ, 0 < A ∧ ∀ hF : SphereFischerInner,
      ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ e : Fin 3 → R3,
      IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x) e →
      ∀ a b : Fin 3, ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ,
      p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous m →
      fischerInner (referenceHorizontalCurvaturePolynomial g L lam x e a b p)
        (referenceHorizontalCurvaturePolynomial g L lam x e a b p) ≤
        (A * (m : ℝ))^2 * fischerInner p p := by
  obtain ⟨A,hA,hbound⟩ := exists_referenceHorizontalCurvaturePolynomial_uniform_sphere_norm_bound g hg L hL K hK
  refine ⟨A,hA,?_⟩
  intro hF lam hlam x hx e he a b m p hp
  by_cases hm : m = 0
  · subst m
    rw [referenceHorizontalCurvaturePolynomial_eq_zero_of_isHomogeneous_zero g L lam x e a b p hp.1]
    simp [fischerInner_zero_left]
  · have hm' : 1 ≤ m := by omega
    exact fischerInner_square_bound_of_sphere_norm_bound hF m (A*(m : ℝ)) (by positivity) _ p
      (referenceHorizontalCurvaturePolynomial_harmonicHomogeneous g hg L lam x e a b m hm' p hp)
      hp (hbound hF lam hlam x hx e he a b m hm' p hp)

def referenceCurvatureContraction (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ) (x : R3)
    (e : Fin 3 → R3) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, fischerInner (pderiv i p)
    (referenceHorizontalCurvaturePolynomial g L lam x e i j (pderiv j p))

lemma pderiv_harmonicHomogeneous_pred (k : ℕ) (i : Fin 3)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hp : p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) :
    pderiv i p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (k-1) := by
  refine ⟨hp.1.pderiv, ?_⟩
  rw [laplacian_pderiv, hp.2, map_zero]

theorem exists_referenceCurvatureContraction_uniform_fischer_bound
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ hF : SphereFischerInner,
      ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ e : Fin 3 → R3,
      IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x) e →
      ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → ∀ p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ,
      p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k →
      |referenceCurvatureContraction g L lam x e p| ≤
        C * (k : ℝ)^2 * fischerInner p p := by
  obtain ⟨A,hA,hbound⟩ := exists_referenceHorizontalCurvaturePolynomial_uniform_fischer_square_bound g hg L hL K hK
  refine ⟨3*A,by positivity,?_⟩
  intro hF lam hlam x hx e he k hk p hp
  have hk' : (0 : ℝ) < k := by exact_mod_cast (lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : 0 < 1) hk)
  have hm : ((k-1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (Nat.sub_le k 1)
  have hsquare (i j : Fin 3) :
      fischerInner (referenceHorizontalCurvaturePolynomial g L lam x e i j (pderiv j p))
        (referenceHorizontalCurvaturePolynomial g L lam x e i j (pderiv j p)) ≤
        (A*(k : ℝ))^2 * fischerInner (pderiv j p) (pderiv j p) := by
    have h := hbound hF lam hlam x hx e he i j (k-1) (pderiv j p)
      (pderiv_harmonicHomogeneous_pred k j p hp)
    refine h.trans ?_
    gcongr
    exact fischerInner_self_nonneg _
  have hcross (i j : Fin 3) :
      |fischerInner (pderiv i p)
        (referenceHorizontalCurvaturePolynomial g L lam x e i j (pderiv j p))| ≤
        (A*(k : ℝ)/2)*(fischerInner (pderiv i p) (pderiv i p) +
          fischerInner (pderiv j p) (pderiv j p)) :=
    abs_fischerInner_le_of_square_bound (A*(k : ℝ)) (mul_pos hA hk') _ _ _ (hsquare i j)
  unfold referenceCurvatureContraction
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, |∑ j : Fin 3, fischerInner (pderiv i p)
        (referenceHorizontalCurvaturePolynomial g L lam x e i j (pderiv j p))| :=
      Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, |fischerInner (pderiv i p)
        (referenceHorizontalCurvaturePolynomial g L lam x e i j (pderiv j p))| := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro i hi
      exact Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, (A*(k : ℝ)/2)*
        (fischerInner (pderiv i p) (pderiv i p) + fischerInner (pderiv j p) (pderiv j p)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro i hi
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro j hj
      exact hcross i j
    _ = (3*A)*(k : ℝ)^2*fischerInner p p := by
      simp only [mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_const,
        Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul, ← Finset.sum_mul,
        sum_fischerInner_pderiv_self hp.1]
      ring

theorem exists_referenceCurvatureContraction_uniform_normalized_bound
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ hF : SphereFischerInner,
      ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ e : Fin 3 → R3,
      IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x) e →
      ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → ∀ p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ,
      p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k →
      |referenceCurvatureContraction g L lam x e p| / sphereNormalization 3 k ≤
        C * (k : ℝ)^2 * ‖polynomialSphereL2 p‖^2 := by
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hbound⟩ := exists_referenceCurvatureContraction_uniform_fischer_bound g hg L hL K hK
  refine ⟨C,hC,?_⟩
  intro hF lam hlam x hx e he k hk p hp
  have h := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hbound hF lam hlam x hx e he k hk p hp)
    (sphereNormalization_pos (n := 3) (by norm_num : 0 < 3) k).le
  rw [polynomialSphereL2_norm_sq hF k p hp]
  unfold normalizedFischerSquare normalizedFischerInner
  simpa only [Fintype.card_fin, mul_div_assoc] using h

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.CurvatureContraction
``````

## Calderon.HessianContraction

SHA256 `063eb46f8363a4e63180fe7f768f71967b63a4fc2c8e2e6e51cf326b269a82f7`.

``````lean
import Calderon.CurvatureContraction
import Calderon.CommonProfileFamily

set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 10
noncomputable section
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.HessianContraction
open RadiusProfile ConformalDepth MetricOperator AngularPolynomial MvPolynomial
  FrameCurvaturePolynomial MetricVolume

lemma fischerInner_eq_sum_of_support_subset (p q : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (s : Finset (Fin 3 →₀ ℕ)) (hp : p.support ⊆ s) :
    fischerInner p q = ∑ a ∈ s, p.coeff a * q.coeff a * fischerWeight a := by
  classical
  unfold fischerInner
  apply Finset.sum_subset hp
  intro a ha hap
  simp [notMem_support_iff.mp hap]

def polynomialFamilySupport (q : Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) : Finset (Fin 3 →₀ ℕ) :=
  Finset.univ.biUnion fun i => (q i).support

lemma support_subset_polynomialFamilySupport (q : Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (i : Fin 3) : (q i).support ⊆ polynomialFamilySupport q := by
  classical
  intro a ha
  exact Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr ⟨i,Finset.mem_univ i,ha⟩

lemma fischer_matrix_contraction_eq_coeff_sum (H : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (q : Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, H i j * fischerInner (q i) (q j)) =
      ∑ a ∈ polynomialFamilySupport q, fischerWeight a *
        (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, H i j * (q i).coeff a * (q j).coeff a) := by
  classical
  simp_rw [fischerInner_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ _ (polynomialFamilySupport q)
    (support_subset_polynomialFamilySupport q _), Finset.mul_sum]
  have hswap (i : Fin 3) :
      (∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ a ∈ polynomialFamilySupport q,
        H i j * ((q i).coeff a * (q j).coeff a * fischerWeight a)) =
      ∑ a ∈ polynomialFamilySupport q, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        H i j * ((q i).coeff a * (q j).coeff a * fischerWeight a) :=
    Finset.sum_comm
  simp_rw [hswap]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a ha
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  ring

lemma sum_fischerInner_self_eq_coeff_sum (q : Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    (∑ i : Fin 3, fischerInner (q i) (q i)) =
      ∑ a ∈ polynomialFamilySupport q, fischerWeight a *
        (∑ i : Fin 3, ((q i).coeff a)^2) := by
  classical
  simp_rw [fischerInner_eq_sum_of_support_subset _ _ (polynomialFamilySupport q)
    (support_subset_polynomialFamilySupport q _)]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a ha
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  ring

lemma fischer_matrix_contraction_le_of_quadratic (H : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (a : ℝ) (hH : ∀ c : Fin 3 → ℝ,
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, H i j * c i * c j) ≤ -a * (∑ i : Fin 3, (c i)^2))
    (q : Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, H i j * fischerInner (q i) (q j)) ≤
      -a * (∑ i : Fin 3, fischerInner (q i) (q i)) := by
  classical
  rw [fischer_matrix_contraction_eq_coeff_sum, sum_fischerInner_self_eq_coeff_sum,
    Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro b hb
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hH (fun i => (q i).coeff b))
    (fischerWeight_pos b).le
  convert h using 1 <;> ring

lemma metricFrame_square_sum (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3)
    (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame M e) (c : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    ⟪M (∑ i : Fin 3, c i • e i), ∑ i : Fin 3, c i • e i⟫_ℝ =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, (c i)^2 := by
  simp only [IsMetricOrthonormalFrame] at he
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul, sum_inner, inner_sum, real_inner_smul_left,
    real_inner_smul_right, he]
  simp [pow_two]

lemma bilinear_metricFrame_quadratic (B : R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (e : Fin 3 → R3) (c : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    B (∑ i : Fin 3, c i • e i) (∑ i : Fin 3, c i • e i) =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, B (e i) (e j) * c i * c j := by
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul, _root_.sum_apply, _root_.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  ring

lemma bilinear_fischer_contraction_le_of_metric_quadratic
    (B : R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (e : Fin 3 → R3) (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame M e) (a : ℝ)
    (hB : ∀ X : R3, B X X ≤ -a * ⟪M X,X⟫_ℝ)
    (q : Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, B (e i) (e j) * fischerInner (q i) (q j)) ≤
      -a * (∑ i : Fin 3, fischerInner (q i) (q i)) := by
  apply fischer_matrix_contraction_le_of_quadratic _ a _ q
  intro c
  have h := hB (∑ i : Fin 3, c i • e i)
  rw [metricFrame_square_sum M e he, bilinear_metricFrame_quadratic B e] at h
  exact h

def referenceProfileHessianBilinear (g : MatrixField) (lam δ R : ℝ) (p : ℕ)
    (L : ℝ) (x : R3) : R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  MetricVolume.coordinateHessianBilinear (referenceLogRadius δ R p L)
    (ConnectionError.coordinateConnectionField
      (inverseMetricOperator (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L))
      (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L)) x) x

def referenceProfileHessianContraction (g : MatrixField) (lam δ R : ℝ) (p : ℕ)
    (L : ℝ) (x : R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3) (k : ℕ)
    (v : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) : ℝ :=
  2*(k : ℝ)*(∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
    referenceProfileHessianBilinear g lam δ R p L x (e i) (e j) *
      fischerInner (pderiv i v) (pderiv j v))

lemma referenceProfileHessianBilinear_le (g : MatrixField) (K : Set R3)
    (L c0 c1 J1 J2 D : ℝ) (hbounds : referenceProfileBounds g K L c0 c1 J1 J2 D)
    (lam : ℝ) (hlam : lam ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (p : ℕ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (x : R3) (hx : x ∈ K) (X : R3) :
    referenceProfileHessianBilinear g lam δ R p L x X X ≤
      -(c1 * referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x)*
        ⟪metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x X,X⟫_ℝ := by
  rw [referenceProfileHessianBilinear, MetricVolume.coordinateHessianBilinear_apply]
  have h := (hbounds.1 lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp x hx).2.1 X
  simpa only [neg_mul] using h

lemma referenceProfileHessianContraction_le (g : MatrixField) (K : Set R3)
    (L c0 c1 J1 J2 D : ℝ) (hbounds : referenceProfileBounds g K L c0 c1 J1 J2 D)
    (lam : ℝ) (hlam : lam ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (p : ℕ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (x : R3) (hx : x ∈ K)
    (e : Fin 3 → R3)
    (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x) e)
    (k : ℕ) (v : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hv : v.IsHomogeneous k) :
    referenceProfileHessianContraction g lam δ R p L x e k v ≤
      -2*c1*(k : ℝ)^2*referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x*fischerInner v v := by
  have h := bilinear_fischer_contraction_le_of_metric_quadratic
    (referenceProfileHessianBilinear g lam δ R p L x) _ e he
    (c1*referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x)
    (referenceProfileHessianBilinear_le g K L c0 c1 J1 J2 D hbounds lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp x hx)
    (fun i => pderiv i v)
  rw [sum_fischerInner_pderiv_self hv] at h
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2*(k : ℝ))
  unfold referenceProfileHessianContraction
  convert hm using 1 <;> ring

theorem exists_referenceProfileHessianContraction_uniform_bound (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ L c : ℝ, 0 < L ∧ 0 < c ∧
      ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 → ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R →
      ∀ p : ℕ, 1 ≤ p → ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ e : Fin 3 → R3,
      IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x) e →
      ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ v : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ, v.IsHomogeneous k →
      referenceProfileHessianContraction g lam δ R p L x e k v ≤
        -2*c*(k : ℝ)^2*referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x*fischerInner v v := by
  obtain ⟨L,c0,c1,J1,J2,D,hL,hc0,hc1,hJ1,hJ2,hD,hbounds⟩ := exists_referenceProfileBounds g hg K hK
  refine ⟨L,c1,hL,hc1,?_⟩
  intro lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp x hx e he k v hv
  exact referenceProfileHessianContraction_le g K L c0 c1 J1 J2 D hbounds lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp x hx e he k v hv

theorem exists_referenceProfileHessianContraction_uniform_normalized_bound
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ L c : ℝ, 0 < L ∧ 0 < c ∧ ∀ hF : SphereHarmonic.SphereFischerInner,
      ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 → ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R →
      ∀ p : ℕ, 1 ≤ p → ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ e : Fin 3 → R3,
      IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x) e →
      ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ v : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ, v ∈ SphereHarmonic.harmonicHomogeneous k →
      referenceProfileHessianContraction g lam δ R p L x e k v / sphereNormalization 3 k ≤
        -2*c*(k : ℝ)^2*referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x*‖SphereHarmonic.polynomialSphereL2 v‖^2 := by
  obtain ⟨L,c,hL,hc,hbound⟩ := exists_referenceProfileHessianContraction_uniform_bound g hg K hK
  refine ⟨L,c,hL,hc,?_⟩
  intro hF lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp x hx e he k v hv
  have h := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hbound lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp x hx e he k v hv.1)
    (sphereNormalization_pos (n := 3) (by norm_num : 0 < 3) k).le
  rw [SphereHarmonic.polynomialSphereL2_norm_sq hF k v hv]
  unfold normalizedFischerSquare normalizedFischerInner
  simpa only [Fintype.card_fin, mul_div_assoc] using h

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.HessianContraction

``````

## Calderon.SmoothMetricFrame

SHA256 `dc48e07c321ecc7b24c7716d3d191b63d069f482d396735fc0b074a9649c23dc`.

``````lean
import Calderon.HessianContraction
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Sqrt

set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 10
noncomputable section
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SmoothMetricFrame
open RadiusProfile ConformalDepth MetricOperator MetricVolume

def metricPair (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (v w : R3) : ℝ := ⟪M v,w⟫_ℝ

def gramSecond (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) : R3 :=
  coordinateVector 1 - (metricPair M (coordinateVector 1) (coordinateVector 0) /
    metricPair M (coordinateVector 0) (coordinateVector 0)) • coordinateVector 0

def gramThird (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) : R3 :=
  coordinateVector 2 - (metricPair M (coordinateVector 2) (coordinateVector 0) /
    metricPair M (coordinateVector 0) (coordinateVector 0)) • coordinateVector 0 -
  (metricPair M (coordinateVector 2) (gramSecond M) /
    metricPair M (gramSecond M) (gramSecond M)) • gramSecond M

def metricNormalize (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (v : R3) : R3 :=
  (Real.sqrt (metricPair M v v))⁻¹ • v

def metricGramFrame (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (i : Fin 3) : R3 :=
  if i = 0 then metricNormalize M (coordinateVector 0)
  else if i = 1 then metricNormalize M (gramSecond M) else metricNormalize M (gramThird M)

lemma coordinateVector_zero_ne : coordinateVector (0 : Fin 3) ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  have hi := congrArg (fun v : R3 => v 0) h
  norm_num [coordinateVector, PiLp.single_apply] at hi

lemma gramSecond_one (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) : gramSecond M 1 = 1 := by
  simp [gramSecond, coordinateVector, PiLp.single_apply]

lemma gramSecond_two (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) : gramSecond M 2 = 0 := by
  simp [gramSecond, coordinateVector, PiLp.single_apply]

lemma gramSecond_ne_zero (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) : gramSecond M ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  have hi := gramSecond_one M
  rw [h] at hi
  norm_num at hi

lemma gramThird_two (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) : gramThird M 2 = 1 := by
  simp [gramThird, coordinateVector, PiLp.single_apply, gramSecond_two]

lemma gramThird_ne_zero (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) : gramThird M ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  have hi := gramThird_two M
  rw [h] at hi
  norm_num at hi

lemma metricPair_sub_left (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (v w z : R3) :
    metricPair M (v-w) z = metricPair M v z - metricPair M w z := by
  simp [metricPair, inner_sub_left]

lemma metricPair_smul_left (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (a : ℝ) (v w : R3) :
    metricPair M (a • v) w = a * metricPair M v w := by
  simp [metricPair, real_inner_smul_left]

lemma metricPair_normalize (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (v w : R3) :
    metricPair M (metricNormalize M v) (metricNormalize M w) =
      (Real.sqrt (metricPair M v v))⁻¹ * (Real.sqrt (metricPair M w w))⁻¹ * metricPair M v w := by
  simp [metricPair, metricNormalize, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right]
  ring

lemma metricPair_normalize_self (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (v : R3)
    (hv : 0 < metricPair M v v) : metricPair M (metricNormalize M v) (metricNormalize M v) = 1 := by
  rw [metricPair_normalize]
  have hs := Real.sq_sqrt hv.le
  have hn := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hv).ne'
  field_simp
  nlinarith

lemma metricPair_gramSecond_zero (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (h0 : metricPair M (coordinateVector 0) (coordinateVector 0) ≠ 0) :
    metricPair M (gramSecond M) (coordinateVector 0) = 0 := by
  rw [gramSecond, metricPair_sub_left, metricPair_smul_left]
  field_simp
  ring

lemma metricPair_gramThird_zero (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (h0 : metricPair M (coordinateVector 0) (coordinateVector 0) ≠ 0) :
    metricPair M (gramThird M) (coordinateVector 0) = 0 := by
  simp only [gramThird, metricPair_sub_left, metricPair_smul_left, metricPair_gramSecond_zero M h0,
    mul_zero, sub_zero]
  field_simp
  ring

lemma metricPair_gramThird_second (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (hs : ∀ v w, metricPair M v w = metricPair M w v)
    (h0 : metricPair M (coordinateVector 0) (coordinateVector 0) ≠ 0)
    (h1 : metricPair M (gramSecond M) (gramSecond M) ≠ 0) :
    metricPair M (gramThird M) (gramSecond M) = 0 := by
  have h01 : metricPair M (coordinateVector 0) (gramSecond M) = 0 := by
    rw [hs, metricPair_gramSecond_zero M h0]
  simp only [gramThird, metricPair_sub_left, metricPair_smul_left, h01, mul_zero, sub_zero]
  field_simp
  ring

theorem metricGramFrame_isMetricOrthonormalFrame (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (hs : ∀ v w, metricPair M v w = metricPair M w v)
    (hp : ∀ v : R3, v ≠ 0 → 0 < metricPair M v v) :
    IsMetricOrthonormalFrame M (metricGramFrame M) := by
  have h0 := hp _ coordinateVector_zero_ne
  have h1 := hp _ (gramSecond_ne_zero M)
  have h2 := hp _ (gramThird_ne_zero M)
  have h10 := metricPair_gramSecond_zero M h0.ne'
  have h20 := metricPair_gramThird_zero M h0.ne'
  have h21 := metricPair_gramThird_second M hs h0.ne' h1.ne'
  have h01 : metricPair M (coordinateVector 0) (gramSecond M) = 0 := by rw [hs,h10]
  have h02 : metricPair M (coordinateVector 0) (gramThird M) = 0 := by rw [hs,h20]
  have h12 : metricPair M (gramSecond M) (gramThird M) = 0 := by rw [hs,h21]
  intro i j
  change metricPair M (metricGramFrame M i) (metricGramFrame M j) = _
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [metricGramFrame, metricPair_normalize_self M _ h0, metricPair_normalize_self M _ h1,
      metricPair_normalize_self M _ h2, metricPair_normalize, h10,h20,h21,h01,h02,h12]

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]

lemma contDiff_metricPair (M : E → R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (v w : E → R3)
    (hM : ContDiff ℝ ∞ M) (hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ v) (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => metricPair (M x) (v x) (w x)) :=
  (hM.clm_apply hv).inner ℝ hw

lemma contDiff_gramSecond (M : E → R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (hM : ContDiff ℝ ∞ M)
    (hp : ∀ x, ∀ v : R3, v ≠ 0 → 0 < metricPair (M x) v v) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => gramSecond (M x)) := by
  have hnum := contDiff_metricPair M (fun _ => coordinateVector 1) (fun _ => coordinateVector 0)
    hM contDiff_const contDiff_const
  have hden := contDiff_metricPair M (fun _ => coordinateVector 0) (fun _ => coordinateVector 0)
    hM contDiff_const contDiff_const
  exact contDiff_const.sub ((hnum.div hden (fun x => (hp x _ coordinateVector_zero_ne).ne')).smul contDiff_const)

lemma contDiff_gramThird (M : E → R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (hM : ContDiff ℝ ∞ M)
    (hp : ∀ x, ∀ v : R3, v ≠ 0 → 0 < metricPair (M x) v v) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => gramThird (M x)) := by
  have h1 := contDiff_gramSecond M hM hp
  have hnum0 := contDiff_metricPair M (fun _ => coordinateVector 2) (fun _ => coordinateVector 0)
    hM contDiff_const contDiff_const
  have hden0 := contDiff_metricPair M (fun _ => coordinateVector 0) (fun _ => coordinateVector 0)
    hM contDiff_const contDiff_const
  have hnum1 := contDiff_metricPair M (fun _ => coordinateVector 2) (fun x => gramSecond (M x))
    hM contDiff_const h1
  have hden1 := contDiff_metricPair M (fun x => gramSecond (M x)) (fun x => gramSecond (M x)) hM h1 h1
  exact (contDiff_const.sub ((hnum0.div hden0 (fun x => (hp x _ coordinateVector_zero_ne).ne')).smul contDiff_const)).sub
    ((hnum1.div hden1 (fun x => (hp x _ (gramSecond_ne_zero (M x))).ne')).smul h1)

lemma contDiff_metricNormalize (M : E → R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (v : E → R3)
    (hM : ContDiff ℝ ∞ M) (hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ v)
    (hpos : ∀ x, 0 < metricPair (M x) (v x) (v x)) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => metricNormalize (M x) (v x)) := by
  have hs := (contDiff_metricPair M v v hM hv hv).sqrt (fun x => (hpos x).ne')
  exact (hs.inv (fun x => (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hpos x)).ne')).smul hv

lemma contDiff_metricGramFrame (M : E → R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (hM : ContDiff ℝ ∞ M)
    (hp : ∀ x, ∀ v : R3, v ≠ 0 → 0 < metricPair (M x) v v) (i : Fin 3) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => metricGramFrame (M x) i) := by
  fin_cases i
  · simpa [metricGramFrame] using contDiff_metricNormalize M (fun _ => coordinateVector 0)
      hM contDiff_const (fun x => hp x _ coordinateVector_zero_ne)
  · simpa [metricGramFrame] using
      contDiff_metricNormalize M (fun x => gramSecond (M x)) hM (contDiff_gramSecond M hM hp)
        (fun x => hp x _ (gramSecond_ne_zero (M x)))
  · simpa [metricGramFrame] using contDiff_metricNormalize M (fun x => gramThird (M x)) hM
        (contDiff_gramThird M hM hp) (fun x => hp x _ (gramThird_ne_zero (M x)))

lemma metricPair_reference_pos (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (x v : R3) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    0 < metricPair (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x) v v := by
  have hv' : (v : Fin 3 → ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    apply hv
    ext i
    exact congrFun h i
  unfold metricPair
  rw [metricOperatorField_inner_eq_quadratic, Matrix.toQuadraticForm'_apply]
  exact (dilatedReferenceMetric_posDef g hg lam L x).dotProduct_mulVec_pos hv'

def referenceMetricGramFrame (g : MatrixField) (L : ℝ) (z : ℝ × R3) (i : Fin 3) : R3 :=
  metricGramFrame (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g z.1) L) z.2) i

theorem referenceMetricGramFrame_isMetricOrthonormalFrame (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L : ℝ) (z : ℝ × R3) :
    IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g z.1) L) z.2)
      (referenceMetricGramFrame g L z) := by
  apply metricGramFrame_isMetricOrthonormalFrame
  · intro v w
    exact CurvatureSkew.referenceMetricOperator_symmetric g hg L z.1 z.2 v w
  · exact metricPair_reference_pos g hg L z.1 z.2

theorem contDiff_referenceMetricGramFrame (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L : ℝ) (i : Fin 3) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × R3 => referenceMetricGramFrame g L z i) :=
  contDiff_metricGramFrame _ (contDiff_referenceMetricOperator_joint g hg L)
    (fun z => metricPair_reference_pos g hg L z.1 z.2) i

theorem contDiff_referenceMetricGramFrame_slice (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (i : Fin 3) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : R3 => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) :=
  (contDiff_referenceMetricGramFrame g hg L i).comp (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id)

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SmoothMetricFrame

``````

## Calderon.MovingFrameConnection

SHA256 `1fb1110392b9cf06772876612c6561b473ca6e2fc46f473c4938cd518980ec2b`.

``````lean
import Calderon.SmoothMetricFrame
import Calderon.FrameCurvaturePolynomial

set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 10
noncomputable section
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.MovingFrameConnection
open PrincipalCommutator ConnectionError MetricOperator ConformalDepth RadiusProfile
  AngularPolynomial SphereHarmonic CurvatureRotation CurvatureSkew
  FrameCurvaturePolynomial SmoothMetricFrame MvPolynomial

def covariantFrameDerivative (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3) (x X : R3) (j : Fin 3) : R3 :=
  fderiv ℝ (fun y => e y j) x X + Γ x X (e x j)

def frameConnectionCoefficient (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3)
    (x X : R3) (i j : Fin 3) : ℝ :=
  ⟪M x (covariantFrameDerivative Γ e x X j),e x i⟫_ℝ

theorem covariantFrameDerivative_eq_sum (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3)
    (x X : R3) (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (M x) (e x)) (j : Fin 3) :
    covariantFrameDerivative Γ e x X j =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, frameConnectionCoefficient M Γ e x X i j • e x i := by
  exact (metricFrame_sum_coordinates (M x) (e x) he _).symm

theorem frameConnectionCoefficient_skew (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3)
    (hM : ContDiff ℝ ∞ M) (hE : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => e y j))
    (hsym : ∀ y U V, ⟪M y U,V⟫_ℝ = ⟪M y V,U⟫_ℝ)
    (he : ∀ y, IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (M y) (e y))
    (hcomp : ∀ y X U V, ⟪M y (Γ y X U),V⟫_ℝ + ⟪M y U,Γ y X V⟫_ℝ =
      ⟪fderiv ℝ M y X U,V⟫_ℝ) (x X : R3) (i j : Fin 3) :
    frameConnectionCoefficient M Γ e x X i j =
      -frameConnectionCoefficient M Γ e x X j i := by
  have hg : (fun y => ⟪M y (e y j),e y i⟫_ℝ) =
      fun _ : R3 => if j = i then (1:ℝ) else 0 := by
    funext y
    exact he y j i
  have hd := directionalFDeriv_metric_pairing X M (fun y => e y j)
    (fun y => e y i) hM (hE j) (hE i) x
  rw [hg] at hd
  have hz : directionalFDeriv X (fun _ : R3 => if j = i then (1:ℝ) else 0) x = 0 := by
    by_cases h : j = i <;> simp [h, directionalFDeriv]
  rw [hz] at hd
  simp only [directionalFDeriv] at hd
  simp only [inner_add_left] at hd
  rw [← hcomp x X (e x j) (e x i)] at hd
  have hs1 := hsym x (e x j) (fderiv ℝ (fun y => e y i) x X)
  have hs2 := hsym x (e x j) (Γ x X (e x i))
  simp only [frameConnectionCoefficient, covariantFrameDerivative, map_add, inner_add_left]
  linarith

def movingFrameCoordinate (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3) (i : Fin 3) (z : R3 × R3) : ℝ :=
  ⟪M z.1 z.2,e z.1 i⟫_ℝ

lemma contDiff_movingFrameCoordinate (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3) (hM : ContDiff ℝ ∞ M)
    (hE : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => e y i)) (i : Fin 3) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (movingFrameCoordinate M e i) :=
  ((hM.comp contDiff_fst).clm_apply contDiff_snd).inner ℝ ((hE i).comp contDiff_fst)

lemma fderiv_movingFrameCoordinate_apply (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3) (hM : ContDiff ℝ ∞ M)
    (hE : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => e y i)) (i : Fin 3) (z a : R3 × R3) :
    fderiv ℝ (movingFrameCoordinate M e i) z a =
      ⟪fderiv ℝ M z.1 a.1 z.2 + M z.1 a.2,e z.1 i⟫_ℝ +
      ⟪M z.1 z.2,fderiv ℝ (fun y => e y i) z.1 a.1⟫_ℝ := by
  have hm := ((hM.differentiable (by simp) z.1).hasFDerivAt.comp z
    (hasFDerivAt_fst (p := z)))
  have he := ((hE i).differentiable (by simp) z.1).hasFDerivAt.comp z
    (hasFDerivAt_fst (p := z))
  have hp := (hm.clm_apply (hasFDerivAt_snd (p := z))).inner ℝ he
  change HasFDerivAt (movingFrameCoordinate M e i) _ z at hp
  rw [hp.fderiv]
  change ⟪M z.1 z.2,fderiv ℝ (fun y => e y i) z.1 a.1⟫_ℝ +
    ⟪M z.1 a.2 + fderiv ℝ M z.1 a.1 z.2,e z.1 i⟫_ℝ = _
  simp only [inner_add_left]
  ring

lemma fderiv_movingFrameCoordinate_horizontal (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3)
    (hM : ContDiff ℝ ∞ M) (hE : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => e y j))
    (hcomp : ∀ y X U V, ⟪M y (Γ y X U),V⟫_ℝ + ⟪M y U,Γ y X V⟫_ℝ =
      ⟪fderiv ℝ M y X U,V⟫_ℝ) (x v X : R3) (i : Fin 3) :
    fderiv ℝ (movingFrameCoordinate M e i) (x,v) (X,-Γ x X v) =
      ⟪M x v,covariantFrameDerivative Γ e x X i⟫_ℝ := by
  rw [fderiv_movingFrameCoordinate_apply M e hM hE]
  simp only [map_neg, inner_add_left, inner_neg_left, covariantFrameDerivative,
    inner_add_right]
  rw [← hcomp x X v (e x i)]
  ring

lemma fderiv_movingFrameCoordinate_horizontal_eq_sum
    (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3) (hM : ContDiff ℝ ∞ M)
    (hE : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => e y j))
    (he : ∀ y, IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (M y) (e y))
    (hcomp : ∀ y X U V, ⟪M y (Γ y X U),V⟫_ℝ + ⟪M y U,Γ y X V⟫_ℝ =
      ⟪fderiv ℝ M y X U,V⟫_ℝ) (x v X : R3) (i : Fin 3) :
    fderiv ℝ (movingFrameCoordinate M e i) (x,v) (X,-Γ x X v) =
      ∑ j : Fin 3, frameConnectionCoefficient M Γ e x X j i *
        movingFrameCoordinate M e j (x,v) := by
  rw [fderiv_movingFrameCoordinate_horizontal M Γ e hM hE hcomp,
    covariantFrameDerivative_eq_sum M Γ e x X (he x) i]
  simp only [inner_sum, real_inner_smul_right, movingFrameCoordinate]

lemma fderiv_movingFrameCoordinate_horizontal_eq_neg_sum
    (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3) (hM : ContDiff ℝ ∞ M)
    (hE : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => e y j))
    (hsym : ∀ y U V, ⟪M y U,V⟫_ℝ = ⟪M y V,U⟫_ℝ)
    (he : ∀ y, IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (M y) (e y))
    (hcomp : ∀ y X U V, ⟪M y (Γ y X U),V⟫_ℝ + ⟪M y U,Γ y X V⟫_ℝ =
      ⟪fderiv ℝ M y X U,V⟫_ℝ) (x v X : R3) (i : Fin 3) :
    fderiv ℝ (movingFrameCoordinate M e i) (x,v) (X,-Γ x X v) =
      -∑ j : Fin 3, frameConnectionCoefficient M Γ e x X i j *
        movingFrameCoordinate M e j (x,v) := by
  rw [fderiv_movingFrameCoordinate_horizontal_eq_sum M Γ e hM hE he hcomp]
  rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  rw [frameConnectionCoefficient_skew M Γ e hM hE hsym he hcomp x X j i, neg_mul]

def movingFramePolynomial (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (z : R3 × R3) : ℝ :=
  eval (fun i => movingFrameCoordinate M e i z) p

lemma contDiff_movingFramePolynomial (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3) (hM : ContDiff ℝ ∞ M)
    (hE : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => e y i)) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (movingFramePolynomial M e p) := by
  unfold movingFramePolynomial
  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on with
  | C c => simpa only [movingFramePolynomial, eval_C] using
      (contDiff_const : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun _ : R3 × R3 => c))
  | add p q hp hq => simpa only [movingFramePolynomial, map_add] using hp.add hq
  | mul_X p i hp =>
      simpa only [map_mul, eval_X] using
        hp.mul (contDiff_movingFrameCoordinate M e hM hE i)

lemma fderiv_movingFramePolynomial_apply (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3) (hM : ContDiff ℝ ∞ M)
    (hE : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => e y i))
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (z a : R3 × R3) :
    fderiv ℝ (movingFramePolynomial M e p) z a =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ (movingFrameCoordinate M e i) z a *
        eval (fun j => movingFrameCoordinate M e j z) (pderiv i p) := by
  have hc := hasFDerivAt_pi.mpr (fun i =>
    ((contDiff_movingFrameCoordinate M e hM hE i).differentiable (by simp) z).hasFDerivAt)
  have hp := (GreenRadialTrace.hasFDerivAt_eval p
    (fun i => movingFrameCoordinate M e i z)).comp z hc
  change HasFDerivAt (movingFramePolynomial M e p) _ z at hp
  rw [hp.fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, GreenRadialTrace.polynomialFDeriv_apply]
  rfl

lemma fderiv_movingFramePolynomial_horizontal (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3)
    (hM : ContDiff ℝ ∞ M) (hE : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => e y j))
    (hsym : ∀ y U V, ⟪M y U,V⟫_ℝ = ⟪M y V,U⟫_ℝ)
    (he : ∀ y, IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (M y) (e y))
    (hcomp : ∀ y X U V, ⟪M y (Γ y X U),V⟫_ℝ + ⟪M y U,Γ y X V⟫_ℝ =
      ⟪fderiv ℝ M y X U,V⟫_ℝ)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (x v X : R3) :
    fderiv ℝ (movingFramePolynomial M e p) (x,v) (X,-Γ x X v) =
      eval (fun i => movingFrameCoordinate M e i (x,v))
        (-polynomialMatrixVectorField (frameConnectionCoefficient M Γ e x X) p) := by
  rw [fderiv_movingFramePolynomial_apply M e hM hE]
  simp only [fderiv_movingFrameCoordinate_horizontal_eq_neg_sum M Γ e hM hE
    hsym he hcomp, neg_mul, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_neg_distrib,
    polynomialMatrixVectorField, map_neg, map_sum, map_mul, eval_C, eval_X]

lemma fderiv_movingFramePolynomial_horizontal_rotation (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3)
    (hM : ContDiff ℝ ∞ M) (hE : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => e y j))
    (hsym : ∀ y U V, ⟪M y U,V⟫_ℝ = ⟪M y V,U⟫_ℝ)
    (he : ∀ y, IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (M y) (e y))
    (hcomp : ∀ y X U V, ⟪M y (Γ y X U),V⟫_ℝ + ⟪M y U,Γ y X V⟫_ℝ =
      ⟪fderiv ℝ M y X U,V⟫_ℝ)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (x v X : R3) :
    fderiv ℝ (movingFramePolynomial M e p) (x,v) (X,-Γ x X v) =
      eval (fun i => movingFrameCoordinate M e i (x,v))
        ((1/2:ℝ) • polynomialRotationCombination (frameConnectionCoefficient M Γ e x X) p) := by
  rw [fderiv_movingFramePolynomial_horizontal M Γ e hM hE hsym he hcomp,
    polynomialMatrixVectorField_eq_neg_half_smul _
      (fun i j => frameConnectionCoefficient_skew M Γ e hM hE hsym he hcomp x X i j)]
  simp

def referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (x X : R3) : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ :=
  frameConnectionCoefficient (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L))
    (fun y => referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,y))
    (fun y => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y)) x X

theorem referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient_skew (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (x X : R3) (i j : Fin 3) :
    referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient g L lam x X i j =
      -referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient g L lam x X j i := by
  exact frameConnectionCoefficient_skew _ _ _
    ((contDiff_referenceMetricOperator_joint g hg L).comp (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id))
    (fun a => contDiff_referenceMetricGramFrame_slice g hg L lam a)
    (fun y U V => referenceMetricOperator_symmetric g hg L lam y U V)
    (fun y => referenceMetricGramFrame_isMetricOrthonormalFrame g hg L (lam,y))
    (fun y Y U V => referenceConnectionFamily_metric_compatible g hg L lam y Y U V)
    x X i j

def referenceMovingFramePolynomial (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) : R3 × R3 → ℝ :=
  movingFramePolynomial (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L))
    (fun y => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y)) p

theorem contDiff_referenceMovingFramePolynomial (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (referenceMovingFramePolynomial g L lam p) :=
  contDiff_movingFramePolynomial _ _
    ((contDiff_referenceMetricOperator_joint g hg L).comp (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id))
    (fun a => contDiff_referenceMetricGramFrame_slice g hg L lam a) p

def referenceFrameAngularPolynomial (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (x X : R3) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  -polynomialMatrixVectorField (referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient g L lam x X) p

theorem referenceFrameAngularPolynomial_eq_half_smul (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (x X : R3)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    referenceFrameAngularPolynomial g L lam x X p =
      (1/2:ℝ) • polynomialRotationCombination (referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient g L lam x X) p := by
  unfold referenceFrameAngularPolynomial
  rw [polynomialMatrixVectorField_eq_neg_half_smul _
    (fun i j => referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient_skew g hg L lam x X i j)]
  simp

attribute [local irreducible] referenceMetricGramFrame referenceConnectionFamily
  metricOperatorField referenceMetric dilatedMetric

set_option diagnostics true in
theorem fderiv_referenceMovingFramePolynomial_horizontal (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (x v X : R3)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    fderiv ℝ (movingFramePolynomial
      (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L))
      (fun y => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y)) p) (x,v)
      (X,-referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,x) X v) =
    eval (fun i => movingFrameCoordinate
      (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L))
      (fun y => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y)) i (x,v))
      (-polynomialMatrixVectorField
        (frameConnectionCoefficient
          (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L))
          (fun y => referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,y))
          (fun y => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y)) x X) p) := by
  have hpair : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : R3 => (lam,y)) := contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id
  have hM : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L)) :=
    (contDiff_referenceMetricOperator_joint g hg L).comp hpair
  exact fderiv_movingFramePolynomial_horizontal _ _ _ hM
    (fun a => contDiff_referenceMetricGramFrame_slice g hg L lam a)
    (fun y U V => referenceMetricOperator_symmetric g hg L lam y U V)
    (fun y => referenceMetricGramFrame_isMetricOrthonormalFrame g hg L (lam,y))
    (fun y Y U V => referenceConnectionFamily_metric_compatible g hg L lam y Y U V) p x v X

theorem referenceFrameAngularPolynomial_harmonicHomogeneous (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (x X : R3)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hp : p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) :
    referenceFrameAngularPolynomial g L lam x X p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k := by
  rw [referenceFrameAngularPolynomial_eq_half_smul g hg L lam x X p]
  exact (harmonicHomogeneous k).smul_mem _
    (polynomialRotationCombination_harmonicHomogeneous k hk _ p hp)

theorem referenceFrameAngularPolynomial_eq_zero_of_isHomogeneous_zero
    (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ) (x X : R3)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hp : p.IsHomogeneous 0) :
    referenceFrameAngularPolynomial g L lam x X p = 0 := by
  simp only [referenceFrameAngularPolynomial, polynomialMatrixVectorField,
    CurvatureContraction.pderiv_eq_zero_of_isHomogeneous_zero p hp,
    mul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, neg_zero]

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.MovingFrameConnection

``````

## Calderon.HessianDegreeAssembly

SHA256 `b184cc63c447389f406b9f2e822c4b75373044e198a17dc1aac2e07b84f354e9`.

``````lean
import Calderon.HessianContraction

set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 10
noncomputable section
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.HessianDegreeAssembly
open RadiusProfile ConformalDepth MetricOperator AngularPolynomial CurvatureRotation
  HessianContraction SphereHarmonic MvPolynomial

lemma hessian_degree_contribution_lower_bound (k : ℝ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (θ c β F E T : ℝ) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) (hθ1 : θ ≤ 1)
    (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hβ : 0 ≤ β) (hF : 0 ≤ F)
    (hE : E ≤ -2*c*k^2*β*F) (hT : T ≤ -6*c*k*β) :
    4*c*k^3*β*F ≤
      -(2+2/(k+1/2))*((k+1/2-1+θ)*E+(1-θ)*k*T*F) := by
  let d := k+1/2
  let a := d-1+θ
  let b := 1-θ
  let A := 2+2/d
  have hd : 0 < d := by dsimp [d]; linarith
  have ha : 0 ≤ a := by dsimp [a,d]; linarith
  have hb : 0 ≤ b := by dsimp [b]; linarith
  have hk0 : 0 ≤ k := by linarith
  have hA : 2 ≤ A := by
    have hdiv : 0 ≤ 2/d := by positivity
    dsimp [A]; linarith
  have hw : k ≤ a+3*b := by dsimp [a,b,d]; linarith
  have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hE ha
  have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hT (by positivity : 0 ≤ b*k*F)
  have hs : a*E+b*k*T*F ≤ -(2*c*k^2*β*F)*(a+3*b) := by nlinarith only [h1,h2]
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs (by linarith : 0 ≤ A)
  change 4*c*k^3*β*F ≤ -A*(a*E+b*k*T*F)
  rw [neg_mul]
  calc
    4*c*k^3*β*F = 2*(2*c*k^2*β*F)*k := by ring
    _ ≤ A*(2*c*k^2*β*F)*(a+3*b) := by gcongr
    _ = -(A*(-(2*c*k^2*β*F)*(a+3*b))) := by ring
    _ ≤ -(A*(a*E+b*k*T*F)) := neg_le_neg hm

def referenceProfileHessianTrace (g : MatrixField) (lam δ R : ℝ) (p : ℕ)
    (L : ℝ) (x : R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3) (k : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  2*(k:ℝ)*∑ i : Fin 3, referenceProfileHessianBilinear g lam δ R p L x (e i) (e i)

def referenceHessianDegreeContribution (g : MatrixField) (lam δ R : ℝ) (p : ℕ)
    (L : ℝ) (x : R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3) (k : ℕ) (θ : ℝ)
    (v : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) : ℝ :=
  -(2+2/((k:ℝ)+1/2))*(((k:ℝ)+1/2-1+θ)*
    referenceProfileHessianContraction g lam δ R p L x e k v +
    (1-θ)*(k:ℝ)*referenceProfileHessianTrace g lam δ R p L x e k*fischerInner v v)

lemma referenceProfileHessianTrace_le (g : MatrixField) (K : Set R3)
    (L c0 c1 J1 J2 D : ℝ) (hbounds : referenceProfileBounds g K L c0 c1 J1 J2 D)
    (lam : ℝ) (hlam : lam ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (p : ℕ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (x : R3) (hx : x ∈ K)
    (e : Fin 3 → R3)
    (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x) e)
    (k : ℕ) :
    referenceProfileHessianTrace g lam δ R p L x e k ≤
      -6*c1*(k:ℝ)*referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x := by
  have hi (i : Fin 3) : referenceProfileHessianBilinear g lam δ R p L x (e i) (e i) ≤
      -(c1*referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x) := by
    have h := referenceProfileHessianBilinear_le g K L c0 c1 J1 J2 D hbounds
      lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp x hx (e i)
    simpa only [he i i, ite_true, mul_one] using h
  have hs := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i (_ : i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3))) => hi i)
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2*(k:ℝ))
  unfold referenceProfileHessianTrace
  convert hm using 1 <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_three] <;> ring

lemma referenceHessianDegreeContribution_ge (g : MatrixField) (K : Set R3)
    (L c0 c1 J1 J2 D : ℝ) (hc1 : 0 ≤ c1)
    (hbounds : referenceProfileBounds g K L c0 c1 J1 J2 D)
    (lam : ℝ) (hlam : lam ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (p : ℕ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (x : R3) (hx : x ∈ K)
    (e : Fin 3 → R3)
    (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x) e)
    (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 ≤ θ) (hθ1 : θ ≤ 1)
    (v : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hv : v.IsHomogeneous k) :
    4*c1*(k:ℝ)^3*referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x*fischerInner v v ≤
      referenceHessianDegreeContribution g lam δ R p L x e k θ v := by
  apply hessian_degree_contribution_lower_bound (k:ℝ) (by exact_mod_cast hk)
    θ c1 (referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x) (fischerInner v v)
    (referenceProfileHessianContraction g lam δ R p L x e k v)
    (referenceProfileHessianTrace g lam δ R p L x e k) hθ hθ1 hc1
  · unfold referenceProfileNorm metricDifferentialNorm
    exact Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  · exact fischerInner_self_nonneg v
  · exact referenceProfileHessianContraction_le g K L c0 c1 J1 J2 D hbounds
      lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp x hx e he k v hv
  · exact referenceProfileHessianTrace_le g K L c0 c1 J1 J2 D hbounds
      lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp x hx e he k

theorem exists_referenceHessianDegreeContribution_uniform_bound (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ L c : ℝ, 0 < L ∧ 0 < c ∧
      ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 → ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R →
      ∀ p : ℕ, 1 ≤ p → ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ e : Fin 3 → R3,
      IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x) e →
      ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 ≤ θ → θ ≤ 1 →
      ∀ v : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ, v.IsHomogeneous k →
      4*c*(k:ℝ)^3*referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x*fischerInner v v ≤
        referenceHessianDegreeContribution g lam δ R p L x e k θ v := by
  obtain ⟨L,c0,c1,J1,J2,D,hL,hc0,hc1,hJ1,hJ2,hD,hbounds⟩ := exists_referenceProfileBounds g hg K hK
  refine ⟨L,c1,hL,hc1,?_⟩
  intro lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp x hx e he k hk θ hθ hθ1 v hv
  exact referenceHessianDegreeContribution_ge g K L c0 c1 J1 J2 D hc1.le hbounds
    lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp x hx e he k hk θ hθ hθ1 v hv

theorem exists_referenceHessianDegreeContribution_uniform_normalized_bound
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ L c : ℝ, 0 < L ∧ 0 < c ∧ ∀ hF : SphereFischerInner,
      ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 → ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R →
      ∀ p : ℕ, 1 ≤ p → ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ e : Fin 3 → R3,
      IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x) e →
      ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → ∀ θ : ℝ, 0 ≤ θ → θ ≤ 1 →
      ∀ v : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ, v ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k →
      4*c*(k:ℝ)^3*referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x*‖polynomialSphereL2 v‖^2 ≤
        referenceHessianDegreeContribution g lam δ R p L x e k θ v / sphereNormalization 3 k := by
  obtain ⟨L,c,hL,hc,hbound⟩ := exists_referenceHessianDegreeContribution_uniform_bound g hg K hK
  refine ⟨L,c,hL,hc,?_⟩
  intro hF lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp x hx e he k hk θ hθ hθ1 v hv
  have h := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hbound lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp x hx e he k hk θ hθ hθ1 v hv.1)
    (sphereNormalization_pos (n:=3) (by norm_num : 0 < 3) k).le
  rw [polynomialSphereL2_norm_sq hF k v hv]
  unfold normalizedFischerSquare normalizedFischerInner
  simpa only [Fintype.card_fin,mul_div_assoc] using h

lemma curvature_error_absorption (c β C k F S : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) (hβ : 0 ≤ β)
    (hk : 0 ≤ k) (hF : 0 ≤ F) (hC : C ≤ c*β)
    (hS : 4*c*k^3*β*F ≤ S) : 3*c*k^3*β*F ≤ S-C*k^3*F := by
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hC (by positivity : 0 ≤ k^3*F)
  nlinarith only [h,hS]

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.HessianDegreeAssembly

``````

## Calderon.VaryingHorizontalCurvature

SHA256 `d99b0c5cabd7e83df75a3bb1e9412dbd6716d7f49182a9b2907413ee8a2b4200`.

``````lean
import Calderon.MovingFrameConnection

set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 10
noncomputable section
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.VaryingHorizontalCurvature
open RadiusProfile ConformalDepth MetricOperator CurvatureRotation CurvatureSkew
  HorizontalCurvature FrameCurvaturePolynomial SmoothMetricFrame MovingFrameConnection

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]

def varyingHorizontalVectorField (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (X : R3 → R3) : R3 × R3 → R3 × R3 := fun z => (X z.1,-Γ z.1 (X z.1) z.2)

def baseVectorFieldBracket (X Y : R3 → R3) : R3 → R3 :=
  fun x => fderiv ℝ Y x (X x) - fderiv ℝ X x (Y x)

lemma contDiff_varyingHorizontalVectorField (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (X : R3 → R3) (hΓ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Γ) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (varyingHorizontalVectorField Γ X) :=
  (hX.comp contDiff_fst).prodMk
    (((hΓ.comp contDiff_fst).clm_apply (hX.comp contDiff_fst)).clm_apply contDiff_snd).neg

lemma fderiv_varyingHorizontalVectorField_apply
    (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (X : R3 → R3)
    (hΓ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Γ) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X) (z a : R3 × R3) :
    fderiv ℝ (varyingHorizontalVectorField Γ X) z a =
      (fderiv ℝ X z.1 a.1,
        -((fderiv ℝ Γ z.1 a.1) (X z.1) z.2) -
          Γ z.1 (fderiv ℝ X z.1 a.1) z.2 - Γ z.1 (X z.1) a.2) := by
  have hg := (hΓ.differentiable (by simp) z.1).hasFDerivAt.comp z
    (hasFDerivAt_fst (p := z))
  have hx := (hX.differentiable (by simp) z.1).hasFDerivAt.comp z
    (hasFDerivAt_fst (p := z))
  have h := hx.prodMk ((hg.clm_apply hx).clm_apply (hasFDerivAt_snd (p := z))).neg
  change HasFDerivAt (varyingHorizontalVectorField Γ X) _ z at h
  rw [h.fderiv]
  change (fderiv ℝ X z.1 a.1,
    -(Γ z.1 (X z.1) a.2 +
      (Γ z.1 (fderiv ℝ X z.1 a.1) + (fderiv ℝ Γ z.1 a.1) (X z.1)) z.2)) = _
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply]
  congr 1
  abel

theorem varyingHorizontalVectorField_bracket
    (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (X Y : R3 → R3)
    (hΓ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Γ) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X) (hY : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Y)
    (z : R3 × R3) :
    fderiv ℝ (varyingHorizontalVectorField Γ Y) z (varyingHorizontalVectorField Γ X z) -
      fderiv ℝ (varyingHorizontalVectorField Γ X) z (varyingHorizontalVectorField Γ Y z) =
      varyingHorizontalVectorField Γ (baseVectorFieldBracket X Y) z +
        (0,-coordinateCurvatureAction Γ z.1 (X z.1) (Y z.1) z.2) := by
  rw [fderiv_varyingHorizontalVectorField_apply Γ Y hΓ hY,
    fderiv_varyingHorizontalVectorField_apply Γ X hΓ hX]
  simp only [varyingHorizontalVectorField, baseVectorFieldBracket,
    Prod.mk_sub_mk, Prod.mk_add_mk, add_zero, coordinateCurvatureAction_apply,
    map_neg, map_sub, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply]
  congr 1
  abel

theorem varyingHorizontalVectorField_covariant_commutator
    (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (X Y : R3 → R3)
    (hΓ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Γ) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X) (hY : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Y)
    (u : R3 × R3 → E) (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (z : R3 × R3) :
    vectorFieldDeriv (varyingHorizontalVectorField Γ X)
        (vectorFieldDeriv (varyingHorizontalVectorField Γ Y) u) z -
      vectorFieldDeriv (varyingHorizontalVectorField Γ Y)
        (vectorFieldDeriv (varyingHorizontalVectorField Γ X) u) z -
      vectorFieldDeriv (varyingHorizontalVectorField Γ (baseVectorFieldBracket X Y)) u z =
      fderiv ℝ u z (0,-coordinateCurvatureAction Γ z.1 (X z.1) (Y z.1) z.2) := by
  rw [vectorFieldDeriv_commutator _ _ u
    ((contDiff_varyingHorizontalVectorField Γ X hΓ hX).differentiable (by simp))
    ((contDiff_varyingHorizontalVectorField Γ Y hΓ hY).differentiable (by simp)) hu,
    varyingHorizontalVectorField_bracket Γ X Y hΓ hX hY, map_add]
  simp only [vectorFieldDeriv]
  abel

lemma fderiv_movingFramePolynomial_vertical (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3) (hM : ContDiff ℝ ∞ M)
    (hE : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => e y i))
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (x v w : R3) :
    fderiv ℝ (movingFramePolynomial M e p) (x,v) (0,w) =
      fderiv ℝ (metricFramePolynomial (M x) (e x) p) v w := by
  rw [fderiv_movingFramePolynomial_apply M e hM hE, fderiv_metricFramePolynomial_apply]
  simp only [fderiv_movingFrameCoordinate_apply M e hM hE,
    map_zero, zero_add, inner_zero_right, add_zero, movingFrameCoordinate,
    metricFrameCoordinates_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply]
  have hc : (fun j => ⟪M x v,e x j⟫_ℝ) = metricFrameCoordinates (M x) (e x) v := by
    funext j
    exact (metricFrameCoordinates_apply (M x) (e x) v j).symm
  simp only [hc,zero_add]

attribute [local irreducible] referenceMetricGramFrame referenceConnectionFamily
  metricOperatorField referenceMetric dilatedMetric

theorem reference_varyingHorizontalVectorField_covariant_commutator
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (X Y : R3 → R3) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X) (hY : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Y)
    (u : R3 × R3 → E) (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (z : R3 × R3) :
    vectorFieldDeriv (varyingHorizontalVectorField (fun y => referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,y)) X)
      (vectorFieldDeriv (varyingHorizontalVectorField (fun y => referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,y)) Y) u) z -
    vectorFieldDeriv (varyingHorizontalVectorField (fun y => referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,y)) Y)
      (vectorFieldDeriv (varyingHorizontalVectorField (fun y => referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,y)) X) u) z -
    vectorFieldDeriv (varyingHorizontalVectorField (fun y => referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,y))
      (baseVectorFieldBracket X Y)) u z =
      fderiv ℝ u z (0,-referenceCurvatureAction g L lam z.1 (X z.1) (Y z.1) z.2) := by
  have hpair : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : R3 => (lam,y)) := contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id
  exact varyingHorizontalVectorField_covariant_commutator _ X Y
    ((contDiff_referenceConnectionFamily g hg L).comp hpair) hX hY u hu z

theorem fderiv_referenceMovingFramePolynomial_vertical_curvature
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (x v : R3) (a b : Fin 3) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    fderiv ℝ (referenceMovingFramePolynomial g L lam p) (x,v)
      (0,-referenceCurvatureAction g L lam x
        (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) a) (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) b) v) =
      MvPolynomial.eval (metricFrameCoordinates
        (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x)
        (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x)) v)
        (referenceHorizontalCurvaturePolynomial g L lam x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x)) a b p) := by
  have hpair : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : R3 => (lam,y)) := contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id
  have hM : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L)) :=
    (contDiff_referenceMetricOperator_joint g hg L).comp hpair
  unfold referenceMovingFramePolynomial
  rw [fderiv_movingFramePolynomial_vertical _ _ hM
    (fun i => contDiff_referenceMetricGramFrame_slice g hg L lam i), map_neg]
  rw [fderiv_metricFramePolynomial_operator_apply _ _ _
    (referenceMetricGramFrame_isMetricOrthonormalFrame g hg L (lam,x))]
  simp only [referenceHorizontalCurvaturePolynomial, referenceCurvatureVectorFieldPolynomial,
    referenceCurvatureRotationCoefficient, map_neg]
  rfl

theorem reference_movingFrame_covariant_polynomial_commutator
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (a b : Fin 3) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (x v : R3) :
    vectorFieldDeriv
      (varyingHorizontalVectorField (fun y => referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,y))
        (fun y => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y) a))
      (vectorFieldDeriv
        (varyingHorizontalVectorField (fun y => referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,y))
          (fun y => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y) b))
        (referenceMovingFramePolynomial g L lam p)) (x,v) -
    vectorFieldDeriv
      (varyingHorizontalVectorField (fun y => referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,y))
        (fun y => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y) b))
      (vectorFieldDeriv
        (varyingHorizontalVectorField (fun y => referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,y))
          (fun y => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y) a))
        (referenceMovingFramePolynomial g L lam p)) (x,v) -
    vectorFieldDeriv
      (varyingHorizontalVectorField (fun y => referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,y))
        (baseVectorFieldBracket (fun y => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y) a)
          (fun y => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y) b)))
      (referenceMovingFramePolynomial g L lam p) (x,v) =
    MvPolynomial.eval (metricFrameCoordinates
      (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x)
      (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x)) v)
      (referenceHorizontalCurvaturePolynomial g L lam x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x)) a b p) := by
  rw [reference_varyingHorizontalVectorField_covariant_commutator g hg L lam _ _
    (contDiff_referenceMetricGramFrame_slice g hg L lam a)
    (contDiff_referenceMetricGramFrame_slice g hg L lam b)
    (referenceMovingFramePolynomial g L lam p) (contDiff_referenceMovingFramePolynomial g hg L lam p)]
  exact fderiv_referenceMovingFramePolynomial_vertical_curvature g hg L lam x v a b p

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.VaryingHorizontalCurvature

``````

## Calderon.FischerConnectionTransport

``````lean
import Calderon.MovingFrameConnection
import Calderon.AngularBaseFinite

set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 10
noncomputable section
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.FischerConnectionTransport
open RadiusProfile ConformalDepth MetricOperator AngularPolynomial SphereHarmonic PrincipalCommutator
  CurvatureSkew MovingFrameConnection SmoothMetricFrame FrameCurvaturePolynomial MvPolynomial

lemma fischerInner_rotationCombination_skew (c : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (p q : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    fischerInner (polynomialRotationCombination c p) q =
      -fischerInner p (polynomialRotationCombination c q) := by
  simp only [polynomialRotationCombination, fischerInner_finset_sum_left,
    fischerInner_sum_right, fischerInner_C_mul_left, fischerInner_C_mul_right,
    fischerInner_rotation_skew, mul_neg, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]

lemma referenceFrameAngularPolynomial_fischer_skew (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (x X : R3)
    (p q : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    fischerInner (referenceFrameAngularPolynomial g L lam x X p) q =
      -fischerInner p (referenceFrameAngularPolynomial g L lam x X q) := by
  rw [referenceFrameAngularPolynomial_eq_half_smul g hg L lam x X p,
    referenceFrameAngularPolynomial_eq_half_smul g hg L lam x X q]
  simp only [smul_eq_C_mul,fischerInner_C_mul_left,fischerInner_C_mul_right,
    fischerInner_rotationCombination_skew,mul_neg]

lemma polynomialMatrixVectorField_add (c : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (p q : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    polynomialMatrixVectorField c (p+q) = polynomialMatrixVectorField c p + polynomialMatrixVectorField c q := by
  simp only [polynomialMatrixVectorField,map_add,mul_add,Finset.sum_add_distrib]

lemma polynomialMatrixVectorField_smul (c : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (a : ℝ) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    polynomialMatrixVectorField c (a • p) = a • polynomialMatrixVectorField c p := by
  simp only [polynomialMatrixVectorField,smul_eq_C_mul,pderiv_C_mul]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  ring

lemma referenceFrameAngularPolynomial_add (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ) (x X : R3)
    (p q : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    referenceFrameAngularPolynomial g L lam x X (p+q) =
      referenceFrameAngularPolynomial g L lam x X p + referenceFrameAngularPolynomial g L lam x X q := by
  simp only [referenceFrameAngularPolynomial,polynomialMatrixVectorField_add,neg_add]

lemma referenceFrameAngularPolynomial_smul (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ) (x X : R3)
    (a : ℝ) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    referenceFrameAngularPolynomial g L lam x X (a • p) =
      a • referenceFrameAngularPolynomial g L lam x X p := by
  simp only [referenceFrameAngularPolynomial,polynomialMatrixVectorField_smul,smul_neg]

variable {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]

def finitePolynomialField (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (x : R3) : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ := ∑ i, c x i • b i

def finitePolynomialFieldDerivative (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (x X : R3) : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  ∑ i, (fderiv ℝ c x X) i • b i

lemma fischerInner_finitePolynomialField (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (d : κ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (z : R3 → κ → ℝ) (x : R3) :
    fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField d z x) =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, c x i * z x j * fischerInner (b i) (d j) := by
  simp only [finitePolynomialField,fischerInner_finset_sum_left,fischerInner_sum_right,
    smul_eq_C_mul,fischerInner_C_mul_left,fischerInner_C_mul_right,Finset.mul_sum,mul_assoc]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  ring

def polynomialFamilyFischerBilinear (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (d : κ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) : (ι → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (κ → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  ∑ i, ∑ j, fischerInner (b i) (d j) •
    (ContinuousLinearMap.proj i).smulRight (ContinuousLinearMap.proj j)

lemma polynomialFamilyFischerBilinear_apply (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (d : κ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : ι → ℝ) (z : κ → ℝ) :
    polynomialFamilyFischerBilinear b d c z =
      ∑ i, ∑ j, c i * z j * fischerInner (b i) (d j) := by
  simp only [polynomialFamilyFischerBilinear,ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply,smul_eq_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  ring

lemma fderiv_fischerInner_finitePolynomialField (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (d : κ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (z : R3 → κ → ℝ)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hz : ContDiff ℝ ∞ z) (x X : R3) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun y => fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c y) (finitePolynomialField d z y)) x X =
      fischerInner (finitePolynomialFieldDerivative b c x X) (finitePolynomialField d z x) +
      fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialFieldDerivative d z x X) := by
  let B := polynomialFamilyFischerBilinear b d
  have hpair : (fun y => fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c y) (finitePolynomialField d z y)) =
      fun y => B (c y) (z y) := by
    funext y
    rw [fischerInner_finitePolynomialField]
    exact (polynomialFamilyFischerBilinear_apply b d (c y) (z y)).symm
  have hp := ((B.hasFDerivAt.comp x ((hc.differentiable (by simp) x).hasFDerivAt)).clm_apply
    ((hz.differentiable (by simp) x).hasFDerivAt))
  change HasFDerivAt (fun y => B (c y) (z y)) _ x at hp
  rw [hpair,hp.fderiv]
  change B (c x) (fderiv ℝ z x X) + B (fderiv ℝ c x X) (z x) = _
  change B (c x) (fderiv ℝ z x X) + B (fderiv ℝ c x X) (z x) =
    fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b (fun _ => fderiv ℝ c x X) x) (finitePolynomialField d z x) +
    fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField d (fun _ => fderiv ℝ z x X) x)
  simp only [B,polynomialFamilyFischerBilinear_apply,fischerInner_finitePolynomialField]
  exact add_comm _ _

def referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (x X : R3) :
    MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  finitePolynomialFieldDerivative b c x X +
    referenceFrameAngularPolynomial g L lam x X (finitePolynomialField b c x)

lemma referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_fischer_compatible (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (d : κ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (z : R3 → κ → ℝ)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hz : ContDiff ℝ ∞ z) (x X : R3) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun y => fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c y) (finitePolynomialField d z y)) x X =
      fischerInner (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x X) (finitePolynomialField d z x) +
      fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam d z x X) := by
  rw [fderiv_fischerInner_finitePolynomialField b d c z hc hz x X]
  simp only [referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative,fischerInner_add_left,fischerInner_add_right]
  rw [referenceFrameAngularPolynomial_fischer_skew g hg L lam x X]
  ring

def referenceAngularPolynomialLinearMap (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ) (x X : R3) :
    MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ where
  toFun := referenceFrameAngularPolynomial g L lam x X
  map_add' := referenceFrameAngularPolynomial_add g L lam x X
  map_smul' := referenceFrameAngularPolynomial_smul g L lam x X

lemma referenceFrameAngularPolynomial_sum (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ) (x X : R3)
    (p : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    referenceFrameAngularPolynomial g L lam x X (∑ i, p i) =
      ∑ i, referenceFrameAngularPolynomial g L lam x X (p i) :=
  map_sum (referenceAngularPolynomialLinearMap g L lam x X) p Finset.univ

lemma finitePolynomialField_harmonicHomogeneous (k : ℕ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hb : ∀ i, b i ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (x : R3) : finitePolynomialField b c x ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k :=
  (harmonicHomogeneous k).sum_mem (fun i _ => (harmonicHomogeneous k).smul_mem _ (hb i))

lemma finitePolynomialFieldDerivative_harmonicHomogeneous (k : ℕ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hb : ∀ i, b i ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (x X : R3) :
    finitePolynomialFieldDerivative b c x X ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k :=
  (harmonicHomogeneous k).sum_mem (fun i _ => (harmonicHomogeneous k).smul_mem _ (hb i))

lemma referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_harmonicHomogeneous (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hb : ∀ i, b i ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (x X : R3) :
    referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x X ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k :=
  (harmonicHomogeneous k).add_mem (finitePolynomialFieldDerivative_harmonicHomogeneous k b hb c x X)
    (referenceFrameAngularPolynomial_harmonicHomogeneous g hg L lam x X k hk _
      (finitePolynomialField_harmonicHomogeneous k b hb c x))

def evaluatedReferencePolynomialField (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (z : R3 × R3) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i, c z.1 i * referenceMovingFramePolynomial g L lam (b i) z

lemma evaluatedReferencePolynomialField_eq (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (z : R3 × R3) :
    evaluatedReferencePolynomialField g L lam b c z =
      referenceMovingFramePolynomial g L lam (finitePolynomialField b c z.1) z := by
  simp only [evaluatedReferencePolynomialField,referenceMovingFramePolynomial,
    movingFramePolynomial,finitePolynomialField,map_sum,smul_eq_C_mul,map_mul,eval_C]

lemma contDiff_referencePolynomialFieldSummand (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (i : ι) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : R3 × R3 => c z.1 i * referenceMovingFramePolynomial g L lam p z) :=
  ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj i : (ι → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp (hc.comp contDiff_fst)).mul
    (contDiff_referenceMovingFramePolynomial g hg L lam p)

lemma contDiff_evaluatedReferencePolynomialField (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (evaluatedReferencePolynomialField g L lam b c) :=
  ContDiff.sum (fun i _ => contDiff_referencePolynomialFieldSummand g hg L lam (b i) c hc i)

attribute [local irreducible] referenceMetricGramFrame referenceConnectionFamily
  metricOperatorField referenceMetric dilatedMetric

lemma fderiv_referencePolynomialFieldSummand_horizontal (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (i : ι) (x v X : R3) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun z : R3 × R3 => c z.1 i * referenceMovingFramePolynomial g L lam p z)
      (x,v) (X,-referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,x) X v) =
    (fderiv ℝ c x X) i * referenceMovingFramePolynomial g L lam p (x,v) +
      c x i * referenceMovingFramePolynomial g L lam
        (referenceFrameAngularPolynomial g L lam x X p) (x,v) := by
  have hbase : HasFDerivAt (fun z : R3 × R3 => c z.1)
      ((fderiv ℝ c x).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ R3 R3)) (x,v) :=
    ((hc.differentiable (by simp) x).hasFDerivAt).comp (x,v)
      (hasFDerivAt_fst (p := (x,v)))
  have hcoef := (ContinuousLinearMap.proj i : (ι → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt.comp (x,v) hbase
  have hpoly := ((contDiff_referenceMovingFramePolynomial g hg L lam p).differentiable
    (by simp) (x,v)).hasFDerivAt
  have hp := hcoef.mul hpoly
  change HasFDerivAt (fun z : R3 × R3 => c z.1 i * referenceMovingFramePolynomial g L lam p z) _ (x,v) at hp
  rw [hp.fderiv]
  change c x i * (fderiv ℝ (referenceMovingFramePolynomial g L lam p) (x,v)
    (X,-referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,x) X v)) +
    referenceMovingFramePolynomial g L lam p (x,v) * (fderiv ℝ c x X) i = _
  have hd := fderiv_referenceMovingFramePolynomial_horizontal g hg L lam x v X p
  change fderiv ℝ (referenceMovingFramePolynomial g L lam p) (x,v)
    (X,-referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,x) X v) =
    referenceMovingFramePolynomial g L lam (referenceFrameAngularPolynomial g L lam x X p) (x,v) at hd
  rw [hd]
  ring

theorem fderiv_evaluatedReferencePolynomialField_horizontal (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (x v X : R3) :
    fderiv ℝ (evaluatedReferencePolynomialField g L lam b c) (x,v)
      (X,-referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,x) X v) =
      referenceMovingFramePolynomial g L lam
        (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x X) (x,v) := by
  rw [show evaluatedReferencePolynomialField g L lam b c =
    (fun z : R3 × R3 => ∑ i, c z.1 i * referenceMovingFramePolynomial g L lam (b i) z) from rfl]
  rw [fderiv_fun_sum (fun i _ =>
    ((contDiff_referencePolynomialFieldSummand g hg L lam (b i) c hc i).differentiable
      (by simp) (x,v)))]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
  simp_rw [fderiv_referencePolynomialFieldSummand_horizontal g hg L lam _ c hc _ x v X]
  simp only [referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative,finitePolynomialFieldDerivative,
    finitePolynomialField,referenceFrameAngularPolynomial_sum,referenceFrameAngularPolynomial_smul]
  simp only [referenceMovingFramePolynomial,movingFramePolynomial,map_add,map_sum,
    smul_eq_C_mul,map_mul,eval_C,Finset.sum_add_distrib]

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.FischerConnectionTransport

``````
