## Calderon.IndexedCovariantCurvature

SHA256 `264f23a53992a21d8d5bb614be880761f2de9518602c43ee02db23a48cf22c6f`.

``````lean
import Calderon.VaryingHorizontalCurvature

set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 10
noncomputable section
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.IndexedCovariantCurvature
open RadiusProfile ConformalDepth MetricOperator ConnectionError CurvatureRotation CurvatureSkew
  HorizontalCurvature FrameCurvaturePolynomial SmoothMetricFrame MovingFrameConnection
  VaryingHorizontalCurvature

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]

attribute [local irreducible] referenceMetricGramFrame referenceConnectionFamily
  metricOperatorField referenceMetric dilatedMetric

theorem referenceConnectionFamily_symmetric (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (x X Y : R3) :
    referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,x) X Y = referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,x) Y X := by
  have hpair : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : R3 => (lam,y)) := contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id
  have hM : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L)) :=
    (contDiff_referenceMetricOperator_joint g hg L).comp hpair
  have hs : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, ∀ U V : R3,
      ⟪metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) y U,V⟫_ℝ =
        ⟪metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) y V,U⟫_ℝ :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y U V => referenceMetricOperator_symmetric g hg L lam y U V)
  simp only [referenceConnectionFamily,coordinateConnectionField_apply]
  apply coordinateConnection_symmetric
  intro U V W
  exact inverse_metric_derivative_symmetric _ _ x
    ((hM.differentiable (by simp) x).hasFDerivAt) hs U V W

theorem frame_baseVectorFieldBracket_eq_sum
    (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3) (x : R3) (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (M x) (e x))
    (hsym : ∀ X Y, Γ x X Y = Γ x Y X) (a b : Fin 3) :
    baseVectorFieldBracket (fun y => e y a) (fun y => e y b) x =
      ∑ l : Fin 3, (frameConnectionCoefficient M Γ e x (e x a) l b -
        frameConnectionCoefficient M Γ e x (e x b) l a) • e x l := by
  have h1 := covariantFrameDerivative_eq_sum M Γ e x (e x a) he b
  have h2 := covariantFrameDerivative_eq_sum M Γ e x (e x b) he a
  have hdiff := congrArg₂ (fun U V : R3 => U-V) h1 h2
  simp only [covariantFrameDerivative, hsym (e x a) (e x b)] at hdiff
  simp only [sub_smul,Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  rw [← hdiff]
  simp only [baseVectorFieldBracket]
  abel

def horizontalLiftAt (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (x v : R3) :
    R3 →L[ℝ] R3 × R3 :=
  (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ R3).prod (-((Γ x).flip v))

lemma horizontalLiftAt_apply (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (x v X : R3) :
    horizontalLiftAt Γ x v X = (X,-Γ x X v) := rfl

theorem frame_bracket_horizontal_derivative_eq_sum
    (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3) (x v : R3) (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (M x) (e x))
    (hsym : ∀ X Y, Γ x X Y = Γ x Y X) (u : R3 × R3 → E) (a b : Fin 3) :
    vectorFieldDeriv (varyingHorizontalVectorField Γ
      (baseVectorFieldBracket (fun y => e y a) (fun y => e y b))) u (x,v) =
      ∑ l : Fin 3, (frameConnectionCoefficient M Γ e x (e x a) l b -
        frameConnectionCoefficient M Γ e x (e x b) l a) •
          vectorFieldDeriv (varyingHorizontalVectorField Γ (fun y => e y l)) u (x,v) := by
  change fderiv ℝ u (x,v) (horizontalLiftAt Γ x v
    (baseVectorFieldBracket (fun y => e y a) (fun y => e y b) x)) = _
  rw [frame_baseVectorFieldBracket_eq_sum M Γ e x he hsym a b]
  simp only [map_sum,map_smul,horizontalLiftAt_apply,vectorFieldDeriv,varyingHorizontalVectorField]

def indexedCovariantHessian (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3)
    (u : R3 × R3 → E) (a b : Fin 3) (z : R3 × R3) : E :=
  vectorFieldDeriv (varyingHorizontalVectorField Γ (fun y => e y a))
    (vectorFieldDeriv (varyingHorizontalVectorField Γ (fun y => e y b)) u) z -
      ∑ l : Fin 3, frameConnectionCoefficient M Γ e z.1 (e z.1 a) l b •
        vectorFieldDeriv (varyingHorizontalVectorField Γ (fun y => e y l)) u z

theorem indexedCovariantHessian_antisymm
    (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3) (hΓ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Γ)
    (hE : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => e y i)) (x v : R3)
    (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (M x) (e x))
    (hsym : ∀ X Y, Γ x X Y = Γ x Y X)
    (u : R3 × R3 → E) (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (a b : Fin 3) :
    indexedCovariantHessian M Γ e u a b (x,v) - indexedCovariantHessian M Γ e u b a (x,v) =
      fderiv ℝ u (x,v) (0,-coordinateCurvatureAction Γ x (e x a) (e x b) v) := by
  have h := varyingHorizontalVectorField_covariant_commutator Γ
    (fun y => e y a) (fun y => e y b) hΓ (hE a) (hE b) u hu (x,v)
  rw [frame_bracket_horizontal_derivative_eq_sum M Γ e x v he hsym u a b] at h
  simp only [sub_smul,Finset.sum_sub_distrib] at h
  simp only [indexedCovariantHessian]
  exact (by abel : _ = _) |>.trans h


def referenceIndexedCovariantHessian (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (u : R3 × R3 → E) (a b : Fin 3) : R3 × R3 → E :=
  indexedCovariantHessian (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L))
    (fun y => referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,y))
    (fun y => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y)) u a b

theorem referenceIndexedCovariantHessian_antisymm (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (u : R3 × R3 → E) (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (x v : R3) (a b : Fin 3) :
    referenceIndexedCovariantHessian g L lam u a b (x,v) -
      referenceIndexedCovariantHessian g L lam u b a (x,v) =
        fderiv ℝ u (x,v) (0,-referenceCurvatureAction g L lam x
          (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) a) (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) b) v) := by
  have hpair : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : R3 => (lam,y)) := contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id
  exact indexedCovariantHessian_antisymm _ _ _
    ((contDiff_referenceConnectionFamily g hg L).comp hpair)
    (fun i => contDiff_referenceMetricGramFrame_slice g hg L lam i) x v
    (referenceMetricGramFrame_isMetricOrthonormalFrame g hg L (lam,x))
    (fun X Y => referenceConnectionFamily_symmetric g hg L lam x X Y) u hu a b

theorem referenceIndexedCovariantHessian_polynomial_antisymm (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (x v : R3) (a b : Fin 3) :
    referenceIndexedCovariantHessian g L lam (referenceMovingFramePolynomial g L lam p) a b (x,v) -
      referenceIndexedCovariantHessian g L lam (referenceMovingFramePolynomial g L lam p) b a (x,v) =
        referenceMovingFramePolynomial g L lam
          (referenceHorizontalCurvaturePolynomial g L lam x
            (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x)) a b p) (x,v) := by
  rw [referenceIndexedCovariantHessian_antisymm g hg L lam _
    (contDiff_referenceMovingFramePolynomial g hg L lam p) x v a b]
  have h := fderiv_referenceMovingFramePolynomial_vertical_curvature g hg L lam x v a b p
  have hc : (fun i => movingFrameCoordinate
      (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L))
      (fun y => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y)) i (x,v)) =
      metricFrameCoordinates (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x)
        (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x)) v := by
    funext i
    exact (metricFrameCoordinates_apply _ _ _ i).symm
  simpa only [referenceMovingFramePolynomial,movingFramePolynomial,hc] using h

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.IndexedCovariantCurvature
``````

## Calderon.FischerDensityIntegration

SHA256 `07ae5d53d69cc70705d392ecdacc8834c78badc2372facb2d7abcd7322d946d6`.

``````lean
import Calderon.FischerConnectionTransport
import Calderon.BaseDensityAdjoint
import Calderon.ReferenceDensityBounds

set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 10
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.FischerDensityIntegration
open RadiusProfile ConformalDepth MetricOperator AngularPolynomial SphereHarmonic
  FischerConnectionTransport BaseDensityAdjoint SmoothMetricFrame ReferenceDensityBounds

def weightedCoordinateDivergence (rho : R3 → ℝ) (X : R3 → R3) (x : R3) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i : Fin 3, directionalDeriv (coordinateDirection i) (fun y => rho y * (X y) i) x

lemma contDiff_vectorComponent (X : R3 → R3) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X) (i : Fin 3) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => (X x) i) :=
  (PiLp.proj 2 (fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ) i : R3 →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp hX

lemma vector_eq_sum_coordinateDirection (v : R3) :
    v = ∑ i : Fin 3, v i • coordinateDirection i := by
  simpa only [coordinateDirection,PiLp.basisFun_apply,PiLp.basisFun_repr] using
    ((PiLp.basisFun 2 ℝ (Fin 3)).sum_repr v).symm

lemma directionalDeriv_variable_eq_sum (P : R3 → ℝ) (X : R3 → R3) (x : R3) :
    fderiv ℝ P x (X x) = ∑ i : Fin 3, (X x) i * directionalDeriv (coordinateDirection i) P x := by
  conv_lhs => rw [vector_eq_sum_coordinateDirection (X x)]
  simp only [map_sum,map_smul,smul_eq_mul,directionalDeriv]

theorem compact_weighted_scalar_variable_adjoint (rho P : R3 → ℝ) (X : R3 → R3)
    (hr : ContDiff ℝ ∞ rho) (hP : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X)
    (hcompact : HasCompactSupport P) :
    (∫ x : R3, rho x * fderiv ℝ P x (X x)) =
      -(∫ x : R3, weightedCoordinateDivergence rho X x * P x) := by
  have hi : ∀ i : Fin 3, Integrable (fun x => rho x * (X x) i *
      directionalDeriv (coordinateDirection i) P x) := by
    intro i
    exact ((hr.continuous.mul (contDiff_vectorComponent X hX i).continuous).mul
      (contDiff_directionalDeriv _ P hP).continuous).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
        (hasCompactSupport_directionalDeriv _ P hcompact).mul_left
  have hj : ∀ i : Fin 3, Integrable (fun x =>
      directionalDeriv (coordinateDirection i) (fun y => rho y * (X y) i) x * P x) := by
    intro i
    exact ((contDiff_directionalDeriv _ _ (hr.mul (contDiff_vectorComponent X hX i))).continuous.mul
      hP.continuous).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hcompact.mul_left
  have he : (fun x => rho x * fderiv ℝ P x (X x)) =
      fun x => ∑ i : Fin 3, rho x * (X x) i * directionalDeriv (coordinateDirection i) P x := by
    funext x
    rw [directionalDeriv_variable_eq_sum,Finset.mul_sum]
    simp only [mul_assoc]
  have hf : (fun x => weightedCoordinateDivergence rho X x * P x) =
      fun x => ∑ i : Fin 3,
        directionalDeriv (coordinateDirection i) (fun y => rho y * (X y) i) x * P x := by
    funext x
    simp only [weightedCoordinateDivergence,Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [he,hf,integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => hi i),integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => hj i),
    ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  have h := compact_weighted_first_adjoint (coordinateDirection i) rho (fun y => (X y) i)
    P (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) hr (contDiff_vectorComponent X hX i) hP contDiff_const hcompact
  simpa only [Real.inner_apply,mul_one,smul_eq_mul] using h

variable {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]

lemma contDiff_fischerPair (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (d : κ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (z : R3 → κ → ℝ)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hz : ContDiff ℝ ∞ z) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField d z x)) := by
  have h : (fun x => fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField d z x)) =
      fun x => polynomialFamilyFischerBilinear b d (c x) (z x) := by
    funext x
    rw [fischerInner_finitePolynomialField,polynomialFamilyFischerBilinear_apply]
  rw [h]
  exact ((polynomialFamilyFischerBilinear b d).contDiff.comp hc).clm_apply hz

lemma hasCompactSupport_fischerPair (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (d : κ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (z : R3 → κ → ℝ)
    (hc : HasCompactSupport c) :
    HasCompactSupport (fun x => fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField d z x)) := by
  apply hc.mono
  intro x hx
  simp only [Function.mem_support] at hx ⊢
  contrapose! hx
  simp only [fischerInner_finitePolynomialField,hx,Pi.zero_apply,zero_mul,Finset.sum_const_zero]

theorem compact_reference_fischer_covariant_contraction (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (rho : R3 → ℝ) (hr : ContDiff ℝ ∞ rho)
    (X : R3 → R3) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (d : κ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (z : R3 → κ → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hz : ContDiff ℝ ∞ z)
    (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c) :
    (∫ x : R3, rho x *
      (fischerInner (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x (X x)) (finitePolynomialField d z x) +
        fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam d z x (X x)))) =
      -(∫ x : R3, weightedCoordinateDivergence rho X x *
        fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField d z x)) := by
  have h := compact_weighted_scalar_variable_adjoint rho
    (fun x => fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField d z x)) X hr
    (contDiff_fischerPair b d c z hc hz) hX (hasCompactSupport_fischerPair b d c z hcompact)
  simpa only [referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_fischer_compatible g hg L lam b d c z hc hz] using h

theorem compact_reference_metric_fischer_covariant_contraction (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (X : R3 → R3) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (d : κ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (z : R3 → κ → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hz : ContDiff ℝ ∞ z)
    (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c) :
    (∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      (fischerInner (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x (X x)) (finitePolynomialField d z x) +
        fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam d z x (X x)))) =
      -(∫ x : R3, weightedCoordinateDivergence (fun y => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,y)) X x *
        fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField d z x)) := by
  exact compact_reference_fischer_covariant_contraction g hg L lam _
    ((contDiff_referenceDensityFamily g hg L).comp (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id))
    X hX b d c z hc hz hcompact

theorem compact_reference_frame_fischer_covariant_contraction (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (a : Fin 3)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (d : κ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (z : R3 → κ → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hz : ContDiff ℝ ∞ z)
    (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c) :
    (∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      (fischerInner (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) a))
          (finitePolynomialField d z x) +
        fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x)
          (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam d z x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) a)))) =
      -(∫ x : R3, weightedCoordinateDivergence (fun y => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,y))
        (fun y => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y) a) x *
          fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField d z x)) :=
  compact_reference_metric_fischer_covariant_contraction g hg L lam _
    (contDiff_referenceMetricGramFrame_slice g hg L lam a) b d c z hc hz hcompact

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.FischerDensityIntegration

``````

## Calderon.OrthogonalSphereMeasure

SHA256 `771bcc02d086aaf5c6d649d1b6857d6bb0168d49647e9a95a6c73d2340297f10`.

``````lean
import Calderon.SphereHarmonicBridge
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.Haar.InnerProductSpace

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped Pointwise
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.OrthogonalSphereMeasure
open SphereHarmonic

def orthogonalSphereHomeomorph (T : R3 ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] R3) : UnitSphere ≃ₜ UnitSphere where
  toFun u := ⟨T u, by simpa only [Metric.mem_sphere,dist_zero_right,T.norm_map] using u.property⟩
  invFun u := ⟨T.symm u, by simpa only [Metric.mem_sphere,dist_zero_right,T.symm.norm_map] using u.property⟩
  left_inv u := by apply Subtype.ext; exact T.symm_apply_apply u
  right_inv u := by apply Subtype.ext; exact T.apply_symm_apply u
  continuous_toFun := (T.continuous.comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk _
  continuous_invFun := (T.symm.continuous.comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk _

lemma orthogonalSphereHomeomorph_apply_val (T : R3 ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] R3) (u : UnitSphere) :
    (orthogonalSphereHomeomorph T u).val = T u.val := rfl

lemma orthogonalSphereHomeomorph_symm_apply_val (T : R3 ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] R3) (u : UnitSphere) :
    ((orthogonalSphereHomeomorph T).symm u).val = T.symm u.val := rfl

theorem orthogonal_unitCone_preimage (T : R3 ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] R3) (s : Set UnitSphere) :
    T ⁻¹' (Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 • (Subtype.val '' s)) =
      Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 • (Subtype.val '' (orthogonalSphereHomeomorph T ⁻¹' s)) := by
  ext v
  constructor
  · intro hv
    rcases hv with ⟨r,hr,w,⟨u,hu,huw⟩,he⟩
    subst w
    refine ⟨r,hr,T.symm u.val,?_,?_⟩
    · refine ⟨(orthogonalSphereHomeomorph T).symm u,?_,rfl⟩
      simpa only [mem_preimage,(orthogonalSphereHomeomorph T).apply_symm_apply] using hu
    · have h := congrArg T.symm he
      simpa only [T.symm.map_smul,T.symm_apply_apply] using h
  · intro hv
    rcases hv with ⟨r,hr,w,⟨u,hu,huw⟩,he⟩
    subst w
    refine ⟨r,hr,T u.val,⟨orthogonalSphereHomeomorph T u,hu,rfl⟩,?_⟩
    have h := congrArg T he
    simpa only [T.map_smul] using h

theorem orthogonalSphereHomeomorph_surfaceMeasure_preserving (T : R3 ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] R3) :
    MeasurePreserving (orthogonalSphereHomeomorph T) surfaceMeasure surfaceMeasure := by
  refine ⟨(orthogonalSphereHomeomorph T).measurable,?_⟩
  apply Measure.ext
  intro s hs
  rw [Measure.map_apply (orthogonalSphereHomeomorph T).measurable hs]
  change (volume : Measure R3).toSphere (orthogonalSphereHomeomorph T ⁻¹' s) =
    (volume : Measure R3).toSphere s
  rw [Measure.toSphere_apply' _ ((orthogonalSphereHomeomorph T).measurable hs),
    Measure.toSphere_apply' _ hs,← orthogonal_unitCone_preimage T s]
  rw [T.measurePreserving.measure_preimage_emb T.toHomeomorph.measurableEmbedding]

theorem orthogonalSphereHomeomorph_sphereProbability_preserving (T : R3 ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] R3) :
    MeasurePreserving (orthogonalSphereHomeomorph T) sphereProbability sphereProbability := by
  refine ⟨(orthogonalSphereHomeomorph T).measurable,?_⟩
  rw [sphereProbability,Measure.map_smul,
    (orthogonalSphereHomeomorph_surfaceMeasure_preserving T).map_eq]
  exact (orthogonalSphereHomeomorph T).measurable.aemeasurable

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.OrthogonalSphereMeasure

``````

## Calderon.MetricFiberMeasure

SHA256 `dc811b5cd601112fae551ce31cca925c059fc4a3b6f192bc9302d5f0a19ee0c9`.

``````lean
import Calderon.OrthogonalSphereMeasure
import Calderon.SmoothMetricFrame
import Calderon.FrameCurvaturePolynomial

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped InnerProductSpace
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.MetricFiberMeasure
open RadiusProfile ConformalDepth MetricOperator SphereHarmonic FrameCurvaturePolynomial
  SmoothMetricFrame OrthogonalSphereMeasure

def metricFrameSynthesis (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3)
    (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame M e) : R3 ≃ₗ[ℝ] R3 :=
  (PiLp.basisFun 2 ℝ (Fin 3)).equivFun.trans (metricFrameBasis M e he).equivFun.symm

lemma metricFrameSynthesis_apply (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3)
    (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame M e) (w : R3) :
    metricFrameSynthesis M e he w = ∑ i : Fin 3, w i • e i := by
  simp only [metricFrameSynthesis,LinearEquiv.trans_apply,Module.Basis.equivFun_symm_apply,
    Module.Basis.equivFun_apply,PiLp.basisFun_repr,metricFrameBasis_apply]

lemma metricFrameSynthesis_quadratic (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3)
    (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame M e) (w : R3) :
    ⟪M (metricFrameSynthesis M e he w),metricFrameSynthesis M e he w⟫_ℝ = ‖w‖ ^ 2 := by
  rw [metricFrameSynthesis_apply]
  have hgram := he
  simp only [IsMetricOrthonormalFrame] at hgram
  simp only [map_sum,map_smul,sum_inner,inner_sum,
    real_inner_smul_left,real_inner_smul_right,hgram,EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq]
  simp [mul_ite,ite_mul,pow_two]

def metricFrameTransition (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e f : Fin 3 → R3)
    (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame M e) (hf : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame M f) : R3 ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] R3 where
  toLinearEquiv := (metricFrameSynthesis M f hf).trans (metricFrameSynthesis M e he).symm
  norm_map' w := by
    have h1 := metricFrameSynthesis_quadratic M e he
      ((metricFrameSynthesis M e he).symm (metricFrameSynthesis M f hf w))
    have h2 := metricFrameSynthesis_quadratic M f hf w
    rw [(metricFrameSynthesis M e he).apply_symm_apply] at h1
    change ‖(metricFrameSynthesis M e he).symm (metricFrameSynthesis M f hf w)‖ = ‖w‖
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg w,norm_nonneg ((metricFrameSynthesis M e he).symm (metricFrameSynthesis M f hf w))]

lemma metricFrameSynthesis_transition (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e f : Fin 3 → R3)
    (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame M e) (hf : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame M f) (w : R3) :
    metricFrameSynthesis M e he (metricFrameTransition M e f he hf w) = metricFrameSynthesis M f hf w :=
  (metricFrameSynthesis M e he).apply_symm_apply _

def metricUnitFiber (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) : Set R3 := {v | ⟪M v,v⟫_ℝ = 1}

lemma measurableSet_metricUnitFiber (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) : MeasurableSet (metricUnitFiber M) :=
  (isClosed_singleton.preimage (M.continuous.inner continuous_id)).measurableSet

def metricFrameSphereMap (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3)
    (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame M e) : UnitSphere → R3 :=
  fun u => metricFrameSynthesis M e he u.val

lemma measurable_metricFrameSphereMap (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3)
    (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame M e) : Measurable (metricFrameSphereMap M e he) :=
  ((metricFrameSynthesis M e he).toContinuousLinearEquiv.continuous.comp continuous_subtype_val).measurable

lemma metricFrameSphereMap_mem_metricUnitFiber (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3)
    (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame M e) (u : UnitSphere) :
    metricFrameSphereMap M e he u ∈ metricUnitFiber M := by
  change ⟪M (metricFrameSynthesis M e he u.val),metricFrameSynthesis M e he u.val⟫_ℝ = 1
  rw [metricFrameSynthesis_quadratic]
  have h : ‖u.val‖ = 1 := by simpa only [Metric.mem_sphere,dist_zero_right] using u.property
  rw [h,one_pow]

def metricFrameProbability (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3)
    (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame M e) : Measure R3 :=
  Measure.map (metricFrameSphereMap M e he) sphereProbability

instance metricFrameProbability_probability (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3)
    (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame M e) : IsProbabilityMeasure (metricFrameProbability M e he) := by
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  rw [metricFrameProbability,Measure.map_apply (measurable_metricFrameSphereMap M e he)
    MeasurableSet.univ,Set.preimage_univ,measure_univ]

theorem metricFrameProbability_metricUnitFiber_compl (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3)
    (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame M e) : metricFrameProbability M e he (metricUnitFiber M)ᶜ = 0 := by
  rw [metricFrameProbability,Measure.map_apply (measurable_metricFrameSphereMap M e he)
    (measurableSet_metricUnitFiber M).compl]
  have h : metricFrameSphereMap M e he ⁻¹' (metricUnitFiber M)ᶜ = ∅ := by
    apply Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.mpr
    intro u
    simpa only [Set.mem_preimage,Set.mem_compl_iff,not_not] using
      metricFrameSphereMap_mem_metricUnitFiber M e he u
  rw [h,measure_empty]

theorem metricFrameProbability_frame_independent (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e f : Fin 3 → R3)
    (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame M e) (hf : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame M f) :
    metricFrameProbability M e he = metricFrameProbability M f hf := by
  let T := metricFrameTransition M e f he hf
  have hcomp : metricFrameSphereMap M e he ∘ orthogonalSphereHomeomorph T = metricFrameSphereMap M f hf := by
    funext u
    exact metricFrameSynthesis_transition M e f he hf u.val
  rw [metricFrameProbability,metricFrameProbability,← hcomp,
    ← Measure.map_map (measurable_metricFrameSphereMap M e he) (orthogonalSphereHomeomorph T).measurable,
    (orthogonalSphereHomeomorph_sphereProbability_preserving T).map_eq]

theorem reference_metricFrameProbability_frame_independent (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (x : R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3)
    (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x) e) :
    metricFrameProbability (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x) e he =
      metricFrameProbability (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x)
        (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x)) (referenceMetricGramFrame_isMetricOrthonormalFrame g hg L (lam,x)) :=
  metricFrameProbability_frame_independent _ _ _ he _

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.MetricFiberMeasure

``````

## Calderon.MetricFiberFischer

SHA256 `3e3aae573ccc75a46883567f5bcc7a14b4774fbcb99bd9e9bda4c0e37e37683a`.

``````lean
import Calderon.MetricFiberMeasure

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory MvPolynomial
open scoped InnerProductSpace
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.MetricFiberFischer
open RadiusProfile ConformalDepth MetricOperator SphereHarmonic AngularPolynomial
  FrameCurvaturePolynomial SmoothMetricFrame MetricFiberMeasure

lemma metricFrameCoordinates_synthesis (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3)
    (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame M e) (w : R3) :
    metricFrameCoordinates M e (metricFrameSynthesis M e he w) = w.ofLp := by
  funext i
  rw [metricFrameCoordinates_apply,metricFrameSynthesis_apply]
  have hgram := he
  simp only [IsMetricOrthonormalFrame] at hgram
  simp only [map_sum,map_smul,sum_inner,real_inner_smul_left,hgram]
  simp

lemma metricFramePolynomial_synthesis (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3)
    (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame M e) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (w : R3) :
    metricFramePolynomial M e p (metricFrameSynthesis M e he w) = p.eval w.ofLp := by
  simp only [metricFramePolynomial,metricFrameCoordinates_synthesis]

theorem metricFramePolynomial_fiber_integral_pair (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3)
    (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame M e) (p q : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    (∫ v : R3, metricFramePolynomial M e p v * metricFramePolynomial M e q v
      ∂metricFrameProbability M e he) = ⟪polynomialSphereL2 p,polynomialSphereL2 q⟫_ℝ := by
  have hcont : Continuous (fun v : R3 => metricFramePolynomial M e p v * metricFramePolynomial M e q v) :=
    (contDiff_metricFramePolynomial M e p).continuous.mul
      (contDiff_metricFramePolynomial M e q).continuous
  rw [metricFrameProbability,integral_map_of_stronglyMeasurable
    (measurable_metricFrameSphereMap M e he) hcont.stronglyMeasurable,polynomialSphereL2_inner]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [] with u
  simp only [metricFrameSphereMap,metricFramePolynomial_synthesis]

theorem integrable_metricFramePolynomial_fiber_pair (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3)
    (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame M e) (p q : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    Integrable (fun v : R3 => metricFramePolynomial M e p v * metricFramePolynomial M e q v)
      (metricFrameProbability M e he) := by
  have hcont : Continuous (fun v : R3 => metricFramePolynomial M e p v * metricFramePolynomial M e q v) :=
    (contDiff_metricFramePolynomial M e p).continuous.mul (contDiff_metricFramePolynomial M e q).continuous
  rw [metricFrameProbability]
  apply (integrable_map_measure hcont.stronglyMeasurable.aestronglyMeasurable
    (measurable_metricFrameSphereMap M e he).aemeasurable).2
  change Integrable (fun u : UnitSphere =>
    metricFramePolynomial M e p (metricFrameSphereMap M e he u) *
    metricFramePolynomial M e q (metricFrameSphereMap M e he u)) sphereProbability
  have h : Integrable (fun u : UnitSphere => p.eval u.val.ofLp * q.eval u.val.ofLp)
      sphereProbability :=
    ((polynomialSphere p).continuous.mul (polynomialSphere q).continuous).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
      (HasCompactSupport.of_compactSpace _)
  simpa only [Function.comp_apply,metricFrameSphereMap,metricFramePolynomial_synthesis] using h

theorem metricFramePolynomial_fiber_inner (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3) (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame M e) (k : ℕ)
    (p q : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hp : p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) (hq : q ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) :
    (∫ v : R3, metricFramePolynomial M e p v * metricFramePolynomial M e q v
      ∂metricFrameProbability M e he) = normalizedFischerInner k p q := by
  rw [metricFramePolynomial_fiber_integral_pair,hF k p q hp hq]

theorem metricFramePolynomial_fiber_square (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3) (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame M e) (k : ℕ)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hp : p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) :
    (∫ v : R3, (metricFramePolynomial M e p v)^2 ∂metricFrameProbability M e he) =
      normalizedFischerSquare k p := by
  simpa only [pow_two,normalizedFischerSquare] using
    metricFramePolynomial_fiber_inner hF M e he k p p hp hp

theorem reference_metricFramePolynomial_fiber_inner (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (x : R3) (k : ℕ)
    (p q : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hp : p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) (hq : q ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) :
    (∫ v : R3,
      metricFramePolynomial (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x)
        (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x)) p v *
      metricFramePolynomial (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x)
        (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x)) q v
      ∂metricFrameProbability (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x)
        (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x))
        (referenceMetricGramFrame_isMetricOrthonormalFrame g hg L (lam,x))) =
      normalizedFischerInner k p q :=
  metricFramePolynomial_fiber_inner hF _ _ _ k p q hp hq

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.MetricFiberFischer
``````

## Calderon.PolynomialSlotCompatibility

SHA256 `1aa1740215aec659cc4f8f524cbe7448646d8a907bf76470d94bdb714f8fc5bd`.

``````lean
import Calderon.FischerConnectionTransport

noncomputable section
open MvPolynomial
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.PolynomialSlotCompatibility
open RadiusProfile ConformalDepth MetricOperator AngularPolynomial CurvatureSkew
  MovingFrameConnection FischerConnectionTransport

lemma polynomialMatrixVectorField_partial_commutator (c : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (i : Fin 3) :
    -polynomialMatrixVectorField c (pderiv i p) - pderiv i (-polynomialMatrixVectorField c p) =
      ∑ a : Fin 3, C (c a i) * pderiv a p := by
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp [polynomialMatrixVectorField,Fin.sum_univ_three,pderiv_mul,
      pderiv_pderiv_comm (0:Fin 3) 1 p,pderiv_pderiv_comm (0:Fin 3) 2 p,
      pderiv_pderiv_comm (1:Fin 3) 2 p] <;> ring

lemma polynomialMatrixVectorField_multiplication_commutator (c : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ a b, c a b = -c b a) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (i : Fin 3) :
    -polynomialMatrixVectorField c (X i * p) - X i * (-polynomialMatrixVectorField c p) =
      ∑ a : Fin 3, C (c a i) * (X a * p) := by
  have hd (a : Fin 3) : c a a = 0 := by have h := hc a a; linarith
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp [polynomialMatrixVectorField,Fin.sum_univ_three,pderiv_mul,hd] <;>
    rw [hc 1 0,hc 2 0,hc 2 1] <;>
    simp only [map_neg] <;> ring

lemma referenceFrameAngularPolynomial_partial_commutator (g : MatrixField)
    (L lam : ℝ) (x X : R3) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (i : Fin 3) :
    referenceFrameAngularPolynomial g L lam x X (pderiv i p) -
      pderiv i (referenceFrameAngularPolynomial g L lam x X p) =
      ∑ a : Fin 3, C (referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient g L lam x X a i) * pderiv a p :=
  polynomialMatrixVectorField_partial_commutator _ p i

lemma referenceFrameAngularPolynomial_multiplication_commutator (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (x V : R3) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (i : Fin 3) :
    referenceFrameAngularPolynomial g L lam x V (X i * p) -
      X i * referenceFrameAngularPolynomial g L lam x V p =
      ∑ a : Fin 3, C (referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient g L lam x V a i) * (X a * p) :=
  polynomialMatrixVectorField_multiplication_commutator _
    (fun a b => referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient_skew g hg L lam x V a b) p i

variable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]

lemma finitePolynomialField_partial (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (x : R3) (i : Fin 3) :
    finitePolynomialField (fun j => pderiv i (b j)) c x = pderiv i (finitePolynomialField b c x) := by
  simp only [finitePolynomialField,map_sum,smul_eq_C_mul,pderiv_C_mul]

lemma finitePolynomialField_multiplication (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (x : R3) (i : Fin 3) :
    finitePolynomialField (fun j => X i * b j) c x = X i * finitePolynomialField b c x := by
  simp only [finitePolynomialField,smul_eq_C_mul,Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  ring

lemma finitePolynomialFieldDerivative_partial (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (x V : R3) (i : Fin 3) :
    finitePolynomialFieldDerivative (fun j => pderiv i (b j)) c x V =
      pderiv i (finitePolynomialFieldDerivative b c x V) :=
  finitePolynomialField_partial b (fun _ => fderiv ℝ c x V) x i

lemma finitePolynomialFieldDerivative_multiplication (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (x V : R3) (i : Fin 3) :
    finitePolynomialFieldDerivative (fun j => X i * b j) c x V =
      X i * finitePolynomialFieldDerivative b c x V :=
  finitePolynomialField_multiplication b (fun _ => fderiv ℝ c x V) x i

def referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (x V : R3) (i : Fin 3) :
    MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam (fun j => b j i) c x V -
    ∑ a : Fin 3, C (referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient g L lam x V a i) *
      finitePolynomialField (fun j => b j a) c x

theorem referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative_partial (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (x V : R3) (i : Fin 3) :
    referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative g L lam (fun j a => pderiv a (b j)) c x V i =
      pderiv i (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x V) := by
  have h := referenceFrameAngularPolynomial_partial_commutator g L lam x V (finitePolynomialField b c x) i
  simp only [referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative,referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative,
    finitePolynomialField_partial,finitePolynomialFieldDerivative_partial,map_add]
  linear_combination h

theorem referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative_multiplication (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (x V : R3) (i : Fin 3) :
    referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative g L lam (fun j a => X a * b j) c x V i =
      X i * referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x V := by
  have h := referenceFrameAngularPolynomial_multiplication_commutator g hg L lam x V (finitePolynomialField b c x) i
  simp only [referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative,referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative,
    finitePolynomialField_multiplication,finitePolynomialFieldDerivative_multiplication,mul_add]
  linear_combination h

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.PolynomialSlotCompatibility
``````

``````lean
import Calderon.MetricFiberFischer
import Calderon.FischerDensityIntegration

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory MvPolynomial
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.MetricFiberAdjunction
open RadiusProfile ConformalDepth MetricOperator SphereHarmonic AngularPolynomial
  FrameCurvaturePolynomial SmoothMetricFrame MetricFiberMeasure MetricFiberFischer
  FischerConnectionTransport FischerDensityIntegration ReferenceDensityBounds BaseDensityAdjoint

def referenceFiberPolynomialPair (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (x : R3) (p q : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ v : R3,
    metricFramePolynomial (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x)
      (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x)) p v *
    metricFramePolynomial (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x)
      (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x)) q v
    ∂metricFrameProbability (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x)
      (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x))
      (referenceMetricGramFrame_isMetricOrthonormalFrame g hg L (lam,x))

lemma referenceFiberPolynomialPair_eq (hF : SphereFischerInner) (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (x : R3) (k : ℕ)
    (p q : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hp : p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) (hq : q ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) :
    referenceFiberPolynomialPair g hg L lam x p q = normalizedFischerInner k p q :=
  reference_metricFramePolynomial_fiber_inner hF g hg L lam x k p q hp hq

variable {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]

lemma referenceFiberPolynomialPair_finite (hF : SphereFischerInner) (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (k : ℕ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (d : κ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ i, b i ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) (hd : ∀ i, d i ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (z : R3 → κ → ℝ) (x : R3) :
    referenceFiberPolynomialPair g hg L lam x (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField d z x) =
      fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField d z x) / sphereNormalization 3 k := by
  simpa only [normalizedFischerInner,Fintype.card_fin] using referenceFiberPolynomialPair_eq hF g hg L lam x k
    _ _ (finitePolynomialField_harmonicHomogeneous k b hb c x) (finitePolynomialField_harmonicHomogeneous k d hd z x)

lemma contDiff_referenceFiberPolynomialPair_finite (hF : SphereFischerInner) (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (k : ℕ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (d : κ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ i, b i ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) (hd : ∀ i, d i ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (z : R3 → κ → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hz : ContDiff ℝ ∞ z) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => referenceFiberPolynomialPair g hg L lam x
      (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField d z x)) := by
  simp_rw [referenceFiberPolynomialPair_finite hF g hg L lam k b d hb hd c z]
  exact (contDiff_fischerPair b d c z hc hz).div_const _

lemma hasCompactSupport_referenceFiberPolynomialPair_finite (hF : SphereFischerInner) (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (k : ℕ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (d : κ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ i, b i ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) (hd : ∀ i, d i ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (z : R3 → κ → ℝ) (hc : HasCompactSupport c) :
    HasCompactSupport (fun x => referenceFiberPolynomialPair g hg L lam x
      (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField d z x)) := by
  apply (hasCompactSupport_fischerPair b d c z hc).mono
  intro x hx
  simp only [Function.mem_support] at hx ⊢
  intro hzero
  apply hx
  rw [referenceFiberPolynomialPair_finite hF g hg L lam k b d hb hd c z,hzero,zero_div]

theorem fderiv_referenceFiberPolynomialPair_finite (hF : SphereFischerInner) (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (d : κ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ i, b i ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) (hd : ∀ i, d i ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (z : R3 → κ → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hz : ContDiff ℝ ∞ z) (x V : R3) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun y => referenceFiberPolynomialPair g hg L lam y
      (finitePolynomialField b c y) (finitePolynomialField d z y)) x V =
      referenceFiberPolynomialPair g hg L lam x
        (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x V) (finitePolynomialField d z x) +
      referenceFiberPolynomialPair g hg L lam x
        (finitePolynomialField b c x) (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam d z x V) := by
  have heq : (fun y => referenceFiberPolynomialPair g hg L lam y
      (finitePolynomialField b c y) (finitePolynomialField d z y)) =
      fun y => (sphereNormalization 3 k)⁻¹ * fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c y) (finitePolynomialField d z y) := by
    funext y
    rw [referenceFiberPolynomialPair_finite hF g hg L lam k b d hb hd c z]
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv,mul_comm]
  rw [heq,fderiv_const_mul ((contDiff_fischerPair b d c z hc hz).differentiable (by simp) x)]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul]
  rw [referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_fischer_compatible g hg L lam b d c z hc hz]
  rw [referenceFiberPolynomialPair_eq hF g hg L lam x k _ _
      (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_harmonicHomogeneous g hg L lam k hk b hb c x V)
      (finitePolynomialField_harmonicHomogeneous k d hd z x),
    referenceFiberPolynomialPair_eq hF g hg L lam x k _ _
      (finitePolynomialField_harmonicHomogeneous k b hb c x)
      (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_harmonicHomogeneous g hg L lam k hk d hd z x V)]
  simp only [normalizedFischerInner,Fintype.card_fin,div_eq_mul_inv]
  ring

theorem compact_referenceFiberPolynomialPair_covariant_contraction (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (rho : R3 → ℝ) (hr : ContDiff ℝ ∞ rho) (V : R3 → R3) (hV : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (d : κ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ i, b i ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) (hd : ∀ i, d i ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (z : R3 → κ → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hz : ContDiff ℝ ∞ z)
    (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c) :
    (∫ x : R3, rho x *
      (referenceFiberPolynomialPair g hg L lam x
        (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x (V x)) (finitePolynomialField d z x) +
      referenceFiberPolynomialPair g hg L lam x
        (finitePolynomialField b c x) (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam d z x (V x)))) =
      -(∫ x : R3, weightedCoordinateDivergence rho V x *
        referenceFiberPolynomialPair g hg L lam x (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField d z x)) := by
  have h := compact_weighted_scalar_variable_adjoint rho _ V hr
    (contDiff_referenceFiberPolynomialPair_finite hF g hg L lam k b d hb hd c z hc hz) hV
    (hasCompactSupport_referenceFiberPolynomialPair_finite hF g hg L lam k b d hb hd c z hcompact)
  simpa only [fderiv_referenceFiberPolynomialPair_finite hF g hg L lam k hk b d hb hd c z hc hz] using h

theorem integrable_compact_referenceFiberPolynomialPair_covariant_sum (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (rho : R3 → ℝ) (hr : ContDiff ℝ ∞ rho) (V : R3 → R3) (hV : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (d : κ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ i, b i ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) (hd : ∀ i, d i ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (z : R3 → κ → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hz : ContDiff ℝ ∞ z)
    (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c) :
    Integrable (fun x : R3 => rho x *
      (referenceFiberPolynomialPair g hg L lam x
        (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x (V x)) (finitePolynomialField d z x) +
      referenceFiberPolynomialPair g hg L lam x
        (finitePolynomialField b c x) (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam d z x (V x)))) := by
  let P : R3 → ℝ := fun x => referenceFiberPolynomialPair g hg L lam x
    (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField d z x)
  have hP := contDiff_referenceFiberPolynomialPair_finite hF g hg L lam k b d hb hd c z hc hz
  have hs := hasCompactSupport_referenceFiberPolynomialPair_finite hF g hg L lam k b d hb hd c z hcompact
  have heq : (fun x => rho x * fderiv ℝ P x (V x)) =
      fun x => ∑ i : Fin 3, rho x * (V x) i * directionalDeriv (coordinateDirection i) P x := by
    funext x
    rw [directionalDeriv_variable_eq_sum,Finset.mul_sum]
    simp only [mul_assoc]
  have hi : Integrable (fun x => rho x * fderiv ℝ P x (V x)) := by
    rw [heq]
    apply integrable_finset_sum
    intro i _
    exact ((hr.continuous.mul (contDiff_vectorComponent V hV i).continuous).mul
      (contDiff_directionalDeriv _ P hP).continuous).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
        (hasCompactSupport_directionalDeriv _ P hs).mul_left
  simpa only [P,fderiv_referenceFiberPolynomialPair_finite hF g hg L lam k hk b d hb hd c z hc hz] using hi

theorem compact_reference_volumeFiber_covariant_contraction (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (V : R3 → R3) (hV : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (d : κ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ i, b i ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) (hd : ∀ i, d i ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (z : R3 → κ → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hz : ContDiff ℝ ∞ z)
    (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c) :
    (∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      (referenceFiberPolynomialPair g hg L lam x
        (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x (V x)) (finitePolynomialField d z x) +
      referenceFiberPolynomialPair g hg L lam x
        (finitePolynomialField b c x) (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam d z x (V x)))) =
      -(∫ x : R3, weightedCoordinateDivergence (fun y => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,y)) V x *
        referenceFiberPolynomialPair g hg L lam x (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField d z x)) :=
  compact_referenceFiberPolynomialPair_covariant_contraction hF g hg L lam k hk _
    ((contDiff_referenceDensityFamily g hg L).comp (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id))
    V hV b d hb hd c z hc hz hcompact

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.MetricFiberAdjunction
``````

## Calderon.HarmonicCoordinateCompatibility

SHA256 `8ad01d78295a5ce5dd17687f5083421bdba3364dc0a1077d624f28b197d226f2`.

``````lean
import Calderon.PolynomialSlotCompatibility

noncomputable section
open MvPolynomial
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.HarmonicCoordinateCompatibility
open RadiusProfile ConformalDepth MetricOperator AngularPolynomial CurvatureSkew
  MovingFrameConnection FischerConnectionTransport PolynomialSlotCompatibility SphereHarmonic

def coordinateHarmonicRaising (k : ℕ) (i : Fin 3) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ := X i * p - C ((2*(k:ℝ)+1)⁻¹) * radiusSq * pderiv i p

lemma coordinateHarmonicRaising_eq_harmonicRaising (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (i : Fin 3)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    coordinateHarmonicRaising k i p = harmonicRaising (k-1) (Pi.single i p) := by
  have hcoef : 2 / (4*((k-1:ℕ):ℝ)+2*(Fintype.card (Fin 3):ℝ)) = (2*(k:ℝ)+1)⁻¹ := by
    have hden : 4*((k-1:ℕ):ℝ)+2*(Fintype.card (Fin 3):ℝ) = 2*(2*(k:ℝ)+1) := by
      rw [Nat.cast_sub hk]
      simp only [Nat.cast_one,Fintype.card_fin,Nat.cast_ofNat]
      ring
    rw [hden]
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv,mul_inv_rev]
    norm_num
    ring
  have hdiv : polynomialDivergence (Pi.single i p) = pderiv i p := by
    simp [polynomialDivergence,Pi.single_apply,apply_ite]
  rw [harmonicRaising,hcoef,hdiv]
  simp [coordinateHarmonicRaising,polynomialRaising,Pi.single_apply]

theorem coordinateHarmonicRaising_harmonicHomogeneous (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (i : Fin 3)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hp : p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) :
    coordinateHarmonicRaising k i p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (k+1) := by
  have hh : ∀ j : Fin 3, ((Pi.single i p : Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) j).IsHomogeneous k := by
    intro j
    by_cases hj : j=i
    · subst j;simpa using hp.1
    · have hz : (0 : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ).IsHomogeneous k :=
        (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 3) ℝ k).zero_mem
      simpa only [Pi.single_apply,if_neg hj] using hz
  have hl : ∀ j : Fin 3, laplacian ((Pi.single i p : Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) j) = 0 := by
    intro j
    by_cases hj : j=i
    · subst j;simpa using hp.2
    · simp [Pi.single_apply,hj,laplacian]
  rw [coordinateHarmonicRaising_eq_harmonicRaising k hk]
  exact ⟨harmonicRaising_isHomogeneous hk _ hh,
    laplacian_harmonicRaising _ hh hl (ne_of_gt (radiusSq_laplacian_coefficient_pos (k-1)))⟩

lemma polynomialMatrixVectorField_radiusSq_mul (c : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ a b,c a b = -c b a) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    polynomialMatrixVectorField c (radiusSq*p) = radiusSq*polynomialMatrixVectorField c p := by
  have hd (a : Fin 3) : c a a = 0 := by have h:=hc a a;linarith
  simp only [polynomialMatrixVectorField,Fin.sum_univ_three,pderiv_mul,pderiv_radiusSq]
  rw [hd 0,hd 1,hd 2,hc 1 0,hc 2 0,hc 2 1]
  simp only [map_zero,map_neg,zero_mul,mul_zero,zero_add,add_zero]
  ring

lemma referenceFrameAngularPolynomial_radiusSq_mul (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (x V : R3) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    referenceFrameAngularPolynomial g L lam x V (radiusSq*p) =
      radiusSq*referenceFrameAngularPolynomial g L lam x V p := by
  rw [referenceFrameAngularPolynomial,referenceFrameAngularPolynomial,
    polynomialMatrixVectorField_radiusSq_mul _
      (fun a b=>referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient_skew g hg L lam x V a b) p]
  ring

lemma referenceFrameAngularPolynomial_C_mul (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ) (x V : R3)
    (r : ℝ) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    referenceFrameAngularPolynomial g L lam x V (C r*p) =
      C r*referenceFrameAngularPolynomial g L lam x V p := by
  simpa only [smul_eq_C_mul] using referenceFrameAngularPolynomial_smul g L lam x V r p

lemma referenceFrameAngularPolynomial_sub (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ) (x V : R3)
    (p q : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    referenceFrameAngularPolynomial g L lam x V (p-q) =
      referenceFrameAngularPolynomial g L lam x V p - referenceFrameAngularPolynomial g L lam x V q :=
  map_sub (referenceAngularPolynomialLinearMap g L lam x V) p q

lemma referenceFrameAngularPolynomial_coordinateHarmonicRaising_commutator (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (x V : R3) (k : ℕ) (i : Fin 3)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    referenceFrameAngularPolynomial g L lam x V (coordinateHarmonicRaising k i p) -
      coordinateHarmonicRaising k i (referenceFrameAngularPolynomial g L lam x V p) =
      ∑ a : Fin 3, C (referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient g L lam x V a i) * coordinateHarmonicRaising k a p := by
  have hm:=referenceFrameAngularPolynomial_multiplication_commutator g hg L lam x V p i
  have hd:=referenceFrameAngularPolynomial_partial_commutator g L lam x V p i
  have hcorr : referenceFrameAngularPolynomial g L lam x V
      (C ((2*(k:ℝ)+1)⁻¹)*radiusSq*pderiv i p) =
      C ((2*(k:ℝ)+1)⁻¹)*radiusSq*referenceFrameAngularPolynomial g L lam x V (pderiv i p) := by
    rw [mul_assoc,referenceFrameAngularPolynomial_C_mul,referenceFrameAngularPolynomial_radiusSq_mul g hg]
    ring
  simp only [coordinateHarmonicRaising]
  rw [referenceFrameAngularPolynomial_sub,hcorr]
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at hm hd ⊢
  linear_combination hm - C ((2*(k:ℝ)+1)⁻¹)*radiusSq*hd

variable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]

lemma finitePolynomialField_coordinateHarmonicRaising (k : ℕ) (i : Fin 3)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (x : R3) :
    finitePolynomialField (fun j=>coordinateHarmonicRaising k i (b j)) c x =
      coordinateHarmonicRaising k i (finitePolynomialField b c x) := by
  simp only [coordinateHarmonicRaising,finitePolynomialField,smul_eq_C_mul,map_sum,
    pderiv_C_mul,Finset.mul_sum,mul_sub,Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  congr 1 <;> apply Finset.sum_congr rfl <;> intro j _ <;> ring

lemma finitePolynomialFieldDerivative_coordinateHarmonicRaising (k : ℕ) (i : Fin 3)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (x V : R3) :
    finitePolynomialFieldDerivative (fun j=>coordinateHarmonicRaising k i (b j)) c x V =
      coordinateHarmonicRaising k i (finitePolynomialFieldDerivative b c x V) :=
  finitePolynomialField_coordinateHarmonicRaising k i b (fun _=>fderiv ℝ c x V) x

theorem referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative_coordinateHarmonicRaising (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (k : ℕ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (x V : R3) (i : Fin 3) :
    referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative g L lam (fun j a=>coordinateHarmonicRaising k a (b j)) c x V i =
      coordinateHarmonicRaising k i (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x V) := by
  have h:=referenceFrameAngularPolynomial_coordinateHarmonicRaising_commutator g hg L lam x V k i
    (finitePolynomialField b c x)
  simp only [referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative,referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative,
    finitePolynomialField_coordinateHarmonicRaising,finitePolynomialFieldDerivative_coordinateHarmonicRaising]
  simp only [coordinateHarmonicRaising,map_add,mul_add,pderiv_C_mul] at h ⊢
  linear_combination h

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.HarmonicCoordinateCompatibility
``````

## Calderon.FiniteCovectorTransport

SHA256 `6c122caef47b97f514f725d6e9db038d24c7493899bd84c0fdf1f6fb3f11ed17`.

``````lean
import Calderon.PolynomialSlotCompatibility
import Calderon.FischerDensityIntegration

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory MvPolynomial
open scoped ContDiff
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.FiniteCovectorTransport
open RadiusProfile ConformalDepth AngularPolynomial MovingFrameConnection
  FischerConnectionTransport PolynomialSlotCompatibility FischerDensityIntegration

lemma fischer_covector_slot_cancellation (w : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ a i,w a i = -w i a) (U V Q Z : Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    (∑ i : Fin 3,
      (fischerInner (Q i-∑ a : Fin 3, C (w a i) * U a) (V i) +
      fischerInner (U i) (Z i-∑ a : Fin 3, C (w a i) * V a))) =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, (fischerInner (Q i) (V i)+fischerInner (U i) (Z i)) := by
  have hnegL (p q : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) : fischerInner (-p) q = -fischerInner p q := by
    simpa using fischerInner_C_mul_left (-1) p q
  have hnegR (p q : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) : fischerInner p (-q) = -fischerInner p q := by
    simpa using fischerInner_C_mul_right (-1) p q
  have hsL (p q r : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) : fischerInner (p-q) r = fischerInner p r-fischerInner q r := by
    simp only [sub_eq_add_neg,fischerInner_add_left,hnegL]
  have hsR (p q r : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) : fischerInner p (q-r) = fischerInner p q-fischerInner p r := by
    simp only [sub_eq_add_neg,fischerInner_add_right,hnegR]
  have hd (a : Fin 3) : w a a=0 := by have h:=hw a a;linarith
  simp only [hsL,hsR,fischerInner_finset_sum_left,fischerInner_sum_right,
    fischerInner_C_mul_left,fischerInner_C_mul_right,Fin.sum_univ_three,
    fischerInner_add_left,fischerInner_add_right]
  rw [hd 0,hd 1,hd 2,hw 1 0,hw 2 0,hw 2 1]
  ring

variable {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]

def finiteCovectorFischerPair (b : ι → Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (d : κ → Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (z : R3 → κ → ℝ) (x : R3) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i : Fin 3, fischerInner (finitePolynomialField (fun j=>b j i) c x)
    (finitePolynomialField (fun j=>d j i) z x)

lemma contDiff_finiteCovectorFischerPair (b : ι → Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (d : κ → Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (z : R3 → κ → ℝ)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hz : ContDiff ℝ ∞ z) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (finiteCovectorFischerPair b d c z) := by
  change ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => ∑ i : Fin 3, fischerInner
    (finitePolynomialField (fun j => b j i) c x) (finitePolynomialField (fun j => d j i) z x))
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
  exact ((contDiff_fischerPair _ _ c z hc hz).add (contDiff_fischerPair _ _ c z hc hz)).add
    (contDiff_fischerPair _ _ c z hc hz)

lemma hasCompactSupport_finiteCovectorFischerPair (b : ι → Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (d : κ → Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (z : R3 → κ → ℝ)
    (hc : HasCompactSupport c) : HasCompactSupport (finiteCovectorFischerPair b d c z) := by
  change HasCompactSupport (fun x => ∑ i : Fin 3, fischerInner
    (finitePolynomialField (fun j => b j i) c x) (finitePolynomialField (fun j => d j i) z x))
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three]
  exact ((hasCompactSupport_fischerPair _ _ c z hc).add (hasCompactSupport_fischerPair _ _ c z hc)).add
    (hasCompactSupport_fischerPair _ _ c z hc)

theorem fderiv_finiteCovectorFischerPair (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (d : κ → Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (z : R3 → κ → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hz : ContDiff ℝ ∞ z) (x V : R3) :
    fderiv ℝ (finiteCovectorFischerPair b d c z) x V =
      ∑ i : Fin 3,
        (fischerInner (referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x V i)
          (finitePolynomialField (fun j=>d j i) z x) +
        fischerInner (finitePolynomialField (fun j=>b j i) c x)
          (referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative g L lam d z x V i)) := by
  have hi : ∀ i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3)), DifferentiableAt ℝ
      (fun y=>fischerInner (finitePolynomialField (fun j=>b j i) c y)
        (finitePolynomialField (fun j=>d j i) z y)) x :=
    fun i _=>(contDiff_fischerPair _ _ c z hc hz).differentiable (by simp) x
  change fderiv ℝ (fun y => ∑ i : Fin 3, fischerInner
    (finitePolynomialField (fun j => b j i) c y) (finitePolynomialField (fun j => d j i) z y)) x V = _
  rw [fderiv_fun_sum hi,ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
  simp_rw [referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_fischer_compatible g hg L lam _ _ c z hc hz]
  exact (fischer_covector_slot_cancellation (referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient g L lam x V)
    (fun a i=>referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient_skew g hg L lam x V a i)
    (fun i=>finitePolynomialField (fun j=>b j i) c x)
    (fun i=>finitePolynomialField (fun j=>d j i) z x)
    (fun i=>referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam (fun j=>b j i) c x V)
    (fun i=>referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam (fun j=>d j i) z x V)).symm

theorem compact_reference_covector_fischer_contraction (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (rho : R3 → ℝ) (hr : ContDiff ℝ ∞ rho) (V : R3 → R3) (hV : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V)
    (b : ι → Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (d : κ → Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (z : R3 → κ → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hz : ContDiff ℝ ∞ z)
    (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c) :
    (∫ x : R3,rho x * (∑ i : Fin 3,
      (fischerInner (referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x (V x) i)
        (finitePolynomialField (fun j=>d j i) z x) +
      fischerInner (finitePolynomialField (fun j=>b j i) c x)
        (referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative g L lam d z x (V x) i)))) =
      -(∫ x : R3,weightedCoordinateDivergence rho V x * finiteCovectorFischerPair b d c z x) := by
  have h:=compact_weighted_scalar_variable_adjoint rho (finiteCovectorFischerPair b d c z) V hr
    (contDiff_finiteCovectorFischerPair b d c z hc hz) hV
    (hasCompactSupport_finiteCovectorFischerPair b d c z hcompact)
  simpa only [fderiv_finiteCovectorFischerPair g hg L lam b d c z hc hz] using h

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.FiniteCovectorTransport
``````

``````lean
import Calderon.MetricFiberCovectorTransport

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory MvPolynomial
open scoped ContDiff
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.AllDegreeCovectorTransport
open AngularPolynomial SphereHarmonic MovingFrameConnection FischerConnectionTransport
  PolynomialSlotCompatibility FiniteCovectorTransport MetricFiberCovectorTransport
  FischerDensityIntegration

variable {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]

lemma referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_harmonicHomogeneous_all (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (k : ℕ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hb : ∀ j, b j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (x V : R3) :
    referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x V ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k := by
  by_cases hk : k = 0
  · subst k
    have hhom := (finitePolynomialField_harmonicHomogeneous 0 b hb c x).1
    rw [referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative,
      referenceFrameAngularPolynomial_eq_zero_of_isHomogeneous_zero g L lam x V _ hhom,add_zero]
    exact finitePolynomialFieldDerivative_harmonicHomogeneous 0 b hb c x V
  · exact referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_harmonicHomogeneous g hg L lam k
      (Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hk) b hb c x V

lemma referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative_harmonicHomogeneous_all (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (k : ℕ)
    (b : ι → Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hb : ∀ j i, b j i ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (x V : R3) (i : Fin 3) :
    referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x V i ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k := by
  apply (harmonicHomogeneous k).sub_mem
    (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_harmonicHomogeneous_all g hg L lam k _ (fun j => hb j i) c x V)
  apply (harmonicHomogeneous k).sum_mem
  intro a _
  simpa only [smul_eq_C_mul] using (harmonicHomogeneous k).smul_mem
    (referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient g L lam x V a i)
    (finitePolynomialField_harmonicHomogeneous k _ (fun j => hb j a) c x)

theorem fderiv_referenceFiberCovectorPair_finite_all (hF : SphereFischerInner) (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (k : ℕ)
    (b : ι → Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (d : κ → Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ j i, b j i ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) (hd : ∀ j i, d j i ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (z : R3 → κ → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hz : ContDiff ℝ ∞ z) (x V : R3) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun y => referenceFiberCovectorPair g hg L lam y
      (fun i => finitePolynomialField (fun j => b j i) c y)
      (fun i => finitePolynomialField (fun j => d j i) z y)) x V =
      referenceFiberCovectorPair g hg L lam x
        (referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x V)
        (fun i => finitePolynomialField (fun j => d j i) z x) +
      referenceFiberCovectorPair g hg L lam x
        (fun i => finitePolynomialField (fun j => b j i) c x)
        (referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative g L lam d z x V) := by
  have heq : (fun y => referenceFiberCovectorPair g hg L lam y
      (fun i => finitePolynomialField (fun j => b j i) c y)
      (fun i => finitePolynomialField (fun j => d j i) z y)) =
      fun y => (sphereNormalization 3 k)⁻¹ * finiteCovectorFischerPair b d c z y := by
    funext y
    rw [referenceFiberCovectorPair_finite hF g hg L lam k b d hb hd c z]
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv,mul_comm]
  rw [heq,fderiv_const_mul ((contDiff_finiteCovectorFischerPair b d c z hc hz).differentiable (by simp) x)]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul]
  rw [fderiv_finiteCovectorFischerPair g hg L lam b d c z hc hz]
  rw [referenceFiberCovectorPair_eq hF g hg L lam x k _ _
      (fun i => referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative_harmonicHomogeneous_all g hg L lam k b hb c x V i)
      (fun i => finitePolynomialField_harmonicHomogeneous k _ (fun j => hd j i) z x),
    referenceFiberCovectorPair_eq hF g hg L lam x k _ _
      (fun i => finitePolynomialField_harmonicHomogeneous k _ (fun j => hb j i) c x)
      (fun i => referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative_harmonicHomogeneous_all g hg L lam k d hd z x V i)]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  ring

theorem compact_referenceFiberCovectorPair_contraction_all (hF : SphereFischerInner) (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (k : ℕ)
    (rho : R3 → ℝ) (hr : ContDiff ℝ ∞ rho) (V : R3 → R3) (hV : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V)
    (b : ι → Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (d : κ → Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ j i, b j i ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) (hd : ∀ j i, d j i ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (z : R3 → κ → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hz : ContDiff ℝ ∞ z)
    (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c) :
    (∫ x : R3, rho x *
      (referenceFiberCovectorPair g hg L lam x
        (referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x (V x))
        (fun i => finitePolynomialField (fun j => d j i) z x) +
      referenceFiberCovectorPair g hg L lam x
        (fun i => finitePolynomialField (fun j => b j i) c x)
        (referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative g L lam d z x (V x)))) =
      -(∫ x : R3, weightedCoordinateDivergence rho V x * referenceFiberCovectorPair g hg L lam x
        (fun i => finitePolynomialField (fun j => b j i) c x)
        (fun i => finitePolynomialField (fun j => d j i) z x)) := by
  have h := compact_weighted_scalar_variable_adjoint rho _ V hr
    (contDiff_referenceFiberCovectorPair_finite hF g hg L lam k b d hb hd c z hc hz) hV
    (hasCompactSupport_referenceFiberCovectorPair_finite hF g hg L lam k b d hb hd c z hcompact)
  simpa only [fderiv_referenceFiberCovectorPair_finite_all hF g hg L lam k b d hb hd c z hc hz] using h

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.AllDegreeCovectorTransport
``````

## Calderon.ContinuousHarmonicLift

SHA256 `b501477bc0e46d8e09ef87837182eed561a1a2a4308f5c4f4b8093db77723a78`.

``````lean
import Calderon.HarmonicSampling
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.OpenPos
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Function.LpSpace.ContinuousFunctions

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory MvPolynomial
open scoped ContDiff Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.ContinuousHarmonicLift
open RadiusProfile SphereHarmonic HarmonicSampling FischerConnectionTransport

lemma surfaceMeasure_isOpenPosMeasure : Measure.IsOpenPosMeasure surfaceMeasure := by
  unfold surfaceMeasure
  infer_instance

lemma sphereProbability_isOpenPosMeasure : Measure.IsOpenPosMeasure sphereProbability := by
  letI := surfaceMeasure_isOpenPosMeasure
  unfold sphereProbability
  exact Measure.isOpenPosMeasure_smul surfaceMeasure
    (ENNReal.inv_ne_zero.mpr (measure_ne_top surfaceMeasure Set.univ))

lemma continuousSphere_toLp_injective : Function.Injective
    (ContinuousMap.toLp 2 sphereProbability ℝ : C(UnitSphere, ℝ) →L[ℝ] SphereL2) := by
  letI := sphereProbability_isOpenPosMeasure
  exact ContinuousMap.toLp_injective (p := 2) sphereProbability

theorem exists_harmonicPolynomial_of_continuousSphere (k : ℕ) (psi : C(UnitSphere, ℝ))
    (hpsi : (ContinuousMap.toLp 2 sphereProbability ℝ) psi ∈ harmonicSphereSubspace k) :
    ∃ p : harmonicHomogeneous k, polynomialSphere p.val = psi := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, heq⟩ := hpsi
  refine ⟨⟨p, hp⟩, ?_⟩
  apply continuousSphere_toLp_injective
  exact heq

theorem existsUnique_harmonicPolynomial_of_continuousSphere (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (k : ℕ) (psi : C(UnitSphere, ℝ))
    (hpsi : (ContinuousMap.toLp 2 sphereProbability ℝ) psi ∈ harmonicSphereSubspace k) :
    ∃! p : harmonicHomogeneous k, polynomialSphere p.val = psi := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := exists_harmonicPolynomial_of_continuousSphere k psi hpsi
  refine ⟨p, hp, ?_⟩
  intro q hq
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply (polynomialSphereL2_injective_degree hF k q.val p.val q.property p.property).mp
  exact congrArg (fun f : C(UnitSphere, ℝ) => (ContinuousMap.toLp 2 sphereProbability ℝ) f)
    (hq.trans hp.symm)

theorem exists_harmonicPolynomialFamily_of_continuousSphere (k : ℕ)
    (psi : R3 → C(UnitSphere, ℝ))
    (hpsi : ∀ x, (ContinuousMap.toLp 2 sphereProbability ℝ) (psi x) ∈ harmonicSphereSubspace k) :
    ∃ U : R3 → harmonicHomogeneous k, ∀ x, polynomialSphere (U x).val = psi x := by
  classical
  choose U hU using fun x => exists_harmonicPolynomial_of_continuousSphere k (psi x) (hpsi x)
  exact ⟨U, hU⟩

theorem exists_smooth_compact_coordinates_of_continuousSphere (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (k : ℕ) (psi : R3 → C(UnitSphere, ℝ))
    (hpsi : ∀ x, (ContinuousMap.toLp 2 sphereProbability ℝ) (psi x) ∈ harmonicSphereSubspace k)
    (hsmooth : ∀ theta : UnitSphere, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => psi x theta))
    (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hzero : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, psi x theta = 0) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ b : Fin n → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ, ∃ c : R3 → Fin n → ℝ,
      (∀ j, b j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ c ∧ HasCompactSupport c ∧
      (∀ x, polynomialSphere (finitePolynomialField b c x) = psi x) ∧
      (∀ x ∉ K, finitePolynomialField b c x = 0) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨U, hU⟩ := exists_harmonicPolynomialFamily_of_continuousSphere k psi hpsi
  have hev (x : R3) (theta : UnitSphere) :
      (U x).val.eval (theta.val : Fin 3 → ℝ) = psi x theta := by
    exact congrArg (fun f : C(UnitSphere, ℝ) => f theta) (hU x)
  have hUsmooth : ∀ theta : UnitSphere,
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => (U x).val.eval (theta.val : Fin 3 → ℝ)) := by
    intro theta
    have heq : (fun x => (U x).val.eval (theta.val : Fin 3 → ℝ)) =
        (fun x => psi x theta) := funext (fun x => hev x theta)
    rw [heq]
    exact hsmooth theta
  have hUzero : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere,
      (U x).val.eval (theta.val : Fin 3 → ℝ) = 0 := by
    intro x hx theta
    exact (hev x theta).trans (hzero x hx theta)
  obtain ⟨n, b, c, hb, hc, hcompact, hrec⟩ :=
    exists_smooth_compact_harmonic_coordinates hF k U hUsmooth K hK hUzero
  refine ⟨n, b, c, hb, hc, hcompact, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x
    rw [hrec x]
    exact hU x
  · intro x hx
    rw [hrec x]
    exact harmonicPolynomial_eq_zero_of_sphere hF k (U x).val (U x).property (hUzero x hx)

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.ContinuousHarmonicLift
``````
