``````lean
import Calderon.MetricFrameDivergence
import Calderon.FischerCovectorAdjunction

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 10
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory MvPolynomial
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.ContractedFischerAdjunction
open RadiusProfile ConformalDepth AngularPolynomial SphereHarmonic MetricOperator
  MovingFrameConnection FischerConnectionTransport FischerDensityIntegration
  FischerCovectorAdjunction MetricFrameDivergence SmoothMetricFrame ReferenceDensityBounds
  PolynomialSlotCompatibility FiniteCovectorTransport BaseDensityAdjoint

attribute [local irreducible] referenceMetricGramFrame referenceConnectionFamily
  MetricOperator.metricOperatorField referenceMetric dilatedMetric
  referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient frameConnectionCoefficient covariantFrameDerivative

variable {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]

def referenceTensorPolynomialDerivative (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ)
    (x V : R3) (i j : Fin 3) : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative g L lam (fun a t => b a i t) c x V j -
    ∑ a : Fin 3, C (referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient g L lam x V a i) *
      finitePolynomialField (fun t => b t a j) c x

lemma referenceTensorPolynomialDerivative_fischer_left_eq (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (d : κ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (z : R3 → κ → ℝ) (x V : R3) (i j : Fin 3) :
    fischerInner (referenceTensorPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x V i j) (finitePolynomialField d z x) =
    fischerInner (referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative g L lam (fun a t => b a i t) c x V j)
      (finitePolynomialField d z x) - ∑ a : Fin 3, referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient g L lam x V a i *
        fischerInner (finitePolynomialField (fun t => b t a j) c x) (finitePolynomialField d z x) := by
  simp only [referenceTensorPolynomialDerivative,fischerInner_sub_left,
    fischerInner_finset_sum_left,fischerInner_C_mul_left]

lemma contDiff_referenceTensorPolynomialDerivative_fischer_left (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (V : R3 → R3) (hV : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V)
    (b : ι → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (d : κ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (z : R3 → κ → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hz : ContDiff ℝ ∞ z)
    (i j : Fin 3) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => fischerInner
      (referenceTensorPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x (V x) i j) (finitePolynomialField d z x)) := by
  simp_rw [referenceTensorPolynomialDerivative_fischer_left_eq]
  apply (contDiff_referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative_fischer_left g hg L lam V hV _ d c z hc hz j).sub
  exact ContDiff.sum (fun a _ =>
    (contDiff_referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient_variable g hg L lam V hV a i).mul
      (contDiff_fischerPair _ _ c z hc hz))

lemma hasCompactSupport_referenceTensorPolynomialDerivative_fischer_left_second
    (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ) (V : R3 → R3)
    (b : ι → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (d : κ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (z : R3 → κ → ℝ) (hz : HasCompactSupport z) (i j : Fin 3) :
    HasCompactSupport (fun x => fischerInner
      (referenceTensorPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x (V x) i j) (finitePolynomialField d z x)) := by
  apply hz.mono
  intro x hx
  simp only [Function.mem_support] at hx ⊢
  intro hz0
  apply hx
  rw [finitePolynomialField_eq_zero_of_coeff_eq_zero d z x hz0,fischerInner_zero_right]

lemma integrable_referenceTensorPolynomialDerivative_fischer_right (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (rho : R3 → ℝ) (hr : Continuous rho)
    (V : R3 → R3) (hV : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V) (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (d : κ → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (z : R3 → κ → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hz : ContDiff ℝ ∞ z)
    (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c) (i j : Fin 3) : Integrable (fun x => rho x * fischerInner
      (finitePolynomialField b c x) (referenceTensorPolynomialDerivative g L lam d z x (V x) i j)) := by
  have h : Integrable (fun x => rho x * fischerInner
      (referenceTensorPolynomialDerivative g L lam d z x (V x) i j) (finitePolynomialField b c x)) :=
    (hr.mul (contDiff_referenceTensorPolynomialDerivative_fischer_left g hg L lam V hV d b z c hz hc i j).continuous).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
        (hasCompactSupport_referenceTensorPolynomialDerivative_fischer_left_second g L lam V d b z c hcompact i j).mul_left
  convert h using 1
  funext x
  rw [fischerInner_symm]

lemma contDiff_weightedCoordinateDivergence (rho : R3 → ℝ) (V : R3 → R3)
    (hr : ContDiff ℝ ∞ rho) (hV : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (weightedCoordinateDivergence rho V) :=
  ContDiff.sum (fun i _ => contDiff_directionalDeriv (coordinateDirection i)
    (fun y => rho y * (V y) i) (hr.mul (contDiff_vectorComponent V hV i)))

lemma frame_connection_trace_cancellation (w : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ v a b, w v a b = -w v b a) (P : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    (∑ i : Fin 3, (∑ a : Fin 3, w a a i) * P i) =
      -(∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, w i a i * P a) := by
  simp only [Finset.sum_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp only [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i hi
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro a ha
  rw [hw i i a,neg_mul]

lemma referenceTensor_contraction_eq_row_add_divergence (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (d : κ → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (z : R3 → κ → ℝ) (x : R3) :
    referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, fischerInner
      (finitePolynomialField (fun a => b a j) c x)
      (referenceTensorPolynomialDerivative g L lam d z x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) i j)) =
    (∑ i : Fin 3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * ∑ j : Fin 3, fischerInner
      (finitePolynomialField (fun a => b a j) c x)
      (referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative g L lam (fun a t => d a i t) z x
        (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) j)) +
    (∑ i : Fin 3, weightedCoordinateDivergence (fun y => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,y))
      (fun y => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y) i) x * finiteCovectorFischerPair b (fun a t => d a i t) c z x) := by
  have h (j : Fin 3) := frame_connection_trace_cancellation
    (fun v a t => referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient g L lam x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) v) a t)
    (fun v a t => referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient_skew g hg L lam x _ a t)
    (fun i => fischerInner (finitePolynomialField (fun a => b a j) c x)
      (finitePolynomialField (fun a => d a i j) z x))
  simp only [referenceTensorPolynomialDerivative,fischerInner_sub_right,fischerInner_sum_right,
    fischerInner_C_mul_right,Finset.sum_sub_distrib,Finset.mul_sum,finiteCovectorFischerPair,
    reference_weightedCoordinateDivergence_gramFrame g hg L lam] at *
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at *
  linear_combination -referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * h 0 -
    referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * h 1 - referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * h 2

theorem compact_reference_contracted_tensor_fischer_adjoint (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (d : κ → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (z : R3 → κ → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hz : ContDiff ℝ ∞ z)
    (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c) :
    (∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, fischerInner
      (referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) j)
      (finitePolynomialField (fun a => d a i j) z x))) =
    -(∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, fischerInner
      (finitePolynomialField (fun a => b a j) c x)
      (referenceTensorPolynomialDerivative g L lam d z x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) i j))) := by
  let rho := fun x => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)
  have hr : ContDiff ℝ ∞ rho :=
    (contDiff_referenceDensityFamily g hg L).comp (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id)
  let e := fun x => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x)
  have he (i : Fin 3) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => e x i) :=
    contDiff_referenceMetricGramFrame_slice g hg L lam i
  let A := fun i x => rho x * ∑ j : Fin 3, fischerInner
    (referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x (e x i) j)
    (finitePolynomialField (fun a => d a i j) z x)
  let B := fun i x => rho x * ∑ j : Fin 3, fischerInner
    (finitePolynomialField (fun a => b a j) c x)
    (referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative g L lam (fun a t => d a i t) z x (e x i) j)
  let D := fun i x => weightedCoordinateDivergence rho (fun y => e y i) x *
    finiteCovectorFischerPair b (fun a t => d a i t) c z x
  have hA (i : Fin 3) : Integrable (A i) := by
    simp only [A,Finset.mul_sum]
    exact integrable_finset_sum _ (fun j _ => integrable_referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative_fischer_left
      g hg L lam rho hr.continuous _ (he i) b _ c z hc hz hcompact j)
  have hB (i : Fin 3) : Integrable (B i) := by
    simp only [B,Finset.mul_sum]
    exact integrable_finset_sum _ (fun j _ => integrable_referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative_fischer_right
      g hg L lam rho hr.continuous _ (he i) _ _ c z hc hz hcompact j)
  have hD (i : Fin 3) : Integrable (D i) :=
    ((contDiff_weightedCoordinateDivergence rho _ hr (he i)).continuous.mul
      (contDiff_finiteCovectorFischerPair b _ c z hc hz).continuous).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport (hasCompactSupport_finiteCovectorFischerPair b _ c z hcompact).mul_left
  have hi (i : Fin 3) : (∫ x, A i x) = -(∫ x, B i x) - (∫ x, D i x) :=
    compact_reference_covector_fischer_adjoint g hg L lam rho hr _ (he i) b _ c z hc hz hcompact
  have hs : (∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 3, A i x) =
      -(∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 3, B i x) - (∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 3, D i x) := by
    rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => hA i),integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => hB i),
      integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => hD i),← Finset.sum_neg_distrib,← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hi i)
  have hBsum : Integrable (fun x => ∑ i : Fin 3, B i x) := integrable_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => hB i)
  have hDsum : Integrable (fun x => ∑ i : Fin 3, D i x) := integrable_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => hD i)
  have hright : (fun x => rho x * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, fischerInner
      (finitePolynomialField (fun a => b a j) c x)
      (referenceTensorPolynomialDerivative g L lam d z x (e x i) i j)) =
      fun x => (∑ i : Fin 3, B i x) + ∑ i : Fin 3, D i x :=
    funext (fun x => referenceTensor_contraction_eq_row_add_divergence g hg L lam b d c z x)
  have hleft : (fun x => rho x * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, fischerInner
      (referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x (e x i) j)
      (finitePolynomialField (fun a => d a i j) z x)) = fun x => ∑ i : Fin 3, A i x := by
    funext x; simp only [A,Finset.mul_sum]
  change (∫ x, rho x * _) = -(∫ x, rho x * _)
  rw [hleft,hright,integral_add hBsum hDsum]
  linarith

def referenceWeightedCovectorPolynomialDerivative (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (k s : ℝ) (x V : R3) (j : Fin 3) : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  C s * referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x V j +
    C (k * fderiv ℝ f x V) * finitePolynomialField (fun a => b a j) c x

def referenceWeightedTensorPolynomialDerivative (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (k s : ℝ) (x V : R3) (i j : Fin 3) : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  C s * referenceTensorPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x V i j +
    C (k * fderiv ℝ f x V) * finitePolynomialField (fun a => b a i j) c x

theorem compact_reference_contracted_weighted_tensor_fischer_adjoint (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (d : κ → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (z : R3 → κ → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (k s : ℝ)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hz : ContDiff ℝ ∞ z) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c) :
    (∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, fischerInner
      (referenceWeightedCovectorPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c f k s x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) j)
      (finitePolynomialField (fun a => d a i j) z x))) =
    (∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, fischerInner
      (finitePolynomialField (fun a => b a j) c x)
      (referenceWeightedTensorPolynomialDerivative g L lam d z f k (-s) x
        (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) i j))) := by
  let rho := fun x => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)
  have hr : ContDiff ℝ ∞ rho :=
    (contDiff_referenceDensityFamily g hg L).comp (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id)
  let e := fun x => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x)
  have he (i : Fin 3) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => e x i) :=
    contDiff_referenceMetricGramFrame_slice g hg L lam i
  let A := fun x => rho x * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, fischerInner
    (referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x (e x i) j)
    (finitePolynomialField (fun a => d a i j) z x)
  let B := fun x => rho x * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, fischerInner
    (finitePolynomialField (fun a => b a j) c x)
    (referenceTensorPolynomialDerivative g L lam d z x (e x i) i j)
  let W := fun x => rho x * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
    (k*fderiv ℝ f x (e x i)) * fischerInner
      (finitePolynomialField (fun a => b a j) c x) (finitePolynomialField (fun a => d a i j) z x)
  have hA : Integrable A := by
    simp only [A,Finset.mul_sum]
    exact integrable_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => integrable_finset_sum _ (fun j _ =>
      integrable_referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative_fischer_left g hg L lam rho hr.continuous
        _ (he i) b _ c z hc hz hcompact j))
  have hB : Integrable B := by
    simp only [B,Finset.mul_sum]
    exact integrable_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => integrable_finset_sum _ (fun j _ =>
      integrable_referenceTensorPolynomialDerivative_fischer_right g hg L lam rho hr.continuous
        _ (he i) _ d c z hc hz hcompact i j))
  have hW : Integrable W := by
    simp only [W,Finset.mul_sum]
    apply integrable_finset_sum; intro i hi
    apply integrable_finset_sum; intro j hj
    have hdf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => fderiv ℝ f x (e x i)) :=
      (hf.fderiv_right (m := ∞) (by simp)).clm_apply (he i)
    have hweight : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => k * fderiv ℝ f x (e x i)) :=
      (contDiff_const : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun _ : R3 => k)).mul hdf
    exact (hr.continuous.mul (hweight.continuous.mul
      (contDiff_fischerPair (fun a => b a j) (fun a => d a i j) c z hc hz).continuous)).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
        (hasCompactSupport_fischerPair (fun a => b a j) (fun a => d a i j) c z hcompact).mul_left.mul_left
  have hab : (∫ x : R3, A x) = -(∫ x : R3, B x) :=
    compact_reference_contracted_tensor_fischer_adjoint g hg L lam b d c z hc hz hcompact
  have hl : (fun x => rho x * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, fischerInner
      (referenceWeightedCovectorPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c f k s x (e x i) j)
      (finitePolynomialField (fun a => d a i j) z x)) = fun x => s*A x+W x := by
    funext x
    simp only [referenceWeightedCovectorPolynomialDerivative,fischerInner_add_left,
      fischerInner_C_mul_left,A,W,Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have hright : (fun x => rho x * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, fischerInner
      (finitePolynomialField (fun a => b a j) c x)
      (referenceWeightedTensorPolynomialDerivative g L lam d z f k (-s) x (e x i) i j)) =
      fun x => (-s)*B x+W x := by
    funext x
    simp only [referenceWeightedTensorPolynomialDerivative,fischerInner_add_right,
      fischerInner_C_mul_right,B,W,Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  change (∫ x : R3, rho x * _) = (∫ x : R3, rho x * _)
  rw [hl,hright,integral_add (hA.const_mul _) hW,integral_add (hB.const_mul _) hW,
    integral_const_mul,integral_const_mul,hab]
  ring

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.ContractedFischerAdjunction
``````

## Calderon.FiniteCovariantCurvature

SHA256 `2640d9d0eff9613d799dfc0ecca567f9e1d23f49b5c2922b9dae355b1e793adb`.

``````lean
import Calderon.WeightedFischerSquare
import Calderon.MetricFiberFischer
import Calderon.IndexedCovariantCurvature
import Calderon.FullCovectorCurvature
import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Funext

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 10
noncomputable section
open MvPolynomial
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.FiniteCovariantCurvature
open RadiusProfile ConformalDepth MetricOperator AngularPolynomial CurvatureSkew
  MovingFrameConnection FischerConnectionTransport WeightedFischerSquare
  SmoothMetricFrame FrameCurvaturePolynomial MetricFiberMeasure MetricFiberFischer
  HorizontalCurvature VaryingHorizontalCurvature IndexedCovariantCurvature
  PolynomialSlotCompatibility FullCovectorCurvature

attribute [local irreducible] referenceMetricGramFrame referenceConnectionFamily
  metricOperatorField referenceMetric dilatedMetric
  referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient frameConnectionCoefficient covariantFrameDerivative

variable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]

lemma referenceMovingFramePolynomial_eq_metricFramePolynomial
    (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (x v : R3) :
    referenceMovingFramePolynomial g L lam p (x,v) =
      metricFramePolynomial (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x)
        (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x)) p v := by
  unfold referenceMovingFramePolynomial movingFramePolynomial metricFramePolynomial
  apply congrArg (fun w : Fin 3 → ℝ => eval w p)
  funext i
  exact (metricFrameCoordinates_apply _ _ _ i).symm

lemma referenceMovingFramePolynomial_injective (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (x : R3) (p q : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (h : ∀ v : R3, referenceMovingFramePolynomial g L lam p (x,v) =
      referenceMovingFramePolynomial g L lam q (x,v)) : p = q := by
  apply MvPolynomial.funext
  intro w
  have he := referenceMetricGramFrame_isMetricOrthonormalFrame g hg L (lam,x)
  have hv := h (metricFrameSynthesis _ _ he (WithLp.toLp 2 w))
  simp only [referenceMovingFramePolynomial_eq_metricFramePolynomial,
    metricFramePolynomial_synthesis] at hv
  simpa using hv

lemma referenceHorizontalCurvaturePolynomial_finite (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (x : R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3) (i j : Fin 3)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) :
    referenceHorizontalCurvaturePolynomial g L lam x e i j (finitePolynomialField b c x) =
      ∑ a, c x a • referenceHorizontalCurvaturePolynomial g L lam x e i j (b a) := by
  let T : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ :=
    { toFun := fun p => -polynomialMatrixVectorField
        (CurvatureRotation.referenceCurvatureRotationCoefficient g L lam x e i j) p
      map_add' := fun p q => by rw [polynomialMatrixVectorField_add,neg_add]
      map_smul' := fun a p => by simp only [polynomialMatrixVectorField_smul,smul_neg,RingHom.id_apply] }
  change T (∑ a, c x a • b a) = ∑ a, c x a • T (b a)
  simp only [map_sum,map_smul]

lemma referenceHorizontalDerivative_eq_evaluated_augmented
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c)
    (V : R3 → R3) :
    vectorFieldDeriv (varyingHorizontalVectorField (fun y => referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,y)) V)
      (evaluatedReferencePolynomialField g L lam b c) =
    evaluatedReferencePolynomialField g L lam (covariantDerivativePolynomialFamily b)
      (covariantDerivativeCoefficientFamily g L lam c V) := by
  funext z
  change fderiv ℝ (evaluatedReferencePolynomialField g L lam b c) z
    (V z.1,-referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,z.1) (V z.1) z.2) = _
  rw [fderiv_evaluatedReferencePolynomialField_horizontal g hg L lam b c hc,
    referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_eq_finite_augmented]
  exact (evaluatedReferencePolynomialField_eq g L lam _ _ z).symm

def referenceIndexedPolynomialHessian (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (x : R3) (i j : Fin 3) :
    MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam (covariantDerivativePolynomialFamily b)
    (covariantDerivativeCoefficientFamily g L lam c (fun y => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y) j))
    x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) -
    ∑ a : Fin 3, C (referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient g L lam x
      (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) a j) *
      referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) a)

lemma referenceIndexedPolynomialHessian_evaluation (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (x v : R3) (i j : Fin 3) :
    referenceMovingFramePolynomial g L lam (referenceIndexedPolynomialHessian g L lam b c x i j) (x,v) =
      referenceIndexedCovariantHessian g L lam (evaluatedReferencePolynomialField g L lam b c) i j (x,v) := by
  unfold referenceIndexedCovariantHessian indexedCovariantHessian
  rw [referenceHorizontalDerivative_eq_evaluated_augmented g hg L lam b c hc]
  have hq := contDiff_covariantDerivativeCoefficientFamily g hg L lam c
    (fun y => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y) j) hc
    (contDiff_referenceMetricGramFrame_slice g hg L lam j)
  change _ = fderiv ℝ
    (evaluatedReferencePolynomialField g L lam (covariantDerivativePolynomialFamily b)
      (covariantDerivativeCoefficientFamily g L lam c (fun y => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y) j)))
    (x,v) (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i,
      -referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,x) (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) v) - _
  rw [fderiv_evaluatedReferencePolynomialField_horizontal g hg L lam _ _ hq]
  have hfirst (a : Fin 3) := fderiv_evaluatedReferencePolynomialField_horizontal g hg L lam b c hc x v
    (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) a)
  simp only [vectorFieldDeriv,varyingHorizontalVectorField] at *
  simp_rw [hfirst]
  simp only [referenceIndexedPolynomialHessian,referenceMovingFramePolynomial,movingFramePolynomial,
    map_sub,map_sum,map_mul,eval_C,smul_eq_mul,referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient]

lemma fderiv_referencePolynomialFieldSummand_vertical (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (a : ι) (x v Y : R3) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun z : R3 × R3 => c z.1 a * referenceMovingFramePolynomial g L lam p z)
      (x,v) (0,Y) = c x a * fderiv ℝ (referenceMovingFramePolynomial g L lam p) (x,v) (0,Y) := by
  have hbase : HasFDerivAt (fun z : R3 × R3 => c z.1)
      ((fderiv ℝ c x).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ R3 R3)) (x,v) :=
    ((hc.differentiable (by simp) x).hasFDerivAt).comp (x,v) (hasFDerivAt_fst (p := (x,v)))
  have hcoef := (ContinuousLinearMap.proj a : (ι → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt.comp (x,v) hbase
  have hpoly := ((contDiff_referenceMovingFramePolynomial g hg L lam p).differentiable
    (by simp) (x,v)).hasFDerivAt
  have hp := hcoef.mul hpoly
  change HasFDerivAt (fun z : R3 × R3 => c z.1 a * referenceMovingFramePolynomial g L lam p z) _ (x,v) at hp
  rw [hp.fderiv]
  change c x a * fderiv ℝ (referenceMovingFramePolynomial g L lam p) (x,v) (0,Y) +
    referenceMovingFramePolynomial g L lam p (x,v) * (fderiv ℝ c x 0) a = _
  simp only [map_zero,Pi.zero_apply,mul_zero,add_zero]

lemma fderiv_evaluatedReferencePolynomialField_vertical_curvature (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (x v : R3) (i j : Fin 3) :
    fderiv ℝ (evaluatedReferencePolynomialField g L lam b c) (x,v)
      (0,-CurvatureRotation.referenceCurvatureAction g L lam x
        (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) j) v) =
    referenceMovingFramePolynomial g L lam
      (referenceHorizontalCurvaturePolynomial g L lam x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x)) i j
        (finitePolynomialField b c x)) (x,v) := by
  rw [show evaluatedReferencePolynomialField g L lam b c =
    (fun z : R3 × R3 => ∑ a, c z.1 a * referenceMovingFramePolynomial g L lam (b a) z) from rfl]
  rw [fderiv_fun_sum (fun a _ => ((contDiff_referencePolynomialFieldSummand g hg L lam (b a) c hc a).differentiable (by simp) (x,v)))]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
  simp_rw [fderiv_referencePolynomialFieldSummand_vertical g hg L lam _ c hc,
    fderiv_referenceMovingFramePolynomial_vertical_curvature g hg L lam]
  rw [referenceHorizontalCurvaturePolynomial_finite]
  simp only [referenceMovingFramePolynomial_eq_metricFramePolynomial,metricFramePolynomial,map_sum,
    smul_eq_C_mul,map_mul,eval_C]

theorem referenceIndexedPolynomialHessian_antisymm (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (x : R3) (i j : Fin 3) :
    referenceIndexedPolynomialHessian g L lam b c x i j -
      referenceIndexedPolynomialHessian g L lam b c x j i =
    referenceHorizontalCurvaturePolynomial g L lam x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x)) i j
      (finitePolynomialField b c x) := by
  apply referenceMovingFramePolynomial_injective g hg L lam x
  intro v
  have h := referenceIndexedCovariantHessian_antisymm g hg L lam
    (evaluatedReferencePolynomialField g L lam b c)
    (contDiff_evaluatedReferencePolynomialField g hg L lam b c hc) x v i j
  rw [fderiv_evaluatedReferencePolynomialField_vertical_curvature g hg L lam b c hc] at h
  rw [← referenceIndexedPolynomialHessian_evaluation g hg L lam b c hc,
    ← referenceIndexedPolynomialHessian_evaluation g hg L lam b c hc] at h
  simpa only [referenceMovingFramePolynomial,movingFramePolynomial,map_sub] using h

lemma referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative_partial_eq_augmented (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (V : R3 → R3) (x : R3) (l : Fin 3) :
    referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative g L lam (fun a t => pderiv t (b a)) c x (V x) l =
    finitePolynomialField (fun a => pderiv l (covariantDerivativePolynomialFamily b a))
      (covariantDerivativeCoefficientFamily g L lam c V) x := by
  rw [referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative_partial,
    referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_eq_finite_augmented,finitePolynomialField_partial]

def referenceLoweredCovectorIndexedHessian (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (x : R3) (i j l : Fin 3) :
    MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative g L lam
    (fun a t => pderiv t (covariantDerivativePolynomialFamily b a))
    (covariantDerivativeCoefficientFamily g L lam c (fun y => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y) j))
    x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) l -
    ∑ a : Fin 3, C (referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient g L lam x
      (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) a j) *
      referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative g L lam (fun a t => pderiv t (b a)) c x
        (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) a) l

lemma referenceLoweredCovectorIndexedHessian_eq_partial (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (x : R3) (i j l : Fin 3) :
    referenceLoweredCovectorIndexedHessian g L lam b c x i j l =
      pderiv l (referenceIndexedPolynomialHessian g L lam b c x i j) := by
  simp only [referenceLoweredCovectorIndexedHessian,referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative_partial,
    referenceIndexedPolynomialHessian,map_sub,map_sum,pderiv_C_mul]

theorem referenceLoweredCovectorIndexedHessian_antisymm (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (x : R3) (i j l : Fin 3) :
    referenceLoweredCovectorIndexedHessian g L lam b c x i j l -
      referenceLoweredCovectorIndexedHessian g L lam b c x j i l =
    referenceCovectorCurvaturePolynomial g L lam x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x)) i j
      (fun a => pderiv a (finitePolynomialField b c x)) l := by
  rw [referenceLoweredCovectorIndexedHessian_eq_partial,
    referenceLoweredCovectorIndexedHessian_eq_partial,← map_sub,
    referenceIndexedPolynomialHessian_antisymm g hg L lam b c hc,
    referenceCovectorCurvaturePolynomial_partial]

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.FiniteCovariantCurvature

``````

## Calderon.FiniteHarmonicEnergy

SHA256 `6ef6f56ab0b99ab423cea41dbeecec8aeac321845678df174942d449d208494c`.

``````lean
import Calderon.FiniteProfileNormComparison

set_option autoImplicit false
universe u v
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory MvPolynomial
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.FiniteHarmonicEnergy
open RadiusProfile SphereHarmonic AngularPolynomial ConformalDepth MetricOperator
  SmoothMetricFrame FrameCurvaturePolynomial MetricFiberMeasure MetricFiberFischer
  MetricFiberCovectorTransport FischerConnectionTransport FiniteRaisingEnergy
  FiniteProfileNormComparison ReferenceDensityBounds MovingFrameConnection HorizontalCurvature
variable {σ : Type*} [Fintype σ]

lemma polynomialSphereL2_sum_norm_sq (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (d : σ → ℕ) (hd : Function.Injective d) (q : σ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hq : ∀ a, q a ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (d a)) :
    ‖polynomialSphereL2 (∑ a, q a)‖^2 = ∑ a, ‖polynomialSphereL2 (q a)‖^2 := by
  classical
  rw [map_sum,← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq,sum_inner]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  rw [inner_sum]
  calc
    _ = ⟪polynomialSphereL2 (q a),polynomialSphereL2 (q a)⟫_ℝ := by
      apply Finset.sum_eq_single a
      · intro b _ hba
        exact hO (d a) (d b) (fun h => hba (hd h).symm) _
          (polynomialSphereL2_mem _ _ (hq a)) _ (polynomialSphereL2_mem _ _ (hq b))
      · simp
    _ = _ := real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq _

lemma polynomialSphereL2_scaled_sum_norm_sq (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (d : σ → ℕ) (hd : Function.Injective d) (q : σ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hq : ∀ a, q a ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (d a)) (r : σ → ℝ) :
    ‖polynomialSphereL2 (∑ a, r a • q a)‖^2 = ∑ a, (r a)^2*‖polynomialSphereL2 (q a)‖^2 := by
  rw [polynomialSphereL2_sum_norm_sq hO d hd _
    (fun a => (harmonicHomogeneous (d a)).smul_mem (r a) (hq a))]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  rw [map_smul, norm_smul, mul_pow, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]

lemma metricFramePolynomial_sum_square (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3) (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame M e)
    (d : σ → ℕ) (hd : Function.Injective d) (q : σ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hq : ∀ a, q a ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (d a)) (r : σ → ℝ) :
    (∫ v : R3, (metricFramePolynomial M e (∑ a, r a • q a) v)^2 ∂metricFrameProbability M e he) =
      ∑ a, (r a)^2*(∫ v : R3, (metricFramePolynomial M e (q a) v)^2 ∂metricFrameProbability M e he) := by
  simp only [pow_two,metricFramePolynomial_fiber_integral_pair,real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  simpa only [pow_two] using polynomialSphereL2_scaled_sum_norm_sq hO d hd q hq r

lemma metricFrameCovectorPair_scaled_sum (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (M : R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3) (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame M e)
    (d : σ → ℕ) (hd : Function.Injective d) (q : σ → Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hq : ∀ a i, q a i ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (d a)) (r : σ → ℝ) :
    metricFrameCovectorPair M e he (fun i => ∑ a, r a • q a i) (fun i => ∑ a, r a • q a i) =
      ∑ a, (r a)^2*metricFrameCovectorPair M e he (q a) (q a) := by
  simp only [metricFrameCovectorPair_eq_sum,← pow_two]
  simp_rw [metricFramePolynomial_sum_square hO M e he d hd _ (fun a => hq a _) r]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp only [Finset.mul_sum]

lemma referenceFiberPolynomialSquare_scaled_sum (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (x : R3)
    (d : σ → ℕ) (hd : Function.Injective d) (q : σ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hq : ∀ a, q a ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (d a)) (r : σ → ℝ) :
    referenceFiberPolynomialSquare g hg L lam x (∑ a, r a • q a) =
      ∑ a, (r a)^2*referenceFiberPolynomialSquare g hg L lam x (q a) :=
  metricFramePolynomial_sum_square hO _ _ _ d hd q hq r

lemma referenceFiberCovectorPair_scaled_sum (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (x : R3)
    (d : σ → ℕ) (hd : Function.Injective d) (q : σ → Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hq : ∀ a i, q a i ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (d a)) (r : σ → ℝ) :
    referenceFiberCovectorPair g hg L lam x (fun i => ∑ a, r a • q a i) (fun i => ∑ a, r a • q a i) =
      ∑ a, (r a)^2*referenceFiberCovectorPair g hg L lam x (q a) (q a) :=
  metricFrameCovectorPair_scaled_sum hO _ _ _ d hd q hq r

lemma referenceFiberPolynomialSquare_norm (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (x : R3) (q : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    referenceFiberPolynomialSquare g hg L lam x q = ‖polynomialSphereL2 q‖^2 := by
  simp only [referenceFiberPolynomialSquare,pow_two,metricFramePolynomial_fiber_integral_pair,
    real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]

lemma integral_referenceFiberPolynomialSquare_sum (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (d : σ → ℕ) (hd : Function.Injective d) (q : σ → R3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hq : ∀ a x, q a x ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (d a))
    (hL1 : ∀ a, Integrable (fun x => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*‖polynomialSphereL2 (q a x)‖^2)) :
    Integrable (fun x => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*
      referenceFiberPolynomialSquare g hg L lam x (∑ a, q a x)) ∧
    (∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*
      referenceFiberPolynomialSquare g hg L lam x (∑ a, q a x)) =
      ∑ a, ∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*‖polynomialSphereL2 (q a x)‖^2 := by
  have heq (x : R3) : referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*
      referenceFiberPolynomialSquare g hg L lam x (∑ a, q a x) =
      ∑ a, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*‖polynomialSphereL2 (q a x)‖^2 := by
    rw [referenceFiberPolynomialSquare_norm,polynomialSphereL2_sum_norm_sq hO d hd _ (fun a => hq a x),Finset.mul_sum]
  have hsum := integrable_finset_sum Finset.univ (fun a _ => hL1 a)
  refine ⟨hsum.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => (heq x).symm)),?_⟩
  simp_rw [heq]
  exact integral_finsetSum _ (fun a _ => hL1 a)

variable {ι : Type u} [Fintype ι]

def finiteReferenceSection (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : σ → ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : σ → R3 → ι → ℝ) : R3 × R3 → ℝ :=
  fun z => ∑ a, evaluatedReferencePolynomialField g L lam (b a) (c a) z

theorem fderiv_finiteReferenceSection_horizontal (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (b : σ → ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : σ → R3 → ι → ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ a, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (c a)) (x v X : R3) :
    fderiv ℝ (finiteReferenceSection g L lam b c) (x,v)
      (X,-referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,x) X v) =
      metricFramePolynomial (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x)
        (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x))
        (∑ a, referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam (b a) (c a) x X) v := by
  unfold finiteReferenceSection
  rw [fderiv_fun_sum (fun a _ =>
    (contDiff_evaluatedReferencePolynomialField g hg L lam (b a) (c a) (hc a)).differentiable (by simp) (x,v))]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]
  simp_rw [fderiv_evaluatedReferencePolynomialField_horizontal g hg L lam _ _ (hc _) x v X]
  have hcoords : metricFrameCoordinates (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x)
      (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x)) v =
      fun i => ⟪metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x v,
        referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i⟫_ℝ := by
    funext i
    exact metricFrameCoordinates_apply _ _ v i
  simp only [referenceMovingFramePolynomial,movingFramePolynomial,metricFramePolynomial,map_sum]
  rw [hcoords]
  rfl

lemma harmonic_sum_sphere_zero_imp_components (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (d : σ → ℕ) (hd : Function.Injective d)
    (q : σ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hq : ∀ a, q a ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (d a))
    (hzero : ∀ theta : UnitSphere, (∑ a, q a).eval (theta.val : Fin 3 → ℝ) = 0) :
    ∀ a, q a = 0 := by
  have hs : polynomialSphere (∑ a, q a) = 0 := by ext theta; exact hzero theta
  have hL : polynomialSphereL2 (∑ a, q a) = 0 := by
    change (ContinuousMap.toLp 2 sphereProbability ℝ) (polynomialSphere (∑ a, q a)) = 0
    rw [hs,map_zero]
  have hsum : (∑ a, ‖polynomialSphereL2 (q a)‖^2) = 0 := by
    rw [← polynomialSphereL2_sum_norm_sq hO d hd q hq,hL,norm_zero]
    norm_num
  intro a
  have hle : ‖polynomialSphereL2 (q a)‖^2 ≤ 0 := by
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ b, ‖polynomialSphereL2 (q b)‖^2 :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (fun b (_ : b ∈ Finset.univ) => sq_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ a)
      _ = 0 := hsum
  have hz : ‖polynomialSphereL2 (q a)‖^2 = 0 := le_antisymm hle (sq_nonneg _)
  exact (polynomialSphereL2_eq_zero_iff hF (d a) (q a) (hq a)).mp
    (norm_eq_zero.mp (sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hz))

def finiteReferenceProfileEnergyDensity (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (lam δ R L : ℝ) (p : ℕ) (m : σ → ℕ)
    (b : σ → ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : σ → R3 → ι → ℝ) (x : R3) : ℝ :=
  let U := fun a => finitePolynomialField (b a) (c a) x
  let Q := fun a i => referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam (b a) (c a) x
    (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i)
  let w := fun a => 1+((m a+1:ℕ):ℝ)
  let beta := referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x
  referenceFiberCovectorPair g hg L lam x (fun i => ∑ a, Q a i) (fun i => ∑ a, Q a i) +
    beta^2*referenceFiberPolynomialSquare g hg L lam x (∑ a, w a • U a) +
    beta⁻¹*referenceFiberCovectorPair g hg L lam x
      (fun i => ∑ a, Real.sqrt (w a) • Q a i) (fun i => ∑ a, Real.sqrt (w a) • Q a i) +
    beta*referenceFiberPolynomialSquare g hg L lam x (∑ a, (w a*Real.sqrt (w a)) • U a)

def finiteReferenceProfileEnergy (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (lam δ R L : ℝ) (p : ℕ) (m : σ → ℕ)
    (b : σ → ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : σ → R3 → ι → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*finiteReferenceProfileEnergyDensity g hg lam δ R L p m b c x

lemma finiteReferenceProfileEnergyDensity_eq_sum (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (lam δ R L : ℝ) (p : ℕ)
    (m : σ → ℕ) (hm : Function.Injective m)
    (b : σ → ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hb : ∀ a j, b a j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (m a+1))
    (c : σ → R3 → ι → ℝ) (x : R3) :
    finiteReferenceProfileEnergyDensity g hg lam δ R L p m b c x =
      ∑ a, referenceProfileModeEnergyDensity g hg lam δ R L p (m a+1) (b a) (c a) x := by
  let U := fun a => finitePolynomialField (b a) (c a) x
  let Q := fun a i => referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam (b a) (c a) x
    (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i)
  let w := fun a => 1+((m a+1:ℕ):ℝ)
  let beta := referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x
  have hd : Function.Injective (fun a => m a+1) := by
    intro a b h
    exact hm (Nat.add_right_cancel h)
  have hU : ∀ a, U a ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (m a+1) := fun a => finitePolynomialField_harmonicHomogeneous _ _ (hb a) _ x
  have hQ : ∀ a i, Q a i ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (m a+1) := fun a i =>
    referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_harmonicHomogeneous g hg L lam (m a+1) (by omega)
      (b a) (hb a) (c a) x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i)
  have hG := referenceFiberCovectorPair_scaled_sum hO g hg L lam x (fun a => m a+1) hd Q hQ (fun _ => 1)
  simp only [one_smul,one_pow,one_mul] at hG
  have hhalf := referenceFiberCovectorPair_scaled_sum hO g hg L lam x (fun a => m a+1) hd Q hQ (fun a => Real.sqrt (w a))
  have hV := referenceFiberPolynomialSquare_scaled_sum hO g hg L lam x (fun a => m a+1) hd U hU w
  have hthree := referenceFiberPolynomialSquare_scaled_sum hO g hg L lam x (fun a => m a+1) hd U hU (fun a => w a*Real.sqrt (w a))
  have hsqrt (a : σ) : (Real.sqrt (w a))^2 = w a := Real.sq_sqrt (by dsimp only [w]; positivity)
  change referenceFiberCovectorPair g hg L lam x (fun i => ∑ a, Q a i) (fun i => ∑ a, Q a i) +
    beta^2*referenceFiberPolynomialSquare g hg L lam x (∑ a, w a • U a) +
    beta⁻¹*referenceFiberCovectorPair g hg L lam x (fun i => ∑ a, Real.sqrt (w a) • Q a i) (fun i => ∑ a, Real.sqrt (w a) • Q a i) +
    beta*referenceFiberPolynomialSquare g hg L lam x (∑ a, (w a*Real.sqrt (w a)) • U a) = _
  rw [hG,hV,hhalf,hthree]
  simp_rw [mul_pow,hsqrt]
  simp only [Finset.mul_sum,← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a _
  dsimp only [referenceProfileModeEnergyDensity,U,Q,w,beta]
  ring

theorem finiteReferenceProfileEnergy_integrable_and_eq (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (lam δ R L : ℝ) (p : ℕ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hR : 0 < R) (hL : 0 < L) (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (m : σ → ℕ) (hm : Function.Injective m)
    (b : σ → ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hb : ∀ a j, b a j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (m a+1))
    (c : σ → R3 → ι → ℝ) (hc : ∀ a, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (c a))
    (hcompact : ∀ a, HasCompactSupport (c a)) :
    Integrable (fun x => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*finiteReferenceProfileEnergyDensity g hg lam δ R L p m b c x) ∧
    finiteReferenceProfileEnergy g hg lam δ R L p m b c =
      ∑ a, referenceProfileModeEnergy g hg lam δ R L p (m a+1) (b a) (c a) := by
  have hmode (a : σ) := (referenceProfileModeEnergy_integrable_and_eq hF g hg lam δ R L p (m a+1)
    hδ hR hL hp (by omega) (b a) (hb a) (c a) (hc a) (hcompact a)).1
  have heq (x : R3) : referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*finiteReferenceProfileEnergyDensity g hg lam δ R L p m b c x =
      ∑ a, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*referenceProfileModeEnergyDensity g hg lam δ R L p (m a+1) (b a) (c a) x := by
    rw [finiteReferenceProfileEnergyDensity_eq_sum hO g hg lam δ R L p m hm b hb c x,Finset.mul_sum]
  have hsum := integrable_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun a _ => hmode a)
  refine ⟨hsum.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => (heq x).symm)),?_⟩
  unfold finiteReferenceProfileEnergy
  simp_rw [heq]
  exact integral_finsetSum _ (fun a _ => hmode a)

def finiteReferenceRaisingEnergy (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (m : σ → ℕ) (b : σ → ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : σ → R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*referenceFiberPolynomialSquare g hg L lam x
    (∑ a, referenceRaisedPolynomialField g L lam (b a) (c a) f (m a) x)

def finiteReferenceLoweringEnergy (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (m : σ → ℕ) (b : σ → ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : σ → R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*referenceFiberPolynomialSquare g hg L lam x
    (∑ a, referenceLoweredPolynomialField g L lam (b a) (c a) f (m a) x)

theorem finiteReferenceRaisingEnergy_integrable_and_eq (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (m : σ → ℕ) (hm : Function.Injective m)
    (b : σ → ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hb : ∀ a j, b a j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (m a+1))
    (c : σ → R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (hc : ∀ a, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (c a))
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hcompact : ∀ a, HasCompactSupport (c a)) :
    Integrable (fun x => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*referenceFiberPolynomialSquare g hg L lam x
      (∑ a, referenceRaisedPolynomialField g L lam (b a) (c a) f (m a) x)) ∧
    finiteReferenceRaisingEnergy g hg L lam m b c f =
      ∑ a, referenceRaisingEnergy g L lam (b a) (c a) f (m a) := by
  have hd : Function.Injective (fun a => m a+2) := by
    intro a b h
    exact hm (Nat.add_right_cancel h)
  exact integral_referenceFiberPolynomialSquare_sum hO g hg L lam (fun a => m a+2) hd
    (fun a x => referenceRaisedPolynomialField g L lam (b a) (c a) f (m a) x)
    (fun a x => referenceRaisedPolynomialField_harmonicHomogeneous g hg L lam (m a) (b a) (hb a) (c a) f x)
    (fun a => integrable_referenceRaisingEnergy hF g hg L lam (m a) (b a) (hb a) (c a) f (hc a) hf (hcompact a))

theorem finiteReferenceLoweringEnergy_integrable_and_eq (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (m : σ → ℕ) (hm : Function.Injective m)
    (b : σ → ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hb : ∀ a j, b a j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (m a+1))
    (c : σ → R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (hc : ∀ a, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (c a))
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hcompact : ∀ a, HasCompactSupport (c a)) :
    Integrable (fun x => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*referenceFiberPolynomialSquare g hg L lam x
      (∑ a, referenceLoweredPolynomialField g L lam (b a) (c a) f (m a) x)) ∧
    finiteReferenceLoweringEnergy g hg L lam m b c f =
      ∑ a, referenceLoweringEnergy g L lam (b a) (c a) f (m a) := by
  exact integral_referenceFiberPolynomialSquare_sum hO g hg L lam m hm
    (fun a x => referenceLoweredPolynomialField g L lam (b a) (c a) f (m a) x)
    (fun a x => referenceLoweredPolynomialField_harmonicHomogeneous g hg L lam (m a) (b a) (hb a) (c a) f x)
    (fun a => integrable_referenceLoweringEnergy hF g hg L lam (m a) (b a) (hb a) (c a) f (hc a) hf (hcompact a))

lemma finiteReferenceSection_eq_metricFramePolynomial (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : σ → ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : σ → R3 → ι → ℝ) (x v : R3) :
    finiteReferenceSection g L lam b c (x,v) =
      metricFramePolynomial (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x)
        (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x)) (∑ a, finitePolynomialField (b a) (c a) x) v := by
  have hcoords : metricFrameCoordinates (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x)
      (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x)) v =
      fun i => ⟪metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x v,
        referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i⟫_ℝ := by
    funext i
    exact metricFrameCoordinates_apply _ _ v i
  simp only [finiteReferenceSection,evaluatedReferencePolynomialField,referenceMovingFramePolynomial,
    movingFramePolynomial,metricFramePolynomial,finitePolynomialField,movingFrameCoordinate,
    map_sum,map_smul,smul_eq_C_mul,map_mul,eval_C]
  rw [hcoords]

theorem exists_finiteReferenceProfileEnergy_uniform_coercivity (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ L cRaise : ℝ, 0 < L ∧ 0 < cRaise ∧
      ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ p : ℕ, 2 ≤ p ∧ ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧
        (∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 → ∀ x ∈ K,
          ‖fderiv ℝ (referenceRadius δ R p L) x‖ ≤ ε ∧
          referenceRadius δ R p L x * referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x^2 ≤ ε) ∧
        ∀ (ζ : Type v) [Fintype ζ] (τ : Type u) [Fintype τ],
          ∀ hF : SphereFischerInner, ∀ hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics,
          ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 →
          ∀ m : ζ → ℕ, Function.Injective m →
          ∀ b : ζ → τ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ, (∀ a j, b a j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (m a+1)) →
          ∀ c : ζ → R3 → τ → ℝ, (∀ a, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (c a)) → (∀ a, HasCompactSupport (c a)) →
          (∀ x ∉ K, ∀ v ∈ metricUnitFiber (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x),
            finiteReferenceSection g L lam b c (x,v) = 0) →
          cRaise*finiteReferenceProfileEnergy g hg lam δ R L p m b c ≤
            finiteReferenceRaisingEnergy g hg L lam m b c (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) -
              finiteReferenceLoweringEnergy g hg L lam m b c (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) := by
  obtain ⟨L,C,hL,hC,hall⟩ := exists_referenceProfileModeEnergy_uniform_coercivity.{u} g hg K hK
  refine ⟨L,C,hL,hC,?_⟩
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨p,hp,R,hR,hsmall,hone⟩ := hall ε hε
  refine ⟨p,hp,R,hR,hsmall,?_⟩
  intro ζ instζ τ instτ hF hO lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 m hm b hb c hc hcompact hzero
  have hcomponent : ∀ a x, x ∉ K → finitePolynomialField (b a) (c a) x = 0 := by
    intro a x hx
    apply harmonic_sum_sphere_zero_imp_components hF hO (fun a => m a+1)
      (fun a b h => hm (Nat.add_right_cancel h)) (fun a => finitePolynomialField (b a) (c a) x)
      (fun a => finitePolynomialField_harmonicHomogeneous _ _ (hb a) _ x) ?_ a
    intro theta
    have hh := hzero x hx _ (metricFrameSphereMap_mem_metricUnitFiber _ _
      (referenceMetricGramFrame_isMetricOrthonormalFrame g hg L (lam,x)) theta)
    rw [finiteReferenceSection_eq_metricFramePolynomial,metricFrameSphereMap,metricFramePolynomial_synthesis] at hh
    exact hh
  have hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) := contDiff_log_referenceRadius δ R p L hδ hR
  rw [(finiteReferenceProfileEnergy_integrable_and_eq hF hO g hg lam δ R L p hδ hR hL
      (by omega) m hm b hb c hc hcompact).2,
    (finiteReferenceRaisingEnergy_integrable_and_eq hF hO g hg L lam m hm b hb c (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) hc hf hcompact).2,
    (finiteReferenceLoweringEnergy_integrable_and_eq hF hO g hg L lam m hm b hb c (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) hc hf hcompact).2,
    Finset.mul_sum,← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun a _ => hone τ hF lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 (m a) (b a) (hb a)
    (c a) (hc a) (hcompact a) (fun x hx => hcomponent a x hx))

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.FiniteHarmonicEnergy

``````

## Calderon.FiniteProfileNormComparison

SHA256 `518a570486ee1b32d225ee144b94eab6c3841236dbfd59d8ba76f80d80d0d7df`.

``````lean
import Calderon.FiniteProfileRaisingGain
import Calderon.MetricFiberCovectorTransport

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 10
universe u
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory MvPolynomial
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Gradient Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.FiniteProfileNormComparison
open RadiusProfile ConformalDepth MetricOperator AngularPolynomial SphereHarmonic
  WeightedFischerSquare SmoothMetricFrame FischerConnectionTransport
  IntegratedFischerIdentities FiniteRaisingEnergy WeightedRaisingBounds
  ProfileHessianEnergy IntegratedProfileConvexity ReferenceDensityBounds
  FiniteProfileRaisingGain MetricFiberMeasure MetricFiberFischer MetricFiberCovectorTransport
  FrameCurvaturePolynomial
attribute [local irreducible] referenceMetricGramFrame referenceConnectionFamily
  metricOperatorField referenceMetric dilatedMetric finitePolynomialField
variable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]

def referenceProfileSecondMass (g : MatrixField) (lam δ R L : ℝ) (p : ℕ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x^2*
    fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField b c x)

def referenceProfileModeFischerEnergy (g : MatrixField) (lam δ R L : ℝ) (p k : ℕ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  referenceProfileFrameEnergy g lam δ R L p b c 0 1 +
    (1+(k:ℝ))^2*referenceProfileSecondMass g lam δ R L p b c +
    (1+(k:ℝ))*referenceProfileWeightedFrameEnergy g lam δ R L p b c 0 1 +
    (1+(k:ℝ))^3*referenceProfileMass g lam δ R L p b c

lemma referenceProfileSecondMass_nonneg (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (lam δ R L : ℝ) (p : ℕ) (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) :
    0 ≤ referenceProfileSecondMass g lam δ R L p b c := by
  exact integral_nonneg (fun x => mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg
    (referenceDensityFamily_pos g hg L (lam,x)).le (sq_nonneg _)) (fischerInner_self_nonneg _))

lemma referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative_zero (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (x V : R3) :
    referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c f 0 1 x V =
      referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x V := by
  simp only [referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative,zero_mul,map_zero,map_one,one_mul,mul_zero,add_zero]

lemma referenceWeightedFrameEnergy_parallelogram (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ)
    (f : R3 → ℝ) (k : ℝ) (x : R3) :
    referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g L lam b c f k 1 x + referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g L lam b c f k (-1) x =
      2*referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g L lam b c f 0 1 x +
      2*k^2*metricDifferentialNorm (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) f x^2*
        fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField b c x) := by
  have hi (i : Fin 3) : fischerInner
      (referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c f k 1 x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i))
      (referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c f k 1 x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i)) +
      fischerInner
      (referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c f k (-1) x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i))
      (referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c f k (-1) x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i)) =
      2*fischerInner (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i))
        (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i)) +
      2*k^2*(fderiv ℝ f x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i))^2*
        fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField b c x) := by
    simp only [referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative,fischerInner_weighted_square]
    ring
  rw [referenceMetricDifferentialNorm_sq_eq_frame_sum g hg L lam f x]
  simp only [referenceWeightedFrameEnergy,← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  simp_rw [hi,referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative_zero]
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib,Finset.mul_sum,Finset.sum_mul]

lemma referenceProfileFrameEnergy_parallelogram (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (lam δ R L : ℝ) (p : ℕ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hR : 0 < R)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c) (k : ℝ) :
    referenceProfileFrameEnergy g lam δ R L p b c k 1 + referenceProfileFrameEnergy g lam δ R L p b c k (-1) =
      2*referenceProfileFrameEnergy g lam δ R L p b c 0 1 + 2*k^2*referenceProfileSecondMass g lam δ R L p b c := by
  let f := referenceLogRadius δ R p L
  let rho := fun x : R3 => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)
  have hf := contDiff_log_referenceRadius δ R p L hδ hR
  have hr : Continuous rho := ((contDiff_referenceDensityFamily g hg L).comp (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id)).continuous
  have hp := integrable_referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g hg L lam rho hr b c f k 1 hc hf hcompact
  have hm := integrable_referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g hg L lam rho hr b c f k (-1) hc hf hcompact
  have hG := integrable_referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g hg L lam rho hr b c f 0 1 hc hf hcompact
  have hV : Integrable (fun x => rho x*referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x^2*
      fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField b c x)) := by
    simpa only [rho,Pi.pow_apply] using integrable_referenceDensity_weighted_fischerPair g hg L lam _
      ((continuous_referenceProfileNorm g hg lam δ R L p hδ hR).pow 2) b b c c hc hc hcompact
  rw [referenceProfileFrameEnergy,referenceProfileFrameEnergy,← integral_add hp hm]
  calc
    _ = ∫ x : R3, 2*(rho x*referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g L lam b c f 0 1 x)+
        (2*k^2)*(rho x*referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x^2*fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField b c x)) := by
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [] with x
      have hh := referenceWeightedFrameEnergy_parallelogram g hg L lam b c f k x
      unfold referenceProfileNorm
      dsimp only [f,rho] at *
      nlinarith only [congrArg (fun z : ℝ => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*z) hh]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [integral_add (hG.const_mul _) (hV.const_mul _)]
      simp only [integral_const_mul,referenceProfileFrameEnergy,referenceProfileSecondMass,f,rho]

lemma referenceProfileFrameEnergy_controls_gradient (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (K : Set R3) (L c0 nu J1 J2 D : ℝ) (hnu : 0 < nu)
    (hbounds : referenceProfileBounds g K L c0 nu J1 J2 D)
    (lam : ℝ) (hlam : lam ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (p k : ℕ) (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c)
    (hzero : ∀ x ∉ K, finitePolynomialField b c x = 0) :
    referenceProfileFrameEnergy g lam δ R L p b c 0 1 +
      (k:ℝ)^2*referenceProfileSecondMass g lam δ R L p b c ≤ referenceProfileFrameEnergy g lam δ R L p b c k 1 := by
  have hpar := referenceProfileFrameEnergy_parallelogram g hg lam δ R L p hδ hR b c hc hcompact k
  have hthird := referenceProfileFrameEnergy_square_difference g hg L lam δ R p k hδ hR b c hc hcompact
  have htrace := referenceProfileTraceHessianEnergy_le g hg K L c0 nu J1 J2 D hbounds lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp k b c hc hcompact hzero
  have hM := referenceProfileMass_nonneg g hg lam δ R L p b c
  have hsign : referenceProfileTraceHessianEnergy g lam δ R L p b c k ≤ 0 := by
    have hh : 0 ≤ 6*nu*(k:ℝ)*referenceProfileMass g lam δ R L p b c := by positivity
    linarith only [htrace,hh]
  change referenceProfileFrameEnergy g lam δ R L p b c k (-1) =
    referenceProfileFrameEnergy g lam δ R L p b c k 1 + referenceProfileTraceHessianEnergy g lam δ R L p b c k at hthird
  linarith

lemma referenceWeightedFrameEnergy_gradient_bound (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ)
    (f : R3 → ℝ) (k : ℝ) (x : R3) :
    referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g L lam b c f 0 1 x ≤
      2*referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g L lam b c f k 1 x +
      2*k^2*metricDifferentialNorm (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) f x^2*
        fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField b c x) := by
  have hi (i : Fin 3) : fischerInner
      (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i))
      (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i)) ≤
      2*fischerInner
      (referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c f k 1 x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i))
      (referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c f k 1 x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i)) +
      2*k^2*(fderiv ℝ f x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i))^2*
        fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField b c x) := by
    let q := referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c f k 1 x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i)
    let w := k*fderiv ℝ f x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i)
    have hrel : q+C (-w)*finitePolynomialField b c x =
        referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) := by
      simp only [q,w,referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative,map_one,one_mul,map_neg]
      ring
    have hh := fischerInner_self_add_le q (C (-w)*finitePolynomialField b c x)
    rw [hrel] at hh
    simp only [fischerInner_C_mul_left,fischerInner_C_mul_right] at hh
    apply hh.trans_eq
    dsimp only [q,w]
    ring
  have hh := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i (_ : i ∈ Finset.univ) => hi i)
  have hzero : referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g L lam b c f 0 1 x = ∑ i : Fin 3,
      fischerInner (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i))
        (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i)) := by
    simp only [referenceWeightedFrameEnergy,referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative_zero]
  rw [hzero]
  apply hh.trans_eq
  rw [referenceMetricDifferentialNorm_sq_eq_frame_sum g hg L lam f x]
  simp only [referenceWeightedFrameEnergy,Finset.sum_add_distrib,Finset.mul_sum,Finset.sum_mul]

lemma referenceProfileWeightedFrameEnergy_controls_gradient (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (lam δ R L : ℝ) (p : ℕ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hR : 0 < R) (hL : 0 < L) (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c) (k : ℝ) :
    referenceProfileWeightedFrameEnergy g lam δ R L p b c 0 1 ≤
      2*referenceProfileWeightedFrameEnergy g lam δ R L p b c k 1 +
      2*k^2*referenceProfileMass g lam δ R L p b c := by
  let f := referenceLogRadius δ R p L
  let rho := fun x : R3 => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)
  let beta := referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L
  have hG := integrable_referenceProfileNorm_inv_frameEnergy g hg lam δ R L p hδ hR hL hp b c 0 1 hc hcompact
  have hW := integrable_referenceProfileNorm_inv_frameEnergy g hg lam δ R L p hδ hR hL hp b c k 1 hc hcompact
  have hM := integrable_referenceProfileNorm_fischerSquare g hg lam δ R L p hδ hR b c hc hcompact
  have hh : referenceProfileWeightedFrameEnergy g lam δ R L p b c 0 1 ≤
      ∫ x : R3, 2*(rho x*(beta x)⁻¹*referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g L lam b c f k 1 x)+
        (2*k^2)*(rho x*beta x*fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField b c x)) := by
    apply integral_mono hG ((hW.const_mul _).add (hM.const_mul _))
    intro x
    have hbeta : 0 < beta x := referenceProfileNorm_pos g hg lam δ R L p hδ hR hL hp x
    have hpoint := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (referenceWeightedFrameEnergy_gradient_bound g hg L lam b c f k x)
      (show 0 ≤ rho x*(beta x)⁻¹ from mul_nonneg (referenceDensityFamily_pos g hg L (lam,x)).le (inv_nonneg.mpr hbeta.le))
    apply hpoint.trans_eq
    change rho x*(beta x)⁻¹*(2*referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g L lam b c f k 1 x+
      2*k^2*(beta x)^2*fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField b c x)) =
      2*(rho x*(beta x)⁻¹*referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g L lam b c f k 1 x)+
      (2*k^2)*(rho x*beta x*fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField b c x))
    field_simp [hbeta.ne']
    <;> ring
  apply hh.trans_eq
  rw [integral_add (hW.const_mul _) (hM.const_mul _)]
  simp only [integral_const_mul,referenceProfileWeightedFrameEnergy,referenceProfileMass,rho,beta,f]

theorem referenceProfileModeFischerEnergy_le (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (K : Set R3) (L c0 nu J1 J2 D : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (hnu : 0 < nu)
    (hbounds : referenceProfileBounds g K L c0 nu J1 J2 D)
    (lam : ℝ) (hlam : lam ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (p k : ℕ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c)
    (hzero : ∀ x ∉ K, finitePolynomialField b c x = 0) :
    referenceProfileModeFischerEnergy g lam δ R L p k b c ≤
      4*referenceProfileFrameEnergy g lam δ R L p b c k 1 +
      4*(k:ℝ)*referenceProfileWeightedFrameEnergy g lam δ R L p b c k 1 +
      12*(k:ℝ)^3*referenceProfileMass g lam δ R L p b c := by
  let n : ℝ := k
  let G := referenceProfileFrameEnergy g lam δ R L p b c 0 1
  let V := referenceProfileSecondMass g lam δ R L p b c
  let I := referenceProfileWeightedFrameEnergy g lam δ R L p b c 0 1
  let M := referenceProfileMass g lam δ R L p b c
  let X := referenceProfileFrameEnergy g lam δ R L p b c k 1
  let W := referenceProfileWeightedFrameEnergy g lam δ R L p b c k 1
  have hn : 1 ≤ n := by change (1:ℝ) ≤ (k:ℝ); exact_mod_cast hk
  have hn0 : 0 ≤ n := by linarith
  have hG : 0 ≤ G := referenceProfileFrameEnergy_nonneg g hg lam δ R L p b c 0 1
  have hV : 0 ≤ V := referenceProfileSecondMass_nonneg g hg lam δ R L p b c
  have hI : 0 ≤ I := referenceProfileWeightedFrameEnergy_nonneg g hg lam δ R L p b c 0 1
  have hM : 0 ≤ M := referenceProfileMass_nonneg g hg lam δ R L p b c
  have hplain : G+n^2*V ≤ X := referenceProfileFrameEnergy_controls_gradient g hg K L c0 nu J1 J2 D hnu hbounds lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p k hp b c hc hcompact hzero
  have hweight : I ≤ 2*W+2*n^2*M := referenceProfileWeightedFrameEnergy_controls_gradient g hg lam δ R L p hδ hR hL hp b c hc hcompact k
  have hfac : 1+n ≤ 2*n := by linarith
  have hfac2 : (1+n)^2 ≤ 4*n^2 := by nlinarith
  have hpart1 : G+(1+n)^2*V ≤ 4*X := by
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hfac2 hV
    linarith only [hh,hplain,hG]
  have hpart2 : (1+n)*I ≤ 4*n*W+4*n^3*M := by
    have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hfac hI
    have hw := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hweight (show 0 ≤ 2*n by positivity)
    nlinarith only [hh,hw]
  have hpart3 : (1+n)^3*M ≤ 8*n^3*M := by
    calc
      _ ≤ (2*n)^3*M := by gcongr
      _ = _ := by ring
  change G+(1+n)^2*V+(1+n)*I+(1+n)^3*M ≤ 4*X+4*n*W+12*n^3*M
  linarith

def referenceFiberPolynomialSquare (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (x : R3) (U : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ v : R3, (metricFramePolynomial (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x)
    (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x)) U v)^2
    ∂metricFrameProbability (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x)
      (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x)) (referenceMetricGramFrame_isMetricOrthonormalFrame g hg L (lam,x))

lemma referenceFiberPolynomialSquare_eq (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (x : R3) (k : ℕ)
    (U : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hU : U ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) :
    referenceFiberPolynomialSquare g hg L lam x U = fischerInner U U / sphereNormalization 3 k := by
  simpa only [referenceFiberPolynomialSquare,pow_two,normalizedFischerInner,Fintype.card_fin] using
    reference_metricFramePolynomial_fiber_inner hF g hg L lam x k U U hU hU

def referenceProfileModeEnergyDensity (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (lam δ R L : ℝ) (p k : ℕ) (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (x : R3) : ℝ :=
  let U := finitePolynomialField b c x
  let Q := fun i : Fin 3 => referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i)
  let V := referenceFiberPolynomialSquare g hg L lam x U
  let G := referenceFiberCovectorPair g hg L lam x Q Q
  let beta := referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x
  G+beta^2*(1+(k:ℝ))^2*V+beta⁻¹*(1+(k:ℝ))*G+beta*(1+(k:ℝ))^3*V

def referenceProfileModeEnergy (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (lam δ R L : ℝ) (p k : ℕ) (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*referenceProfileModeEnergyDensity g hg lam δ R L p k b c x

lemma referenceProfileModeEnergyDensity_eq (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (lam δ R L : ℝ) (p k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hb : ∀ j, b j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (x : R3) :
    referenceProfileModeEnergyDensity g hg lam δ R L p k b c x =
      (referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g L lam b c (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) 0 1 x +
        (1+(k:ℝ))^2*referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x^2*fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField b c x) +
        (1+(k:ℝ))*(referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x)⁻¹*referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g L lam b c (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) 0 1 x +
        (1+(k:ℝ))^3*referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x*fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField b c x)) /
      sphereNormalization 3 k := by
  let Q := fun i : Fin 3 => referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i)
  have hQ : ∀ i, Q i ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k := fun i =>
    referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_harmonicHomogeneous g hg L lam k hk b hb c x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i)
  dsimp only [referenceProfileModeEnergyDensity]
  rw [referenceFiberPolynomialSquare_eq hF g hg L lam x k _ (finitePolynomialField_harmonicHomogeneous k b hb c x),
    referenceFiberCovectorPair_eq hF g hg L lam x k Q Q hQ hQ]
  simp only [referenceWeightedFrameEnergy,referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative_zero]
  dsimp only [Q]
  ring

theorem referenceProfileModeEnergy_integrable_and_eq (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (lam δ R L : ℝ) (p k : ℕ)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hR : 0 < R) (hL : 0 < L) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hb : ∀ j, b j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c) :
    Integrable (fun x => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*referenceProfileModeEnergyDensity g hg lam δ R L p k b c x) ∧
      referenceProfileModeEnergy g hg lam δ R L p k b c = referenceProfileModeFischerEnergy g lam δ R L p k b c / sphereNormalization 3 k := by
  let f := referenceLogRadius δ R p L
  let rho := fun x : R3 => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)
  let beta := referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L
  let A := fun x : R3 => rho x*referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g L lam b c f 0 1 x
  let B := fun x : R3 => rho x*(beta x)^2*fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField b c x)
  let C := fun x : R3 => rho x*(beta x)⁻¹*referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g L lam b c f 0 1 x
  let D := fun x : R3 => rho x*beta x*fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField b c x)
  have hf := contDiff_log_referenceRadius δ R p L hδ hR
  have hr : Continuous rho := ((contDiff_referenceDensityFamily g hg L).comp (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id)).continuous
  have hA : Integrable A := integrable_referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g hg L lam rho hr b c f 0 1 hc hf hcompact
  have hB : Integrable B := by
    simpa only [B,rho,beta,Pi.pow_apply] using integrable_referenceDensity_weighted_fischerPair g hg L lam _
      ((continuous_referenceProfileNorm g hg lam δ R L p hδ hR).pow 2) b b c c hc hc hcompact
  have hC : Integrable C := integrable_referenceProfileNorm_inv_frameEnergy g hg lam δ R L p hδ hR hL hp b c 0 1 hc hcompact
  have hD : Integrable D := integrable_referenceProfileNorm_fischerSquare g hg lam δ R L p hδ hR b c hc hcompact
  have hAB : Integrable (fun x => A x+(1+(k:ℝ))^2*B x) :=
    hA.add (hB.const_mul ((1+(k:ℝ))^2))
  have hABC : Integrable (fun x => (A x+(1+(k:ℝ))^2*B x)+(1+(k:ℝ))*C x) :=
    hAB.add (hC.const_mul (1+(k:ℝ)))
  have hraw : Integrable (fun x => ((A x+(1+(k:ℝ))^2*B x)+(1+(k:ℝ))*C x)+(1+(k:ℝ))^3*D x) :=
    hABC.add (hD.const_mul ((1+(k:ℝ))^3))
  have heq (x : R3) : rho x*referenceProfileModeEnergyDensity g hg lam δ R L p k b c x =
      (((A x+(1+(k:ℝ))^2*B x)+(1+(k:ℝ))*C x)+(1+(k:ℝ))^3*D x)/sphereNormalization 3 k := by
    rw [referenceProfileModeEnergyDensity_eq hF g hg lam δ R L p k hk b hb c x]
    dsimp only [A,B,C,D,rho,beta,f]
    ring
  have hactual : Integrable (fun x => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*referenceProfileModeEnergyDensity g hg lam δ R L p k b c x) :=
    (hraw.div_const (sphereNormalization 3 k)).congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => (heq x).symm))
  refine ⟨hactual,?_⟩
  calc
    _ = (∫ x : R3, ((A x+(1+(k:ℝ))^2*B x)+(1+(k:ℝ))*C x)+(1+(k:ℝ))^3*D x)/sphereNormalization 3 k := by
      rw [referenceProfileModeEnergy,← integral_div]
      exact integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall heq)
    _ = _ := by
      rw [integral_add hABC (hD.const_mul _)]
      change ((∫ x : R3, (A x+(1+(k:ℝ))^2*B x)+(1+(k:ℝ))*C x)+
        (∫ x : R3, (1+(k:ℝ))^3*D x))/sphereNormalization 3 k = _
      rw [integral_add hAB (hC.const_mul _)]
      change (((∫ x : R3, A x+(1+(k:ℝ))^2*B x)+(∫ x : R3, (1+(k:ℝ))*C x))+
        (∫ x : R3, (1+(k:ℝ))^3*D x))/sphereNormalization 3 k = _
      rw [integral_add hA (hB.const_mul _)]
      simp only [integral_const_mul,referenceProfileModeFischerEnergy,referenceProfileFrameEnergy,
        referenceProfileSecondMass,referenceProfileWeightedFrameEnergy,referenceProfileMass,A,B,C,D,rho,beta,f]

def referenceProfileCoercivityConstant (a nu : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  min (1/8:ℝ) (min (a/16) (nu/12))

lemma referenceProfileCoercivityConstant_pos (a nu : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hnu : 0 < nu) :
    0 < referenceProfileCoercivityConstant a nu := by
  exact lt_min (by norm_num) (lt_min (by positivity) (by positivity))

lemma referenceProfileCoercivityConstant_le (a nu : ℝ) :
    referenceProfileCoercivityConstant a nu ≤ 1/8 ∧
    referenceProfileCoercivityConstant a nu ≤ a/16 ∧ referenceProfileCoercivityConstant a nu ≤ nu/12 :=
  ⟨min_le_left _ _, (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _), (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)⟩

theorem referenceProfileModeEnergy_coercive (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsClosed K)
    (L c0 nu J1 J2 D : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (hnu : 0 < nu)
    (hbounds : referenceProfileBounds g K L c0 nu J1 J2 D)
    (lam : ℝ) (hlam : lam ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (p : ℕ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (m : ℕ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hb : ∀ j, b j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (m+1))
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c)
    (hzero : ∀ x ∉ K, finitePolynomialField b c x = 0)
    (a beta0 Ccurv : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb0 : 1 ≤ beta0) (hC : 0 ≤ Ccurv)
    (hasmall : a ≤ nu/8) (hab : a ≤ beta0) (habsorb : 50*Ccurv ≤ nu*beta0)
    (hbeta : ∀ x ∈ K, beta0 ≤ referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x)
    (hcurv : |referenceIntegratedFullCovectorCurvature g L lam b c| ≤
      Ccurv*((m:ℝ)+1)^2*referenceFischerMass g L lam b c) :
    referenceProfileCoercivityConstant a nu * referenceProfileModeEnergy g hg lam δ R L p (m+1) b c ≤
      referenceRaisingEnergy g L lam b c (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) m -
        referenceLoweringEnergy g L lam b c (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) m := by
  let n : ℝ := (m:ℝ)+1
  let X := referenceProfileFrameEnergy g lam δ R L p b c (m+1) 1
  let W := referenceProfileWeightedFrameEnergy g lam δ R L p b c (m+1) 1
  let M := referenceProfileMass g lam δ R L p b c
  let Raw := referenceProfileModeFischerEnergy g lam δ R L p (m+1) b c
  let E := referenceProfileModeEnergy g hg lam δ R L p (m+1) b c
  let N := sphereNormalization 3 (m+1)
  let Δ := referenceRaisingEnergy g L lam b c (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) m-
    referenceLoweringEnergy g L lam b c (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) m
  let C := referenceProfileCoercivityConstant a nu
  have hCpos : 0 < C := referenceProfileCoercivityConstant_pos a nu ha hnu
  have hN : 0 < N := sphereNormalization_pos (n:=3) (by norm_num) (m+1)
  have hn : 0 ≤ n := by positivity
  have hX : 0 ≤ X := referenceProfileFrameEnergy_nonneg g hg lam δ R L p b c (m+1) 1
  have hW : 0 ≤ W := referenceProfileWeightedFrameEnergy_nonneg g hg lam δ R L p b c (m+1) 1
  have hM : 0 ≤ M := referenceProfileMass_nonneg g hg lam δ R L p b c
  have heq : E = Raw/N := (referenceProfileModeEnergy_integrable_and_eq hF g hg lam δ R L p (m+1) hδ hR hL hp (by omega) b hb c hc hcompact).2
  have hnorm : Raw ≤ 4*X+4*n*W+12*n^3*M := by
    simpa only [Raw,X,W,M,n,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one] using
      referenceProfileModeFischerEnergy_le g hg K L c0 nu J1 J2 D hL hnu hbounds lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p (m+1) hp (by omega) b c hc hcompact hzero
  have hgain : X/2+(a/4)*(n+2)*W+nu*n^3*M ≤ N*Δ := by
    simpa only [X,W,M,n,N,Δ,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one] using
      referenceProfileRaisingEnergy_gain hF g hg K hK L c0 nu J1 J2 D hL hnu hbounds lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp m b hb c hc hcompact hzero a beta0 Ccurv ha hb0 hC hasmall hab habsorb hbeta hcurv
  obtain ⟨hC1,hC2,hC3⟩ := referenceProfileCoercivityConstant_le a nu
  have hcx : 4*C ≤ 1/2 := by dsimp only [C]; linarith only [hC1]
  have hcw : 4*C ≤ a/4 := by dsimp only [C]; linarith only [hC2]
  have hcm : 12*C ≤ nu := by dsimp only [C]; linarith only [hC3]
  have hreserve : C*(4*X+4*n*W+12*n^3*M) ≤ X/2+(a/4)*(n+2)*W+nu*n^3*M := by
    have hx := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcx hX
    have hw := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcw (show 0 ≤ n*W by positivity)
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hcm (show 0 ≤ n^3*M by positivity)
    have haW := mul_nonneg ha.le hW
    nlinarith only [hx,hw,hm,haW]
  have hfinal : N*(C*E) ≤ N*Δ := by
    calc
      N*(C*E) = C*Raw := by rw [heq]; field_simp [hN.ne'] <;> ring
      _ ≤ C*(4*X+4*n*W+12*n^3*M) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnorm hCpos.le
      _ ≤ X/2+(a/4)*(n+2)*W+nu*n^3*M := hreserve
      _ ≤ N*Δ := hgain
  by_contra hnot
  have hpos : 0 < N*(C*E-Δ) := mul_pos hN (sub_pos.mpr (lt_of_not_ge hnot))
  nlinarith only [hfinal,hpos]

theorem exists_referenceProfileModeEnergy_uniform_coercivity (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ L cRaise : ℝ, 0 < L ∧ 0 < cRaise ∧
      ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ p : ℕ, 2 ≤ p ∧ ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧
        (∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 → ∀ x ∈ K,
          ‖fderiv ℝ (referenceRadius δ R p L) x‖ ≤ ε ∧
          referenceRadius δ R p L x * referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x^2 ≤ ε) ∧
        ∀ (τ : Type u) [Fintype τ], ∀ hF : SphereFischerInner,
          ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 →
          ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ b : τ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ,
          (∀ j, b j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (m+1)) →
          ∀ c : R3 → τ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ c → HasCompactSupport c →
          (∀ x ∉ K, finitePolynomialField b c x = 0) →
          cRaise*referenceProfileModeEnergy g hg lam δ R L p (m+1) b c ≤
            referenceRaisingEnergy g L lam b c (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) m -
              referenceLoweringEnergy g L lam b c (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) m := by
  obtain ⟨L,c0,nu,J1,J2,D,hL,hc0,hnu,hJ1,hJ2,hD,hbounds⟩ := exists_referenceProfileBounds g hg K hK
  obtain ⟨A,hA,hcurv⟩ := exists_referenceIntegratedCurvature_allFinite_uniform_bound.{u} g hg L hL K hK
  let a := min (1:ℝ) (nu/8)
  let beta0 := max (1:ℝ) (50*A/nu)
  have ha : 0 < a := lt_min (by norm_num) (by positivity)
  have hasmall : a ≤ nu/8 := min_le_right _ _
  have ha1 : a ≤ 1 := min_le_left _ _
  have hb0 : 1 ≤ beta0 := le_max_left _ _
  have hab : a ≤ beta0 := ha1.trans hb0
  have habsorb : 50*A ≤ nu*beta0 := by
    have hh := (div_le_iff₀ hnu).mp (le_max_right (1:ℝ) (50*A/nu))
    simpa only [beta0,mul_comm] using hh
  refine ⟨L,referenceProfileCoercivityConstant a nu,hL,referenceProfileCoercivityConstant_pos a nu ha hnu,?_⟩
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨p,hp,R,hR,hprofile⟩ := referenceProfileBounds_choose_degree_radius g K L c0 nu J1 J2 D hc0 hbounds beta0 ε hε
  refine ⟨p,hp,R,hR,?_,?_⟩
  · intro lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 x hx
    exact (hprofile lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 x hx).2
  · intro τ inst hF lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 m b hb c hc hcompact hzero
    have hhcurv : |referenceIntegratedFullCovectorCurvature g L lam b c| ≤
        A*((m:ℝ)+1)^2*referenceFischerMass g L lam b c := by
      simpa only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one] using hcurv τ hF lam hlam (m+1) (by omega) b hb c hc hcompact hzero
    exact referenceProfileModeEnergy_coercive hF g hg K hK.isClosed L c0 nu J1 J2 D hL hnu hbounds
      lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p (by omega) m b hb c hc hcompact hzero a beta0 A ha hb0 hA.le
      hasmall hab habsorb (fun x hx => (hprofile lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 x hx).1) hhcurv

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.FiniteProfileNormComparison

``````
