## Calderon.FiniteProfileRaisingGain

SHA256 `2bddd0679f8372944532eb1e1e47d0a735da1ebeba734544c0ab6a645b14e8b8`.

``````lean
import Calderon.IntegratedProfileConvexity
import Calderon.RaisingCoercivity

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 10
universe u
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory MvPolynomial
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Gradient Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.FiniteProfileRaisingGain
open RadiusProfile ConformalDepth MetricOperator AngularPolynomial SphereHarmonic
  WeightedFischerSquare SmoothMetricFrame FischerConnectionTransport
  IntegratedFischerIdentities FiniteRaisingEnergy WeightedRaisingBounds
  ProfileHessianEnergy IntegratedProfileConvexity ReferenceDensityBounds FullCovectorCurvature
attribute [local irreducible] referenceMetricGramFrame referenceConnectionFamily
  metricOperatorField referenceMetric dilatedMetric finitePolynomialField
variable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]

def referenceProfileFrameEnergy (g : MatrixField) (lam δ R L : ℝ) (p : ℕ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (k s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*
    referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g L lam b c (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) k s x

def referenceFischerMass (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*fischerInner
    (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField b c x)

lemma referenceProfileFrameEnergy_nonneg (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (lam δ R L : ℝ) (p : ℕ) (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (k s : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ referenceProfileFrameEnergy g lam δ R L p b c k s := by
  apply integral_nonneg
  intro x
  exact mul_nonneg (referenceDensityFamily_pos g hg L (lam,x)).le
    (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => fischerInner_self_nonneg _))

lemma referenceFischerMass_nonneg (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) :
    0 ≤ referenceFischerMass g L lam b c := by
  apply integral_nonneg
  intro x
  exact mul_nonneg (referenceDensityFamily_pos g hg L (lam,x)).le (fischerInner_self_nonneg _)

lemma referenceProfileMass_ge_threshold (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (K : Set R3) (L lam δ R : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hR : 0 < R) (p : ℕ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c)
    (hzero : ∀ x ∉ K, finitePolynomialField b c x = 0)
    (beta0 : ℝ) (hbeta : ∀ x ∈ K, beta0 ≤ referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x) :
    beta0*referenceFischerMass g L lam b c ≤ referenceProfileMass g lam δ R L p b c := by
  have hV := integrable_referenceDensity_fischerPair g hg L lam b b c c hc hc hcompact
  have hM := integrable_referenceProfileNorm_fischerSquare g hg lam δ R L p hδ hR b c hc hcompact
  rw [referenceFischerMass,← integral_const_mul]
  apply integral_mono (hV.const_mul _) hM
  intro x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ K
  · have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hbeta x hx) (mul_nonneg
      (referenceDensityFamily_pos g hg L (lam,x)).le (fischerInner_self_nonneg (finitePolynomialField b c x)))
    convert hh using 1 <;> ring
  · simp only [hzero x hx,fischerInner_zero_left,mul_zero,le_refl]

theorem referenceProfileRaisingEnergy_gain (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsClosed K)
    (L c0 nu J1 J2 D : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (hnu : 0 < nu)
    (hbounds : referenceProfileBounds g K L c0 nu J1 J2 D)
    (lam : ℝ) (hlam : lam ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (p : ℕ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (m : ℕ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hb : ∀ j, b j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (m+1))
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c)
    (hzero : ∀ x ∉ K, finitePolynomialField b c x = 0)
    (a beta0 Ccurv : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb0 : 1 ≤ beta0) (hC : 0 ≤ Ccurv)
    (hasmall : a ≤ nu/8) (hab : a ≤ beta0) (habsorb : 50*Ccurv ≤ nu*beta0)
    (hbeta : ∀ x ∈ K, beta0 ≤ referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x)
    (hcurv : |referenceIntegratedFullCovectorCurvature g L lam b c| ≤
      Ccurv*((m:ℝ)+1)^2*referenceFischerMass g L lam b c) :
    referenceProfileFrameEnergy g lam δ R L p b c (m+1) 1 /2 +
      (a/4)*(((m:ℝ)+1)+2)*referenceProfileWeightedFrameEnergy g lam δ R L p b c (m+1) 1 +
      nu*((m:ℝ)+1)^3*referenceProfileMass g lam δ R L p b c ≤
      sphereNormalization 3 (m+1)*(referenceRaisingEnergy g L lam b c (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) m -
        referenceLoweringEnergy g L lam b c (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) m) := by
  let n : ℝ := (m:ℝ)+1
  let f := referenceLogRadius δ R p L
  let X := referenceProfileFrameEnergy g lam δ R L p b c n 1
  let Y := (n+2)*referenceProfileWeightedFrameEnergy g lam δ R L p b c n 1
  let G := referenceLoweredWeightedTraceSquare g L lam b c f n (-1)
  let M := referenceProfileMass g lam δ R L p b c
  let V := referenceFischerMass g L lam b c
  let S := referenceLoweredWeightedTraceSquare g L lam b c f n 1
  let H := referenceLoweredHessianEnergy g L lam b c f n
  let J := referenceProfileTraceHessianEnergy g lam δ R L p b c n
  let E := referenceIntegratedFullCovectorCurvature g L lam b c
  have hn : 1 ≤ n := by
    have hm0 : 0 ≤ (m:ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg m
    dsimp only [n]
    linarith
  have hn0 : 0 ≤ n := by linarith
  have hV : 0 ≤ V := referenceFischerMass_nonneg g hg L lam b c
  have hM : 0 ≤ M := referenceProfileMass_nonneg g hg lam δ R L p b c
  have hX : 0 ≤ X := referenceProfileFrameEnergy_nonneg g hg lam δ R L p b c n 1
  have hW := referenceProfileWeightedFrameEnergy_nonneg g hg lam δ R L p b c n 1
  have hY : 0 ≤ Y := mul_nonneg (by linarith) hW
  have hG : 0 ≤ G := referenceLoweredWeightedTraceSquare_nonneg g hg L lam b c f n (-1)
  have hMV : beta0*V ≤ M := referenceProfileMass_ge_threshold g hg K L lam δ R hδ hR p b c hc hcompact hzero beta0 hbeta
  have hthird := referenceProfileFrameEnergy_square_difference g hg L lam δ R p (m+1) hδ hR b c hc hcompact
  have hthird' : referenceProfileFrameEnergy g lam δ R L p b c n (-1) = X+J := by
    simpa only [referenceProfileFrameEnergy,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one,n,X,J] using hthird
  have hfirst := referenceLoweredWeighted_second_integrated_inequality g hg L lam (m+1) (by omega) b hb c f hc
    (contDiff_log_referenceRadius δ R p L hδ hR) hcompact
  have hfirst' : S ≤ n*(X+J)-H+(-E) := by
    have hh : S ≤ n*referenceProfileFrameEnergy g lam δ R L p b c n (-1)-H-E := by
      simpa only [S,n,referenceProfileFrameEnergy,H,E,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one,f] using hfirst
    rw [hthird'] at hh
    linarith
  have hsecond := referenceProfileTrace_convex_uniform_integrated_bound g hg K hK L lam δ R hL hδ hR p (m+1) hp (by omega)
    b hb c hc hcompact hzero a beta0 ha.le (by linarith) hab hbeta
  have hsecond' : S ≤ (n+3-1)*X-a*Y+(2*a/beta0)*G+8*a*n^3*M := by
    convert hsecond using 1 <;> dsimp only [S,n,X,Y,G,M,f,referenceProfileFrameEnergy] <;> push_cast <;> ring
  have hhH := referenceProfile_loweredHessianEnergy_le g hg K L c0 nu J1 J2 D hbounds lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp (m+1) b hb c hc hcompact hzero
  have hH : H ≤ -2*nu*n^2*M := by
    simpa only [H,n,M,f,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one,mul_assoc] using hhH
  have hhJ := referenceProfileTraceHessianEnergy_le g hg K L c0 nu J1 J2 D hbounds lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp (m+1) b c hc hcompact hzero
  have hJ : J ≤ -6*nu*n*M := by
    simpa only [J,n,M,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one,mul_assoc] using hhJ
  have hJ0 : J ≤ 0 := by
    have hh : 0 ≤ 6*nu*n*M := by positivity
    linarith only [hJ,hh]
  have hR2 : -E ≤ (5*Ccurv)*n^2*V := by
    have hh : -E ≤ Ccurv*n^2*V := (neg_le_abs E).trans hcurv
    have hpC : 0 ≤ Ccurv*n^2*V := by positivity
    linarith
  have hR3 : -(5*Ccurv)*n^3*V ≤ (3+2*n)*E := by
    have hE : -(Ccurv*n^2*V) ≤ E := by linarith [(neg_le_abs E).trans hcurv]
    have hcE := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hE (show 0 ≤ 3+2*n by positivity)
    have hcost : (3+2*n)*(Ccurv*n^2*V) ≤ (5*Ccurv)*n^3*V := by
      nlinarith only [mul_nonneg (show 0 ≤ n-1 by linarith) (show 0 ≤ 3*Ccurv*n^2*V by positivity)]
    linarith
  have hbound := raising_form_lower_bound (n:=3) (k:=n) (c₀:=nu) (c₁:=a) (C:=5*Ccurv) (β:=beta0)
    (X:=X) (Y:=Y) (G:=G) (W:=M) (V:=V) (F:=S) (H:=H) (T:=J) (R₂:=-E) (R₃:=(3+2*n)*E)
    (by norm_num) hn hnu ha (by positivity) hb0 hasmall hab (by linarith) hMV hX hY hG hM hV hfirst' hsecond' hJ0 hH hR2 hR3
  have henergy := referenceRaisingEnergy_sub_loweringEnergy_reduced hF g hg L lam m b hb c f hc
    (contDiff_log_referenceRadius δ R p L hδ hR) hcompact
  have hN := sphereNormalization_pos (n:=3) (by norm_num : 0 < 3) (m+1)
  have hExact : sphereNormalization 3 (m+1)*(referenceRaisingEnergy g L lam b c f m-referenceLoweringEnergy g L lam b c f m) =
      (2+2/(n+3/2-1))*((n+3/2-1)*X-S-(n+3/2-1)*H)+2*G+(3+2*n)*E := by
    have henergy' : referenceRaisingEnergy g L lam b c f m-referenceLoweringEnergy g L lam b c f m =
        ((3+2*n)*(X-(4/(4*(m:ℝ)+6))*S-H)+2*G+(3+2*n)*E)/sphereNormalization 3 (m+1) := henergy
    have hden : 4*(m:ℝ)+6 = 4*(n+3/2-1) := by dsimp only [n]; ring
    rw [henergy',hden]
    have hd : n+3/2-1 ≠ 0 := by linarith
    field_simp [hN.ne',hd]
    <;> ring_nf
    <;> field_simp [show 1+n*2 ≠ 0 by linarith]
    <;> ring
  rw [← hExact] at hbound
  simpa only [X,Y,n,M,f,referenceProfileFrameEnergy,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one,mul_assoc] using hbound

theorem exists_referenceIntegratedCurvature_allFinite_uniform_bound (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (τ : Type u) [Fintype τ], ∀ hF : SphereFischerInner,
      ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k →
      ∀ b : τ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ, (∀ j, b j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) →
      ∀ c : R3 → τ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ c → HasCompactSupport c →
      (∀ x ∉ K, finitePolynomialField b c x = 0) →
      |referenceIntegratedFullCovectorCurvature g L lam b c| ≤
        C*(k:ℝ)^2*referenceFischerMass g L lam b c := by
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hbound⟩ := exists_referenceFullCovectorCurvatureContraction_uniform_fischer_bound g hg L hL K hK
  refine ⟨C,hC,?_⟩
  intro τ inst hF lam hlam k hk b hb c hc hcompact hzero
  have hE := integrable_referenceFullCovectorCurvature g hg L lam b c hc hcompact
  have hU := integrable_referenceDensity_fischerPair g hg L lam b b c c hc hc hcompact
  have hp (x : R3) : |referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*
      referenceFullCovectorCurvatureContraction g L lam x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x)) (finitePolynomialField b c x)| ≤
      (C*(k:ℝ)^2)*(referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField b c x)) := by
    by_cases hx : x ∈ K
    · rw [abs_mul,abs_of_pos (referenceDensityFamily_pos g hg L (lam,x))]
      calc
        _ ≤ referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*(C*(k:ℝ)^2*fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField b c x)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hbound hF lam hlam x hx _
            (referenceMetricGramFrame_isMetricOrthonormalFrame g hg L (lam,x)) k hk _
            (finitePolynomialField_harmonicHomogeneous k b hb c x))
            (referenceDensityFamily_pos g hg L (lam,x)).le
        _ = _ := by ring
    · rw [hzero x hx,referenceFullCovectorCurvatureContraction_zero]
      simp only [fischerInner_zero_left,mul_zero,abs_zero,le_refl]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ x : R3, |referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*referenceFullCovectorCurvatureContraction g L lam x
      (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x)) (finitePolynomialField b c x)| := abs_integral_le_integral_abs
    _ ≤ ∫ x : R3, (C*(k:ℝ)^2)*(referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField b c x)) :=
      integral_mono hE.abs (hU.const_mul _) hp
    _ = _ := integral_const_mul _ _

theorem exists_referenceProfileRaisingEnergy_uniform_gain (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ L a nu : ℝ, 0 < L ∧ 0 < a ∧ 0 < nu ∧
      ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ p : ℕ, 2 ≤ p ∧ ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧
        (∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 → ∀ x ∈ K,
          ‖fderiv ℝ (referenceRadius δ R p L) x‖ ≤ ε ∧
          referenceRadius δ R p L x * referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x^2 ≤ ε) ∧
        ∀ (τ : Type u) [Fintype τ], ∀ hF : SphereFischerInner,
          ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 →
          ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ b : τ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ,
          (∀ j, b j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (m+1)) →
          ∀ c : R3 → τ → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ c → HasCompactSupport c →
          (∀ x ∉ K, finitePolynomialField b c x = 0) →
          referenceProfileFrameEnergy g lam δ R L p b c (m+1) 1 /2 +
            (a/4)*(((m:ℝ)+1)+2)*referenceProfileWeightedFrameEnergy g lam δ R L p b c (m+1) 1 +
            nu*((m:ℝ)+1)^3*referenceProfileMass g lam δ R L p b c ≤
            sphereNormalization 3 (m+1)*(referenceRaisingEnergy g L lam b c (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) m -
              referenceLoweringEnergy g L lam b c (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) m) := by
  obtain ⟨L,c0,nu,J1,J2,D,hL,hc0,hnu,hJ1,hJ2,hD,hbounds⟩ := exists_referenceProfileBounds g hg K hK
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hcurv⟩ := exists_referenceIntegratedCurvature_allFinite_uniform_bound.{u} g hg L hL K hK
  let a := min (1:ℝ) (nu/8)
  let beta0 := max (1:ℝ) (50*C/nu)
  have ha : 0 < a := lt_min (by norm_num) (by positivity)
  have hasmall : a ≤ nu/8 := min_le_right _ _
  have ha1 : a ≤ 1 := min_le_left _ _
  have hb0 : 1 ≤ beta0 := le_max_left _ _
  have hab : a ≤ beta0 := ha1.trans hb0
  have habsorb : 50*C ≤ nu*beta0 := by
    have hh := (div_le_iff₀ hnu).mp (le_max_right (1:ℝ) (50*C/nu))
    simpa only [beta0,mul_comm] using hh
  refine ⟨L,a,nu,hL,ha,hnu,?_⟩
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨p,hp,R,hR,hprofile⟩ := referenceProfileBounds_choose_degree_radius g K L c0 nu J1 J2 D hc0 hbounds beta0 ε hε
  refine ⟨p,hp,R,hR,?_,?_⟩
  · intro lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 x hx
    exact (hprofile lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 x hx).2
  · intro τ inst hF lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 m b hb c hc hcompact hzero
    have hhcurv : |referenceIntegratedFullCovectorCurvature g L lam b c| ≤
        C*((m:ℝ)+1)^2*referenceFischerMass g L lam b c := by
      simpa only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one] using hcurv τ hF lam hlam (m+1) (by omega) b hb c hc hcompact hzero
    exact referenceProfileRaisingEnergy_gain hF g hg K hK.isClosed L c0 nu J1 J2 D hL hnu hbounds
      lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p (by omega) m b hb c hc hcompact hzero a beta0 C ha hb0 hC.le
      hasmall hab habsorb (fun x hx => (hprofile lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 x hx).1) hhcurv

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.FiniteProfileRaisingGain

``````

## Calderon.FiniteRaisingEnergy

SHA256 `ed533717cc919a7b591645dea07a83b211a1a0cda0c04bc4ac4d752eca96635f`.

``````lean
import Calderon.IntegratedFischerIdentities

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 10
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory MvPolynomial
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.FiniteRaisingEnergy
open RadiusProfile ConformalDepth MetricOperator AngularPolynomial SphereHarmonic
  WeightedFischerSquare SmoothMetricFrame FischerConnectionTransport
  WeightedIndexedCurvature FiniteTensorRealization IntegratedFischerIdentities
  ReferenceDensityBounds PolynomialSlotCompatibility

attribute [local irreducible] referenceMetricGramFrame referenceConnectionFamily
  metricOperatorField referenceMetric dilatedMetric finitePolynomialField
  referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative

variable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]

def referenceWeightedFramePolynomialField (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (k s : ℝ) (x : R3) (i : Fin 3) : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c f k s x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i)

def referenceRaisedPolynomialField (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (m : ℕ) (x : R3) : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  sphereRaising m (referenceWeightedFramePolynomialField g L lam b c f (m+1) 1 x)

def referenceLoweredPolynomialField (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (m : ℕ) (x : R3) : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  polynomialDivergence (referenceWeightedFramePolynomialField g L lam b c f (m+1) (-1) x)

def referenceRaisingEnergy (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (m : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
    ‖polynomialSphereL2 (referenceRaisedPolynomialField g L lam b c f m x)‖^2

def referenceLoweringEnergy (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (m : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
    ‖polynomialSphereL2 (referenceLoweredPolynomialField g L lam b c f m x)‖^2

lemma sphereRaising_sum_family {σ : Type*} [Fintype σ] (m : ℕ)
    (q : σ → Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    sphereRaising m (fun i => ∑ a : σ, q a i) = ∑ a : σ, sphereRaising m (q a) := by
  simp only [sphereRaising,harmonicRaising,polynomialRaising,polynomialDivergence,
    Fin.sum_univ_three,map_sum]
  simp only [mul_add,mul_sub,Finset.mul_sum,Finset.sum_add_distrib,Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

lemma sphereRaising_C_mul_family (m : ℕ) (q : Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (r : ℝ) :
    sphereRaising m (fun i => C r*q i) = C r*sphereRaising m q := by
  simp only [sphereRaising,harmonicRaising,polynomialRaising,polynomialDivergence,
    Fin.sum_univ_three,pderiv_C_mul]
  ring

lemma sphereRaising_finitePolynomialField (m : ℕ)
    (b : ι → Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (x : R3) :
    sphereRaising m (fun i => finitePolynomialField (fun a => b a i) c x) =
      finitePolynomialField (fun a => sphereRaising m (b a)) c x := by
  simp only [finitePolynomialField,smul_eq_C_mul]
  rw [sphereRaising_sum_family]
  simp_rw [sphereRaising_C_mul_family]

lemma referenceWeightedFramePolynomialField_harmonicHomogeneous (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hb : ∀ a, b a ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (m+1))
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (s : ℝ) (x : R3) (i : Fin 3) :
    referenceWeightedFramePolynomialField g L lam b c f (m+1) s x i ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (m+1) :=
  by
    simpa only [referenceWeightedFramePolynomialField,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one] using
      referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative_harmonicHomogeneous g hg L lam (m+1) (by omega)
        b hb c f s x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i)

lemma referenceRaisedPolynomialField_harmonicHomogeneous (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hb : ∀ a, b a ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (m+1))
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (x : R3) :
    referenceRaisedPolynomialField g L lam b c f m x ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (m+2) :=
  sphereRaising_harmonicHomogeneous m _
    (referenceWeightedFramePolynomialField_harmonicHomogeneous g hg L lam m b hb c f 1 x)

lemma referenceLoweredPolynomialField_harmonicHomogeneous (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hb : ∀ a, b a ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (m+1))
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (x : R3) :
    referenceLoweredPolynomialField g L lam b c f m x ∈ harmonicHomogeneous m :=
  polynomialDivergence_harmonicHomogeneous m _
    (referenceWeightedFramePolynomialField_harmonicHomogeneous g hg L lam m b hb c f (-1) x)

def referenceRaisingPolynomialFamily (m : ℕ) (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    (Fin 3 × ((ι ⊕ (Fin 3 × Fin 3 × ι)) ⊕ ι)) → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  fun a => sphereRaising m (indexedPolynomialFamily (weightedDerivativePolynomialFamily b) a)

lemma referenceRaisedPolynomialField_eq_finite (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (m : ℕ) (x : R3) : referenceRaisedPolynomialField g L lam b c f m x =
      finitePolynomialField (referenceRaisingPolynomialFamily m b)
        (referenceLoweredWeightedTensorCoefficientFamily g L lam c f (m+1) 1) x := by
  unfold referenceRaisedPolynomialField referenceRaisingPolynomialFamily
  rw [← sphereRaising_finitePolynomialField]
  congr 1
  funext i
  exact (finitePolynomialField_referenceWeighted_indexed g L lam b c f (m+1) 1 x i).symm

lemma referenceLoweredPolynomialField_eq_trace (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (m : ℕ) (x : R3) : referenceLoweredPolynomialField g L lam b c f m x =
      referenceLoweredWeightedTraceField g L lam b c f (m+1) (-1) x := by
  simp only [referenceLoweredPolynomialField,polynomialDivergence,referenceWeightedFramePolynomialField,
    referenceLoweredWeightedTraceField,referenceLoweredWeightedTensorField,
    referenceWeightedCovectorPolynomialDerivative_partial]

lemma integrable_referenceRaisingEnergy (hF : SphereFischerInner) (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hb : ∀ a, b a ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (m+1))
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c) : Integrable (fun x => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      ‖polynomialSphereL2 (referenceRaisedPolynomialField g L lam b c f m x)‖^2) := by
  simp_rw [polynomialSphereL2_norm_sq hF (m+2) _
    (referenceRaisedPolynomialField_harmonicHomogeneous g hg L lam m b hb c f _),
    normalizedFischerSquare,normalizedFischerInner,referenceRaisedPolynomialField_eq_finite]
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin,← mul_div_assoc]
  exact (integrable_referenceDensity_fischerPair g hg L lam _ _ _ _
    (contDiff_referenceLoweredWeightedTensorCoefficientFamily g hg L lam c f (m+1) 1 hc hf)
    (contDiff_referenceLoweredWeightedTensorCoefficientFamily g hg L lam c f (m+1) 1 hc hf)
    (hasCompactSupport_referenceLoweredWeightedTensorCoefficientFamily g L lam c f (m+1) 1 hcompact)).div_const _

lemma integrable_referenceLoweringEnergy (hF : SphereFischerInner) (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hb : ∀ a, b a ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (m+1))
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c) : Integrable (fun x => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      ‖polynomialSphereL2 (referenceLoweredPolynomialField g L lam b c f m x)‖^2) := by
  simp_rw [polynomialSphereL2_norm_sq hF m _
    (referenceLoweredPolynomialField_harmonicHomogeneous g hg L lam m b hb c f _),
    normalizedFischerSquare,normalizedFischerInner,referenceLoweredPolynomialField_eq_trace]
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin,← mul_div_assoc]
  exact (integrable_referenceLoweredWeightedTrace_square g hg L lam b c f (m+1) (-1) hc hf hcompact).div_const _

lemma polynomialDivergence_referenceWeightedFramePolynomialField (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (k s : ℝ) (x : R3) : polynomialDivergence (referenceWeightedFramePolynomialField g L lam b c f k s x) =
      referenceLoweredWeightedTraceField g L lam b c f k s x := by
  simp only [polynomialDivergence,referenceWeightedFramePolynomialField,
    referenceLoweredWeightedTraceField,referenceLoweredWeightedTensorField,
    referenceWeightedCovectorPolynomialDerivative_partial]

def referenceFockNumerator (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (m : ℕ) (x : R3) : ℝ :=
  (3+2*((m:ℝ)+1)) * (referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g L lam b c f ((m:ℝ)+1) 1 x +
    (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      fischerInner (referenceLoweredWeightedTensorField g L lam b c f ((m:ℝ)+1) 1 x i j)
        (referenceLoweredWeightedTensorField g L lam b c f ((m:ℝ)+1) 1 x j i)) -
    (4/(4*(m:ℝ)+6))*fischerInner (referenceLoweredWeightedTraceField g L lam b c f ((m:ℝ)+1) 1 x)
      (referenceLoweredWeightedTraceField g L lam b c f ((m:ℝ)+1) 1 x)) -
  (3+2*(m:ℝ))*fischerInner (referenceLoweredWeightedTraceField g L lam b c f ((m:ℝ)+1) (-1) x)
    (referenceLoweredWeightedTraceField g L lam b c f ((m:ℝ)+1) (-1) x)

theorem referenceRaised_lowered_fock_difference_pointwise (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hb : ∀ a, b a ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (m+1))
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (x : R3) :
    ‖polynomialSphereL2 (referenceRaisedPolynomialField g L lam b c f m x)‖^2 -
      ‖polynomialSphereL2 (referenceLoweredPolynomialField g L lam b c f m x)‖^2 =
    referenceFockNumerator g L lam b c f m x / sphereNormalization 3 (m+1) := by
  have h := sphere_fock_difference hF m
    (referenceWeightedFramePolynomialField g L lam b c f (m+1) 1 x)
    (referenceWeightedFramePolynomialField g L lam b c f (m+1) (-1) x)
    (referenceWeightedFramePolynomialField_harmonicHomogeneous g hg L lam m b hb c f 1 x)
    (referenceWeightedFramePolynomialField_harmonicHomogeneous g hg L lam m b hb c f (-1) x)
  simpa only [referenceRaisedPolynomialField,referenceLoweredPolynomialField,referenceFockNumerator,
    polynomialDivergence_referenceWeightedFramePolynomialField,referenceWeightedFrameEnergy,
    referenceWeightedFramePolynomialField,referenceLoweredWeightedTensorField,
    referenceWeightedCovectorPolynomialDerivative_partial,show (2:ℝ)*3=6 by norm_num] using h

lemma integrable_referenceFockNumerator (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c) :
    Integrable (fun x => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*referenceFockNumerator g L lam b c f m x) := by
  have hr : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : R3 => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)) :=
    (contDiff_referenceDensityFamily g hg L).comp (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id)
  have hX := integrable_referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g hg L lam _ hr.continuous b c f ((m:ℝ)+1) 1 hc hf hcompact
  have hC : Integrable (fun x => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      fischerInner (referenceLoweredWeightedTensorField g L lam b c f ((m:ℝ)+1) 1 x i j)
        (referenceLoweredWeightedTensorField g L lam b c f ((m:ℝ)+1) 1 x j i)) := by
    simp only [Finset.mul_sum]
    exact integrable_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => integrable_finset_sum _ (fun j _ =>
      integrable_referenceLoweredWeightedTensor_pair g hg L lam b c f ((m:ℝ)+1) 1 1 hc hf hcompact i j j i))
  have hp := integrable_referenceLoweredWeightedTrace_square g hg L lam b c f ((m:ℝ)+1) 1 hc hf hcompact
  have hm := integrable_referenceLoweredWeightedTrace_square g hg L lam b c f ((m:ℝ)+1) (-1) hc hf hcompact
  convert (((hX.add hC).sub (hp.const_mul (4/(4*(m:ℝ)+6)))).const_mul (3+2*((m:ℝ)+1))).sub
    (hm.const_mul (3+2*(m:ℝ))) using 1
  funext x
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply,Pi.add_apply,referenceFockNumerator]
  ring

theorem referenceRaisingEnergy_sub_loweringEnergy_integral (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hb : ∀ a, b a ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (m+1))
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c) :
    referenceRaisingEnergy g L lam b c f m-referenceLoweringEnergy g L lam b c f m =
      (∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*referenceFockNumerator g L lam b c f m x) /
        sphereNormalization 3 (m+1) := by
  rw [referenceRaisingEnergy,referenceLoweringEnergy,
    ← integral_sub (integrable_referenceRaisingEnergy hF g hg L lam m b hb c f hc hf hcompact)
      (integrable_referenceLoweringEnergy hF g hg L lam m b hb c f hc hf hcompact)]
  have he : (fun x : R3 => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*
      ‖polynomialSphereL2 (referenceRaisedPolynomialField g L lam b c f m x)‖^2 -
      referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*‖polynomialSphereL2 (referenceLoweredPolynomialField g L lam b c f m x)‖^2) =
      fun x => (referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*referenceFockNumerator g L lam b c f m x) /
        sphereNormalization 3 (m+1) := by
    funext x
    rw [← mul_sub,referenceRaised_lowered_fock_difference_pointwise hF g hg L lam m b hb c f x]
    ring
  rw [he,integral_div]

theorem integral_referenceFockNumerator (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c) :
    (∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*referenceFockNumerator g L lam b c f m x) =
    (3+2*((m:ℝ)+1)) * ((∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g L lam b c f ((m:ℝ)+1) 1 x) +
      referenceLoweredWeightedCrossEnergy g L lam b c f ((m:ℝ)+1) 1 -
      (4/(4*(m:ℝ)+6))*referenceLoweredWeightedTraceSquare g L lam b c f ((m:ℝ)+1) 1) -
    (3+2*(m:ℝ))*referenceLoweredWeightedTraceSquare g L lam b c f ((m:ℝ)+1) (-1) := by
  let X : R3 → ℝ := fun x => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g L lam b c f ((m:ℝ)+1) 1 x
  let Cc : R3 → ℝ := fun x => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
    fischerInner (referenceLoweredWeightedTensorField g L lam b c f ((m:ℝ)+1) 1 x i j)
      (referenceLoweredWeightedTensorField g L lam b c f ((m:ℝ)+1) 1 x j i)
  let Sp : R3 → ℝ := fun x => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*fischerInner
    (referenceLoweredWeightedTraceField g L lam b c f ((m:ℝ)+1) 1 x)
    (referenceLoweredWeightedTraceField g L lam b c f ((m:ℝ)+1) 1 x)
  let Sm : R3 → ℝ := fun x => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*fischerInner
    (referenceLoweredWeightedTraceField g L lam b c f ((m:ℝ)+1) (-1) x)
    (referenceLoweredWeightedTraceField g L lam b c f ((m:ℝ)+1) (-1) x)
  have hr : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : R3 => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)) :=
    (contDiff_referenceDensityFamily g hg L).comp (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id)
  have hX : Integrable X := integrable_referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g hg L lam _ hr.continuous b c f ((m:ℝ)+1) 1 hc hf hcompact
  have hC : Integrable Cc := by
    simp only [Cc,Finset.mul_sum]
    exact integrable_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => integrable_finset_sum _ (fun j _ =>
      integrable_referenceLoweredWeightedTensor_pair g hg L lam b c f ((m:ℝ)+1) 1 1 hc hf hcompact i j j i))
  have hSp : Integrable Sp := integrable_referenceLoweredWeightedTrace_square g hg L lam b c f ((m:ℝ)+1) 1 hc hf hcompact
  have hSm : Integrable Sm := integrable_referenceLoweredWeightedTrace_square g hg L lam b c f ((m:ℝ)+1) (-1) hc hf hcompact
  let XS : R3 → ℝ := fun x => (X+Cc) x-(4/(4*(m:ℝ)+6))*Sp x
  have hXS : Integrable XS := (hX.add hC).sub (hSp.const_mul (4/(4*(m:ℝ)+6)))
  have hiXS : (∫ x : R3, XS x) = (∫ x, X x)+(∫ x, Cc x)-(4/(4*(m:ℝ)+6))*(∫ x, Sp x) := by
    change (∫ x : R3, (X+Cc) x-(4/(4*(m:ℝ)+6))*Sp x) = _
    rw [integral_sub (hX.add hC) (hSp.const_mul _)]
    change (∫ x : R3, X x+Cc x)-(∫ x : R3, (4/(4*(m:ℝ)+6))*Sp x) = _
    rw [integral_add hX hC,integral_const_mul]
  have hp : (fun x : R3 => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*referenceFockNumerator g L lam b c f m x) =
      fun x => (3+2*((m:ℝ)+1))*XS x-(3+2*(m:ℝ))*Sm x := by
    funext x
    simp only [referenceFockNumerator,XS,Pi.add_apply,X,Cc,Sp,Sm]
    ring
  rw [hp,integral_sub (hXS.const_mul _) (hSm.const_mul _),integral_const_mul,integral_const_mul,hiXS]
  rfl

theorem referenceRaisingEnergy_sub_loweringEnergy (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hb : ∀ a, b a ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (m+1))
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c) :
    referenceRaisingEnergy g L lam b c f m-referenceLoweringEnergy g L lam b c f m =
    ((3+2*((m:ℝ)+1)) * ((∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g L lam b c f ((m:ℝ)+1) 1 x) +
      referenceLoweredWeightedCrossEnergy g L lam b c f ((m:ℝ)+1) 1 -
      (4/(4*(m:ℝ)+6))*referenceLoweredWeightedTraceSquare g L lam b c f ((m:ℝ)+1) 1) -
    (3+2*(m:ℝ))*referenceLoweredWeightedTraceSquare g L lam b c f ((m:ℝ)+1) (-1)) / sphereNormalization 3 (m+1) := by
  rw [referenceRaisingEnergy_sub_loweringEnergy_integral hF g hg L lam m b hb c f hc hf hcompact,
    integral_referenceFockNumerator g hg L lam m b c f hc hf hcompact]

theorem referenceRaisingEnergy_sub_loweringEnergy_reduced (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hb : ∀ a, b a ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (m+1))
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c) :
    referenceRaisingEnergy g L lam b c f m-referenceLoweringEnergy g L lam b c f m =
    ((3+2*((m:ℝ)+1)) * ((∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g L lam b c f ((m:ℝ)+1) 1 x) -
      (4/(4*(m:ℝ)+6))*referenceLoweredWeightedTraceSquare g L lam b c f ((m:ℝ)+1) 1 -
      referenceLoweredHessianEnergy g L lam b c f ((m:ℝ)+1)) +
    2*referenceLoweredWeightedTraceSquare g L lam b c f ((m:ℝ)+1) (-1) +
    (3+2*((m:ℝ)+1))*referenceIntegratedFullCovectorCurvature g L lam b c) / sphereNormalization 3 (m+1) := by
  rw [referenceRaisingEnergy_sub_loweringEnergy hF g hg L lam m b hb c f hc hf hcompact,
    referenceLoweredWeighted_first_integrated_identity g hg L lam b c f ((m:ℝ)+1) hc hf hcompact]
  ring

theorem referenceLoweredWeightedTraceSquare_nonneg (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (k s : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ referenceLoweredWeightedTraceSquare g L lam b c f k s :=
  integral_nonneg (fun x => mul_nonneg (referenceDensityFamily_pos g hg L (lam,x)).le
    (fischerInner_self_nonneg _))

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.FiniteRaisingEnergy

``````

## Calderon.FiniteTensorRealization

SHA256 `1d19e5433445cc5171151cc87b4d5a1b01d0b512c92b949c39726454780eaa43`.

``````lean
import Calderon.WeightedIndexedCurvature
import Calderon.ScalarContractedAdjunction

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 10
noncomputable section
open MvPolynomial
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.FiniteTensorRealization
open RadiusProfile ConformalDepth MetricOperator AngularPolynomial CurvatureSkew
  MovingFrameConnection FischerConnectionTransport WeightedFischerSquare
  SmoothMetricFrame FrameCurvaturePolynomial FiniteCovariantCurvature
  PolynomialSlotCompatibility FullCovectorCurvature IndexedCovariantCurvature
  ContractedFischerAdjunction WeightedIndexedCurvature ScalarContractedAdjunction

attribute [local irreducible] referenceMetricGramFrame referenceConnectionFamily
  metricOperatorField referenceMetric dilatedMetric
  referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient frameConnectionCoefficient covariantFrameDerivative
  finitePolynomialField finitePolynomialFieldDerivative referenceFrameAngularPolynomial
  referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative

variable {ι κ σ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ] [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ]

lemma referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_congr (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (d : κ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (z : R3 → κ → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hz : ContDiff ℝ ∞ z)
    (h : ∀ x, finitePolynomialField b c x = finitePolynomialField d z x) (x V : R3) :
    referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x V =
      referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam d z x V := by
  have heval : evaluatedReferencePolynomialField g L lam b c =
      evaluatedReferencePolynomialField g L lam d z := by
    funext v
    rw [evaluatedReferencePolynomialField_eq,evaluatedReferencePolynomialField_eq,h v.1]
  apply referenceMovingFramePolynomial_injective g hg L lam x
  intro v
  have hd := congrArg (fun u : R3 × R3 → ℝ => fderiv ℝ u (x,v)
    (V,-referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,x) V v)) heval
  rw [fderiv_evaluatedReferencePolynomialField_horizontal g hg L lam b c hc,
    fderiv_evaluatedReferencePolynomialField_horizontal g hg L lam d z hz] at hd
  exact hd

def indexedPolynomialFamily (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    (σ × ι) → σ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ := fun a i => if a.1=i then b a.2 else 0

def indexedCoefficientFamily (c : R3 → σ → ι → ℝ) (x : R3) : σ × ι → ℝ :=
  fun a => c x a.1 a.2

lemma finitePolynomialField_indexed (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → σ → ι → ℝ) (x : R3) (i : σ) :
    finitePolynomialField (fun a => indexedPolynomialFamily b a i) (indexedCoefficientFamily c) x =
      finitePolynomialField b (fun y => c y i) x := by
  simp only [finitePolynomialField,indexedPolynomialFamily,indexedCoefficientFamily,
    Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  simp

lemma contDiff_indexedCoefficientFamily (c : R3 → σ → ι → ℝ)
    (hc : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => c x i)) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (indexedCoefficientFamily c) := by
  apply contDiff_pi.mpr
  intro a
  exact contDiff_pi.mp (hc a.1) a.2

lemma hasCompactSupport_indexedCoefficientFamily (c : R3 → σ → ι → ℝ)
    (hc : HasCompactSupport c) : HasCompactSupport (indexedCoefficientFamily c) := by
  apply hc.mono
  intro x hx
  simp only [Function.mem_support] at hx ⊢
  intro hc0
  apply hx
  funext a
  simp only [indexedCoefficientFamily,hc0,Pi.zero_apply]

def referenceWeightedIndexedCoefficientFamily (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (k t : ℝ) :
    R3 → Fin 3 → ((ι ⊕ (Fin 3 × Fin 3 × ι)) ⊕ ι) → ℝ := fun x i =>
  weightedDerivativeCoefficientFamily g L lam c f k t
    (fun y => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y) i) x

lemma contDiff_referenceWeightedIndexedCoefficientFamily (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (k t : ℝ)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (referenceWeightedIndexedCoefficientFamily g L lam c f k t) := by
  apply contDiff_pi.mpr
  intro i
  exact contDiff_weightedDerivativeCoefficientFamily g hg L lam c f k t _ hc hf
    (contDiff_referenceMetricGramFrame_slice g hg L lam i)

lemma hasCompactSupport_referenceWeightedIndexedCoefficientFamily (g : MatrixField)
    (L lam : ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (k t : ℝ) (hc : HasCompactSupport c) :
    HasCompactSupport (referenceWeightedIndexedCoefficientFamily g L lam c f k t) := by
  apply hc.mono'
  intro x hx
  by_contra hnot
  have hc0 := image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hnot
  have hd0 := fderiv_of_notMem_tsupport (𝕜 := ℝ) hnot
  simp only [Function.mem_support] at hx
  apply hx
  funext i a
  rcases a with a | a
  · rcases a with a | ⟨h,j,a⟩ <;>
      simp only [referenceWeightedIndexedCoefficientFamily,weightedDerivativeCoefficientFamily,
        joinedCoefficientFamily,Sum.elim_inl,Pi.smul_apply,covariantDerivativeCoefficientFamily,
        hd0,hc0,ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply,Pi.zero_apply,smul_zero,mul_zero]
  · simp only [referenceWeightedIndexedCoefficientFamily,weightedDerivativeCoefficientFamily,
      joinedCoefficientFamily,Sum.elim_inr,Pi.smul_apply,hc0,Pi.zero_apply,smul_zero]

lemma finitePolynomialField_referenceWeighted_indexed (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (k t : ℝ) (x : R3) (i : Fin 3) :
    finitePolynomialField
      (fun a => indexedPolynomialFamily (weightedDerivativePolynomialFamily b) a i)
      (indexedCoefficientFamily (referenceWeightedIndexedCoefficientFamily g L lam c f k t)) x =
    referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c f k t x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) := by
  rw [finitePolynomialField_indexed]
  exact (referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative_eq_finite g L lam b c f k t _ x).symm

lemma finitePolynomialField_referenceWeighted_lowered (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (k t : ℝ) (x : R3) (i l : Fin 3) :
    finitePolynomialField
      (fun a => pderiv l (indexedPolynomialFamily (weightedDerivativePolynomialFamily b) a i))
      (indexedCoefficientFamily (referenceWeightedIndexedCoefficientFamily g L lam c f k t)) x =
    referenceWeightedCovectorPolynomialDerivative g L lam (fun a h => pderiv h (b a)) c f k t x
      (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) l := by
  rw [finitePolynomialField_partial,finitePolynomialField_referenceWeighted_indexed,
    referenceWeightedCovectorPolynomialDerivative_partial]

lemma referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative_referenceWeighted_lowered (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (k t : ℝ)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (x V : R3) (j l : Fin 3) :
    referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative g L lam
      (fun a h => pderiv h (indexedPolynomialFamily (weightedDerivativePolynomialFamily b) a j))
      (indexedCoefficientFamily (referenceWeightedIndexedCoefficientFamily g L lam c f k t)) x V l =
    referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative g L lam (fun a h => pderiv h (weightedDerivativePolynomialFamily b a))
      (weightedDerivativeCoefficientFamily g L lam c f k t
        (fun y => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y) j)) x V l := by
  have hj := contDiff_referenceWeightedIndexedCoefficientFamily g hg L lam c f k t hc hf
  have hflatten := contDiff_indexedCoefficientFamily _ (contDiff_pi.mp hj)
  have hcomponent := contDiff_weightedDerivativeCoefficientFamily g hg L lam c f k t _ hc hf
    (contDiff_referenceMetricGramFrame_slice g hg L lam j)
  rw [referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative_partial,referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative_partial]
  apply congrArg (pderiv l)
  apply referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_congr g hg L lam _ _ _ _ hflatten hcomponent
  intro y
  rw [finitePolynomialField_indexed]
  rfl

lemma referenceWeightedTensorPolynomialDerivative_referenceWeighted_lowered (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (k s t : ℝ)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (x : R3) (i j l : Fin 3) :
    referenceWeightedTensorPolynomialDerivative g L lam
      (fun a h q => pderiv q (indexedPolynomialFamily (weightedDerivativePolynomialFamily b) a h))
      (indexedCoefficientFamily (referenceWeightedIndexedCoefficientFamily g L lam c f k t)) f k s x
      (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) j l =
    referenceWeightedLoweredCovectorIndexedHessian g L lam b c f k s t x i j l := by
  simp only [referenceWeightedTensorPolynomialDerivative,referenceTensorPolynomialDerivative,
    referenceWeightedLoweredCovectorIndexedHessian,referenceWeightedCovectorPolynomialDerivative]
  rw [referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative_referenceWeighted_lowered g hg L lam b c f k t hc hf]
  simp_rw [finitePolynomialField_referenceWeighted_lowered]
  rw [referenceWeightedCovectorPolynomialDerivative_partial g L lam b c f k t x
    (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) j) l]
  rw [referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative_eq_finite g L lam b c f k t
    (fun y => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y) j) x]
  simp only [finitePolynomialField_partial,referenceWeightedCovectorPolynomialDerivative]
  ring

def referenceWeightedTracePolynomialFamily (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    Fin 3 × ((ι ⊕ (Fin 3 × Fin 3 × ι)) ⊕ ι) → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ := fun a =>
  ∑ i : Fin 3, pderiv i (indexedPolynomialFamily (weightedDerivativePolynomialFamily b) a i)

lemma finitePolynomialField_referenceWeighted_trace (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (k t : ℝ) (x : R3) :
    finitePolynomialField (referenceWeightedTracePolynomialFamily b)
      (indexedCoefficientFamily (referenceWeightedIndexedCoefficientFamily g L lam c f k t)) x =
    ∑ i : Fin 3, referenceWeightedCovectorPolynomialDerivative g L lam
      (fun a h => pderiv h (b a)) c f k t x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) i := by
  unfold referenceWeightedTracePolynomialFamily
  simp only [finitePolynomialField,Finset.smul_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => by
    simpa only [finitePolynomialField] using
      finitePolynomialField_referenceWeighted_lowered g L lam b c f k t x i i)

lemma referenceWeightedTensorPolynomialDerivative_transpose (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (k s : ℝ) (x V : R3) (i j : Fin 3) :
    referenceWeightedTensorPolynomialDerivative g L lam (fun a h l => b a l h) c f k s x V i j =
      referenceWeightedTensorPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c f k s x V j i := by
  simp only [referenceWeightedTensorPolynomialDerivative,referenceTensorPolynomialDerivative,
    referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative]
  ring

lemma finitePolynomialField_sum_family (b : ι → σ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (x : R3) :
    finitePolynomialField (fun a => ∑ i : σ, b a i) c x =
      ∑ i : σ, finitePolynomialField (fun a => b a i) c x := by
  simp only [finitePolynomialField,Finset.smul_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_comm

lemma referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_sum_family (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → σ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (x V : R3) :
    referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam (fun a => ∑ i : σ, b a i) c x V =
      ∑ i : σ, referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam (fun a => b a i) c x V := by
  simp only [referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative,finitePolynomialField_sum_family]
  have hd : finitePolynomialFieldDerivative (fun a => ∑ i : σ, b a i) c x V =
      ∑ i : σ, finitePolynomialFieldDerivative (fun a => b a i) c x V := by
    simp only [finitePolynomialFieldDerivative,Finset.smul_sum]
    exact Finset.sum_comm
  rw [hd]
  have ha : referenceFrameAngularPolynomial g L lam x V (∑ i : σ, finitePolynomialField (fun a => b a i) c x) =
      ∑ i : σ, referenceFrameAngularPolynomial g L lam x V (finitePolynomialField (fun a => b a i) c x) :=
    referenceFrameAngularPolynomial_sum g L lam x V (fun i => finitePolynomialField (fun a => b a i) c x)
  rw [ha,Finset.sum_add_distrib]

lemma skew_tensor_trace_cancellation (w : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ a i, w a i = -w i a) (T : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, C (w a i) * T a i) +
      (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, C (w a i) * T i a) = 0 := by
  have h : (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, C (w a i) * T a i) =
      -(∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ a : Fin 3, C (w a i) * T i a) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    simp only [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro i hi
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro a ha
    rw [hw i a,map_neg,neg_mul]
  rw [h,neg_add_cancel]

lemma referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative_tensorTrace (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ)
    (f : R3 → ℝ) (k s : ℝ) (x V : R3) :
    referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative g L lam (fun a => ∑ i : Fin 3, b a i i) c f k s x V =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, referenceWeightedTensorPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c f k s x V i i := by
  have h := skew_tensor_trace_cancellation
    (fun a i => referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient g L lam x V a i)
    (fun a i => referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient_skew g hg L lam x V a i)
    (fun a i => finitePolynomialField (fun j => b j a i) c x)
  have hq := referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_sum_family g L lam (fun a i => b a i i) c x V
  have hu := finitePolynomialField_sum_family (fun a i => b a i i) c x
  simp only [referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative,referenceWeightedTensorPolynomialDerivative,
    referenceTensorPolynomialDerivative,referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative,
    Fin.sum_univ_three] at *
  rw [hq,hu]
  linear_combination C s * h

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.FiniteTensorRealization

``````

``````lean
lemma contDiff_frameConnectionCoefficient_variable

    (hV : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V) (i j : Fin 3) :

  exact (hM.clm_apply (((hE j).fderiv_right (m := ∞) (by simp)).clm_apply hV |>.add
    ((hGamma.clm_apply hV).clm_apply (hE j)))).inner ℝ (hE i)

  contDiff_frameConnectionCoefficient_variable _ _ _ V
    ((contDiff_referenceMetricOperator_joint g hg L).comp (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id))
    ((contDiff_referenceConnectionFamily g hg L).comp (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id))

  convert h using 1
  funext x
  rw [fischerInner_symm]

theorem compact_reference_covector_fischer_adjoint (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (rho : R3 → ℝ) (hr : ContDiff ℝ ∞ rho) (V : R3 → R3) (hV : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V)
    (b : ι → Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (d : κ → Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (z : R3 → κ → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hz : ContDiff ℝ ∞ z)
    (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c) :
    (∫ x : R3, rho x * (∑ i : Fin 3, fischerInner
      (referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x (V x) i)
      (finitePolynomialField (fun j => d j i) z x))) =
      -(∫ x : R3, rho x * (∑ i : Fin 3, fischerInner
        (finitePolynomialField (fun j => b j i) c x)
        (referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative g L lam d z x (V x) i))) -
      (∫ x : R3, weightedCoordinateDivergence rho V x * finiteCovectorFischerPair b d c z x) := by
  have hleft : Integrable (fun x => rho x * (∑ i : Fin 3, fischerInner
      (referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x (V x) i)
      (finitePolynomialField (fun j => d j i) z x))) := by
    simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    exact integrable_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => integrable_referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative_fischer_left
      g hg L lam rho hr.continuous V hV b _ c z hc hz hcompact i)
  have hright : Integrable (fun x => rho x * (∑ i : Fin 3, fischerInner
      (finitePolynomialField (fun j => b j i) c x)
      (referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative g L lam d z x (V x) i))) := by
    simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    exact integrable_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => integrable_referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative_fischer_right
      g hg L lam rho hr.continuous V hV _ d c z hc hz hcompact i)
  have h := compact_reference_covector_fischer_contraction g hg L lam rho hr V hV b d c z hc hz hcompact
  simp_rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib,mul_add] at h
  rw [integral_add hleft hright] at h
  linarith

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.FischerCovectorAdjunction
``````

## Calderon.FullCovectorCurvature

SHA256 `62ce2acd2334403942825f2bae759c27ad30bddc281aea8313749a80f51308b2`.

``````lean
import Calderon.CurvatureContraction
import Calderon.PolynomialSlotCompatibility

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 10
noncomputable section
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.FullCovectorCurvature
open RadiusProfile ConformalDepth MetricOperator SphereHarmonic AngularPolynomial MvPolynomial
  CurvatureRotation CurvatureSkew FrameCurvaturePolynomial CurvatureContraction
  PolynomialSlotCompatibility

def referenceCovectorCurvaturePolynomial (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ) (x : R3)
    (e : Fin 3 → R3) (i j : Fin 3) (W : Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (l : Fin 3) : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  referenceHorizontalCurvaturePolynomial g L lam x e i j (W l) -
    ∑ b : Fin 3, C (referenceCurvatureRotationCoefficient g L lam x e i j b l) * W b

def referenceBaseCovectorCurvatureContraction (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ) (x : R3)
    (e : Fin 3 → R3) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) : ℝ :=
  -(∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
    referenceCurvatureRotationCoefficient g L lam x e i j b j *
      fischerInner (pderiv i p) (pderiv b p))

def referenceFullCovectorCurvatureContraction (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ) (x : R3)
    (e : Fin 3 → R3) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, fischerInner (pderiv i p)
    (referenceCovectorCurvaturePolynomial g L lam x e i j (fun b => pderiv b p) j)

lemma referenceCovectorCurvaturePolynomial_partial (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ) (x : R3)
    (e : Fin 3 → R3) (i j l : Fin 3) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    referenceCovectorCurvaturePolynomial g L lam x e i j (fun b => pderiv b p) l =
      pderiv l (referenceHorizontalCurvaturePolynomial g L lam x e i j p) := by
  have h := polynomialMatrixVectorField_partial_commutator
    (referenceCurvatureRotationCoefficient g L lam x e i j) p l
  simp only [referenceCovectorCurvaturePolynomial, referenceHorizontalCurvaturePolynomial,
    referenceCurvatureVectorFieldPolynomial]
  linear_combination h

lemma referenceFullCovectorCurvatureContraction_eq (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ) (x : R3)
    (e : Fin 3 → R3) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    referenceFullCovectorCurvatureContraction g L lam x e p =
      referenceCurvatureContraction g L lam x e p +
        referenceBaseCovectorCurvatureContraction g L lam x e p := by
  simp only [referenceFullCovectorCurvatureContraction, referenceCovectorCurvaturePolynomial,
    referenceCurvatureContraction, referenceBaseCovectorCurvatureContraction,
    fischerInner_sub_right, fischerInner_sum_right, fischerInner_C_mul_right,
    Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  exact sub_eq_add_neg _ _

lemma abs_fischerInner_le_half_squares (p q : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    |fischerInner p q| ≤ (fischerInner p p + fischerInner q q) / 2 := by
  simpa only [one_pow, one_mul, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm] using
    abs_fischerInner_le_of_square_bound 1 (by norm_num) p q q (by simp)

lemma abs_base_covector_curvature_sum_le (c : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (B : ℝ) (hB : 0 ≤ B) (hc : ∀ i j b, |c i j b| ≤ B)
    (k : ℕ) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hp : p.IsHomogeneous k) :
    |-(∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        c i j b * fischerInner (pderiv i p) (pderiv b p))| ≤
      (9*B)*(k : ℝ)*fischerInner p p := by
  have hcross (i j b : Fin 3) :
      |c i j b * fischerInner (pderiv i p) (pderiv b p)| ≤
        (B/2)*(fischerInner (pderiv i p) (pderiv i p) +
          fischerInner (pderiv b p) (pderiv b p)) := by
    rw [abs_mul]
    calc
      _ ≤ B * ((fischerInner (pderiv i p) (pderiv i p) +
          fischerInner (pderiv b p) (pderiv b p))/2) :=
        mul_le_mul (hc i j b) (abs_fischerInner_le_half_squares _ _) (abs_nonneg _) hB
      _ = _ := by ring
  rw [abs_neg]
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, |∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        c i j b * fischerInner (pderiv i p) (pderiv b p)| :=
      Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
        |c i j b * fischerInner (pderiv i p) (pderiv b p)| := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro i hi
      refine (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans ?_
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro j hj
      exact Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, (B/2)*
        (fischerInner (pderiv i p) (pderiv i p) +
          fischerInner (pderiv b p) (pderiv b p)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro i hi
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro j hj
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum; intro b hb
      exact hcross i j b
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_const,
        Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul, ← Finset.sum_mul,
        sum_fischerInner_pderiv_self hp]
      ring

theorem exists_referenceBaseCovectorCurvatureContraction_uniform_fischer_bound
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ e : Fin 3 → R3,
      IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x) e →
      ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ, p.IsHomogeneous k →
      |referenceBaseCovectorCurvatureContraction g L lam x e p| ≤
        C*(k : ℝ)*fischerInner p p := by
  obtain ⟨B,hB,hbound⟩ := exists_referenceCurvatureRotationCoefficient_uniform_bound g hg L hL K hK
  refine ⟨9*B,by positivity,?_⟩
  intro lam hlam x hx e he k p hp
  exact abs_base_covector_curvature_sum_le
    (fun i j b => referenceCurvatureRotationCoefficient g L lam x e i j b j)
    B hB.le (fun i j b => hbound lam hlam x hx e he i j b j) k p hp

theorem exists_referenceFullCovectorCurvatureContraction_uniform_fischer_bound
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ hF : SphereFischerInner,
      ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ e : Fin 3 → R3,
      IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x) e →
      ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → ∀ p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ,
      p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k →
      |referenceFullCovectorCurvatureContraction g L lam x e p| ≤
        C*(k : ℝ)^2*fischerInner p p := by
  obtain ⟨A,hA,hpoly⟩ := exists_referenceCurvatureContraction_uniform_fischer_bound g hg L hL K hK
  obtain ⟨B,hB,hbase⟩ := exists_referenceBaseCovectorCurvatureContraction_uniform_fischer_bound g hg L hL K hK
  refine ⟨A+B,add_pos hA hB,?_⟩
  intro hF lam hlam x hx e he k hk p hp
  have hk' : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hkk : (k : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ)^2 := by nlinarith
  rw [referenceFullCovectorCurvatureContraction_eq]
  calc
    _ ≤ |referenceCurvatureContraction g L lam x e p| +
        |referenceBaseCovectorCurvatureContraction g L lam x e p| := abs_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ A*(k : ℝ)^2*fischerInner p p + B*(k : ℝ)*fischerInner p p :=
      add_le_add (hpoly hF lam hlam x hx e he k hk p hp) (hbase lam hlam x hx e he k p hp.1)
    _ ≤ A*(k : ℝ)^2*fischerInner p p + B*(k : ℝ)^2*fischerInner p p := by
      gcongr
      exact fischerInner_self_nonneg _
    _ = _ := by ring

theorem exists_referenceFullCovectorCurvatureContraction_uniform_normalized_bound
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ hF : SphereFischerInner,
      ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ x ∈ K, ∀ e : Fin 3 → R3,
      IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x) e →
      ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → ∀ p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ,
      p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k →
      |referenceFullCovectorCurvatureContraction g L lam x e p| / sphereNormalization 3 k ≤
        C*(k : ℝ)^2*‖polynomialSphereL2 p‖^2 := by
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hbound⟩ := exists_referenceFullCovectorCurvatureContraction_uniform_fischer_bound g hg L hL K hK
  refine ⟨C,hC,?_⟩
  intro hF lam hlam x hx e he k hk p hp
  have h := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (hbound hF lam hlam x hx e he k hk p hp)
    (sphereNormalization_pos (n := 3) (by norm_num : 0 < 3) k).le
  rw [polynomialSphereL2_norm_sq hF k p hp]
  unfold normalizedFischerSquare normalizedFischerInner
  simpa only [Fintype.card_fin, mul_div_assoc] using h

lemma referenceCurvatureContraction_eq_zero_of_isHomogeneous_one
    (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ) (x : R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hp : p.IsHomogeneous 1) :
    referenceCurvatureContraction g L lam x e p = 0 := by
  have hd (i : Fin 3) : (pderiv i p).IsHomogeneous 0 := by simpa using hp.pderiv (i := i)
  simp only [referenceCurvatureContraction,
    referenceHorizontalCurvaturePolynomial_eq_zero_of_isHomogeneous_zero g L lam x e _ _ _ (hd _),
    fischerInner_zero_right, Finset.sum_const_zero]

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.FullCovectorCurvature
``````

## Calderon.HarmonicSampling

``````lean
import Calderon.FiniteProfileNormComparison
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Dual.Lemmas
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Finsupp.LinearCombination
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Dimension.Free
import Mathlib.RingTheory.MvPolynomial.Homogeneous

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MvPolynomial
open scoped ContDiff Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.HarmonicSampling
open RadiusProfile SphereHarmonic AngularPolynomial FischerConnectionTransport

lemma finiteDimensional_harmonicHomogeneous (k : ℕ) : FiniteDimensional ℝ (harmonicHomogeneous k) := by
  letI : Module.Finite ℝ (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 3) ℝ k) :=
    Module.Finite.of_fg (homogeneousSubmodule_fg (Fin 3) ℝ k)
  have hle : harmonicHomogeneous k ≤ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 3) ℝ k := fun p hp => hp.1
  exact FiniteDimensional.of_injective (Submodule.inclusion hle) (Submodule.inclusion_injective hle)

def harmonicSphereEvaluation (k : ℕ) (theta : UnitSphere) : (harmonicHomogeneous k) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ where
  toFun p := p.val.eval (theta.val : Fin 3 → ℝ)
  map_add' p q := by simp
  map_smul' r p := by simp [smul_eq_C_mul]

lemma harmonicPolynomial_eq_zero_of_sphere (hF : SphereFischerInner) (k : ℕ)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hp : p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k)
    (hzero : ∀ theta : UnitSphere, p.eval (theta.val : Fin 3 → ℝ) = 0) : p = 0 := by
  have hs : polynomialSphere p = 0 := by ext theta; exact hzero theta
  have hL : polynomialSphereL2 p = 0 := by
    change (ContinuousMap.toLp 2 sphereProbability ℝ) (polynomialSphere p) = 0
    rw [hs,map_zero]
  exact (polynomialSphereL2_eq_zero_iff hF k p hp).mp hL

lemma harmonicSphereEvaluation_iInf_ker_eq_bot (hF : SphereFischerInner) (k : ℕ) :
    (⨅ theta : UnitSphere, LinearMap.ker (harmonicSphereEvaluation k theta)) = ⊥ := by
  apply le_antisymm
  · intro p hp
    have hh : ∀ theta : UnitSphere, p.val.eval (theta.val : Fin 3 → ℝ) = 0 := by
      intro theta
      exact (Submodule.mem_iInf _).mp hp theta
    have hp0 : p = 0 := Subtype.ext (harmonicPolynomial_eq_zero_of_sphere hF k p.val p.property hh)
    simpa only [hp0] using (Submodule.zero_mem (⊥ : Submodule ℝ (harmonicHomogeneous k)))
  · exact bot_le

theorem harmonicLinearForm_mem_span_evaluations (hF : SphereFischerInner) (k : ℕ)
    (ell : (harmonicHomogeneous k) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) :
    ell ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (harmonicSphereEvaluation k)) := by
  letI := finiteDimensional_harmonicHomogeneous k
  apply FiniteDimensional.mem_span_of_iInf_ker_le_ker
  rw [harmonicSphereEvaluation_iInf_ker_eq_bot hF k]
  exact bot_le

theorem harmonicLinearForm_finite_evaluations (hF : SphereFischerInner) (k : ℕ)
    (ell : (harmonicHomogeneous k) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) :
    ∃ w : UnitSphere →₀ ℝ, ∀ p : harmonicHomogeneous k,
      ell p = ∑ theta ∈ w.support, w theta * p.val.eval (theta.val : Fin 3 → ℝ) := by
  obtain ⟨w,hw⟩ := Finsupp.mem_span_range_iff_exists_finsupp.mp
    (harmonicLinearForm_mem_span_evaluations hF k ell)
  refine ⟨w,?_⟩
  intro p
  have hh := congrArg (fun L : (harmonicHomogeneous k) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ => L p) hw
  change ell p = ∑ theta ∈ w.support, w theta * harmonicSphereEvaluation k theta p
  simpa only [Finsupp.sum,LinearMap.sum_apply,LinearMap.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul] using hh.symm

theorem contDiff_harmonicLinearForm_of_evaluations (hF : SphereFischerInner) (k : ℕ)
    (U : R3 → harmonicHomogeneous k)
    (hsmooth : ∀ theta : UnitSphere, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => (U x).val.eval (theta.val : Fin 3 → ℝ)))
    (ell : (harmonicHomogeneous k) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => ell (U x)) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨w,hw⟩ := harmonicLinearForm_finite_evaluations hF k ell
  have hh : (fun x => ell (U x)) = fun x => ∑ theta ∈ w.support, w theta * (U x).val.eval (theta.val : Fin 3 → ℝ) := by
    funext x
    exact hw (U x)
  rw [hh]
  exact ContDiff.sum (fun theta _ => contDiff_const.mul (hsmooth theta))

theorem hasCompactSupport_harmonicLinearForm_of_sphere_support (hF : SphereFischerInner) (k : ℕ)
    (U : R3 → harmonicHomogeneous k) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hzero : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, (U x).val.eval (theta.val : Fin 3 → ℝ) = 0)
    (ell : (harmonicHomogeneous k) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ) : HasCompactSupport (fun x => ell (U x)) := by
  apply hK.of_isClosed_subset (isClosed_tsupport _) ?_
  apply closure_minimal ?_ hK.isClosed
  intro x hx
  by_contra hnot
  have hu0 : U x = 0 := Subtype.ext (harmonicPolynomial_eq_zero_of_sphere hF k (U x).val (U x).property (hzero x hnot))
  exact hx (by change ell (U x) = 0; rw [hu0,map_zero])

theorem contDiff_harmonicBasis_coordinates {τ : Type*} [Fintype τ]
    (hF : SphereFischerInner) (k : ℕ) (B : Module.Basis τ ℝ (harmonicHomogeneous k))
    (U : R3 → harmonicHomogeneous k)
    (hsmooth : ∀ theta : UnitSphere, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => (U x).val.eval (theta.val : Fin 3 → ℝ))) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => fun j => B.repr (U x) j) := by
  apply contDiff_pi.mpr
  intro j
  exact contDiff_harmonicLinearForm_of_evaluations hF k U hsmooth (B.coord j)

theorem hasCompactSupport_harmonicBasis_coordinates {τ : Type*} [Fintype τ]
    (hF : SphereFischerInner) (k : ℕ) (B : Module.Basis τ ℝ (harmonicHomogeneous k))
    (U : R3 → harmonicHomogeneous k) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hzero : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, (U x).val.eval (theta.val : Fin 3 → ℝ) = 0) :
    HasCompactSupport (fun x => fun j => B.repr (U x) j) := by
  apply hK.of_isClosed_subset (isClosed_tsupport _) ?_
  apply closure_minimal ?_ hK.isClosed
  intro x hx
  by_contra hnot
  have hu0 : U x = 0 := Subtype.ext (harmonicPolynomial_eq_zero_of_sphere hF k (U x).val (U x).property (hzero x hnot))
  apply hx
  change (fun j => B.repr (U x) j) = 0
  rw [hu0,map_zero]
  rfl

lemma harmonicBasis_finitePolynomialField {τ : Type*} [Fintype τ]
    (k : ℕ) (B : Module.Basis τ ℝ (harmonicHomogeneous k))
    (U : R3 → harmonicHomogeneous k) (x : R3) :
    finitePolynomialField (fun j => (B j).val) (fun y j => B.repr (U y) j) x = (U x).val := by
  have hh := congrArg (fun p : harmonicHomogeneous k => p.val) (B.sum_repr (U x))
  simpa only [finitePolynomialField,Submodule.coe_sum,Submodule.coe_smul,smul_eq_C_mul] using hh

theorem exists_smooth_compact_harmonic_coordinates (hF : SphereFischerInner) (k : ℕ)
    (U : R3 → harmonicHomogeneous k)
    (hsmooth : ∀ theta : UnitSphere, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => (U x).val.eval (theta.val : Fin 3 → ℝ)))
    (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hzero : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, (U x).val.eval (theta.val : Fin 3 → ℝ) = 0) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ b : Fin n → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ, ∃ c : R3 → Fin n → ℝ,
      (∀ j, b j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ c ∧ HasCompactSupport c ∧
      ∀ x, finitePolynomialField b c x = (U x).val := by
  letI := finiteDimensional_harmonicHomogeneous k
  let B := Module.finBasis ℝ (harmonicHomogeneous k)
  refine ⟨Module.finrank ℝ (harmonicHomogeneous k),fun j => (B j).val,
    (fun x j => B.repr (U x) j), (fun j => (B j).property),
    contDiff_harmonicBasis_coordinates hF k B U hsmooth,
    hasCompactSupport_harmonicBasis_coordinates hF k B U K hK hzero, ?_⟩
  intro x
  exact harmonicBasis_finitePolynomialField k B U x

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.HarmonicSampling
``````
