## Calderon.MetricFrameTrace

SHA256 `d7999a7d9c460f98cb9fbbee06d7e2136581e0d5b4ca1c7e74ed0deeb4301575`.

``````lean
import Calderon.FischerDensityIntegration
import Calderon.MetricHessianQuadratic
import Calderon.ReferenceCovariantJets

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 10
noncomputable section
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Gradient Topology Matrix.Norms.Operator
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.MetricFrameTrace
open RadiusProfile ConformalDepth MetricOperator MetricVolume AngularPolynomial
  FrameCurvaturePolynomial FischerDensityIntegration SmoothMetricFrame ReferenceDensityBounds

lemma matrixOperator_apply_inverse (M : Mat) (hM : M.PosDef) (v : R3) :
    matrixOperatorMap M (matrixOperatorMap M⁻¹ v) = v := by
  have h : matrixOperatorAlgEquiv M * matrixOperatorAlgEquiv M⁻¹ = 1 := by
    rw [← map_mul, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv M (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hM.det_pos.ne'), map_one]
  exact congrArg (fun A : R3 →L[ℝ] R3 => A v) h

lemma inverseMatrix_metricFrame_sum (M : Mat) (hM : M.PosDef) (e : Fin 3 → R3)
    (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (matrixOperatorMap M) e) (v : R3) :
    matrixOperatorMap M⁻¹ v = ∑ i : Fin 3, ⟪v,e i⟫_ℝ • e i := by
  have h := metricFrame_sum_coordinates (matrixOperatorMap M) e he (matrixOperatorMap M⁻¹ v)
  rw [matrixOperator_apply_inverse M hM] at h
  exact h.symm

lemma inverseMatrix_entry_eq_metricFrame_sum (M : Mat) (hM : M.PosDef) (e : Fin 3 → R3)
    (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (matrixOperatorMap M) e) (i j : Fin 3) :
    M⁻¹ i j = ∑ a : Fin 3, (e a) i * (e a) j := by
  have h := congrArg (fun v : R3 => v i)
    (inverseMatrix_metricFrame_sum M hM e he (coordinateVector j))
  simpa [matrixOperator_coordinate, coordinateVector, PiLp.single_apply, mul_comm,
    EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left] using h

def metricFrameGradient (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3) (f : R3 → ℝ) (x : R3) : R3 :=
  ∑ i : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ f x (e x i) • e x i

lemma metricFrameGradient_eq_inverse_gradient (g : MatrixField) (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3)
    (f : R3 → ℝ) (x : R3) (hp : (g x).PosDef)
    (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (metricOperatorField g x) (e x)) :
    metricFrameGradient e f x = matrixOperatorMap ((g x)⁻¹) (gradient f x) := by
  rw [inverseMatrix_metricFrame_sum (g x) hp (e x) he]
  simp only [metricFrameGradient, inner_gradient_left]

lemma contDiff_metricFrameGradient (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (he : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => e x i)) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (metricFrameGradient e f) := by
  have hd := (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.mp hf).2
  exact ContDiff.sum (fun i _ => (hd.clm_apply (he i)).smul (he i))

lemma bilinear_metricFrame_trace (M : Mat) (hM : M.PosDef) (e : Fin 3 → R3)
    (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (matrixOperatorMap M) e)
    (B : R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) :
    (∑ a : Fin 3, B (e a) (e a)) =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, M⁻¹ i j * B (coordinateVector i) (coordinateVector j) := by
  have hB (a : Fin 3) := bilinear_coordinate_sum B (e a) (e a)
  simp only [hB, inverseMatrix_entry_eq_metricFrame_sum M hM e he, Fin.sum_univ_three]
  ring

lemma weightedCoordinateDivergence_eq_densityWeightedDivergence (rho : R3 → ℝ)
    (V : R3 → R3) (x : R3) :
    weightedCoordinateDivergence rho V x =
      AngularPolynomial.densityWeightedDivergence (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin 3) ℝ) rho V x := by
  simp only [weightedCoordinateDivergence, AngularPolynomial.densityWeightedDivergence,
    EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right, one_mul, conj_trivial,
    BaseDensityAdjoint.directionalDeriv, coordinateDirection]

theorem weightedCoordinateDivergence_metricFrameGradient_eq_hessian_trace
    (g : MatrixField) (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3) (f : R3 → ℝ) (x : R3)
    (hg : ∀ i j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => g y i j) x)
    (hp : ∀ y, (g y).PosDef)
    (he : ∀ y, IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (metricOperatorField g y) (e y))
    (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x) :
    weightedCoordinateDivergence (vol g) (metricFrameGradient e f) x =
      vol g x * ∑ a : Fin 3, coordinateHessian f
        (fun X Y => ConnectionError.coordinateConnectionField
          (ConnectionError.inverseMetricField (metricOperatorField g)) (metricOperatorField g) x X Y)
        x (e x a) (e x a) := by
  have hG : metricFrameGradient e f =
      fun y => matrixOperatorMap ((g y)⁻¹) (gradient f y) :=
    funext (fun y => metricFrameGradient_eq_inverse_gradient g e f y (hp y) (he y))
  rw [hG, weightedCoordinateDivergence_eq_densityWeightedDivergence,
    densityWeightedDivergence_eq_metricHessian_trace g f x hg hp hf]
  have hT := bilinear_metricFrame_trace (g x) (hp x) (e x) (he x)
    (MetricVolume.coordinateHessianBilinear f
      (ConnectionError.coordinateConnectionField
        (ConnectionError.inverseMetricField (metricOperatorField g)) (metricOperatorField g) x) x)
  simp only [MetricVolume.coordinateHessianBilinear_apply] at hT
  rw [hT]

theorem reference_weightedCoordinateDivergence_metricFrameGradient_eq_hessian_trace
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (f : R3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (x : R3) :
    weightedCoordinateDivergence (fun y => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,y))
      (metricFrameGradient (fun y => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y)) f) x =
    referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * ∑ a : Fin 3,
      coordinateHessian f (fun X Y => referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,x) X Y) x
        (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) a) (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) a) := by
  have hpos : ∀ y, (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L y).PosDef := by
    intro y
    exact EnergyBridge.conformalMatrix_posDef _ _ (fun z => hg.posDef (lam • z)) y
  have hs : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L y i j) := by
    intro i j
    exact EnergyBridge.conformalMatrix_smooth_entries _ _
      (fun i j => (hg.smooth i j).comp
        ((contDiff_const : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun _ : R3 => lam)).smul
          (contDiff_id : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : R3 => y))))
      (contDiff_const.mul contDiff_referenceCoordinateDepth) i j
  exact weightedCoordinateDivergence_metricFrameGradient_eq_hessian_trace
    (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) _ f x
    (fun i j => (hs i j).differentiable (by simp) x) hpos
    (fun y => referenceMetricGramFrame_isMetricOrthonormalFrame g hg L (lam,y))
    ((contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.mp hf).2.differentiable (by simp) x)

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.MetricFrameTrace

``````

## Calderon.ProfileHessianEnergy

SHA256 `ab1b0fc5fa01f164cfbf6f611d4f682512e72de66c1c2c742bc1debf5043ebfd`.

``````lean
import Calderon.WeightedRaisingBounds
import Calderon.HessianContraction

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 10
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory MvPolynomial
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Gradient Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.ProfileHessianEnergy
open RadiusProfile ConformalDepth MetricOperator AngularPolynomial SphereHarmonic
  WeightedFischerSquare SmoothMetricFrame FischerConnectionTransport
  IntegratedFischerIdentities FiniteRaisingEnergy WeightedRaisingBounds
  MetricFrameTrace ReferenceDensityBounds HessianContraction FischerDensityIntegration
  FiniteCovariantCurvature FrameCurvaturePolynomial MovingFrameConnection

attribute [local irreducible] referenceMetricGramFrame referenceConnectionFamily
  metricOperatorField referenceMetric dilatedMetric finitePolynomialField
variable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]

def referenceProfileMass (g : MatrixField) (lam δ R L : ℝ) (p : ℕ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x*
    fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField b c x)

def referenceProfileTraceHessianEnergy (g : MatrixField) (lam δ R L : ℝ) (p : ℕ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (k : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*(2*k*∑ i : Fin 3,
    referenceFrameHessianCoefficient g L lam (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) x i i)*
    fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField b c x)

lemma integrable_referenceProfileTraceHessianEnergy (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (lam δ R L : ℝ) (p : ℕ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hR : 0 < R)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (k : ℝ)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c) :
    Integrable (fun x : R3 => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*(2*k*∑ i : Fin 3,
      referenceFrameHessianCoefficient g L lam (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) x i i)*
      fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField b c x)) := by
  have hH : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : R3 => 2*k*∑ i : Fin 3,
      referenceFrameHessianCoefficient g L lam (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) x i i) :=
    contDiff_const.mul (ContDiff.sum (fun i _ =>
      contDiff_referenceFrameHessianCoefficient g hg L lam _
        (contDiff_log_referenceRadius δ R p L hδ hR) i i))
  exact integrable_referenceDensity_weighted_fischerPair g hg L lam _ hH.continuous b b c c hc hc hcompact

lemma referenceProfile_loweredHessian_eq_contraction (g : MatrixField)
    (lam δ R L : ℝ) (p k : ℕ) (v : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (x : R3) :
    (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (2*(k:ℝ)*referenceFrameHessianCoefficient g L lam (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) x i j)*
        fischerInner (pderiv i v) (pderiv j v)) =
      referenceProfileHessianContraction g lam δ R p L x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x)) k v := by
  simp only [referenceProfileHessianContraction,referenceProfileHessianBilinear,
    MetricVolume.coordinateHessianBilinear_apply,referenceFrameHessianCoefficient,
    referenceConnectionFamily,AngularPolynomial.inverseMetricOperator,Finset.mul_sum,mul_assoc]

lemma referenceProfileMass_nonneg (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (lam δ R L : ℝ) (p : ℕ) (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) :
    0 ≤ referenceProfileMass g lam δ R L p b c := by
  apply integral_nonneg
  intro x
  exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (referenceDensityFamily_pos g hg L (lam,x)).le
    (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)) (fischerInner_self_nonneg _)

lemma referenceProfile_loweredHessian_pointwise_le (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (K : Set R3) (L c0 nu J1 J2 D : ℝ) (hbounds : referenceProfileBounds g K L c0 nu J1 J2 D)
    (lam : ℝ) (hlam : lam ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (p : ℕ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (k : ℕ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hb : ∀ a, b a ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (hzero : ∀ x ∉ K, finitePolynomialField b c x = 0) (x : R3) :
    (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (2*(k:ℝ)*referenceFrameHessianCoefficient g L lam (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) x i j)*
        fischerInner (pderiv i (finitePolynomialField b c x)) (pderiv j (finitePolynomialField b c x))) ≤
      -2*nu*(k:ℝ)^2*referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x*
        fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField b c x) := by
  by_cases hx : x ∈ K
  · rw [referenceProfile_loweredHessian_eq_contraction]
    exact referenceProfileHessianContraction_le g K L c0 nu J1 J2 D hbounds lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp x hx _
      (referenceMetricGramFrame_isMetricOrthonormalFrame g hg L (lam,x)) k _
      (finitePolynomialField_harmonicHomogeneous k b hb c x).1
  · simp only [hzero x hx,map_zero,fischerInner_zero_left,mul_zero,Finset.sum_const_zero,le_refl]

lemma referenceProfile_loweredHessianEnergy_le (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (K : Set R3) (L c0 nu J1 J2 D : ℝ) (hbounds : referenceProfileBounds g K L c0 nu J1 J2 D)
    (lam : ℝ) (hlam : lam ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (p : ℕ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (k : ℕ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hb : ∀ a, b a ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c)
    (hzero : ∀ x ∉ K, finitePolynomialField b c x = 0) :
    referenceLoweredHessianEnergy g L lam b c (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) k ≤
      (-2*nu*(k:ℝ)^2)*referenceProfileMass g lam δ R L p b c := by
  have hH := integrable_referenceLoweredHessian g hg L lam b c _ (k:ℝ) hc
    (contDiff_log_referenceRadius δ R p L hδ hR) hcompact
  have hM := integrable_referenceProfileNorm_fischerSquare g hg lam δ R L p hδ hR b c hc hcompact
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ x : R3, (-2*nu*(k:ℝ)^2)*(referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x*
        fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField b c x)) := by
      apply integral_mono hH (hM.const_mul _)
      intro x
      have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (referenceProfile_loweredHessian_pointwise_le g hg K L c0 nu J1 J2 D hbounds lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp k b hb c hzero x)
        (referenceDensityFamily_pos g hg L (lam,x)).le
      calc
        _ ≤ referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*(-2*nu*(k:ℝ)^2*referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x*
            fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField b c x)) := hh
        _ = _ := by ring
    _ = _ := integral_const_mul _ _

lemma referenceProfileTraceHessian_pointwise_le (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (K : Set R3) (L c0 nu J1 J2 D : ℝ) (hbounds : referenceProfileBounds g K L c0 nu J1 J2 D)
    (lam : ℝ) (hlam : lam ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (p : ℕ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (k : ℕ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ)
    (hzero : ∀ x ∉ K, finitePolynomialField b c x = 0) (x : R3) :
    (2*(k:ℝ)*∑ i : Fin 3, referenceFrameHessianCoefficient g L lam (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) x i i)*
        fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField b c x) ≤
      -6*nu*(k:ℝ)*referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x*
        fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField b c x) := by
  by_cases hx : x ∈ K
  · have he := referenceMetricGramFrame_isMetricOrthonormalFrame g hg L (lam,x)
    have hdiag (i : Fin 3) : referenceFrameHessianCoefficient g L lam (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) x i i ≤
        -nu*referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x := by
      have h := (hbounds.1 lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp x hx).2.1 (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i)
      rw [IsMetricOrthonormalFrame_unit _ _ he i,mul_one] at h
      simpa only [referenceFrameHessianCoefficient,referenceConnectionFamily] using h
    have hs := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i (_ : i ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3))) => hdiag i)
    simp only [Finset.sum_const,Finset.card_univ,Fintype.card_fin,nsmul_eq_mul,Nat.cast_ofNat] at hs
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs (show 0 ≤ 2*(k:ℝ) by positivity)
    have hm' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hm (fischerInner_self_nonneg (finitePolynomialField b c x))
    convert hm' using 1 <;> ring
  · simp only [hzero x hx,fischerInner_zero_left,mul_zero,le_refl]

lemma referenceProfileTraceHessianEnergy_le (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (K : Set R3) (L c0 nu J1 J2 D : ℝ) (hbounds : referenceProfileBounds g K L c0 nu J1 J2 D)
    (lam : ℝ) (hlam : lam ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ ≤ 1)
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (p : ℕ) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (k : ℕ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c)
    (hzero : ∀ x ∉ K, finitePolynomialField b c x = 0) :
    referenceProfileTraceHessianEnergy g lam δ R L p b c k ≤
      (-6*nu*(k:ℝ))*referenceProfileMass g lam δ R L p b c := by
  have hJ := integrable_referenceProfileTraceHessianEnergy g hg lam δ R L p hδ hR b c k hc hcompact
  have hM := integrable_referenceProfileNorm_fischerSquare g hg lam δ R L p hδ hR b c hc hcompact
  calc
    _ ≤ ∫ x : R3, (-6*nu*(k:ℝ))*(referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x*
        fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField b c x)) := by
      apply integral_mono hJ (hM.const_mul _)
      intro x
      convert mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (referenceProfileTraceHessian_pointwise_le g hg K L c0 nu J1 J2 D hbounds lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 R hR p hp k b c hzero x)
        (referenceDensityFamily_pos g hg L (lam,x)).le using 1 <;> ring
    _ = _ := integral_const_mul _ _

lemma referenceProfileFrameEnergy_square_difference (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam δ R : ℝ) (p k : ℕ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hR : 0 < R)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c) :
    (∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g L lam b c (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) k (-1) x) =
      (∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g L lam b c (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) k 1 x) +
      referenceProfileTraceHessianEnergy g lam δ R L p b c k :=
  compact_referenceLogRadius_weightedFrameEnergy_square_difference g hg L lam δ R p k hδ hR b c hc hcompact

lemma referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_eq_zero_off_closed (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsClosed K)
    (hU : ∀ y ∉ K, finitePolynomialField b c y = 0) (x V : R3) (hx : x ∉ K) :
    referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x V = 0 := by
  let F : R3 × R3 → ℝ := evaluatedReferencePolynomialField g L lam b c
  apply referenceMovingFramePolynomial_injective g hg L lam x
  intro v
  have hO : IsOpen {z : R3 × R3 | z.1 ∉ K} := hK.isOpen_compl.preimage continuous_fst
  have he : F =ᶠ[𝓝 (x,v)] (fun _ : R3 × R3 => (0:ℝ)) := by
    filter_upwards [hO.mem_nhds hx] with z hz
    change evaluatedReferencePolynomialField g L lam b c z = 0
    rw [evaluatedReferencePolynomialField_eq,hU z.1 hz]
    simp [referenceMovingFramePolynomial,movingFramePolynomial]
  have hD : fderiv ℝ F (x,v) = 0 := by
    simpa only [fderiv_const_apply] using he.fderiv_eq (𝕜 := ℝ)
  have hH := fderiv_evaluatedReferencePolynomialField_horizontal g hg L lam b c hc x v V
  change fderiv ℝ F (x,v) (V,-referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,x) V v) = _ at hH
  rw [hD] at hH
  simpa [referenceMovingFramePolynomial,movingFramePolynomial] using hH.symm

lemma referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative_eq_zero_off_closed (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsClosed K)
    (hU : ∀ y ∉ K, finitePolynomialField b c y = 0) (x V : R3) (hx : x ∉ K)
    (f : R3 → ℝ) (k s : ℝ) :
    referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c f k s x V = 0 := by
  simp only [referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative,
    referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_eq_zero_off_closed g hg L lam b c hc K hK hU x V hx,
    hU x hx,mul_zero,add_zero]

lemma referenceWeightedFrameEnergy_eq_zero_off_closed (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsClosed K)
    (hU : ∀ y ∉ K, finitePolynomialField b c y = 0) (x : R3) (hx : x ∉ K)
    (f : R3 → ℝ) (k s : ℝ) : referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g L lam b c f k s x = 0 := by
  simp only [referenceWeightedFrameEnergy,
    referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative_eq_zero_off_closed g hg L lam b c hc K hK hU x _ hx,
    fischerInner_zero_left,Finset.sum_const_zero]

lemma referenceLoweredWeightedTraceField_eq_zero_off_closed (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsClosed K)
    (hU : ∀ y ∉ K, finitePolynomialField b c y = 0) (x : R3) (hx : x ∉ K)
    (f : R3 → ℝ) (k s : ℝ) : referenceLoweredWeightedTraceField g L lam b c f k s x = 0 := by
  rw [← polynomialDivergence_referenceWeightedFramePolynomialField]
  simp only [polynomialDivergence,referenceWeightedFramePolynomialField,
    referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative_eq_zero_off_closed g hg L lam b c hc K hK hU x _ hx,
    map_zero,Finset.sum_const_zero]

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.ProfileHessianEnergy

``````

## Calderon.ScalarContractedAdjunction

SHA256 `14f01f006b9bdc599af7d5c43597319aad8a48fdba7590539250930edce88a1e`.

``````lean
import Calderon.ContractedFischerAdjunction
import Calderon.WeightedFischerSquare

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 10
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory MvPolynomial
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.ScalarContractedAdjunction
open RadiusProfile ConformalDepth AngularPolynomial SphereHarmonic MetricOperator
  MovingFrameConnection FischerConnectionTransport FischerDensityIntegration
  FischerCovectorAdjunction MetricFrameDivergence SmoothMetricFrame ReferenceDensityBounds
  PolynomialSlotCompatibility FiniteCovectorTransport BaseDensityAdjoint
  ContractedFischerAdjunction WeightedFischerSquare

attribute [local irreducible] referenceMetricGramFrame referenceConnectionFamily
  MetricOperator.metricOperatorField referenceMetric dilatedMetric
  referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient frameConnectionCoefficient covariantFrameDerivative

variable {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]

lemma integrable_referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_fischer_left (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (rho : R3 → ℝ) (hr : Continuous rho)
    (V : R3 → R3) (hV : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (d : κ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (z : R3 → κ → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hz : ContDiff ℝ ∞ z)
    (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c) : Integrable (fun x => rho x * fischerInner
      (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x (V x)) (finitePolynomialField d z x)) :=
  (hr.mul (contDiff_referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_fischer_left g hg L lam V hV b d c z hc hz).continuous).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
    (hasCompactSupport_referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_fischer_left g L lam V b d c z hcompact).mul_left

lemma integrable_referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_fischer_right (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (rho : R3 → ℝ) (hr : Continuous rho)
    (V : R3 → R3) (hV : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (d : κ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (z : R3 → κ → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hz : ContDiff ℝ ∞ z)
    (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c) : Integrable (fun x => rho x * fischerInner
      (finitePolynomialField b c x) (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam d z x (V x))) := by
  have h : Integrable (fun x => rho x * fischerInner
      (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam d z x (V x)) (finitePolynomialField b c x)) :=
    (hr.mul (contDiff_referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_fischer_left g hg L lam V hV d b z c hz hc).continuous).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
      (hasCompactSupport_referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_fischer_left_second g L lam V d b z c hcompact).mul_left
  convert h using 1
  funext x
  rw [fischerInner_symm]

lemma referenceCovector_contraction_eq_scalar_add_divergence (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (d : κ → Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (z : R3 → κ → ℝ) (x : R3) :
    referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * (∑ i : Fin 3, fischerInner
      (finitePolynomialField b c x)
      (referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative g L lam d z x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) i)) =
    (∑ i : Fin 3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * fischerInner
      (finitePolynomialField b c x)
      (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam (fun a => d a i) z x
        (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i))) +
    (∑ i : Fin 3, weightedCoordinateDivergence (fun y => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,y))
      (fun y => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y) i) x *
      fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField (fun a => d a i) z x)) := by
  have h := frame_connection_trace_cancellation
    (fun v a t => referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient g L lam x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) v) a t)
    (fun v a t => referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient_skew g hg L lam x _ a t)
    (fun i => fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField (fun a => d a i) z x))
  simp only [referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative,fischerInner_sub_right,fischerInner_sum_right,
    fischerInner_C_mul_right,Finset.sum_sub_distrib,Finset.mul_sum,
    reference_weightedCoordinateDivergence_gramFrame g hg L lam] at *
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_three] at *
  linear_combination -referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * h

theorem compact_reference_contracted_covector_fischer_adjoint (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (d : κ → Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (z : R3 → κ → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hz : ContDiff ℝ ∞ z)
    (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c) :
    (∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * (∑ i : Fin 3, fischerInner
      (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i))
      (finitePolynomialField (fun a => d a i) z x))) =
    -(∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * (∑ i : Fin 3, fischerInner
      (finitePolynomialField b c x)
      (referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative g L lam d z x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) i))) := by
  let rho := fun x => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)
  have hr : ContDiff ℝ ∞ rho :=
    (contDiff_referenceDensityFamily g hg L).comp (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id)
  let e := fun x => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x)
  have he (i : Fin 3) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => e x i) :=
    contDiff_referenceMetricGramFrame_slice g hg L lam i
  let A := fun i x => rho x * fischerInner
    (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x (e x i))
    (finitePolynomialField (fun a => d a i) z x)
  let B := fun i x => rho x * fischerInner
    (finitePolynomialField b c x)
    (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam (fun a => d a i) z x (e x i))
  let D := fun i x => weightedCoordinateDivergence rho (fun y => e y i) x *
    fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField (fun a => d a i) z x)
  have hA (i : Fin 3) : Integrable (A i) :=
    integrable_referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_fischer_left g hg L lam rho hr.continuous _ (he i) b _ c z hc hz hcompact
  have hB (i : Fin 3) : Integrable (B i) :=
    integrable_referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_fischer_right g hg L lam rho hr.continuous _ (he i) b _ c z hc hz hcompact
  have hD (i : Fin 3) : Integrable (D i) :=
    ((contDiff_weightedCoordinateDivergence rho _ hr (he i)).continuous.mul
      (contDiff_fischerPair b _ c z hc hz).continuous).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
        (hasCompactSupport_fischerPair b _ c z hcompact).mul_left
  have hi (i : Fin 3) : (∫ x, A i x) = -(∫ x, B i x) - (∫ x, D i x) := by
    have h := compact_reference_frame_fischer_covariant_contraction g hg L lam i b (fun a => d a i) c z hc hz hcompact
    have heq : (fun x => rho x * (fischerInner
      (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x (e x i)) (finitePolynomialField (fun a => d a i) z x) +
      fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam (fun a => d a i) z x (e x i)))) =
      fun x => A i x+B i x := by funext x; simp only [A,B,mul_add]
    change (∫ x, rho x * _) = -(∫ x, D i x) at h
    rw [heq,integral_add (hA i) (hB i)] at h
    linarith
  have hs : (∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 3, A i x) =
      -(∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 3, B i x) - (∫ x, ∑ i : Fin 3, D i x) := by
    rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => hA i),integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => hB i),
      integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => hD i),← Finset.sum_neg_distrib,← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hi i)
  have hBsum : Integrable (fun x => ∑ i : Fin 3, B i x) := integrable_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => hB i)
  have hDsum : Integrable (fun x => ∑ i : Fin 3, D i x) := integrable_finset_sum _ (fun i _ => hD i)
  have hright : (fun x => rho x * ∑ i : Fin 3, fischerInner
      (finitePolynomialField b c x)
      (referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative g L lam d z x (e x i) i)) =
      fun x => (∑ i : Fin 3, B i x) + ∑ i : Fin 3, D i x :=
    funext (fun x => referenceCovector_contraction_eq_scalar_add_divergence g hg L lam b d c z x)
  have hleft : (fun x => rho x * ∑ i : Fin 3, fischerInner
      (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x (e x i))
      (finitePolynomialField (fun a => d a i) z x)) = fun x => ∑ i : Fin 3, A i x := by
    funext x; simp only [A,Finset.mul_sum]
  change (∫ x, rho x * _) = -(∫ x, rho x * _)
  rw [hleft,hright,integral_add hBsum hDsum]
  linarith

theorem compact_reference_contracted_weighted_covector_fischer_adjoint (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (d : κ → Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (z : R3 → κ → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (k s : ℝ)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hz : ContDiff ℝ ∞ z) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c) :
    (∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * (∑ i : Fin 3, fischerInner
      (referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c f k s x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i))
      (finitePolynomialField (fun a => d a i) z x))) =
    (∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * (∑ i : Fin 3, fischerInner
      (finitePolynomialField b c x)
      (referenceWeightedCovectorPolynomialDerivative g L lam d z f k (-s) x
        (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) i))) := by
  let rho := fun x => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)
  have hr : ContDiff ℝ ∞ rho :=
    (contDiff_referenceDensityFamily g hg L).comp (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id)
  let e := fun x => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x)
  have he (i : Fin 3) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => e x i) :=
    contDiff_referenceMetricGramFrame_slice g hg L lam i
  let A := fun x => rho x * ∑ i : Fin 3, fischerInner
    (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x (e x i))
    (finitePolynomialField (fun a => d a i) z x)
  let B := fun x => rho x * ∑ i : Fin 3, fischerInner
    (finitePolynomialField b c x)
    (referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative g L lam d z x (e x i) i)
  let W := fun x => rho x * ∑ i : Fin 3,
    (k*fderiv ℝ f x (e x i)) * fischerInner
      (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField (fun a => d a i) z x)
  have hA : Integrable A := by
    simp only [A,Finset.mul_sum]
    exact integrable_finset_sum _ (fun i _ =>
      integrable_referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_fischer_left g hg L lam rho hr.continuous
        _ (he i) b _ c z hc hz hcompact)
  have hB : Integrable B := by
    simp only [B,Finset.mul_sum]
    exact integrable_finset_sum _ (fun i _ =>
      integrable_referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative_fischer_right g hg L lam rho hr.continuous
        _ (he i) b d c z hc hz hcompact i)
  have hW : Integrable W := by
    simp only [W,Finset.mul_sum]
    apply integrable_finset_sum; intro i hi
    have hdf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => fderiv ℝ f x (e x i)) :=
      (hf.fderiv_right (m := ∞) (by simp)).clm_apply (he i)
    have hweight : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => k * fderiv ℝ f x (e x i)) :=
      (contDiff_const : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun _ : R3 => k)).mul hdf
    exact (hr.continuous.mul (hweight.continuous.mul
      (contDiff_fischerPair b (fun a => d a i) c z hc hz).continuous)).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
        (hasCompactSupport_fischerPair b (fun a => d a i) c z hcompact).mul_left.mul_left
  have hab : (∫ x : R3, A x) = -(∫ x : R3, B x) :=
    compact_reference_contracted_covector_fischer_adjoint g hg L lam b d c z hc hz hcompact
  have hl : (fun x => rho x * ∑ i : Fin 3, fischerInner
      (referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c f k s x (e x i))
      (finitePolynomialField (fun a => d a i) z x)) = fun x => s*A x+W x := by
    funext x
    simp only [referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative,fischerInner_add_left,
      fischerInner_C_mul_left,A,W,Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  have hright : (fun x => rho x * ∑ i : Fin 3, fischerInner
      (finitePolynomialField b c x)
      (referenceWeightedCovectorPolynomialDerivative g L lam d z f k (-s) x (e x i) i)) =
      fun x => (-s)*B x+W x := by
    funext x
    simp only [referenceWeightedCovectorPolynomialDerivative,fischerInner_add_right,
      fischerInner_C_mul_right,B,W,Fin.sum_univ_three]
    ring
  change (∫ x : R3, rho x * _) = (∫ x : R3, rho x * _)
  rw [hl,hright,integral_add (hA.const_mul _) hW,integral_add (hB.const_mul _) hW,
    integral_const_mul,integral_const_mul,hab]
  ring

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.ScalarContractedAdjunction

``````

## Calderon.SphereHilbertDecomposition

``````lean
import Calderon.HarmonicSampling
import Calderon.SpherePositiveDensity
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.l2Space

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory MvPolynomial
open scoped InnerProductSpace Topology ENNReal
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SphereHilbertDecomposition
open SphereHarmonic HarmonicSampling AngularPolynomial

lemma finiteDimensional_harmonicSphereSubspace (k : ℕ) :
    FiniteDimensional ℝ (harmonicSphereSubspace k) := by
  letI := finiteDimensional_harmonicHomogeneous k
  change FiniteDimensional ℝ ((harmonicHomogeneous k).map polynomialSphereL2)
  infer_instance

lemma completeSpace_harmonicSphereSubspace (k : ℕ) :
    CompleteSpace (harmonicSphereSubspace k) := by
  letI := finiteDimensional_harmonicSphereSubspace k
  infer_instance

lemma orthogonalFamily_harmonicSphereSubspaces (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) :
    OrthogonalFamily ℝ (fun k : ℕ => harmonicSphereSubspace k)
      (fun k => (harmonicSphereSubspace k).subtypeₗᵢ) := by
  intro i j hij u v
  exact hO i j hij u u.property v v.property

theorem isHilbertSum_harmonicSphereSubspaces (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) :
    IsHilbertSum ℝ (fun k : ℕ => harmonicSphereSubspace k)
      (fun k => (harmonicSphereSubspace k).subtypeₗᵢ) := by
  letI : ∀ k : ℕ, CompleteSpace (harmonicSphereSubspace k) :=
    completeSpace_harmonicSphereSubspace
  apply IsHilbertSum.mkInternal
  · exact orthogonalFamily_harmonicSphereSubspaces hO
  · change ⊤ ≤ (⨆ k : ℕ, harmonicSphereSubspace k).topologicalClosure
    rw [hD]

def sphereHarmonicDecomposition (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) :
    SphereL2 ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] lp (fun k : ℕ => harmonicSphereSubspace k) 2 :=
  (isHilbertSum_harmonicSphereSubspaces hO hD).linearIsometryEquiv

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
theorem hasSum_sphereHarmonicDecomposition (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (u : SphereL2) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ =>
      ((sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD u) k : SphereL2)) u := by
  simpa only [HasSum, sphereHarmonicDecomposition,
    LinearIsometryEquiv.symm_apply_apply, Finset.sum, Multiset.sum_eq_foldr,
    Submodule.coe_subtypeₗᵢ, Submodule.coe_subtype] using
    (isHilbertSum_harmonicSphereSubspaces hO hD).hasSum_linearIsometryEquiv_symm
      (sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD u)

theorem tsum_sphereHarmonicDecomposition (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (u : SphereL2) :
    (∑' k : ℕ, ((sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD u) k : SphereL2)) = u :=
  (hasSum_sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD u).tsum_eq

theorem norm_sq_sphereHarmonicDecomposition (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (u : SphereL2) :
    ‖u‖ ^ 2 = ∑' k : ℕ, ‖(sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD u) k‖ ^ 2 := by
  have h := lp.norm_rpow_eq_tsum (show 0 < (2 : ℝ≥0∞).toReal by norm_num)
    (sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD u)
  simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_ofNat, Real.rpow_two,
    LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map] using h

theorem inner_sphereHarmonicDecomposition (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (u v : SphereL2) :
    ⟪u, v⟫_ℝ = ∑' k : ℕ,
      ⟪(sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD u) k,
        (sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD v) k⟫_ℝ := by
  rw [← (sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD).inner_map_map u v]
  exact lp.inner_eq_tsum _ _

theorem sphereHarmonicDecomposition_subtype (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (k : ℕ) (v : harmonicSphereSubspace k) :
    sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD (v : SphereL2) = lp.single 2 k v := by
  apply (sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD).symm.injective
  rw [LinearIsometryEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  exact (IsHilbertSum.linearIsometryEquiv_symm_apply_single
    (isHilbertSum_harmonicSphereSubspaces hO hD) v).symm

theorem sphereHarmonicDecomposition_zero_mem_constants (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (u : SphereL2) :
    ((sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD u) 0 : SphereL2) ∈ sphereConstantSpan := by
  rw [← harmonicSphereSubspace_zero_eq]
  exact ((sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD u) 0).property

theorem sphereHarmonicDecomposition_polynomial_norm_sq (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (k : ℕ)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hp : p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) :
    ‖(sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD (polynomialSphereL2 p)) k‖ ^ 2 =
      normalizedFischerSquare k p := by
  have h := sphereHarmonicDecomposition_subtype hO hD k
    ⟨polynomialSphereL2 p, polynomialSphereL2_mem k p hp⟩
  rw [h]
  simpa using polynomialSphereL2_norm_sq hF k p hp

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SphereHilbertDecomposition
``````

``````lean
import Calderon.WeightedFischerSquare
import Calderon.AllDegreeCovectorTransport

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 10
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory MvPolynomial
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Gradient Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.WeightedFiberSquare
open RadiusProfile ConformalDepth AngularPolynomial SphereHarmonic
  MovingFrameConnection FischerConnectionTransport FischerDensityIntegration
  WeightedFischerSquare AllDegreeCovectorTransport MetricFiberAdjunction
  SmoothMetricFrame ReferenceDensityBounds

attribute [local irreducible] referenceMetricGramFrame referenceConnectionFamily
  MetricOperator.metricOperatorField referenceMetric dilatedMetric

variable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]

lemma referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative_harmonicHomogeneous_all
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hb : ∀ j, b j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous m)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (k s : ℝ) (x V : R3) :
    referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c f k s x V ∈ harmonicHomogeneous m := by
  apply (harmonicHomogeneous m).add_mem
  · simpa only [smul_eq_C_mul] using (harmonicHomogeneous m).smul_mem s
      (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_harmonicHomogeneous_all g hg L lam m b hb c x V)
  · simpa only [smul_eq_C_mul] using (harmonicHomogeneous m).smul_mem
      (k*fderiv ℝ f x V) (finitePolynomialField_harmonicHomogeneous m b hb c x)

def referenceWeightedFiberFrameEnergy (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (k s : ℝ) (x : R3) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i : Fin 3, referenceFiberPolynomialPair g hg L lam x
    (referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c f k s x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i))
    (referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c f k s x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i))

lemma referenceWeightedFiberFrameEnergy_eq (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hb : ∀ j, b j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous m)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (k s : ℝ) (x : R3) :
    referenceWeightedFiberFrameEnergy g hg L lam b c f k s x =
      referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g L lam b c f k s x / sphereNormalization 3 m := by
  have hp (i : Fin 3) := referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative_harmonicHomogeneous_all
    g hg L lam m b hb c f k s x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i)
  have hpair (i : Fin 3) := referenceFiberPolynomialPair_eq hF g hg L lam x m _ _ (hp i) (hp i)
  simp only [referenceWeightedFiberFrameEnergy,referenceWeightedFrameEnergy,hpair,
    normalizedFischerInner,Fintype.card_fin,Finset.sum_div]

lemma integrable_referenceWeightedFiberFrameEnergy (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (rho : R3 → ℝ) (hr : Continuous rho)
    (m : ℕ) (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hb : ∀ j, b j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous m)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (k s : ℝ)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c) :
    Integrable (fun x => rho x*referenceWeightedFiberFrameEnergy g hg L lam b c f k s x) := by
  have h := integrable_referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g hg L lam rho hr b c f k s hc hf hcompact
  have he : (fun x => rho x*referenceWeightedFiberFrameEnergy g hg L lam b c f k s x) =
      fun x => (sphereNormalization 3 m)⁻¹ * (rho x*referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g L lam b c f k s x) := by
    funext x
    rw [referenceWeightedFiberFrameEnergy_eq hF g hg L lam m b hb c f k s]
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
    ring
  rw [he]
  exact h.const_mul _

lemma integral_referenceWeightedFiberFrameEnergy_eq (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (rho : R3 → ℝ)
    (m : ℕ) (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hb : ∀ j, b j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous m)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (k s : ℝ) :
    (∫ x : R3, rho x*referenceWeightedFiberFrameEnergy g hg L lam b c f k s x) =
      (sphereNormalization 3 m)⁻¹ *
        (∫ x : R3, rho x*referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g L lam b c f k s x) := by
  rw [← integral_const_mul]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [] with x
  rw [referenceWeightedFiberFrameEnergy_eq hF g hg L lam m b hb c f k s]
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
  ring

theorem compact_referenceWeightedFiberFrameEnergy_hessian_square_difference
    (hF : SphereFischerInner) (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (k : ℕ) (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hb : ∀ j, b j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c) :
    (∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      referenceWeightedFiberFrameEnergy g hg L lam b c f (k : ℝ) (-1) x) =
    (∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      referenceWeightedFiberFrameEnergy g hg L lam b c f (k : ℝ) 1 x) +
    (∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      (2*(k : ℝ)*∑ i : Fin 3, coordinateHessian f
        (fun X Y => referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,x) X Y) x
        (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i)) *
      referenceFiberPolynomialPair g hg L lam x (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField b c x)) := by
  have h := compact_referenceWeightedFrameEnergy_hessian_square_difference g hg L lam b c f
    (k : ℝ) hc hf hcompact
  simp only [integral_referenceWeightedFiberFrameEnergy_eq hF g hg L lam _ k b hb c f]
  have hJ : (∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      (2*(k : ℝ)*∑ i : Fin 3, coordinateHessian f
        (fun X Y => referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,x) X Y) x
        (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i)) *
      referenceFiberPolynomialPair g hg L lam x (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField b c x)) =
    (sphereNormalization 3 k)⁻¹ *
    (∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      (2*(k : ℝ)*∑ i : Fin 3, coordinateHessian f
        (fun X Y => referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,x) X Y) x
        (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i)) *
      fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField b c x)) := by
    rw [← integral_const_mul]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [] with x
    rw [referenceFiberPolynomialPair_finite hF g hg L lam k b b hb hb c c]
    simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
    ring
  rw [hJ,h,mul_add]

theorem compact_referenceLogRadius_weightedFiberFrameEnergy_square_difference
    (hF : SphereFischerInner) (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam δ R : ℝ)
    (profileP k : ℕ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hR : 0 < R)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hb : ∀ j, b j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c) :
    (∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * referenceWeightedFiberFrameEnergy g hg L lam b c
      (referenceLogRadius δ R profileP L) (k : ℝ) (-1) x) =
    (∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * referenceWeightedFiberFrameEnergy g hg L lam b c
      (referenceLogRadius δ R profileP L) (k : ℝ) 1 x) +
    (∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      (2*(k : ℝ)*∑ i : Fin 3, coordinateHessian (referenceLogRadius δ R profileP L)
        (fun X Y => referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,x) X Y) x
        (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i)) *
      referenceFiberPolynomialPair g hg L lam x (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField b c x)) :=
  compact_referenceWeightedFiberFrameEnergy_hessian_square_difference hF g hg L lam k b hb c
    (referenceLogRadius δ R profileP L) hc (contDiff_log_referenceRadius δ R profileP L hδ hR) hcompact

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.WeightedFiberSquare
``````

``````lean
import Calderon.FischerCovectorAdjunction
import Calderon.MetricFrameTrace

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 10
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory MvPolynomial
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Gradient Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.WeightedFischerSquare
open RadiusProfile ConformalDepth AngularPolynomial SphereHarmonic MetricOperator
  MovingFrameConnection FischerConnectionTransport FischerDensityIntegration
  FischerCovectorAdjunction MetricFrameTrace SmoothMetricFrame ReferenceDensityBounds

attribute [local irreducible] referenceMetricGramFrame referenceConnectionFamily
  metricOperatorField referenceMetric dilatedMetric
  referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient frameConnectionCoefficient covariantFrameDerivative

variable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]

def covariantDerivativePolynomialFamily (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    ι ⊕ (Fin 3 × Fin 3 × ι) → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ
  | .inl j => b j
  | .inr a => X a.2.1 * pderiv a.1 (b a.2.2)

def covariantDerivativeCoefficientFamily (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (V : R3 → R3) (x : R3) : ι ⊕ (Fin 3 × Fin 3 × ι) → ℝ
  | .inl j => (fderiv ℝ c x (V x)) j
  | .inr a => -referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient g L lam x (V x) a.1 a.2.1 * c x a.2.2

lemma referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_eq_finite_augmented (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (V : R3 → R3) (x : R3) :
    referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x (V x) =
      finitePolynomialField (covariantDerivativePolynomialFamily b)
        (covariantDerivativeCoefficientFamily g L lam c V) x := by
  simp only [referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative, finitePolynomialFieldDerivative,
    referenceFrameAngularPolynomial, CurvatureSkew.polynomialMatrixVectorField,
    finitePolynomialField, Fintype.sum_sum_type, Fintype.sum_prod_type,
    covariantDerivativePolynomialFamily, covariantDerivativeCoefficientFamily,
    smul_eq_C_mul, map_sum, pderiv_C_mul, Finset.mul_sum, map_neg, map_mul,
    neg_mul, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  apply congrArg (fun z : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ =>
    (∑ j : ι, C ((fderiv ℝ c x (V x)) j) * b j) + -z)
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro a ha
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro t ht
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro j hj
  rw [mul_assoc, mul_left_comm (X t) (C (c x j)), mul_assoc]

lemma contDiff_covariantDerivativeCoefficientFamily (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (V : R3 → R3)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hV : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (covariantDerivativeCoefficientFamily g L lam c V) := by
  apply contDiff_pi.mpr
  intro j
  rcases j with j | ⟨a,t,j⟩
  · exact contDiff_pi.mp (contDiff_variableCoefficientDerivative c V hc hV) j
  · exact (contDiff_referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient_variable g hg L lam V hV a t).neg.mul
      (contDiff_pi.mp hc j)

lemma contDiff_referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_fischer_square
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (V : R3 → R3)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hV : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => fischerInner
      (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x (V x))
      (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x (V x))) := by
  simp only [referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_eq_finite_augmented]
  exact contDiff_fischerPair _ _ _ _
    (contDiff_covariantDerivativeCoefficientFamily g hg L lam c V hc hV)
    (contDiff_covariantDerivativeCoefficientFamily g hg L lam c V hc hV)

def referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (k s : ℝ) (x V : R3) : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  C s * referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x V +
    C (k * fderiv ℝ f x V) * finitePolynomialField b c x

lemma fischerInner_weighted_square (q p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (s w : ℝ) :
    fischerInner (C s*q+C w*p) (C s*q+C w*p) =
      s^2*fischerInner q q + 2*s*w*fischerInner q p + w^2*fischerInner p p := by
  simp only [fischerInner_add_left,fischerInner_add_right,fischerInner_C_mul_left,
    fischerInner_C_mul_right,fischerInner_symm p q]
  ring

lemma contDiff_referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative_fischer_square
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (k s : ℝ) (V : R3 → R3) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)

    (contDiff_referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_fischer_square g hg L lam b c V hc hV)).add
    ((contDiff_const.mul hw).mul
      (contDiff_referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_fischer_left g hg L lam V hV b b c c hc hc))).add
    ((hw.pow 2).mul (contDiff_fischerPair b b c c hc hc))

lemma hasCompactSupport_referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative_fischer_square
    (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ) (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (k s : ℝ) (V : R3 → R3)
    (hc : HasCompactSupport c) :
    HasCompactSupport (fun x => fischerInner
      (referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c f k s x (V x))
      (referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c f k s x (V x))) := by
  apply hc.mono'
  intro x hx
  by_contra hnot
  have hc0 := image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hnot
  have hD0 := fderiv_of_notMem_tsupport (𝕜 := ℝ) hnot
  simp only [Function.mem_support] at hx
  apply hx
  simp only [referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative,
    referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_eq_zero_of_coeff_fderiv_eq_zero g L lam b c x (V x) hc0 hD0,
    finitePolynomialField_eq_zero_of_coeff_eq_zero b c x hc0, mul_zero, add_zero, fischerInner_zero_left]

def referenceWeightedFrameEnergy (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (k s : ℝ) (x : R3) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i : Fin 3, fischerInner
    (referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c f k s x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i))
    (referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c f k s x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i))

lemma integrable_referenceWeightedFrameEnergy (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (rho : R3 → ℝ) (hr : Continuous rho)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (k s : ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c) :
    Integrable (fun x => rho x * referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g L lam b c f k s x) := by
  have hi (i : Fin 3) : Integrable (fun x => rho x * fischerInner
      (referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c f k s x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i))
      (referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c f k s x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i))) :=
    (hr.mul (contDiff_referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative_fischer_square g hg L lam b c f k s _ hc hf
      (contDiff_referenceMetricGramFrame_slice g hg L lam i)).continuous).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
      (hasCompactSupport_referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative_fischer_square g L lam b c f k s _ hcompact).mul_left
  simpa only [referenceWeightedFrameEnergy,Finset.mul_sum] using
    integrable_finset_sum Finset.univ (fun i _ => hi i)

lemma fderiv_fischer_square_metricFrameGradient (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ)
    (f : R3 → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (x : R3) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun y => fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c y) (finitePolynomialField b c y)) x
      (metricFrameGradient (fun y => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y)) f x) =
    ∑ i : Fin 3, 2*fderiv ℝ f x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) *
      fischerInner (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x
        (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i)) (finitePolynomialField b c x) := by
  simp only [metricFrameGradient,map_sum,map_smul,smul_eq_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  rw [referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_fischer_compatible g hg L lam b b c c hc hc]
  rw [fischerInner_symm (finitePolynomialField b c x)]
  ring

lemma referenceWeightedFrameEnergy_sub (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ)
    (f : R3 → ℝ) (k : ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (x : R3) :
    referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g L lam b c f k (-1) x -
      referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g L lam b c f k 1 x =
    -2*k*fderiv ℝ (fun y => fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c y) (finitePolynomialField b c y)) x
      (metricFrameGradient (fun y => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y)) f x) := by
  rw [fderiv_fischer_square_metricFrameGradient g hg L lam b c f hc]
  simp only [referenceWeightedFrameEnergy,referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative,fischerInner_weighted_square,
    ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib,Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  ring

theorem compact_referenceWeightedFrameEnergy_square_difference
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (rho : R3 → ℝ) (hr : ContDiff ℝ ∞ rho)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (k : ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c) :
    (∫ x : R3, rho x * referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g L lam b c f k (-1) x) =
      (∫ x : R3, rho x * referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g L lam b c f k 1 x) +
        2*k*(∫ x : R3, weightedCoordinateDivergence rho
          (metricFrameGradient (fun y => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y)) f) x *
            fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField b c x)) := by
  have hi := integrable_referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g hg L lam rho hr.continuous b c f k (-1) hc hf hcompact
  have hj := integrable_referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g hg L lam rho hr.continuous b c f k 1 hc hf hcompact
  have h := compact_weighted_scalar_variable_adjoint rho
    (fun x => fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField b c x))
    (metricFrameGradient (fun y => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y)) f) hr
    (contDiff_fischerPair b b c c hc hc)
    (contDiff_metricFrameGradient _ f (fun i => contDiff_referenceMetricGramFrame_slice g hg L lam i) hf)
    (hasCompactSupport_fischerPair b b c c hcompact)
  have he : (fun x => rho x * referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g L lam b c f k (-1) x -
      rho x * referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g L lam b c f k 1 x) =
    fun x => (-2*k)*(rho x*fderiv ℝ
      (fun y => fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c y) (finitePolynomialField b c y)) x
      (metricFrameGradient (fun y => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y)) f x)) := by
    funext x
    rw [← mul_sub,referenceWeightedFrameEnergy_sub g hg L lam b c f k hc]
    ring
  have hd : (∫ x : R3, rho x * referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g L lam b c f k (-1) x) -
      (∫ x : R3, rho x * referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g L lam b c f k 1 x) =
      2*k*(∫ x : R3, weightedCoordinateDivergence rho
        (metricFrameGradient (fun y => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y)) f) x *
          fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField b c x)) := by
    rw [← integral_sub hi hj, he, integral_const_mul, h]
    ring
  linarith

theorem compact_referenceWeightedFrameEnergy_hessian_square_difference
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (k : ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c) :
    (∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g L lam b c f k (-1) x) =
      (∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g L lam b c f k 1 x) +
      (∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
        (2*k*∑ i : Fin 3, coordinateHessian f (fun X Y => referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,x) X Y) x
          (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i)) *
          fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField b c x)) := by
  have h := compact_referenceWeightedFrameEnergy_square_difference g hg L lam
    (fun x => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x))
    ((contDiff_referenceDensityFamily g hg L).comp (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id)) b c f k hc hf hcompact
  simp only [reference_weightedCoordinateDivergence_metricFrameGradient_eq_hessian_trace g hg L lam f hf] at h
  rw [h]
  congr 1
  rw [← integral_const_mul]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  filter_upwards [] with x
  ring

theorem compact_referenceLogRadius_weightedFrameEnergy_square_difference
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam δ R : ℝ) (profileP k : ℕ)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hR : 0 < R)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c) :
    (∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g L lam b c (referenceLogRadius δ R profileP L) (k : ℝ) (-1) x) =
    (∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g L lam b c (referenceLogRadius δ R profileP L) (k : ℝ) 1 x) +
    (∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      (2*(k : ℝ)*∑ i : Fin 3, coordinateHessian (referenceLogRadius δ R profileP L)
        (fun X Y => referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,x) X Y) x
        (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i)) *
      fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField b c x)) :=
  compact_referenceWeightedFrameEnergy_hessian_square_difference g hg L lam b c
    (referenceLogRadius δ R profileP L) (k : ℝ) hc
    (contDiff_log_referenceRadius δ R profileP L hδ hR) hcompact

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.WeightedFischerSquare

``````
