## Calderon.WeightedIndexedCurvature

SHA256 `26274e3d2a371876b420ce3c4f1b59cc2f845f25d86d56ab6fd973f2e67af941`.

``````lean
import Calderon.FiniteCovariantCurvature
import Calderon.ContractedFischerAdjunction
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FDeriv.Symmetric

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 10
noncomputable section
open MvPolynomial
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.WeightedIndexedCurvature
open RadiusProfile ConformalDepth MetricOperator AngularPolynomial CurvatureSkew
  MovingFrameConnection FischerConnectionTransport WeightedFischerSquare
  SmoothMetricFrame FrameCurvaturePolynomial FiniteCovariantCurvature
  PolynomialSlotCompatibility FullCovectorCurvature IndexedCovariantCurvature
  ContractedFischerAdjunction

attribute [local irreducible] referenceMetricGramFrame referenceConnectionFamily
  metricOperatorField referenceMetric dilatedMetric
  referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient frameConnectionCoefficient covariantFrameDerivative

attribute [local irreducible] finitePolynomialField finitePolynomialFieldDerivative
  referenceFrameAngularPolynomial referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative

variable {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]

lemma finitePolynomialField_coeff_smul (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (a : R3 → ℝ) (x : R3) :
    finitePolynomialField b (fun y => a y • c y) x = a x • finitePolynomialField b c x := by
  simp only [finitePolynomialField,Pi.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul,smul_smul,Finset.smul_sum]

lemma referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_coeff_smul (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (a : R3 → ℝ)
    (x V : R3) (hc : DifferentiableAt ℝ c x) (ha : DifferentiableAt ℝ a x) :
    referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b (fun y => a y • c y) x V =
      C (a x) * referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x V +
      C (fderiv ℝ a x V) * finitePolynomialField b c x := by
  have hd : finitePolynomialFieldDerivative b (fun y => a y • c y) x V =
      a x • finitePolynomialFieldDerivative b c x V +
      (fderiv ℝ a x V) • finitePolynomialField b c x := by
    simp only [finitePolynomialFieldDerivative,finitePolynomialField,fderiv_fun_smul ha hc,
      ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
      ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply,Pi.add_apply,Pi.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul,
      add_smul,smul_smul,Finset.sum_add_distrib,Finset.smul_sum]
  rw [referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative,hd,finitePolynomialField_coeff_smul,
    referenceFrameAngularPolynomial_smul,← smul_eq_C_mul,← smul_eq_C_mul,
    referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative,smul_add]
  abel

def joinedPolynomialFamily (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (d : κ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) : ι ⊕ κ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ := Sum.elim b d

def joinedCoefficientFamily (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (z : R3 → κ → ℝ)
    (x : R3) : ι ⊕ κ → ℝ := Sum.elim (c x) (z x)

lemma contDiff_joinedCoefficientFamily (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (z : R3 → κ → ℝ)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hz : ContDiff ℝ ∞ z) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (joinedCoefficientFamily c z) := by
  apply contDiff_pi.mpr
  intro a
  cases a with
  | inl i => exact contDiff_pi.mp hc i
  | inr j => exact contDiff_pi.mp hz j

lemma finitePolynomialField_joined (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (d : κ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (z : R3 → κ → ℝ) (x : R3) :
    finitePolynomialField (joinedPolynomialFamily b d) (joinedCoefficientFamily c z) x =
      finitePolynomialField b c x+finitePolynomialField d z x := by
  simp only [finitePolynomialField,Fintype.sum_sum_type,joinedPolynomialFamily,
    joinedCoefficientFamily,Sum.elim_inl,Sum.elim_inr]

lemma referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_joined (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (d : κ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (z : R3 → κ → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hz : ContDiff ℝ ∞ z)
    (x V : R3) :
    referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam (joinedPolynomialFamily b d)
      (joinedCoefficientFamily c z) x V =
    referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x V+
      referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam d z x V := by
  have hjoin := (contDiff_joinedCoefficientFamily c z hc hz).differentiable (by simp) x
  have hleft (a : ι) : (fderiv ℝ (joinedCoefficientFamily c z) x V) (.inl a) =
      (fderiv ℝ c x V) a := by
    have h := congrArg (fun T : R3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => T V) (fderiv_apply hjoin (.inl a))
    change fderiv ℝ (fun y => c y a) x V = _ at h
    rw [fderiv_apply (hc.differentiable (by simp) x) a] at h
    simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply] using h.symm
  have hright (a : κ) : (fderiv ℝ (joinedCoefficientFamily c z) x V) (.inr a) =
      (fderiv ℝ z x V) a := by
    have h := congrArg (fun T : R3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => T V) (fderiv_apply hjoin (.inr a))
    change fderiv ℝ (fun y => z y a) x V = _ at h
    rw [fderiv_apply (hz.differentiable (by simp) x) a] at h
    simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply] using h.symm
  have hd : finitePolynomialFieldDerivative (joinedPolynomialFamily b d)
      (joinedCoefficientFamily c z) x V =
      finitePolynomialFieldDerivative b c x V+finitePolynomialFieldDerivative d z x V := by
    simp only [finitePolynomialFieldDerivative,Fintype.sum_sum_type,
      joinedPolynomialFamily,Sum.elim_inl,Sum.elim_inr,hleft,hright]
  simp only [referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative]
  change finitePolynomialFieldDerivative (joinedPolynomialFamily b d)
      (joinedCoefficientFamily c z) x V + referenceFrameAngularPolynomial g L lam x V
        (finitePolynomialField (joinedPolynomialFamily b d) (joinedCoefficientFamily c z) x) =
    (finitePolynomialFieldDerivative b c x V+referenceFrameAngularPolynomial g L lam x V (finitePolynomialField b c x)) +
    (finitePolynomialFieldDerivative d z x V+referenceFrameAngularPolynomial g L lam x V (finitePolynomialField d z x))
  rw [hd,finitePolynomialField_joined,referenceFrameAngularPolynomial_add]
  abel

def weightedDerivativePolynomialFamily (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    (ι ⊕ (Fin 3 × Fin 3 × ι)) ⊕ ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  joinedPolynomialFamily (covariantDerivativePolynomialFamily b) b

def weightedDerivativeCoefficientFamily (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (k t : ℝ) (V : R3 → R3) :
    R3 → ((ι ⊕ (Fin 3 × Fin 3 × ι)) ⊕ ι) → ℝ :=
  joinedCoefficientFamily (fun x => t • covariantDerivativeCoefficientFamily g L lam c V x)
    (fun x => (k*fderiv ℝ f x (V x)) • c x)

lemma contDiff_weightedDerivativeCoefficientFamily (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (k t : ℝ) (V : R3 → R3)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hV : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (weightedDerivativeCoefficientFamily g L lam c f k t V) := by
  apply contDiff_joinedCoefficientFamily
  · exact (contDiff_const : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun _ : R3 => t)).smul
      (contDiff_covariantDerivativeCoefficientFamily g hg L lam c V hc hV)
  · exact ((contDiff_const : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun _ : R3 => k)).mul
      ((hf.fderiv_right (m := ∞) (by simp)).clm_apply hV)).smul hc

lemma referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative_eq_finite (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (k t : ℝ) (V : R3 → R3) (x : R3) :
    referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c f k t x (V x) =
      finitePolynomialField (weightedDerivativePolynomialFamily b)
        (weightedDerivativeCoefficientFamily g L lam c f k t V) x := by
  rw [weightedDerivativePolynomialFamily,weightedDerivativeCoefficientFamily,
    finitePolynomialField_joined,finitePolynomialField_coeff_smul,finitePolynomialField_coeff_smul,
    ← referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_eq_finite_augmented]
  simp only [referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative,smul_eq_C_mul]

def referenceWeightedIndexedPolynomialHessian (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (k s t : ℝ) (x : R3) (i j : Fin 3) : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative g L lam (weightedDerivativePolynomialFamily b)
    (weightedDerivativeCoefficientFamily g L lam c f k t
      (fun y => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y) j)) f k s x
    (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) -
  C s * ∑ a : Fin 3, C (referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient g L lam x
      (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) a j) *
    referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c f k t x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) a)

lemma referenceFrameCovariantDerivative_eq_sum (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (x V : R3) (j : Fin 3) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun y => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y) j) x V+
      referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,x) V (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) j) =
    ∑ a : Fin 3, referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient g L lam x V a j •
      referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) a := by
  simpa only [covariantFrameDerivative,referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient] using covariantFrameDerivative_eq_sum
    (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L))
    (fun y => referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,y))
    (fun y => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y)) x V
    (referenceMetricGramFrame_isMetricOrthonormalFrame g hg L (lam,x)) j

lemma referenceFrameDerivative_df_eq_hessian_add_connection (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (x : R3) (i j : Fin 3) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y) j)) x
      (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) =
    coordinateHessian f (fun V W => referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,x) V W) x
      (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) j) +
    ∑ a : Fin 3, referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient g L lam x
      (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) a j *
      fderiv ℝ f x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) a) := by
  have hdf : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x :=
    ((hf.fderiv_right (m := ∞) (by simp)).differentiable (by simp) x)
  have he : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y) j) x :=
    (contDiff_referenceMetricGramFrame_slice g hg L lam j).differentiable (by simp) x
  have hrec := congrArg (fun v : R3 => fderiv ℝ f x v)
    (referenceFrameCovariantDerivative_eq_sum g hg L lam x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) j)
  rw [fderiv_clm_apply hdf he]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,ContinuousLinearMap.flip_apply,
    coordinateHessian,map_add,map_sum,map_smul,smul_eq_mul] at *
  linarith

lemma reference_coordinateHessian_symm (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (x V W : R3) :
    coordinateHessian f (fun X Y => referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,x) X Y) x V W =
    coordinateHessian f (fun X Y => referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,x) X Y) x W V := by
  simp only [coordinateHessian]
  rw [hf.contDiffAt.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by simp) V W,
    referenceConnectionFamily_symmetric g hg L lam x V W]

lemma referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_weighted_finite (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (k t : ℝ)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (x : R3) (i j : Fin 3) :
    referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam (weightedDerivativePolynomialFamily b)
      (weightedDerivativeCoefficientFamily g L lam c f k t
        (fun y => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y) j)) x
      (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) =
    C t * referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam (covariantDerivativePolynomialFamily b)
      (covariantDerivativeCoefficientFamily g L lam c (fun y => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y) j))
      x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) +
    C (k*fderiv ℝ f x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) j)) *
      referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) +
    C (k * (coordinateHessian f (fun V W => referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,x) V W) x
        (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) j) +
      ∑ a : Fin 3, referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient g L lam x
        (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) a j *
        fderiv ℝ f x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) a))) * finitePolynomialField b c x := by
  have he := contDiff_referenceMetricGramFrame_slice g hg L lam j
  have hq := contDiff_covariantDerivativeCoefficientFamily g hg L lam c
    (fun y => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y) j) hc he
  have hdf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y) j)) :=
    (hf.fderiv_right (m := ∞) (by simp)).clm_apply he
  have hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => k*fderiv ℝ f y (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y) j)) :=
    (contDiff_const : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun _ : R3 => k)).mul hdf
  have htc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => t • covariantDerivativeCoefficientFamily g L lam c
      (fun z => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,z) j) y) := by
    apply contDiff_pi.mpr
    intro a
    exact (contDiff_const : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun _ : R3 => t)).mul (contDiff_pi.mp hq a)
  have hwc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y =>
      (k*fderiv ℝ f y (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y) j)) • c y) := by
    apply contDiff_pi.mpr
    intro a
    exact hw.mul (contDiff_pi.mp hc a)
  rw [weightedDerivativePolynomialFamily,weightedDerivativeCoefficientFamily,
    referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_joined g L lam
      (covariantDerivativePolynomialFamily b) b
      (fun y => t • covariantDerivativeCoefficientFamily g L lam c
        (fun z => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,z) j) y)
      (fun y => (k*fderiv ℝ f y (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y) j)) • c y) htc hwc,
    referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_coeff_smul g L lam _ _ _ _ _
      (hq.differentiable (by simp) x) (differentiableAt_const t),
    referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_coeff_smul g L lam _ _ _ _ _
      (hc.differentiable (by simp) x) (hw.differentiable (by simp) x)]
  rw [fderiv_const_mul (hdf.differentiable (by simp) x) k]
  rw [(hasFDerivAt_const t x).fderiv]
  simp only [fderiv_const,ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply,map_zero,zero_mul,add_zero,
    ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,smul_eq_mul]
  rw [referenceFrameDerivative_df_eq_hessian_add_connection g hg L lam f hf]
  abel

lemma referenceWeightedIndexedPolynomialHessian_expansion (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (k s t : ℝ)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (x : R3) (i j : Fin 3) :
    referenceWeightedIndexedPolynomialHessian g L lam b c f k s t x i j =
    C (s*t) * referenceIndexedPolynomialHessian g L lam b c x i j +
    C (s*k*coordinateHessian f (fun V W => referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,x) V W) x
      (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) j)) * finitePolynomialField b c x +
    C (s*k*fderiv ℝ f x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) j)) *
      referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) +
    C (t*k*fderiv ℝ f x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i)) *
      referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) j) +
    C (k^2*fderiv ℝ f x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i)*
      fderiv ℝ f x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) j)) * finitePolynomialField b c x := by
  rw [referenceWeightedIndexedPolynomialHessian,referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative,
    referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_weighted_finite g hg L lam b c f k t hc hf,
    ← referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative_eq_finite]
  simp only [referenceIndexedPolynomialHessian,referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative,
    Fin.sum_univ_three,map_mul,map_add,map_pow]
  ring

theorem referenceWeightedIndexedPolynomialHessian_mixed_commutator (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (k : ℝ)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (x : R3) (i j : Fin 3) :
    referenceWeightedIndexedPolynomialHessian g L lam b c f k (-1) 1 x j i -
      referenceWeightedIndexedPolynomialHessian g L lam b c f k 1 (-1) x i j =
    referenceHorizontalCurvaturePolynomial g L lam x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x)) i j
      (finitePolynomialField b c x) -
    C (2*k*coordinateHessian f (fun V W => referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,x) V W) x
      (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) j)) * finitePolynomialField b c x := by
  rw [referenceWeightedIndexedPolynomialHessian_expansion g hg L lam b c f k (-1) 1 hc hf,
    referenceWeightedIndexedPolynomialHessian_expansion g hg L lam b c f k 1 (-1) hc hf,
    reference_coordinateHessian_symm g hg L lam f hf x
      (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) j) (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i),
    ← referenceIndexedPolynomialHessian_antisymm g hg L lam b c hc x i j]
  simp only [map_mul,map_neg,map_one,map_ofNat]
  ring

lemma hasCompactSupport_covariantDerivativeCoefficientFamily (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (V : R3 → R3) (hc : HasCompactSupport c) :
    HasCompactSupport (covariantDerivativeCoefficientFamily g L lam c V) := by
  apply hc.mono'
  intro x hx
  by_contra hnot
  have hc0 := image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hnot
  have hd0 := fderiv_of_notMem_tsupport (𝕜 := ℝ) hnot
  simp only [Function.mem_support] at hx
  apply hx
  funext a
  rcases a with a | ⟨i,j,a⟩
  · simp only [covariantDerivativeCoefficientFamily,hd0,ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply,Pi.zero_apply]
  · simp only [covariantDerivativeCoefficientFamily,hc0,Pi.zero_apply,mul_zero]

lemma hasCompactSupport_weightedDerivativeCoefficientFamily (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (k t : ℝ) (V : R3 → R3) (hc : HasCompactSupport c) :
    HasCompactSupport (weightedDerivativeCoefficientFamily g L lam c f k t V) := by
  apply hc.mono'
  intro x hx
  by_contra hnot
  have hc0 := image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hnot
  have hd0 := fderiv_of_notMem_tsupport (𝕜 := ℝ) hnot
  simp only [Function.mem_support] at hx
  apply hx
  funext a
  rcases a with a | a
  · rcases a with a | ⟨i,j,a⟩ <;>
      simp only [weightedDerivativeCoefficientFamily,joinedCoefficientFamily,Sum.elim_inl,
        Pi.smul_apply,covariantDerivativeCoefficientFamily,hd0,hc0,
        ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply,Pi.zero_apply,smul_zero,mul_zero]
  · simp only [weightedDerivativeCoefficientFamily,joinedCoefficientFamily,Sum.elim_inr,
      Pi.smul_apply,hc0,Pi.zero_apply,smul_zero]

lemma referenceWeightedCovectorPolynomialDerivative_partial (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (k s : ℝ) (x V : R3) (l : Fin 3) :
    referenceWeightedCovectorPolynomialDerivative g L lam (fun a t => pderiv t (b a)) c f k s x V l =
      pderiv l (referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c f k s x V) := by
  simp only [referenceWeightedCovectorPolynomialDerivative,referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative,
    referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative_partial,finitePolynomialField_partial,map_add,pderiv_C_mul]

def referenceWeightedLoweredCovectorIndexedHessian (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (k s t : ℝ) (x : R3) (i j l : Fin 3) : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  referenceWeightedCovectorPolynomialDerivative g L lam
    (fun a h => pderiv h (weightedDerivativePolynomialFamily b a))
    (weightedDerivativeCoefficientFamily g L lam c f k t
      (fun y => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y) j)) f k s x
    (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) l -
  C s * ∑ a : Fin 3, C (referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient g L lam x
      (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) a j) *
    referenceWeightedCovectorPolynomialDerivative g L lam (fun a h => pderiv h (b a)) c f k t x
      (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) a) l

lemma referenceWeightedLoweredCovectorIndexedHessian_eq_partial (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (k s t : ℝ) (x : R3) (i j l : Fin 3) :
    referenceWeightedLoweredCovectorIndexedHessian g L lam b c f k s t x i j l =
      pderiv l (referenceWeightedIndexedPolynomialHessian g L lam b c f k s t x i j) := by
  simp only [referenceWeightedLoweredCovectorIndexedHessian,
    referenceWeightedCovectorPolynomialDerivative_partial,referenceWeightedIndexedPolynomialHessian,
    map_sub,map_sum,pderiv_C_mul]

theorem referenceWeightedLoweredCovectorIndexedHessian_mixed_commutator (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (k : ℝ)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (x : R3) (i j l : Fin 3) :
    referenceWeightedLoweredCovectorIndexedHessian g L lam b c f k (-1) 1 x j i l -
      referenceWeightedLoweredCovectorIndexedHessian g L lam b c f k 1 (-1) x i j l =
    referenceCovectorCurvaturePolynomial g L lam x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x)) i j
      (fun a => pderiv a (finitePolynomialField b c x)) l -
    C (2*k*coordinateHessian f (fun V W => referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,x) V W) x
      (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) j)) *
      pderiv l (finitePolynomialField b c x) := by
  rw [referenceWeightedLoweredCovectorIndexedHessian_eq_partial,
    referenceWeightedLoweredCovectorIndexedHessian_eq_partial,← map_sub,
    referenceWeightedIndexedPolynomialHessian_mixed_commutator g hg L lam b c f k hc hf]
  simp only [map_sub,pderiv_C_mul,referenceCovectorCurvaturePolynomial_partial]

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.WeightedIndexedCurvature

``````

## Calderon.WeightedRaisingBounds

SHA256 `b6c3d1a59f245fb447de845f34bdfdea33068359ee1064b0d9e7a78136f7e4f4`.

``````lean
import Calderon.FiniteRaisingEnergy

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 10
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory MvPolynomial
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Gradient Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.WeightedRaisingBounds
open RadiusProfile ConformalDepth MetricOperator AngularPolynomial SphereHarmonic
  WeightedFischerSquare SmoothMetricFrame FischerConnectionTransport
  IntegratedFischerIdentities FiniteRaisingEnergy PolynomialSlotCompatibility
  MetricFrameTrace ReferenceDensityBounds FischerDensityIntegration

attribute [local irreducible] referenceMetricGramFrame referenceConnectionFamily
  metricOperatorField referenceMetric dilatedMetric finitePolynomialField
  referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative
variable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]

lemma referenceWeightedFramePolynomialField_plus_eq (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (k : ℕ) (x : R3) :
    referenceWeightedFramePolynomialField g L lam b c f k 1 x =
      weightedDerivativePlus k (fun i => fderiv ℝ f x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i))
        (finitePolynomialField b c x) (fun i => referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x
          (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i)) := by
  funext i
  simp only [referenceWeightedFramePolynomialField,referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative,
    weightedDerivativePlus,map_mul,map_one,one_mul,mul_assoc]

lemma referenceWeightedFramePolynomialField_minus_eq (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (k : ℕ) (x : R3) :
    referenceWeightedFramePolynomialField g L lam b c f k (-1) x =
      weightedDerivativeMinus k (fun i => fderiv ℝ f x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i))
        (finitePolynomialField b c x) (fun i => referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x
          (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i)) := by
  funext i
  simp only [referenceWeightedFramePolynomialField,referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative,
    weightedDerivativeMinus,map_mul,map_neg,map_one,neg_one_mul,mul_assoc]

lemma referenceLoweredWeightedTraceField_pointwise_bound (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hb : ∀ a, b a ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (s : ℝ) (x : R3) :
    fischerInner (referenceLoweredWeightedTraceField g L lam b c f k s x)
      (referenceLoweredWeightedTraceField g L lam b c f k s x) ≤
      ((k:ℝ)+2)*referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g L lam b c f k s x := by
  have hq : ∀ i : Fin 3, (referenceWeightedFramePolynomialField g L lam b c f k s x i).IsHomogeneous k :=
    fun i => (referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative_harmonicHomogeneous g hg L lam k hk b hb c f s x
      (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i)).1
  have h := fischerInner_divergence_self_le hk _ hq
  rw [polynomialDivergence_referenceWeightedFramePolynomialField] at h
  simpa only [Fintype.card_fin,referenceWeightedFramePolynomialField,referenceWeightedFrameEnergy,
    Nat.cast_ofNat,show (k:ℝ)+(3:ℝ)-1=(k:ℝ)+2 by ring] using h

lemma metricDifferentialNorm_sq_eq_frame_sum (g : MatrixField)
    (hp : ∀ x, (g x).PosDef) (f : R3 → ℝ) (x : R3) (e : Fin 3 → R3)
    (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (metricOperatorField g x) e) :
    metricDifferentialNorm g f x ^ 2 = ∑ i : Fin 3, (fderiv ℝ f x (e i))^2 := by
  have hq : coefficientQuadratic (inverseMetricOperator g) x (gradient f x) =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, (fderiv ℝ f x (e i))^2 := by
    unfold coefficientQuadratic
    rw [inverseMetricOperator_eq_matrix_inverse_of_posDef g hp,
      inverseMatrix_metricFrame_sum (g x) (hp x) e (by simpa only [metricOperatorField] using he)]
    simp only [sum_inner,real_inner_smul_left]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    simp [inner_gradient_left,inner_gradient_right,pow_two]
  unfold metricDifferentialNorm
  rw [hq,Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => sq_nonneg _))]

lemma referenceMetricDifferentialNorm_sq_eq_frame_sum (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (x : R3) :
    metricDifferentialNorm (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) f x ^2 =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, (fderiv ℝ f x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i))^2 :=
  metricDifferentialNorm_sq_eq_frame_sum _ (dilatedReferenceMetric_posDef g hg lam L) f x _
    (referenceMetricGramFrame_isMetricOrthonormalFrame g hg L (lam,x))

lemma referenceLoweredWeightedTraceField_mixed_bound (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hb : ∀ a, b a ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (x : R3) :
    fischerInner (referenceLoweredWeightedTraceField g L lam b c f k 1 x)
      (referenceLoweredWeightedTraceField g L lam b c f k 1 x) ≤
      2*fischerInner (referenceLoweredWeightedTraceField g L lam b c f k (-1) x)
        (referenceLoweredWeightedTraceField g L lam b c f k (-1) x) +
      8*(k:ℝ)^3*metricDifferentialNorm (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) f x ^2*
        fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField b c x) := by
  have hv : (finitePolynomialField b c x).IsHomogeneous k :=
    (finitePolynomialField_harmonicHomogeneous k b hb c x).1
  have h := fischerInner_weightedDerivative_divergence_bound
    (fun i => fderiv ℝ f x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i)) (finitePolynomialField b c x)
    (fun i => referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i))
    hv (metricDifferentialNorm (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) f x)
    (referenceMetricDifferentialNorm_sq_eq_frame_sum g hg L lam f x).symm.le
  rw [← referenceWeightedFramePolynomialField_plus_eq,← referenceWeightedFramePolynomialField_minus_eq,
    polynomialDivergence_referenceWeightedFramePolynomialField,
    polynomialDivergence_referenceWeightedFramePolynomialField] at h
  exact h

lemma referenceLoweredWeightedTraceField_convex_bound (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hb : ∀ a, b a ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (x : R3) (zeta : ℝ)
    (hz : 0 ≤ zeta) (hz1 : zeta ≤ 1) :
    fischerInner (referenceLoweredWeightedTraceField g L lam b c f k 1 x)
      (referenceLoweredWeightedTraceField g L lam b c f k 1 x) ≤
      (1-zeta)*(((k:ℝ)+2)*referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g L lam b c f k 1 x) +
      zeta*(2*fischerInner (referenceLoweredWeightedTraceField g L lam b c f k (-1) x)
        (referenceLoweredWeightedTraceField g L lam b c f k (-1) x) +
        8*(k:ℝ)^3*metricDifferentialNorm (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) f x ^2*
          fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField b c x)) := by
  have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (referenceLoweredWeightedTraceField_pointwise_bound g hg L lam k hk b hb c f 1 x)
    (sub_nonneg.mpr hz1)
  have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (referenceLoweredWeightedTraceField_mixed_bound g hg L lam k hk b hb c f x) hz
  nlinarith

lemma fderiv_referenceLogRadius_ne_zero (δ R L : ℝ) (p : ℕ)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hR : 0 < R) (hL : 0 < L) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (x : R3) :
    fderiv ℝ (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) x ≠ 0 := by
  have hpp : 0 < (p:ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < p by omega)
  have ha : (p:ℝ)*logSlope δ (referenceDepth L x) ≠ 0 :=
    (mul_pos hpp (logSlope_pos δ _ hδ)).ne'
  have ht := fderiv_referenceDepth_ne_zero L hL.ne' x
  change fderiv ℝ (fun y => Real.log (referenceRadius δ R p L y)) x ≠ 0
  rw [log_referenceRadius δ R p L hδ hR,fderiv_logProfile δ (Real.log R) p (referenceDepth L) x hδ
    ((contDiff_referenceDepth L).differentiable (by simp) x)]
  unfold profileDifferential
  exact smul_ne_zero ha ht

lemma referenceProfileNorm_pos (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (lam δ R L : ℝ) (p : ℕ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hR : 0 < R) (hL : 0 < L)
    (hp : 1 ≤ p) (x : R3) : 0 < referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x :=
  metricDifferentialNorm_pos _ (dilatedReferenceMetric_posDef g hg lam L) _ x
    (fderiv_referenceLogRadius_ne_zero δ R L p hδ hR hL hp x)

lemma continuous_referenceProfileNorm (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (lam δ R L : ℝ) (p : ℕ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    Continuous (referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L) :=
  continuous_metricDifferentialNorm _ (dilatedReferenceMetric_smooth_entries g hg lam L)
    (dilatedReferenceMetric_posDef g hg lam L) _ (contDiff_log_referenceRadius δ R p L hδ hR)

lemma continuous_referenceProfileNorm_inv (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (lam δ R L : ℝ) (p : ℕ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hR : 0 < R) (hL : 0 < L) (hp : 1 ≤ p) :
    Continuous (fun x => (referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x)⁻¹) :=
  (continuous_referenceProfileNorm g hg lam δ R L p hδ hR).inv₀
    (fun x => (referenceProfileNorm_pos g hg lam δ R L p hδ hR hL hp x).ne')

lemma referenceProfileTrace_convex_bound (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam δ R : ℝ) (profileP k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hb : ∀ a, b a ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (x : R3) (c1 : ℝ) (hc1 : 0 ≤ c1)
    (hbeta : 0 < referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R profileP L x)
    (hc1beta : c1 ≤ referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R profileP L x) :
    fischerInner (referenceLoweredWeightedTraceField g L lam b c (referenceLogRadius δ R profileP L) k 1 x)
      (referenceLoweredWeightedTraceField g L lam b c (referenceLogRadius δ R profileP L) k 1 x) ≤
      (1-c1/referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R profileP L x)*(((k:ℝ)+2)*referenceWeightedFrameEnergy g L lam b c (referenceLogRadius δ R profileP L) k 1 x) +
      (c1/referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R profileP L x)*(2*fischerInner
        (referenceLoweredWeightedTraceField g L lam b c (referenceLogRadius δ R profileP L) k (-1) x)
        (referenceLoweredWeightedTraceField g L lam b c (referenceLogRadius δ R profileP L) k (-1) x) +
        8*(k:ℝ)^3*referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R profileP L x ^2*
          fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField b c x)) :=
  referenceLoweredWeightedTraceField_convex_bound g hg L lam k hk b hb c _ x _
    (div_nonneg hc1 hbeta.le) ((div_le_one hbeta).mpr hc1beta)

variable {κ : Type*} [Fintype κ]

lemma integrable_referenceDensity_weighted_fischerPair (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (a : R3 → ℝ) (ha : Continuous a)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (d : κ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (z : R3 → κ → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hz : ContDiff ℝ ∞ z)
    (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c) : Integrable (fun x => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*a x*
      fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField d z x)) := by
  have hr : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : R3 => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)) :=
    (contDiff_referenceDensityFamily g hg L).comp (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id)
  exact ((hr.continuous.mul ha).mul (contDiff_fischerPair b d c z hc hz).continuous).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
``````

````````
# Natural angular coefficient adjoints: full upfront expansion v001

Author role, not independent auditor. Stable author unit: section5-natural-adjoint-author.
Frozen main theorem and all ten definitions remain unchanged. No Lean source was written before this expansion. Compiler and all Leanflow state remain root-owned.

## Authority and precise scope

Selected original Section05, SHA-256 dee56e58ab1316aaebb7d53f48231658899ff07750fc7ab83f4cdd46ce3c1413, entire source actually read. Primary correspondence: lines 487–519 (real scalar principal coefficient, complete full-density adjoint defect, cancellation of third base derivatives), within the selected lines 426–575. Additional source premises supplied by the intended application: orthonormal sphere trivialization; fixed normalized probability sphere measure; positive smooth reference base density μ; a^{ij}=rQ^{ij} real symmetric, independent of angle. The actual scalar-principal realization uses the already checked referenceRadius and referenceInverseEntryFamily+h and referenceDensityFamily.

The packet proves a real Hilbert-valued differential-operator identity for arbitrary smooth bounded angular endomorphism coefficient families B_i and C. Their adjoints are the actual ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint maps, not freely supplied witnesses. Hilbert space E is complete. This applies directly to bounded Hilbert realizations and finite spectral compressions once the coefficients have been constructed. It does not declare the manuscript's Ψ¹ and Ψ² coefficients bounded on H⁰: their full natural sphere-domain realization is an additional open application. No spectral projection commutation is assumed. Compressing a coefficient can alter compositions by projection-boundary terms, which this packet does not discard. No error estimate, coercivity, trace equation, density existence, novel analytic premise or main theorem is assumed or claimed.

## Definitions and domain

Set D_i u(x)=fderiv ℝ u(x)(v_i), with fixed coordinate directions v_i. For smooth u:Y→E,

S_a u = Σ_{i,j} a^{ij} D_i D_j u,
F_B u = Σ_i B_i D_i u,
Uu = S_a u + F_B u + Cu.

For the integrated adjoint theorem use smooth globally defined coefficients μ,a,B,C and smooth u,w on R³, with u compactly supported and μ>0 everywhere. Global extensions constitute an explicit conditional domain interface; arbitrary intrinsic/local extension is not claimed. These hypotheses justify all coefficient-section products and integrations. Compact support of u implies compact support of its derivatives; smooth products with compact support are integrable. w need not have compact support. For the pointwise defect theorem only μ(x)≠0 and local matrix symmetry near x are necessary, with global smoothness retained to reuse checked calculus.

Because adjoint on real Hilbert CLMs is a continuous real linear isometry, x↦B_i(x)* and x↦C(x)* are smooth. The base derivative D_i(B_i*) is the actual Fréchet derivative of that family. It is retained, even where one later proves differentiation commutes with the real adjoint map.

## First and zero angular terms: genuine integration by parts

The exact Hilbert identity is <B_i D_i u,w>=<D_i u,B_i* w>. Multiplying by μ and moving one ordinary base derivative gives

∫ μ <B_i D_i u,w> = -∫ <D_i(μ B_i* w),u>.

The right side, using positivity of μ and real inner-product symmetry, equals

∫ μ <u, -μ⁻¹ D_i(μ B_i* w)>.

Pointwise, product differentiation yields

-μ⁻¹ D_i(μ B_i* w)
= -B_i* D_i w - μ⁻¹[D_i μ B_i* + μ D_i(B_i*)]w
= -B_i* D_i w - μ⁻¹ D_i(μ B_i*)w.

No term involving D_i μ or D_i B_i* is omitted. For the zero-base term, <Cu,w>=<u,C*w> pointwise, so its formal adjoint is C*.

## Scalar second-principal term and full adjoint

Twice integrating by parts gives the checked divergence form

S_a†w = μ⁻¹ Σ_{i,j} D_j D_i(μ a^{ij} w).

The order of base derivatives is reversed by the two integrations. Smooth constant-direction derivatives commute. Real symmetry a^{ij}=a^{ji}, including its derivative by local equality, merges the two cross terms. Consequently

S_a†w − S_a w = s_0 w + Σ_i s_i D_i w,
s_i = 2 μ⁻¹ Σ_j D_j(μ a^{ij}),
s_0 = μ⁻¹ Σ_{i,j} D_j D_i(μ a^{ij}).

These are the existing checked adjointFirstCoefficient and adjointZeroCoefficient functions. They retain derivatives of μ and a in their divergence expression; expanding, D_j(μa)=D_jμ a+μD_ja and D_jD_i(μa)=D_jD_iμ a+D_iμ D_ja+D_jμ D_ia+μD_jD_ia.

Define the proposed full formal adjoint by

U†w = S_a†w − μ⁻¹ Σ_i D_i(μ B_i* w) + C*w.

The three actual integrations and finite-sum integral identities prove ∫ μ<Uu,w>=∫ μ<u,U†w> for the stated smooth compact domain. This is a proved formal adjoint on that domain; it is not a claim about equality of maximal closed unbounded adjoint domains.

## Exact defect and source coefficient correspondence

Define actual CLM coefficient functions

G_i(x) = s_i(x) id_E − B_i(x) − B_i(x)*,
H(x) = s_0(x) id_E − μ(x)⁻¹ Σ_i D_i[μ B_i*](x) + C(x)* − C(x).

Then the full pointwise identity is

U†w − Uw = Σ_i G_i D_i w + H w.

The proof first expands each angular adjoint first-base term by the product rules above, substitutes the already proved scalar second-base defect, distributes finite sums, and collects ordinary base orders by additive module identities. All angular adjoints are actual CLM adjoints. G_i includes both −B_i and −B_i*, and H includes the full derivative of μB_i*. The expression has no second-base derivative; this is the substantive source formula in lines 497–507.

For a=actualPrincipalMatrix(g,L,λ,δ,R,p,h), μ(x)=referenceDensityFamily(g,L,(λ,x)), invoke actual_scalar_adjoint_defect. Admissible reference g, positive δ,R, smooth h, and symmetry of h near x give exactly the radius-weighted symmetric scalar principal and positive natural reference density. B and C remain explicit smooth Hilbert coefficient parameters, because the actual moving trace construction has not been proved. This specialization neither identifies arbitrary B,C with the source trace coefficients nor changes the fixed main assumptions.

## Third-base cancellation with the computed coefficients

For each G_k and scalar a^{ij}, the coefficient of D_kD_iD_j w in [G_kD_k, a^{ij}D_iD_j] is G_k a^{ij}−a^{ij}G_k. It vanishes because scalar multiplication commutes with every real-linear angular CLM, independently of whether G_k or B_k is scalar as an angular operator.

More precisely, the checked mixed principal identity gives

[G_kD_k,a^{ij}D_iD_j]w
= (D_k a^{ij}) G_k D_iD_jw
− a^{ij}(D_iD_jG_k)D_kw
− a^{ij}(D_jG_k)D_iD_kw
− a^{ij}(D_iG_k)D_jD_kw.

The packet will specialize this identity to the computed defect G_k, with smoothness derived from μ,a,B rather than supplied as a desired cancellation hypothesis. H contributes [H,a^{ij}D_iD_j]w=−a^{ij}(D_iD_jH)w−a^{ij}(D_jH)D_iw−a^{ij}(D_iH)D_jw, again with base order at most one. Remaining [G_kD_k,B_iD_i] has base order at most two and [G_kD_k,C], [H,B_iD_i], [H,C] at most one. Thus [U†−U,U] contains no third base derivatives. At the first delivery, only assertions backed by supplied Lean declarations count as implemented; further assembly can be supplied in the same stable unit.

The analogous T†/U cancellation needs the actual natural T† first-base CLM families and their common core. Generic first-order/principal cancellation is already checked and is not a substitute for that source realization. UZ has at most two base derivatives only after actual Z is an angular zero-base operator. Those applications remain explicit open obligations.

## Derivative budget and limits

The defect formula itself uses two base derivatives of μa, one of μB*, and none of C*. Computing the displayed [G D,S_a] requires two more derivatives of G, hence at most three of μa and two of B* plus μ-inverse derivatives. [H,S_a] uses two more derivatives of H, hence at most four of μa, three of B*, two of C*, with μ inverse derivatives. One additional integration for source error forms would reach at most five of μa; no quantitative assertion about source symbol seminorms is made here.

The actual source application still requires: moving trace construction and its six-derivative normalized symbol family; full natural angular/domain transfer including genuine sphere adjoints; actual T† coefficients and domain; source Ψ commutator mapping and the exact four-term N error estimate; common shrink-uniform constants; actual Pψ=0 and density application. # Computed full-adjoint defect commutator: upfront expansion v003

Additive to v001. No extra hypotheses beyond its explicit smooth Hilbert coefficient interface. The packet uses the computed G,H of U†−U rather than an independent first-order discrepancy premise. Let D=ΣG_k D_k+H and U=Σa_ij D_iD_j+ΣB_iD_i+C. All statements remain conditional on smooth bounded endomorphism realizations; genuine source common-core/symbol transfer remains open.

For compact/source-local application actual principal a and μ are those in v001. For calculus below require smooth global μ,a,B,C with μ nowhere zero; G,H smoothness follows from the explicit formulas by ordinary inversion, adjoint smoothness, products, finite sums and derivatives. No desired cancellation or coercive estimate is assumed.

The six commutator building blocks have the following complete formulas, with all coefficients evaluated at x and all operators acting in the stated order:

1. [G_k D_k,a_ij D_iD_j]w = (D_k a_ij)G_k D_iD_jw − a_ij(D_iD_jG_k)D_kw − a_ij(D_jG_k)D_iD_kw − a_ij(D_iG_k)D_jD_kw.
2. [H,a_ij D_iD_j]w = −a_ij(D_iD_jH)w −a_ij(D_jH)D_iw −a_ij(D_iH)D_jw.
3. [G_k D_k,B_iD_i]w = G_k(D_kB_i)D_iw − B_i(D_iG_k)D_kw +(G_kB_i−B_iG_k)D_kD_iw.
4. [H,B_iD_i]w = (HB_i−B_iH)D_iw −B_i(D_iH)w.
5. [G_kD_k,C]w = G_k(D_kC)w +(G_kC−CG_k)D_kw.
6. [H,C]w = (HC−CH)w.

Each formula is obtained by the actual Fréchet Leibniz rule for CLM application. In 1 and2 scalar multiplication commutes with every real CLM. In3 mixed fixed-direction derivatives commute, but angular G_k and B_i need not commute: their angular commutator multiplying a second-base derivative is retained. Thus no third base derivative survives and no angular coefficient commutation is assumed. All six formulas are to be specialized to the explicitly computed G,H with their smoothness derived in Lean. Their finite sums give [D,U]=[U†−U,U], provided the full pointwise defect is instantiated on the actual common smooth domain. The full summed assembly and the T†/U counterpart must be named and proved before claimed as implemented.

Orders are ordinary base orders only. This calculation does not prove angular Ψ-order loss, epsilon/beta bounds or the source three permitted error types; those need genuine symbol/domain estimates. Actual bounded Hilbert formulas cannot by themselves establish the error-form/coercivity inequality for N.

# Full-adjoint commutator reduction: upfront expansion v004

Continuation of v001/v003 with unchanged bounded-Hilbert/common-core scope. Define the computed differential defect D w=H w+ΣG_i D_iw, using the explicit coefficient functions of v001. It has base order at most one by definition, and the proved pointwise source formula gives U†w−Uw=Dw for every smooth w. Smoothness of D follows from that of G,H and w.

Ordinary constant-direction Fréchet derivatives are additive on smooth sections. The same is true after a second derivative by first rewriting D_j(u+w)=D_ju+D_jw and differentiating the equality. Finite sums, coefficient CLM application and scalar multiplication are additive, so U(u+w)=Uu+Uw. No operator linearity on nonsmooth functions is asserted.

Under globally symmetric a and μ nowhere zero, the full defect identity gives the function equality U†w=Uw+Dw, as well as U†(Uw)=U(Uw)+D(Uw), because Uw is smooth. Hence, retaining every composed lower angular coefficient,

[U†,U]w=U†(Uw)−U(U†w)=D(Uw)−U(Dw)=[D,U]w.

This proves the exact reduction used in source lines509–516. The six previously expanded commutator blocks in v003 provide its complete local normal form and show which coefficient derivatives occur; until a summed normal-form Lean theorem is provided, the reduction and individual blocks do not themselves count as formal proof of a full source angular error type or quantitative estimate. ## Definitions and domain

Set D_i u(x)=fderiv ℝ u(x)(v_i), with fixed coordinate directions v_i. For smooth u:Y→E,

S_a u = Σ_{i,j} a^{ij} D_i D_j u,
F_B u = Σ_i B_i D_i u,
Uu = S_a u + F_B u + Cu.

For the integrated adjoint theorem use smooth globally defined coefficients μ,a,B,C and smooth u,w on R³, with u compactly supported and μ>0 everywhere. Global extensions constitute an explicit conditional domain interface; arbitrary intrinsic/local extension is not claimed. These hypotheses justify all coefficient-section products and integrations. Compact support of u implies compact support of its derivatives; smooth products with compact support are integrable. w need not have compact support. For the pointwise defect theorem only μ(x)≠0 and local matrix symmetry near x are necessary, with global smoothness retained to reuse checked calculus.

Because adjoint on real Hilbert CLMs is a continuous real linear isometry, x↦B_i(x)* and x↦C(x)* are smooth. The base derivative D_i(B_i*) is the actual Fréchet derivative of that family. It is retained, even where one later proves differentiation commutes with the real adjoint map.

## First and zero angular terms: genuine integration by parts

The exact Hilbert identity is <B_i D_i u,w>=<D_i u,B_i* w>. Multiplying by μ and moving one ordinary base derivative gives

∫ μ <B_i D_i u,w> = -∫ <D_i(μ B_i* w),u>.

The right side, using positivity of μ and real inner-product symmetry, equals

∫ μ <u, -μ⁻¹ D_i(μ B_i* w)>.

Pointwise, product differentiation yields

-μ⁻¹ D_i(μ B_i* w)
= -B_i* D_i w - μ⁻¹[D_i μ B_i* + μ D_i(B_i*)]w
= -B_i* D_i w - μ⁻¹ D_i(μ B_i*)w.

No term involving D_i μ or D_i B_i* is omitted. For the zero-base term, <Cu,w>=<u,C*w> pointwise, so its formal adjoint is C*.

## Scalar second-principal term and full adjoint

Twice integrating by parts gives the checked divergence form

S_a†w = μ⁻¹ Σ_{i,j} D_j D_i(μ a^{ij} w).

The order of base derivatives is reversed by the two integrations. Smooth constant-direction derivatives commute. Real symmetry a^{ij}=a^{ji}, including its derivative by local equality, merges the two cross terms. Consequently

S_a†w − S_a w = s_0 w + Σ_i s_i D_i w,
s_i = 2 μ⁻¹ Σ_j D_j(μ a^{ij}),
s_0 = μ⁻¹ Σ_{i,j} D_j D_i(μ a^{ij}).

These are the existing checked adjointFirstCoefficient and adjointZeroCoefficient functions. They retain derivatives of μ and a in their divergence expression; expanding, D_j(μa)=D_jμ a+μD_ja and D_jD_i(μa)=D_jD_iμ a+D_iμ D_ja+D_jμ D_ia+μD_jD_ia.

Define the proposed full formal adjoint by

U†w = S_a†w − μ⁻¹ Σ_i D_i(μ B_i* w) + C*w.

The three actual integrations and finite-sum integral identities prove ∫ μ<Uu,w>=∫ μ<u,U†w> for the stated smooth compact domain. This is a proved formal adjoint on that domain; it is not a claim about equality of maximal closed unbounded adjoint domains.

## Exact defect and source coefficient correspondence

Define actual CLM coefficient functions

G_i(x) = s_i(x) id_E − B_i(x) − B_i(x)*,
H(x) = s_0(x) id_E − μ(x)⁻¹ Σ_i D_i[μ B_i*](x) + C(x)* − C(x).

Then the full pointwise identity is

U†w − Uw = Σ_i G_i D_i w + H w.

The proof first expands each angular adjoint first-base term by the product rules above, substitutes the already proved scalar second-base defect, distributes finite sums, and collects ordinary base orders by additive module identities. All angular adjoints are actual CLM adjoints. G_i includes both −B_i and −B_i*, and H includes the full derivative of μB_i*. The expression has no second-base derivative; this is the substantive source formula in lines 497–507.

For a=actualPrincipalMatrix(g,L,λ,δ,R,p,h), μ(x)=referenceDensityFamily(g,L,(λ,x)), invoke actual_scalar_adjoint_defect. Admissible reference g, positive δ,R, smooth h, and symmetry of h near x give exactly the radius-weighted symmetric scalar principal and positive natural reference density. B and C remain explicit smooth Hilbert coefficient parameters, because the actual moving trace construction has not been proved. This specialization neither identifies arbitrary B,C with the source trace coefficients nor changes the fixed main assumptions.

## Third-base cancellation with the computed coefficients

For each G_k and scalar a^{ij}, the coefficient of D_kD_iD_j w in [G_kD_k, a^{ij}D_iD_j] is G_k a^{ij}−a^{ij}G_k. It vanishes because scalar multiplication commutes with every real-linear angular CLM, independently of whether G_k or B_k is scalar as an angular operator.

More precisely, the checked mixed principal identity gives

[G_kD_k,a^{ij}D_iD_j]w
= (D_k a^{ij}) G_k D_iD_jw
− a^{ij}(D_iD_jG_k)D_kw
− a^{ij}(D_jG_k)D_iD_kw
− a^{ij}(D_iG_k)D_jD_kw.

The packet will specialize this identity to the computed defect G_k, with smoothness derived from μ,a,B rather than supplied as a desired cancellation hypothesis. H contributes [H,a^{ij}D_iD_j]w=−a^{ij}(D_iD_jH)w−a^{ij}(D_jH)D_iw−a^{ij}(D_iH)D_jw, again with base order at most one. Remaining [G_kD_k,B_iD_i] has base order at most two and [G_kD_k,C], [H,B_iD_i], [H,C] at most one. Thus [U†−U,U] contains no third base derivatives. The analogous T†/U cancellation needs the actual natural T† first-base CLM families and their common core. Generic first-order/principal cancellation is already checked and is not a substitute for that source realization. UZ has at most two base derivatives only after actual Z is an angular zero-base operator. Those applications remain explicit open obligations.

The defect formula itself uses two base derivatives of μa, one of μB*, and none of C*. One additional integration for source error forms would reach at most five of μa; no quantitative assertion about source symbol seminorms is made here.

# Computed full-adjoint defect commutator: upfront expansion v003

Additive to v001. No extra hypotheses beyond its explicit smooth Hilbert coefficient interface. The packet uses the computed G,H of U†−U rather than an independent first-order discrepancy premise. Let D=ΣG_k D_k+H and U=Σa_ij D_iD_j+ΣB_iD_i+C. All statements remain conditional on smooth bounded endomorphism realizations; genuine source common-core/symbol transfer remains open.

For compact/source-local application actual principal a and μ are those in v001. For calculus below require smooth global μ,a,B,C with μ nowhere zero; G,H smoothness follows from the explicit formulas by ordinary inversion, adjoint smoothness, products, finite sums and derivatives. No desired cancellation or coercive estimate is assumed.

The six commutator building blocks have the following complete formulas, with all coefficients evaluated at x and all operators acting in the stated order:

1. [G_k D_k,a_ij D_iD_j]w = (D_k a_ij)G_k D_iD_jw − a_ij(D_iD_jG_k)D_kw − a_ij(D_jG_k)D_iD_kw − a_ij(D_iG_k)D_jD_kw.
2. [H,a_ij D_iD_j]w = −a_ij(D_iD_jH)w −a_ij(D_jH)D_iw −a_ij(D_iH)D_jw.
3. [G_k D_k,B_iD_i]w = G_k(D_kB_i)D_iw − B_i(D_iG_k)D_kw +(G_kB_i−B_iG_k)D_kD_iw.
4. [H,B_iD_i]w = (HB_i−B_iH)D_iw −B_i(D_iH)w.
5. [G_kD_k,C]w = G_k(D_kC)w +(G_kC−CG_k)D_kw.
6. [H,C]w = (HC−CH)w.

Each formula is obtained by the actual Fréchet Leibniz rule for CLM application. In 1 and2 scalar multiplication commutes with every real CLM. In3 mixed fixed-direction derivatives commute, but angular G_k and B_i need not commute: their angular commutator multiplying a second-base derivative is retained. Thus no third base derivative survives and no angular coefficient commutation is assumed. All six formulas are to be specialized to the explicitly computed G,H with their smoothness derived in Lean. Their finite sums give [D,U]=[U†−U,U], provided the full pointwise defect is instantiated on the actual common smooth domain. The full summed assembly and the T†/U counterpart must be named and proved before claimed as implemented.

Orders are ordinary base orders only. This calculation does not prove angular Ψ-order loss, epsilon/beta bounds or the source three permitted error types; those need genuine symbol/domain estimates. Actual bounded Hilbert formulas cannot by themselves establish the error-form/coercivity inequality for N.


# Full-adjoint commutator reduction: upfront expansion v004

Continuation of v001/v003 with unchanged bounded-Hilbert/common-core scope. Define the computed differential defect D w=H w+ΣG_i D_iw, using the explicit coefficient functions of v001. It has base order at most one by definition, and the proved pointwise source formula gives U†w−Uw=Dw for every smooth w. Smoothness of D follows from that of G,H and w.

Ordinary constant-direction Fréchet derivatives are additive on smooth sections. The same is true after a second derivative by first rewriting D_j(u+w)=D_ju+D_jw and differentiating the equality. Finite sums, coefficient CLM application and scalar multiplication are additive, so U(u+w)=Uu+Uw. No operator linearity on nonsmooth functions is asserted.

Under globally symmetric a and μ nowhere zero, the full defect identity gives the function equality U†w=Uw+Dw, as well as U†(Uw)=U(Uw)+D(Uw), because Uw is smooth. Hence, retaining every composed lower angular coefficient,

[U†,U]w=U†(Uw)−U(U†w)=D(Uw)−U(Dw)=[D,U]w.

This proves the exact reduction used in source lines509–516. The six previously expanded commutator blocks in v003 provide its complete local normal form and show which coefficient derivatives occur; until a summed normal-form Lean theorem is provided, the reduction and individual blocks do not themselves count as formal proof of a full source angular error type or quantitative estimate. Source natural angular domain transfer and T†/U realization remain open.

## A. Genuine spectral bilinear mapping, including exact Bessel examples

Fix existing OrthogonalSphereHarmonics and DenseSphereHarmonics evidence hO,hD. For arbitrary real coefficient sequence w, suppose |w(k)| <= C b_s(k)b_t(k), C>=0. Parseval for the actual sphere Hilbert decomposition gives

<a,v> = sum_k <w(k)u_k,v_k> = sum_k <r(k)b_s(k)u_k,b_t(k)v_k> = <z,V_t>.

All series are genuine inner-product Parseval series; equality follows termwise from graph witnesses and exact scalar cancellation. Hence |<a,v>| <= ||z|| ||V_t|| <= C ||U_s|| ||V_t||. No desired quadratic-form estimate is assumed. The only coefficient hypothesis is ordinary spectral multiplier growth, and its diagonal nature is explicit.

The positive real-power identity b_(s+t)=b_s b_t follows from Real.rpow_add, since 1+k>0. Consequently an actual multiplier output a=Lambda_(s+t)u has C=1 and the preceding estimate applies. ## Calderon.AmbientCovectorComponents

SHA256 `94d3878aeccb9a5ff0e0e2f4e1f80fd736ec345d639caf0f65e6cc483eda348d`.

``````lean
import Calderon.SmoothMovingFrameFields

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open Set
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.AmbientCovectorComponents
open SmoothMovingFrameFields SmoothSphereFields SphereHarmonic
open SmoothSphereRotationProjection SpectralCoreRegularity
open MovingFrameConnection SmoothMetricFrame RadiusProfile

def ambientCovectorDerivative {r : ℕ} (C : R3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (X : R3 → R3) (G : (Fin r → Fin 3) → R3 × R3 → ℝ)
    (a : Fin r → Fin 3) (q : R3 × R3) : ℝ :=
  ambientFrameHorizontal C X (G a) q -
    ∑ s : Fin r, ∑ j : Fin 3, C q.1 j (a s) * G (Function.update a s j) q

lemma ambientCovectorDerivative_rank_zero (C : R3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (X : R3 → R3) (G : (Fin 0 → Fin 3) → R3 × R3 → ℝ)
    (a : Fin 0 → Fin 3) (q : R3 × R3) :
    ambientCovectorDerivative C X G a q = ambientFrameHorizontal C X (G a) q := by
  simp [ambientCovectorDerivative]

lemma ambientCovectorDerivative_rank_one (C : R3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (X : R3 → R3) (G : (Fin 1 → Fin 3) → R3 × R3 → ℝ)
    (a : Fin 1 → Fin 3) (q : R3 × R3) :
    ambientCovectorDerivative C X G a q = ambientFrameHorizontal C X (G a) q -
      ∑ j : Fin 3, C q.1 j (a 0) * G (Function.update a 0 j) q := by
  simp only [ambientCovectorDerivative,Fin.sum_univ_one]

lemma ambientCovectorDerivative_rank_two (C : R3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (X : R3 → R3) (G : (Fin 2 → Fin 3) → R3 × R3 → ℝ)
    (a : Fin 2 → Fin 3) (q : R3 × R3) :
    ambientCovectorDerivative C X G a q = ambientFrameHorizontal C X (G a) q -
      ((∑ j : Fin 3, C q.1 j (a 0) * G (Function.update a 0 j) q) +
        ∑ j : Fin 3, C q.1 j (a 1) * G (Function.update a 1 j) q) := by
  simp only [ambientCovectorDerivative,Fin.sum_univ_two]

lemma contDiff_ambientCovectorDerivative {r : ℕ} (C : R3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => C x i j))
    (X : R3 → R3) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X)
    (G : (Fin r → Fin 3) → R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ∀ a, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (G a))
    (a : Fin r → Fin 3) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (ambientCovectorDerivative C X G a) :=
  (contDiff_ambientFrameHorizontal C hC X hX (G a) (hG a)).sub
    (ContDiff.sum fun s _ => ContDiff.sum fun j _ =>
      ((hC j (a s)).comp contDiff_fst).mul (hG (Function.update a s j)))

lemma ambientSphereL2_covectorDerivative {r : ℕ} (C : R3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => C x i j))
    (X : R3 → R3) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X)
    (G : (Fin r → Fin 3) → R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ∀ a, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (G a))
    (a : Fin r → Fin 3) (x : R3) :
    ambientSphereL2 (ambientCovectorDerivative C X G a)
      (contDiff_ambientCovectorDerivative C hC X hX G hG a) x =
    ambientSphereL2 (ambientFrameHorizontal C X (G a))
      (contDiff_ambientFrameHorizontal C hC X hX (G a) (hG a)) x -
      ∑ s : Fin r, ∑ j : Fin 3, C x j (a s) •
        ambientSphereL2 (G (Function.update a s j)) (hG (Function.update a s j)) x := by
  let B : C(UnitSphere,ℝ) := ambientSphereSection (ambientFrameHorizontal C X (G a))
    (contDiff_ambientFrameHorizontal C hC X hX (G a) (hG a)) x
  let R : (Fin r → Fin 3) → C(UnitSphere,ℝ) := fun b => ambientSphereSection (G b) (hG b) x
  have he : ambientSphereSection (ambientCovectorDerivative C X G a)
      (contDiff_ambientCovectorDerivative C hC X hX G hG a) x =
      B - ∑ s : Fin r, ∑ j : Fin 3, C x j (a s) • R (Function.update a s j) := by
    ext theta
    have hv : ambientCovectorDerivative C X G a (x,theta.val) =
        ambientFrameHorizontal C X (G a) (x,theta.val) -
        ∑ s : Fin r, ∑ j : Fin 3, C x j (a s) * G (Function.update a s j) (x,theta.val) := rfl
    simpa [B,R,ambientSphereSection,CompactParameterSmoothness.compactPullback,
      SmoothSphereFields.unitSphereInclusion] using hv
  have ht := congrArg (ContinuousMap.toLp 2 SphereHarmonic.sphereProbability ℝ) he
  simp only [map_sub,map_sum,map_smul] at ht
  exact ht

theorem sphereHarmonicCoordinate_covectorDerivative {r : ℕ}
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (k : ℕ)
    (C : R3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => C x i j))
    (hskew : ∀ x i j, C x i j = -C x j i) (X : R3 → R3) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X)
    (G : (Fin r → Fin 3) → R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ∀ a, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (G a))
    (a : Fin r → Fin 3) (x : R3) :
    sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (ambientSphereL2 (ambientCovectorDerivative C X G a)
      (contDiff_ambientCovectorDerivative C hC X hX G hG a) x) =
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (ambientSphereL2 (G a) (hG a) y)) x (X x) +
      (1/2 : ℝ) • (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, C x i j • harmonicSphereRotation k i j
        (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (ambientSphereL2 (G a) (hG a) x))) -
      ∑ s : Fin r, ∑ j : Fin 3, C x j (a s) • sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k
        (ambientSphereL2 (G (Function.update a s j)) (hG (Function.update a s j)) x) := by
  rw [ambientSphereL2_covectorDerivative C hC X hX G hG a x]
  simp only [map_sub,map_sum,map_smul]
  rw [sphereHarmonicCoordinate_frameHorizontal hO hD k C hC hskew X hX (G a) (hG a) x]

lemma ambientCovectorDerivative_sphere_zero {r : ℕ} (C : R3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (hskew : ∀ x i j, C x i j = -C x j i) (X : R3 → R3)
    (G : (Fin r → Fin 3) → R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ∀ a, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (G a))
    (K : Set R3) (hK : IsClosed K)
    (hz : ∀ a x, x ∉ K → ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G a (x,theta.val)=0)
    (a : Fin r → Fin 3) :
    ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, ambientCovectorDerivative C X G a (x,theta.val)=0 := by
  intro x hx theta
  have hh := ambientFrameHorizontal_sphere_zero C hskew X (G a) (hG a) K hK (hz a) x hx theta
  have hs : ∀ b, G b (x,theta.val)=0 := fun b => hz b x hx theta
  simp [ambientCovectorDerivative,hh,hs]

lemma hasCompactSupport_covectorDerivativeLift {r : ℕ} (C : R3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => C x i j))
    (hskew : ∀ x i j, C x i j = -C x j i) (X : R3 → R3) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X)
    (G : (Fin r → Fin 3) → R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ∀ a, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (G a))
    (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hz : ∀ a x, x ∉ K → ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G a (x,theta.val)=0)
    (a : Fin r → Fin 3) : HasCompactSupport (ambientSphereL2 (ambientCovectorDerivative C X G a)
      (contDiff_ambientCovectorDerivative C hC X hX G hG a)) :=
  hasCompactSupport_ambientSphereL2 _ (contDiff_ambientCovectorDerivative C hC X hX G hG a) K hK
    (ambientCovectorDerivative_sphere_zero C hskew X G hG K hK.isClosed hz a)

lemma contDiff_covectorDerivativeLift {r : ℕ} (C : R3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => C x i j)) (X : R3 → R3) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X)
    (G : (Fin r → Fin 3) → R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ∀ a, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (G a))
    (a : Fin r → Fin 3) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (ambientSphereL2 (ambientCovectorDerivative C X G a)
      (contDiff_ambientCovectorDerivative C hC X hX G hG a)) :=
  contDiff_ambientSphereL2 _ (contDiff_ambientCovectorDerivative C hC X hX G hG a)

theorem sphereHarmonicCoordinate_metricCovectorDerivative {r : ℕ}
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (k : ℕ)
    (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3) (hM : ContDiff ℝ ∞ M) (hΓ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Γ)
    (hE : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => e y i))
    (hsym : ∀ y U V, ⟪M y U,V⟫_ℝ = ⟪M y V,U⟫_ℝ)
    (he : ∀ y, IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (M y) (e y))
    (hcomp : ∀ y X U V, ⟪M y (Γ y X U),V⟫_ℝ + ⟪M y U,Γ y X V⟫_ℝ =
      ⟪fderiv ℝ M y X U,V⟫_ℝ)
    (X : R3 → R3) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X)
    (G : (Fin r → Fin 3) → R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ∀ a, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (G a))
    (a : Fin r → Fin 3) (x : R3) :
    let C := fun y => frameConnectionCoefficient M Γ e y (X y)
    let hC := fun i j => contDiff_frameConnectionCoefficient_field M Γ e hM hΓ hE X hX i j
    sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (ambientSphereL2 (ambientCovectorDerivative C X G a)
      (contDiff_ambientCovectorDerivative C hC X hX G hG a) x) =
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (ambientSphereL2 (G a) (hG a) y)) x (X x) +
      (1/2 : ℝ) • (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, C x i j • harmonicSphereRotation k i j
        (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (ambientSphereL2 (G a) (hG a) x))) -
      ∑ s : Fin r, ∑ j : Fin 3, C x j (a s) • sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k
        (ambientSphereL2 (G (Function.update a s j)) (hG (Function.update a s j)) x) :=
  sphereHarmonicCoordinate_covectorDerivative hO hD k _
    (fun i j => contDiff_frameConnectionCoefficient_field M Γ e hM hΓ hE X hX i j)
    (fun y i j => frameConnectionCoefficient_skew M Γ e hM hE hsym he hcomp y (X y) i j)
    X hX G hG a x

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.AmbientCovectorComponents

## Calderon.SpectralWeightComparison

SHA256 `0421fe0c8734c8d3b0799116324894953e8d7fd29900fd23542444b88860d7d5`.

``````lean
import Calderon.SpectralWeightedGraph

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open scoped Topology ENNReal InnerProductSpace
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SpectralWeightComparison
open SphereHarmonic SphereHilbertDecomposition SpectralCoreRegularity SpectralWeightedGraph

def casimirWeight (k : ℕ) : ℝ := 1 + (k : ℝ) * ((k : ℝ) + 1)

lemma casimirWeight_pos (k : ℕ) : 0 < casimirWeight k := by
  unfold casimirWeight
  positivity

theorem abs_besselWeight_le_two_casimirWeight (s : ℝ) (hs : s ≤ 2) (k : ℕ) :
    |besselWeight s k| ≤ 2 * casimirWeight k := by
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (besselWeight_pos s k).le]
  have hr : besselWeight s k ≤ (1 + (k : ℝ)) ^ 2 := by
    simpa only [besselWeight,Real.rpow_two] using
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (le_add_of_nonneg_right (Nat.cast_nonneg k)) hs
  unfold casimirWeight
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (k : ℝ)]

lemma norm_spectralGraph_coordinate_le
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (w z : ℕ → ℝ) (C : ℝ) (hw : ∀ k, |w k| ≤ C * |z k|)
    (u b v : SphereL2) (hb : (u,b) ∈ spectralGraph hO hD w)
    (hv : (u,v) ∈ spectralGraph hO hD z) (k : ℕ) :
    ‖sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k b‖ ≤ C * ‖sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k v‖ := by
  rw [hb k,hv k]
  simp only [norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs]
  calc
    _ ≤ (C * |z k|) * ‖sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k u‖ :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hw k) (norm_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := by ring

theorem exists_spectralGraph_of_weight_le
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (w z : ℕ → ℝ) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hw : ∀ k, |w k| ≤ C * |z k|)
    (u v : SphereL2) (hv : (u,v) ∈ spectralGraph hO hD z) :
    ∃ b : SphereL2, (u,b) ∈ spectralGraph hO hD w := by
  have ht (k : ℕ) : ‖spectralCoordinateSequence hO hD w u k‖ ≤
      C * ‖sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k v‖ := by
    rw [spectralCoordinateSequence,hv k]
    simp only [norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs]
    calc
      _ ≤ (C * |z k|) * ‖sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k u‖ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hw k) (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hm : Memℓp (spectralCoordinateSequence hO hD w u) 2 :=
    (lp.memℓp (C • sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD v)).mono' (fun k => by
      simpa only [lp.coeFn_smul,Pi.smul_apply,norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_nonneg hC,sphereHarmonicCoordinate_apply] using ht k)
  exact (exists_spectralGraph_iff_summable hO hD w u).mpr
    ((memLp_spectralCoordinateSequence_iff hO hD w u).mp hm)

theorem norm_spectralGraph_output_le
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (w z : ℕ → ℝ) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hw : ∀ k, |w k| ≤ C * |z k|)
    (u b v : SphereL2) (hb : (u,b) ∈ spectralGraph hO hD w)
    (hv : (u,v) ∈ spectralGraph hO hD z) : ‖b‖ ≤ C * ‖v‖ := by
  have hp := lp.norm_mono (p := 2) (show (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0 by norm_num)
    (x := sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD b)
    (y := C • sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD v) (fun k => by
      simpa only [lp.coeFn_smul,Pi.smul_apply,norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,
        abs_of_nonneg hC,sphereHarmonicCoordinate_apply] using
        norm_spectralGraph_coordinate_le hO hD w z C hw u b v hb hv k)
  simpa only [norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg hC,
    LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map] using hp

theorem norm_spectralGraph_tail_le
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (w z : ℕ → ℝ) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hw : ∀ k, |w k| ≤ C * |z k|)
    (u b v : SphereL2) (hb : (u,b) ∈ spectralGraph hO hD w)
    (hv : (u,v) ∈ spectralGraph hO hD z) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖b - sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n b‖ ≤
      C * ‖v - sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n v‖ := by
  have hbt : (u - sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n u,
      b - sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n b) ∈ spectralGraph hO hD w := by
    intro k
    change sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (b - sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n b) =
      w k • sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (u - sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n u)
    have hs := spectralGraph_partialSum hO hD w (u,b) hb n
    rw [map_sub,map_sub,hb k,hs k,smul_sub]
  have hvt : (u - sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n u,
      v - sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n v) ∈ spectralGraph hO hD z := by
    intro k
    change sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (v - sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n v) =
      z k • sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (u - sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n u)
    have hs := spectralGraph_partialSum hO hD z (u,v) hv n
    rw [map_sub,map_sub,hv k,hs k,smul_sub]
  exact norm_spectralGraph_output_le hO hD w z C hC hw _ _ _ hbt hvt

theorem exists_sphereBesselGraph_of_casimirGraph
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (s : ℝ) (hs : s ≤ 2) (u v : SphereL2)
    (hv : (u,v) ∈ spectralGraph hO hD casimirWeight) :
    ∃ b : SphereL2, (u,b) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD s := by
  apply exists_spectralGraph_of_weight_le hO hD (besselWeight s) casimirWeight 2
    (by norm_num) ?_ u v hv
  intro k
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (casimirWeight_pos k).le]
  exact abs_besselWeight_le_two_casimirWeight s hs k

theorem norm_sphereBesselGraph_output_le_casimirGraph
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (s : ℝ) (hs : s ≤ 2) (u b v : SphereL2)
    (hb : (u,b) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD s)
    (hv : (u,v) ∈ spectralGraph hO hD casimirWeight) : ‖b‖ ≤ 2 * ‖v‖ := by
  apply norm_spectralGraph_output_le hO hD (besselWeight s) casimirWeight 2
    (by norm_num) ?_ u b v hb hv
  intro k
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (casimirWeight_pos k).le]
  exact abs_besselWeight_le_two_casimirWeight s hs k

theorem norm_sphereBesselGraph_tail_le_casimirGraph
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (s : ℝ) (hs : s ≤ 2) (u b v : SphereL2)
    (hb : (u,b) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD s)
    (hv : (u,v) ∈ spectralGraph hO hD casimirWeight) (n : ℕ) :
    ‖b - sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n b‖ ≤
      2 * ‖v - sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n v‖ := by
  apply norm_spectralGraph_tail_le hO hD (besselWeight s) casimirWeight 2
    (by norm_num) ?_ u b v hb hv n
  intro k
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (casimirWeight_pos k).le]
  exact abs_besselWeight_le_two_casimirWeight s hs k

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SpectralWeightComparison

import Calderon.SpectralWeightComparison
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FDeriv.Linear
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.ContDiff.Comp

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open scoped ContDiff Topology ENNReal
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.BoundedSpectralMultiplier
open SphereHarmonic SphereHilbertDecomposition SpectralCoreRegularity
  SpectralWeightedGraph SpectralWeightComparison

def boundedSpectralOutput (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (w : ℕ → ℝ) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hw : ∀ k, |w k| ≤ C) (u : SphereL2) : SphereL2 :=
  (exists_spectralGraph_of_weight_le hO hD w (fun _ => 1) C hC
    (by simpa only [abs_one,mul_one] using hw) u u
    (by intro k; exact (one_smul ℝ _).symm)).choose

lemma boundedSpectralOutput_mem (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (w : ℕ → ℝ) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hw : ∀ k, |w k| ≤ C) (u : SphereL2) :
    (u,boundedSpectralOutput hO hD w C hC hw u) ∈ spectralGraph hO hD w :=
  (exists_spectralGraph_of_weight_le hO hD w (fun _ => 1) C hC
    (by simpa only [abs_one,mul_one] using hw) u u
    (by intro k; exact (one_smul ℝ _).symm)).choose_spec

lemma boundedSpectralOutput_add (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (w : ℕ → ℝ) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hw : ∀ k, |w k| ≤ C) (u v : SphereL2) :
    boundedSpectralOutput hO hD w C hC hw (u+v) =
      boundedSpectralOutput hO hD w C hC hw u + boundedSpectralOutput hO hD w C hC hw v := by
  apply spectralGraph_output_unique hO hD w (u+v)
  · exact boundedSpectralOutput_mem hO hD w C hC hw (u+v)
  · intro k
    change sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k
        (boundedSpectralOutput hO hD w C hC hw u + boundedSpectralOutput hO hD w C hC hw v) =
      w k • sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (u+v)
    rw [map_add,map_add,boundedSpectralOutput_mem hO hD w C hC hw u k,
      boundedSpectralOutput_mem hO hD w C hC hw v k,smul_add]

lemma boundedSpectralOutput_smul (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (w : ℕ → ℝ) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hw : ∀ k, |w k| ≤ C) (c : ℝ) (u : SphereL2) :
    boundedSpectralOutput hO hD w C hC hw (c • u) =
      c • boundedSpectralOutput hO hD w C hC hw u := by
  apply spectralGraph_output_unique hO hD w (c • u)
  · exact boundedSpectralOutput_mem hO hD w C hC hw (c • u)
  · intro k
    change sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (c • boundedSpectralOutput hO hD w C hC hw u) =
      w k • sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (c • u)
    rw [map_smul,map_smul,boundedSpectralOutput_mem hO hD w C hC hw u k,smul_comm]

lemma norm_boundedSpectralOutput_le (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hw : ∀ k, |w k| ≤ C) (u : SphereL2) :
    ‖boundedSpectralOutput hO hD w C hC hw u‖ ≤ C * ‖u‖ :=
  norm_spectralGraph_output_le hO hD w (fun _ => 1) C hC
    (by simpa only [abs_one,mul_one] using hw) u _ u
    (boundedSpectralOutput_mem hO hD w C hC hw u)
    (by intro k; exact (one_smul ℝ _).symm)

def boundedSpectralMultiplier (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (w : ℕ → ℝ) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hw : ∀ k, |w k| ≤ C) : SphereL2 →L[ℝ] SphereL2 :=
  LinearMap.mkContinuous
    ({ toFun := boundedSpectralOutput hO hD w C hC hw
       map_add' := boundedSpectralOutput_add hO hD w C hC hw
       map_smul' := boundedSpectralOutput_smul hO hD w C hC hw } : SphereL2 →ₗ[ℝ] SphereL2)
    C (norm_boundedSpectralOutput_le hO hD w C hC hw)

lemma boundedSpectralMultiplier_mem (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hw : ∀ k, |w k| ≤ C) (u : SphereL2) :
    (u,boundedSpectralMultiplier hO hD w C hC hw u) ∈ spectralGraph hO hD w :=
  boundedSpectralOutput_mem hO hD w C hC hw u

lemma norm_boundedSpectralMultiplier_le (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hw : ∀ k, |w k| ≤ C) : ‖boundedSpectralMultiplier hO hD w C hC hw‖ ≤ C :=
  (boundedSpectralMultiplier hO hD w C hC hw).opNorm_le_bound hC
    (norm_boundedSpectralOutput_le hO hD w C hC hw)

def casimirBesselRatio (s : ℝ) (k : ℕ) : ℝ := besselWeight s k / casimirWeight k

lemma abs_casimirBesselRatio_le_two (s : ℝ) (hs : s ≤ 2) (k : ℕ) :
    |casimirBesselRatio s k| ≤ 2 := by
  rw [casimirBesselRatio,abs_div,abs_of_nonneg (casimirWeight_pos k).le]
  exact (div_le_iff₀ (casimirWeight_pos k)).mpr
    (abs_besselWeight_le_two_casimirWeight s hs k)

def casimirBesselMultiplier (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (s : ℝ) (hs : s ≤ 2) : SphereL2 →L[ℝ] SphereL2 :=
  boundedSpectralMultiplier hO hD (casimirBesselRatio s) 2 (by norm_num)
    (abs_casimirBesselRatio_le_two s hs)

theorem casimirBesselMultiplier_graph (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (s : ℝ) (hs : s ≤ 2) (u v : SphereL2)
    (hv : (u,v) ∈ spectralGraph hO hD casimirWeight) :
    (u,casimirBesselMultiplier hO hD s hs v) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD s := by
  have hb := boundedSpectralMultiplier_mem hO hD (casimirBesselRatio s) 2
    (by norm_num) (abs_casimirBesselRatio_le_two s hs) v
  intro k
  change sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k
      (boundedSpectralMultiplier hO hD (casimirBesselRatio s) 2 (by norm_num)
        (abs_casimirBesselRatio_le_two s hs) v) =
    besselWeight s k • sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k u
  rw [hb k,hv k,smul_smul]
  change (besselWeight s k / casimirWeight k * casimirWeight k) •
    sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k u = _
  rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ (casimirWeight_pos k).ne']

lemma norm_casimirBesselMultiplier_apply_le (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (s : ℝ) (hs : s ≤ 2) (v : SphereL2) :
    ‖casimirBesselMultiplier hO hD s hs v‖ ≤ 2 * ‖v‖ :=
  norm_boundedSpectralOutput_le hO hD (casimirBesselRatio s) 2 (by norm_num)
    (abs_casimirBesselRatio_le_two s hs) v

lemma contDiff_casimirBesselMultiplier (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (s : ℝ) (hs : s ≤ 2) (V : R3 → SphereL2)
    (hV : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => casimirBesselMultiplier hO hD s hs (V x)) :=
  (casimirBesselMultiplier hO hD s hs).contDiff.comp hV

lemma fderiv_casimirBesselMultiplier (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (s : ℝ) (hs : s ≤ 2) (V : R3 → SphereL2) (x : R3)
    (hV : DifferentiableAt ℝ V x) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun y => casimirBesselMultiplier hO hD s hs (V y)) x =
      (casimirBesselMultiplier hO hD s hs).comp (fderiv ℝ V x) :=
  ((casimirBesselMultiplier hO hD s hs).hasFDerivAt.comp x hV.hasFDerivAt).fderiv

lemma hasCompactSupport_casimirBesselMultiplier (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (s : ℝ) (hs : s ≤ 2) (V : R3 → SphereL2)
    (hV : HasCompactSupport V) :
    HasCompactSupport (fun x => casimirBesselMultiplier hO hD s hs (V x)) :=
  hV.comp_left (map_zero (casimirBesselMultiplier hO hD s hs))

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.BoundedSpectralMultiplier
````````
