````````
``````lean
import Calderon.SmoothAngularCasimir
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Isomorphisms
import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Module.FiniteDimension

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory MvPolynomial
open scoped ContDiff Topology ENNReal InnerProductSpace
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SmoothSphereRotationProjection
open SphereHarmonic SmoothSphereRotation SmoothAngularCasimir RotationCasimir
open SphereHilbertDecomposition SpectralCoreRegularity AngularPolynomial GreenRadialTrace

/-- Actual true rotation of a polynomial restriction, with its actual probability L2 lift. -/
lemma smoothSphereLift_rotation_polynomial (i j : Fin 3) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    smoothSphereLift (sphereRotationDerivative i j (polynomialEvaluation p))
      (contDiff_sphereRotationDerivative i j _ (contDiff_polynomialEvaluation p)) =
        polynomialSphereL2 (polynomialRotation i j p) := by
  change (ContinuousMap.toLp 2 sphereProbability ℝ) _ =
    (ContinuousMap.toLp 2 sphereProbability ℝ) _
  congr 1
  ext u
  exact congrFun (sphereRotationDerivative_polynomialEvaluation i j p) u.val

/-- Derived from true smooth probability skewness; no Fischer-inner interface is used. -/
lemma polynomialSphereL2_rotation_skew (i j : Fin 3) (p q : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    ⟪polynomialSphereL2 (polynomialRotation i j p),polynomialSphereL2 q⟫_ℝ =
      -⟪polynomialSphereL2 p,polynomialSphereL2 (polynomialRotation i j q)⟫_ℝ := by
  have h := inner_sphereRotationDerivative_skew i j (polynomialEvaluation p)
    (polynomialEvaluation q) (contDiff_polynomialEvaluation p) (contDiff_polynomialEvaluation q)
  rw [smoothSphereLift_rotation_polynomial i j p,smoothSphereLift_polynomialEvaluation q,
    smoothSphereLift_polynomialEvaluation p,smoothSphereLift_rotation_polynomial i j q] at h
  exact h

/-- Kernel stability is an actual norm consequence of smooth skewness, not AE-to-pointwise. -/
lemma polynomialSphereL2_rotation_eq_zero_of_eq_zero (i j : Fin 3)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hp : polynomialSphereL2 p = 0) :
    polynomialSphereL2 (polynomialRotation i j p) = 0 := by
  have hn : ‖polynomialSphereL2 (polynomialRotation i j p)‖^2 = 0 := by
    rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq,polynomialSphereL2_rotation_skew i j p
      (polynomialRotation i j p),hp,inner_zero_left,neg_zero]
  exact norm_eq_zero.mp (sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hn)

def polynomialRotationLinear (i j : Fin 3) :
    MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ →ₗ[ℝ] MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ where
  toFun := polynomialRotation i j
  map_add' p q := by simp [polynomialRotation,map_add,mul_add,sub_add_sub_comm]
  map_smul' c p := by
    simp only [polynomialRotation,smul_eq_C_mul,pderiv_C_mul,RingHom.id_apply]
    ring

/-- The actual harmonic-polynomial image map, with no representative injectivity premise. -/
def harmonicPolynomialSphereMap (k : ℕ) :
    harmonicHomogeneous k →ₗ[ℝ] harmonicSphereSubspace k where
  toFun p := ⟨polynomialSphereL2 p,polynomialSphereL2_mem k p p.property⟩
  map_add' p q := by apply Subtype.ext; exact map_add polynomialSphereL2 (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (q : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
  map_smul' c p := by apply Subtype.ext; exact map_smul polynomialSphereL2 c (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)

lemma harmonicPolynomialSphereMap_surjective (k : ℕ) :
    Function.Surjective (harmonicPolynomialSphereMap k) := by
  intro v
  rcases Submodule.mem_map.mp v.property with ⟨p,hp,hpv⟩
  refine ⟨⟨p,hp⟩,?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact hpv

/-- Actual polynomial rotation remains in the same true harmonic image at every degree. -/
def rotatedHarmonicSphereMap (k : ℕ) (i j : Fin 3) :
    harmonicHomogeneous k →ₗ[ℝ] harmonicSphereSubspace k where
  toFun p := ⟨polynomialSphereL2 (polynomialRotation i j p),
    polynomialSphereL2_mem k _ (polynomialRotation_harmonic_all k i j p p.property)⟩
  map_add' p q := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change polynomialSphereL2 (polynomialRotationLinear i j ((p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)+q)) =
      polynomialSphereL2 (polynomialRotationLinear i j p) +
        polynomialSphereL2 (polynomialRotationLinear i j q)
    rw [map_add,map_add]
  map_smul' c p := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change polynomialSphereL2 (polynomialRotationLinear i j (c • (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ))) =
      c • polynomialSphereL2 (polynomialRotationLinear i j p)
    rw [map_smul,map_smul]

lemma harmonicPolynomialSphereMap_ker_le_rotated (k : ℕ) (i j : Fin 3) :
    LinearMap.ker (harmonicPolynomialSphereMap k) ≤
      LinearMap.ker (rotatedHarmonicSphereMap k i j) := by
  intro p hp
  apply LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hz := congrArg Subtype.val (LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hp)
  change polynomialSphereL2 (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) = 0 at hz
  exact polynomialSphereL2_rotation_eq_zero_of_eq_zero i j p hz

/-- Genuine quotient descent through the actual surjective image map. -/
def harmonicSphereRotationLinear (k : ℕ) (i j : Fin 3) :
    harmonicSphereSubspace k →ₗ[ℝ] harmonicSphereSubspace k :=
  (harmonicPolynomialSphereMap k).liftOfSurjective (harmonicPolynomialSphereMap_surjective k)
    ⟨rotatedHarmonicSphereMap k i j,harmonicPolynomialSphereMap_ker_le_rotated k i j⟩

lemma harmonicSphereRotationLinear_apply_image (k : ℕ) (i j : Fin 3)
    (p : harmonicHomogeneous k) :
    harmonicSphereRotationLinear k i j (harmonicPolynomialSphereMap k p) =
      rotatedHarmonicSphereMap k i j p := by
  unfold harmonicSphereRotationLinear
  exact LinearMap.equivOfSurjective_apply (harmonicPolynomialSphereMap_surjective k)
    (harmonicPolynomialSphereMap_ker_le_rotated k i j)

/-- Actual finite-dimensional continuity, without any supplied norm/domain bound. -/
def harmonicSphereRotation (k : ℕ) (i j : Fin 3) :
    harmonicSphereSubspace k →L[ℝ] harmonicSphereSubspace k := by
  letI := finiteDimensional_harmonicSphereSubspace k
  exact LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (harmonicSphereRotationLinear k i j)

lemma harmonicSphereRotation_apply_image (k : ℕ) (i j : Fin 3)
    (p : harmonicHomogeneous k) :
    harmonicSphereRotation k i j (harmonicPolynomialSphereMap k p) =
      rotatedHarmonicSphereMap k i j p :=
  harmonicSphereRotationLinear_apply_image k i j p

lemma inner_harmonicSphereRotation_skew (k : ℕ) (i j : Fin 3)
    (u v : harmonicSphereSubspace k) :
    ⟪harmonicSphereRotation k i j u,v⟫_ℝ = -⟪u,harmonicSphereRotation k i j v⟫_ℝ := by
  rcases harmonicPolynomialSphereMap_surjective k u with ⟨p,rfl⟩
  rcases harmonicPolynomialSphereMap_surjective k v with ⟨q,rfl⟩
  rw [harmonicSphereRotation_apply_image,harmonicSphereRotation_apply_image]
  change ⟪polynomialSphereL2 (polynomialRotation i j p),polynomialSphereL2 q⟫_ℝ =
    -⟪polynomialSphereL2 p,polynomialSphereL2 (polynomialRotation i j q)⟫_ℝ
  exact polynomialSphereL2_rotation_skew i j p q

/-- True projection commutation for actual ambient smooth fields, derived rather than assumed. -/
theorem sphereHarmonicCoordinate_sphereRotationDerivative (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (k : ℕ) (i j : Fin 3) (F : R3 → ℝ) (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F) :
    sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k
      (smoothSphereLift (sphereRotationDerivative i j F) (contDiff_sphereRotationDerivative i j F hF)) =
        harmonicSphereRotation k i j (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (smoothSphereLift F hF)) := by
  apply ext_inner_right ℝ
  intro v
  rcases harmonicPolynomialSphereMap_surjective k v with ⟨p,rfl⟩
  rw [sphereHarmonicCoordinate_inner hO hD k _ (harmonicPolynomialSphereMap k p),
    inner_harmonicSphereRotation_skew,
    sphereHarmonicCoordinate_inner hO hD k _
      (harmonicSphereRotation k i j (harmonicPolynomialSphereMap k p)),
    harmonicSphereRotation_apply_image]
  change ⟪smoothSphereLift (sphereRotationDerivative i j F)
      (contDiff_sphereRotationDerivative i j F hF),polynomialSphereL2 p⟫_ℝ =
    -⟪smoothSphereLift F hF,polynomialSphereL2 (polynomialRotation i j p)⟫_ℝ
  have h := inner_sphereRotationDerivative_skew i j F (polynomialEvaluation p)
    hF (contDiff_polynomialEvaluation p)
  rw [smoothSphereLift_polynomialEvaluation p,smoothSphereLift_rotation_polynomial i j p] at h
  exact h

lemma harmonicSphereRotation_self (k : ℕ) (i : Fin 3) : harmonicSphereRotation k i i = 0 := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro v
  rcases harmonicPolynomialSphereMap_surjective k v with ⟨p,rfl⟩
  rw [harmonicSphereRotation_apply_image]
  apply Subtype.ext
  change polynomialSphereL2 (polynomialRotation i i p) = 0
  simp [polynomialRotation]

lemma harmonicSphereRotation_degree_zero (i j : Fin 3) : harmonicSphereRotation 0 i j = 0 := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro v
  rcases harmonicPolynomialSphereMap_surjective 0 v with ⟨p,rfl⟩
  rw [harmonicSphereRotation_apply_image]
  apply Subtype.ext
  change polynomialSphereL2 (polynomialRotation i j p) = 0
  rw [SphereDerivativeAdjoint.eq_C_of_harmonicHomogeneous_zero p p.property]
  simp [polynomialRotation]

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SmoothSphereRotationProjection

import Calderon.SmoothSphereRotationProjection

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MvPolynomial
open scoped InnerProductSpace
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SmoothSphereRotationBounds
open SphereHarmonic AngularPolynomial RotationCasimir SmoothSphereRotationProjection

/-- Genuine probability rotation energy, using actual smooth skewness and no Fischer premise. -/
theorem sum_polynomialSphereL2_rotation_norm_sq (k : ℕ) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hp : p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) :
    (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ‖polynomialSphereL2 (polynomialRotation i j p)‖^2) =
      (2*(k:ℝ)*((k:ℝ)+1))*‖polynomialSphereL2 p‖^2 := by
  have hterm (i j : Fin 3) :
      ‖polynomialSphereL2 (polynomialRotation i j p)‖^2 =
        -⟪polynomialSphereL2 p,
          polynomialSphereL2 (polynomialRotation i j (polynomialRotation i j p))⟫_ℝ := by
    rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
    exact polynomialSphereL2_rotation_skew i j p (polynomialRotation i j p)
  simp_rw [hterm]
  simp_rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  simp_rw [← inner_sum,← map_sum]
  have hrot := sum_double_rotation_eq p
  rw [hrot,polynomialEuler_homogeneous k p hp.1,polynomialEuler_C_mul,
    polynomialEuler_homogeneous k p hp.1,hp.2]
  have he : 2 * ((radiusSq : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) * 0 -
      C (k:ℝ) * (C (k:ℝ)*p) - C (k:ℝ)*p) =
      C (-(2*(k:ℝ)*((k:ℝ)+1))) * p := by
    simp only [map_neg,map_mul,map_add,map_ofNat,map_one]
    ring
  rw [he,← smul_eq_C_mul,map_smul,real_inner_smul_right,real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  ring

theorem sum_harmonicSphereRotation_norm_sq (k : ℕ) (v : harmonicSphereSubspace k) :
    (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ‖harmonicSphereRotation k i j v‖^2) =
      (2*(k:ℝ)*((k:ℝ)+1))*‖v‖^2 := by
  rcases harmonicPolynomialSphereMap_surjective k v with ⟨p,rfl⟩

  change (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      ‖polynomialSphereL2 (polynomialRotation i j p)‖^2) =
    (2*(k:ℝ)*((k:ℝ)+1))*‖polynomialSphereL2 p‖^2
  exact sum_polynomialSphereL2_rotation_norm_sq k p p.property

lemma norm_harmonicSphereRotation_sq_le (k : ℕ) (i j : Fin 3)
    (v : harmonicSphereSubspace k) :
    ‖harmonicSphereRotation k i j v‖^2 ≤ (2*(k:ℝ)*((k:ℝ)+1))*‖v‖^2 := by
  rw [← sum_harmonicSphereRotation_norm_sq]
  exact (Finset.single_le_sum (fun a _ => sq_nonneg ‖harmonicSphereRotation k i a v‖)
    (Finset.mem_univ j)).trans
    (Finset.single_le_sum (fun a _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun b _ =>
      sq_nonneg ‖harmonicSphereRotation k a b v‖) (Finset.mem_univ i))

/-- Universal constant before every degree, pair, truncation, type and radius. -/
theorem norm_harmonicSphereRotation_le (k : ℕ) (i j : Fin 3)
    (v : harmonicSphereSubspace k) :
    ‖harmonicSphereRotation k i j v‖ ≤ Real.sqrt 2 * (1+(k:ℝ)) * ‖v‖ := by
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)).mp
  have hb := norm_harmonicSphereRotation_sq_le k i j v
  have hs : (Real.sqrt 2)^2 = 2 := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
  rw [mul_pow,mul_pow,hs]
  have hk : (k:ℝ)*((k:ℝ)+1) ≤ (1+(k:ℝ))^2 := by
    nlinarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) k]
  have he : 2*(k:ℝ)*((k:ℝ)+1) ≤ 2*(1+(k:ℝ))^2 := by nlinarith [hk]
  exact hb.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right he (sq_nonneg ‖v‖))

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SmoothSphereRotationBounds

``````

``````lean
import Calderon.SmoothAngularApplication
import Calderon.DilatedProfileBeta

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Filter Set
open scoped ContDiff Topology ENNReal
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.ReferenceWeightedApproximation
open SphereHarmonic SphereHilbertDecomposition SpectralCoreRegularity
  ConformalDepth RadiusProfile WeightedBaseSpectral
  WeightedAngularConvergence SmoothAngularApplication

def actualReferenceBeta (g : MatrixField) (L lam d R : ℝ) (p : ℕ) : R3 → ℝ :=
  metricDifferentialNorm (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L)
    (fun x => Real.log (referenceRadius d R p L x))

lemma actualReferenceBeta_eq (g : MatrixField) (L lam d R : ℝ) (p : ℕ)
    (hd : 0 < d) (hR : 0 < R) (x : R3) :
    actualReferenceBeta g L lam d R p x =
      ((p : ℝ) * logSlope d (referenceDepth L x)) *
        metricDifferentialNorm (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) (referenceDepth L) x := by
  unfold actualReferenceBeta
  rw [log_referenceRadius d R p L hd hR]
  exact metricDifferentialNorm_logProfile _ d (Real.log R) p _ x hd
    ((contDiff_referenceDepth L).differentiable (by simp) x)

lemma continuous_actualReferenceBeta (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam d R : ℝ) (p : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) (hd : 0 < d) (hR : 0 < R) :
    Continuous (actualReferenceBeta g L lam d R p) := by
  have he : actualReferenceBeta g L lam d R p = fun x =>
      ((p : ℝ) * logSlope d (referenceDepth L x)) *
        metricDifferentialNorm (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) (referenceDepth L) x :=
    funext (actualReferenceBeta_eq g L lam d R p hd hR)
  have hs : Continuous (logSlope d) :=
    continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr (fun t => (hasDerivAt_logSlope d t hd).continuousAt)
  have hinc : Continuous (fun x : R3 => (lam,x)) := continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id
  have hb := (contDiff_dilatedReferenceDepth_metricNorm g hg L hL).continuous.comp hinc
  change Continuous (fun x : R3 =>
    metricDifferentialNorm (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) (referenceDepth L) x) at hb
  rw [he]
  exact (continuous_const.mul (hs.comp (contDiff_referenceDepth L).continuous)).mul hb

lemma actualReferenceBeta_pos (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam d R : ℝ) (p : ℕ) (hL : 0 < L) (hd : 0 < d) (hR : 0 < R)
    (hp : 1 ≤ p) (x : R3) : 0 < actualReferenceBeta g L lam d R p x := by
  rw [actualReferenceBeta_eq g L lam d R p hd hR x]
  have hpR : 0 < (p : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (show 0 < p by omega)
  have hmetric : ∀ y, (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L y).PosDef :=
    fun y => EnergyBridge.conformalMatrix_posDef _ _ (dilatedMetric_posDef g hg lam) y
  exact mul_pos (mul_pos hpR (logSlope_pos d _ hd))
    (metricDifferentialNorm_pos _ hmetric _ x
      (fderiv_referenceDepth_ne_zero L (ne_of_gt hL) x))

lemma continuous_weightedAmbientBesselField
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam d R : ℝ) (p : ℕ)
    (hL : 0 < L) (hd : 0 < d) (hR : 0 < R) (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (s : ℝ) (hs : s ≤ 2)
    (t : ℝ) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :
    Continuous (fun x => actualReferenceBeta g L lam d R p x ^ t • ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG x) :=
  ((continuous_actualReferenceBeta g hg L lam d R p hL hd hR).rpow_const
    (fun x => Or.inl (actualReferenceBeta_pos g hg L lam d R p hL hd hR hp x).ne')).smul (contDiff_ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG).continuous

lemma hasCompactSupport_weightedAmbientBesselField
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam d R : ℝ) (p : ℕ)
    (hL : 0 < L) (hd : 0 < d) (hR : 0 < R) (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (s : ℝ) (hs : s ≤ 2)
    (t : ℝ) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ u : UnitSphere, G (x,u.val)=0) :
    HasCompactSupport (fun x => actualReferenceBeta g L lam d R p x ^ t • ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG x) :=
  (hasCompactSupport_ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG K hK hz).smul_left
    (f := fun x => actualReferenceBeta g L lam d R p x ^ t)

lemma memLp_weightedAmbientBesselField
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam d R : ℝ) (p : ℕ)
    (hL : 0 < L) (hd : 0 < d) (hR : 0 < R) (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (s : ℝ) (hs : s ≤ 2)
    (t : ℝ) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ u : UnitSphere, G (x,u.val)=0) :
    MemLp (fun x => actualReferenceBeta g L lam d R p x ^ t • ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG x)
      2 (referenceBaseMeasure g L lam) :=
  memLp_referenceBase g hg L lam _
    (continuous_weightedAmbientBesselField g hg L lam d R p hL hd hR hp hO hD s hs t G hG)
    (hasCompactSupport_weightedAmbientBesselField g hg L lam d R p hL hd hR hp hO hD s hs t G hG K hK hz)

theorem tendsto_referenceWeightedAmbientBesselField
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam d R : ℝ) (p : ℕ)
    (hL : 0 < L) (hd : 0 < d) (hR : 0 < R) (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (s : ℝ) (hs : s ≤ 2)
    (t : ℝ) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ u : UnitSphere, G (x,u.val)=0) :
    let b := actualReferenceBeta g L lam d R p
    let W := ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG
    let hW := contDiff_ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG
    let hc := hasCompactSupport_ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG K hK hz
    let V := W
    let hv := hW.continuous
    let hvc := hc
    let hb := (continuous_actualReferenceBeta g hg L lam d R p hL hd hR).rpow_const
      (fun x => Or.inl (actualReferenceBeta_pos g hg L lam d R p hL hd hR hp x).ne')
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => referenceBaseLift g hg L lam
      (fun x => b x ^ t • sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n (V x))
      (hb.smul ((sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n).continuous.comp hv))
      ((hasCompactSupport_sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n V hvc).smul_left
        (f := fun x => b x ^ t))) atTop
      (𝓝 (referenceBaseLift g hg L lam (fun x => b x ^ t • V x)
        (hb.smul hv) (hvc.smul_left (f := fun x => b x ^ t)))) :=
  tendsto_referenceBaseLift_base_rpow_smul g hg L lam hO hD
    (actualReferenceBeta g L lam d R p)
    (continuous_actualReferenceBeta g hg L lam d R p hL hd hR)
    (actualReferenceBeta_pos g hg L lam d R p hL hd hR hp) t _
    ((contDiff_ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG).continuous)
    ((hasCompactSupport_ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG K hK hz))

theorem tendsto_referenceWeightedPureDerivative
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam d R : ℝ) (p : ℕ)
    (hL : 0 < L) (hd : 0 < d) (hR : 0 < R) (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (s : ℝ) (hs : s ≤ 2)
    (t : ℝ) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ u : UnitSphere, G (x,u.val)=0) (X : R3) :
    let b := actualReferenceBeta g L lam d R p
    let W := ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG
    let hW := contDiff_ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG
    let hc := hasCompactSupport_ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG K hK hz
    let V := (fun x => fderiv ℝ W x X)
    let hv := continuous_pureDerivative W hW X
    let hvc := hasCompactSupport_pureDerivative W hc X
    let hb := (continuous_actualReferenceBeta g hg L lam d R p hL hd hR).rpow_const
      (fun x => Or.inl (actualReferenceBeta_pos g hg L lam d R p hL hd hR hp x).ne')
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => referenceBaseLift g hg L lam
      (fun x => b x ^ t • sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n (V x))

        (f := fun x => b x ^ t))) atTop
      (𝓝 (referenceBaseLift g hg L lam (fun x => b x ^ t • V x)
        (hb.smul hv) (hvc.smul_left (f := fun x => b x ^ t)))) :=
  tendsto_referenceBaseLift_base_rpow_smul g hg L lam hO hD
    (actualReferenceBeta g L lam d R p)
    (continuous_actualReferenceBeta g hg L lam d R p hL hd hR)
    (actualReferenceBeta_pos g hg L lam d R p hL hd hR hp) t _
    (continuous_pureDerivative (ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG) (contDiff_ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG) X)
    (hasCompactSupport_pureDerivative (ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG) (hasCompactSupport_ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG K hK hz) X)

theorem tendsto_referenceWeightedSecondPureDerivative
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam d R : ℝ) (p : ℕ)
    (hL : 0 < L) (hd : 0 < d) (hR : 0 < R) (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (s : ℝ) (hs : s ≤ 2)

## Calderon.WeightedBaseSpectral

SHA256 `9a7d1328f38674a5b80009fc05e909711cdc2f9e3427a7e48fc6b768d7bffb26`.

``````lean
import Calderon.PositiveSpectralCore
import Calderon.ReferenceDensityBounds
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.DominatedConvergence

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Filter
open scoped InnerProductSpace ContDiff Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.WeightedBaseSpectral
open SphereHarmonic SphereHilbertDecomposition SpectralCoreRegularity
  PositiveSpectralCore ReferenceDensityBounds

def referenceBaseMeasure (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ) : Measure R3 :=
  volume.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)))

lemma continuous_referenceBaseDensity (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) : Continuous (fun x : R3 => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)) :=
  (contDiff_referenceDensityFamily g hg L).continuous.comp
    (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)

lemma integral_referenceBaseMeasure (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) :
    (∫ x, f x ∂referenceBaseMeasure g L lam) =
      ∫ x, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * f x := by
  unfold referenceBaseMeasure
  rw [integral_withDensity_eq_integral_toReal_smul
    (continuous_referenceBaseDensity g hg L lam).measurable.ennreal_ofReal
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top))]
  apply integral_congr_ae
  apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
  intro x
  dsimp only
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (referenceDensityFamily_pos g hg L (lam,x)).le]
  rfl

lemma integrable_referenceBase_norm_sq (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (U : R3 → SphereL2) (hU : Continuous U)
    (hcomp : HasCompactSupport U) :
    Integrable (fun x => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * ‖U x‖ ^ 2) := by
  have hc : HasCompactSupport (fun x => ‖U x‖ ^ 2) :=
    hcomp.comp_left (g := fun u : SphereL2 => ‖u‖ ^ 2) (by simp)
  have hprod : HasCompactSupport (fun x => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * ‖U x‖ ^ 2) := hc.mul_left
  exact ((continuous_referenceBaseDensity g hg L lam).mul (hU.norm.pow 2)).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hprod

lemma memLp_referenceBase (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (U : R3 → SphereL2) (hU : Continuous U)
    (hcomp : HasCompactSupport U) : MemLp U 2 (referenceBaseMeasure g L lam) := by
  apply (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm hU.aestronglyMeasurable).mpr
  unfold referenceBaseMeasure
  apply (integrable_withDensity_iff_integrable_smul'
    (continuous_referenceBaseDensity g hg L lam).measurable.ennreal_ofReal
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun _ => ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top))).mpr
  have he : (fun x => (ENNReal.ofReal (referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x))).toReal • ‖U x‖^2) =
      (fun x => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * ‖U x‖^2) := by
    funext x
    rw [ENNReal.toReal_ofReal (referenceDensityFamily_pos g hg L (lam,x)).le]
    rfl
  rw [he]
  exact integrable_referenceBase_norm_sq g hg L lam U hU hcomp

def referenceBaseLift (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (U : R3 → SphereL2) (hU : Continuous U)
    (hcomp : HasCompactSupport U) : Lp SphereL2 2 (referenceBaseMeasure g L lam) :=
  (memLp_referenceBase g hg L lam U hU hcomp).toLp U

theorem inner_referenceBaseLift (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (U V : R3 → SphereL2) (hU : Continuous U) (hV : Continuous V)
    (hUc : HasCompactSupport U) (hVc : HasCompactSupport V) :
    ⟪referenceBaseLift g hg L lam U hU hUc,
      referenceBaseLift g hg L lam V hV hVc⟫_ℝ =
      ∫ x, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * ⟪U x,V x⟫_ℝ := by
  rw [L2.inner_def]
  have hfirst := (memLp_referenceBase g hg L lam U hU hUc).coeFn_toLp
  have hsecond := (memLp_referenceBase g hg L lam V hV hVc).coeFn_toLp
  have he : (∫ x, ⟪referenceBaseLift g hg L lam U hU hUc x,
      referenceBaseLift g hg L lam V hV hVc x⟫_ℝ ∂referenceBaseMeasure g L lam) =
      ∫ x, ⟪U x,V x⟫_ℝ ∂referenceBaseMeasure g L lam := by
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [hfirst,hsecond] with x hx hy
    exact congrArg₂ (fun u v : SphereL2 => ⟪u,v⟫_ℝ) hx hy
  exact he.trans (integral_referenceBaseMeasure g hg L lam _)

theorem norm_sq_referenceBaseLift (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (U : R3 → SphereL2) (hU : Continuous U)
    (hcomp : HasCompactSupport U) :
    ‖referenceBaseLift g hg L lam U hU hcomp‖ ^ 2 =
      ∫ x, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * ‖U x‖ ^ 2 := by
  rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, inner_referenceBaseLift]
  simp only [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]

lemma norm_sum_sphereHarmonicCoordinates_le (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (s : Finset ℕ) (u : SphereL2) :
    ‖∑ k ∈ s, (sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD u k : SphereL2)‖ ≤ ‖u‖ := by
  have hs : HasSum (fun k : ℕ => ‖sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD u k‖ ^ 2)
      (‖u‖ ^ 2) := by
    simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_ofNat, Real.rpow_two, LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map] using
      lp.hasSum_norm (show 0 < (2 : ENNReal).toReal by norm_num)
        (sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD u)
  have hsum := (orthogonalFamily_harmonicSphereSubspaces hO).norm_sum
    (sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD u) s
  have he : ‖∑ k ∈ s, (sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD u k : SphereL2)‖ ^ 2 =
      ∑ k ∈ s, ‖sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD u k‖ ^ 2 := by
    simpa only [Submodule.coe_subtypeₗᵢ, Submodule.coe_subtype] using hsum
  apply (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp
  rw [he]
  exact sum_le_hasSum s (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _) hs

lemma norm_spherePositivePartialSum_le (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (n : ℕ) (u : SphereL2) :
    ‖spherePositivePartialSum hO hD n u‖ ≤ ‖u‖ := by
  classical
  rw [spherePositivePartialSum_apply]
  have he : (∑ k ∈ (Finset.range n).image (fun k : ℕ => k+1),
      (sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD u k : SphereL2)) =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD u (k+1) : SphereL2) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_image]
    intro a ha b hb hab
    exact Nat.add_right_cancel hab
  rw [← he]
  exact norm_sum_sphereHarmonicCoordinates_le hO hD _ u

lemma norm_spherePositiveProjection_le (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (u : SphereL2) :
    ‖spherePositiveProjection hO hD u‖ ≤ ‖u‖ :=
  le_of_tendsto' (tendsto_spherePositivePartialSum hO hD u).norm
    (fun n => norm_spherePositivePartialSum_le hO hD n u)

theorem tendsto_integral_spherePositivePartialSum_sub_sq
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (U : R3 → SphereL2) (hU : Continuous U) (hcomp : HasCompactSupport U) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ∫ x, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      ‖spherePositivePartialSum hO hD n (U x) - spherePositiveProjection hO hD (U x)‖ ^ 2)
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  have hc (n : ℕ) : Continuous (fun x => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      ‖spherePositivePartialSum hO hD n (U x) - spherePositiveProjection hO hD (U x)‖ ^ 2) :=
    (continuous_referenceBaseDensity g hg L lam).mul
      ((((spherePositivePartialSum hO hD n).continuous.comp hU).sub
        ((spherePositiveProjection hO hD).continuous.comp hU)).norm.pow 2)
  have hb : Integrable (fun x => 4 *
      (referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * ‖U x‖ ^ 2)) :=
    (integrable_referenceBase_norm_sq g hg L lam U hU hcomp).const_mul 4
  have hbound (n : ℕ) : ∀ᵐ x, ‖referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      ‖spherePositivePartialSum hO hD n (U x) - spherePositiveProjection hO hD (U x)‖ ^ 2‖ ≤
      4 * (referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * ‖U x‖ ^ 2) := by
    apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
    intro x
    have hr := le_of_lt (referenceDensityFamily_pos g hg L (lam,x))
    have hn : ‖spherePositivePartialSum hO hD n (U x) - spherePositiveProjection hO hD (U x)‖ ≤
        2 * ‖U x‖ := by
      calc
        _ ≤ ‖spherePositivePartialSum hO hD n (U x)‖ +
            ‖spherePositiveProjection hO hD (U x)‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
        _ ≤ ‖U x‖ + ‖U x‖ := add_le_add
          (norm_spherePositivePartialSum_le hO hD n _) (norm_spherePositiveProjection_le hO hD _)
        _ = _ := by ring
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hr (sq_nonneg _))]
    have hs := (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)).mpr hn
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs hr]
  have hlim : ∀ᵐ x, Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      ‖spherePositivePartialSum hO hD n (U x) - spherePositiveProjection hO hD (U x)‖ ^ 2)
      atTop (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) := by
    apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
    intro x
    simpa using (((tendsto_spherePositivePartialSum hO hD (U x)).sub_const
      (spherePositiveProjection hO hD (U x))).norm.pow 2).const_mul
        (referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x))
  simpa using tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence
    (fun x => 4 * (referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * ‖U x‖ ^ 2))
    (fun n => (hc n).aestronglyMeasurable) hb hbound hlim

lemma referenceBaseLift_sub (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (U V : R3 → SphereL2) (hU : Continuous U) (hV : Continuous V)
    (hUc : HasCompactSupport U) (hVc : HasCompactSupport V) :
    referenceBaseLift g hg L lam (fun x => U x - V x) (hU.sub hV) (hUc.sub hVc) =
      referenceBaseLift g hg L lam U hU hUc - referenceBaseLift g hg L lam V hV hVc := by
  exact MemLp.toLp_sub (memLp_referenceBase g hg L lam U hU hUc)
    (memLp_referenceBase g hg L lam V hV hVc)

theorem tendsto_referenceBaseLift_spherePositivePartialSum
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (U : R3 → SphereL2) (hU : Continuous U) (hcomp : HasCompactSupport U) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => referenceBaseLift g hg L lam
      (fun x => spherePositivePartialSum hO hD n (U x))
      ((spherePositivePartialSum hO hD n).continuous.comp hU)
      (hcomp.comp_left (map_zero _))) atTop
      (𝓝 (referenceBaseLift g hg L lam (fun x => spherePositiveProjection hO hD (U x))
        ((spherePositiveProjection hO hD).continuous.comp hU)
        (hcomp.comp_left (map_zero _)))) := by
  let S (n : ℕ) := referenceBaseLift g hg L lam
    (fun x => spherePositivePartialSum hO hD n (U x))
    ((spherePositivePartialSum hO hD n).continuous.comp hU)
    (hcomp.comp_left (map_zero _))
  let V := referenceBaseLift g hg L lam (fun x => spherePositiveProjection hO hD (U x))
    ((spherePositiveProjection hO hD).continuous.comp hU)
    (hcomp.comp_left (map_zero _))
  have he (n : ℕ) : ‖S n - V‖ ^ 2 = ∫ x, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      ‖spherePositivePartialSum hO hD n (U x) - spherePositiveProjection hO hD (U x)‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [← referenceBaseLift_sub]
    exact norm_sq_referenceBaseLift g hg L lam _ _ _
  have hs : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ‖S n - V‖ ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) := by
    simp_rw [he]
    exact tendsto_integral_spherePositivePartialSum_sub_sq g hg L lam hO hD U hU hcomp
  have hn : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ‖S n - V‖) atTop (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) := by
    have h := Real.continuous_sqrt.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hs
    change Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => Real.sqrt (‖S n - V‖ ^ 2)) atTop (𝓝 (Real.sqrt 0)) at h
    simpa only [Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_zero] using h
  apply (tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero).mpr
  simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using hn

theorem tendsto_referenceBaseLift_spherePositivePartialSum_of_meanZero
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (U : R3 → SphereL2) (hU : Continuous U) (hcomp : HasCompactSupport U)
    (hmean : ∀ x, sphereMean (U x) = 0) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => referenceBaseLift g hg L lam
      (fun x => spherePositivePartialSum hO hD n (U x))
      ((spherePositivePartialSum hO hD n).continuous.comp hU)
      (hcomp.comp_left (map_zero _))) atTop
      (𝓝 (referenceBaseLift g hg L lam U hU hcomp)) := by
  have he : (fun x => spherePositiveProjection hO hD (U x)) = U :=
    funext (fun x => spherePositiveProjection_eq_self hO hD (U x) (hmean x))
  simpa only [he] using tendsto_referenceBaseLift_spherePositivePartialSum
    g hg L lam hO hD U hU hcomp

lemma continuous_pureDerivative (U : R3 → SphereL2) (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U) (X : R3) :
    Continuous (fun x => fderiv ℝ U x X) :=
  ((hU.fderiv_right (m := ∞) (by simp)).clm_apply contDiff_const).continuous

lemma hasCompactSupport_pureDerivative (U : R3 → SphereL2)
    (hcomp : HasCompactSupport U) (X : R3) :
    HasCompactSupport (fun x => fderiv ℝ U x X) := hcomp.fderiv_apply ℝ X

theorem tendsto_referenceBaseLift_pureDerivative_spectral
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (U : R3 → SphereL2) (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U) (hcomp : HasCompactSupport U)
    (hmean : ∀ x, sphereMean (U x) = 0) (X : R3) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => referenceBaseLift g hg L lam
      (fun x => spherePositivePartialSum hO hD n (fderiv ℝ U x X))
      ((spherePositivePartialSum hO hD n).continuous.comp (continuous_pureDerivative U hU X))
      ((hasCompactSupport_pureDerivative U hcomp X).comp_left (map_zero _))) atTop
      (𝓝 (referenceBaseLift g hg L lam (fun x => fderiv ℝ U x X)
        (continuous_pureDerivative U hU X) (hasCompactSupport_pureDerivative U hcomp X))) := by
  apply tendsto_referenceBaseLift_spherePositivePartialSum_of_meanZero
  intro x
  exact sphereMean_fderiv_eq_zero U x X (hU.differentiable (by simp) x) hmean

lemma pureDerivative_positivePartialSum_eq (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (U : R3 → SphereL2) (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U)
    (n : ℕ) (x X : R3) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun y => spherePositivePartialSum hO hD n (U y)) x X =
      spherePositivePartialSum hO hD n (fderiv ℝ U x X) := by
  rw [fderiv_spherePositivePartialSum hO hD n U x (hU.differentiable (by simp) x)]
  rfl

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.WeightedBaseSpectral

## Calderon.ConstantPrincipalRaising

SHA256 `5ed96612f1f824bc4ae2ebbcf6dc49f30bb494cbf133a1ce3079c39d7abc8d56`.

``````lean
import Calderon.SphereDerivativeAdjoint
import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Module.FiniteDimension
import Mathlib.Analysis.Matrix.Normed
import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Operator.Basic

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MvPolynomial
open scoped Matrix Matrix.Norms.Elementwise InnerProductSpace
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.ConstantPrincipalRaising
open SphereHarmonic AngularPolynomial HarmonicCoordinateCompatibility SphereDerivativeAdjoint

def constantDoubleRaising (i j : Fin 3) : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  sphereDerivativeAdjoint 1 i (sphereDerivativeAdjoint 0 j (C 1))

theorem constantDoubleRaising_eq (i j : Fin 3) :
    constantDoubleRaising i j = C 15 * (X i * X j) -
      C (if i = j then 5 else 0) * radiusSq := by
  rw [constantDoubleRaising,sphereDerivativeAdjoint_constant_one]
  by_cases hij : i = j
  · subst j
    norm_num [sphereDerivativeAdjoint,coordinateHarmonicRaising,pderiv_X,
      C_eq_coe_nat,C_eq_smul_one,smul_mul_assoc,mul_smul_comm] <;> module
  · norm_num [sphereDerivativeAdjoint,coordinateHarmonicRaising,pderiv_X,hij,
      C_eq_coe_nat,C_eq_smul_one,smul_mul_assoc,mul_smul_comm] <;> module

lemma constantDoubleRaising_symm (i j : Fin 3) :
    constantDoubleRaising i j = constantDoubleRaising j i := by
  rw [constantDoubleRaising_eq,constantDoubleRaising_eq]
  simp only [eq_comm (a := j) (b := i)]
  ring

lemma constantDoubleRaising_harmonicHomogeneous (i j : Fin 3) :
    constantDoubleRaising i j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous 2 :=
  sphereDerivativeAdjoint_harmonicHomogeneous 1 i _
    (sphereDerivativeAdjoint_harmonicHomogeneous 0 j _ (C_harmonicHomogeneous 1))

def constantAngularPolynomial (Q : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, C (Q i j) * constantDoubleRaising i j

lemma constantAngularPolynomial_harmonicHomogeneous (Q : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    constantAngularPolynomial Q ∈ harmonicHomogeneous 2 := by
  apply (harmonicHomogeneous 2).sum_mem
  intro i hi
  apply (harmonicHomogeneous 2).sum_mem
  intro j hj
  simpa only [smul_eq_C_mul] using
    (harmonicHomogeneous 2).smul_mem (Q i j) (constantDoubleRaising_harmonicHomogeneous i j)

lemma constantAngularPolynomial_one (hF : SphereFischerInner) :
    constantAngularPolynomial (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) = 0 := by
  have he (i : Fin 3) : (∑ j : Fin 3,
      C ((1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) i j) * constantDoubleRaising i j) =
      constantDoubleRaising i i := by
    simp [Matrix.one_apply]
  unfold constantAngularPolynomial
  simp_rw [he]
  exact sum_double_sphereDerivativeAdjoint_eq_zero hF 0 (C 1) (C_harmonicHomogeneous 1)

def constantAngularMap : (Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] SphereL2 :=
  ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj j : (Fin 3 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.proj i : (Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℝ))).smulRight
      (polynomialSphereL2 (constantDoubleRaising i j))

lemma constantAngularMap_apply (Q : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    constantAngularMap Q = polynomialSphereL2 (constantAngularPolynomial Q) := by
  simp only [constantAngularMap,constantAngularPolynomial,_root_.sum_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply,ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply,map_sum,← smul_eq_C_mul,map_smul]
  change (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
    (((ContinuousLinearMap.proj j : (Fin 3 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.proj i : (Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (Fin 3 → ℝ))).smulRight
      (polynomialSphereL2 (constantDoubleRaising i j))) (fun i j => Q i j)) = _
  simp only [_root_.sum_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply]

lemma constantAngularMap_one (hF : SphereFischerInner) :
    constantAngularMap (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) = 0 := by
  rw [constantAngularMap_apply,constantAngularPolynomial_one hF,map_zero]

lemma constantAngularMap_sub_one (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (Q : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) : constantAngularMap (Q-(1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)) = constantAngularMap Q := by
  change constantAngularMap ((fun i j => Q i j) -
    (fun i j => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) i j)) = constantAngularMap (fun i j => Q i j)
  rw [map_sub]
  have hz : constantAngularMap (fun i j => (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) i j) = 0 :=
    constantAngularMap_one hF
  rw [hz,sub_zero]

theorem exists_uniform_constantAngular_bound :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (hF : SphereFischerInner) (Q : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ),
      ‖polynomialSphereL2 (constantAngularPolynomial Q)‖ ≤ C * ‖Q-1‖ := by
  let C : ℝ := 1 + ‖constantAngularMap‖
  refine ⟨C,by dsimp [C]; positivity,?_⟩
  intro hF Q
  rw [← constantAngularMap_apply,← constantAngularMap_sub_one hF Q]
  exact (constantAngularMap.le_opNorm (Q-(1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ))).trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by dsimp [C]; linarith) (norm_nonneg _))

theorem exists_uniform_inverse_radius_constantAngular_bound :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (hF : SphereFischerInner) (Q : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
      (r eps : ℝ), 0 < r → 0 ≤ eps → ‖Q-1‖ ≤ eps*r →
      ‖r⁻¹ • polynomialSphereL2 (constantAngularPolynomial Q)‖ ≤ C*eps := by
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hbound⟩ := exists_uniform_constantAngular_bound
  refine ⟨C,hC,?_⟩
  intro hF Q r eps hr heps hsmall
  rw [norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hr)]
  calc
    _ ≤ r⁻¹ * (C*(eps*r)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      ((hbound hF Q).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsmall hC.le)) (inv_nonneg.mpr hr.le)
    _ = C*eps := by field_simp

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.ConstantPrincipalRaising

``````

## Calderon.CutoffRadiusSeparation

SHA256 `0341e329ef096bf80b9802f3edd3955ec9299e56676f90ec57e203fdeda6f503`.

``````lean
import Calderon.DilatedProfileUniform

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.CutoffRadiusSeparation
open AngularPolynomial MetricOperator ConnectionError RadiusProfile ConformalDepth

lemma logSlope_le_of_positive_depth (delta t tb : ℝ) (hd : 0 < delta)
    (hb : 0 < tb) (ht : tb ≤ t) : logSlope delta t ≤ 1/tb := by
  exact (logSlope_le_inv_softplus delta t hd).trans
    (one_div_le_one_div_of_le hb (ht.trans (le_softplus delta t hd)))

lemma referenceRadius_ge_of_positive_depth (delta R tb : ℝ) (p : ℕ) (L : ℝ) (x : R3)
    (hd : 0 < delta) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hb : 0 ≤ tb) (ht : tb ≤ referenceDepth L x) :
    R * tb^p ≤ referenceRadius delta R p L x := by
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
    (pow_le_pow_left₀ hb (ht.trans (le_softplus delta _ hd)) p) hR

lemma positive_referenceRadius_lower_bound (R tb : ℝ) (p : ℕ)
    (hR : 0 < R) (hb : 0 < tb) : 0 < R*tb^p := mul_pos hR (pow_pos hb p)

theorem exists_uniform_positive_depth_radius_beta_bounds
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L : ℝ) (hL : 0 < L)
    (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, ∀ delta R tb : ℝ,
      0 < delta → 0 < R → 0 < tb → ∀ p : ℕ, ∀ x ∈ K, tb ≤ referenceDepth L x →
      R*tb^p ≤ referenceRadius delta R p L x ∧
      metricDifferentialNorm (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L)
        (fun y => Real.log (referenceRadius delta R p L y)) x ≤ (p:ℝ)*C/tb := by
  obtain ⟨m,C,T,hm,hC,hbounds⟩ :=
    exists_dilatedReferenceDepth_uniform_metricNorm_bounds g hg L hL K hK
  refine ⟨C,hC,?_⟩
  intro lam hlam delta R tb hd hR hb p x hx ht
  refine ⟨referenceRadius_ge_of_positive_depth delta R tb p L x hd hR.le hb.le ht,?_⟩
  rw [log_referenceRadius delta R p L hd hR,
    metricDifferentialNorm_logProfile _ delta (Real.log R) p _ x hd
      ((contDiff_referenceDepth L).differentiable (by simp) x)]
  obtain ⟨hmin,hmax,hT⟩ := hbounds lam hlam x hx
  have ha := logSlope_le_of_positive_depth delta (referenceDepth L x) tb hd hb ht
  have h1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hmax
    (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg p) (logSlope_pos delta (referenceDepth L x) hd).le)
  have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ha (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg p) hC.le)
  calc
    _ ≤ ((p:ℝ)*logSlope delta (referenceDepth L x))*C := h1
    _ = ((p:ℝ)*C)*logSlope delta (referenceDepth L x) := by ring
    _ ≤ ((p:ℝ)*C)*(1/tb) := h2
    _ = (p:ℝ)*C/tb := by ring

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.CutoffRadiusSeparation

import Calderon.WeightedBaseSpectral
import Calderon.BoundedSpectralMultiplier

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Filter
open scoped InnerProductSpace ContDiff Topology ENNReal
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.WeightedAngularConvergence
open SphereHarmonic SphereHilbertDecomposition SpectralCoreRegularity
  SpectralWeightedGraph SpectralWeightComparison BoundedSpectralMultiplier
  WeightedBaseSpectral ReferenceDensityBounds

lemma norm_sphereHarmonicPartialSum_le (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (n : ℕ) (u : SphereL2) :
    ‖sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n u‖ ≤ ‖u‖ := by
  rw [sphereHarmonicPartialSum_apply]
  exact norm_sum_sphereHarmonicCoordinates_le hO hD (Finset.range n) u

lemma boundedSpectralMultiplier_partialSum (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hw : ∀ k, |w k| ≤ C) (n : ℕ) (u : SphereL2) :
    boundedSpectralMultiplier hO hD w C hC hw (sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n u) =
      sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n (boundedSpectralMultiplier hO hD w C hC hw u) := by
  apply spectralGraph_output_unique hO hD w (sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n u)
  · exact boundedSpectralMultiplier_mem hO hD w C hC hw _
  · exact spectralGraph_partialSum hO hD w (u,boundedSpectralMultiplier hO hD w C hC hw u)
      (boundedSpectralMultiplier_mem hO hD w C hC hw u) n

lemma casimirBesselMultiplier_partialSum (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (s : ℝ) (hs : s ≤ 2) (n : ℕ) (u : SphereL2) :
    casimirBesselMultiplier hO hD s hs (sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n u) =
      sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n (casimirBesselMultiplier hO hD s hs u) :=
  boundedSpectralMultiplier_partialSum hO hD (casimirBesselRatio s) 2 (by norm_num)
    (abs_casimirBesselRatio_le_two s hs) n u

theorem tendsto_integral_sphereHarmonicPartialSum_sub_sq
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (U : R3 → SphereL2) (hU : Continuous U) (hcomp : HasCompactSupport U) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ∫ x, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      ‖sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n (U x) - U x‖ ^ 2)
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
  have hc (n : ℕ) : Continuous (fun x => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      ‖sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n (U x) - U x‖ ^ 2) :=
    (continuous_referenceBaseDensity g hg L lam).mul
      ((((sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n).continuous.comp hU).sub
        hU).norm.pow 2)
  have hb : Integrable (fun x => 4 *
      (referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * ‖U x‖ ^ 2)) :=
    (integrable_referenceBase_norm_sq g hg L lam U hU hcomp).const_mul 4
  have hbound (n : ℕ) : ∀ᵐ x, ‖referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      ‖sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n (U x) - U x‖ ^ 2‖ ≤
      4 * (referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * ‖U x‖ ^ 2) := by
    apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
    intro x
    have hr := le_of_lt (referenceDensityFamily_pos g hg L (lam,x))
    have hn : ‖sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n (U x) - U x‖ ≤
        2 * ‖U x‖ := by
      calc
        _ ≤ ‖sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n (U x)‖ +
            ‖U x‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
        _ ≤ ‖U x‖ + ‖U x‖ := add_le_add
          (norm_sphereHarmonicPartialSum_le hO hD n _) (le_refl _)
        _ = _ := by ring
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hr (sq_nonneg _))]
    have hs := (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)).mpr hn
    nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs hr]
  have hlim : ∀ᵐ x, Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      ‖sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n (U x) - U x‖ ^ 2)
      atTop (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) := by
    apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
    intro x
    simpa using (((tendsto_sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD (U x)).sub_const
      (U x)).norm.pow 2).const_mul
        (referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x))
  simpa using tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence
    (fun x => 4 * (referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * ‖U x‖ ^ 2))
    (fun n => (hc n).aestronglyMeasurable) hb hbound hlim

theorem tendsto_referenceBaseLift_sphereHarmonicPartialSum
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (U : R3 → SphereL2) (hU : Continuous U) (hcomp : HasCompactSupport U) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => referenceBaseLift g hg L lam
      (fun x => sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n (U x))
      ((sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n).continuous.comp hU)
      (hcomp.comp_left (map_zero _))) atTop
      (𝓝 (referenceBaseLift g hg L lam U hU hcomp)) := by
  let S (n : ℕ) := referenceBaseLift g hg L lam
    (fun x => sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n (U x))
    ((sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n).continuous.comp hU)
    (hcomp.comp_left (map_zero _))
  let V := referenceBaseLift g hg L lam U hU hcomp
  have he (n : ℕ) : ‖S n - V‖ ^ 2 = ∫ x, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      ‖sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n (U x) - U x‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [← referenceBaseLift_sub]
    exact norm_sq_referenceBaseLift g hg L lam _ _ _
  have hs : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ‖S n - V‖ ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) := by
    simp_rw [he]
    exact tendsto_integral_sphereHarmonicPartialSum_sub_sq g hg L lam hO hD U hU hcomp
  have hn : Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ‖S n - V‖) atTop (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) := by
    have h := Real.continuous_sqrt.continuousAt.tendsto.comp hs
    change Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => Real.sqrt (‖S n - V‖ ^ 2)) atTop (𝓝 (Real.sqrt 0)) at h
    simpa only [Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_zero] using h
  apply (tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero).mpr
  simpa only [dist_eq_norm] using hn

theorem casimirBesselMultiplier_partialSum_graph (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (s : ℝ) (hs : s ≤ 2) (n : ℕ) (u v : SphereL2)
    (hv : (u,v) ∈ spectralGraph hO hD casimirWeight) :
    (sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n u,
      sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n (casimirBesselMultiplier hO hD s hs v)) ∈
        sphereBesselGraph hO hD s := by
  rw [← casimirBesselMultiplier_partialSum]
  exact casimirBesselMultiplier_graph hO hD s hs _ _
    (spectralGraph_partialSum hO hD casimirWeight (u,v) hv n)

theorem tendsto_referenceBaseLift_casimirBesselMultiplier
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (s : ℝ) (hs : s ≤ 2) (V : R3 → SphereL2)
    (hV : Continuous V) (hcomp : HasCompactSupport V) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => referenceBaseLift g hg L lam
      (fun x => sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n (casimirBesselMultiplier hO hD s hs (V x)))
      ((sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n).continuous.comp
        ((casimirBesselMultiplier hO hD s hs).continuous.comp hV))
      ((hasCompactSupport_casimirBesselMultiplier hO hD s hs V hcomp).comp_left (map_zero _)))
      atTop (𝓝 (referenceBaseLift g hg L lam
        (fun x => casimirBesselMultiplier hO hD s hs (V x))
        ((casimirBesselMultiplier hO hD s hs).continuous.comp hV)
        (hasCompactSupport_casimirBesselMultiplier hO hD s hs V hcomp))) :=
  tendsto_referenceBaseLift_sphereHarmonicPartialSum g hg L lam hO hD _
    ((casimirBesselMultiplier hO hD s hs).continuous.comp hV)
    (hasCompactSupport_casimirBesselMultiplier hO hD s hs V hcomp)

theorem tendsto_referenceBaseLift_casimirBesselMultiplier_partialSum
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (s : ℝ) (hs : s ≤ 2) (V : R3 → SphereL2)
    (hV : Continuous V) (hcomp : HasCompactSupport V) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => referenceBaseLift g hg L lam
      (fun x => casimirBesselMultiplier hO hD s hs (sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n (V x)))
      ((casimirBesselMultiplier hO hD s hs).continuous.comp
        ((sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n).continuous.comp hV))
      (hasCompactSupport_casimirBesselMultiplier hO hD s hs _
        (hasCompactSupport_sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n V hcomp)))
      atTop (𝓝 (referenceBaseLift g hg L lam
        (fun x => casimirBesselMultiplier hO hD s hs (V x))
        ((casimirBesselMultiplier hO hD s hs).continuous.comp hV)
        (hasCompactSupport_casimirBesselMultiplier hO hD s hs V hcomp))) := by
  simpa only [casimirBesselMultiplier_partialSum] using
    tendsto_referenceBaseLift_casimirBesselMultiplier g hg L lam hO hD s hs V hV hcomp

lemma contDiff_pureDerivative (U : R3 → SphereL2) (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U) (X : R3) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => fderiv ℝ U x X) :=
  (hU.fderiv_right (m := ∞) (by simp)).clm_apply contDiff_const

theorem tendsto_referenceBaseLift_pureDerivative_full
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (U : R3 → SphereL2) (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U)
    (hcomp : HasCompactSupport U) (X : R3) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => referenceBaseLift g hg L lam
      (fun x => sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n (fderiv ℝ U x X))
      ((sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n).continuous.comp (continuous_pureDerivative U hU X))
      ((hasCompactSupport_pureDerivative U hcomp X).comp_left (map_zero _))) atTop
      (𝓝 (referenceBaseLift g hg L lam (fun x => fderiv ℝ U x X)
        (continuous_pureDerivative U hU X) (hasCompactSupport_pureDerivative U hcomp X))) :=
  tendsto_referenceBaseLift_sphereHarmonicPartialSum g hg L lam hO hD _
    (continuous_pureDerivative U hU X) (hasCompactSupport_pureDerivative U hcomp X)

theorem tendsto_referenceBaseLift_secondPureDerivative_full
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (U : R3 → SphereL2) (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U)
    (hcomp : HasCompactSupport U) (X Y : R3) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => referenceBaseLift g hg L lam
      (fun x => sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n (fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ U y X) x Y))
      ((sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n).continuous.comp
        (continuous_pureDerivative _ (contDiff_pureDerivative U hU X) Y))
      ((hasCompactSupport_pureDerivative _ (hasCompactSupport_pureDerivative U hcomp X) Y).comp_left
        (map_zero _))) atTop
      (𝓝 (referenceBaseLift g hg L lam (fun x => fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ U y X) x Y)
        (continuous_pureDerivative _ (contDiff_pureDerivative U hU X) Y)
        (hasCompactSupport_pureDerivative _ (hasCompactSupport_pureDerivative U hcomp X) Y))) :=
  tendsto_referenceBaseLift_pureDerivative_full g hg L lam hO hD _
    (contDiff_pureDerivative U hU X) (hasCompactSupport_pureDerivative U hcomp X) Y

lemma pureDerivative_harmonicPartialSum_eq (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (U : R3 → SphereL2) (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U)
    (n : ℕ) (x X : R3) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun y => sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n (U y)) x X =
      sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n (fderiv ℝ U x X) := by
  rw [fderiv_sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n U x (hU.differentiable (by simp) x)]
  rfl

lemma secondPureDerivative_harmonicPartialSum_eq (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (U : R3 → SphereL2) (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U)
    (n : ℕ) (x X Y : R3) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fun z => sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n (U z)) y X) x Y =
      sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n (fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ U y X) x Y) := by
  have he : (fun y => fderiv ℝ (fun z => sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n (U z)) y X) =
      (fun y => sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n (fderiv ℝ U y X)) :=
    funext (fun y => pureDerivative_harmonicPartialSum_eq hO hD U hU n y X)
  rw [he]
  exact pureDerivative_harmonicPartialSum_eq hO hD _ (contDiff_pureDerivative U hU X) n x Y

lemma sphereHarmonicPartialSum_base_smul (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (n : ℕ) (a : R3 → ℝ) (U : R3 → SphereL2) (x : R3) :
    sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n (a x • U x) =
      a x • sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n (U x) := map_smul _ _ _

theorem tendsto_referenceBaseLift_base_smul
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (a : R3 → ℝ) (ha : Continuous a) (U : R3 → SphereL2)
    (hU : Continuous U) (hcomp : HasCompactSupport U) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => referenceBaseLift g hg L lam
      (fun x => a x • sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n (U x))
      (ha.smul ((sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n).continuous.comp hU))
      ((hasCompactSupport_sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n U hcomp).smul_left (f := a))) atTop
      (𝓝 (referenceBaseLift g hg L lam (fun x => a x • U x)
        (ha.smul hU) (hcomp.smul_left (f := a)))) := by
  simpa only [map_smul] using
    tendsto_referenceBaseLift_sphereHarmonicPartialSum g hg L lam hO hD
      (fun x => a x • U x) (ha.smul hU) (hcomp.smul_left (f := a))

theorem tendsto_referenceBaseLift_base_rpow_smul
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (beta : R3 → ℝ) (hb : Continuous beta) (hpos : ∀ x, 0 < beta x) (t : ℝ)
    (U : R3 → SphereL2) (hU : Continuous U) (hcomp : HasCompactSupport U) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => referenceBaseLift g hg L lam
      (fun x => beta x ^ t • sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n (U x))
      ((hb.rpow_const (fun x => Or.inl (hpos x).ne')).smul
        ((sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n).continuous.comp hU))
      ((hasCompactSupport_sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n U hcomp).smul_left
        (f := fun x => beta x ^ t))) atTop
      (𝓝 (referenceBaseLift g hg L lam (fun x => beta x ^ t • U x)
        ((hb.rpow_const (fun x => Or.inl (hpos x).ne')).smul hU)
          (hcomp.smul_left (f := fun x => beta x ^ t)))) :=
  tendsto_referenceBaseLift_base_smul g hg L lam hO hD (fun x => beta x ^ t)
    (hb.rpow_const (fun x => Or.inl (hpos x).ne')) U hU hcomp

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.WeightedAngularConvergence

import Calderon.SmoothAmbientAngularCasimir
import Calderon.WeightedAngularConvergence

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set Filter
open scoped ContDiff Topology ENNReal
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SmoothAngularApplication
open SphereHarmonic SmoothSphereFields SmoothAmbientAngularCasimir
  SpectralCoreRegularity SpectralWeightedGraph SpectralWeightComparison
  BoundedSpectralMultiplier WeightedBaseSpectral WeightedAngularConvergence

def ambientShiftedCasimirField (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) : R3 → SphereL2 :=
  ambientSphereL2 (ambientShiftedAngularCasimirIterate 1 G)
    (contDiff_ambientShiftedAngularCasimirIterate 1 G hG)

def ambientBesselField (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (s : ℝ) (hs : s ≤ 2) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) : R3 → SphereL2 :=
  fun x => casimirBesselMultiplier hO hD s hs (ambientShiftedCasimirField G hG x)

theorem ambientShiftedCasimirField_graph (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (x : R3) :
    (ambientSphereL2 G hG x,ambientShiftedCasimirField G hG x) ∈
      spectralGraph hO hD casimirWeight := by
  intro k
  simpa only [ambientShiftedCasimirField,pow_one,casimirWeight] using
    sphereHarmonicCoordinate_angularCasimirLift hO hD 1 k G hG x

theorem ambientBesselField_graph (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (s : ℝ) (hs : s ≤ 2)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (x : R3) :
    (ambientSphereL2 G hG x,ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG x) ∈
      sphereBesselGraph hO hD s :=
  casimirBesselMultiplier_graph hO hD s hs _ _ (ambientShiftedCasimirField_graph hO hD G hG x)

lemma contDiff_ambientBesselField (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (s : ℝ) (hs : s ≤ 2)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG) :=
  contDiff_casimirBesselMultiplier hO hD s hs _ (contDiff_angularCasimirLift 1 G hG)

lemma ambientBesselField_eq_zero (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (s : ℝ) (hs : s ≤ 2)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (K : Set R3)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ u : UnitSphere, G (x,u.val)=0) (x : R3) (hx : x ∉ K) :
    ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG x = 0 := by
  have he : ambientShiftedCasimirField G hG x = 0 :=
    ambientSphereL2_eq_zero _ (contDiff_ambientShiftedAngularCasimirIterate 1 G hG) x
      (ambientShiftedAngularCasimirIterate_sphere_zero 1 G hG K hz x hx)
  change casimirBesselMultiplier hO hD s hs (ambientShiftedCasimirField G hG x) = 0
  rw [he,map_zero]

lemma hasCompactSupport_ambientBesselField (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (s : ℝ) (hs : s ≤ 2)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ u : UnitSphere, G (x,u.val)=0) :
    HasCompactSupport (ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG) :=
  hasCompactSupport_casimirBesselMultiplier hO hD s hs _
    (hasCompactSupport_angularCasimirLift 1 G hG K hK hz)

lemma tsupport_ambientBesselField_subset (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (s : ℝ) (hs : s ≤ 2)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ u : UnitSphere, G (x,u.val)=0) :
    tsupport (ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG) ⊆ K := by
  apply closure_minimal _ hK.isClosed
  intro x hx
  by_contra hxK
  change ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG x ≠ 0 at hx
  exact hx (ambientBesselField_eq_zero hO hD s hs G hG K hz x hxK)

lemma tsupport_pureDerivative_ambientBesselField_subset (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (s : ℝ) (hs : s ≤ 2)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ u : UnitSphere, G (x,u.val)=0) (X : R3) :
    tsupport (fun x => fderiv ℝ (ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG) x X) ⊆ K :=
  (tsupport_fderiv_apply_subset ℝ X).trans
    (tsupport_ambientBesselField_subset hO hD s hs G hG K hK hz)

lemma tsupport_secondPureDerivative_ambientBesselField_subset (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (s : ℝ) (hs : s ≤ 2)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ u : UnitSphere, G (x,u.val)=0) (X Y : R3) :
    tsupport (fun x => fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ (ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG) y X) x Y) ⊆ K :=
  (tsupport_fderiv_apply_subset ℝ Y).trans
    (tsupport_pureDerivative_ambientBesselField_subset hO hD s hs G hG K hK hz X)

lemma fderiv_ambientBesselField (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (s : ℝ) (hs : s ≤ 2)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (x : R3) :
    fderiv ℝ (ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG) x =
      (casimirBesselMultiplier hO hD s hs).comp (fderiv ℝ (ambientShiftedCasimirField G hG) x) :=
  fderiv_casimirBesselMultiplier hO hD s hs _ x
    ((contDiff_angularCasimirLift 1 G hG).differentiable (by simp) x)

lemma memLp_ambientBesselField (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (s : ℝ) (hs : s ≤ 2)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ u : UnitSphere, G (x,u.val)=0) :
    MemLp (ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG) 2 (referenceBaseMeasure g L lam) :=
  memLp_referenceBase g hg L lam _ (contDiff_ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG).continuous
    (hasCompactSupport_ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG K hK hz)

theorem ambientBesselField_partialSum_graph (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (s : ℝ) (hs : s ≤ 2)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (n : ℕ) (x : R3) :
    (sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n (ambientSphereL2 G hG x),
      sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n (ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG x)) ∈
        sphereBesselGraph hO hD s :=
  casimirBesselMultiplier_partialSum_graph hO hD s hs n _ _
    (ambientShiftedCasimirField_graph hO hD G hG x)

theorem tendsto_referenceBaseLift_ambientBesselField
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (s : ℝ) (hs : s ≤ 2)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ u : UnitSphere, G (x,u.val)=0) :
    let W := ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG
    let hW := (contDiff_ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG).continuous
    let hcomp := hasCompactSupport_ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG K hK hz
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => referenceBaseLift g hg L lam
      (fun x => sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n (W x))
      ((sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n).continuous.comp hW)
      (hcomp.comp_left (map_zero _))) atTop
      (𝓝 (referenceBaseLift g hg L lam W hW hcomp)) :=
  tendsto_referenceBaseLift_sphereHarmonicPartialSum g hg L lam hO hD _
    (contDiff_ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG).continuous
    (hasCompactSupport_ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG K hK hz)

theorem tendsto_referenceBaseLift_pureDerivative_ambientBesselField
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (s : ℝ) (hs : s ≤ 2)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ u : UnitSphere, G (x,u.val)=0) (X : R3) :
    let W := ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG
    let hW := contDiff_ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG
    let hcomp := hasCompactSupport_ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG K hK hz
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => referenceBaseLift g hg L lam
      (fun x => sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n (fderiv ℝ W x X))
      ((sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n).continuous.comp (continuous_pureDerivative W hW X))
      ((hasCompactSupport_pureDerivative W hcomp X).comp_left (map_zero _))) atTop
      (𝓝 (referenceBaseLift g hg L lam (fun x => fderiv ℝ W x X)
        (continuous_pureDerivative W hW X) (hasCompactSupport_pureDerivative W hcomp X))) :=
  tendsto_referenceBaseLift_pureDerivative_full g hg L lam hO hD _
    (contDiff_ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG)
    (hasCompactSupport_ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG K hK hz) X

theorem tendsto_referenceBaseLift_secondPureDerivative_ambientBesselField
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (s : ℝ) (hs : s ≤ 2)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ u : UnitSphere, G (x,u.val)=0) (X Y : R3) :
    let W := ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG
    let hW := contDiff_ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG
    let hcomp := hasCompactSupport_ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG K hK hz
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => referenceBaseLift g hg L lam
      (fun x => sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n (fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ W y X) x Y))
      ((sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n).continuous.comp
        (continuous_pureDerivative _ (contDiff_pureDerivative W hW X) Y))
      ((hasCompactSupport_pureDerivative _ (hasCompactSupport_pureDerivative W hcomp X) Y).comp_left
        (map_zero _))) atTop
      (𝓝 (referenceBaseLift g hg L lam (fun x => fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ W y X) x Y)
        (continuous_pureDerivative _ (contDiff_pureDerivative W hW X) Y)
        (hasCompactSupport_pureDerivative _ (hasCompactSupport_pureDerivative W hcomp X) Y))) :=
  tendsto_referenceBaseLift_secondPureDerivative_full g hg L lam hO hD _
    (contDiff_ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG)
    (hasCompactSupport_ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG K hK hz) X Y

``````lean
import Calderon.WeightedAngularConvergence

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set Filter
open scoped ContDiff Topology ENNReal
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.WeightedSupportLocalization
open SphereHarmonic SpectralCoreRegularity WeightedBaseSpectral WeightedAngularConvergence

lemma continuous_base_smul_on_support (O K : Set R3) (hO : IsOpen O)
    (hK : IsCompact K) (hKO : K ⊆ O) (a : R3 → ℝ) (ha : ContinuousOn a O)
    (U : R3 → SphereL2) (hU : Continuous U) (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, U x=0) :
    Continuous (fun x => a x • U x) := by
  apply continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr
  intro x
  by_cases hxO : x ∈ O
  · exact (ha.continuousAt (hO.mem_nhds hxO)).smul hU.continuousAt
  · have hxK : x ∉ K := fun hx => hxO (hKO hx)
    have he : (fun y => a y • U y) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun _ => (0 : SphereL2)) := by
      filter_upwards [hK.isClosed.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hxK] with y hy
      rw [hz y hy,smul_zero]
    exact continuousAt_const.congr_of_eventuallyEq he

lemma continuous_base_rpow_smul_on_support (O K : Set R3) (hO : IsOpen O)
    (hK : IsCompact K) (hKO : K ⊆ O) (beta : R3 → ℝ) (hb : ContinuousOn beta O)
    (hpos : ∀ x ∈ O, 0 < beta x) (t : ℝ) (U : R3 → SphereL2)
    (hU : Continuous U) (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, U x=0) :
    Continuous (fun x => beta x ^ t • U x) :=
  continuous_base_smul_on_support O K hO hK hKO (fun x => beta x ^ t)
    (hb.rpow_const (fun x hx => Or.inl (hpos x hx).ne')) U hU hz

theorem tendsto_referenceBaseLift_base_smul_on_support
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (hOrth : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hDense : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (O K : Set R3) (hO : IsOpen O) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKO : K ⊆ O)
    (a : R3 → ℝ) (ha : ContinuousOn a O) (U : R3 → SphereL2)
    (hU : Continuous U) (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, U x=0) :
    let W := fun x => a x • U x
    let hW := continuous_base_smul_on_support O K hO hK hKO a ha U hU hz
    let hcomp : HasCompactSupport W :=
      (HasCompactSupport.intro hK hz).smul_left (f := a)
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => referenceBaseLift g hg L lam
      (fun x => sphereHarmonicPartialSum hOrth hDense n (W x))
      ((sphereHarmonicPartialSum hOrth hDense n).continuous.comp hW)
      (hcomp.comp_left (map_zero _))) atTop
      (𝓝 (referenceBaseLift g hg L lam W hW hcomp)) :=
  tendsto_referenceBaseLift_sphereHarmonicPartialSum g hg L lam hOrth hDense _
    (continuous_base_smul_on_support O K hO hK hKO a ha U hU hz)
    ((HasCompactSupport.intro hK hz).smul_left (f := a))

theorem tendsto_referenceBaseLift_base_rpow_smul_on_support
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (hOrth : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hDense : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (O K : Set R3) (hO : IsOpen O) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKO : K ⊆ O)
    (beta : R3 → ℝ) (hb : ContinuousOn beta O) (hpos : ∀ x ∈ O, 0 < beta x) (t : ℝ)
    (U : R3 → SphereL2) (hU : Continuous U) (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, U x=0) :
    let W := fun x => beta x ^ t • U x
    let hW := continuous_base_rpow_smul_on_support O K hO hK hKO beta hb hpos t U hU hz
    let hcomp : HasCompactSupport W :=
      (HasCompactSupport.intro hK hz).smul_left (f := fun x => beta x ^ t)
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => referenceBaseLift g hg L lam
      (fun x => sphereHarmonicPartialSum hOrth hDense n (W x))
      ((sphereHarmonicPartialSum hOrth hDense n).continuous.comp hW)
      (hcomp.comp_left (map_zero _))) atTop
      (𝓝 (referenceBaseLift g hg L lam W hW hcomp)) :=
  tendsto_referenceBaseLift_base_smul_on_support g hg L lam hOrth hDense O K hO hK hKO
    (fun x => beta x ^ t) (hb.rpow_const (fun x hx => Or.inl (hpos x hx).ne')) U hU hz

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.WeightedSupportLocalization

``````
````````
