````````
## Calderon.SmoothMovingFrameFields

SHA256 `635c2094e7849bad1d0b28bf9af225565dd755b539c91e17ea8c98f545a883bc`.

``````lean
import Calderon.SmoothAmbientAngularCasimir
import Calderon.SmoothSphereRotationProjection
import Calderon.MovingFrameConnection
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FDeriv.Congr

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set Filter
open scoped ContDiff Topology ENNReal InnerProductSpace
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SmoothMovingFrameFields
open SphereHarmonic SmoothSphereRotation SmoothAngularCasimir SmoothSphereFields
open SmoothAmbientAngularCasimir SmoothSphereRotationProjection SpectralCoreRegularity
open MovingFrameConnection SmoothMetricFrame CompactParameterSmoothness RadiusProfile

def matrixVector (C : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (z : R3) : R3 :=
  WithLp.toLp 2 fun i => ∑ j : Fin 3, C i j * z j

/-- The source sign and half factor are derived from the actual skew matrix. -/
lemma neg_matrixVector_eq_half_rotation (C : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ i j, C i j = -C j i) (z : R3) :
    -matrixVector C z = (1/2 : ℝ) • ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      C i j • rotationVector i j z := by
  have hz (i : Fin 3) : C i i = 0 := by linarith [hC i i]
  ext l
  fin_cases l <;>
    simp [matrixVector,rotationVector,Fin.sum_univ_three,hz,hC 1 0,hC 2 0,hC 2 1] <;> ring

def movingFrameCoordinateVector (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3)
    (q : R3 × R3) : R3 := WithLp.toLp 2 fun i => movingFrameCoordinate M e i q

lemma contDiff_movingFrameCoordinateVector (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3) (hM : ContDiff ℝ ∞ M)
    (hE : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => e x i)) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (movingFrameCoordinateVector M e) := by
  apply contDiff_piLp'
  intro i
  exact contDiff_movingFrameCoordinate M e hM hE i

lemma fderiv_movingFrameCoordinateVector_horizontal
    (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3) (hM : ContDiff ℝ ∞ M)
    (hE : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => e y i))
    (hsym : ∀ y U V, ⟪M y U,V⟫_ℝ = ⟪M y V,U⟫_ℝ)
    (he : ∀ y, IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (M y) (e y))
    (hcomp : ∀ y X U V, ⟪M y (Γ y X U),V⟫_ℝ + ⟪M y U,Γ y X V⟫_ℝ =
      ⟪fderiv ℝ M y X U,V⟫_ℝ) (x v X : R3) :
    fderiv ℝ (movingFrameCoordinateVector M e) (x,v) (X,-Γ x X v) =
      -matrixVector (frameConnectionCoefficient M Γ e x X) (movingFrameCoordinateVector M e (x,v)) := by
  have hp : HasFDerivAt (fun q : R3 × R3 => fun i => movingFrameCoordinate M e i q)
      (ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun i => fderiv ℝ (movingFrameCoordinate M e i) (x,v)) (x,v) := by
    apply hasFDerivAt_pi.mpr
    intro i
    exact ((contDiff_movingFrameCoordinate M e hM hE i).differentiable (by simp) (x,v)).hasFDerivAt
  have ht := ((PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ (fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ)).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.hasFDerivAt).comp (x,v) hp
  have hd : HasFDerivAt (movingFrameCoordinateVector M e)
      ((PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ (fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ)).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun i => fderiv ℝ (movingFrameCoordinate M e i) (x,v))) (x,v) := by
    convert! ht using 1
  rw [hd.fderiv]
  ext i
  change fderiv ℝ (movingFrameCoordinate M e i) (x,v) (X,-Γ x X v) =
    -(∑ j : Fin 3, frameConnectionCoefficient M Γ e x X i j * movingFrameCoordinate M e j (x,v))
  exact fderiv_movingFrameCoordinate_horizontal_eq_neg_sum M Γ e hM hE hsym he hcomp x v X i

def movingFrameAmbient (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (q : R3 × R3) : ℝ :=
  G (q.1,movingFrameCoordinateVector M e q)

lemma contDiff_movingFrameAmbient (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3) (hM : ContDiff ℝ ∞ M)
    (hE : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => e x i)) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ)
    (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (movingFrameAmbient M e G) :=
  hG.comp (contDiff_fst.prodMk (contDiff_movingFrameCoordinateVector M e hM hE))

def ambientBaseDirectional (X : R3 → R3) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (q : R3 × R3) : ℝ :=
  fderiv ℝ G q (X q.1,0)

lemma contDiff_ambientBaseDirectional (X : R3 → R3) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (ambientBaseDirectional X G) :=
  (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.mp hG).2.clm_apply
    ((hX.comp contDiff_fst).prodMk contDiff_const)

/-- Actual derivative in the moving-coordinate horizontal direction, independent of projections. -/
def ambientFrameHorizontal (C : R3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ) (X : R3 → R3)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (q : R3 × R3) : ℝ :=
  fderiv ℝ G q (X q.1,-matrixVector (C q.1) q.2)

lemma contDiff_ambientFrameHorizontal (C : R3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => C x i j)) (X : R3 → R3)
    (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (ambientFrameHorizontal C X G) := by
  have hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun q : R3 × R3 => matrixVector (C q.1) q.2) := by
    apply contDiff_piLp'
    intro i
    change ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun q : R3 × R3 => ∑ j : Fin 3, C q.1 i j * q.2 j)
    exact ContDiff.sum fun j _ => (hC i j |>.comp contDiff_fst).mul
      ((contDiff_piLp_apply (p := (2 : ℝ≥0∞)) (i := j)).comp contDiff_snd)
  exact (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.mp hG).2.clm_apply
    ((hX.comp contDiff_fst).prodMk hv.neg)

lemma ambientFrameHorizontal_eq_base_add_rotation (C : R3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ x i j, C x i j = -C x j i) (X : R3 → R3) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ)
    (q : R3 × R3) :
    ambientFrameHorizontal C X G q = ambientBaseDirectional X G q +
      (1/2 : ℝ) * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, C q.1 i j * ambientAngularRotation i j G q := by
  unfold ambientFrameHorizontal ambientBaseDirectional
  rw [neg_matrixVector_eq_half_rotation (C q.1) (hC q.1) q.2]
  have he : (X q.1,(1/2 : ℝ) • ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, C q.1 i j • rotationVector i j q.2) =
      (X q.1,0) + (1/2 : ℝ) • ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
        C q.1 i j • (0,rotationVector i j q.2) := by
    ext l <;> simp [Fin.sum_univ_three]
  rw [he]
  simp only [map_add,map_smul,map_sum,smul_eq_mul,ambientAngularRotation]

/-- True physical moving-frame chain rule for a genuinely base-dependent ambient smooth field. -/
theorem fderiv_movingFrameAmbient_horizontal
    (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3) (hM : ContDiff ℝ ∞ M)
    (hE : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => e y i))
    (hsym : ∀ y U V, ⟪M y U,V⟫_ℝ = ⟪M y V,U⟫_ℝ)
    (he : ∀ y, IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (M y) (e y))
    (hcomp : ∀ y X U V, ⟪M y (Γ y X U),V⟫_ℝ + ⟪M y U,Γ y X V⟫_ℝ =
      ⟪fderiv ℝ M y X U,V⟫_ℝ) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G)
    (x v X : R3) :
    fderiv ℝ (movingFrameAmbient M e G) (x,v) (X,-Γ x X v) =
      ambientFrameHorizontal (fun y => frameConnectionCoefficient M Γ e y X)
        (fun _ => X) G (x,movingFrameCoordinateVector M e (x,v)) := by
  have hz := ((contDiff_movingFrameCoordinateVector M e hM hE).differentiable (by simp) (x,v)).hasFDerivAt
  have hp := (hasFDerivAt_fst (p := (x,v))).prodMk hz
  have hd := ((hG.differentiable (by simp)) (x,movingFrameCoordinateVector M e (x,v))).hasFDerivAt.comp (x,v) hp
  change HasFDerivAt (movingFrameAmbient M e G) _ (x,v) at hd
  rw [hd.fderiv]
  change fderiv ℝ G (x,movingFrameCoordinateVector M e (x,v))
    (X,fderiv ℝ (movingFrameCoordinateVector M e) (x,v) (X,-Γ x X v)) = _
  rw [fderiv_movingFrameCoordinateVector_horizontal M Γ e hM hE hsym he hcomp x v X]
  rfl

lemma ambientSphereL2_baseDirectional (X : R3 → R3) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (x : R3) :
    ambientSphereL2 (ambientBaseDirectional X G) (contDiff_ambientBaseDirectional X hX G hG) x =
      fderiv ℝ (ambientSphereL2 G hG) x (X x) := by
  rw [fderiv_ambientSphereL2 G hG x,ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
  change (ContinuousMap.toLp 2 sphereProbability ℝ) _ =
    (ContinuousMap.toLp 2 sphereProbability ℝ) _
  congr 1

lemma ambientSphereL2_angularRotation (i j : Fin 3) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ)
    (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (x : R3) :
    ambientSphereL2 (ambientAngularRotation i j G) (contDiff_ambientAngularRotation i j G hG) x =
      smoothSphereLift (sphereRotationDerivative i j (fun z => G (x,z)))
        (contDiff_sphereRotationDerivative i j _ (contDiff_angular_slice G hG x)) := by
  change (ContinuousMap.toLp 2 sphereProbability ℝ) _ =
    (ContinuousMap.toLp 2 sphereProbability ℝ) _
  congr 1
  ext theta
  exact congrFun (ambientAngularRotation_slice i j G hG x) theta.val

lemma sphereHarmonicCoordinate_ambientAngularRotation (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (k : ℕ) (i j : Fin 3) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ)
    (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (x : R3) :
    sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k
      (ambientSphereL2 (ambientAngularRotation i j G) (contDiff_ambientAngularRotation i j G hG) x) =
    harmonicSphereRotation k i j (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (ambientSphereL2 G hG x)) := by
  rw [ambientSphereL2_angularRotation i j G hG x,ambientSphereL2_eq_smoothSphereLift G hG x]
  exact sphereHarmonicCoordinate_sphereRotationDerivative hO hD k i j _ (contDiff_angular_slice G hG x)

lemma ambientSphereL2_frameHorizontal (C : R3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => C x i j))
    (hskew : ∀ x i j, C x i j = -C x j i) (X : R3 → R3) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (x : R3) :
    ambientSphereL2 (ambientFrameHorizontal C X G) (contDiff_ambientFrameHorizontal C hC X hX G hG) x =
      fderiv ℝ (ambientSphereL2 G hG) x (X x) + (1/2 : ℝ) •
        ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, C x i j •
          ambientSphereL2 (ambientAngularRotation i j G) (contDiff_ambientAngularRotation i j G hG) x := by
  let B : C(UnitSphere,ℝ) := ambientSphereSection (ambientBaseDirectional X G)
    (contDiff_ambientBaseDirectional X hX G hG) x
  let R : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → C(UnitSphere,ℝ) := fun i j =>
    ambientSphereSection (ambientAngularRotation i j G) (contDiff_ambientAngularRotation i j G hG) x
  have he : ambientSphereSection (ambientFrameHorizontal C X G)
      (contDiff_ambientFrameHorizontal C hC X hX G hG) x =
      B + (1/2 : ℝ) • ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, C x i j • R i j := by
    ext theta
    simpa [B,R,ambientSphereSection,compactPullback,unitSphereInclusion] using
      ambientFrameHorizontal_eq_base_add_rotation C hskew X G (x,theta.val)
  have ht := congrArg (ContinuousMap.toLp 2 sphereProbability ℝ) he
  simp only [map_add,map_smul,map_sum] at ht
  rw [← ambientSphereL2_baseDirectional X hX G hG x]
  exact ht

/-- Derived actual ambient horizontal commutation, retaining pure base dependence and all pairs. -/
theorem sphereHarmonicCoordinate_frameHorizontal (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (k : ℕ) (C : R3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => C x i j))
    (hskew : ∀ x i j, C x i j = -C x j i) (X : R3 → R3) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (x : R3) :
    sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k
      (ambientSphereL2 (ambientFrameHorizontal C X G) (contDiff_ambientFrameHorizontal C hC X hX G hG) x) =
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (ambientSphereL2 G hG y)) x (X x) +
        (1/2 : ℝ) • ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, C x i j •
          harmonicSphereRotation k i j (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (ambientSphereL2 G hG x)) := by
  rw [ambientSphereL2_frameHorizontal C hC hskew X hX G hG x]
  simp only [map_add,map_smul,map_sum]
  rw [fderiv_sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (ambientSphereL2 G hG) x
    ((contDiff_ambientSphereL2 G hG).differentiable (by simp) x),ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
  simp_rw [sphereHarmonicCoordinate_ambientAngularRotation hO hD k _ _ G hG x]

lemma ambientBaseDirectional_sphere_zero (X : R3 → R3) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ)
    (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsClosed K)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x,theta.val)=0) :
    ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, ambientBaseDirectional X G (x,theta.val)=0 := by
  intro x hx theta
  have he : (fun y : R3 => G (y,theta.val)) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] fun _ => 0 := by
    filter_upwards [hK.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hx] with y hy
    exact hz y hy theta
  have hf := he.fderiv_eq (𝕜 := ℝ)
  have hd := (hasFDerivAt_base_slice G (hG.differentiable (by simp)) x theta.val).fderiv
  have hv := congrArg (fun L : R3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (X x)) (hd.symm.trans hf)
  simpa [ambientBaseDirectional,basePartial] using hv

lemma ambientFrameHorizontal_sphere_zero (C : R3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (hskew : ∀ x i j, C x i j = -C x j i) (X : R3 → R3) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ)
    (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsClosed K)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x,theta.val)=0) :
    ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, ambientFrameHorizontal C X G (x,theta.val)=0 := by
  intro x hx theta
  rw [ambientFrameHorizontal_eq_base_add_rotation C hskew X G]
  simp only [ambientBaseDirectional_sphere_zero X G hG K hK hz x hx theta,
    ambientAngularRotation_sphere_zero _ _ G hG K hz x hx theta,mul_zero,
    Finset.sum_const_zero,zero_add]

lemma hasCompactSupport_frameHorizontalLift (C : R3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => C x i j))
    (hskew : ∀ x i j, C x i j = -C x j i) (X : R3 → R3) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x,theta.val)=0) :
    HasCompactSupport (ambientSphereL2 (ambientFrameHorizontal C X G)
      (contDiff_ambientFrameHorizontal C hC X hX G hG)) :=
  hasCompactSupport_ambientSphereL2 _ (contDiff_ambientFrameHorizontal C hC X hX G hG) K hK
    (ambientFrameHorizontal_sphere_zero C hskew X G hG K hK.isClosed hz)

lemma contDiff_frameHorizontalLift (C : R3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => C x i j)) (X : R3 → R3) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (ambientSphereL2 (ambientFrameHorizontal C X G)
      (contDiff_ambientFrameHorizontal C hC X hX G hG)) :=
  contDiff_ambientSphereL2 _ (contDiff_ambientFrameHorizontal C hC X hX G hG)

lemma contDiff_frameConnectionCoefficient_field (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3)
    (hM : ContDiff ℝ ∞ M) (hΓ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Γ)
    (hE : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => e x j)) (X : R3 → R3)
    (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X) (i j : Fin 3) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => frameConnectionCoefficient M Γ e x (X x) i j) := by
  have he : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => fderiv ℝ (fun y => e y j) x (X x)) :=
    (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.mp (hE j)).2.clm_apply hX
  have hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => Γ x (X x) (e x j)) :=
    (hΓ.clm_apply hX).clm_apply (hE j)
  exact (hM.clm_apply (he.add hg)).inner ℝ (hE i)


/-- Actual metric-compatible source frame specializes the derived commutation without a skew premise. -/
theorem sphereHarmonicCoordinate_movingFrameHorizontal (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (k : ℕ)
    (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3) (hM : ContDiff ℝ ∞ M) (hΓ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Γ)
    (hE : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => e y i))
    (hsym : ∀ y U V, ⟪M y U,V⟫_ℝ = ⟪M y V,U⟫_ℝ)
    (he : ∀ y, IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (M y) (e y))
    (hcomp : ∀ y X U V, ⟪M y (Γ y X U),V⟫_ℝ + ⟪M y U,Γ y X V⟫_ℝ =
      ⟪fderiv ℝ M y X U,V⟫_ℝ)
    (X : R3 → R3) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ)
    (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (x : R3) :
    sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k
      (ambientSphereL2
        (ambientFrameHorizontal (fun y => frameConnectionCoefficient M Γ e y (X y)) X G)
        (contDiff_ambientFrameHorizontal _
          (fun i j => contDiff_frameConnectionCoefficient_field M Γ e hM hΓ hE X hX i j)
          X hX G hG) x) =
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (ambientSphereL2 G hG y)) x (X x) +
        (1/2 : ℝ) • ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, frameConnectionCoefficient M Γ e x (X x) i j •
          harmonicSphereRotation k i j (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (ambientSphereL2 G hG x)) :=
  sphereHarmonicCoordinate_frameHorizontal hO hD k _
    (fun i j => contDiff_frameConnectionCoefficient_field M Γ e hM hΓ hE X hX i j)
    (fun y i j => frameConnectionCoefficient_skew M Γ e hM hE hsym he hcomp y (X y) i j)
    X hX G hG x

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SmoothMovingFrameFields

``````

## Calderon.MixedPrincipalCommutator

SHA256 `104d0e287f2d1ab745e5b4bad3cee7e7d021a2663ce3c08b41f7300419c5c5c5`.

``````lean
import Calderon.SmoothAngularApplication
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FDeriv.Symmetric
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FDeriv.CompCLM

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open scoped ContDiff
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.MixedPrincipalCommutator
variable {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]

def directionalFDeriv (X : R3) (u : R3 → E) : R3 → E := fun x => fderiv ℝ u x X

lemma contDiff_directionalFDeriv (X : R3) (u : R3 → E) (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (directionalFDeriv X u) :=
  (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.mp hu).2.clm_apply contDiff_const

lemma directionalFDeriv_smul (X : R3) (a : R3 → ℝ) (u : R3 → E)
    (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ a) (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (x : R3) :
    directionalFDeriv X (fun y => a y • u y) x =
      directionalFDeriv X a x • u x + a x • directionalFDeriv X u x := by
  unfold directionalFDeriv
  rw [fderiv_fun_smul (ha.differentiable (by simp) x) (hu.differentiable (by simp) x)]
  change a x • fderiv ℝ u x X + fderiv ℝ a x X • u x = _
  exact add_comm _ _

lemma directionalFDeriv_clm_apply (X : R3) (b : R3 → E →L[ℝ] F) (u : R3 → E)
    (hb : ContDiff ℝ ∞ b) (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (x : R3) :
    directionalFDeriv X (fun y => b y (u y)) x =
      directionalFDeriv X b x (u x) + b x (directionalFDeriv X u x) := by
  unfold directionalFDeriv
  rw [fderiv_clm_apply (hb.differentiable (by simp) x) (hu.differentiable (by simp) x)]
  change b x (fderiv ℝ u x X) + fderiv ℝ b x X (u x) = _
  exact add_comm _ _

lemma directionalFDeriv_add (X : R3) (u v : R3 → E)
    (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ v) (x : R3) :
    directionalFDeriv X (fun y => u y + v y) x =
      directionalFDeriv X u x + directionalFDeriv X v x := by
  unfold directionalFDeriv
  rw [fderiv_fun_add (hu.differentiable (by simp) x) (hv.differentiable (by simp) x)]
  rfl

lemma directionalFDeriv_sum {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (X : R3) (u : ι → R3 → E)
    (hu : ∀ i ∈ s, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (u i)) (x : R3) :
    directionalFDeriv X (fun y => ∑ i ∈ s, u i y) x =
      ∑ i ∈ s, directionalFDeriv X (u i) x := by
  unfold directionalFDeriv
  rw [fderiv_fun_sum (fun i hi => (hu i hi).differentiable (by simp) x)]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply]

lemma directionalFDeriv_comm (X Y : R3) (u : R3 → E) (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (x : R3) :
    directionalFDeriv X (directionalFDeriv Y u) x =
      directionalFDeriv Y (directionalFDeriv X u) x := by
  have he (A B : R3) : directionalFDeriv A (directionalFDeriv B u) x =
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ u) x A B := by
    unfold directionalFDeriv
    rw [fderiv_clm_apply ((contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.mp hu).2.differentiable (by simp) x)
      (differentiableAt_const B)]
    simp
  rw [he X Y,he Y X]
  exact (hu.contDiffAt.isSymmSndFDerivAt (by simp)) X Y

lemma directionalFDeriv_third_permutation (X Y Z : R3) (u : R3 → E)
    (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (x : R3) :
    directionalFDeriv Z (directionalFDeriv X (directionalFDeriv Y u)) x =
      directionalFDeriv X (directionalFDeriv Y (directionalFDeriv Z u)) x := by
  rw [directionalFDeriv_comm Z X _ (contDiff_directionalFDeriv Y u hu) x]
  have he : directionalFDeriv Z (directionalFDeriv Y u) =
      directionalFDeriv Y (directionalFDeriv Z u) :=
    funext (directionalFDeriv_comm Z Y u hu)
  rw [he]

lemma directionalFDeriv_twice_clm_apply (X Y : R3) (b : R3 → E →L[ℝ] F)
    (u : R3 → E) (hb : ContDiff ℝ ∞ b) (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (x : R3) :
    directionalFDeriv X (directionalFDeriv Y (fun y => b y (u y))) x =
      directionalFDeriv X (directionalFDeriv Y b) x (u x) +
      directionalFDeriv Y b x (directionalFDeriv X u x) +
      directionalFDeriv X b x (directionalFDeriv Y u x) +
      b x (directionalFDeriv X (directionalFDeriv Y u) x) := by
  have hDb := contDiff_directionalFDeriv Y b hb
  have hDu := contDiff_directionalFDeriv Y u hu
  have he : directionalFDeriv Y (fun y => b y (u y)) =
      fun y => directionalFDeriv Y b y (u y) + b y (directionalFDeriv Y u y) :=
    funext (directionalFDeriv_clm_apply Y b u hb hu)
  rw [he,directionalFDeriv_add X _ _ (hDb.clm_apply hu) (hb.clm_apply hDu),
    directionalFDeriv_clm_apply X _ u hDb hu,
    directionalFDeriv_clm_apply X b _ hb hDu]
  abel

lemma mixed_principal_commutator (X Y Z : R3) (a : R3 → ℝ)
    (b : R3 → E →L[ℝ] F) (u : R3 → E) (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ a)
    (hb : ContDiff ℝ ∞ b) (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (x : R3) :
    b x (directionalFDeriv Z (fun y => a y • directionalFDeriv X (directionalFDeriv Y u) y) x) -
      a x • directionalFDeriv X (directionalFDeriv Y (fun y => b y (directionalFDeriv Z u y))) x =
      directionalFDeriv Z a x • b x (directionalFDeriv X (directionalFDeriv Y u) x) -
      a x • (directionalFDeriv X (directionalFDeriv Y b) x (directionalFDeriv Z u x) +
        directionalFDeriv Y b x (directionalFDeriv X (directionalFDeriv Z u) x) +
        directionalFDeriv X b x (directionalFDeriv Y (directionalFDeriv Z u) x)) := by
  rw [directionalFDeriv_smul Z a _ ha
      (contDiff_directionalFDeriv X _ (contDiff_directionalFDeriv Y u hu)),
    directionalFDeriv_twice_clm_apply X Y b _ hb (contDiff_directionalFDeriv Z u hu),
    map_add,map_smul,map_smul,directionalFDeriv_third_permutation X Y Z u hu x]
  simp only [smul_add]
  abel

def coordinateFirstOrder (b : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] F) (u : R3 → E) : R3 → F :=
  fun x => ∑ k : Fin 3, b k x (directionalFDeriv (PiLp.single 2 k 1) u x)

def coordinateScalarSecondOrder (a : Fin 3 × Fin 3 → R3 → ℝ) (u : R3 → E) : R3 → E :=
  fun x => ∑ q : Fin 3 × Fin 3,
    a q x • directionalFDeriv (PiLp.single 2 q.1 1) (directionalFDeriv (PiLp.single 2 q.2 1) u) x

theorem coordinate_principal_commutator (a : Fin 3 × Fin 3 → R3 → ℝ)
    (b : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] F) (u : R3 → E)
    (ha : ∀ q, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (a q)) (hb : ∀ k, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (b k))
    (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (x : R3) :
    coordinateFirstOrder b (coordinateScalarSecondOrder a u) x -
      coordinateScalarSecondOrder a (coordinateFirstOrder b u) x =
    ∑ k : Fin 3, ∑ q : Fin 3 × Fin 3,
      (directionalFDeriv (PiLp.single 2 k 1) (a q) x •
        b k x (directionalFDeriv (PiLp.single 2 q.1 1) (directionalFDeriv (PiLp.single 2 q.2 1) u) x) -
      a q x • (directionalFDeriv (PiLp.single 2 q.1 1) (directionalFDeriv (PiLp.single 2 q.2 1) (b k)) x
          (directionalFDeriv (PiLp.single 2 k 1) u x) +
        directionalFDeriv (PiLp.single 2 q.2 1) (b k) x
          (directionalFDeriv (PiLp.single 2 q.1 1) (directionalFDeriv (PiLp.single 2 k 1) u) x) +
        directionalFDeriv (PiLp.single 2 q.1 1) (b k) x
          (directionalFDeriv (PiLp.single 2 q.2 1) (directionalFDeriv (PiLp.single 2 k 1) u) x))) := by
  have hs (X : R3) : directionalFDeriv X (coordinateScalarSecondOrder a u) =
      fun y => ∑ q : Fin 3 × Fin 3, directionalFDeriv X
        (fun z => a q z • directionalFDeriv (PiLp.single 2 q.1 1)
          (directionalFDeriv (PiLp.single 2 q.2 1) u) z) y := by
    funext y
    exact directionalFDeriv_sum Finset.univ X _
      (fun q _ => (ha q).smul (contDiff_directionalFDeriv _ _ (contDiff_directionalFDeriv _ u hu))) y
  have ht (X Y : R3) : directionalFDeriv X (directionalFDeriv Y (coordinateFirstOrder b u)) =
      fun y => ∑ k : Fin 3, directionalFDeriv X (directionalFDeriv Y
        (fun z => b k z (directionalFDeriv (PiLp.single 2 k 1) u z))) y := by
    have he : directionalFDeriv Y (coordinateFirstOrder b u) = fun z =>
        ∑ k : Fin 3, directionalFDeriv Y
          (fun w => b k w (directionalFDeriv (PiLp.single 2 k 1) u w)) z := by
      funext z
      exact directionalFDeriv_sum Finset.univ Y _
        (fun k _ => (hb k).clm_apply (contDiff_directionalFDeriv _ u hu)) z
    rw [he]
    funext y
    exact directionalFDeriv_sum Finset.univ X _
      (fun k _ => contDiff_directionalFDeriv Y _
        ((hb k).clm_apply (contDiff_directionalFDeriv _ u hu))) y
  change (∑ k : Fin 3, b k x (directionalFDeriv (PiLp.single 2 k 1)
    (coordinateScalarSecondOrder a u) x)) -
    (∑ q : Fin 3 × Fin 3, a q x • directionalFDeriv (PiLp.single 2 q.1 1)
      (directionalFDeriv (PiLp.single 2 q.2 1) (coordinateFirstOrder b u)) x) = _
  simp_rw [hs,ht,map_sum,Finset.smul_sum]
  conv_lhs => rhs; rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _
  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro q _
  exact mixed_principal_commutator _ _ _ (a q) (b k) u (ha q) (hb k) hu x

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.MixedPrincipalCommutator

``````

import Calderon.PhysicalTensorHarmonicBridge

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.VariablePhysicalTensorBridge
open PhysicalTensorProductRule PhysicalTensorAmbientRealization PhysicalTensorHarmonicBridge
open SmoothMovingFrameFields AmbientCovectorComponents MovingFrameConnection RadiusProfile SphereHarmonic
open SmoothSphereFields SmoothSphereRotationProjection SpectralCoreRegularity

def variableReferenceCovariantTensorComponent {r : ℕ}
    (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (T : R3 × R3 → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => R3) ℝ)
    (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3) (a : Fin r → Fin 3) (X : R3 → R3) (q : R3 × R3) : ℝ :=
  referenceCovariantTensorComponent Γ T e a (X q.1) q

lemma variableReferenceCovariantTensorComponent_eq_ambient {r : ℕ}
    (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (T : R3 × R3 → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => R3) ℝ)
    (hT : ContDiff ℝ ∞ T) (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3)
    (hM : ContDiff ℝ ∞ M) (hE : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => e x j))
    (hsym : ∀ y U V, ⟪M y U,V⟫_ℝ = ⟪M y V,U⟫_ℝ)
    (he : ∀ y, IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (M y) (e y))
    (hcomp : ∀ y X U V, ⟪M y (Γ y X U),V⟫_ℝ + ⟪M y U,Γ y X V⟫_ℝ =
      ⟪fderiv ℝ M y X U,V⟫_ℝ) (a : Fin r → Fin 3) (X : R3 → R3) (q : R3 × R3) :
    variableReferenceCovariantTensorComponent Γ T e a X q =
      ambientCovectorDerivative (fun y => frameConnectionCoefficient M Γ e y (X y))
        X (ambientPhysicalTensorComponent T e) a q := by
  exact referenceCovariantTensorComponent_eq_ambient M Γ T hT e hM hE hsym he hcomp a (X q.1) q

lemma contDiff_variableReferenceCovariantTensorComponent {r : ℕ}
    (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (T : R3 × R3 → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => R3) ℝ)
    (hT : ContDiff ℝ ∞ T) (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3)
    (hM : ContDiff ℝ ∞ M) (hΓ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Γ)
    (hE : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => e x j))
    (hsym : ∀ y U V, ⟪M y U,V⟫_ℝ = ⟪M y V,U⟫_ℝ)
    (he : ∀ y, IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (M y) (e y))
    (hcomp : ∀ y X U V, ⟪M y (Γ y X U),V⟫_ℝ + ⟪M y U,Γ y X V⟫_ℝ =
      ⟪fderiv ℝ M y X U,V⟫_ℝ) (a : Fin r → Fin 3)
    (X : R3 → R3) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (variableReferenceCovariantTensorComponent Γ T e a X) := by
  have hf : variableReferenceCovariantTensorComponent Γ T e a X =
      ambientCovectorDerivative (fun y => frameConnectionCoefficient M Γ e y (X y))
        X (ambientPhysicalTensorComponent T e) a := by
    funext q
    exact variableReferenceCovariantTensorComponent_eq_ambient M Γ T hT e hM hE hsym he hcomp a X q
  rw [hf]
  exact contDiff_ambientCovectorDerivative _
    (fun i j => contDiff_frameConnectionCoefficient_field M Γ e hM hΓ hE X hX i j)
    X hX _ (fun b => contDiff_ambientPhysicalTensorComponent T hT e hE b) a

lemma sphereHarmonicCoordinate_variableReferenceCovariantTensorComponent {r : ℕ}
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (k : ℕ)
    (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (T : R3 × R3 → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => R3) ℝ)
    (hT : ContDiff ℝ ∞ T) (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3)
    (hM : ContDiff ℝ ∞ M) (hΓ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Γ)
    (hE : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => e x j))
    (hsym : ∀ y U V, ⟪M y U,V⟫_ℝ = ⟪M y V,U⟫_ℝ)
    (he : ∀ y, IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (M y) (e y))
    (hcomp : ∀ y X U V, ⟪M y (Γ y X U),V⟫_ℝ + ⟪M y U,Γ y X V⟫_ℝ =
      ⟪fderiv ℝ M y X U,V⟫_ℝ) (a : Fin r → Fin 3)
    (X : R3 → R3) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X) (x : R3) :
    let G := ambientPhysicalTensorComponent T e
    let hG := fun b => contDiff_ambientPhysicalTensorComponent T hT e hE b
    let C := fun y => frameConnectionCoefficient M Γ e y (X y)

      (contDiff_variableReferenceCovariantTensorComponent M Γ T hT e hM hΓ hE hsym he hcomp a X hX) x) =
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (ambientSphereL2 (G a) (hG a) y)) x (X x) +
      (1/2 : ℝ) • (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, C x i j • harmonicSphereRotation k i j
        (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (ambientSphereL2 (G a) (hG a) x))) -
      ∑ s : Fin r, ∑ j : Fin 3, C x j (a s) • sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k
        (ambientSphereL2 (G (Function.update a s j)) (hG (Function.update a s j)) x) := by
  have hf : variableReferenceCovariantTensorComponent Γ T e a X =
      ambientCovectorDerivative (fun y => frameConnectionCoefficient M Γ e y (X y))
        X (ambientPhysicalTensorComponent T e) a := by
    funext q
    exact variableReferenceCovariantTensorComponent_eq_ambient M Γ T hT e hM hE hsym he hcomp a X q
  simp only [hf]
  exact sphereHarmonicCoordinate_metricCovectorDerivative hO hD k M Γ e hM hΓ hE hsym he hcomp
    X hX (ambientPhysicalTensorComponent T e)
    (fun b => contDiff_ambientPhysicalTensorComponent T hT e hE b) a x

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.VariablePhysicalTensorBridge

## Calderon.PositiveSpectralCore

SHA256 `e59986124bf11753c5e724f09b8b62c8a83dafca1c8a0a6eabb9a2bbc864f130`.

``````lean
import Calderon.SpectralCoreRegularity

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory MvPolynomial Filter
open scoped InnerProductSpace ContDiff Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.PositiveSpectralCore
open SphereHarmonic SphereHilbertDecomposition SpectralCoreRegularity

lemma sphereMean_sphereHarmonicCoordinate_zero (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (u : SphereL2) :
    sphereMean (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD 0 u : SphereL2) = sphereMean u := by
  let e : harmonicSphereSubspace 0 :=
    ⟨polynomialSphereL2 (C 1), polynomialSphereL2_mem 0 (C 1) (C_harmonicHomogeneous 1)⟩
  have hi := (sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD).inner_map_map (e : SphereL2) u
  rw [sphereHarmonicDecomposition_subtype hO hD 0 e, lp.inner_single_left] at hi
  exact hi

theorem sphereHarmonicCoordinate_zero_eq_mean (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (u : SphereL2) :
    (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD 0 u : SphereL2) =
      sphereMean u • polynomialSphereL2 (C 1) := by
  have hm := sphereHarmonicDecomposition_zero_mem_constants hO hD u
  obtain ⟨r,hr⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hm
  have hmean := sphereMean_sphereHarmonicCoordinate_zero hO hD u
  change sphereMean (sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD u 0 : SphereL2) = sphereMean u at hmean
  rw [← hr, map_smul, sphereMean_constant_one] at hmean
  simp only [smul_eq_mul, mul_one] at hmean
  change (sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD u 0 : SphereL2) = _
  rw [← hr, hmean]

lemma sphereHarmonicCoordinate_zero_eq_zero_iff (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (u : SphereL2) :
    sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD 0 u = 0 ↔ sphereMean u = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro hz
    have hm := sphereMean_sphereHarmonicCoordinate_zero hO hD u
    rw [hz] at hm
    simpa using hm.symm
  · intro hm
    apply Subtype.ext
    simpa [hm] using sphereHarmonicCoordinate_zero_eq_mean hO hD u

def spherePositiveProjection (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) : SphereL2 →L[ℝ] SphereL2 :=
  ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ SphereL2 - (harmonicSphereSubspace 0).subtypeL.comp
    (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD 0)

lemma spherePositiveProjection_apply (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (u : SphereL2) :
    spherePositiveProjection hO hD u = u - sphereMean u • polynomialSphereL2 (C 1) := by
  simp [spherePositiveProjection, sphereHarmonicCoordinate_zero_eq_mean]

lemma spherePositiveProjection_mem_meanZero (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (u : SphereL2) :
    spherePositiveProjection hO hD u ∈ meanZeroSphere := by
  change sphereMean (spherePositiveProjection hO hD u) = 0
  rw [spherePositiveProjection_apply, map_sub, map_smul, sphereMean_constant_one]
  simp

lemma spherePositiveProjection_eq_self (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (u : SphereL2) (hu : sphereMean u = 0) :
    spherePositiveProjection hO hD u = u := by
  simp [spherePositiveProjection_apply, hu]

lemma spherePositiveProjection_idempotent (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (u : SphereL2) :
    spherePositiveProjection hO hD (spherePositiveProjection hO hD u) =
      spherePositiveProjection hO hD u :=
  spherePositiveProjection_eq_self hO hD _ (spherePositiveProjection_mem_meanZero hO hD u)

lemma spherePositiveProjection_constant_one (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) :
    spherePositiveProjection hO hD (polynomialSphereL2 (C 1)) = 0 := by
  rw [spherePositiveProjection_apply, sphereMean_constant_one, one_smul, sub_self]

def spherePositivePartialSum (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (n : ℕ) : SphereL2 →L[ℝ] SphereL2 :=
  ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (harmonicSphereSubspace (k+1)).subtypeL.comp
    (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (k+1))

lemma spherePositivePartialSum_apply (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (n : ℕ) (u : SphereL2) :
    spherePositivePartialSum hO hD n u =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD u (k+1) : SphereL2) := by
  simp [spherePositivePartialSum, sphereHarmonicCoordinate_apply]

lemma spherePositivePartialSum_eq_sub (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (n : ℕ) (u : SphereL2) :
    spherePositivePartialSum hO hD n u = sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD (n+1) u -
      (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD 0 u : SphereL2) := by
  rw [spherePositivePartialSum_apply, sphereHarmonicPartialSum_apply, Finset.sum_range_succ']
  simp only [sphereHarmonicCoordinate_apply]
  abel

lemma spherePositivePartialSum_mem_meanZero (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (n : ℕ) (u : SphereL2) :
    spherePositivePartialSum hO hD n u ∈ meanZeroSphere := by
  rw [spherePositivePartialSum_apply]
  apply meanZeroSphere.sum_mem
  intro k hk
  exact harmonicSphereSubspace_le_meanZero hO (k+1) (by omega)
    (sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD u (k+1)).property

theorem tendsto_spherePositivePartialSum (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (u : SphereL2) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => spherePositivePartialSum hO hD n u) atTop
      (𝓝 (spherePositiveProjection hO hD u)) := by
  have ht := (tendsto_sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD u).comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)
  have hs := ht.sub_const (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD 0 u : SphereL2)
  simpa only [spherePositivePartialSum_eq_sub, spherePositiveProjection_apply,
    sphereHarmonicCoordinate_zero_eq_mean, Function.comp_def] using hs

theorem tendsto_spherePositivePartialSum_of_meanZero (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (u : SphereL2) (hu : sphereMean u = 0) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => spherePositivePartialSum hO hD n u) atTop (𝓝 u) := by
  simpa only [spherePositiveProjection_eq_self hO hD u hu] using
    tendsto_spherePositivePartialSum hO hD u

lemma contDiff_spherePositivePartialSum (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (n : ℕ) (U : R3 → SphereL2)
    (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => spherePositivePartialSum hO hD n (U x)) :=
  (spherePositivePartialSum hO hD n).contDiff.comp hU

lemma hasCompactSupport_spherePositivePartialSum (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (n : ℕ) (U : R3 → SphereL2)
    (hU : HasCompactSupport U) :
    HasCompactSupport (fun x => spherePositivePartialSum hO hD n (U x)) :=
  hU.comp_left (map_zero (spherePositivePartialSum hO hD n))

lemma spherePositivePartialSum_eq_zero_of_eq_zero (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (n : ℕ) (U : R3 → SphereL2) (x : R3) (hU : U x = 0) :
    spherePositivePartialSum hO hD n (U x) = 0 := by
  rw [hU, map_zero]

lemma fderiv_spherePositivePartialSum (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (n : ℕ) (U : R3 → SphereL2) (x : R3)
    (hU : DifferentiableAt ℝ U x) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun y => spherePositivePartialSum hO hD n (U y)) x =
      (spherePositivePartialSum hO hD n).comp (fderiv ℝ U x) :=
  ((spherePositivePartialSum hO hD n).hasFDerivAt.comp x hU.hasFDerivAt).fderiv

lemma sphereMean_fderiv_eq_zero (U : R3 → SphereL2) (x X : R3)
    (hU : DifferentiableAt ℝ U x) (hmean : ∀ y, sphereMean (U y) = 0) :
    sphereMean (fderiv ℝ U x X) = 0 := by
  have hfun : (fun y => sphereMean (U y)) = (fun _ : R3 => (0 : ℝ)) := funext hmean
  have hf := (sphereMean.hasFDerivAt.comp x hU.hasFDerivAt).fderiv
  change fderiv ℝ (fun y => sphereMean (U y)) x = sphereMean.comp (fderiv ℝ U x) at hf
  rw [hfun] at hf
  have hz : fderiv ℝ (fun _ : R3 => (0 : ℝ)) x = 0 := (hasFDerivAt_const (0 : ℝ) x).fderiv
  rw [hz] at hf
  have hv := congrArg (fun T : R3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => T X) hf
  simpa using hv.symm

theorem tendsto_fderiv_spherePositivePartialSum_apply (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (U : R3 → SphereL2) (x X : R3)
    (hU : DifferentiableAt ℝ U x) (hmean : ∀ y, sphereMean (U y) = 0) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => fderiv ℝ
      (fun y => spherePositivePartialSum hO hD n (U y)) x X)
      atTop (𝓝 (fderiv ℝ U x X)) := by
  simp_rw [fderiv_spherePositivePartialSum hO hD _ U x hU,
    ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
  exact tendsto_spherePositivePartialSum_of_meanZero hO hD _
    (sphereMean_fderiv_eq_zero U x X hU hmean)

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.PositiveSpectralCore

``````

## Calderon.FiniteSpectralPadding

SHA256 `d2996fa62a6129969de0b2d922dc78a61ea3fb68b57baede00fcf8fff315a6cc`.

``````lean
import Calderon.PositiveSpectralCore
import Calderon.FiniteHarmonicEnergy

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory MvPolynomial
open scoped ContDiff Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.FiniteSpectralPadding
open SphereHarmonic SphereHilbertDecomposition SpectralCoreRegularity PositiveSpectralCore RadiusProfile
  FischerConnectionTransport FiniteHarmonicEnergy MetricFiberMeasure MetricOperator ConformalDepth
  FrameCurvaturePolynomial
variable {σ : Type*} [Fintype σ]

def paddedHarmonicBasis (n : σ → ℕ)
    (b : ∀ a : σ, Fin (n a) → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (a : σ) (s : Σ a : σ, Fin (n a)) : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ := by
  classical
  exact if h : s.1 = a then b a (h ▸ s.2) else 0

def coefficientPadding (n : σ → ℕ) (a : σ) :
    (Fin (n a) → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ((Σ a : σ, Fin (n a)) → ℝ) := by
  classical
  exact ContinuousLinearMap.pi (fun s => if h : s.1 = a then
    ContinuousLinearMap.proj (h ▸ s.2) else 0)

lemma paddedHarmonicBasis_same (n : σ → ℕ)
    (b : ∀ a : σ, Fin (n a) → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (a : σ) (j : Fin (n a)) :
    paddedHarmonicBasis n b a ⟨a,j⟩ = b a j := by
  simp [paddedHarmonicBasis]

lemma paddedHarmonicBasis_ne (n : σ → ℕ)
    (b : ∀ a : σ, Fin (n a) → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (a a' : σ)
    (h : a' ≠ a) (j : Fin (n a')) : paddedHarmonicBasis n b a ⟨a',j⟩ = 0 := by
  simp [paddedHarmonicBasis,h]

lemma coefficientPadding_same (n : σ → ℕ) (a : σ) (c : Fin (n a) → ℝ) (j : Fin (n a)) :
    coefficientPadding n a c ⟨a,j⟩ = c j := by
  simp [coefficientPadding]

lemma coefficientPadding_ne (n : σ → ℕ) (a a' : σ) (h : a' ≠ a)
    (c : Fin (n a) → ℝ) (j : Fin (n a')) : coefficientPadding n a c ⟨a',j⟩ = 0 := by
  simp [coefficientPadding,h]

lemma paddedHarmonicBasis_harmonicHomogeneous (n : σ → ℕ) (d : σ → ℕ)
    (b : ∀ a : σ, Fin (n a) → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ a j, b a j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (d a)) (a : σ)
    (s : Σ a : σ, Fin (n a)) : paddedHarmonicBasis n b a s ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (d a) := by
  classical
  unfold paddedHarmonicBasis
  split_ifs with h
  · exact hb a (h ▸ s.2)
  · exact (harmonicHomogeneous (d a)).zero_mem

lemma contDiff_coefficientPadding (n : σ → ℕ) (a : σ)
    (c : R3 → Fin (n a) → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => coefficientPadding n a (c x)) :=
  (coefficientPadding n a).contDiff.comp hc

lemma hasCompactSupport_coefficientPadding (n : σ → ℕ) (a : σ)
    (c : R3 → Fin (n a) → ℝ) (hc : HasCompactSupport c) :
    HasCompactSupport (fun x => coefficientPadding n a (c x)) :=
  hc.comp_left (map_zero (coefficientPadding n a))

lemma coefficientPadding_eq_zero (n : σ → ℕ) (a : σ) (c : Fin (n a) → ℝ) (hc : c = 0) :
    coefficientPadding n a c = 0 := by
  rw [hc,map_zero]

theorem finitePolynomialField_padding (n : σ → ℕ)
    (b : ∀ a : σ, Fin (n a) → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : ∀ a : σ, R3 → Fin (n a) → ℝ) (a : σ) (x : R3) :
    finitePolynomialField (paddedHarmonicBasis n b a)
      (fun y => coefficientPadding n a (c a y)) x = finitePolynomialField (b a) (c a) x := by
  classical
  unfold finitePolynomialField
  rw [Fintype.sum_sigma]
  calc
    _ = ∑ j : Fin (n a), coefficientPadding n a (c a x) ⟨a,j⟩ •
        paddedHarmonicBasis n b a ⟨a,j⟩ := by
      apply Finset.sum_eq_single a
      · intro a' _ hne
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
        intro j _
        change coefficientPadding n a (c a x) ⟨a',j⟩ • paddedHarmonicBasis n b a ⟨a',j⟩ = 0
        rw [coefficientPadding_ne n a a' hne]
        exact zero_smul ℝ _
      · simp
    _ = _ := by simp only [coefficientPadding_same,paddedHarmonicBasis_same]

theorem exists_common_smooth_compact_sphereHarmonicCoordinates
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (d : σ → ℕ)
    (U : R3 → SphereL2) (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hzero : ∀ x ∉ K, U x = 0) :
    ∃ n : σ → ℕ, ∃ b : σ → (Σ a : σ, Fin (n a)) → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ,
      ∃ c : σ → R3 → (Σ a : σ, Fin (n a)) → ℝ,
        (∀ a j, b a j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (d a)) ∧
        (∀ a, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (c a)) ∧ (∀ a, HasCompactSupport (c a)) ∧
        (∀ a x, polynomialSphereL2 (finitePolynomialField (b a) (c a) x) =
          (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (d a) (U x) : SphereL2)) ∧
        (∀ a x, x ∉ K → c a x = 0) ∧
        (∀ a x, x ∉ K → finitePolynomialField (b a) (c a) x = 0) := by
  classical
  have hex (a : σ) := exists_smooth_compact_coordinates_sphereHarmonicCoordinate
    hO hD (d a) U hU K hK hzero
  choose n b c hb hc hcompact hrep hcz using hex
  refine ⟨n,paddedHarmonicBasis n b,fun a x => coefficientPadding n a (c a x),
    paddedHarmonicBasis_harmonicHomogeneous n d b hb,
    fun a => contDiff_coefficientPadding n a (c a) (hc a),
    fun a => hasCompactSupport_coefficientPadding n a (c a) (hcompact a),?_,?_,?_⟩
  · intro a x
    rw [finitePolynomialField_padding]
    exact hrep a x
  · intro a x hx
    change coefficientPadding n a (c a x) = 0
    rw [hcz a x hx,map_zero]
  · intro a x hx
    rw [finitePolynomialField_padding]
    simp [finitePolynomialField,hcz a x hx]

lemma finiteReferenceSection_eq_zero_off (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (b : σ → ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : σ → R3 → ι → ℝ) (K : Set R3) (hz : ∀ a x, x ∉ K → c a x = 0)
    (x v : R3) (hx : x ∉ K) : finiteReferenceSection g L lam b c (x,v) = 0 := by
  rw [finiteReferenceSection_eq_metricFramePolynomial]
  have hp : ∀ a, finitePolynomialField (b a) (c a) x = 0 := by
    intro a
    simp [finitePolynomialField,hz a x hx]
  simp [hp,metricFramePolynomial]

lemma polynomialSphereL2_sum_eq_spherePositivePartialSum
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (N : ℕ)
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (b : Fin N → ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : Fin N → R3 → ι → ℝ) (U : R3 → SphereL2)
    (hr : ∀ a x, polynomialSphereL2 (finitePolynomialField (b a) (c a) x) =
      (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (a.val+1) (U x) : SphereL2)) (x : R3) :
    polynomialSphereL2 (∑ a, finitePolynomialField (b a) (c a) x) =
      spherePositivePartialSum hO hD N (U x) := by
  rw [map_sum,spherePositivePartialSum_apply]
  simp_rw [hr,sphereHarmonicCoordinate_apply]
  exact Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun k => (sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD (U x) (k+1) : SphereL2)) N

theorem exists_spectralCore_uniform_coercivity (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ L cRaise : ℝ, 0 < L ∧ 0 < cRaise ∧
      ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ p : ℕ, 2 ≤ p ∧ ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧
        (∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 → ∀ x ∈ K,
          ‖fderiv ℝ (referenceRadius δ R p L) x‖ ≤ ε ∧
          referenceRadius δ R p L x * referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x^2 ≤ ε) ∧
        ∀ hF : SphereFischerInner, ∀ hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics,
          ∀ hD : DenseSphereHarmonics, ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1,
          ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 → ∀ N : ℕ, ∀ U : R3 → SphereL2,
          ContDiff ℝ ∞ U → (∀ x ∉ K, U x = 0) →
          ∃ n : Fin N → ℕ,
            ∃ b : Fin N → (Σ a : Fin N, Fin (n a)) → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ,
              ∃ c : Fin N → R3 → (Σ a : Fin N, Fin (n a)) → ℝ,
                (∀ a j, b a j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (a.val+1)) ∧
                (∀ a, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (c a)) ∧ (∀ a, HasCompactSupport (c a)) ∧
                (∀ x, polynomialSphereL2 (∑ a, finitePolynomialField (b a) (c a) x) =
                  spherePositivePartialSum hO hD N (U x)) ∧
                (∀ x ∉ K, ∀ v : R3, finiteReferenceSection g L lam b c (x,v) = 0) ∧
                cRaise*finiteReferenceProfileEnergy g hg lam δ R L p (fun a => a.val) b c ≤
                  finiteReferenceRaisingEnergy g hg L lam (fun a => a.val) b c (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) -
                    finiteReferenceLoweringEnergy g hg L lam (fun a => a.val) b c (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) := by
  obtain ⟨L,C,hL,hC,hall⟩ := exists_finiteReferenceProfileEnergy_uniform_coercivity.{0,0} g hg K hK
  refine ⟨L,C,hL,hC,?_⟩
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨p,hp,R,hR,hsmall,hcoerc⟩ := hall ε hε
  refine ⟨p,hp,R,hR,hsmall,?_⟩
  intro hF hO hD lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 N U hU hzero
  obtain ⟨n,b,c,hb,hc,hcompact,hrep,hcz,hpz⟩ :=
    exists_common_smooth_compact_sphereHarmonicCoordinates hO hD
      (fun a : Fin N => a.val+1) U hU K hK hzero
  have hsupp : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ v : R3, finiteReferenceSection g L lam b c (x,v) = 0 := by
    intro x hx v
    exact finiteReferenceSection_eq_zero_off g L lam b c K hcz x v hx
  refine ⟨n,b,c,hb,hc,hcompact,
    polynomialSphereL2_sum_eq_spherePositivePartialSum hO hD N b c U hrep,hsupp,?_⟩
  exact hcoerc (Fin N) (Σ a : Fin N, Fin (n a)) hF hO lam hlam δ hδ hδ1
    (fun a => a.val) Fin.val_injective b hb c hc hcompact (fun x hx v _ => hsupp x hx v)

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.FiniteSpectralPadding

## Calderon.SphereDerivativeAdjoint

SHA256 `3388a0e4bf4bf723489cbe84bf2c2413a7589f423890b3cef98a4b131fb0d16a`.

``````lean
import Calderon.HarmonicCoordinateCompatibility
import Calderon.SpherePositiveDensity

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MvPolynomial
open scoped InnerProductSpace
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SphereDerivativeAdjoint
open SphereHarmonic AngularPolynomial HarmonicCoordinateCompatibility

def sphereDerivativeAdjoint (k : ℕ) (i : Fin 3) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ := C (2*(k:ℝ)+3) * coordinateHarmonicRaising k i p

lemma sphereDerivativeAdjoint_eq_raisingComponent (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (i : Fin 3) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    sphereDerivativeAdjoint k i p = raisingComponent k i p := by
  rw [sphereDerivativeAdjoint,coordinateHarmonicRaising_eq_harmonicRaising k hk,
    raisingComponent,sphereRaising]
  congr 2
  rw [Nat.cast_sub hk]
  simp only [Nat.cast_one,Fintype.card_fin,Nat.cast_ofNat]
  ring

lemma sphereDerivativeAdjoint_zero_C (i : Fin 3) (r : ℝ) :
    sphereDerivativeAdjoint 0 i (C r) = C 3 * (X i * C r) := by
  simp [sphereDerivativeAdjoint,coordinateHarmonicRaising]

lemma eq_C_of_harmonicHomogeneous_zero (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hp : p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous 0) : p = C (p.coeff 0) :=
  totalDegree_eq_zero_iff_eq_C.mp ((totalDegree_zero_iff_isHomogeneous (Fin 3)).2 hp.1)

theorem sphereDerivativeAdjoint_harmonicHomogeneous (k : ℕ) (i : Fin 3)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hp : p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) :
    sphereDerivativeAdjoint k i p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (k+1) := by
  cases k with
  | zero =>
    rw [eq_C_of_harmonicHomogeneous_zero p hp,sphereDerivativeAdjoint_zero_C]
    refine ⟨?_,?_⟩
    · simpa using ((isHomogeneous_X (R := ℝ) i).mul
        (isHomogeneous_C (Fin 3) (p.coeff 0))).C_mul 3
    · rw [laplacian_C_mul,laplacian_X_mul]
      simp [laplacian]
  | succ k =>
    rw [sphereDerivativeAdjoint_eq_raisingComponent (k+1) (by omega)]
    exact raisingComponent_harmonicHomogeneous (k+1) (by omega) i p hp

theorem sphereDerivativeAdjoint_inner_adjoint (hF : SphereFischerInner) (k : ℕ)
    (i : Fin 3) (p h : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hp : p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) (hh : h ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (k+1)) :
    ⟪polynomialSphereL2 (sphereDerivativeAdjoint k i p),polynomialSphereL2 h⟫_ℝ =
      ⟪polynomialSphereL2 p,polynomialSphereL2 (pderiv i h)⟫_ℝ := by
  cases k with
  | zero =>
    rw [hF 1 _ h (sphereDerivativeAdjoint_harmonicHomogeneous 0 i p hp) hh,
      hF 0 p _ hp (pderiv_harmonicHomogeneous_succ 0 i h hh)]
    rw [eq_C_of_harmonicHomogeneous_zero p hp,sphereDerivativeAdjoint_zero_C]
    simp only [normalizedFischerInner,fischerInner_C_mul_left,fischerInner_X_mul_left,
      Fintype.card_fin,sphereNormalization_succ,sphereNormalization_zero,Nat.cast_zero,
      Nat.cast_ofNat,mul_zero,add_zero,mul_one,div_one]
    ring
  | succ k =>
    rw [sphereDerivativeAdjoint_eq_raisingComponent (k+1) (by omega)]
    exact raisingComponent_inner_adjoint hF (k+1) (by omega) i p h hp hh

lemma sum_double_sphereDerivativeAdjoint_pair_eq_zero (hF : SphereFischerInner) (k : ℕ)
    (p h : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hp : p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k)
    (hh : h ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (k+2)) :
    (∑ i : Fin 3, ⟪polynomialSphereL2
      (sphereDerivativeAdjoint (k+1) i (sphereDerivativeAdjoint k i p)),
      polynomialSphereL2 h⟫_ℝ) = 0 := by
  have hh' : h ∈ harmonicHomogeneous ((k+1)+1) := by simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using hh
  simp_rw [sphereDerivativeAdjoint_inner_adjoint hF (k+1) _ _ h
    (sphereDerivativeAdjoint_harmonicHomogeneous k _ p hp) hh']
  simp_rw [sphereDerivativeAdjoint_inner_adjoint hF k _ p _ hp
    (pderiv_harmonicHomogeneous_succ (k+1) _ h hh')]
  rw [← inner_sum,← map_sum]
  change ⟪polynomialSphereL2 p,polynomialSphereL2 (laplacian h)⟫_ℝ = 0
  rw [hh.2,map_zero,inner_zero_right]

theorem sum_double_sphereDerivativeAdjoint_eq_zero (hF : SphereFischerInner) (k : ℕ)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hp : p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) :
    (∑ i : Fin 3, sphereDerivativeAdjoint (k+1) i (sphereDerivativeAdjoint k i p)) = 0 := by
  let s := ∑ i : Fin 3, sphereDerivativeAdjoint (k+1) i (sphereDerivativeAdjoint k i p)
  have hs : s ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (k+2) := by
    apply (harmonicHomogeneous (k+2)).sum_mem
    intro i hi
    simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using sphereDerivativeAdjoint_harmonicHomogeneous (k+1) i _
      (sphereDerivativeAdjoint_harmonicHomogeneous k i p hp)
  have hn : ‖polynomialSphereL2 s‖^2 = 0 := by
    rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
    change ⟪polynomialSphereL2 (∑ i : Fin 3, sphereDerivativeAdjoint (k+1) i
      (sphereDerivativeAdjoint k i p)),polynomialSphereL2 s⟫_ℝ = 0
    rw [map_sum,sum_inner]
    simpa only [s,map_sum] using sum_double_sphereDerivativeAdjoint_pair_eq_zero hF k p s hp hs
  exact (polynomialSphereL2_eq_zero_iff hF (k+2) s hs).mp
    (norm_eq_zero.mp (sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hn))

lemma sphereDerivativeAdjoint_C_mul (k : ℕ) (i : Fin 3) (r : ℝ)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    sphereDerivativeAdjoint k i (C r*p) = C r*sphereDerivativeAdjoint k i p := by
  simp only [sphereDerivativeAdjoint,coordinateHarmonicRaising,pderiv_C_mul]
  ring

lemma sphereDerivativeAdjoint_add (k : ℕ) (i : Fin 3) (p q : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    sphereDerivativeAdjoint k i (p+q) = sphereDerivativeAdjoint k i p +
      sphereDerivativeAdjoint k i q := by
  simp only [sphereDerivativeAdjoint,coordinateHarmonicRaising,map_add]
  ring

lemma sphereDerivativeAdjoint_zero (k : ℕ) (i : Fin 3) :
    sphereDerivativeAdjoint k i 0 = 0 := by
  simp [sphereDerivativeAdjoint,coordinateHarmonicRaising]

lemma sphereDerivativeAdjoint_constant_one (i : Fin 3) :
    sphereDerivativeAdjoint 0 i (C 1) = C 3*X i := by
  simpa only [map_one,mul_one] using sphereDerivativeAdjoint_zero_C i 1

lemma sphereDerivativeAdjoint_degree_commutator (k : ℕ) (i : Fin 3)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    polynomialSphereL2 (C ((k+1:ℕ):ℝ)*sphereDerivativeAdjoint k i p) -
      polynomialSphereL2 (sphereDerivativeAdjoint k i (C (k:ℝ)*p)) =
        polynomialSphereL2 (sphereDerivativeAdjoint k i p) := by
  rw [sphereDerivativeAdjoint_C_mul,← map_sub]
  congr 1
  simp only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one,map_add,map_one]
  ring

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SphereDerivativeAdjoint

``````

``````lean
import Calderon.PhysicalTensorAmbientRealization

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.PhysicalTensorHarmonicBridge
open PhysicalTensorProductRule PhysicalTensorAmbientRealization SmoothMovingFrameFields
open AmbientCovectorComponents MovingFrameConnection RadiusProfile SphereHarmonic
open SmoothSphereFields SmoothSphereRotationProjection SpectralCoreRegularity

lemma movingFrameCoordinateVector_frameReconstruction
    (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3) (q : R3 × R3)
    (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (M q.1) (e q.1)) :
    movingFrameCoordinateVector M e (q.1,frameReconstruction e q) = q.2 := by
  ext i
  change ⟪M q.1 (∑ j : Fin 3, q.2 j • e q.1 j),e q.1 i⟫_ℝ = q.2 i
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp [Fin.sum_univ_three, map_add, map_smul, inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left,
      he 0 0, he 0 1, he 0 2, he 1 0, he 1 1, he 1 2, he 2 0, he 2 1, he 2 2]

def referenceCovariantTensorComponent {r : ℕ}
    (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (T : R3 × R3 → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => R3) ℝ)
    (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3) (a : Fin r → Fin 3) (X : R3) (q : R3 × R3) : ℝ :=
  physicalCovariantTensorEvaluation Γ T e a (q.1,frameReconstruction e q) X

lemma referenceCovariantTensorComponent_eq_ambient {r : ℕ}
    (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (T : R3 × R3 → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => R3) ℝ)
    (hT : ContDiff ℝ ∞ T) (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3)
    (hM : ContDiff ℝ ∞ M) (hE : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => e x j))
    (hsym : ∀ y U V, ⟪M y U,V⟫_ℝ = ⟪M y V,U⟫_ℝ)
    (he : ∀ y, IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (M y) (e y))
    (hcomp : ∀ y X U V, ⟪M y (Γ y X U),V⟫_ℝ + ⟪M y U,Γ y X V⟫_ℝ =
      ⟪fderiv ℝ M y X U,V⟫_ℝ) (a : Fin r → Fin 3) (X : R3) (q : R3 × R3) :
    referenceCovariantTensorComponent Γ T e a X q =
      ambientCovectorDerivative (fun y => frameConnectionCoefficient M Γ e y X)
        (fun _ => X) (ambientPhysicalTensorComponent T e) a q := by
  unfold referenceCovariantTensorComponent
  rw [physicalCovariantTensorEvaluation_eq_ambientCovectorDerivative M Γ T hT e hM hE hsym he hcomp
    a q.1 (frameReconstruction e q) X]
  rw [movingFrameCoordinateVector_frameReconstruction M e q (he q.1)]

lemma contDiff_referenceCovariantTensorComponent {r : ℕ}
    (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (T : R3 × R3 → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => R3) ℝ)
    (hT : ContDiff ℝ ∞ T) (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3)
    (hM : ContDiff ℝ ∞ M) (hΓ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Γ)
    (hE : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => e x j))
    (hsym : ∀ y U V, ⟪M y U,V⟫_ℝ = ⟪M y V,U⟫_ℝ)
    (he : ∀ y, IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (M y) (e y))
    (hcomp : ∀ y X U V, ⟪M y (Γ y X U),V⟫_ℝ + ⟪M y U,Γ y X V⟫_ℝ =
      ⟪fderiv ℝ M y X U,V⟫_ℝ) (a : Fin r → Fin 3) (X : R3) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (referenceCovariantTensorComponent Γ T e a X) := by
  have hf : referenceCovariantTensorComponent Γ T e a X =
      ambientCovectorDerivative (fun y => frameConnectionCoefficient M Γ e y X)
        (fun _ => X) (ambientPhysicalTensorComponent T e) a := by
    funext q
    exact referenceCovariantTensorComponent_eq_ambient M Γ T hT e hM hE hsym he hcomp a X q
  rw [hf]
  exact contDiff_ambientCovectorDerivative _
    (fun i j => contDiff_frameConnectionCoefficient_field M Γ e hM hΓ hE (fun _ => X) contDiff_const i j)
    (fun _ => X) contDiff_const _ (fun b => contDiff_ambientPhysicalTensorComponent T hT e hE b) a

lemma sphereHarmonicCoordinate_referenceCovariantTensorComponent {r : ℕ}
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (k : ℕ)
    (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (T : R3 × R3 → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => R3) ℝ)
    (hT : ContDiff ℝ ∞ T) (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3)
    (hM : ContDiff ℝ ∞ M) (hΓ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Γ)
    (hE : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => e x j))
    (hsym : ∀ y U V, ⟪M y U,V⟫_ℝ = ⟪M y V,U⟫_ℝ)
    (he : ∀ y, IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (M y) (e y))
    (hcomp : ∀ y X U V, ⟪M y (Γ y X U),V⟫_ℝ + ⟪M y U,Γ y X V⟫_ℝ =
      ⟪fderiv ℝ M y X U,V⟫_ℝ) (a : Fin r → Fin 3) (X x : R3) :
    let G := ambientPhysicalTensorComponent T e
    let hG := fun b => contDiff_ambientPhysicalTensorComponent T hT e hE b
    let C := fun y => frameConnectionCoefficient M Γ e y X
    sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (ambientSphereL2 (referenceCovariantTensorComponent Γ T e a X)
      (contDiff_referenceCovariantTensorComponent M Γ T hT e hM hΓ hE hsym he hcomp a X) x) =
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (ambientSphereL2 (G a) (hG a) y)) x X +
      (1/2 : ℝ) • (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, C x i j • harmonicSphereRotation k i j
        (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (ambientSphereL2 (G a) (hG a) x))) -
      ∑ s : Fin r, ∑ j : Fin 3, C x j (a s) • sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k
        (ambientSphereL2 (G (Function.update a s j)) (hG (Function.update a s j)) x) := by
  have hf : referenceCovariantTensorComponent Γ T e a X =
      ambientCovectorDerivative (fun y => frameConnectionCoefficient M Γ e y X)
        (fun _ => X) (ambientPhysicalTensorComponent T e) a := by
    funext q
    exact referenceCovariantTensorComponent_eq_ambient M Γ T hT e hM hE hsym he hcomp a X q
  simp only [hf]
  exact sphereHarmonicCoordinate_metricCovectorDerivative hO hD k M Γ e hM hΓ hE hsym he hcomp
    (fun _ => X) contDiff_const (ambientPhysicalTensorComponent T e)
    (fun b => contDiff_ambientPhysicalTensorComponent T hT e hE b) a x

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.PhysicalTensorHarmonicBridge

## Calderon.PhysicalTensorProductRule

SHA256 `7666932b2136c40f08902914ca7dd23df21b0dbe52b77b5123fb2288ec60e638`.

``````lean
import Calderon.SmoothMovingFrameFields
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FDeriv.Analytic

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.PhysicalTensorProductRule
open MovingFrameConnection RadiusProfile

def physicalTensorComponent {r : ℕ}
    (T : R3 × R3 → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => R3) ℝ)
    (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3) (a : Fin r → Fin 3) (q : R3 × R3) : ℝ :=
  T q (fun s => e q.1 (a s))

lemma fderiv_physicalTensorComponent_horizontal {r : ℕ}
    (T : R3 × R3 → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => R3) ℝ)
    (hT : ContDiff ℝ ∞ T) (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3)
    (hE : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => e x i))
    (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (a : Fin r → Fin 3) (q : R3 × R3) (X : R3) :
    fderiv ℝ (physicalTensorComponent T e a) q (X,-Γ q.1 X q.2) =
      (fderiv ℝ T q (X,-Γ q.1 X q.2)) (fun s => e q.1 (a s)) +
        ∑ s : Fin r, T q (Function.update (fun t => e q.1 (a t)) s
          (fderiv ℝ (fun x => e x (a s)) q.1 X)) := by
  have hf := ((hT.differentiable (by simp)) q).hasFDerivAt
  have hg (s : Fin r) : HasFDerivAt (fun p : R3 × R3 => e p.1 (a s))
      ((fderiv ℝ (fun x => e x (a s)) q.1).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ R3 R3)) q :=
    (((hE (a s)).differentiable (by simp)) q.1).hasFDerivAt.comp q hasFDerivAt_fst
  have hd := hf.continuousMultilinearMap_apply hg
  change HasFDerivAt (physicalTensorComponent T e a) _ q at hd
  rw [hd.fderiv]
  simp

def physicalCovariantTensorEvaluation {r : ℕ}
    (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (T : R3 × R3 → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => R3) ℝ)
    (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3) (a : Fin r → Fin 3) (q : R3 × R3) (X : R3) : ℝ :=
  (fderiv ℝ T q (X,-Γ q.1 X q.2)) (fun s => e q.1 (a s)) -
    ∑ s : Fin r, T q (Function.update (fun t => e q.1 (a t)) s (Γ q.1 X (e q.1 (a s))))

lemma physicalCovariantTensorEvaluation_eq_component_sub_frame {r : ℕ}
    (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (T : R3 × R3 → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => R3) ℝ)
    (hT : ContDiff ℝ ∞ T) (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3)
    (hE : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => e x i))
    (a : Fin r → Fin 3) (q : R3 × R3) (X : R3) :
    physicalCovariantTensorEvaluation Γ T e a q X =
      fderiv ℝ (physicalTensorComponent T e a) q (X,-Γ q.1 X q.2) -
        ∑ s : Fin r, T q (Function.update (fun t => e q.1 (a t)) s
          (covariantFrameDerivative Γ e q.1 X (a s))) := by
  rw [fderiv_physicalTensorComponent_horizontal T hT e hE Γ a q X]
  simp only [covariantFrameDerivative, ContinuousMultilinearMap.map_update_add,
    Finset.sum_add_distrib, physicalCovariantTensorEvaluation]
  ring

lemma physicalCovariantTensorEvaluation_eq_component_sub_connection {r : ℕ}
    (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (T : R3 × R3 → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => R3) ℝ)
    (hT : ContDiff ℝ ∞ T) (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3)
    (hE : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => e x i))
    (a : Fin r → Fin 3) (q : R3 × R3) (X : R3)
    (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (M q.1) (e q.1)) :
    physicalCovariantTensorEvaluation Γ T e a q X =
      fderiv ℝ (physicalTensorComponent T e a) q (X,-Γ q.1 X q.2) -
        ∑ s : Fin r, ∑ j : Fin 3, frameConnectionCoefficient M Γ e q.1 X j (a s) *
          physicalTensorComponent T e (Function.update a s j) q := by
  rw [physicalCovariantTensorEvaluation_eq_component_sub_frame Γ T hT e hE a q X]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro s _
  rw [covariantFrameDerivative_eq_sum M Γ e q.1 X he (a s)]
  change (T q).toContinuousLinearMap (fun t => e q.1 (a t)) s
      (∑ j : Fin 3, frameConnectionCoefficient M Γ e q.1 X j (a s) • e q.1 j) = _
  simp only [map_sum, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  congr 1
  change T q (Function.update (fun t => e q.1 (a t)) s (e q.1 j)) =
    T q (fun t => e q.1 (Function.update a s j t))
  congr 1
  funext t
  by_cases ht : t = s
  · subst t
    simp
  · simp [Function.update_of_ne ht]

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.PhysicalTensorProductRule

``````

## Calderon.RotationCasimir

SHA256 `2efcc8be824a89ee0634c110c143d2d7298e8f6149a4f2f465ab275cc7ee11ff`.

``````lean
import Calderon.SphereDerivativeAdjoint
import Calderon.SphereRotationCore

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MvPolynomial
open scoped InnerProductSpace
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.RotationCasimir
open AngularPolynomial SphereHarmonic SphereDerivativeAdjoint

def polynomialEuler (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  ∑ i : Fin 3, X i * pderiv i p

def polynomialCasimir (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  C (-(1/2 : ℝ)) * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
    polynomialRotation i j (polynomialRotation i j p)

theorem sum_double_rotation_eq (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, polynomialRotation i j (polynomialRotation i j p)) =
      2 * (radiusSq * laplacian p - polynomialEuler (polynomialEuler p) - polynomialEuler p) := by
  simp [polynomialRotation,polynomialEuler,radiusSq,laplacian,Fin.sum_univ_three,
    pderiv_mul,pderiv_X]
  ring

lemma polynomialEuler_C_mul (a : ℝ) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    polynomialEuler (C a * p) = C a * polynomialEuler p := by
  simp [polynomialEuler,Finset.mul_sum,mul_left_comm,mul_assoc]

lemma polynomialEuler_homogeneous (k : ℕ) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hp : p.IsHomogeneous k) : polynomialEuler p = C (k:ℝ) * p := by
  simpa [polynomialEuler,nsmul_eq_mul] using hp.sum_X_mul_pderiv

theorem polynomialCasimir_harmonic (k : ℕ) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hp : p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) : polynomialCasimir p = C ((k:ℝ)*((k:ℝ)+1)) * p := by
  rw [polynomialCasimir,sum_double_rotation_eq,polynomialEuler_homogeneous k p hp.1,
    polynomialEuler_C_mul,polynomialEuler_homogeneous k p hp.1,hp.2]
  have he : 2 * ((radiusSq : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) * 0 -
      C (k:ℝ) * (C (k:ℝ)*p) - C (k:ℝ)*p) =
      C (-(2*(k:ℝ)*((k:ℝ)+1))) * p := by
    simp only [map_neg,map_mul,map_add,map_ofNat,map_one]
    ring
  rw [he,← mul_assoc,← map_mul]
  apply congrArg (fun a : ℝ => C a * p)
  ring

lemma polynomialRotation_harmonic_all (k : ℕ) (i j : Fin 3)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hp : p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) :
    polynomialRotation i j p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k := by
  cases k with
  | zero =>
      rw [eq_C_of_harmonicHomogeneous_zero p hp]
      simp only [polynomialRotation,pderiv_C,mul_zero,sub_self]
      exact (harmonicHomogeneous 0).zero_mem
  | succ k => exact polynomialRotation_harmonicHomogeneous _ (by omega) i j p hp

lemma polynomialRotation_sphere_inner_skew_all (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (k : ℕ) (i j : Fin 3) (p q : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hp : p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) (hq : q ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) :
    ⟪polynomialSphereL2 (polynomialRotation i j p),polynomialSphereL2 q⟫_ℝ =
      -⟪polynomialSphereL2 p,polynomialSphereL2 (polynomialRotation i j q)⟫_ℝ := by
  cases k with
  | zero =>
      rw [eq_C_of_harmonicHomogeneous_zero p hp,eq_C_of_harmonicHomogeneous_zero q hq]
      simp [polynomialRotation]
  | succ k => exact polynomialRotation_sphere_inner_skew hF _ (by omega) i j p q hp hq

theorem sum_rotation_sphere_norm_sq (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (k : ℕ) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hp : p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) :
    (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, ‖polynomialSphereL2 (polynomialRotation i j p)‖^2) =
      (2*(k:ℝ)*((k:ℝ)+1))*‖polynomialSphereL2 p‖^2 := by
  have hterm (i j : Fin 3) :
      ‖polynomialSphereL2 (polynomialRotation i j p)‖^2 =
        -⟪polynomialSphereL2 p,
          polynomialSphereL2 (polynomialRotation i j (polynomialRotation i j p))⟫_ℝ := by
    rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
    exact polynomialRotation_sphere_inner_skew_all hF k i j p _ hp
      (polynomialRotation_harmonic_all k i j p hp)
  simp_rw [hterm]
  simp_rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  simp_rw [← inner_sum,← map_sum]
  have hrot := sum_double_rotation_eq p
  rw [hrot,polynomialEuler_homogeneous k p hp.1,polynomialEuler_C_mul,
    polynomialEuler_homogeneous k p hp.1,hp.2]
  have he : 2 * ((radiusSq : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) * 0 -
      C (k:ℝ) * (C (k:ℝ)*p) - C (k:ℝ)*p) =
      C (-(2*(k:ℝ)*((k:ℝ)+1))) * p := by
    simp only [map_neg,map_mul,map_add,map_ofNat,map_one]
    ring
  rw [he,← smul_eq_C_mul,map_smul,real_inner_smul_right,real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  ring

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.RotationCasimir

``````

## Calderon.CompactParameterSmoothness

SHA256 `3931cec25f4fc49d95790af2f56768053fcfc79ac48c6569e503d1d8cb1472d0`.

``````lean
import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Operator.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.MeanValue
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.ContDiff.Comp
import Mathlib.Topology.ContinuousMap.Compact
import Mathlib.Topology.ContinuousMap.Algebra

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open Filter Set
open scoped ContDiff Topology
universe u
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.CompactParameterSmoothness

variable {K H E : Type u} [TopologicalSpace K] [CompactSpace K]
  [NormedAddCommGroup H] [NormedSpace ℝ H]
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]

def applyContinuousFamily (A : C(K,H →L[ℝ] E)) (h : H) : C(K,E) :=
  ⟨fun theta => A theta h,A.continuous.clm_apply continuous_const⟩

lemma norm_applyContinuousFamily_le (A : C(K,H →L[ℝ] E)) (h : H) :
    ‖applyContinuousFamily A h‖ ≤ ‖A‖ * ‖h‖ := by
  apply (ContinuousMap.norm_le (applyContinuousFamily A h) (mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg A) (norm_nonneg h))).mpr
  intro theta
  exact (A theta).le_opNorm h |>.trans
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (A.norm_coe_le_norm theta) (norm_nonneg h))

def transposeAt (A : C(K,H →L[ℝ] E)) : H →L[ℝ] C(K,E) :=
  ({toFun := applyContinuousFamily A
    map_add' := by intros; ext; simp [applyContinuousFamily]
    map_smul' := by intros; ext; simp [applyContinuousFamily]} : H →ₗ[ℝ] C(K,E)).mkContinuous
      ‖A‖ (norm_applyContinuousFamily_le A)

lemma transposeAt_apply (A : C(K,H →L[ℝ] E)) (h : H) (theta : K) :
    transposeAt A h theta = A theta h := rfl

lemma norm_transposeAt_le (A : C(K,H →L[ℝ] E)) : ‖transposeAt A‖ ≤ ‖A‖ :=
  (transposeAt A).opNorm_le_bound (norm_nonneg A) (norm_applyContinuousFamily_le A)

def transposeContinuousFamily :
    C(K,H →L[ℝ] E) →L[ℝ] (H →L[ℝ] C(K,E)) := by
  let T : C(K,H →L[ℝ] E) →ₗ[ℝ] (H →L[ℝ] C(K,E)) :=
    { toFun := fun A => transposeAt (K := K) (H := H) (E := E) A
      map_add' := by intros; ext; simp [transposeAt_apply]
      map_smul' := by intros; ext; simp [transposeAt_apply] }
  have hb : ∀ A : C(K,H →L[ℝ] E), ‖T A‖ ≤ 1 * ‖A‖ := by
    intro A
    change ‖transposeAt A‖ ≤ 1 * ‖A‖
    simpa only [one_mul] using norm_transposeAt_le A
  exact LinearMap.mkContinuous (E := C(K,H →L[ℝ] E)) (F := H →L[ℝ] C(K,E)) T 1 hb

lemma transposeContinuousFamily_apply (A : C(K,H →L[ℝ] E)) (h : H) (theta : K) :
    transposeContinuousFamily A h theta = A theta h := rfl

lemma norm_transposeContinuousFamily_le :
    @norm (C(K,H →L[ℝ] E) →L[ℝ] (H →L[ℝ] C(K,E)))
      (ContinuousLinearMap.hasOpNorm (𝕜 := ℝ) (𝕜₂ := ℝ) (σ₁₂ := RingHom.id ℝ)
        (E := C(K,H →L[ℝ] E)) (F := H →L[ℝ] C(K,E)))
      (transposeContinuousFamily (K := K) (H := H) (E := E)) ≤ 1 := by
  unfold transposeContinuousFamily
  exact LinearMap.mkContinuous_norm_le (𝕜 := ℝ) (𝕜₂ := ℝ)
    (σ₁₂ := RingHom.id ℝ) (E := C(K,H →L[ℝ] E)) (F := H →L[ℝ] C(K,E))
    _ zero_le_one _

theorem hasFDerivAt_of_uniform_slice_derivative
    (F : H → C(K,E)) (D : H → C(K,H →L[ℝ] E)) (x : H)
    (hD : ContinuousAt D x)
    (hFD : ∀ y theta, HasFDerivAt (fun z => F z theta) (D y theta) y) :
    HasFDerivAt F (transposeContinuousFamily (D x)) x := by
  apply HasFDerivAt.of_isLittleO
  rw [Asymptotics.isLittleO_iff]
  intro eps heps
  have hev : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, ‖D y - D x‖ < eps := by
    have hs : ContinuousAt (fun y : H => D y - D x) x := hD.sub continuousAt_const
    have hn0 : ContinuousAt (fun A : C(K,H →L[ℝ] E) => ‖A‖) (D x - D x) :=
      (continuous_norm (E := C(K,H →L[ℝ] E))).continuousAt
    have hz : ‖(0 : C(K,H →L[ℝ] E))‖ = 0 := by
      change dist (0 : C(K,H →L[ℝ] E)) 0 = 0
      exact dist_self _
    have hn : Tendsto (fun y => ‖D y - D x‖) (𝓝 x) (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) := by
      simpa only [Function.comp_def, sub_self, hz] using
        (hn0.comp (f := fun y : H => D y - D x) (x := x) hs).tendsto
    exact hn.eventually (Iio_mem_nhds heps)
  obtain ⟨delta,hdelta,hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hev
  filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds x hdelta] with y hy
  apply (ContinuousMap.norm_le _ (mul_nonneg heps.le (norm_nonneg _))).mpr
  intro theta
  let g : H → E := fun z => F z theta - F x theta - D x theta (z-x)
  have hgd (z : H) : HasFDerivAt g (D z theta - D x theta) z := by
    have hh : HasFDerivAt (fun w => D x theta (w-x)) (D x theta) z := by
      simpa only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_id,Function.comp_def,id_eq] using
        (D x theta).hasFDerivAt.comp z (hasFDerivAt_id z |>.sub_const x)
    change HasFDerivAt ((fun w => F w theta - F x theta) -
      fun w => D x theta (w-x)) (D z theta - D x theta) z
    exact ((hFD z theta).sub_const (F x theta)).sub hh
  have hbound (z : H) (hz : z ∈ Metric.ball x delta) : ‖D z theta - D x theta‖ ≤ eps := by
    exact ((D z - D x).norm_coe_le_norm theta).trans (hball hz).le
  have hg := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasFDerivWithin_le
    (fun z _ => (hgd z).hasFDerivWithinAt) hbound (convex_ball x delta)
    (Metric.mem_ball_self hdelta) hy
  simpa [g,transposeContinuousFamily_apply,ContinuousMap.sub_apply] using hg

variable {V : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V]

def compactPullback (g : H × V → E) (hg : Continuous g) (v : C(K,V)) : H → C(K,E) :=
  fun x => ⟨fun theta => g (x,v theta),hg.comp (continuous_const.prodMk v.continuous)⟩

lemma compactPullback_apply (g : H × V → E) (hg : Continuous g) (v : C(K,V))
    (x : H) (theta : K) : compactPullback g hg v x theta = g (x,v theta) := rfl

lemma continuous_compactPullback (g : H × V → E) (hg : Continuous g) (v : C(K,V)) :
    Continuous (compactPullback g hg v) := by
  apply ContinuousMap.continuous_of_continuous_uncurry
  exact hg.comp (continuous_fst.prodMk (v.continuous.comp continuous_snd))

def basePartial (g : H × V → E) (z : H × V) : H →L[ℝ] E :=
  (fderiv ℝ g z).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ H V)

lemma hasFDerivAt_base_slice (g : H × V → E) (hg : Differentiable ℝ g)
    (y : H) (v : V) : HasFDerivAt (fun x => g (x,v)) (basePartial g (y,v)) y :=
  (hg (y,v)).hasFDerivAt.comp y (hasFDerivAt_prodMk_left y v)

lemma contDiff_basePartial (n : ℕ) (g : H × V → E) (hg : ContDiff ℝ (n+1) g) :
    ContDiff ℝ n (basePartial g) := by
  exact ((ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℝ H (H × V) E).flip
    (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ H V)).contDiff.comp (hg.fderiv_right (by simp))

theorem contDiff_compactPullback (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ (E : Type u) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
      (g : H × V → E) (hg : ContDiff ℝ n g) (v : C(K,V)),
      ContDiff ℝ n (compactPullback g hg.continuous v) := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      intro E _ _ g hg v
      exact contDiff_zero.mpr (continuous_compactPullback g hg.continuous v)
  | succ n ih =>
      intro E _ _ g hg v
      have hp := contDiff_basePartial n g hg
      have hDC := ih (H →L[ℝ] E) (basePartial g) hp v
      have hT : ContDiff ℝ n (transposeContinuousFamily (K := K) (H := H) (E := E)) :=
        ContinuousLinearMap.contDiff (𝕜 := ℝ) (E := C(K,H →L[ℝ] E))
          (F := H →L[ℝ] C(K,E)) (n := n)
          (transposeContinuousFamily (K := K) (H := H) (E := E))
      refine contDiff_succ_iff_hasFDerivAt.mpr
        ⟨fun x => transposeContinuousFamily (compactPullback (basePartial g) hp.continuous v x),
          hT.comp hDC,?_⟩
      intro x
      apply hasFDerivAt_of_uniform_slice_derivative
        (compactPullback g hg.continuous v)
        (compactPullback (basePartial g) hp.continuous v) x hDC.continuous.continuousAt
      intro y theta
      exact hasFDerivAt_base_slice g (hg.differentiable (by simp)) y (v theta)

theorem contDiff_infty_compactPullback (g : H × V → E) (hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g)
    (v : C(K,V)) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (compactPullback g hg.continuous v) := by
  apply contDiff_iff_forall_nat_le.mpr
  intro n _
  exact contDiff_compactPullback n E g (hg.of_le (by simp)) v

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.CompactParameterSmoothness

``````
````````
