````````
``````lean
import Calderon.CompactParameterSmoothness
import Calderon.SphereHarmonicBridge
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FDeriv.Const

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Filter Set
open scoped ContDiff Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SmoothSphereFields
open SphereHarmonic CompactParameterSmoothness

def unitSphereInclusion : C(UnitSphere,R3) := ⟨Subtype.val,continuous_subtype_val⟩

def ambientSphereSection (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :
    R3 → C(UnitSphere,ℝ) := compactPullback G hG.continuous unitSphereInclusion

def ambientSphereL2 (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) : R3 → SphereL2 :=
  fun x => ContinuousMap.toLp 2 sphereProbability ℝ (ambientSphereSection G hG x)

lemma contDiff_ambientSphereSection (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (ambientSphereSection G hG) :=
  contDiff_infty_compactPullback G hG unitSphereInclusion

lemma contDiff_ambientSphereL2 (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (ambientSphereL2 G hG) := by
  change ContDiff ℝ ∞
    ((ContinuousMap.toLp 2 sphereProbability ℝ : C(UnitSphere,ℝ) →L[ℝ] SphereL2) ∘
      ambientSphereSection G hG)
  exact (ContinuousMap.toLp 2 sphereProbability ℝ : C(UnitSphere,ℝ) →L[ℝ] SphereL2).contDiff.comp
    (contDiff_ambientSphereSection G hG)

lemma ambientSphereL2_ae (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (x : R3) :
    ambientSphereL2 G hG x =ᵐ[sphereProbability] (fun theta : UnitSphere => G (x,theta.val)) :=
  ContinuousMap.coeFn_toLp (p := 2) (𝕜 := ℝ) sphereProbability
    (ambientSphereSection G hG x)

def ambientBasePartialSphere (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (x : R3) :
    C(UnitSphere,R3 →L[ℝ] ℝ) :=
  compactPullback (basePartial G)
    (contDiff_basePartial 0 G (hG.of_le (by simp))).continuous unitSphereInclusion x

lemma hasFDerivAt_ambientSphereSection (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (x : R3) :
    HasFDerivAt (ambientSphereSection G hG)
      (transposeContinuousFamily (ambientBasePartialSphere G hG x)) x := by
  apply hasFDerivAt_of_uniform_slice_derivative
    (ambientSphereSection G hG) (ambientBasePartialSphere G hG) x
  · exact (continuous_compactPullback (basePartial G)
      (contDiff_basePartial 0 G (hG.of_le (by simp))).continuous unitSphereInclusion).continuousAt
  · intro y theta
    exact hasFDerivAt_base_slice G (hG.differentiable (by simp)) y theta.val

lemma fderiv_ambientSphereL2 (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (x : R3) :
    fderiv ℝ (ambientSphereL2 G hG) x =
      (ContinuousMap.toLp 2 sphereProbability ℝ).comp
        (transposeContinuousFamily (ambientBasePartialSphere G hG x)) := by
  change fderiv ℝ
    ((ContinuousMap.toLp 2 sphereProbability ℝ : C(UnitSphere,ℝ) →L[ℝ] SphereL2) ∘
      ambientSphereSection G hG) x = _
  exact ((ContinuousMap.toLp 2 sphereProbability ℝ : C(UnitSphere,ℝ) →L[ℝ] SphereL2).hasFDerivAt.comp x
    (hasFDerivAt_ambientSphereSection G hG x)).fderiv

lemma fderiv_ambientSphereL2_ae (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (x X : R3) :
    fderiv ℝ (ambientSphereL2 G hG) x X =ᵐ[sphereProbability]
      (fun theta : UnitSphere => fderiv ℝ G (x,theta.val) (X,0)) := by
  rw [fderiv_ambientSphereL2,ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
  exact ContinuousMap.coeFn_toLp (p := 2) (𝕜 := ℝ) sphereProbability
    (transposeContinuousFamily (ambientBasePartialSphere G hG x) X)

lemma ambientSphereSection_eq_zero (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (x : R3)
    (hz : ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x,theta.val)=0) : ambientSphereSection G hG x = 0 := by
  ext theta
  exact hz theta

lemma ambientSphereL2_eq_zero (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (x : R3)
    (hz : ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x,theta.val)=0) : ambientSphereL2 G hG x = 0 := by
  change ContinuousMap.toLp 2 sphereProbability ℝ (ambientSphereSection G hG x)=0
  rw [ambientSphereSection_eq_zero G hG x hz,map_zero]

lemma hasCompactSupport_ambientSphereSection (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G)
    (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x,theta.val)=0) :
    HasCompactSupport (ambientSphereSection G hG) :=
  HasCompactSupport.intro hK (fun x hx => ambientSphereSection_eq_zero G hG x (hz x hx))

lemma hasCompactSupport_ambientSphereL2 (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G)
    (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x,theta.val)=0) :
    HasCompactSupport (ambientSphereL2 G hG) :=
  HasCompactSupport.intro hK (fun x hx => ambientSphereL2_eq_zero G hG x (hz x hx))

lemma hasCompactSupport_fderiv_ambientSphereL2 (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G)
    (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x,theta.val)=0) (X : R3) :
    HasCompactSupport (fun x => fderiv ℝ (ambientSphereL2 G hG) x X) :=
  (hasCompactSupport_ambientSphereL2 G hG K hK hz).fderiv_apply ℝ X

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SmoothSphereFields

``````

## Calderon.SpectralWeightedGraph

``````lean
import Calderon.SpectralCoreRegularity
import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Module.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Pow.Real

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open Filter Set
open scoped Topology ENNReal InnerProductSpace
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SpectralWeightedGraph
open SphereHarmonic SphereHilbertDecomposition SpectralCoreRegularity

lemma sphereHarmonicCoordinate_partialSum
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (n k : ℕ) (u : SphereL2) :
    sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n u) =
      if k < n then sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k u else 0 := by
  classical
  rw [sphereHarmonicPartialSum_apply,map_sum]
  by_cases hk : k < n
  · rw [ite_eq_left hk,Finset.sum_eq_single k]
    · exact sphereHarmonicCoordinate_subtype hO hD k _
    · intro j _ hj
      simp [sphereHarmonicCoordinate_apply,sphereHarmonicDecomposition_subtype,
        lp.single_apply,Ne.symm hj]
    · intro hknot
      exact (hknot (Finset.mem_range.mpr hk)).elim
  · rw [ite_eq_right hk]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro j hj
    have hjk : k ≠ j := by intro he; subst j; exact hk (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)
    simp [sphereHarmonicCoordinate_apply,sphereHarmonicDecomposition_subtype,
      lp.single_apply,hjk]

def spectralGraph (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (w : ℕ → ℝ) : Submodule ℝ (SphereL2 × SphereL2) where
  carrier := {z | ∀ k, sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k z.2 =
    w k • sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k z.1}
  zero_mem' := by intro k; simp
  add_mem' := by
    intro z z' hz hz' k
    simp only [Prod.fst_add,Prod.snd_add,map_add,smul_add]
    rw [hz k,hz' k]
  smul_mem' := by
    intro c z hz k
    change sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (c • z.2) =
      w k • sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (c • z.1)
    rw [map_smul,map_smul]
    rw [hz k,smul_comm]

lemma mem_spectralGraph_iff (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (u v : SphereL2) :
    (u,v) ∈ spectralGraph hO hD w ↔ ∀ k,
      sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k v =
        w k • sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k u := Iff.rfl

theorem spectralGraph_output_unique (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (u v v' : SphereL2)
    (hv : (u,v) ∈ spectralGraph hO hD w)
    (hv' : (u,v') ∈ spectralGraph hO hD w) : v = v' := by
  apply (sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD).injective
  apply lp.ext
  funext k
  exact (hv k).trans (hv' k).symm

lemma spectralGraph_zero_input (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (v : SphereL2)
    (hv : (0,v) ∈ spectralGraph hO hD w) : v = 0 :=
  spectralGraph_output_unique hO hD w 0 v 0 hv (spectralGraph hO hD w).zero_mem

theorem isClosed_spectralGraph (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (w : ℕ → ℝ) :
    IsClosed (spectralGraph hO hD w : Set (SphereL2 × SphereL2)) := by
  change IsClosed {z : SphereL2 × SphereL2 | ∀ k,
    sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k z.2 = w k • sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k z.1}
  simp_rw [ofPred_forall]
  apply isClosed_iInter
  intro k
  exact isClosed_eq ((sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k).continuous.comp continuous_snd)
    (((sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k).continuous.comp continuous_fst).const_smul (w k))

lemma spectralGraph_partialSum (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (z : SphereL2 × SphereL2)
    (hz : z ∈ spectralGraph hO hD w) (n : ℕ) :
    (sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n z.1,sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n z.2) ∈
      spectralGraph hO hD w := by
  intro k
  simp_rw [sphereHarmonicCoordinate_partialSum]
  by_cases hk : k < n
  · simpa only [if_pos hk] using hz k
  · simp only [if_neg hk,smul_zero]

def spectralFiniteGraph (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (w : ℕ → ℝ) : Set (SphereL2 × SphereL2) :=
  {z | z ∈ spectralGraph hO hD w ∧ ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ k : ℕ, n ≤ k →
    sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k z.1 = 0 ∧
    sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k z.2 = 0}

lemma spectralFiniteGraph_partialSum (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (z : SphereL2 × SphereL2)
    (hz : z ∈ spectralGraph hO hD w) (n : ℕ) :
    (sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n z.1,sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n z.2) ∈
      spectralFiniteGraph hO hD w := by
  refine ⟨spectralGraph_partialSum hO hD w z hz n,n,?_⟩
  intro k hk
  simp only [sphereHarmonicCoordinate_partialSum,if_neg (not_lt.mpr hk),and_self]

theorem tendsto_spectralGraph_partialSum (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (z : SphereL2 × SphereL2) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ =>
      (sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n z.1,sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n z.2))
      atTop (𝓝 z) :=
  (tendsto_sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD z.1).prodMk_nhds
    (tendsto_sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD z.2)

theorem closure_spectralFiniteGraph (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (w : ℕ → ℝ) :
    closure (spectralFiniteGraph hO hD w) =
      (spectralGraph hO hD w : Set (SphereL2 × SphereL2)) := by
  apply Subset.antisymm
  · exact closure_minimal (fun _ hz => hz.1) (isClosed_spectralGraph hO hD w)
  · intro z hz
    exact isClosed_closure.mem_of_tendsto (tendsto_spectralGraph_partialSum hO hD z)
      (Eventually.of_forall (fun n => subset_closure (spectralFiniteGraph_partialSum hO hD w z hz n)))

theorem norm_sq_spectralGraph_output (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (u v : SphereL2)
    (hv : (u,v) ∈ spectralGraph hO hD w) :
    ‖v‖ ^ 2 = ∑' k : ℕ, |w k| ^ 2 * ‖sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k u‖ ^ 2 := by
  rw [norm_sq_sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD v]
  apply tsum_congr
  intro k
  change ‖sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k v‖ ^ 2 = _
  rw [hv k,norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,mul_pow]

def besselWeight (s : ℝ) (k : ℕ) : ℝ := (1 + (k : ℝ)) ^ s

lemma besselWeight_pos (s : ℝ) (k : ℕ) : 0 < besselWeight s k :=
  Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by positivity) s

lemma besselWeight_zero_degree (s : ℝ) : besselWeight s 0 = 1 := by
  simp [besselWeight]

lemma besselWeight_zero_order (k : ℕ) : besselWeight 0 k = 1 := by
  simp [besselWeight]

def sphereBesselGraph (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (s : ℝ) : Submodule ℝ (SphereL2 × SphereL2) := spectralGraph hO hD (besselWeight s)

theorem isClosed_sphereBesselGraph (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (s : ℝ) :
    IsClosed (sphereBesselGraph hO hD s : Set (SphereL2 × SphereL2)) :=
  isClosed_spectralGraph hO hD (besselWeight s)

lemma inner_sphereHarmonicCoordinate_right (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (k : ℕ) (u : SphereL2) (a : harmonicSphereSubspace k) :
    ⟪u,(a : SphereL2)⟫_ℝ = ⟪sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k u,a⟫_ℝ := by
  rw [← (sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD).inner_map_map,
    sphereHarmonicDecomposition_subtype]
  exact lp.inner_single_right (𝕜 := ℝ) k a (sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD u)

theorem spectralGraph_inner_symm (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (u v a b : SphereL2)
    (huv : (u,v) ∈ spectralGraph hO hD w)
    (hab : (a,b) ∈ spectralGraph hO hD w) : ⟪v,a⟫_ℝ = ⟪u,b⟫_ℝ := by
  rw [inner_sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD v a,
    inner_sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD u b]
  apply tsum_congr
  intro k
  change ⟪sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k v,sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k a⟫_ℝ =
    ⟪sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k u,sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k b⟫_ℝ
  rw [huv k,hab k]
  change ⟪w k • sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k u,
      sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k a⟫_ℝ =
    ⟪sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k u,w k • sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k a⟫_ℝ
  rw [real_inner_smul_left (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k u)
      (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k a) (w k),
    real_inner_smul_right (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k u)
      (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k a) (w k)]

lemma spectralGraph_single (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) (a : harmonicSphereSubspace k) :
    ((a : SphereL2),w k • (a : SphereL2)) ∈ spectralGraph hO hD w := by
  intro j
  simp only [map_smul,sphereHarmonicCoordinate_apply,sphereHarmonicDecomposition_subtype]
  by_cases hj : j = k
  · subst j; simp
  · simp [lp.single_apply,hj,Ne.symm hj]

lemma spectralFiniteGraph_single (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (k : ℕ) (a : harmonicSphereSubspace k) :
    ((a : SphereL2),w k • (a : SphereL2)) ∈ spectralFiniteGraph hO hD w := by
  refine ⟨spectralGraph_single hO hD w k a,k+1,?_⟩
  intro j hj
  have hjk : j ≠ k := by omega
  simp [sphereHarmonicCoordinate_apply,sphereHarmonicDecomposition_subtype,
    map_smul,lp.single_apply,hjk,Ne.symm hjk]

theorem mem_spectralGraph_iff_inner_finite (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (u v : SphereL2) :
    (u,v) ∈ spectralGraph hO hD w ↔ ∀ z ∈ spectralFiniteGraph hO hD w,
      ⟪v,z.1⟫_ℝ = ⟪u,z.2⟫_ℝ := by
  constructor
  · intro huv z hz
    exact spectralGraph_inner_symm hO hD w u v z.1 z.2 huv hz.1
  · intro ht k
    let q : harmonicSphereSubspace k :=
      sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k v - w k • sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k u
    have he := ht ((q : SphereL2),w k • (q : SphereL2))
      (spectralFiniteGraph_single hO hD w k q)
    change ⟪v,(q : SphereL2)⟫_ℝ = ⟪u,w k • (q : SphereL2)⟫_ℝ at he
    rw [real_inner_smul_right,inner_sphereHarmonicCoordinate_right hO hD k,
      inner_sphereHarmonicCoordinate_right hO hD k] at he
    have hq : ⟪q,q⟫_ℝ = 0 := by
      dsimp only [q]
      rw [inner_sub_left,real_inner_smul_left (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k u)
        (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k v - w k • sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k u) (w k)]
      exact sub_eq_zero.mpr he
    have hz : q = 0 := (inner_self_eq_zero).mp hq
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp hz

theorem mem_spectralGraph_iff_inner_all (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (u v : SphereL2) :
    (u,v) ∈ spectralGraph hO hD w ↔ ∀ z ∈ spectralGraph hO hD w,
      ⟪v,z.1⟫_ℝ = ⟪u,z.2⟫_ℝ := by
  constructor
  · intro huv z hz
    exact spectralGraph_inner_symm hO hD w u v z.1 z.2 huv hz
  · intro ht
    apply (mem_spectralGraph_iff_inner_finite hO hD w u v).mpr
    intro z hz
    exact ht z hz.1

def spectralCoordinateSequence (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (u : SphereL2) :
    (k : ℕ) → harmonicSphereSubspace k :=
  fun k => w k • sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k u

theorem memLp_spectralCoordinateSequence_iff (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (u : SphereL2) :
    Memℓp (spectralCoordinateSequence hO hD w u) 2 ↔
      Summable (fun k : ℕ => |w k| ^ 2 * ‖sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k u‖ ^ 2) := by
  simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_ofNat,Real.rpow_two,spectralCoordinateSequence,
    norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,mul_pow] using
    (memℓp_gen_iff (show 0 < (2 : ℝ≥0∞).toReal by norm_num)
      (f := spectralCoordinateSequence hO hD w u))

theorem exists_spectralGraph_iff_summable (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (u : SphereL2) :
    (∃ v : SphereL2, (u,v) ∈ spectralGraph hO hD w) ↔
      Summable (fun k : ℕ => |w k| ^ 2 * ‖sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k u‖ ^ 2) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v,hv⟩
    apply (memLp_spectralCoordinateSequence_iff hO hD w u).mp
    have he : spectralCoordinateSequence hO hD w u =
        (sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD v : (k : ℕ) → harmonicSphereSubspace k) := by
      funext k
      exact (hv k).symm
    rw [he]
    exact lp.memℓp _
  · intro hs
    let q : lp (fun k : ℕ => harmonicSphereSubspace k) 2 :=
      ⟨spectralCoordinateSequence hO hD w u,
        (memLp_spectralCoordinateSequence_iff hO hD w u).mpr hs⟩
    refine ⟨(sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD).symm q,?_⟩
    intro k
    rw [sphereHarmonicCoordinate_apply,LinearIsometryEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    rfl

theorem hasSum_spectralGraph_output (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (u v : SphereL2)
    (hv : (u,v) ∈ spectralGraph hO hD w) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ => w k • (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k u : SphereL2)) v := by
  have he : (fun k : ℕ => w k • (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k u : SphereL2)) =
      (fun k : ℕ => (sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD v k : SphereL2)) := by
    funext k
    exact congrArg (fun a : harmonicSphereSubspace k => (a : SphereL2)) (hv k).symm
  rw [he]
  exact hasSum_sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD v

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SpectralWeightedGraph

``````

## Calderon.PhysicalTensorAmbientRealization

``````lean
import Calderon.PhysicalTensorProductRule
import Calderon.AmbientCovectorComponents

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace ENNReal
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.PhysicalTensorAmbientRealization
open PhysicalTensorProductRule SmoothMovingFrameFields AmbientCovectorComponents
open MovingFrameConnection RadiusProfile FrameCurvaturePolynomial

def frameReconstruction (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3) (q : R3 × R3) : R3 :=
  ∑ j : Fin 3, q.2 j • e q.1 j

lemma contDiff_frameReconstruction (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3)
    (hE : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => e x j)) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (frameReconstruction e) := by
  have hz (j : Fin 3) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun q : R3 × R3 => q.2 j) :=
    (contDiff_piLp_apply (p := (2 : ℝ≥0∞)) (i := j)).comp contDiff_snd
  exact ContDiff.sum fun j _ => (hz j).smul ((hE j).comp contDiff_fst)

lemma frameReconstruction_movingFrameCoordinateVector
    (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3) (q : R3 × R3)
    (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (M q.1) (e q.1)) :
    frameReconstruction e (q.1,movingFrameCoordinateVector M e q) = q.2 := by
  change (∑ j : Fin 3, movingFrameCoordinate M e j q • e q.1 j) = q.2
  exact metricFrame_sum_coordinates (M q.1) (e q.1) he q.2

def ambientPhysicalTensorComponent {r : ℕ}
    (T : R3 × R3 → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => R3) ℝ)
    (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3) (a : Fin r → Fin 3) (q : R3 × R3) : ℝ :=
  T (q.1,frameReconstruction e q) (fun s => e q.1 (a s))

lemma contDiff_ambientPhysicalTensorComponent {r : ℕ}
    (T : R3 × R3 → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => R3) ℝ)
    (hT : ContDiff ℝ ∞ T) (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3)
    (hE : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => e x j)) (a : Fin r → Fin 3) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (ambientPhysicalTensorComponent T e a) := by
  have hm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun q : R3 × R3 => T (q.1,frameReconstruction e q)) :=
    hT.comp (contDiff_fst.prodMk (contDiff_frameReconstruction e hE))
  have he : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun q : R3 × R3 => fun s : Fin r => e q.1 (a s)) :=
    contDiff_pi.mpr fun s => (hE (a s)).comp contDiff_fst
  have ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p :
      (ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => R3) ℝ) × (Fin r → R3) => p.1 p.2) :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => R3) ℝ)).analyticOnNhd_uncurry_of_multilinear.contDiff
  exact ha.comp (hm.prodMk he)

lemma physicalTensorComponent_eq_movingFrameAmbient {r : ℕ}
    (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (T : R3 × R3 → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => R3) ℝ)
    (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3) (a : Fin r → Fin 3) (q : R3 × R3)
    (he : IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (M q.1) (e q.1)) :
    physicalTensorComponent T e a q =
      movingFrameAmbient M e (ambientPhysicalTensorComponent T e a) q := by
  unfold movingFrameAmbient ambientPhysicalTensorComponent
  rw [frameReconstruction_movingFrameCoordinateVector M e q he]
  rfl

lemma physicalCovariantTensorEvaluation_eq_ambientCovectorDerivative {r : ℕ}
    (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (T : R3 × R3 → ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin r => R3) ℝ)
    (hT : ContDiff ℝ ∞ T) (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3)
    (hM : ContDiff ℝ ∞ M) (hE : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => e x j))
    (hsym : ∀ y U V, ⟪M y U,V⟫_ℝ = ⟪M y V,U⟫_ℝ)
    (he : ∀ y, IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (M y) (e y))
    (hcomp : ∀ y X U V, ⟪M y (Γ y X U),V⟫_ℝ + ⟪M y U,Γ y X V⟫_ℝ =
      ⟪fderiv ℝ M y X U,V⟫_ℝ) (a : Fin r → Fin 3) (x v X : R3) :
    physicalCovariantTensorEvaluation Γ T e a (x,v) X =
      ambientCovectorDerivative (fun y => frameConnectionCoefficient M Γ e y X)
        (fun _ => X) (ambientPhysicalTensorComponent T e) a
        (x,movingFrameCoordinateVector M e (x,v)) := by
  have hf (b : Fin r → Fin 3) : physicalTensorComponent T e b =
      movingFrameAmbient M e (ambientPhysicalTensorComponent T e b) := by
    funext q
    exact physicalTensorComponent_eq_movingFrameAmbient M T e b q (he q.1)
  rw [physicalCovariantTensorEvaluation_eq_component_sub_connection M Γ T hT e hE a (x,v) X (he x), hf a]
  rw [fderiv_movingFrameAmbient_horizontal M Γ e hM hE hsym he hcomp
    (ambientPhysicalTensorComponent T e a) (contDiff_ambientPhysicalTensorComponent T hT e hE a) x v X]
  unfold ambientCovectorDerivative
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro s _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  congr 1
  exact physicalTensorComponent_eq_movingFrameAmbient M T e (Function.update a s j) (x,v) (he x)

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.PhysicalTensorAmbientRealization

``````

## Calderon.SmoothSphereRotation

SHA256 `c4a83d7afc0339b551047c7138d1f54b1646d833290b7da8665798bbcd725027`.

``````lean
import Calderon.OrthogonalSphereMeasure
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.ParametricIntegral
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.ContDiff.WithLp
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FDeriv.WithLp
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Deriv.Prod
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Trigonometric.Deriv
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Function.LocallyIntegrable
import Mathlib.Tactic

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set Filter
open scoped ContDiff Topology ENNReal
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SmoothSphereRotation
open SphereHarmonic OrthogonalSphereMeasure

/-- The actual coordinate-plane flow, including identity on diagonal pairs. -/
def coordinateRotation (i j : Fin 3) (t : ℝ) (x : R3) : R3 :=
  if i = j then x else WithLp.toLp 2 fun l =>
    if l = i then Real.cos t * x i - Real.sin t * x j else
    if l = j then Real.sin t * x i + Real.cos t * x j else x l

/-- The true ambient generator, with the manuscript's `X_i ∂_j-X_j ∂_i` sign. -/
def rotationVector (i j : Fin 3) (x : R3) : R3 :=
  x i • PiLp.single 2 j (1 : ℝ) - x j • PiLp.single 2 i (1 : ℝ)

def sphereRotationDerivative (i j : Fin 3) (F : R3 → ℝ) (x : R3) : ℝ :=
  fderiv ℝ F x (rotationVector i j x)

lemma rotation_pair_square (t a b : ℝ) :
    (Real.cos t * a - Real.sin t * b)^2 +
      (Real.sin t * a + Real.cos t * b)^2 = a^2 + b^2 := by
  calc
    _ = (Real.sin t ^ 2 + Real.cos t ^ 2) * (a^2 + b^2) := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq]; ring

lemma rotation_inverse_first (t a b : ℝ) :
    Real.cos t * (Real.cos t * a + Real.sin t * b) -
      Real.sin t * (-Real.sin t * a + Real.cos t * b) = a := by
  calc
    _ = (Real.sin t ^ 2 + Real.cos t ^ 2) * a := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq]; ring

lemma rotation_inverse_second (t a b : ℝ) :
    Real.sin t * (Real.cos t * a + Real.sin t * b) +
      Real.cos t * (-Real.sin t * a + Real.cos t * b) = b := by
  calc
    _ = (Real.sin t ^ 2 + Real.cos t ^ 2) * b := by ring
    _ = _ := by rw [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq]; ring

lemma coordinateRotation_add (i j : Fin 3) (t : ℝ) (x y : R3) :
    coordinateRotation i j t (x+y) = coordinateRotation i j t x +
      coordinateRotation i j t y := by
  ext l
  by_cases hij : i=j
  · simp [coordinateRotation,hij]
  · by_cases hli : l=i <;> by_cases hlj : l=j <;>
      simp [coordinateRotation,hij,Ne.symm hij,hli,hlj] <;> ring

lemma coordinateRotation_smul (i j : Fin 3) (t c : ℝ) (x : R3) :
    coordinateRotation i j t (c • x) = c • coordinateRotation i j t x := by
  ext l
  by_cases hij : i=j
  · simp [coordinateRotation,hij]
  · by_cases hli : l=i <;> by_cases hlj : l=j <;>
      simp [coordinateRotation,hij,Ne.symm hij,hli,hlj] <;> ring

lemma coordinateRotation_inverse (i j : Fin 3) (t : ℝ) (x : R3) :
    coordinateRotation i j t (coordinateRotation i j (-t) x) = x := by
  by_cases hij : i=j
  · simp [coordinateRotation,hij]
  · ext l
    by_cases hli : l=i
    · subst l
      simpa [coordinateRotation,hij,Ne.symm hij,Real.cos_neg,Real.sin_neg] using
        rotation_inverse_first t (x i) (x j)
    · by_cases hlj : l=j
      · subst l
        simpa [coordinateRotation,hij,Ne.symm hij,Real.cos_neg,Real.sin_neg] using
          rotation_inverse_second t (x i) (x j)
      · simp [coordinateRotation,hij,Ne.symm hij,hli,hlj]

lemma coordinateRotation_norm (i j : Fin 3) (t : ℝ) (x : R3) :
    ‖coordinateRotation i j t x‖ = ‖x‖ := by
  apply (sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mp
  rw [EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq,EuclideanSpace.real_norm_sq_eq]
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [coordinateRotation,Fin.sum_univ_three]
  · nlinarith only [rotation_pair_square t (x 0) (x 1)]
  · nlinarith only [rotation_pair_square t (x 0) (x 2)]
  · nlinarith only [rotation_pair_square t (x 1) (x 0)]
  · nlinarith only [rotation_pair_square t (x 1) (x 2)]
  · nlinarith only [rotation_pair_square t (x 2) (x 0)]
  · nlinarith only [rotation_pair_square t (x 2) (x 1)]

/-- No orthogonality premise is supplied: the trigonometric flow is proved isometric. -/
def coordinateRotationIsometry (i j : Fin 3) (t : ℝ) : R3 ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] R3 where
  toFun := coordinateRotation i j t
  invFun := coordinateRotation i j (-t)
  left_inv x := by simpa using coordinateRotation_inverse i j (-t) x
  right_inv x := coordinateRotation_inverse i j t x
  map_add' := coordinateRotation_add i j t
  map_smul' c x := coordinateRotation_smul i j t c x
  norm_map' := coordinateRotation_norm i j t

lemma coordinateRotation_zero (i j : Fin 3) (x : R3) :
    coordinateRotation i j 0 x = x := by
  ext l
  by_cases hij : i=j
  · simp [coordinateRotation,hij]
  · by_cases hli : l=i <;> by_cases hlj : l=j <;>
      simp [coordinateRotation,hij,Ne.symm hij,hli,hlj]

lemma rotationVector_self (i : Fin 3) (x : R3) : rotationVector i i x = 0 := by
  simp [rotationVector]

lemma contDiff_coordinateRotation (i j : Fin 3) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun q : ℝ × R3 => coordinateRotation i j q.1 q.2) := by
  apply contDiff_piLp'
  intro l
  by_cases hij : i=j
  · simp only [coordinateRotation,ite_eq_left hij]
    fun_prop
  · by_cases hli : l=i <;> by_cases hlj : l=j <;>
      simp only [coordinateRotation,ite_eq_right hij,Ne.symm hij,PiLp.toLp_apply,hli,hlj,ite_true,ite_false] <;> fun_prop

lemma continuous_sphereCoordinateRotation (i j : Fin 3) :
    Continuous (fun q : ℝ × UnitSphere => coordinateRotation i j q.1 q.2.val) := by
  have h1 : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × R3 => coordinateRotation i j q.1 q.2) :=
    (contDiff_coordinateRotation i j).continuous
  have h2 : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × UnitSphere => (q.1,q.2.val)) :=
    continuous_fst.prodMk (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd)
  convert! h1.comp h2 using 1

lemma contDiff_rotationVector (i j : Fin 3) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (rotationVector i j) := by
  unfold rotationVector
  fun_prop

lemma contDiff_sphereRotationDerivative (i j : Fin 3) (F : R3 → ℝ)
    (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (sphereRotationDerivative i j F) := by
  exact (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.mp hF).2.clm_apply (contDiff_rotationVector i j)

lemma hasDerivAt_coordinateRotation (i j : Fin 3) (t : ℝ) (x : R3) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => coordinateRotation i j s x)
      (rotationVector i j (coordinateRotation i j t x)) t := by
  have hpi : HasDerivAt (fun s => fun l => coordinateRotation i j s x l)
      (fun l => rotationVector i j (coordinateRotation i j t x) l) t := by
    apply hasDerivAt_pi.mpr
    intro l
    by_cases hij : i=j
    · simpa [coordinateRotation,hij,rotationVector] using hasDerivAt_const t (x l)
    · by_cases hli : l=i
      · subst l
        convert ((Real.hasDerivAt_cos t).mul_const (x i)).sub
          ((Real.hasDerivAt_sin t).mul_const (x j)) using 1 <;>
          simp [coordinateRotation,rotationVector,hij,Ne.symm hij,funext_iff,Pi.sub_apply,Pi.add_apply,mul_comm] <;> ring
      · by_cases hlj : l=j
        · subst l
          convert ((Real.hasDerivAt_sin t).mul_const (x i)).add
            ((Real.hasDerivAt_cos t).mul_const (x j)) using 1 <;>
            simp [coordinateRotation,rotationVector,hij,Ne.symm hij,funext_iff,Pi.sub_apply,Pi.add_apply,mul_comm] <;> ring
        · simpa [coordinateRotation,rotationVector,hij,Ne.symm hij,hli,hlj,Ne.symm hli,Ne.symm hlj]
            using hasDerivAt_const t (x l)
  convert!
    ((PiLp.continuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ (fun _ : Fin 3 => ℝ)).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.hasFDerivAt).comp_hasDerivAt t hpi using 1 <;> rfl

lemma hasDerivAt_rotation_comp (i j : Fin 3) (F : R3 → ℝ)
    (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F) (t : ℝ) (x : R3) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s => F (coordinateRotation i j s x))
      (sphereRotationDerivative i j F (coordinateRotation i j t x)) t := by
  exact ((hF.differentiable (by simp)) _).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t
    (hasDerivAt_coordinateRotation i j t x)

lemma integrable_sphere_continuous (f : UnitSphere → ℝ) (hf : Continuous f) :
    Integrable f sphereProbability := by
  have hi := hf.continuousOn.integrableOn_of_subset_isCompact isCompact_univ
    MeasurableSet.univ (show (univ : Set UnitSphere) ⊆ univ from Subset.rfl)
    (show sphereProbability univ ≠ (⊤ : ℝ≥0∞) by simp)
  simpa only [IntegrableOn,Measure.restrict_univ] using hi

lemma integral_rotation_product (i j : Fin 3) (t : ℝ) (F G : R3 → ℝ) :
    (∫ u : UnitSphere, F (coordinateRotation i j t u.val) *
      G (coordinateRotation i j t u.val) ∂sphereProbability) =
    ∫ u : UnitSphere, F u.val * G u.val ∂sphereProbability := by
  exact (orthogonalSphereHomeomorph_sphereProbability_preserving
    (coordinateRotationIsometry i j t)).integral_comp
      (orthogonalSphereHomeomorph (coordinateRotationIsometry i j t)).measurableEmbedding
      (fun u : UnitSphere => F u.val * G u.val)

/-- The uniform bound is derived on one compact product before any orbit integral derivative. -/
lemma exists_rotation_product_derivative_bound (i j : Fin 3) (F G : R3 → ℝ)
    (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ t ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1, ∀ u : UnitSphere,
      ‖sphereRotationDerivative i j F (coordinateRotation i j t u.val) *
        G (coordinateRotation i j t u.val) + F (coordinateRotation i j t u.val) *
        sphereRotationDerivative i j G (coordinateRotation i j t u.val)‖ ≤ C := by
  let D : ℝ × UnitSphere → ℝ := fun q =>
    sphereRotationDerivative i j F (coordinateRotation i j q.1 q.2.val) *
      G (coordinateRotation i j q.1 q.2.val) +
    F (coordinateRotation i j q.1 q.2.val) *
      sphereRotationDerivative i j G (coordinateRotation i j q.1 q.2.val)
  have hrot : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × UnitSphere => coordinateRotation i j q.1 q.2.val) :=
    continuous_sphereCoordinateRotation i j
  have hD : Continuous D := by
    exact (((contDiff_sphereRotationDerivative i j F hF).continuous.comp hrot).mul
      (hG.continuous.comp hrot)).add
      ((hF.continuous.comp hrot).mul
        ((contDiff_sphereRotationDerivative i j G hG).continuous.comp hrot))
  have hK : IsCompact (Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ (univ : Set UnitSphere)) :=
    isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_univ
  rcases hK.bddAbove_image hD.norm.continuousOn with ⟨C,hC⟩
  refine ⟨max C 0,le_max_right _ _,?_⟩
  intro t ht u
  exact (hC (mem_image_of_mem _ (show (t,u) ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ
    (univ : Set UnitSphere) from ⟨ht,mem_univ _⟩))).trans (le_max_left _ _)

/-- Actual weak skew-adjunction for the sphere probability measure and true rotation fields. -/
theorem integral_sphereRotationDerivative_skew (i j : Fin 3) (F G : R3 → ℝ)
    (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :
    (∫ u : UnitSphere, sphereRotationDerivative i j F u.val * G u.val ∂sphereProbability) =
      -(∫ u : UnitSphere, F u.val * sphereRotationDerivative i j G u.val ∂sphereProbability) := by
  let H : ℝ → UnitSphere → ℝ := fun t u =>
    F (coordinateRotation i j t u.val) * G (coordinateRotation i j t u.val)
  let D : ℝ → UnitSphere → ℝ := fun t u =>
    sphereRotationDerivative i j F (coordinateRotation i j t u.val) *
      G (coordinateRotation i j t u.val) +
    F (coordinateRotation i j t u.val) *
      sphereRotationDerivative i j G (coordinateRotation i j t u.val)
  have hrot (t : ℝ) : Continuous (fun u : UnitSphere => coordinateRotation i j t u.val) :=
    (coordinateRotationIsometry i j t).continuous.comp continuous_subtype_val
  have hH (t : ℝ) : Continuous (H t) :=
    (hF.continuous.comp (hrot t)).mul (hG.continuous.comp (hrot t))
  have hD (t : ℝ) : Continuous (D t) :=
    (((contDiff_sphereRotationDerivative i j F hF).continuous.comp (hrot t)).mul
      (hG.continuous.comp (hrot t))).add
      ((hF.continuous.comp (hrot t)).mul
        ((contDiff_sphereRotationDerivative i j G hG).continuous.comp (hrot t)))
  obtain ⟨C,hC,hbound⟩ := exists_rotation_product_derivative_bound i j F G hF hG
  have hdiff : ∀ u : UnitSphere, ∀ t : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun s => H s u) (D t u) t := by
    intro u t
    exact (hasDerivAt_rotation_comp i j F hF t u.val).mul
      (hasDerivAt_rotation_comp i j G hG t u.val)
  have hd := (hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le
    (F := H) (F' := D) (μ := sphereProbability) (x₀ := (0 : ℝ))
    (s := Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1) (bound := fun _ : UnitSphere => C)
    (Ioo_mem_nhds (by norm_num) (by norm_num))
    (Eventually.of_forall fun t => (hH t).aestronglyMeasurable)
    (integrable_sphere_continuous (H 0) (hH 0))
    ((hD 0).aestronglyMeasurable)
    (Eventually.of_forall fun u t ht => hbound t ⟨le_of_lt ht.1,le_of_lt ht.2⟩ u)
    (integrable_const C)
    (Eventually.of_forall fun u t _ => hdiff u t)).2
  have hconst : (fun t => ∫ u : UnitSphere, H t u ∂sphereProbability) =
      fun _ : ℝ => ∫ u : UnitSphere, F u.val * G u.val ∂sphereProbability := by
    funext t
    exact integral_rotation_product i j t F G
  have hz : (∫ u : UnitSphere, D 0 u ∂sphereProbability) = 0 :=
    hd.unique (by
      rw [hconst]
      exact hasDerivAt_const (0 : ℝ)
        (∫ u : UnitSphere, F u.val * G u.val ∂sphereProbability))
  have hleft := integrable_sphere_continuous
    (fun u : UnitSphere => sphereRotationDerivative i j F u.val * G u.val)
    (((contDiff_sphereRotationDerivative i j F hF).continuous.comp continuous_subtype_val).mul
      (hG.continuous.comp continuous_subtype_val))
  have hright := integrable_sphere_continuous
    (fun u : UnitSphere => F u.val * sphereRotationDerivative i j G u.val)
    ((hF.continuous.comp continuous_subtype_val).mul
      ((contDiff_sphereRotationDerivative i j G hG).continuous.comp continuous_subtype_val))
  simp only [D,coordinateRotation_zero] at hz
  rw [integral_add hleft hright] at hz
  linarith

lemma sphereRotationDerivative_eq_zero_of_sphere_zero (i j : Fin 3) (F : R3 → ℝ)
    (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F) (hzero : ∀ u : UnitSphere, F u.val = 0) (u : UnitSphere) :
    sphereRotationDerivative i j F u.val = 0 := by
  have hz : (fun t : ℝ => F (coordinateRotation i j t u.val)) = fun _ : ℝ => 0 := by
    funext t
    exact hzero (orthogonalSphereHomeomorph (coordinateRotationIsometry i j t) u)
  have hd := hasDerivAt_rotation_comp i j F hF 0 u.val
  simp only [coordinateRotation_zero] at hd
  exact hd.unique (by rw [hz]; exact hasDerivAt_const (0 : ℝ) (0 : ℝ))

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SmoothSphereRotation

``````

## Calderon.SmoothAngularCasimir

``````lean
import Calderon.SmoothSphereRotation
import Calderon.RotationCasimir
import Calderon.GreenEuclidean
import Calderon.SpectralCoreRegularity
import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Lp.lpSpace
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.ContDiff.Operations

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory MvPolynomial
open scoped ContDiff Topology ENNReal InnerProductSpace
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SmoothAngularCasimir
open SphereHarmonic SmoothSphereRotation SphereHilbertDecomposition SpectralCoreRegularity
open AngularPolynomial GreenRadialTrace RotationCasimir

/-- Ordered pairs are counted twice, so the normalization is `-1/2`. -/
def angularCasimir (F : R3 → ℝ) (x : R3) : ℝ :=
  -(1/2 : ℝ) * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
    sphereRotationDerivative i j (sphereRotationDerivative i j F) x

/-- This is distinct from the manuscript's lower-order operator `J`. -/
def shiftedAngularCasimir (F : R3 → ℝ) (x : R3) : ℝ := F x + angularCasimir F x

def shiftedAngularCasimirIterate : ℕ → (R3 → ℝ) → R3 → ℝ
  | 0,F => F
  | m+1,F => shiftedAngularCasimir (shiftedAngularCasimirIterate m F)

lemma contDiff_angularCasimir (F : R3 → ℝ) (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (angularCasimir F) := by
  have hsum : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      sphereRotationDerivative i j (sphereRotationDerivative i j F) x) :=
    ContDiff.sum fun i _ => ContDiff.sum fun j _ =>
      contDiff_sphereRotationDerivative i j _ (contDiff_sphereRotationDerivative i j F hF)
  exact contDiff_const.mul hsum

lemma contDiff_shiftedAngularCasimir (F : R3 → ℝ) (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (shiftedAngularCasimir F) := hF.add (contDiff_angularCasimir F hF)

lemma contDiff_shiftedAngularCasimirIterate (m : ℕ) (F : R3 → ℝ)
    (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (shiftedAngularCasimirIterate m F) := by
  induction m with
  | zero => exact hF
  | succ m hm => exact contDiff_shiftedAngularCasimir _ hm

def smoothSphereRestriction (F : R3 → ℝ) (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F) : C(UnitSphere,ℝ) :=
  ⟨fun u => F u.val,hF.continuous.comp continuous_subtype_val⟩

def smoothSphereLift (F : R3 → ℝ) (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F) : SphereL2 :=
  ContinuousMap.toLp 2 sphereProbability ℝ (smoothSphereRestriction F hF)

lemma smoothSphereLift_inner (F G : R3 → ℝ) (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F)
    (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :
    ⟪smoothSphereLift F hF,smoothSphereLift G hG⟫_ℝ =

  simpa only [smoothSphereLift,smoothSphereRestriction,ContinuousMap.coe_mk,
    starRingEnd_apply,star_trivial,mul_comm] using
      ContinuousMap.inner_toLp sphereProbability (smoothSphereRestriction F hF)
        (smoothSphereRestriction G hG)

lemma smoothSphereLift_add (F G : R3 → ℝ) (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F)
    (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :
    smoothSphereLift (fun x => F x+G x) (hF.add hG) =
      smoothSphereLift F hF + smoothSphereLift G hG := by
  unfold smoothSphereLift
  rw [← map_add]
  congr 1

lemma smoothSphereLift_angularCasimir (F : R3 → ℝ) (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F) :
    smoothSphereLift (angularCasimir F) (contDiff_angularCasimir F hF) =
      -(1/2 : ℝ) • ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,

            (contDiff_sphereRotationDerivative i j F hF)) := by
  let f : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → C(UnitSphere,ℝ) := fun i j =>
    smoothSphereRestriction (sphereRotationDerivative i j (sphereRotationDerivative i j F))
      (contDiff_sphereRotationDerivative i j _ (contDiff_sphereRotationDerivative i j F hF))
  have hc : smoothSphereRestriction (angularCasimir F) (contDiff_angularCasimir F hF) =
      -(1/2 : ℝ) • ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, f i j := by
    ext u
    simp [smoothSphereRestriction,angularCasimir,f]
  unfold smoothSphereLift
  rw [hc]
  simp only [map_smul,map_sum,f,smoothSphereLift]

lemma smoothSphereLift_shiftedAngularCasimir (F : R3 → ℝ) (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F) :
    smoothSphereLift (shiftedAngularCasimir F) (contDiff_shiftedAngularCasimir F hF) =
      smoothSphereLift F hF + smoothSphereLift (angularCasimir F) (contDiff_angularCasimir F hF) :=
  smoothSphereLift_add F (angularCasimir F) hF (contDiff_angularCasimir F hF)

lemma inner_sphereRotationDerivative_skew (i j : Fin 3) (F G : R3 → ℝ)
    (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :

    (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :
    ⟪smoothSphereLift (angularCasimir F) (contDiff_angularCasimir F hF),smoothSphereLift G hG⟫_ℝ =

  rw [smoothSphereLift_angularCasimir F hF,smoothSphereLift_angularCasimir G hG]

    real_inner_smul_right (smoothSphereLift F hF) _ (-(1/2 : ℝ))]

  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _

    (contDiff_sphereRotationDerivative i j F hF) hG
  have h2 := inner_sphereRotationDerivative_skew i j F (sphereRotationDerivative i j G) hF
    (contDiff_sphereRotationDerivative i j G hG)
  linarith

lemma inner_shiftedAngularCasimir_symmetric (F G : R3 → ℝ) (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F)
    (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :

lemma contDiff_polynomialEvaluation (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (polynomialEvaluation p) := by

  induction p using MvPolynomial.induction_on with

  change (ContinuousMap.toLp 2 sphereProbability ℝ) _ =

theorem hasSum_smooth_shiftedAngularCasimir (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (m : ℕ) (F : R3 → ℝ) (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F) :
    HasSum (fun k : ℕ => (1+(k:ℝ)*((k:ℝ)+1))^(2*m) *
      ‖sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (smoothSphereLift F hF)‖^2)

        (contDiff_shiftedAngularCasimirIterate m F hF)‖^2) := by
  have h := lp.hasSum_norm (show 0 < (2 : ℝ≥0∞).toReal by norm_num)

  simp only [← pow_mul,Nat.mul_comm]

/-- The constant is fixed before degree and truncation; no assumed tail budget. -/
lemma angular_weight_le_shiftedCasimir (m q k : ℕ) (hq : q ≤ 4*m) :
    (1+(k:ℝ))^q ≤ (2:ℝ)^(2*m) * (1+(k:ℝ)*((k:ℝ)+1))^(2*m) := by
  have ha : (1+(k:ℝ))^2 ≤ 2*(1+(k:ℝ)*((k:ℝ)+1)) := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (k:ℝ)]
  calc
    (1+(k:ℝ))^q ≤ (1+(k:ℝ))^(4*m) :=
      pow_le_pow_right₀ (by nlinarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) k]) hq
    _ = ((1+(k:ℝ))^2)^(2*m) := by
      rw [← pow_mul]
      congr 1
      omega
    _ ≤ (2*(1+(k:ℝ)*((k:ℝ)+1)))^(2*m) :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) ha _
    _ = _ := by rw [mul_pow]

/-- Every finite angular power is summable because an actual smooth Casimir iterate is L2. -/
theorem summable_smooth_angular_weight (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (m q : ℕ) (hq : q ≤ 4*m)
    (F : R3 → ℝ) (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F) :
    Summable (fun k : ℕ => (1+(k:ℝ))^q *
      ‖sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (smoothSphereLift F hF)‖^2) := by
  have hs := (hasSum_smooth_shiftedAngularCasimir hO hD m F hF).summable.mul_left
    ((2:ℝ)^(2*m))
  apply Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun k => by positivity) _ hs
  intro k
  simpa only [mul_assoc] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
    (angular_weight_le_shiftedCasimir m q k hq)
    (sq_nonneg ‖sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (smoothSphereLift F hF)‖)

theorem summable_smooth_angular_weight_all (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (q : ℕ) (F : R3 → ℝ) (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F) :
    Summable (fun k : ℕ => (1+(k:ℝ))^q *
      ‖sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (smoothSphereLift F hF)‖^2) :=
  summable_smooth_angular_weight hO hD q q (by omega) F hF

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SmoothAngularCasimir

## Calderon.SmoothAmbientAngularCasimir

SHA256 `ab3d5b5c6960291e3985c28ce0f0d451d626cb78fb24e539ab90904390d4646f`.

``````lean
import Calderon.SmoothAngularCasimir
import Calderon.SmoothSphereFields
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FDeriv.Prod

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped ContDiff Topology ENNReal
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SmoothAmbientAngularCasimir
open SphereHarmonic SmoothSphereRotation SmoothAngularCasimir SmoothSphereFields

/-- The actual angular derivative in the ambient base/angular product. -/
def ambientAngularRotation (i j : Fin 3) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (q : R3 × R3) : ℝ :=
  fderiv ℝ G q (0,rotationVector i j q.2)

def ambientAngularCasimir (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (q : R3 × R3) : ℝ :=
  -(1/2 : ℝ) * ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
    ambientAngularRotation i j (ambientAngularRotation i j G) q

def ambientShiftedAngularCasimir (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (q : R3 × R3) : ℝ :=
  G q + ambientAngularCasimir G q

def ambientShiftedAngularCasimirIterate : ℕ → (R3 × R3 → ℝ) → R3 × R3 → ℝ
  | 0,G => G
  | m+1,G => ambientShiftedAngularCasimir (ambientShiftedAngularCasimirIterate m G)

lemma contDiff_angular_slice (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (x : R3) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => G (x,z)) := hG.comp (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id)

lemma fderiv_angular_slice_apply (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G)
    (x z v : R3) : fderiv ℝ (fun w => G (x,w)) z v = fderiv ℝ G (x,z) (0,v) := by
  convert! congrArg (fun L : R3 →L[ℝ] ℝ => L v)
    ((((hG.differentiable (by simp)) (x,z)).hasFDerivAt.comp z
      (hasFDerivAt_prodMk_right x z)).fderiv) using 1 <;> rfl

lemma contDiff_ambientAngularRotation (i j : Fin 3) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ)
    (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (ambientAngularRotation i j G) :=
  (contDiff_infty_iff_fderiv.mp hG).2.clm_apply
    (contDiff_const.prodMk ((contDiff_rotationVector i j).comp contDiff_snd))

lemma ambientAngularRotation_slice (i j : Fin 3) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ)
    (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (x : R3) :
    (fun z => ambientAngularRotation i j G (x,z)) =
      sphereRotationDerivative i j (fun z => G (x,z)) := by
  funext z
  exact (fderiv_angular_slice_apply G hG x z (rotationVector i j z)).symm

lemma contDiff_ambientAngularCasimir (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (ambientAngularCasimir G) := by
  have hs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun q => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      ambientAngularRotation i j (ambientAngularRotation i j G) q) :=
    ContDiff.sum fun i _ => ContDiff.sum fun j _ => contDiff_ambientAngularRotation i j _
      (contDiff_ambientAngularRotation i j G hG)
  exact contDiff_const.mul hs

lemma ambientAngularCasimir_slice (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (x : R3) :
    (fun z => ambientAngularCasimir G (x,z)) = angularCasimir (fun z => G (x,z)) := by
  funext z
  unfold ambientAngularCasimir angularCasimir
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  have he := ambientAngularRotation_slice i j (ambientAngularRotation i j G)
    (contDiff_ambientAngularRotation i j G hG) x
  rw [ambientAngularRotation_slice i j G hG x] at he
  exact congrFun he z

lemma contDiff_ambientShiftedAngularCasimir (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (ambientShiftedAngularCasimir G) := hG.add (contDiff_ambientAngularCasimir G hG)

lemma ambientShiftedAngularCasimir_slice (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (x : R3) :
    (fun z => ambientShiftedAngularCasimir G (x,z)) = shiftedAngularCasimir (fun z => G (x,z)) := by
  funext z
  exact congrArg (fun a : ℝ => G (x,z)+a) (congrFun (ambientAngularCasimir_slice G hG x) z)

lemma contDiff_ambientShiftedAngularCasimirIterate (m : ℕ) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ)
    (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (ambientShiftedAngularCasimirIterate m G) := by
  induction m with
  | zero => exact hG
  | succ m hm => exact contDiff_ambientShiftedAngularCasimir _ hm

lemma ambientShiftedAngularCasimirIterate_slice (m : ℕ) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ)
    (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (x : R3) :
    (fun z => ambientShiftedAngularCasimirIterate m G (x,z)) =
      shiftedAngularCasimirIterate m (fun z => G (x,z)) := by
  induction m with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ m hm =>
      rw [ambientShiftedAngularCasimirIterate,ambientShiftedAngularCasimir_slice
        _ (contDiff_ambientShiftedAngularCasimirIterate m G hG) x,hm]
      rfl

lemma ambientAngularRotation_sphere_zero (i j : Fin 3) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ)
    (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (K : Set R3)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ u : UnitSphere, G (x,u.val)=0) :
    ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ u : UnitSphere, ambientAngularRotation i j G (x,u.val)=0 := by
  intro x hx u
  have he := congrFun (ambientAngularRotation_slice i j G hG x) u.val
  rw [he]
  exact sphereRotationDerivative_eq_zero_of_sphere_zero i j _
    (contDiff_angular_slice G hG x) (hz x hx) u

lemma ambientShiftedAngularCasimir_sphere_zero (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ)
    (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (K : Set R3)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ u : UnitSphere, G (x,u.val)=0) :
    ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ u : UnitSphere, ambientShiftedAngularCasimir G (x,u.val)=0 := by
  intro x hx u
  have ho (i j : Fin 3) : ambientAngularRotation i j (ambientAngularRotation i j G) (x,u.val)=0 :=
    ambientAngularRotation_sphere_zero i j _ (contDiff_ambientAngularRotation i j G hG) K
      (ambientAngularRotation_sphere_zero i j G hG K hz) x hx u
  simp [ambientShiftedAngularCasimir,ambientAngularCasimir,hz x hx u,ho]

lemma ambientShiftedAngularCasimirIterate_sphere_zero (m : ℕ) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ)
    (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (K : Set R3)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ u : UnitSphere, G (x,u.val)=0) :
    ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ u : UnitSphere, ambientShiftedAngularCasimirIterate m G (x,u.val)=0 := by
  induction m with
  | zero => exact hz
  | succ m hm =>
      exact ambientShiftedAngularCasimir_sphere_zero _
        (contDiff_ambientShiftedAngularCasimirIterate m G hG) K hm

lemma ambientSphereL2_eq_smoothSphereLift (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (x : R3) :
    ambientSphereL2 G hG x = smoothSphereLift (fun z => G (x,z)) (contDiff_angular_slice G hG x) := by
  change (ContinuousMap.toLp 2 sphereProbability ℝ) _ =
    (ContinuousMap.toLp 2 sphereProbability ℝ) _
  congr 1

lemma hasCompactSupport_angularCasimirLift (m : ℕ) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ)
    (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ u : UnitSphere, G (x,u.val)=0) :
    HasCompactSupport (ambientSphereL2 (ambientShiftedAngularCasimirIterate m G)
      (contDiff_ambientShiftedAngularCasimirIterate m G hG)) :=
  hasCompactSupport_ambientSphereL2 _ (contDiff_ambientShiftedAngularCasimirIterate m G hG) K hK
    (ambientShiftedAngularCasimirIterate_sphere_zero m G hG K hz)

/-- A genuinely smooth compact-base L2 output, built from actual angular derivatives. -/
lemma contDiff_angularCasimirLift (m : ℕ) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (ambientSphereL2 (ambientShiftedAngularCasimirIterate m G)
      (contDiff_ambientShiftedAngularCasimirIterate m G hG)) :=
  contDiff_ambientSphereL2 _ (contDiff_ambientShiftedAngularCasimirIterate m G hG)

/-- Actual coefficients, with no supplied angular summability premise. -/
theorem sphereHarmonicCoordinate_angularCasimirLift (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (m k : ℕ) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (x : R3) :
    SpectralCoreRegularity.sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k
      (ambientSphereL2 (ambientShiftedAngularCasimirIterate m G)
        (contDiff_ambientShiftedAngularCasimirIterate m G hG) x) =
    (1+(k:ℝ)*((k:ℝ)+1))^m • SpectralCoreRegularity.sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k
      (ambientSphereL2 G hG x) := by
  simp_rw [ambientSphereL2_eq_smoothSphereLift]
  have he := ambientShiftedAngularCasimirIterate_slice m G hG x
  have hl : smoothSphereLift (fun z => ambientShiftedAngularCasimirIterate m G (x,z))
      (contDiff_angular_slice _ (contDiff_ambientShiftedAngularCasimirIterate m G hG) x) =
      smoothSphereLift (shiftedAngularCasimirIterate m (fun z => G (x,z)))
        (contDiff_shiftedAngularCasimirIterate m _ (contDiff_angular_slice G hG x)) := by
    unfold smoothSphereLift
    congr 1
    ext u
    exact congrFun he u.val
  rw [hl]
  exact sphereHarmonicCoordinate_shiftedAngularCasimirIterate hO hD m k _
    (contDiff_angular_slice G hG x)

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SmoothAmbientAngularCasimir

import Calderon.SphereHilbertDecomposition
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FDeriv.Linear
import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Module.FiniteDimension

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory MvPolynomial Filter
open scoped ContDiff Topology ENNReal
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SpectralCoreRegularity
open SphereHarmonic SphereHilbertDecomposition HarmonicSampling FischerConnectionTransport

def sphereHarmonicCoordinate (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (k : ℕ) : SphereL2 →L[ℝ] harmonicSphereSubspace k :=
  (lp.evalCLM ℝ (fun k : ℕ => harmonicSphereSubspace k) 2 k).comp
    (sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toContinuousLinearMap

lemma sphereHarmonicCoordinate_apply (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (k : ℕ) (u : SphereL2) :
    sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k u = sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD u k := rfl

lemma norm_sphereHarmonicCoordinate_le (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (k : ℕ) (u : SphereL2) :
    ‖sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k u‖ ≤ ‖u‖ := by
  have h := lp.norm_apply_le_norm (show (2 : ℝ≥0∞) ≠ 0 by norm_num)
    (sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD u) k
  simpa only [sphereHarmonicCoordinate_apply, LinearIsometryEquiv.norm_map] using h

lemma sphereHarmonicCoordinate_subtype (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (k : ℕ) (v : harmonicSphereSubspace k) :
    sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (v : SphereL2) = v := by
  rw [sphereHarmonicCoordinate_apply, sphereHarmonicDecomposition_subtype]
  simp

def sphereHarmonicPartialSum (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (n : ℕ) : SphereL2 →L[ℝ] SphereL2 :=
  ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (harmonicSphereSubspace k).subtypeL.comp
    (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k)

lemma sphereHarmonicPartialSum_apply (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (n : ℕ) (u : SphereL2) :
    sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n u =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD u k : SphereL2) := by
  simp [sphereHarmonicPartialSum, sphereHarmonicCoordinate_apply]

theorem tendsto_sphereHarmonicPartialSum (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (u : SphereL2) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n u) atTop (𝓝 u) := by
  simpa only [sphereHarmonicPartialSum_apply] using
    (hasSum_sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD u).tendsto_sum_nat

lemma contDiff_sphereHarmonicCoordinate (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (k : ℕ) (U : R3 → SphereL2)
    (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (U x)) :=
  (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k).contDiff.comp hU

lemma contDiff_sphereHarmonicPartialSum (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (n : ℕ) (U : R3 → SphereL2)
    (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n (U x)) :=
  (sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n).contDiff.comp hU

lemma fderiv_sphereHarmonicCoordinate (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (k : ℕ) (U : R3 → SphereL2) (x : R3)
    (hU : DifferentiableAt ℝ U x) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun y => sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (U y)) x =
      (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k).comp (fderiv ℝ U x) :=
  ((sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k).hasFDerivAt.comp x hU.hasFDerivAt).fderiv

lemma fderiv_sphereHarmonicPartialSum (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (n : ℕ) (U : R3 → SphereL2) (x : R3)
    (hU : DifferentiableAt ℝ U x) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun y => sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n (U y)) x =
      (sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n).comp (fderiv ℝ U x) :=
  ((sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n).hasFDerivAt.comp x hU.hasFDerivAt).fderiv

theorem tendsto_fderiv_sphereHarmonicPartialSum_apply (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (U : R3 → SphereL2) (x X : R3)
    (hU : DifferentiableAt ℝ U x) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => fderiv ℝ
      (fun y => sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n (U y)) x X)
      atTop (𝓝 (fderiv ℝ U x X)) := by
  simp_rw [fderiv_sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD _ U x hU,
    ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
  exact tendsto_sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD (fderiv ℝ U x X)

lemma sphereHarmonicCoordinate_eq_zero_of_eq_zero (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (k : ℕ) (U : R3 → SphereL2) (x : R3)
    (hU : U x = 0) : sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (U x) = 0 := by
  rw [hU, map_zero]

lemma sphereHarmonicPartialSum_eq_zero_of_eq_zero (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (n : ℕ) (U : R3 → SphereL2) (x : R3)
    (hU : U x = 0) : sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n (U x) = 0 := by
  rw [hU, map_zero]

lemma hasCompactSupport_sphereHarmonicCoordinate (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (k : ℕ) (U : R3 → SphereL2)
    (hU : HasCompactSupport U) :
    HasCompactSupport (fun x => sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (U x)) :=
  hU.comp_left (map_zero (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k))

lemma hasCompactSupport_sphereHarmonicPartialSum (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (n : ℕ) (U : R3 → SphereL2)
    (hU : HasCompactSupport U) :
    HasCompactSupport (fun x => sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n (U x)) :=
  hU.comp_left (map_zero (sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n))

theorem exists_smooth_compact_coordinates_sphereHarmonicCoordinate
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (k : ℕ)
    (U : R3 → SphereL2) (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hzero : ∀ x ∉ K, U x = 0) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ b : Fin n → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ, ∃ c : R3 → Fin n → ℝ,
      (∀ j, b j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ c ∧ HasCompactSupport c ∧
      (∀ x, polynomialSphereL2 (finitePolynomialField b c x) =
        (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (U x) : SphereL2)) ∧
      (∀ x ∉ K, c x = 0) := by
  classical
  letI := finiteDimensional_harmonicSphereSubspace k
  let B := Module.finBasis ℝ (harmonicSphereSubspace k)
  have hex : ∀ j, ∃ p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ,
      p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k ∧ polynomialSphereL2 p = (B j : SphereL2) := by
    intro j
    exact (B j).property
  choose b hb he using hex
  let c : R3 → Fin (Module.finrank ℝ (harmonicSphereSubspace k)) → ℝ :=
    fun x => B.equivFunL (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (U x))
  have hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c :=
    B.equivFunL.contDiff.comp (contDiff_sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k U hU)
  have hcz : ∀ x ∉ K, c x = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    change B.equivFunL (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (U x)) = 0
    rw [hzero x hx, map_zero, map_zero]
  have hcomp : HasCompactSupport c := by
    apply hK.of_isClosed_subset (isClosed_tsupport _) ?_
    apply closure_minimal ?_ hK.isClosed
    intro x hx
    by_contra hnot
    exact hx (hcz x hnot)
  refine ⟨Module.finrank ℝ (harmonicSphereSubspace k), b, c, hb, hc, hcomp, ?_, hcz⟩
  intro x
  have hsum := congrArg (fun v : harmonicSphereSubspace k => (v : SphereL2))
    (B.sum_repr (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (U x)))
  unfold finitePolynomialField
  rw [map_sum]
  have hterm (j) : polynomialSphereL2 (c x j • b j) = c x j • (B j : SphereL2) := by
    rw [map_smul, he j]
  simp_rw [hterm]
  simpa only [Submodule.coe_sum, Submodule.coe_smul, c, Module.Basis.equivFunL_apply,
    Module.Basis.equivFun_apply] using hsum

theorem exists_smooth_compact_polynomial_sphereHarmonicCoordinate
    (hF : SphereFischerInner) (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (k : ℕ) (U : R3 → SphereL2)
    (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hzero : ∀ x ∉ K, U x = 0) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ b : Fin n → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ, ∃ c : R3 → Fin n → ℝ,
      (∀ j, b j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ c ∧ HasCompactSupport c ∧
      (∀ x, polynomialSphereL2 (finitePolynomialField b c x) =
        (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (U x) : SphereL2)) ∧
      (∀ x ∉ K, finitePolynomialField b c x = 0) := by
  obtain ⟨n,b,c,hb,hc,hcompact,hrep,hcz⟩ :=
    exists_smooth_compact_coordinates_sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k U hU K hK hzero
  refine ⟨n,b,c,hb,hc,hcompact,hrep,?_⟩
  intro x hx
  apply (polynomialSphereL2_eq_zero_iff hF k _
    (finitePolynomialField_harmonicHomogeneous k b hb c x)).mp
  rw [hrep x, hzero x hx, map_zero]
  rfl

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SpectralCoreRegularity

## Calderon.NaturalAdjointCommutator

SHA256 `a29131e45563a5956f2ac3c37ef7cc4e3f4dd19be942841efdde25ceaf68ad50`.

``````lean
import Calderon.NaturalAngularAdjointIntegration

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open scoped ContDiff
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.NaturalAngularAdjoint
open PrincipalCommutator

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]

lemma zero_scalar_second_commutator (i j : R3) (a : R3 → ℝ)
    (H : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (w : R3 → E)
    (hH : ContDiff ℝ ∞ H) (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w) (x : R3) :
    H x (a x • directionalFDeriv i (directionalFDeriv j w) x) -
      a x • directionalFDeriv i (directionalFDeriv j (fun y => H y (w y))) x =
    -a x • directionalFDeriv i (directionalFDeriv j H) x (w x) -
      a x • directionalFDeriv j H x (directionalFDeriv i w x) -
      a x • directionalFDeriv i H x (directionalFDeriv j w x) := by
  rw [map_smul, directionalFDeriv_second_clm_apply i j H w hH hw]
  simp only [smul_add]
  module

lemma first_first_commutator (i k : R3) (G B : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (w : R3 → E)
    (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (hB : ContDiff ℝ ∞ B) (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w) (x : R3) :
    G x (directionalFDeriv k (fun y => B y (directionalFDeriv i w y)) x) -
      B x (directionalFDeriv i (fun y => G y (directionalFDeriv k w y)) x) =
    G x (directionalFDeriv k B x (directionalFDeriv i w x)) -
      B x (directionalFDeriv i G x (directionalFDeriv k w x)) +
      ((G x).comp (B x) - (B x).comp (G x))
        (directionalFDeriv k (directionalFDeriv i w) x) := by
  rw [directionalFDeriv_clm_apply k B _ hB (contDiff_directionalFDeriv i w hw),
    directionalFDeriv_clm_apply i G _ hG (contDiff_directionalFDeriv k w hw),
    directionalFDeriv_commute i k w hw x]
  simp only [map_add, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
  abel

lemma zero_first_commutator (i : R3) (H B : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (w : R3 → E)
    (hH : ContDiff ℝ ∞ H) (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w) (x : R3) :
    H x (B x (directionalFDeriv i w x)) -
      B x (directionalFDeriv i (fun y => H y (w y)) x) =
    ((H x).comp (B x) - (B x).comp (H x)) (directionalFDeriv i w x) -
      B x (directionalFDeriv i H x (w x)) := by
  rw [directionalFDeriv_clm_apply i H w hH hw]
  simp only [map_add, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
  abel

lemma first_zero_commutator (k : R3) (G C : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (w : R3 → E)
    (hC : ContDiff ℝ ∞ C) (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w) (x : R3) :
    G x (directionalFDeriv k (fun y => C y (w y)) x) -
      C x (G x (directionalFDeriv k w x)) =
    G x (directionalFDeriv k C x (w x)) +
      ((G x).comp (C x) - (C x).comp (G x)) (directionalFDeriv k w x) := by
  rw [directionalFDeriv_clm_apply k C w hC hw]
  simp only [map_add, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
  abel

/-- Second-base part of the commutator of the computed zero defect and U.
 The computed H contains every μ/a/B*/C* derivative from the source formula. -/
theorem defect_zero_scalar_principal_commutator (v : Fin 3 → R3)
    (mu : R3 → ℝ) (a : MatrixField) (B : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] E)
    (C : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (w : R3 → E)
    (hm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ mu) (ha : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => a y i j))
    (hB : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (B i)) (hC : ContDiff ℝ ∞ C)
    (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w) (hp : ∀ x, mu x ≠ 0) (i j : Fin 3) (x : R3) :
    defectZeroCoefficient v mu a B C x
      (a x i j • directionalFDeriv (v i) (directionalFDeriv (v j) w) x) -
      a x i j • directionalFDeriv (v i) (directionalFDeriv (v j)
        (fun y => defectZeroCoefficient v mu a B C y (w y))) x =
    -a x i j • directionalFDeriv (v i)
      (directionalFDeriv (v j) (defectZeroCoefficient v mu a B C)) x (w x) -
    a x i j • directionalFDeriv (v j) (defectZeroCoefficient v mu a B C) x
      (directionalFDeriv (v i) w x) -
    a x i j • directionalFDeriv (v i) (defectZeroCoefficient v mu a B C) x
      (directionalFDeriv (v j) w x) := by
  exact zero_scalar_second_commutator (v i) (v j) (fun y => a y i j)
    (defectZeroCoefficient v mu a B C) w
    (contDiff_defectZeroCoefficient v mu a B C hm ha hB hC hp) hw x

/-- Actual angular coefficient commutators remain: no assumption G_k B_i = B_i G_k. -/
theorem defect_first_angular_first_commutator (v : Fin 3 → R3)
    (mu : R3 → ℝ) (a : MatrixField) (B : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] E)
    (w : R3 → E) (hm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ mu)
    (ha : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => a y i j))
    (hB : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (B i)) (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w)
    (hp : ∀ x, mu x ≠ 0) (i k : Fin 3) (x : R3) :
    defectFirstCoefficient v mu a B x k
      (directionalFDeriv (v k) (fun y => B i y (directionalFDeriv (v i) w y)) x) -
      B i x (directionalFDeriv (v i) (fun y => defectFirstCoefficient v mu a B y k
        (directionalFDeriv (v k) w y)) x) =
    defectFirstCoefficient v mu a B x k
      (directionalFDeriv (v k) (B i) x (directionalFDeriv (v i) w x)) -
      B i x (directionalFDeriv (v i) (fun y => defectFirstCoefficient v mu a B y k) x
        (directionalFDeriv (v k) w x)) +
    ((defectFirstCoefficient v mu a B x k).comp (B i x) -
      (B i x).comp (defectFirstCoefficient v mu a B x k))
        (directionalFDeriv (v k) (directionalFDeriv (v i) w) x) := by
  exact first_first_commutator (v i) (v k)
    (fun y => defectFirstCoefficient v mu a B y k) (B i) w
    (contDiff_defectFirstCoefficient v mu a B hm ha hB hp k) (hB i) hw x

/-- The computed zero defect paired with the actual first-base angular term. -/
theorem defect_zero_angular_first_commutator (v : Fin 3 → R3)
    (mu : R3 → ℝ) (a : MatrixField) (B : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] E)
    (C : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (w : R3 → E)
    (hm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ mu) (ha : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => a y i j))
    (hB : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (B i)) (hC : ContDiff ℝ ∞ C)
    (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w) (hp : ∀ x, mu x ≠ 0) (i : Fin 3) (x : R3) :
    defectZeroCoefficient v mu a B C x (B i x (directionalFDeriv (v i) w x)) -
      B i x (directionalFDeriv (v i) (fun y => defectZeroCoefficient v mu a B C y (w y)) x) =
    ((defectZeroCoefficient v mu a B C x).comp (B i x) -
      (B i x).comp (defectZeroCoefficient v mu a B C x)) (directionalFDeriv (v i) w x) -
      B i x (directionalFDeriv (v i) (defectZeroCoefficient v mu a B C) x (w x)) := by
  exact zero_first_commutator (v i) (defectZeroCoefficient v mu a B C) (B i) w
    (contDiff_defectZeroCoefficient v mu a B C hm ha hB hC hp) hw x

/-- The computed first defect paired with the actual zero-base angular coefficient. -/
theorem defect_first_angular_zero_commutator (v : Fin 3 → R3)
    (mu : R3 → ℝ) (a : MatrixField) (B : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] E)
    (C : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (w : R3 → E)
    (hC : ContDiff ℝ ∞ C) (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w) (k : Fin 3) (x : R3) :
    defectFirstCoefficient v mu a B x k
      (directionalFDeriv (v k) (fun y => C y (w y)) x) -
      C x (defectFirstCoefficient v mu a B x k (directionalFDeriv (v k) w x)) =
    defectFirstCoefficient v mu a B x k (directionalFDeriv (v k) C x (w x)) +
      ((defectFirstCoefficient v mu a B x k).comp (C x) -
        (C x).comp (defectFirstCoefficient v mu a B x k)) (directionalFDeriv (v k) w x) := by
  exact first_zero_commutator (v k) (fun y => defectFirstCoefficient v mu a B y k) C w hC hw x

/-- Final zero-base angular commutator is retained exactly. -/
lemma defect_zero_angular_zero_commutator (v : Fin 3 → R3) (mu : R3 → ℝ)
    (a : MatrixField) (B : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (C : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E)
    (w : R3 → E) (x : R3) :
    defectZeroCoefficient v mu a B C x (C x (w x)) -
      C x (defectZeroCoefficient v mu a B C x (w x)) =
    ((defectZeroCoefficient v mu a B C x).comp (C x) -
      (C x).comp (defectZeroCoefficient v mu a B C x)) (w x) := rfl

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.NaturalAngularAdjoint

``````
````````
