````````
## Calderon.NaturalAdjointNormalForm

SHA256 `f816d3528a246aa2c1352c56e11a17b1ea14008013c55a806e91eb870e679b7f`.

``````lean
import Calderon.NaturalFullAdjointReduction

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open Filter
open scoped ContDiff
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.NaturalAngularAdjoint
open PrincipalCommutator ScalarBaseAdjoint

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]

lemma directionalFDeriv_fintype_sum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (X : R3) (u : ι → R3 → E)
    (hu : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (u i)) (x : R3) :
    directionalFDeriv X (fun y => ∑ i, u i y) x =
      ∑ i, directionalFDeriv X (u i) x := by
  classical
  unfold directionalFDeriv
  rw [fderiv_fun_sum (fun i _ => (hu i).differentiable (by simp) x)]
  simp only [sum_apply]

lemma directionalFDeriv_second_fintype_sum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (X Y : R3)
    (u : ι → R3 → E) (hu : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (u i)) (x : R3) :
    directionalFDeriv X (directionalFDeriv Y (fun y => ∑ i, u i y)) x =
      ∑ i, directionalFDeriv X (directionalFDeriv Y (u i)) x := by
  have he : directionalFDeriv Y (fun y => ∑ i, u i y) =
      fun y => ∑ i, directionalFDeriv Y (u i) y :=
    funext (directionalFDeriv_fintype_sum Y u hu)
  rw [he]
  exact directionalFDeriv_fintype_sum X _ (fun i => contDiff_directionalFDeriv Y (u i) (hu i)) x

def firstPrincipalRemainder (v : Fin 3 → R3) (a : MatrixField)
    (G : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (w : R3 → E) (x : R3) : E :=
  ∑ k, ∑ i, ∑ j, (
    directionalFDeriv (v k) (fun y => a y i j) x •
      G k x (directionalFDeriv (v i) (directionalFDeriv (v j) w) x) -
    a x i j • directionalFDeriv (v i) (directionalFDeriv (v j) (G k)) x
      (directionalFDeriv (v k) w x) -
    a x i j • directionalFDeriv (v j) (G k) x
      (directionalFDeriv (v i) (directionalFDeriv (v k) w) x) -
    a x i j • directionalFDeriv (v i) (G k) x
      (directionalFDeriv (v j) (directionalFDeriv (v k) w) x))

def zeroPrincipalRemainder (v : Fin 3 → R3) (a : MatrixField)
    (H : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (w : R3 → E) (x : R3) : E :=
  ∑ i, ∑ j, (
    -a x i j • directionalFDeriv (v i) (directionalFDeriv (v j) H) x (w x) -
    a x i j • directionalFDeriv (v j) H x (directionalFDeriv (v i) w x) -
    a x i j • directionalFDeriv (v i) H x (directionalFDeriv (v j) w x))

def firstFirstRemainder (v : Fin 3 → R3) (G B : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] E)
    (w : R3 → E) (x : R3) : E :=
  ∑ k, ∑ i, (
    G k x (directionalFDeriv (v k) (B i) x (directionalFDeriv (v i) w x)) -
      B i x (directionalFDeriv (v i) (G k) x (directionalFDeriv (v k) w x)) +
      ((G k x).comp (B i x) - (B i x).comp (G k x))
        (directionalFDeriv (v k) (directionalFDeriv (v i) w) x))

def zeroFirstRemainder (v : Fin 3 → R3) (H : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E)
    (B : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (w : R3 → E) (x : R3) : E :=
  ∑ i, (((H x).comp (B i x) - (B i x).comp (H x)) (directionalFDeriv (v i) w x) -
    B i x (directionalFDeriv (v i) H x (w x)))

def firstZeroRemainder (v : Fin 3 → R3) (G : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] E)
    (C : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (w : R3 → E) (x : R3) : E :=
  ∑ k, (G k x (directionalFDeriv (v k) C x (w x)) +
    ((G k x).comp (C x) - (C x).comp (G k x)) (directionalFDeriv (v k) w x))

/-- Transparent normal form: every section derivative in these six summands
 has ordinary base order zero, one or two. Angular commutators are retained. -/
def secondBaseCommutatorRemainder (v : Fin 3 → R3) (a : MatrixField)
    (G : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (H : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E)
    (B : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (C : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E)
    (w : R3 → E) (x : R3) : E :=
  firstPrincipalRemainder v a G w x + zeroPrincipalRemainder v a H w x +
    firstFirstRemainder v G B w x + zeroFirstRemainder v H B w x +
    firstZeroRemainder v G C w x + ((H x).comp (C x) - (C x).comp (H x)) (w x)

lemma angularFirstBase_scalarSecondBase_commutator (v : Fin 3 → R3) (a : MatrixField)
    (G : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (w : R3 → E)
    (ha : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => a y i j))
    (hG : ∀ k, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (G k)) (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w) (x : R3) :
    angularFirstBase v G (scalarSecondBase v a w) x -
      scalarSecondBase v a (angularFirstBase v G w) x = firstPrincipalRemainder v a G w x := by
  have hs (X : R3) : directionalFDeriv X (scalarSecondBase v a w) =
      fun y => ∑ i, ∑ j, directionalFDeriv X
        (fun z => a z i j • directionalFDeriv (v i) (directionalFDeriv (v j) w) z) y := by
    funext y
    let F : Fin 3 → Fin 3 → R3 → E := fun i j z =>
      a z i j • directionalFDeriv (v i) (directionalFDeriv (v j) w) z
    have hF (i j : Fin 3) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (F i j) :=
      (ha i j).smul (contDiff_directionalFDeriv (v i) _ (contDiff_directionalFDeriv (v j) w hw))
    have hsum (i : Fin 3) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => ∑ j : Fin 3, F i j z) :=
      ContDiff.sum (f := F i) (s := Finset.univ) (fun j _ => hF i j)
    change directionalFDeriv X (fun z => ∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3, F i j z) y = _
    rw [directionalFDeriv_fintype_sum X (fun i z => ∑ j : Fin 3, F i j z) hsum y]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    exact directionalFDeriv_fintype_sum X (F i) (hF i) y
  have ht (X Y : R3) : directionalFDeriv X (directionalFDeriv Y (angularFirstBase v G w)) =
      fun y => ∑ k, directionalFDeriv X (directionalFDeriv Y
        (fun z => G k z (directionalFDeriv (v k) w z))) y := by
    funext y
    exact directionalFDeriv_second_fintype_sum X Y _
      (fun k => (hG k).clm_apply (contDiff_directionalFDeriv (v k) w hw)) y
  change (∑ k, G k x (directionalFDeriv (v k) (scalarSecondBase v a w) x)) -
    (∑ i, ∑ j, a x i j • directionalFDeriv (v i)
      (directionalFDeriv (v j) (angularFirstBase v G w)) x) = _
  simp_rw [hs, ht, map_sum, Finset.smul_sum]
  have he : (∑ i, ∑ j, ∑ k, a x i j • directionalFDeriv (v i)
        (directionalFDeriv (v j) (fun z => G k z (directionalFDeriv (v k) w z))) x) =
      ∑ k, ∑ i, ∑ j, a x i j • directionalFDeriv (v i)
        (directionalFDeriv (v j) (fun z => G k z (directionalFDeriv (v k) w z))) x := by
    calc
      _ = ∑ i, ∑ k, ∑ j, a x i j • directionalFDeriv (v i)
          (directionalFDeriv (v j) (fun z => G k z (directionalFDeriv (v k) w z))) x := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        exact Finset.sum_comm
      _ = _ := Finset.sum_comm
  unfold firstPrincipalRemainder
  rw [he, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _
  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  exact scalar_principal_directional_commutator (v i) (v j) (v k)
    (fun y => a y i j) (G k) w (ha i j) (hG k) hw x

lemma zero_scalarSecondBase_commutator (v : Fin 3 → R3) (a : MatrixField)
    (H : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (w : R3 → E)
    (hH : ContDiff ℝ ∞ H) (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w) (x : R3) :
    H x (scalarSecondBase v a w x) -
      scalarSecondBase v a (fun y => H y (w y)) x = zeroPrincipalRemainder v a H w x := by
  simp only [scalarSecondBase, zeroPrincipalRemainder, map_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  exact zero_scalar_second_commutator (v i) (v j) (fun y => a y i j) H w hH hw x

lemma angularFirstBase_commutator (v : Fin 3 → R3) (G B : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] E)
    (w : R3 → E) (hG : ∀ k, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (G k))
    (hB : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (B i)) (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w) (x : R3) :
    angularFirstBase v G (angularFirstBase v B w) x -
      angularFirstBase v B (angularFirstBase v G w) x = firstFirstRemainder v G B w x := by
  have hs (A : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (hA : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (A i)) (X : R3) :
      directionalFDeriv X (angularFirstBase v A w) =
      fun y => ∑ i, directionalFDeriv X (fun z => A i z (directionalFDeriv (v i) w z)) y := by
    funext y
    exact directionalFDeriv_fintype_sum X _
      (fun i => (hA i).clm_apply (contDiff_directionalFDeriv (v i) w hw)) y
  change (∑ k, G k x (directionalFDeriv (v k) (angularFirstBase v B w) x)) -
    (∑ i, B i x (directionalFDeriv (v i) (angularFirstBase v G w) x)) = _
  simp_rw [hs B hB, hs G hG, map_sum]
  conv_lhs => rhs; rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  unfold firstFirstRemainder
  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _
  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  exact first_first_commutator (v i) (v k) (G k) (B i) w (hG k) (hB i) hw x

lemma zero_angularFirstBase_commutator (v : Fin 3 → R3) (H : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E)
    (B : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (w : R3 → E)
    (hH : ContDiff ℝ ∞ H) (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w) (x : R3) :
    H x (angularFirstBase v B w x) - angularFirstBase v B (fun y => H y (w y)) x =
      zeroFirstRemainder v H B w x := by
  simp only [angularFirstBase, zeroFirstRemainder, map_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  exact zero_first_commutator (v i) H (B i) w hH hw x

lemma angularFirstBase_zero_commutator (v : Fin 3 → R3) (G : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] E)
    (C : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (w : R3 → E)
    (hC : ContDiff ℝ ∞ C) (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w) (x : R3) :
    angularFirstBase v G (fun y => C y (w y)) x - C x (angularFirstBase v G w x) =
      firstZeroRemainder v G C w x := by
  simp only [angularFirstBase, firstZeroRemainder, map_sum, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _
  exact first_zero_commutator (v k) (G k) C w hC hw x

def firstZeroOperator (v : Fin 3 → R3) (G : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] E)
    (H : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (w : R3 → E) (x : R3) : E :=
  angularFirstBase v G w x + H x (w x)

lemma firstZeroOperator_add (v : Fin 3 → R3) (G : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] E)
    (H : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (u w : R3 → E)
    (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w) (x : R3) :
    firstZeroOperator v G H (fun y => u y + w y) x =
      firstZeroOperator v G H u x + firstZeroOperator v G H w x := by
  simp only [firstZeroOperator, angularFirstBase]
  simp_rw [directionalFDeriv_add _ u w hu hw x, map_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  abel

/-- Full finite-summed commutator normal form, with no third-base section derivative. -/
theorem firstZeroOperator_naturalOperator_commutator (v : Fin 3 → R3) (a : MatrixField)
    (G : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (H : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E)
    (B : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (C : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (w : R3 → E)
    (ha : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => a y i j))
    (hG : ∀ k, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (G k)) (hH : ContDiff ℝ ∞ H)
    (hB : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (B i)) (hC : ContDiff ℝ ∞ C)
    (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w) (x : R3) :
    firstZeroOperator v G H (naturalOperator v a B C w) x -
      naturalOperator v a B C (firstZeroOperator v G H w) x =
      secondBaseCommutatorRemainder v a G H B C w x := by
  have hs := contDiff_scalarSecondBase v a w ha hw
  have hfb := contDiff_angularFirstBase v B w hB hw
  have hfg := contDiff_angularFirstBase v G w hG hw
  have hcw := hC.clm_apply hw
  have hhw := hH.clm_apply hw
  have hl : firstZeroOperator v G H (naturalOperator v a B C w) x =
      firstZeroOperator v G H (scalarSecondBase v a w) x +
      firstZeroOperator v G H (angularFirstBase v B w) x +
      firstZeroOperator v G H (fun y => C y (w y)) x := by
    unfold naturalOperator
    rw [firstZeroOperator_add v G H _ _ (hs.add hfb) hcw x,
      firstZeroOperator_add v G H _ _ hs hfb x]
  have hr : naturalOperator v a B C (firstZeroOperator v G H w) x =
      naturalOperator v a B C (angularFirstBase v G w) x +
      naturalOperator v a B C (fun y => H y (w y)) x := by
    exact naturalOperator_add v a B C _ _ hfg hhw x
  calc
    _ = (angularFirstBase v G (scalarSecondBase v a w) x -
          scalarSecondBase v a (angularFirstBase v G w) x) +
        (H x (scalarSecondBase v a w x) - scalarSecondBase v a (fun y => H y (w y)) x) +
        (angularFirstBase v G (angularFirstBase v B w) x -
          angularFirstBase v B (angularFirstBase v G w) x) +
        (H x (angularFirstBase v B w x) - angularFirstBase v B (fun y => H y (w y)) x) +
        (angularFirstBase v G (fun y => C y (w y)) x - C x (angularFirstBase v G w x)) +
        (H x (C x (w x)) - C x (H x (w x))) := by
      rw [hl, hr]
      unfold firstZeroOperator naturalOperator
      abel
    _ = _ := by
      rw [angularFirstBase_scalarSecondBase_commutator v a G w ha hG hw x,
        zero_scalarSecondBase_commutator v a H w hH hw x,
        angularFirstBase_commutator v G B w hG hB hw x,
        zero_angularFirstBase_commutator v H B w hH hw x,
        angularFirstBase_zero_commutator v G C w hC hw x]
      rfl

lemma naturalAdjointDefect_eq_firstZeroOperator (v : Fin 3 → R3) (mu : R3 → ℝ)
    (a : MatrixField) (B : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (C : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E)
    (w : R3 → E) :
    naturalAdjointDefect v mu a B C w =
      firstZeroOperator v (fun i y => defectFirstCoefficient v mu a B y i)
        (defectZeroCoefficient v mu a B C) w := by
  funext x
  exact add_comm _ _

/-- The full computed density/angular adjoint commutator has the transparent
 second-base normal form. Its angular order and quantitative form estimates are open. -/
theorem naturalFullAdjoint_commutator_normal_form (v : Fin 3 → R3)
    (mu : R3 → ℝ) (a : MatrixField) (B : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] E)
    (C : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (w : R3 → E)
    (hm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ mu) (ha : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => a y i j))
    (hB : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (B i)) (hC : ContDiff ℝ ∞ C)
    (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w) (hp : ∀ x, mu x ≠ 0)
    (hs : ∀ x, (a x).IsHermitian) (x : R3) :
    naturalFormalAdjoint v mu a B C (naturalOperator v a B C w) x -
      naturalOperator v a B C (naturalFormalAdjoint v mu a B C w) x =
    secondBaseCommutatorRemainder v a (fun i y => defectFirstCoefficient v mu a B y i)
      (defectZeroCoefficient v mu a B C) B C w x := by
  rw [naturalFullAdjoint_commutator_eq_defect_commutator v mu a B C w hm ha hB hC hw hp hs x,
    naturalAdjointDefect_eq_firstZeroOperator, naturalAdjointDefect_eq_firstZeroOperator]
  exact firstZeroOperator_naturalOperator_commutator v a _ _ B C w ha
    (fun i => contDiff_defectFirstCoefficient v mu a B hm ha hB hp i)
    (contDiff_defectZeroCoefficient v mu a B C hm ha hB hC hp) hB hC hw x

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.NaturalAngularAdjoint

``````

## Calderon.NaturalAngularAdjoint

SHA256 `72e2361eebae8205230f6a7f76ed03d5ff82105de3ca555b1118ed9f61f54acd`.

``````lean
import Calderon.ActualPerturbedDefect
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Adjoint

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Filter
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.NaturalAngularAdjoint
open PrincipalCommutator ScalarBaseAdjoint ActualScalarPrincipalAdjoint

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]

/-- The pointwise angular adjoint is the genuine Hilbert adjoint. -/
def angularAdjoint (B : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E :=
  fun x => ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (B x)

lemma contDiff_angularAdjoint (B : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (hB : ContDiff ℝ ∞ B) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (angularAdjoint B) := by
  exact (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint : (E →L[ℝ] E) ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] (E →L[ℝ] E)).contDiff.comp hB

lemma angularAdjoint_inner (B : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (x : R3) (u w : E) :
    ⟪B x u, w⟫_ℝ = ⟪u, angularAdjoint B x w⟫_ℝ := by
  exact (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right (B x) u w).symm

/-- Integration by parts for the actual first-base angular term, with the whole
 density and angular adjoint kept inside the derivative. -/
theorem compact_angular_first_adjoint (v : R3) (mu : R3 → ℝ)
    (B : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (u w : R3 → E)
    (hm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ mu) (hB : ContDiff ℝ ∞ B)
    (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w)
    (hc : HasCompactSupport u) (hp : ∀ x, mu x ≠ 0) :
    (∫ x : R3, mu x * ⟪B x (directionalFDeriv v u x), w x⟫_ℝ) =
      ∫ x : R3, mu x * ⟪u x, -(mu x)⁻¹ •
        directionalFDeriv v (fun y => mu y • angularAdjoint B y (w y)) x⟫_ℝ := by
  have hb := contDiff_angularAdjoint B hB
  have h := BaseDensityAdjoint.compact_inner_directionalDeriv v
    (fun y => mu y • angularAdjoint B y (w y)) u
    (hm.smul (hb.clm_apply hw)) hu hc
  have hl : (fun x : R3 => mu x * ⟪B x (directionalFDeriv v u x), w x⟫_ℝ) =
      fun x => ⟪mu x • angularAdjoint B x (w x), directionalFDeriv v u x⟫_ℝ := by
    funext x
    rw [inner_smul_left, angularAdjoint_inner, real_inner_comm]
    rfl
  have hr : (fun x : R3 => mu x * ⟪u x, -(mu x)⁻¹ •
      directionalFDeriv v (fun y => mu y • angularAdjoint B y (w y)) x⟫_ℝ) =
      fun x => -⟪directionalFDeriv v
        (fun y => mu y • angularAdjoint B y (w y)) x, u x⟫_ℝ := by
    funext x
    have hmu : mu x * -(mu x)⁻¹ = -1 := by
      rw [mul_neg, mul_inv_cancel₀ (hp x)]
    rw [inner_smul_right, ← mul_assoc, hmu, neg_one_mul, real_inner_comm]
  rw [hl, hr, integral_neg]
  exact h

/-- A smooth zero-base angular coefficient has exactly its pointwise angular adjoint. -/
theorem compact_angular_zero_adjoint (mu : R3 → ℝ) (C : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E)
    (u w : R3 → E) :
    (∫ x : R3, mu x * ⟪C x (u x), w x⟫_ℝ) =
      ∫ x : R3, mu x * ⟪u x, angularAdjoint C x (w x)⟫_ℝ := by
  apply integral_congr_ae
  exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x =>
    congrArg (fun z : ℝ => mu x * z) (angularAdjoint_inner C x (u x) (w x)))

/-- The first-base part of the source-coordinate perturbation. -/
def angularFirstBase (v : Fin 3 → R3) (B : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] E)
    (u : R3 → E) (x : R3) : E :=
  ∑ i, B i x (directionalFDeriv (v i) u x)

/-- Full base-density adjoint of the first-base part. -/
def angularFirstBaseAdjoint (v : Fin 3 → R3) (mu : R3 → ℝ)
    (B : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (w : R3 → E) (x : R3) : E :=
  -(mu x)⁻¹ • ∑ i, directionalFDeriv (v i)
    (fun y => mu y • angularAdjoint (B i) y (w y)) x

/-- Genuine coordinate U with real scalar second principal and angular lower coefficients. -/
def naturalOperator (v : Fin 3 → R3) (a : MatrixField)
    (B : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (C : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E)
    (u : R3 → E) (x : R3) : E :=
  scalarSecondBase v a u x + angularFirstBase v B u x + C x (u x)

/-- The candidate is proved to be the formal adjoint on the smooth compact domain below. -/
def naturalFormalAdjoint (v : Fin 3 → R3) (mu : R3 → ℝ) (a : MatrixField)
    (B : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (C : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E)
    (w : R3 → E) (x : R3) : E :=
  scalarSecondBaseAdjoint v mu a w x + angularFirstBaseAdjoint v mu B w x +
    angularAdjoint C x (w x)

/-- Derivative of the actual weighted angular adjoint coefficient. -/
def weightedAngularAdjointDerivative (v : R3) (mu : R3 → ℝ)
    (B : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E :=
  directionalFDeriv v (fun y => mu y • angularAdjoint B y)

lemma weightedAngularAdjointDerivative_apply (v : R3) (mu : R3 → ℝ)
    (B : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (hm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ mu) (hB : ContDiff ℝ ∞ B)
    (x : R3) (z : E) :
    weightedAngularAdjointDerivative v mu B x z =
      directionalFDeriv v mu x • angularAdjoint B x z +
        mu x • directionalFDeriv v (angularAdjoint B) x z := by
  rw [weightedAngularAdjointDerivative,
    directionalFDeriv_smul v mu (angularAdjoint B) hm (contDiff_angularAdjoint B hB)]
  rfl

lemma angular_first_adjoint_term (v : R3) (mu : R3 → ℝ)
    (B : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (w : R3 → E)
    (hm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ mu) (hB : ContDiff ℝ ∞ B)
    (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w) (x : R3) (hp : mu x ≠ 0) :
    -(mu x)⁻¹ • directionalFDeriv v
      (fun y => mu y • angularAdjoint B y (w y)) x =
      -angularAdjoint B x (directionalFDeriv v w x) -
        (mu x)⁻¹ • weightedAngularAdjointDerivative v mu B x (w x) := by
  have hb : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => mu y • angularAdjoint B y) :=
    hm.smul (contDiff_angularAdjoint B hB)
  have he : (fun y => mu y • angularAdjoint B y (w y)) =
      fun y => (mu y • angularAdjoint B y) (w y) := rfl
  have hd := directionalFDeriv_clm_apply v (fun y => mu y • angularAdjoint B y) w hb hw x
  rw [he, hd]
  simp only [weightedAngularAdjointDerivative, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
    smul_add, smul_smul]
  have hc : -(mu x)⁻¹ * mu x = -1 := by
    rw [neg_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hp]
  rw [hc]
  module

lemma angularFirstBaseAdjoint_coefficient_form (v : Fin 3 → R3) (mu : R3 → ℝ)
    (B : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (w : R3 → E)
    (hm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ mu) (hB : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (B i))
    (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w) (x : R3) (hp : mu x ≠ 0) :
    angularFirstBaseAdjoint v mu B w x =
      ∑ i, (-angularAdjoint (B i) x (directionalFDeriv (v i) w x) -
        (mu x)⁻¹ • weightedAngularAdjointDerivative (v i) mu (B i) x (w x)) := by
  unfold angularFirstBaseAdjoint
  rw [Finset.smul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  exact angular_first_adjoint_term (v i) mu (B i) w hm (hB i) hw x hp

/-- Exact first-base coefficient of U†−U, including B and the actual sphere adjoint B*. -/
def defectFirstCoefficient (v : Fin 3 → R3) (mu : R3 → ℝ) (a : MatrixField)
    (B : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (x : R3) (i : Fin 3) : E →L[ℝ] E :=
  adjointFirstCoefficient v mu a x i • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E -
    B i x - angularAdjoint (B i) x

/-- Exact zero-base coefficient: all density and angular adjoint derivatives retained. -/
def defectZeroCoefficient (v : Fin 3 → R3) (mu : R3 → ℝ) (a : MatrixField)
    (B : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (C : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (x : R3) : E →L[ℝ] E :=
  adjointZeroCoefficient v mu a x • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E -
    (mu x)⁻¹ • ∑ i, weightedAngularAdjointDerivative (v i) mu (B i) x +
    angularAdjoint C x - C x

/-- Full source-coordinate defect, proved from scalar product differentiation and
 genuine angular adjoints. There is no second-base derivative on the right. -/
theorem naturalFormalAdjoint_sub (v : Fin 3 → R3) (mu : R3 → ℝ) (a : MatrixField)
    (B : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (C : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (w : R3 → E)
    (hm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ mu) (ha : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => a y i j))
    (hB : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (B i)) (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w)
    (x : R3) (hp : mu x ≠ 0) (hs : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, (a y).IsHermitian) :
    naturalFormalAdjoint v mu a B C w x - naturalOperator v a B C w x =
      defectZeroCoefficient v mu a B C x (w x) +
      ∑ i, defectFirstCoefficient v mu a B x i (directionalFDeriv (v i) w x) := by
  have hscalar := scalarSecondBaseAdjoint_coefficient_form v mu a w hm ha hw x hp hs
  have hfirst := angularFirstBaseAdjoint_coefficient_form v mu B w hm hB hw x hp
  have he : naturalFormalAdjoint v mu a B C w x - naturalOperator v a B C w x =
      (scalarSecondBaseAdjoint v mu a w x - scalarSecondBase v a w x) +
      (angularFirstBaseAdjoint v mu B w x - angularFirstBase v B w x) +
      (angularAdjoint C x (w x) - C x (w x)) := by
    unfold naturalFormalAdjoint naturalOperator
    abel
  rw [he, hscalar, hfirst]
  simp only [angularFirstBase, defectFirstCoefficient, defectZeroCoefficient,
    ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    Finset.smul_sum, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
  module

/-- The complete angular-coefficient defect with the actual reference density,
 actual shrinking radius and real symmetric perturbed principal matrix.
 B,C are explicit bounded Hilbert coefficient families; source Ψ-domain transfer remains open. -/
theorem actual_naturalFormalAdjoint_sub (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam δ R : ℝ) (p : ℕ) (h : MatrixField)
    (B : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (C : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (w : R3 → E)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hR : 0 < R)
    (hh : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => h y i j))
    (hB : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (B i)) (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w)
    (x : R3) (hs : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, (h y).IsHermitian) :
    naturalFormalAdjoint ReferenceDensityBounds.coordinateDirection
      (fun y => ReferenceDensityBounds.referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,y))
      (actualPrincipalMatrix g L lam δ R p h) B C w x -
      naturalOperator ReferenceDensityBounds.coordinateDirection
        (actualPrincipalMatrix g L lam δ R p h) B C w x =
    defectZeroCoefficient ReferenceDensityBounds.coordinateDirection
      (fun y => ReferenceDensityBounds.referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,y))
      (actualPrincipalMatrix g L lam δ R p h) B C x (w x) +
    ∑ i, defectFirstCoefficient ReferenceDensityBounds.coordinateDirection
      (fun y => ReferenceDensityBounds.referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,y))
      (actualPrincipalMatrix g L lam δ R p h) B x i
      (directionalFDeriv (ReferenceDensityBounds.coordinateDirection i) w x) := by
  apply naturalFormalAdjoint_sub
  · exact (ReferenceDensityBounds.contDiff_referenceDensityFamily g hg L).comp
      (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : R3 => (lam,y)))
  · exact ActualPerturbedDefect.contDiff_actualPrincipalMatrix_entry
      g hg L lam δ R p h hδ hR hh
  · exact hB
  · exact hw
  · exact ne_of_gt (ReferenceDensityBounds.referenceDensityFamily_pos g hg L (lam,x))
  · filter_upwards [hs] with y hy
    exact ActualPerturbedDefect.actualPrincipalMatrix_isHermitian g hg L lam δ R p h y hy

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.NaturalAngularAdjoint

``````

## Calderon.NaturalAngularAdjointIntegration

SHA256 `075d7ea8f96b6450d2580fcb7ce4ed2dd44bc929710a683569127b4b47e20533`.

``````lean
import Calderon.NaturalAngularAdjoint

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Filter
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.NaturalAngularAdjoint
open PrincipalCommutator ScalarBaseAdjoint ActualScalarPrincipalAdjoint

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]

lemma hasCompactSupport_clm_apply (B : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (u : R3 → E)
    (hc : HasCompactSupport u) : HasCompactSupport (fun x => B x (u x)) := by
  apply hc.mono
  intro x hx
  simp only [Function.mem_support] at hx ⊢
  contrapose! hx
  simp [hx]

lemma compact_weighted_inner_integrable (mu : R3 → ℝ) (u w : R3 → E)
    (hm : Continuous mu) (hu : Continuous u) (hw : Continuous w)
    (hc : HasCompactSupport u) :
    Integrable (fun x => mu x * ⟪u x, w x⟫_ℝ) := by
  have h := BaseDensityAdjoint.compact_inner_integrable (fun x => mu x • w x) u
    (hm.smul hw) hu hc
  simpa only [inner_smul_left, starRingEnd_apply, star_trivial, real_inner_comm] using h

lemma contDiff_scalarSecondBase (v : Fin 3 → R3) (a : MatrixField) (u : R3 → E)
    (ha : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => a y i j)) (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (scalarSecondBase v a u) := by
  exact ContDiff.sum (fun i _ => ContDiff.sum (fun j _ =>
    (ha i j).smul (contDiff_directionalFDeriv (v i) _
      (contDiff_directionalFDeriv (v j) u hu))))

lemma hasCompactSupport_scalarSecondBase (v : Fin 3 → R3) (a : MatrixField)
    (u : R3 → E) (hc : HasCompactSupport u) :
    HasCompactSupport (scalarSecondBase v a u) := by
  have h := HasCompactSupport.finset_sum (s := Finset.univ) (fun i _ =>
    HasCompactSupport.finset_sum (s := Finset.univ) (fun j _ =>
      ((hc.fderiv_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) (v j)).fderiv_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) (v i)).smul_left
        (f := fun y => a y i j)))
  have he : (∑ i : Fin 3, ∑ j : Fin 3,
      (fun y => a y i j) • directionalFDeriv (v i) (directionalFDeriv (v j) u)) =
      scalarSecondBase v a u := by
    funext y
    simp only [Finset.sum_apply, Pi.smul_apply', scalarSecondBase]
  rw [← he]
  exact h

lemma contDiff_scalarSecondBaseAdjoint (v : Fin 3 → R3) (mu : R3 → ℝ)
    (a : MatrixField) (w : R3 → E) (hm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ mu)
    (ha : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => a y i j)) (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w)
    (hp : ∀ x, mu x ≠ 0) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (scalarSecondBaseAdjoint v mu a w) := by
  exact (hm.inv hp).smul (ContDiff.sum (fun i _ => ContDiff.sum (fun j _ =>
    contDiff_directionalFDeriv (v j) _ (contDiff_directionalFDeriv (v i) _
      ((hm.mul (ha i j)).smul hw)))))

lemma contDiff_angularFirstBase (v : Fin 3 → R3)
    (B : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (u : R3 → E)
    (hB : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (B i)) (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (angularFirstBase v B u) := by
  exact ContDiff.sum (fun i _ => (hB i).clm_apply (contDiff_directionalFDeriv (v i) u hu))

lemma hasCompactSupport_angularFirstBase (v : Fin 3 → R3)
    (B : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (u : R3 → E) (hc : HasCompactSupport u) :
    HasCompactSupport (angularFirstBase v B u) := by
  have h := HasCompactSupport.finset_sum (s := Finset.univ) (fun i _ =>
    hasCompactSupport_clm_apply (B i) (directionalFDeriv (v i) u)
      (hc.fderiv_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) (v i)))
  have he : (∑ i : Fin 3, fun x => B i x (directionalFDeriv (v i) u x)) =
      angularFirstBase v B u := by
    funext x
    simp only [Finset.sum_apply, angularFirstBase]
  rw [← he]
  exact h

lemma contDiff_angularFirstBaseAdjoint (v : Fin 3 → R3) (mu : R3 → ℝ)
    (B : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (w : R3 → E)
    (hm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ mu) (hB : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (B i))
    (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w) (hp : ∀ x, mu x ≠ 0) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (angularFirstBaseAdjoint v mu B w) := by
  exact ((hm.inv hp).neg).smul (ContDiff.sum (fun i _ =>
    contDiff_directionalFDeriv (v i) _
      (hm.smul ((contDiff_angularAdjoint (B i) (hB i)).clm_apply hw))))

/-- The full finite first-base sum has the proved density adjoint. -/
theorem compact_angularFirstBase_adjoint (v : Fin 3 → R3) (mu : R3 → ℝ)
    (B : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (u w : R3 → E)
    (hm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ mu) (hB : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (B i))
    (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w)
    (hc : HasCompactSupport u) (hp : ∀ x, mu x ≠ 0) :
    (∫ x : R3, mu x * ⟪angularFirstBase v B u x, w x⟫_ℝ) =
      ∫ x : R3, mu x * ⟪u x, angularFirstBaseAdjoint v mu B w x⟫_ℝ := by
  have hiL (i : Fin 3) : Integrable (fun x : R3 =>
      mu x * ⟪B i x (directionalFDeriv (v i) u x), w x⟫_ℝ) := by
    exact compact_weighted_inner_integrable mu _ w hm.continuous
      ((hB i).clm_apply (contDiff_directionalFDeriv (v i) u hu)).continuous hw.continuous
      (hasCompactSupport_clm_apply (B i) _ (hc.fderiv_apply (𝕜 := ℝ) (v i)))
  have hiR (i : Fin 3) : Integrable (fun x : R3 =>
      mu x * ⟪u x, -(mu x)⁻¹ • directionalFDeriv (v i)
        (fun y => mu y • angularAdjoint (B i) y (w y)) x⟫_ℝ) := by
    exact compact_weighted_inner_integrable mu u _ hm.continuous hu.continuous
      ((((hm.inv hp).neg).smul (contDiff_directionalFDeriv (v i) _
        (hm.smul ((contDiff_angularAdjoint (B i) (hB i)).clm_apply hw)))).continuous) hc
  have hl : (fun x : R3 => mu x * ⟪angularFirstBase v B u x, w x⟫_ℝ) =
      fun x => ∑ i, mu x * ⟪B i x (directionalFDeriv (v i) u x), w x⟫_ℝ := by
    funext x
    simp only [angularFirstBase, sum_inner, Finset.mul_sum]
  have hr : (fun x : R3 => mu x * ⟪u x, angularFirstBaseAdjoint v mu B w x⟫_ℝ) =
      fun x => ∑ i, mu x * ⟪u x, -(mu x)⁻¹ • directionalFDeriv (v i)
        (fun y => mu y • angularAdjoint (B i) y (w y)) x⟫_ℝ := by
    funext x
    simp only [angularFirstBaseAdjoint, Finset.smul_sum, inner_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [hl, hr, integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => hiL i),
    integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => hiR i)]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  exact compact_angular_first_adjoint (v i) mu (B i) u w hm (hB i) hu hw hc hp

/-- Genuine full weighted formal-adjoint identity. This is a compact smooth-domain
 result, not equality of maximal closed unbounded operator domains. -/
theorem compact_naturalFormalAdjoint (v : Fin 3 → R3) (mu : R3 → ℝ) (a : MatrixField)
    (B : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (C : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (u w : R3 → E)
    (hm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ mu) (ha : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => a y i j))
    (hB : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (B i)) (hC : ContDiff ℝ ∞ C)
    (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w)
    (hc : HasCompactSupport u) (hp : ∀ x, 0 < mu x) :
    (∫ x : R3, mu x * ⟪naturalOperator v a B C u x, w x⟫_ℝ) =
      ∫ x : R3, mu x * ⟪u x, naturalFormalAdjoint v mu a B C w x⟫_ℝ := by
  have hp0 : ∀ x, mu x ≠ 0 := fun x => ne_of_gt (hp x)
  have hsL := compact_weighted_inner_integrable mu (scalarSecondBase v a u) w
    hm.continuous (contDiff_scalarSecondBase v a u ha hu).continuous hw.continuous
    (hasCompactSupport_scalarSecondBase v a u hc)
  have hfL := compact_weighted_inner_integrable mu (angularFirstBase v B u) w
    hm.continuous (contDiff_angularFirstBase v B u hB hu).continuous hw.continuous
    (hasCompactSupport_angularFirstBase v B u hc)
  have hzL := compact_weighted_inner_integrable mu (fun x => C x (u x)) w
    hm.continuous (hC.clm_apply hu).continuous hw.continuous
    (hasCompactSupport_clm_apply C u hc)
  have hsR := compact_weighted_inner_integrable mu u (scalarSecondBaseAdjoint v mu a w)
    hm.continuous hu.continuous
    (contDiff_scalarSecondBaseAdjoint v mu a w hm ha hw hp0).continuous hc
  have hfR := compact_weighted_inner_integrable mu u (angularFirstBaseAdjoint v mu B w)
    hm.continuous hu.continuous
    (contDiff_angularFirstBaseAdjoint v mu B w hm hB hw hp0).continuous hc
  have hzR := compact_weighted_inner_integrable mu u (fun x => angularAdjoint C x (w x))
    hm.continuous hu.continuous ((contDiff_angularAdjoint C hC).clm_apply hw).continuous hc
  have hsLf : Integrable (fun x : R3 =>
      mu x * ⟪scalarSecondBase v a u x, w x⟫_ℝ +
      mu x * ⟪angularFirstBase v B u x, w x⟫_ℝ) := hsL.add hfL
  have hsRf : Integrable (fun x : R3 =>
      mu x * ⟪u x, scalarSecondBaseAdjoint v mu a w x⟫_ℝ +
      mu x * ⟪u x, angularFirstBaseAdjoint v mu B w x⟫_ℝ) := hsR.add hfR
  simp only [naturalOperator, naturalFormalAdjoint, inner_add_left, inner_add_right, mul_add]
  rw [integral_add hsLf hzL, integral_add hsL hfL,
    integral_add hsRf hzR, integral_add hsR hfR,
    compact_scalarSecondBase_adjoint v mu a u w hm ha hu hw hc hp,
    compact_angularFirstBase_adjoint v mu B u w hm hB hu hw hc hp0,
    compact_angular_zero_adjoint mu C u w]

lemma contDiff_adjointFirstCoefficient (v : Fin 3 → R3) (mu : R3 → ℝ) (a : MatrixField)
    (hm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ mu) (ha : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => a y i j))
    (hp : ∀ x, mu x ≠ 0) (i : Fin 3) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => adjointFirstCoefficient v mu a x i) := by
  exact (contDiff_const.mul (hm.inv hp)).mul (ContDiff.sum (fun j _ =>
    contDiff_directionalFDeriv (v j) _ (hm.mul (ha i j))))

lemma contDiff_adjointZeroCoefficient (v : Fin 3 → R3) (mu : R3 → ℝ) (a : MatrixField)
    (hm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ mu) (ha : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => a y i j))
    (hp : ∀ x, mu x ≠ 0) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (adjointZeroCoefficient v mu a) := by
  exact (hm.inv hp).mul (ContDiff.sum (fun i _ => ContDiff.sum (fun j _ =>
    contDiff_directionalFDeriv (v j) _
      (contDiff_directionalFDeriv (v i) _ (hm.mul (ha i j))))))

lemma contDiff_defectFirstCoefficient (v : Fin 3 → R3) (mu : R3 → ℝ) (a : MatrixField)
    (B : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] E)
    (hm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ mu) (ha : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => a y i j))
    (hB : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (B i)) (hp : ∀ x, mu x ≠ 0) (i : Fin 3) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => defectFirstCoefficient v mu a B x i) := by
  exact (((contDiff_adjointFirstCoefficient v mu a hm ha hp i).smul contDiff_const).sub
    (hB i)).sub (contDiff_angularAdjoint (B i) (hB i))

lemma contDiff_defectZeroCoefficient (v : Fin 3 → R3) (mu : R3 → ℝ) (a : MatrixField)
    (B : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (C : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E)
    (hm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ mu) (ha : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => a y i j))
    (hB : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (B i)) (hC : ContDiff ℝ ∞ C)
    (hp : ∀ x, mu x ≠ 0) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (defectZeroCoefficient v mu a B C) := by
  exact ((((contDiff_adjointZeroCoefficient v mu a hm ha hp).smul contDiff_const).sub
    ((hm.inv hp).smul (ContDiff.sum (fun i _ =>
      contDiff_directionalFDeriv (v i) _ (hm.smul (contDiff_angularAdjoint (B i) (hB i))))))).add
    (contDiff_angularAdjoint C hC)).sub hC

/-- The actual computed defect first coefficient has no third-base term against
 the scalar principal part. Smoothness of the computed coefficient is derived. -/
theorem defect_first_scalar_principal_commutator (v : Fin 3 → R3)
    (mu : R3 → ℝ) (a : MatrixField) (B : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] E)
    (w : R3 → E) (hm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ mu)
    (ha : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => a y i j))
    (hB : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (B i)) (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w)
    (hp : ∀ x, mu x ≠ 0) (i j k : Fin 3) (x : R3) :
    defectFirstCoefficient v mu a B x k
      (directionalFDeriv (v k) (fun y => a y i j •
        directionalFDeriv (v i) (directionalFDeriv (v j) w) y) x) -
      a x i j • directionalFDeriv (v i) (directionalFDeriv (v j)
        (fun y => defectFirstCoefficient v mu a B y k
          (directionalFDeriv (v k) w y))) x =
    directionalFDeriv (v k) (fun y => a y i j) x •
      defectFirstCoefficient v mu a B x k
        (directionalFDeriv (v i) (directionalFDeriv (v j) w) x) -
    a x i j • directionalFDeriv (v i)
      (directionalFDeriv (v j) (fun y => defectFirstCoefficient v mu a B y k)) x
        (directionalFDeriv (v k) w x) -
    a x i j • directionalFDeriv (v j)
      (fun y => defectFirstCoefficient v mu a B y k) x
        (directionalFDeriv (v i) (directionalFDeriv (v k) w) x) -
    a x i j • directionalFDeriv (v i)
      (fun y => defectFirstCoefficient v mu a B y k) x
        (directionalFDeriv (v j) (directionalFDeriv (v k) w) x) := by
  exact scalar_principal_directional_commutator (v i) (v j) (v k)
    (fun y => a y i j) (fun y => defectFirstCoefficient v mu a B y k) w
    (ha i j) (contDiff_defectFirstCoefficient v mu a B hm ha hB hp k) hw x

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.NaturalAngularAdjoint

``````

## Calderon.NaturalFullAdjointReduction

SHA256 `91b488bf10f3a1c40ba32544f363b33a735a0f2280925272e678dedcb3af2e13`.

``````lean
import Calderon.NaturalAdjointCommutator

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open Filter
open scoped ContDiff Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.NaturalAngularAdjoint
open PrincipalCommutator ScalarBaseAdjoint

variable {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E]

/-- The computed full-density/angular-adjoint defect as an actual differential operator. -/
def naturalAdjointDefect (v : Fin 3 → R3) (mu : R3 → ℝ) (a : MatrixField)
    (B : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (C : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E)
    (w : R3 → E) (x : R3) : E :=
  defectZeroCoefficient v mu a B C x (w x) +
    ∑ i, defectFirstCoefficient v mu a B x i (directionalFDeriv (v i) w x)

lemma contDiff_naturalOperator (v : Fin 3 → R3) (a : MatrixField)
    (B : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (C : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (w : R3 → E)
    (ha : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => a y i j))
    (hB : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (B i)) (hC : ContDiff ℝ ∞ C) (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (naturalOperator v a B C w) := by
  exact ((contDiff_scalarSecondBase v a w ha hw).add
    (contDiff_angularFirstBase v B w hB hw)).add (hC.clm_apply hw)

lemma contDiff_naturalAdjointDefect (v : Fin 3 → R3) (mu : R3 → ℝ) (a : MatrixField)
    (B : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (C : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (w : R3 → E)
    (hm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ mu) (ha : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => a y i j))
    (hB : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (B i)) (hC : ContDiff ℝ ∞ C)
    (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w) (hp : ∀ x, mu x ≠ 0) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (naturalAdjointDefect v mu a B C w) := by
  exact ((contDiff_defectZeroCoefficient v mu a B C hm ha hB hC hp).clm_apply hw).add
    (contDiff_angularFirstBase v (fun i y => defectFirstCoefficient v mu a B y i) w
      (fun i => contDiff_defectFirstCoefficient v mu a B hm ha hB hp i) hw)

lemma directionalFDeriv_second_add (i j : R3) (u w : R3 → E)
    (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w) (x : R3) :
    directionalFDeriv i (directionalFDeriv j (fun y => u y + w y)) x =
      directionalFDeriv i (directionalFDeriv j u) x +
      directionalFDeriv i (directionalFDeriv j w) x := by
  have he : directionalFDeriv j (fun y => u y + w y) =
      fun y => directionalFDeriv j u y + directionalFDeriv j w y :=
    funext (directionalFDeriv_add j u w hu hw)
  rw [he, directionalFDeriv_add i _ _ (contDiff_directionalFDeriv j u hu)
    (contDiff_directionalFDeriv j w hw)]

lemma naturalOperator_add (v : Fin 3 → R3) (a : MatrixField)
    (B : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (C : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (u w : R3 → E)
    (hu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ u) (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w) (x : R3) :
    naturalOperator v a B C (fun y => u y + w y) x =
      naturalOperator v a B C u x + naturalOperator v a B C w x := by
  simp only [naturalOperator, scalarSecondBase, angularFirstBase]
  simp_rw [directionalFDeriv_second_add _ _ u w hu hw x,
    directionalFDeriv_add _ u w hu hw x, smul_add, map_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  abel

lemma naturalFormalAdjoint_eq_operator_add_defect (v : Fin 3 → R3)
    (mu : R3 → ℝ) (a : MatrixField) (B : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] E)
    (C : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (w : R3 → E)
    (hm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ mu) (ha : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => a y i j))
    (hB : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (B i)) (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w)
    (hp : ∀ x, mu x ≠ 0) (hs : ∀ x, (a x).IsHermitian) :
    naturalFormalAdjoint v mu a B C w =
      fun x => naturalOperator v a B C w x + naturalAdjointDefect v mu a B C w x := by
  funext x
  have h := naturalFormalAdjoint_sub v mu a B C w hm ha hB hw x (hp x)
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hs)
  change naturalFormalAdjoint v mu a B C w x = _
  change naturalFormalAdjoint v mu a B C w x - naturalOperator v a B C w x =
    naturalAdjointDefect v mu a B C w x at h
  exact (sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp h).trans (add_comm _ _)

/-- Exact source reduction [U†,U]=[U†−U,U] on the declared smooth Hilbert domain.
 The right operator is the computed first/zero defect, not an assumed discrepancy. -/
theorem naturalFullAdjoint_commutator_eq_defect_commutator (v : Fin 3 → R3)
    (mu : R3 → ℝ) (a : MatrixField) (B : Fin 3 → R3 → E →L[ℝ] E)
    (C : R3 → E →L[ℝ] E) (w : R3 → E)
    (hm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ mu) (ha : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => a y i j))
    (hB : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (B i)) (hC : ContDiff ℝ ∞ C)
    (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w) (hp : ∀ x, mu x ≠ 0)
    (hs : ∀ x, (a x).IsHermitian) (x : R3) :
    naturalFormalAdjoint v mu a B C (naturalOperator v a B C w) x -
      naturalOperator v a B C (naturalFormalAdjoint v mu a B C w) x =
    naturalAdjointDefect v mu a B C (naturalOperator v a B C w) x -
      naturalOperator v a B C (naturalAdjointDefect v mu a B C w) x := by
  have hU := contDiff_naturalOperator v a B C w ha hB hC hw
  have hD := contDiff_naturalAdjointDefect v mu a B C w hm ha hB hC hw hp
  rw [naturalFormalAdjoint_eq_operator_add_defect v mu a B C
    (naturalOperator v a B C w) hm ha hB hU hp hs,
    naturalFormalAdjoint_eq_operator_add_defect v mu a B C w hm ha hB hw hp hs,
    naturalOperator_add v a B C (naturalOperator v a B C w)
      (naturalAdjointDefect v mu a B C w) hU hD x]
  simp only [add_sub_add_left_eq_sub]

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.NaturalAngularAdjoint

``````

## Calderon.NaturalHarmonicCompression

SHA256 `7933a09d4c43f2e6558889e1b7da61277c343388428cfb490686bd10225f0fc1`.

``````lean
import Calderon.NaturalAngularAdjointIntegration
import Calderon.SphereHilbertDecomposition

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open Filter
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.NaturalHarmonicCompression
open SphereHarmonic SphereHilbertDecomposition NaturalAngularAdjoint

local instance (k : ℕ) : CompleteSpace (harmonicSphereSubspace k) :=
  completeSpace_harmonicSphereSubspace k

/-- Actual finite harmonic compression using the true probability Hilbert projector. -/
def harmonicCompression (k : ℕ) (A : SphereL2 →L[ℝ] SphereL2) :
    harmonicSphereSubspace k →L[ℝ] harmonicSphereSubspace k :=
  (harmonicSphereSubspace k).orthogonalProjectionOnto.comp
    (A.comp (harmonicSphereSubspace k).subtypeL)

/-- Genuine adjoints commute with compression; no coefficient/projector commutation. -/
theorem harmonicCompression_adjoint (k : ℕ) (A : SphereL2 →L[ℝ] SphereL2) :
    ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (harmonicCompression k A) =
      harmonicCompression k (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A) := by
  unfold harmonicCompression
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_comp, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_comp,
    Submodule.adjoint_subtypeL, Submodule.adjoint_orthogonalProjectionOnto]
  ext u
  rfl

/-- Exact retained projection-boundary error in a product of compressed coefficients. -/
theorem harmonicCompression_comp_sub (k : ℕ) (A B : SphereL2 →L[ℝ] SphereL2) :
    (harmonicCompression k A).comp (harmonicCompression k B) -
      harmonicCompression k (A.comp B) =
    (harmonicSphereSubspace k).orthogonalProjectionOnto.comp
      (A.comp (((harmonicSphereSubspace k).subtypeL.comp
        (harmonicSphereSubspace k).orthogonalProjectionOnto -
          ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ SphereL2).comp
            (B.comp (harmonicSphereSubspace k).subtypeL))) := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro u
  simp only [harmonicCompression, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, map_sub]

lemma contDiff_harmonicCompression (k : ℕ) (A : R3 → SphereL2 →L[ℝ] SphereL2)
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => harmonicCompression k (A x)) := by
  exact contDiff_const.clm_comp (hA.clm_comp contDiff_const)

/-- Any actual angular linear restriction on this finite harmonic input has
 genuine continuity by finite dimensionality, without an assumed norm bound. -/
def harmonicRestrictionCompression (k : ℕ)
    (A : harmonicSphereSubspace k →ₗ[ℝ] SphereL2) :
    harmonicSphereSubspace k →L[ℝ] harmonicSphereSubspace k := by
  letI := finiteDimensional_harmonicSphereSubspace k
  exact (harmonicSphereSubspace k).orthogonalProjectionOnto.comp A.toContinuousLinearMap

/-- The true finite adjoint is the restriction adjoint followed by actual inclusion. -/
theorem harmonicRestrictionCompression_adjoint (k : ℕ)
    (A : harmonicSphereSubspace k →ₗ[ℝ] SphereL2) :
    ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (harmonicRestrictionCompression k A) =
      (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (by
        letI := finiteDimensional_harmonicSphereSubspace k
        exact A.toContinuousLinearMap)).comp (harmonicSphereSubspace k).subtypeL := by
  unfold harmonicRestrictionCompression
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_comp, Submodule.adjoint_orthogonalProjectionOnto]

/-- Exact source radial-degree operator on the genuine degree-k probability Hilbert fiber. -/
def radialDegreeOperator (k : ℕ) :
    harmonicSphereSubspace k →L[ℝ] harmonicSphereSubspace k :=
  (k : ℝ) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (harmonicSphereSubspace k)

@[simp] lemma radialDegreeOperator_apply (k : ℕ) (u : harmonicSphereSubspace k) :
    radialDegreeOperator k u = (k : ℝ) • u := rfl

theorem radialDegreeOperator_adjoint (k : ℕ) :
    ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (radialDegreeOperator k) = radialDegreeOperator k := by
  symm
  apply (ContinuousLinearMap.eq_adjoint_iff _ _).mpr
  intro u w
  change ⟪(k : ℝ) • u, w⟫_ℝ = ⟪u, (k : ℝ) • w⟫_ℝ
  exact (real_inner_smul_left u w (k : ℝ)).trans (real_inner_smul_right u w (k : ℝ)).symm

/-- Full density defect on the actual finite harmonic fiber. This does not
 identify arbitrary compressed symbols with the source U or discard projection errors. -/
theorem harmonicCompression_naturalFormalAdjoint_sub (k : ℕ) (v : Fin 3 → R3)
    (mu : R3 → ℝ) (a : MatrixField)
    (B : Fin 3 → R3 → SphereL2 →L[ℝ] SphereL2) (C : R3 → SphereL2 →L[ℝ] SphereL2)
    (w : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace k)
    (hm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ mu) (ha : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => a y i j))
    (hB : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (B i)) (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w)
    (x : R3) (hp : mu x ≠ 0) (hs : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, (a y).IsHermitian) :
    naturalFormalAdjoint v mu a (fun i y => harmonicCompression k (B i y))
      (fun y => harmonicCompression k (C y)) w x -
      naturalOperator v a (fun i y => harmonicCompression k (B i y))
        (fun y => harmonicCompression k (C y)) w x =
    defectZeroCoefficient v mu a (fun i y => harmonicCompression k (B i y))
      (fun y => harmonicCompression k (C y)) x (w x) +
      ∑ i, defectFirstCoefficient v mu a (fun i y => harmonicCompression k (B i y)) x i
        (PrincipalCommutator.directionalFDeriv (v i) w x) := by
  exact naturalFormalAdjoint_sub v mu a _ _ w hm ha
    (fun i => contDiff_harmonicCompression k (B i) (hB i)) hw x hp hs

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.NaturalHarmonicCompression

``````

## Calderon.NaturalPhysicalGradient

SHA256 `238f3cd9324b6acafd44e7d37a3cd6fe6e3b4ef38c3f289641ebd8746ed71693`.

``````lean
import Calderon.VariablePhysicalTensorBridge
import Calderon.VaryingHorizontalCurvature
import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Module.Multilinear.Curry

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace ENNReal
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.NaturalPhysicalGradient
open RadiusProfile PhysicalTensorProductRule PhysicalTensorAmbientRealization
  PhysicalTensorHarmonicBridge VariablePhysicalTensorBridge MovingFrameConnection
  SmoothMovingFrameFields SmoothSphereFields SphereHarmonic

/-- Actual physical horizontal lift, linear in its base direction. -/
def physicalHorizontalLift (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (q : R3 × R3) : R3 →L[ℝ] R3 × R3 :=
  ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ R3 R3 -
    (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ R3 R3).comp ((Γ q.1).flip q.2)

lemma physicalHorizontalLift_apply (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (q : R3 × R3) (X : R3) :
    physicalHorizontalLift Γ q X = (X,-Γ q.1 X q.2) := by
  simp [physicalHorizontalLift]

lemma contDiff_physicalHorizontalLift (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (hΓ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Γ) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (physicalHorizontalLift Γ) := by
  have hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun q : R3 × R3 => (Γ q.1).flip q.2) :=
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.flipₗᵢ ℝ R3 R3 R3).toContinuousLinearMap.contDiff.comp
      (hΓ.comp contDiff_fst)).clm_apply contDiff_snd
  exact contDiff_const.sub (contDiff_const.clm_comp hf)

/-- The covector constructed from the full scalar differential and the physical lift. -/
def physicalScalarGradient (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (q : R3 × R3) : R3 →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  (fderiv ℝ G q).comp (physicalHorizontalLift Γ q)

lemma physicalScalarGradient_apply (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (q : R3 × R3) (X : R3) :
    physicalScalarGradient Γ G q X = fderiv ℝ G q (X,-Γ q.1 X q.2) := by
  rw [physicalScalarGradient,ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,physicalHorizontalLift_apply]

lemma contDiff_physicalScalarGradient (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (hΓ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Γ) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (physicalScalarGradient Γ G) :=
  (hG.fderiv_right (m := ∞) (by simp)).clm_comp
    (contDiff_physicalHorizontalLift Γ hΓ)

/-- The actual new derivative index is represented by a rank-one physical tensor. -/
def physicalGradientTensor (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (q : R3 × R3) :
    ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin 1 => R3) ℝ :=
  (continuousMultilinearCurryFin1 ℝ R3 ℝ).symm (physicalScalarGradient Γ G q)

lemma physicalGradientTensor_apply (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (q : R3 × R3) (m : Fin 1 → R3) :
    physicalGradientTensor Γ G q m = physicalScalarGradient Γ G q (m 0) := by
  rw [physicalGradientTensor,continuousMultilinearCurryFin1_symm_apply]

lemma contDiff_physicalGradientTensor (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (hΓ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Γ) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (physicalGradientTensor Γ G) :=
  (continuousMultilinearCurryFin1 ℝ R3 ℝ).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.contDiff.comp
    (contDiff_physicalScalarGradient Γ hΓ G hG)

/-- The first input is the new direction; the old covector input keeps its connection term. -/
def physicalScalarHessian (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (q : R3 × R3) : R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  (fderiv ℝ (physicalScalarGradient Γ G) q).comp (physicalHorizontalLift Γ q) -
    (ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℝ R3 R3 ℝ (physicalScalarGradient Γ G q)).comp (Γ q.1)

lemma physicalScalarHessian_apply (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (q : R3 × R3) (X Y : R3) :
    physicalScalarHessian Γ G q X Y =
      fderiv ℝ (physicalScalarGradient Γ G) q (X,-Γ q.1 X q.2) Y -
        physicalScalarGradient Γ G q (Γ q.1 X Y) := by
  simp [physicalScalarHessian,physicalHorizontalLift_apply]

lemma contDiff_physicalScalarHessian (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (hΓ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Γ) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (physicalScalarHessian Γ G) := by
  have hL := contDiff_physicalScalarGradient Γ hΓ G hG
  exact ((hL.fderiv_right (m := ∞) (by simp)).clm_comp
    (contDiff_physicalHorizontalLift Γ hΓ)).sub
    ((contDiff_const.clm_apply hL).clm_comp (hΓ.comp contDiff_fst))

/-- A genuine rank-two physical Hessian, with direction first and covector second. -/
def physicalHessianTensor (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (q : R3 × R3) :
    ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin 2 => R3) ℝ :=
  (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin 2 => R3) ℝ).symm
    (((continuousMultilinearCurryFin1 ℝ R3 ℝ).symm.toContinuousLinearMap).comp
      (physicalScalarHessian Γ G q))

lemma physicalHessianTensor_apply (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (q : R3 × R3) (m : Fin 2 → R3) :
    physicalHessianTensor Γ G q m = physicalScalarHessian Γ G q (m 0) (m 1) := by
  simp [physicalHessianTensor,continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv_symm_apply,
    continuousMultilinearCurryFin1_symm_apply,Fin.tail]

lemma contDiff_physicalHessianTensor (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (hΓ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Γ) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (physicalHessianTensor Γ G) := by
  have hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun A : R3 →L[ℝ]
      ContinuousMultilinearMap ℝ (fun _ : Fin 1 => R3) ℝ =>
      (continuousMultilinearCurryLeftEquiv ℝ (fun _ : Fin 2 => R3) ℝ).symm A) :=
    LinearIsometryEquiv.contDiff _
  have hi : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun q : R3 × R3 =>
      ((continuousMultilinearCurryFin1 ℝ R3 ℝ).symm.toContinuousLinearMap).comp
        (physicalScalarHessian Γ G q)) :=
    (contDiff_const (c := (continuousMultilinearCurryFin1 ℝ R3 ℝ).symm.toContinuousLinearMap)).clm_comp
      (contDiff_physicalScalarHessian Γ hΓ G hG)
  exact hc.comp hi

lemma fderiv_physicalGradientTensor_apply (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (hΓ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Γ) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G)
    (q V : R3 × R3) (m : Fin 1 → R3) :
    (fderiv ℝ (physicalGradientTensor Γ G) q V) m =
      fderiv ℝ (physicalScalarGradient Γ G) q V (m 0) := by
  have hd := (continuousMultilinearCurryFin1 ℝ R3 ℝ).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.hasFDerivAt.comp q
    (((contDiff_physicalScalarGradient Γ hΓ G hG).differentiable (by simp) q).hasFDerivAt)
  change HasFDerivAt (physicalGradientTensor Γ G) _ q at hd
  rw [hd.fderiv,ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
  exact continuousMultilinearCurryFin1_symm_apply _ _

lemma physicalScalarHessian_eq_covariantGradientTensor
    (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (hΓ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Γ)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G)
    (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3) (j : Fin 3) (q : R3 × R3) (X : R3) :
    physicalScalarHessian Γ G q X (e q.1 j) =
      physicalCovariantTensorEvaluation Γ (physicalGradientTensor Γ G) e
        (fun _ : Fin 1 => j) q X := by
  simp only [physicalCovariantTensorEvaluation,Fin.sum_univ_one,
    fderiv_physicalGradientTensor_apply Γ hΓ G hG,physicalGradientTensor_apply,
    Function.update_self]
  exact physicalScalarHessian_apply Γ G q X (e q.1 j)

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.NaturalPhysicalGradient

``````

## Calderon.NaturalPhysicalGradientFrame

SHA256 `fa76a1508be082e75d21063af3b82c461a804ba222f2b489dc7770c2d2faa273`.

``````lean
import Calderon.NaturalPhysicalGradient

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.NaturalPhysicalGradientFrame
open NaturalPhysicalGradient PhysicalTensorProductRule PhysicalTensorAmbientRealization
  PhysicalTensorHarmonicBridge VariablePhysicalTensorBridge SmoothMovingFrameFields
  MovingFrameConnection RadiusProfile SmoothSphereFields SphereHarmonic
  SmoothSphereRotationProjection SpectralCoreRegularity

def referenceScalarGradientComponent (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3) (j : Fin 3) (q : R3 × R3) : ℝ :=
  physicalScalarGradient Γ G (q.1,frameReconstruction e q) (e q.1 j)

def referenceScalarHessianComponent (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3) (i j : Fin 3) (q : R3 × R3) : ℝ :=
  physicalScalarHessian Γ G (q.1,frameReconstruction e q) (e q.1 i) (e q.1 j)

lemma referenceScalarGradientComponent_eq_ambient
    (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ)
    (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3) (j : Fin 3) :
    referenceScalarGradientComponent Γ G e j =
      ambientPhysicalTensorComponent (physicalGradientTensor Γ G) e (fun _ : Fin 1 => j) := by
  funext q
  exact (physicalGradientTensor_apply Γ G (q.1,frameReconstruction e q)
    (fun _ : Fin 1 => e q.1 j)).symm

lemma referenceScalarHessianComponent_eq_covariantGradient
    (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (hΓ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Γ)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G)
    (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3) (i j : Fin 3) :
    referenceScalarHessianComponent Γ G e i j =
      variableReferenceCovariantTensorComponent Γ (physicalGradientTensor Γ G) e
        (fun _ : Fin 1 => j) (fun x => e x i) := by
  funext q
  exact physicalScalarHessian_eq_covariantGradientTensor Γ hΓ G hG e j
    (q.1,frameReconstruction e q) (e q.1 i)

lemma contDiff_referenceScalarGradientComponent
    (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (hΓ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Γ)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G)
    (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3) (hE : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => e x j)) (j : Fin 3) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (referenceScalarGradientComponent Γ G e j) := by
  rw [referenceScalarGradientComponent_eq_ambient]
  exact contDiff_ambientPhysicalTensorComponent _
    (contDiff_physicalGradientTensor Γ hΓ G hG) e hE _

lemma contDiff_referenceScalarHessianComponent
    (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (hΓ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Γ)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G)
    (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3) (hE : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => e x j)) (i j : Fin 3) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (referenceScalarHessianComponent Γ G e i j) :=
  (((contDiff_physicalScalarHessian Γ hΓ G hG).comp
    (contDiff_fst.prodMk (contDiff_frameReconstruction e hE))).clm_apply
    ((hE i).comp contDiff_fst)).clm_apply ((hE j).comp contDiff_fst)

/-- Genuine Hessian coordinate: new direction first, every old covector connection retained. -/
theorem sphereHarmonicCoordinate_referenceScalarHessianComponent
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (k : ℕ)
    (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (Γ : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (hM : ContDiff ℝ ∞ M) (hΓ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Γ)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G)
    (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3) (hE : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => e x j))
    (hsym : ∀ y U V, ⟪M y U,V⟫_ℝ = ⟪M y V,U⟫_ℝ)
    (he : ∀ y, IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (M y) (e y))
    (hcomp : ∀ y X U V, ⟪M y (Γ y X U),V⟫_ℝ + ⟪M y U,Γ y X V⟫_ℝ =
      ⟪fderiv ℝ M y X U,V⟫_ℝ) (i j : Fin 3) (x : R3) :
    let Grad := referenceScalarGradientComponent Γ G e
    let hGrad := fun j => contDiff_referenceScalarGradientComponent Γ hΓ G hG e hE j
    let C := fun y => frameConnectionCoefficient M Γ e y (e y i)
    sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (ambientSphereL2
      (referenceScalarHessianComponent Γ G e i j)
      (contDiff_referenceScalarHessianComponent Γ hΓ G hG e hE i j) x) =
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k
        (ambientSphereL2 (Grad j) (hGrad j) y)) x (e x i) +
      (1/2 : ℝ) • (∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3, C x a b • harmonicSphereRotation k a b
        (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (ambientSphereL2 (Grad j) (hGrad j) x))) -
      ∑ l : Fin 3, C x l j • sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k
        (ambientSphereL2 (Grad l) (hGrad l) x) := by
  have hp := sphereHarmonicCoordinate_variableReferenceCovariantTensorComponent
    hO hD k M Γ (physicalGradientTensor Γ G) (contDiff_physicalGradientTensor Γ hΓ G hG)
    e hM hΓ hE hsym he hcomp (fun _ : Fin 1 => j) (fun y => e y i) (hE i) x
  simp only [← referenceScalarHessianComponent_eq_covariantGradient Γ hΓ G hG e i j] at hp
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_one] at hp
  have hf (l : Fin 3) :
      Function.update (fun _ : Fin 1 => j) 0 l = (fun _ : Fin 1 => l) := by
    funext t
    fin_cases t
    simp
  simp only [hf,← referenceScalarGradientComponent_eq_ambient Γ G e] at hp
  exact hp

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.NaturalPhysicalGradientFrame

## Calderon.SectionFiveCoefficientDerivative

SHA256 `c2ef68dd823176990d9990256c3ce32abe870e23ec3f58cd40767ec493c8ac64`.

``````lean
import Calderon.SectionFiveErrorBounds
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Deriv.Inv

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory
open scoped InnerProductSpace ContDiff
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SectionFiveErrorForms
open SphereHarmonic SphereHilbertDecomposition SpectralCoreRegularity
  SpectralWeightedGraph BaseDensityAdjoint

lemma directionalDeriv_harmonicCoordinate
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (k : ℕ) (i : R3) (U : R3 → SphereL2) (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U) (x : R3) :
    directionalDeriv i (fun y => sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (U y)) x =
      sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (directionalDeriv i U x) := by
  unfold directionalDeriv
  have hc : HasFDerivAt (fun y => sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (U y))
      ((sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k).comp (fderiv ℝ U x)) x :=
    (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k).hasFDerivAt.comp x
      (hU.differentiable (by simp) x).hasFDerivAt
  rw [hc.fderiv]
  rfl

/-- Differentiating a true varying spectral graph retains the coefficient derivative. -/
theorem directionalDeriv_spectral_family
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (w : R3 → ℕ → ℝ) (i : R3) (U Q : R3 → SphereL2)
    (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U) (hQ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Q)
    (hw : ∀ k, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => w x k))
    (hgraph : ∀ x, (U x,Q x) ∈ spectralGraph hO hD (w x)) (x : R3) (k : ℕ) :
    sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (directionalDeriv i Q x) =
      directionalDeriv i (fun y => w y k) x • sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (U x) +
        w x k • sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (directionalDeriv i U x) := by
  have he : (fun y => sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (Q y)) =
      (fun y => w y k • sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (U y)) :=
    funext (fun y => hgraph y k)
  have hd := congrArg (fun f : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace k => directionalDeriv i f x) he
  rw [directionalDeriv_harmonicCoordinate hO hD k i Q hQ x,
    directionalDeriv_smul i (fun y => w y k)
      (fun y => sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (U y)) (hw k)
      ((sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k).contDiff.comp hU) x,
    directionalDeriv_harmonicCoordinate hO hD k i U hU x] at hd
  exact hd

theorem coefficient_derivative_remainder_graph
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (w : R3 → ℕ → ℝ) (i : R3) (U Q Qi : R3 → SphereL2)
    (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U) (hQ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Q)
    (hw : ∀ k, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => w x k))
    (hgraph : ∀ x, (U x,Q x) ∈ spectralGraph hO hD (w x))
    (hQi : ∀ x, (directionalDeriv i U x,Qi x) ∈ spectralGraph hO hD (w x)) (x : R3) :
    (U x,directionalDeriv i Q x-Qi x) ∈
      spectralGraph hO hD (fun k => directionalDeriv i (fun y => w y k) x) := by
  intro k
  rw [map_sub,directionalDeriv_spectral_family hO hD w i U Q hU hQ hw hgraph x k,hQi x k]
  simp only [add_sub_cancel_right]

/-- The lower remainder after one IBP has exactly the differentiated density-weight symbol. -/
theorem weighted_coefficient_derivative_remainder_graph
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (w : R3 → ℕ → ℝ) (i : R3) (h : R3 → ℝ) (U Q Qi : R3 → SphereL2)
    (hh : ContDiff ℝ ∞ h) (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U) (hQ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Q)
    (hw : ∀ k, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => w x k))
    (hgraph : ∀ x, (U x,Q x) ∈ spectralGraph hO hD (w x))
    (hQi : ∀ x, (directionalDeriv i U x,Qi x) ∈ spectralGraph hO hD (w x)) (x : R3) :
    (U x,directionalDeriv i (fun y => h y • Q y) x-h x • Qi x) ∈
      spectralGraph hO hD (fun k => directionalDeriv i h x * w x k +
        h x * directionalDeriv i (fun y => w y k) x) := by
  intro k
  rw [directionalDeriv_smul i h Q hh hQ x,map_sub,map_add,map_smul,map_smul,map_smul,
    hgraph x k,directionalDeriv_spectral_family hO hD w i U Q hU hQ hw hgraph x k,hQi x k]
  simp only [smul_add,smul_smul,add_smul]
  abel

lemma directionalDeriv_mul (i : R3) (f g : R3 → ℝ)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g) (x : R3) :
    directionalDeriv i (fun y => f y*g y) x =
      directionalDeriv i f x*g x + f x*directionalDeriv i g x := by
  unfold directionalDeriv
  rw [fderiv_fun_mul (hf.differentiable (by simp) x) (hg.differentiable (by simp) x)]
  simp only [add_apply,smul_apply,smul_eq_mul]
  ring

lemma directionalDeriv_inv (i : R3) (beta : R3 → ℝ)
    (hbeta : ContDiff ℝ ∞ beta) (x : R3) (hpos : 0 < beta x) :
    directionalDeriv i (fun y => (beta y)⁻¹) x =
      -(beta x ^ 2)⁻¹ * directionalDeriv i beta x := by
  unfold directionalDeriv
  have hi : HasFDerivAt (fun y => (beta y)⁻¹)
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ (-(beta x^2)⁻¹)).comp (fderiv ℝ beta x)) x :=
    (hasDerivAt_inv (ne_of_gt hpos)).hasFDerivAt.comp x
      (hbeta.differentiable (by simp) x).hasFDerivAt
  rw [hi.fderiv]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply,smul_eq_mul]
  ring

lemma abs_directionalDeriv_inv_le (i : R3) (beta : R3 → ℝ)
    (hbeta : ContDiff ℝ ∞ beta) (x : R3) (hpos : 0 < beta x) (C : ℝ)
    (hderiv : |directionalDeriv i beta x| ≤ C * beta x^2) :
    |directionalDeriv i (fun y => (beta y)⁻¹) x| ≤ C := by
  rw [directionalDeriv_inv i beta hbeta x hpos,abs_mul,abs_neg,
    abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr (sq_pos_of_pos hpos))]
  have h := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hderiv (inv_nonneg.mpr (sq_nonneg (beta x)))
  calc
    _ ≤ (beta x^2)⁻¹ * (C * beta x^2) := h
    _ = C := by field_simp [ne_of_gt hpos]

/-- A scalar coefficient budget deriving, rather than assuming, the whole differentiated symbol. -/
lemma abs_density_weight_derivative_coefficient_le
    (beta mu dmu dinv w dw Cmu Cbeta Cw Cdw b1 b2 : ℝ)
    (hbeta : 1 ≤ beta) (hmu : 0 ≤ mu)
    (hCmu : 0 ≤ Cmu) (hCbeta : 0 ≤ Cbeta) (hCw : 0 ≤ Cw) (hCdw : 0 ≤ Cdw)
    (hb1 : 0 ≤ b1) (hb12 : b1 ≤ b2)
    (hdmu : |dmu| ≤ Cmu*mu) (hdinv : |dinv| ≤ Cbeta)
    (hw : |w| ≤ Cw*b1) (hdw : |dw| ≤ Cdw*beta*b1) :
    |(dmu*beta⁻¹+mu*dinv)*w+mu*beta⁻¹*dw| ≤
      mu*((Cmu+Cbeta)*Cw+Cdw)*b2 := by
  have hpos : 0 < beta := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hbeta
  have hinv : 0 ≤ beta⁻¹ := inv_nonneg.mpr hpos.le
  have hinvle : beta⁻¹ ≤ 1 := (inv_le_one₀ hpos).mpr hbeta
  have hweight : |dmu*beta⁻¹+mu*dinv| ≤ mu*(Cmu+Cbeta) := by
    calc
      _ ≤ |dmu*beta⁻¹|+|mu*dinv| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ = |dmu| * beta⁻¹+mu*|dinv| := by rw [abs_mul,abs_mul,abs_of_nonneg hinv,abs_of_nonneg hmu]
      _ ≤ (Cmu*mu)*beta⁻¹+mu*Cbeta := add_le_add
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hdmu hinv) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdinv hmu)
      _ ≤ Cmu*mu+mu*Cbeta := add_le_add
        (by simpa only [mul_one] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hinvle (mul_nonneg hCmu hmu)) le_rfl
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hterm1 : |(dmu*beta⁻¹+mu*dinv)*w| ≤ mu*(Cmu+Cbeta)*Cw*b1 := by
    rw [abs_mul]
    calc
      _ ≤ (mu*(Cmu+Cbeta))*(Cw*b1) :=
        mul_le_mul hweight hw (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hterm2 : |mu*beta⁻¹*dw| ≤ mu*Cdw*b1 := by
    rw [abs_mul,abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg hmu hinv)]
    calc
      _ ≤ mu*beta⁻¹*(Cdw*beta*b1) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hdw (mul_nonneg hmu hinv)
      _ = _ := by field_simp [ne_of_gt hpos]
  calc
    _ ≤ |(dmu*beta⁻¹+mu*dinv)*w|+|mu*beta⁻¹*dw| := abs_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ mu*(Cmu+Cbeta)*Cw*b1+mu*Cdw*b1 := add_le_add hterm1 hterm2
    _ = mu*((Cmu+Cbeta)*Cw+Cdw)*b1 := by ring
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hb12 (by positivity)

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SectionFiveErrorForms

``````

## Calderon.SectionFiveErrorBounds

SHA256 `b5a7727546e805a103f79a200f6bc81914535feaf9134702b474eb030b773024`.

``````lean
import Calderon.SectionFiveErrorForms

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory
open scoped InnerProductSpace ContDiff
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SectionFiveErrorForms
open SphereHarmonic SphereHilbertDecomposition SpectralCoreRegularity
  SpectralWeightedGraph BoundedSpectralMultiplier WeightedBaseSpectral

lemma norm_sq_le_sum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (U : ι → SphereL2) (i : ι) :
    ‖U i‖^2 ≤ ∑ j, ‖U j‖^2 := by
  classical
  exact Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j : ι => (‖U j‖ : ℝ)^2)
    (fun j _ => sq_nonneg (‖U j‖ : ℝ)) (Finset.mem_univ i)

lemma norm_mul_norm_le_sum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (U : ι → SphereL2) (i j : ι) :
    ‖U i‖ * ‖U j‖ ≤ ∑ k, ‖U k‖^2 := by
  have hi := norm_sq_le_sum U i
  have hj := norm_sq_le_sum U j
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖U i‖-‖U j‖)]

lemma weighted_gradient_square_le_sourceNormSquareIntegrand
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (beta : ℝ) (hbeta : 0 ≤ beta)
    (G0 : ι → SphereL2) (U1 : SphereL2) (Ghalf : ι → SphereL2) (Uthree : SphereL2) :
    beta⁻¹ * (∑ i, ‖Ghalf i‖^2) ≤ sourceNormSquareIntegrand beta G0 U1 Ghalf Uthree := by
  have h := angular_error_terms_le_sourceNormSquareIntegrand beta G0 U1 Ghalf Uthree
  have hz := mul_nonneg hbeta (sq_nonneg ‖Uthree‖)
  linarith

lemma weighted_value_square_le_sourceNormSquareIntegrand
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (beta : ℝ) (hbeta : 0 ≤ beta)
    (G0 : ι → SphereL2) (U1 : SphereL2) (Ghalf : ι → SphereL2) (Uthree : SphereL2) :
    beta * ‖Uthree‖^2 ≤ sourceNormSquareIntegrand beta G0 U1 Ghalf Uthree := by
  have h := angular_error_terms_le_sourceNormSquareIntegrand beta G0 U1 Ghalf Uthree
  have hz : 0 ≤ beta⁻¹ * (∑ i, ‖Ghalf i‖^2) := by positivity
  linarith

theorem abs_principal_spectral_form_le_sourceNormSquareIntegrand
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (beta C : ℝ) (hbeta : 0 < beta) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (w : ℕ → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k, |w k| ≤ C * besselWeight 1 k)
    (G0 Ghalf : ι → SphereL2) (U1 Uthree a : SphereL2) (i j : ι)
    (ha : (G0 i,a) ∈ spectralGraph hO hD w)
    (hhalf : ∀ k, (G0 k,Ghalf k) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD (1/2)) :
    |beta⁻¹ * ⟪a,G0 j⟫_ℝ| ≤ C * sourceNormSquareIntegrand beta G0 U1 Ghalf Uthree := by
  have hw' (k : ℕ) : |w k| ≤ C * (besselWeight (1/2) k * besselWeight (1/2) k) := by
    have hsum : (1/2 : ℝ)+(1/2)=1 := by norm_num
    rw [← besselWeight_add,hsum]
    exact hw k
  have hs := abs_inner_spectralGraph_le hO hD w (1/2) (1/2) C hC hw'
    (G0 i) a (Ghalf i) (G0 j) (Ghalf j) ha (hhalf i) (hhalf j)
  rw [abs_mul,abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hbeta)]
  calc
    _ ≤ beta⁻¹ * (C * ‖Ghalf i‖ * ‖Ghalf j‖) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs (inv_nonneg.mpr hbeta.le)
    _ = C * (beta⁻¹ * (‖Ghalf i‖ * ‖Ghalf j‖)) := by ring
    _ ≤ C * (beta⁻¹ * (∑ k, ‖Ghalf k‖^2)) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_mul_norm_le_sum Ghalf i j)
        (inv_nonneg.mpr hbeta.le)) hC
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (weighted_gradient_square_le_sourceNormSquareIntegrand beta hbeta.le G0 U1 Ghalf Uthree) hC

theorem abs_mixed_spectral_form_le_sourceNormSquareIntegrand
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (beta C : ℝ) (hbeta : 0 < beta) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (w : ℕ → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k, |w k| ≤ C * besselWeight 2 k)
    (G0 Ghalf : ι → SphereL2) (phi U1 Uthree a : SphereL2) (i : ι)
    (ha : (G0 i,a) ∈ spectralGraph hO hD w)
    (hhalf : (G0 i,Ghalf i) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD (1/2))
    (hthree : (phi,Uthree) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD (3/2)) :
    |⟪a,phi⟫_ℝ| ≤ C * sourceNormSquareIntegrand beta G0 U1 Ghalf Uthree := by
  have hw' (k : ℕ) : |w k| ≤ C * (besselWeight (1/2) k * besselWeight (3/2) k) := by
    have hsum : (1/2 : ℝ)+(3/2)=2 := by norm_num
    rw [← besselWeight_add,hsum]
    exact hw k
  have hs := abs_inner_spectralGraph_le hO hD w (1/2) (3/2) C hC hw'
    (G0 i) a (Ghalf i) phi Uthree ha hhalf hthree
  calc
    _ ≤ C * (‖Ghalf i‖ * ‖Uthree‖) := by simpa only [mul_assoc] using hs
    _ ≤ C * (beta⁻¹ * ‖Ghalf i‖^2 + beta * ‖Uthree‖^2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_weighted_sq beta _ _ hbeta) hC
    _ ≤ C * (beta⁻¹ * (∑ k, ‖Ghalf k‖^2) + beta * ‖Uthree‖^2) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_sq_le_sum Ghalf i) (inv_nonneg.mpr hbeta.le)) le_rfl) hC
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (angular_error_terms_le_sourceNormSquareIntegrand beta G0 U1 Ghalf Uthree) hC

theorem abs_zero_spectral_form_le_sourceNormSquareIntegrand
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (beta C : ℝ) (hbeta : 0 < beta) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (w : ℕ → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k, |w k| ≤ C * besselWeight 3 k)
    (G0 Ghalf : ι → SphereL2) (phi U1 Uthree a : SphereL2)
    (ha : (phi,a) ∈ spectralGraph hO hD w)
    (hthree : (phi,Uthree) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD (3/2)) :
    |beta * ⟪a,phi⟫_ℝ| ≤ C * sourceNormSquareIntegrand beta G0 U1 Ghalf Uthree := by
  have hw' (k : ℕ) : |w k| ≤ C * (besselWeight (3/2) k * besselWeight (3/2) k) := by
    have hsum : (3/2 : ℝ)+(3/2)=3 := by norm_num
    rw [← besselWeight_add,hsum]
    exact hw k
  have hs := abs_inner_spectralGraph_le hO hD w (3/2) (3/2) C hC hw'
    phi a Uthree phi Uthree ha hthree hthree
  rw [abs_mul,abs_of_pos hbeta]
  calc
    _ ≤ beta * (C * ‖Uthree‖ * ‖Uthree‖) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs hbeta.le
    _ = C * (beta * ‖Uthree‖^2) := by ring
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (weighted_value_square_le_sourceNormSquareIntegrand beta hbeta.le G0 U1 Ghalf Uthree) hC

/-- Actual base integration converts an established pointwise form bound into an N bound. -/
theorem abs_integral_form_le_sourceNormSquare {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (g : MatrixField) (L lam epsilon C : ℝ) (hepsilon : 0 ≤ epsilon)
    (beta : R3 → ℝ) (G0 Ghalf : R3 → ι → SphereL2)
    (U1 Uthree : R3 → SphereL2) (form : R3 → ℝ)
    (hN : Integrable (fun x => sourceNormSquareIntegrand (beta x) (G0 x) (U1 x)
      (Ghalf x) (Uthree x)) (referenceBaseMeasure g L lam))
    (hform : Integrable form (referenceBaseMeasure g L lam))
    (hbound : ∀ x, |form x| ≤ C * sourceNormSquareIntegrand (beta x) (G0 x) (U1 x)
      (Ghalf x) (Uthree x)) :
    |∫ x, epsilon * form x ∂referenceBaseMeasure g L lam| ≤
      epsilon * C * sourceNormSquare g L lam beta G0 U1 Ghalf Uthree := by
  have hpoint : ∀ᵐ x ∂referenceBaseMeasure g L lam, ‖epsilon * form x‖ ≤
      (epsilon * C) * sourceNormSquareIntegrand (beta x) (G0 x) (U1 x) (Ghalf x) (Uthree x) := by
    apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
    intro x
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_mul,abs_of_nonneg hepsilon]
    simpa only [mul_assoc] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hbound x) hepsilon
  have hi := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le (hN.const_mul (epsilon*C)) hpoint
  simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs,integral_const_mul,sourceNormSquare] using hi

/-- Common-constant absorption after, and only after, the component errors have been bounded. -/
theorem absorb_common_error_bound (N principal remainder c C epsilon : ℝ)
    (hN : 0 ≤ N) (hc : 0 < c) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (hepsilon : 0 ≤ epsilon)
    (hsmall : epsilon * C ≤ c/2)
    (hpositive : c * N ≤ principal + remainder)
    (herror : |remainder| ≤ epsilon * C * N) :
    (c/2) * N ≤ principal := by
  have hr := le_abs_self remainder
  have hs := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsmall hN
  linarith

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SectionFiveErrorForms
````````
