````````
``````lean
import Calderon.BoundedSpectralMultiplier
import Calderon.WeightedBaseSpectral
import Calderon.BaseDensityAdjoint

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory
open scoped InnerProductSpace ContDiff
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SectionFiveErrorForms
open SphereHarmonic SphereHilbertDecomposition SpectralCoreRegularity
  SpectralWeightedGraph BoundedSpectralMultiplier WeightedBaseSpectral
  BaseDensityAdjoint ReferenceDensityBounds

lemma besselWeight_add (s t : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    besselWeight (s + t) k = besselWeight s k * besselWeight t k := by
  exact Real.rpow_add (by positivity : 0 < 1 + (k : ℝ)) s t

lemma besselWeight_mono (s t : ℝ) (hst : s ≤ t) (k : ℕ) :
    besselWeight s k ≤ besselWeight t k := by
  exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le
    (le_add_of_nonneg_right (Nat.cast_nonneg k)) hst

def spectralPairRatio (w : ℕ → ℝ) (s t : ℝ) (k : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  w k / (besselWeight s k * besselWeight t k)

lemma abs_spectralPairRatio_le (w : ℕ → ℝ) (s t C : ℝ)
    (hw : ∀ k, |w k| ≤ C * (besselWeight s k * besselWeight t k)) (k : ℕ) :
    |spectralPairRatio w s t k| ≤ C := by
  rw [spectralPairRatio, abs_div,
    abs_of_pos (mul_pos (besselWeight_pos s k) (besselWeight_pos t k))]
  exact (div_le_iff₀ (mul_pos (besselWeight_pos s k) (besselWeight_pos t k))).mpr (hw k)

/-- A bilinear estimate on the genuine sphere Hilbert spectral graphs. -/
theorem abs_inner_spectralGraph_le
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (w : ℕ → ℝ) (s t C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hw : ∀ k, |w k| ≤ C * (besselWeight s k * besselWeight t k))
    (u a us v vt : SphereL2) (ha : (u,a) ∈ spectralGraph hO hD w)
    (hus : (u,us) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD s)
    (hvt : (v,vt) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD t) :
    |⟪a,v⟫_ℝ| ≤ C * ‖us‖ * ‖vt‖ := by
  let z := boundedSpectralMultiplier hO hD (spectralPairRatio w s t) C hC
    (abs_spectralPairRatio_le w s t C hw) us
  have hz : (us,z) ∈ spectralGraph hO hD (spectralPairRatio w s t) :=
    boundedSpectralMultiplier_mem hO hD (spectralPairRatio w s t) C hC
      (abs_spectralPairRatio_le w s t C hw) us
  have he : ⟪a,v⟫_ℝ = ⟪z,vt⟫_ℝ := by
    rw [inner_sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD a v,
      inner_sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD z vt]
    apply tsum_congr
    intro k
    change ⟪sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k a,
        sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k v⟫_ℝ =
      ⟪sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k z,
        sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k vt⟫_ℝ
    rw [ha k,hz k,hus k,hvt k,smul_smul]
    change ⟪w k • sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k u,
        sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k v⟫_ℝ =
      ⟪(spectralPairRatio w s t k * besselWeight s k) • sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k u,
        besselWeight t k • sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k v⟫_ℝ
    rw [real_inner_smul_left (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k u)
      (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k v) (w k),
      real_inner_smul_left (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k u)
        (besselWeight t k • sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k v)
        (spectralPairRatio w s t k * besselWeight s k),
      real_inner_smul_right (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k u)
        (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k v) (besselWeight t k)]
    have hmul : spectralPairRatio w s t k * besselWeight s k * besselWeight t k = w k := by
      unfold spectralPairRatio
      field_simp [(besselWeight_pos s k).ne', (besselWeight_pos t k).ne']
    rw [← mul_assoc,hmul]
  rw [he]
  have hznorm : ‖z‖ ≤ C * ‖us‖ :=
    norm_boundedSpectralOutput_le hO hD (spectralPairRatio w s t) C hC
      (abs_spectralPairRatio_le w s t C hw) us
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖z‖ * ‖vt‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
    _ ≤ (C * ‖us‖) * ‖vt‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      hznorm (norm_nonneg _)

theorem abs_inner_besselGraph_le
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (s t : ℝ) (u a us v vt : SphereL2)
    (ha : (u,a) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD (s+t))
    (hus : (u,us) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD s)
    (hvt : (v,vt) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD t) :
    |⟪a,v⟫_ℝ| ≤ ‖us‖ * ‖vt‖ := by
  simpa only [one_mul] using abs_inner_spectralGraph_le hO hD
    (besselWeight (s+t)) s t 1 (by norm_num)
    (fun k => by rw [abs_of_pos (besselWeight_pos (s+t) k), besselWeight_add, one_mul])
    u a us v vt ha hus hvt

lemma mul_le_weighted_sq (beta a b : ℝ) (hbeta : 0 < beta) :
    a * b ≤ beta⁻¹ * a^2 + beta * b^2 := by
  apply (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ hbeta).mp
  field_simp
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a-beta*b), sq_nonneg a, sq_nonneg b]

theorem abs_inner_bessel_two_le_weighted_sq
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (beta : ℝ) (hbeta : 0 < beta) (u a uhalf v vthreehalf : SphereL2)
    (ha : (u,a) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD 2)
    (hu : (u,uhalf) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD (1/2))
    (hv : (v,vthreehalf) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD (3/2)) :
    |⟪a,v⟫_ℝ| ≤ beta⁻¹ * ‖uhalf‖^2 + beta * ‖vthreehalf‖^2 := by
  have h := abs_inner_besselGraph_le hO hD (1/2) (3/2) u a uhalf v vthreehalf
    (by norm_num at ha ⊢; exact ha) hu hv
  exact h.trans (mul_le_weighted_sq beta ‖uhalf‖ ‖vthreehalf‖ hbeta)

/-- The exact four angular/base terms of the source norm, with finite tensor slots. -/
def sourceNormSquareIntegrand {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (beta : ℝ)
    (gradientZero : ι → SphereL2) (phiOne : SphereL2)
    (gradientHalf : ι → SphereL2) (phiThreeHalf : SphereL2) : ℝ :=
  (∑ i, ‖gradientZero i‖^2) + beta^2 * ‖phiOne‖^2 +
    beta⁻¹ * (∑ i, ‖gradientHalf i‖^2) + beta * ‖phiThreeHalf‖^2

def sourceNormSquare {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (beta : R3 → ℝ) (gradientZero : R3 → ι → SphereL2)
    (phiOne : R3 → SphereL2) (gradientHalf : R3 → ι → SphereL2)
    (phiThreeHalf : R3 → SphereL2) : ℝ :=
  ∫ x, sourceNormSquareIntegrand (beta x) (gradientZero x) (phiOne x)
    (gradientHalf x) (phiThreeHalf x) ∂referenceBaseMeasure g L lam

theorem sourceNormSquare_eq_density_integral {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (beta : R3 → ℝ) (gradientZero : R3 → ι → SphereL2)
    (phiOne : R3 → SphereL2) (gradientHalf : R3 → ι → SphereL2)
    (phiThreeHalf : R3 → SphereL2) :
    sourceNormSquare g L lam beta gradientZero phiOne gradientHalf phiThreeHalf =
      ∫ x, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
        sourceNormSquareIntegrand (beta x) (gradientZero x) (phiOne x)
          (gradientHalf x) (phiThreeHalf x) :=
  integral_referenceBaseMeasure g hg L lam _

lemma sourceNormSquareIntegrand_nonneg {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (beta : ℝ) (hbeta : 0 ≤ beta) (gradientZero : ι → SphereL2)
    (phiOne : SphereL2) (gradientHalf : ι → SphereL2) (phiThreeHalf : SphereL2) :
    0 ≤ sourceNormSquareIntegrand beta gradientZero phiOne gradientHalf phiThreeHalf := by
  unfold sourceNormSquareIntegrand
  positivity

lemma angular_error_terms_le_sourceNormSquareIntegrand {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (beta : ℝ) (gradientZero : ι → SphereL2) (phiOne : SphereL2)
    (gradientHalf : ι → SphereL2) (phiThreeHalf : SphereL2) :
    beta⁻¹ * (∑ i, ‖gradientHalf i‖^2) + beta * ‖phiThreeHalf‖^2 ≤
      sourceNormSquareIntegrand beta gradientZero phiOne gradientHalf phiThreeHalf := by
  unfold sourceNormSquareIntegrand
  have h0 : 0 ≤ ∑ i, ‖gradientZero i‖^2 := Finset.sum_nonneg (fun _ _ => sq_nonneg _)
  have h1 : 0 ≤ beta^2 * ‖phiOne‖^2 := mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _)
  linarith

/-- One actual base integration by parts; the complete density-weight coefficient stays inside D. -/
theorem compact_second_form_one_parts (i j : R3) (mu weight : R3 → ℝ)
    (phi q : R3 → SphereL2) (hmu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ mu)
    (hweight : ContDiff ℝ ∞ weight) (hphi : ContDiff ℝ ∞ phi)
    (hq : ContDiff ℝ ∞ q) (hcompact : HasCompactSupport phi) :
    (∫ x, mu x * weight x * ⟪directionalDeriv i (directionalDeriv j phi) x,q x⟫_ℝ) =
      -(∫ x, ⟪directionalDeriv i (fun y => (mu y * weight y) • q y) x,
        directionalDeriv j phi x⟫_ℝ) :=
  compact_weighted_first_adjoint i mu weight (directionalDeriv j phi) q
    hmu hweight (contDiff_directionalDeriv j phi hphi) hq
    (hasCompactSupport_directionalDeriv j phi hcompact)

theorem compact_second_form_one_parts_expanded (i j : R3) (mu weight : R3 → ℝ)
    (phi q : R3 → SphereL2) (hmu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ mu)
    (hweight : ContDiff ℝ ∞ weight) (hphi : ContDiff ℝ ∞ phi)
    (hq : ContDiff ℝ ∞ q) (hcompact : HasCompactSupport phi) :
    (∫ x, mu x * weight x * ⟪directionalDeriv i (directionalDeriv j phi) x,q x⟫_ℝ) =
      -(∫ x, directionalDeriv i (fun y => mu y * weight y) x *
        ⟪q x,directionalDeriv j phi x⟫_ℝ) -
        (∫ x, mu x * weight x * ⟪directionalDeriv i q x,directionalDeriv j phi x⟫_ℝ) := by
  rw [compact_second_form_one_parts i j mu weight phi q hmu hweight hphi hq hcompact]
  have hdphi := contDiff_directionalDeriv j phi hphi
  have hc := hasCompactSupport_directionalDeriv j phi hcompact
  have ha := compact_inner_integrable
    (fun x => directionalDeriv i (fun y => mu y * weight y) x • q x)
    (directionalDeriv j phi)
    ((contDiff_directionalDeriv i _ (hmu.mul hweight)).smul hq).continuous
    hdphi.continuous hc
  have hb := compact_inner_integrable
    (fun x => (mu x * weight x) • directionalDeriv i q x)
    (directionalDeriv j phi)
    ((hmu.mul hweight).smul (contDiff_directionalDeriv i q hq)).continuous
    hdphi.continuous hc
  simp_rw [directionalDeriv_smul i _ q (hmu.mul hweight) hq,inner_add_left]
  rw [integral_add ha hb]
  simp only [real_inner_smul_left]
  ring

import Calderon.SectionFiveErrorForms

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open scoped InnerProductSpace
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SectionFiveErrorForms
open SphereHarmonic SphereHilbertDecomposition SpectralCoreRegularity SpectralWeightedGraph

lemma besselWeight_neg_mul (t : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    besselWeight (-t) k * besselWeight t k = 1 := by
  rw [← besselWeight_add,neg_add_cancel,besselWeight_zero_order]

/-- Exact angular duality on the genuine spectral graphs; neither output need be diagonal. -/
theorem inner_besselGraph_inverse_pair
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (t : ℝ) (a z v vt : SphereL2)
    (hz : (a,z) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD (-t))
    (hvt : (v,vt) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD t) :
    ⟪a,v⟫_ℝ = ⟪z,vt⟫_ℝ := by
  rw [inner_sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD a v,
    inner_sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD z vt]
  apply tsum_congr
  intro k
  change ⟪sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k a,sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k v⟫_ℝ =
    ⟪sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k z,sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k vt⟫_ℝ
  rw [hz k,hvt k]
  change ⟪sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k a,sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k v⟫_ℝ =
    ⟪besselWeight (-t) k • sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k a,
      besselWeight t k • sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k v⟫_ℝ
  rw [real_inner_smul_left (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k a)
      (besselWeight t k • sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k v) (besselWeight (-t) k),
    real_inner_smul_right (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k a)
      (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k v) (besselWeight t k),
    ← mul_assoc,besselWeight_neg_mul,one_mul]

/-- A bounded normalized angular operator gives a bilinear estimate, including non-diagonal maps. -/
theorem abs_inner_normalized_angular_form_le
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (s t C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C) (K : SphereL2 →L[ℝ] SphereL2) (hK : ‖K‖ ≤ C)
    (u us a v vt : SphereL2) (hus : (u,us) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD s)
    (houtput : (a,K us) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD (-t))
    (hvt : (v,vt) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD t) :
    |⟪a,v⟫_ℝ| ≤ C * ‖us‖ * ‖vt‖ := by
  rw [inner_besselGraph_inverse_pair hO hD t a (K us) v vt houtput hvt]
  calc
    _ ≤ ‖K us‖ * ‖vt‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
    _ ≤ (‖K‖ * ‖us‖) * ‖vt‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (K.le_opNorm us) (norm_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ (C * ‖us‖) * ‖vt‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hK (norm_nonneg _)) (norm_nonneg _)

theorem abs_inner_normalized_mixed_form_le_weighted_sq
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (beta C : ℝ) (hbeta : 0 < beta) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (K : SphereL2 →L[ℝ] SphereL2) (hK : ‖K‖ ≤ C)
    (u uhalf a v vthreehalf : SphereL2)
    (hu : (u,uhalf) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD (1/2))
    (houtput : (a,K uhalf) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD (-(3/2)))
    (hv : (v,vthreehalf) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD (3/2)) :
    |⟪a,v⟫_ℝ| ≤ C * (beta⁻¹ * ‖uhalf‖^2 + beta * ‖vthreehalf‖^2) := by
  have h := abs_inner_normalized_angular_form_le hO hD (1/2) (3/2) C hC K hK
    u uhalf a v vthreehalf hu houtput hv
  calc
    _ ≤ C * (‖uhalf‖ * ‖vthreehalf‖) := by simpa only [mul_assoc] using h
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_weighted_sq beta _ _ hbeta) hC

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SectionFiveErrorForms

``````lean
import Calderon.SectionFiveCoefficientDerivative
import Calderon.SectionFiveNormalizedAngularForm
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.FDeriv.CompCLM

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory
open scoped InnerProductSpace ContDiff
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SectionFiveErrorForms
open SphereHarmonic SphereHilbertDecomposition SpectralCoreRegularity
  SpectralWeightedGraph SpectralWeightComparison BaseDensityAdjoint
  WeightedBaseSpectral ReferenceDensityBounds

lemma directionalDeriv_besselGraph
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (s : ℝ) (i : R3) (U V : R3 → SphereL2)
    (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U) (hV : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V)
    (hgraph : ∀ x, (U x,V x) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD s) (x : R3) :
    (directionalDeriv i U x,directionalDeriv i V x) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD s := by
  intro k
  have h := directionalDeriv_spectral_family hO hD (fun _ k => besselWeight s k)
    i U V hU hV (fun _ => contDiff_const) hgraph x k
  simpa only [directionalDeriv,fderiv_const_apply,ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply,zero_smul,zero_add] using h

lemma directionalDeriv_clm_apply (i : R3) (K : R3 → SphereL2 →L[ℝ] SphereL2)
    (U : R3 → SphereL2) (hK : ContDiff ℝ ∞ K) (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U) (x : R3) :
    directionalDeriv i (fun y => K y (U y)) x =
      K x (directionalDeriv i U x) + (fderiv ℝ K x i) (U x) := by
  unfold directionalDeriv
  rw [fderiv_clm_apply (hK.differentiable (by simp) x) (hU.differentiable (by simp) x)]
  rfl

lemma norm_bessel_half_le_threehalf
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (u uh ut : SphereL2)
    (hh : (u,uh) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD (1/2))
    (ht : (u,ut) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD (3/2)) : ‖uh‖ ≤ ‖ut‖ := by
  have h := norm_spectralGraph_output_le hO hD (besselWeight (1/2)) (besselWeight (3/2))
    1 (by norm_num) (fun k => by
      rw [abs_of_pos (besselWeight_pos (1/2) k),abs_of_pos (besselWeight_pos (3/2) k),one_mul]
      exact besselWeight_mono (1/2) (3/2) (by norm_num) k) u uh ut hh ht
  simpa only [one_mul] using h

lemma abs_scaled_clm_inner_le (K : SphereL2 →L[ℝ] SphereL2) (d C : ℝ)
    (hK : ‖K‖ ≤ C) (u v : SphereL2) :
    |⟪d • K u,v⟫_ℝ| ≤ (|d| * C) * (‖u‖*‖v‖) := by
  rw [real_inner_smul_left,abs_mul]
  calc
    _ ≤ |d| * (‖K u‖*‖v‖) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _) (abs_nonneg _)
    _ ≤ |d| * ((C*‖u‖)*‖v‖) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right ((K.le_opNorm u).trans
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hK (norm_nonneg _))) (norm_nonneg _)) (abs_nonneg _)
    _ = _ := by ring

/-- Non-diagonal second-base form from a genuine normalized angular operator family and one IBP. -/
theorem compact_normalized_second_error_form_bound
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam epsilon : ℝ) (hepsilon : 0 ≤ epsilon)
    (directions : ι → R3) (i j : ι) (beta : R3 → ℝ)
    (hbeta : ContDiff ℝ ∞ beta) (hbeta1 : ∀ x, 1 ≤ beta x)
    (phi phiHalf phiOne phiThree q : R3 → SphereL2)
    (hphi : ContDiff ℝ ∞ phi) (hphiHalf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ phiHalf)
    (hq : ContDiff ℝ ∞ q) (hcompact : HasCompactSupport phi)
    (hhalf : ∀ x, (phi x,phiHalf x) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD (1/2))
    (hone : ∀ x, (phi x,phiOne x) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD 1)
    (hthree : ∀ x, (phi x,phiThree x) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD (3/2))
    (K : R3 → SphereL2 →L[ℝ] SphereL2) (hK : ContDiff ℝ ∞ K)
    (hqmap : ∀ x, (q x,K x (phiHalf x)) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD (-(1/2)))
    (Cmu Cbeta Cw Cdw : ℝ)
    (hCmu : 0 ≤ Cmu) (hCbeta : 0 ≤ Cbeta) (hCw : 0 ≤ Cw) (hCdw : 0 ≤ Cdw)
    (hKbound : ∀ x, ‖K x‖ ≤ Cw)
    (hDKbound : ∀ x, ‖(fderiv ℝ K x (directions i))‖ ≤ Cdw * beta x)
    (hdmu : ∀ x, |directionalDeriv (directions i) (fun y => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,y)) x|
      ≤ Cmu * referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x))
    (hdbeta : ∀ x, |directionalDeriv (directions i) beta x| ≤ Cbeta * beta x^2)
    (hN : Integrable (fun x => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      sourceNormSquareIntegrand (beta x) (fun k => directionalDeriv (directions k) phi x)
        (phiOne x) (fun k => directionalDeriv (directions k) phiHalf x) (phiThree x))) :
    |epsilon * (∫ x, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * (beta x)⁻¹ *
      ⟪directionalDeriv (directions i) (directionalDeriv (directions j) phi) x,q x⟫_ℝ)| ≤
      epsilon * (Cw+(Cmu+Cbeta)*Cw+Cdw) *
        sourceNormSquare g L lam beta (fun x k => directionalDeriv (directions k) phi x)
          phiOne (fun x k => directionalDeriv (directions k) phiHalf x) phiThree := by
  let mu : R3 → ℝ := fun x => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)
  let h : R3 → ℝ := fun x => mu x * (beta x)⁻¹
  let W : R3 → SphereL2 := fun x => K x (phiHalf x)
  let G : R3 → ι → SphereL2 := fun x k => directionalDeriv (directions k) phiHalf x
  let NN : R3 → ℝ := fun x => sourceNormSquareIntegrand (beta x)
    (fun k => directionalDeriv (directions k) phi x) (phiOne x) (G x) (phiThree x)
  have hpos (x : R3) : 0 < beta x := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (hbeta1 x)
  have hmu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ mu :=
    (contDiff_referenceDensityFamily g hg L).comp (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id)
  have hinv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => (beta x)⁻¹) := hbeta.inv (fun x => (hpos x).ne')
  have hh : ContDiff ℝ ∞ h := hmu.mul hinv
  have hW : ContDiff ℝ ∞ W := hK.clm_apply hphiHalf
  have hweighted : ∀ x, (h x • q x,h x • W x) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD (-(1/2)) := by
    intro x
    exact (sphereBesselGraph hO hD (-(1/2))).smul_mem (h x) (hqmap x)
  have hparts := compact_second_form_one_parts (directions i) (directions j) mu
    (fun x => (beta x)⁻¹) phi q hmu hinv hphi hq hcompact
  have hpair (x : R3) :
      ⟪directionalDeriv (directions i) (fun y => h y • q y) x,
        directionalDeriv (directions j) phi x⟫_ℝ =
      ⟪directionalDeriv (directions i) (fun y => h y • W y) x,G x j⟫_ℝ :=
    inner_besselGraph_inverse_pair hO hD (1/2) _ _ _ _
      (directionalDeriv_besselGraph hO hD (-(1/2)) (directions i)
        (fun y => h y • q y) (fun y => h y • W y) (hh.smul hq) (hh.smul hW) hweighted x)
      (directionalDeriv_besselGraph hO hD (1/2) (directions j) phi phiHalf hphi hphiHalf hhalf x)
  have hbound (x : R3) :
      |⟪directionalDeriv (directions i) (fun y => h y • W y) x,G x j⟫_ℝ| ≤
        (Cw+(Cmu+Cbeta)*Cw+Cdw) * (mu x*NN x) := by
    have hmu0 : 0 ≤ mu x := (referenceDensityFamily_pos g hg L (lam,x)).le
    have hh0 : 0 ≤ h x := mul_nonneg hmu0 (inv_nonneg.mpr (hpos x).le)
    have hN0 : 0 ≤ NN x := sourceNormSquareIntegrand_nonneg (beta x) (hpos x).le _ _ _ _
    have hhalfthree := norm_bessel_half_le_threehalf hO hD _ _ _ (hhalf x) (hthree x)
    have hproduct : ‖phiHalf x‖ * ‖G x j‖ ≤ NN x := by
      calc
        _ ≤ ‖phiThree x‖ * ‖G x j‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hhalfthree (norm_nonneg _)
        _ ≤ (beta x)⁻¹ * ‖G x j‖^2 + beta x * ‖phiThree x‖^2 := by
          simpa only [mul_comm] using mul_le_weighted_sq (beta x) ‖G x j‖ ‖phiThree x‖ (hpos x)
        _ ≤ (beta x)⁻¹ * (∑ k, ‖G x k‖^2) + beta x * ‖phiThree x‖^2 :=
          add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_sq_le_sum (G x) j)
            (inv_nonneg.mpr (hpos x).le)) le_rfl
        _ ≤ _ := angular_error_terms_le_sourceNormSquareIntegrand (beta x) _ _ _ _
    have hdhinv : |directionalDeriv (directions i) h x| ≤ mu x*(Cmu+Cbeta) := by
      dsimp [h]
      rw [directionalDeriv_mul (directions i) mu (fun y => (beta y)⁻¹) hmu hinv x]
      simpa only [mul_one,mul_zero,add_zero] using abs_density_weight_derivative_coefficient_le
        (beta x) (mu x) (directionalDeriv (directions i) mu x)
        (directionalDeriv (directions i) (fun y => (beta y)⁻¹) x) 1 0 Cmu Cbeta 1 0 1 1
        (hbeta1 x) hmu0 hCmu hCbeta (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num) le_rfl
        (hdmu x) (abs_directionalDeriv_inv_le (directions i) beta hbeta x (hpos x) Cbeta (hdbeta x))
        (by norm_num) (by simp)
    have hp : |⟪h x • K x (G x i),G x j⟫_ℝ| ≤ mu x*Cw*NN x := by
      calc
        _ ≤ (|h x| * Cw) * (‖G x i‖*‖G x j‖) := abs_scaled_clm_inner_le (K x) (h x) Cw (hKbound x) _ _
        _ ≤ (|h x| * Cw) * (∑ k, ‖G x k‖^2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (norm_mul_norm_le_sum (G x) i j) (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) hCw)
        _ = (mu x*Cw) * ((beta x)⁻¹ * (∑ k, ‖G x k‖^2)) := by rw [abs_of_nonneg hh0]; dsimp [h]; ring
        _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (weighted_gradient_square_le_sourceNormSquareIntegrand (beta x) (hpos x).le _ _ _ _)
          (mul_nonneg hmu0 hCw)
    have hm : |⟪directionalDeriv (directions i) h x • K x (phiHalf x),G x j⟫_ℝ| ≤
        (mu x*(Cmu+Cbeta)*Cw)*NN x := by
      calc
        _ ≤ (|directionalDeriv (directions i) h x| * Cw) * (‖phiHalf x‖*‖G x j‖) :=
          abs_scaled_clm_inner_le (K x) _ Cw (hKbound x) _ _
        _ ≤ (mu x*(Cmu+Cbeta)*Cw) * NN x := mul_le_mul
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hdhinv hCw) hproduct (by positivity) (by positivity)
    have hd : |⟪h x • (fderiv ℝ K x (directions i)) (phiHalf x),G x j⟫_ℝ| ≤
        (mu x*Cdw)*NN x := by
      calc
        _ ≤ (|h x| * (Cdw*beta x)) * (‖phiHalf x‖*‖G x j‖) :=
          abs_scaled_clm_inner_le ((fderiv ℝ K x (directions i))) (h x) _ (hDKbound x) _ _
        _ = (mu x*Cdw) * (‖phiHalf x‖*‖G x j‖) := by
          rw [abs_of_nonneg hh0]
          dsimp [h]
          field_simp [(hpos x).ne'] <;> ring
        _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hproduct (mul_nonneg hmu0 hCdw)
    have hF : directionalDeriv (directions i) (fun y => h y • W y) x =
        h x • K x (G x i) + directionalDeriv (directions i) h x • K x (phiHalf x) +
          h x • (fderiv ℝ K x (directions i)) (phiHalf x) := by
      rw [directionalDeriv_smul (directions i) h W hh hW x]
      change directionalDeriv (directions i) h x • K x (phiHalf x) +
        h x • directionalDeriv (directions i) (fun y => K y (phiHalf y)) x = _
      rw [directionalDeriv_clm_apply (directions i) K phiHalf hK hphiHalf x,smul_add]
      dsimp [G]
      abel
    rw [hF,inner_add_left,inner_add_left]
    calc
      _ ≤ |⟪h x • K x (G x i),G x j⟫_ℝ +
          ⟪directionalDeriv (directions i) h x • K x (phiHalf x),G x j⟫_ℝ| +
          |⟪h x • (fderiv ℝ K x (directions i)) (phiHalf x),G x j⟫_ℝ| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ (|⟪h x • K x (G x i),G x j⟫_ℝ| +
          |⟪directionalDeriv (directions i) h x • K x (phiHalf x),G x j⟫_ℝ|) +
          |⟪h x • (fderiv ℝ K x (directions i)) (phiHalf x),G x j⟫_ℝ| :=
        add_le_add (abs_add_le _ _) le_rfl
      _ ≤ (mu x*Cw*NN x+(mu x*(Cmu+Cbeta)*Cw)*NN x)+(mu x*Cdw)*NN x :=
        add_le_add (add_le_add hp hm) hd
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hint := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le
    (f := fun x => ⟪directionalDeriv (directions i) (fun y => h y • W y) x,G x j⟫_ℝ)
    (hN.const_mul (Cw+(Cmu+Cbeta)*Cw+Cdw))
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs,mu,NN,G] using hbound x))
  rw [integral_const_mul] at hint
  have hresult : |∫ x, mu x * (beta x)⁻¹ *
      ⟪directionalDeriv (directions i) (directionalDeriv (directions j) phi) x,q x⟫_ℝ| ≤
      (Cw+(Cmu+Cbeta)*Cw+Cdw) * sourceNormSquare g L lam beta
        (fun x k => directionalDeriv (directions k) phi x) phiOne G phiThree := by
    rw [hparts,abs_neg]
    change |∫ x, ⟪directionalDeriv (directions i) (fun y => h y • q y) x,
      directionalDeriv (directions j) phi x⟫_ℝ| ≤ _
    simp_rw [hpair]
    rw [sourceNormSquare_eq_density_integral g hg L lam]
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs,mu,NN,G] using hint
  rw [abs_mul,abs_of_nonneg hepsilon]
  simpa only [G,mul_assoc] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hresult hepsilon

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SectionFiveErrorForms

``````

## Calderon.SectionFiveSecondErrorForm

SHA256 `e178c7859c684e2ed6d0d7d3524427cd9232e126c4f4b863538fe05d6c84219e`.

``````lean
import Calderon.SectionFiveCoefficientDerivative

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory
open scoped InnerProductSpace ContDiff
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SectionFiveErrorForms
open SphereHarmonic SphereHilbertDecomposition SpectralCoreRegularity
  SpectralWeightedGraph BaseDensityAdjoint WeightedBaseSpectral ReferenceDensityBounds

/-- One genuine second-base spectral error, with all differentiated density, weight and symbols. -/
theorem compact_second_spectral_error_form_bound
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam epsilon : ℝ)
    (hepsilon : 0 ≤ epsilon) (directions : ι → R3) (i j : ι)
    (beta : R3 → ℝ) (hbeta : ContDiff ℝ ∞ beta) (hbeta1 : ∀ x, 1 ≤ beta x)
    (w : R3 → ℕ → ℝ) (hw : ∀ k, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => w x k))
    (phi Q Qi Qij U1 Uthree : R3 → SphereL2) (Ghalf : R3 → ι → SphereL2)
    (hphi : ContDiff ℝ ∞ phi) (hQ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Q) (hcompact : HasCompactSupport phi)
    (hgraph : ∀ x, (phi x,Q x) ∈ spectralGraph hO hD (w x))
    (hQi : ∀ x, (directionalDeriv (directions i) phi x,Qi x) ∈ spectralGraph hO hD (w x))
    (hQij : ∀ x, (directionalDeriv (directions i) (directionalDeriv (directions j) phi) x,Qij x)
      ∈ spectralGraph hO hD (w x))
    (hhalf : ∀ x k, (directionalDeriv (directions k) phi x,Ghalf x k) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD (1/2))
    (hone : ∀ x, (phi x,U1 x) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD 1)
    (hthree : ∀ x, (phi x,Uthree x) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD (3/2))
    (Cmu Cbeta Cw Cdw : ℝ)
    (hCmu : 0 ≤ Cmu) (hCbeta : 0 ≤ Cbeta) (hCw : 0 ≤ Cw) (hCdw : 0 ≤ Cdw)
    (hdmu : ∀ x, |directionalDeriv (directions i) (fun y => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,y)) x|
      ≤ Cmu * referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x))
    (hdbeta : ∀ x, |directionalDeriv (directions i) beta x| ≤ Cbeta * beta x^2)
    (hwbound : ∀ x k, |w x k| ≤ Cw * besselWeight 1 k)
    (hdw : ∀ x k, |directionalDeriv (directions i) (fun y => w y k) x|
      ≤ Cdw * beta x * besselWeight 1 k)
    (hN : Integrable (fun x => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      sourceNormSquareIntegrand (beta x) (fun k => directionalDeriv (directions k) phi x)
        (U1 x) (Ghalf x) (Uthree x))) :
    |epsilon * (∫ x, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * (beta x)⁻¹ * ⟪Qij x,phi x⟫_ℝ)| ≤
      epsilon * (Cw + ((Cmu+Cbeta)*Cw+Cdw)) *
        sourceNormSquare g L lam beta (fun x k => directionalDeriv (directions k) phi x)
          U1 Ghalf Uthree := by
  let mu : R3 → ℝ := fun x => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)
  let h : R3 → ℝ := fun x => mu x * (beta x)⁻¹
  let Cd : ℝ := (Cmu+Cbeta)*Cw+Cdw
  let NN : R3 → ℝ := fun x => sourceNormSquareIntegrand (beta x)
    (fun k => directionalDeriv (directions k) phi x) (U1 x) (Ghalf x) (Uthree x)
  have hCd : 0 ≤ Cd := by dsimp [Cd]; positivity
  have hpos (x : R3) : 0 < beta x := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (hbeta1 x)
  have hmu : ContDiff ℝ ∞ mu :=
    (contDiff_referenceDensityFamily g hg L).comp (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id)
  have hinv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => (beta x)⁻¹) := hbeta.inv (fun x => (hpos x).ne')
  have hh : ContDiff ℝ ∞ h := hmu.mul hinv
  have hparts : (∫ x, mu x * (beta x)⁻¹ * ⟪Qij x,phi x⟫_ℝ) =
      -(∫ x, ⟪directionalDeriv (directions i) (fun y => h y • Q y) x,
        directionalDeriv (directions j) phi x⟫_ℝ) := by
    have he : (fun x => mu x * (beta x)⁻¹ * ⟪Qij x,phi x⟫_ℝ) =
        (fun x => mu x * (beta x)⁻¹ *
          ⟪directionalDeriv (directions i) (directionalDeriv (directions j) phi) x,Q x⟫_ℝ) := by
      funext x
      rw [spectralGraph_inner_symm hO hD (w x) _ _ _ _ (hQij x) (hgraph x)]
    rw [he]
    exact compact_second_form_one_parts (directions i) (directions j) mu
      (fun x => (beta x)⁻¹) phi Q hmu hinv hphi hQ hcompact
  have hbound (x : R3) :
      |⟪directionalDeriv (directions i) (fun y => h y • Q y) x,
        directionalDeriv (directions j) phi x⟫_ℝ| ≤ (Cw+Cd) * (mu x * NN x) := by
    let E : SphereL2 := directionalDeriv (directions i) (fun y => h y • Q y) x - h x • Qi x
    let m : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => directionalDeriv (directions i) h x * w x k +
      h x * directionalDeriv (directions i) (fun y => w y k) x
    have hmu0 : 0 ≤ mu x := (referenceDensityFamily_pos g hg L (lam,x)).le
    have hE : (phi x,E) ∈ spectralGraph hO hD m :=
      weighted_coefficient_derivative_remainder_graph hO hD w (directions i) h
        phi Q Qi hh hphi hQ hw hgraph hQi x
    have hm (k : ℕ) : |m k| ≤ (mu x*Cd) * besselWeight 2 k := by
      dsimp [m,h]
      rw [directionalDeriv_mul (directions i) mu (fun y => (beta y)⁻¹) hmu hinv x]
      simpa only [mul_assoc,Cd] using abs_density_weight_derivative_coefficient_le
        (beta x) (mu x) (directionalDeriv (directions i) mu x)
        (directionalDeriv (directions i) (fun y => (beta y)⁻¹) x) (w x k)
        (directionalDeriv (directions i) (fun y => w y k) x)
        Cmu Cbeta Cw Cdw (besselWeight 1 k) (besselWeight 2 k)
        (hbeta1 x) hmu0 hCmu hCbeta hCw hCdw (besselWeight_pos 1 k).le
        (besselWeight_mono 1 2 (by norm_num) k) (hdmu x)
        (abs_directionalDeriv_inv_le (directions i) beta hbeta x (hpos x) Cbeta (hdbeta x))
        (hwbound x k) (hdw x k)
    have hm' (k : ℕ) : |m k| ≤ (mu x*Cd) * (besselWeight (3/2) k * besselWeight (1/2) k) := by
      have hs : (3/2 : ℝ)+(1/2)=2 := by norm_num
      rw [← besselWeight_add,hs]
      exact hm k
    have hlow := abs_inner_spectralGraph_le hO hD m (3/2) (1/2) (mu x*Cd)
      (mul_nonneg hmu0 hCd) hm' (phi x) E (Uthree x)
      (directionalDeriv (directions j) phi x) (Ghalf x j) hE (hthree x) (hhalf x j)
    have hlow' : |⟪E,directionalDeriv (directions j) phi x⟫_ℝ| ≤ mu x*Cd*NN x := by
      calc
        _ ≤ (mu x*Cd) * (‖Ghalf x j‖ * ‖Uthree x‖) := by
          simpa only [mul_assoc,mul_comm ‖Uthree x‖ ‖Ghalf x j‖] using hlow
        _ ≤ (mu x*Cd) * ((beta x)⁻¹ * ‖Ghalf x j‖^2 + beta x * ‖Uthree x‖^2) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_weighted_sq (beta x) _ _ (hpos x))
            (mul_nonneg hmu0 hCd)
        _ ≤ (mu x*Cd) * ((beta x)⁻¹ * (∑ k, ‖Ghalf x k‖^2) + beta x * ‖Uthree x‖^2) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (add_le_add
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_sq_le_sum (Ghalf x) j)
              (inv_nonneg.mpr (hpos x).le)) le_rfl) (mul_nonneg hmu0 hCd)
        _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (angular_error_terms_le_sourceNormSquareIntegrand (beta x)
            (fun k => directionalDeriv (directions k) phi x) (U1 x) (Ghalf x) (Uthree x))
          (mul_nonneg hmu0 hCd)
    have hprincipal := abs_principal_spectral_form_le_sourceNormSquareIntegrand
      hO hD (beta x) Cw (hpos x) hCw (w x) (hwbound x)
      (fun k => directionalDeriv (directions k) phi x) (Ghalf x) (U1 x) (Uthree x)
      (Qi x) i j (hQi x) (hhalf x)
    have hprincipal' : |⟪h x • Qi x,directionalDeriv (directions j) phi x⟫_ℝ| ≤ mu x*Cw*NN x := by
      rw [real_inner_smul_left]
      change |(mu x*(beta x)⁻¹)*⟪Qi x,directionalDeriv (directions j) phi x⟫_ℝ| ≤ _
      rw [mul_assoc,abs_mul,abs_of_nonneg hmu0]
      simpa only [mul_assoc] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprincipal hmu0
    have he : directionalDeriv (directions i) (fun y => h y • Q y) x = h x • Qi x + E := by
      dsimp [E]
      abel
    rw [he,inner_add_left]
    calc
      _ ≤ |⟪h x • Qi x,directionalDeriv (directions j) phi x⟫_ℝ| +
          |⟪E,directionalDeriv (directions j) phi x⟫_ℝ| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ mu x*Cw*NN x+mu x*Cd*NN x := add_le_add hprincipal' hlow'
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hint := norm_integral_le_of_norm_le
    (f := fun x => ⟪directionalDeriv (directions i) (fun y => h y • Q y) x,
      directionalDeriv (directions j) phi x⟫_ℝ) (hN.const_mul (Cw+Cd))
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => by simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs,mu,NN] using hbound x))
  rw [integral_const_mul] at hint
  have hresult : |∫ x, mu x * (beta x)⁻¹ * ⟪Qij x,phi x⟫_ℝ| ≤
      (Cw+Cd) * sourceNormSquare g L lam beta
        (fun x k => directionalDeriv (directions k) phi x) U1 Ghalf Uthree := by
    rw [hparts,abs_neg,sourceNormSquare_eq_density_integral g hg L lam]
    simpa only [Real.norm_eq_abs,mu,NN] using hint
  rw [abs_mul,abs_of_nonneg hepsilon]
  simpa only [Cd,mul_assoc] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hresult hepsilon

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SectionFiveErrorForms

``````

## Calderon.SectionFiveThreeErrorForms

SHA256 `298aed27e21dc41f2771fd73f6c27b21433c84f926e4c2276c73dbd11f1933e9`.

``````lean
import Calderon.SectionFiveErrorBounds

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory
open scoped InnerProductSpace
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SectionFiveErrorForms
open SphereHarmonic SphereHilbertDecomposition SpectralCoreRegularity
  SpectralWeightedGraph WeightedBaseSpectral

def threeSpectralErrorForm {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (g : MatrixField) (L lam epsilon : ℝ) (beta : R3 → ℝ)
    (G0 : R3 → ι → SphereL2) (phi A1 A2 A3 : R3 → SphereL2) (j : ι) : ℝ :=
  ∫ x, epsilon * ((beta x)⁻¹ * ⟪A1 x,G0 x j⟫_ℝ +
    ⟪A2 x,phi x⟫_ℝ + beta x * ⟪A3 x,phi x⟫_ℝ) ∂referenceBaseMeasure g L lam

/-- Three true spectral form bounds and their common-constant absorption in the original N. -/
theorem threeSpectralErrorForm_bound_and_absorption {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (g : MatrixField) (L lam epsilon c C1 C2 C3 : ℝ)
    (hepsilon : 0 ≤ epsilon) (hc : 0 < c)
    (hC1 : 0 ≤ C1) (hC2 : 0 ≤ C2) (hC3 : 0 ≤ C3)
    (hsmall : epsilon * (C1+C2+C3) ≤ c/2)
    (beta : R3 → ℝ) (hbeta : ∀ x, 0 < beta x)
    (G0 Ghalf : R3 → ι → SphereL2) (phi U1 Uthree A1 A2 A3 : R3 → SphereL2)
    (i j : ι) (w1 w2 w3 : R3 → ℕ → ℝ)
    (hw1 : ∀ x k, |w1 x k| ≤ C1 * besselWeight 1 k)
    (hw2 : ∀ x k, |w2 x k| ≤ C2 * besselWeight 2 k)
    (hw3 : ∀ x k, |w3 x k| ≤ C3 * besselWeight 3 k)
    (hA1 : ∀ x, (G0 x i,A1 x) ∈ spectralGraph hO hD (w1 x))
    (hA2 : ∀ x, (G0 x i,A2 x) ∈ spectralGraph hO hD (w2 x))
    (hA3 : ∀ x, (phi x,A3 x) ∈ spectralGraph hO hD (w3 x))
    (hhalf : ∀ x k, (G0 x k,Ghalf x k) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD (1/2))
    (hone : ∀ x, (phi x,U1 x) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD 1)
    (hthree : ∀ x, (phi x,Uthree x) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD (3/2))
    (hN : Integrable (fun x => sourceNormSquareIntegrand (beta x) (G0 x) (U1 x)
      (Ghalf x) (Uthree x)) (referenceBaseMeasure g L lam))
    (hf1 : Integrable (fun x => (beta x)⁻¹ * ⟪A1 x,G0 x j⟫_ℝ) (referenceBaseMeasure g L lam))
    (hf2 : Integrable (fun x => ⟪A2 x,phi x⟫_ℝ) (referenceBaseMeasure g L lam))
    (hf3 : Integrable (fun x => beta x * ⟪A3 x,phi x⟫_ℝ) (referenceBaseMeasure g L lam)) :
    |threeSpectralErrorForm g L lam epsilon beta G0 phi A1 A2 A3 j| ≤
      epsilon * (C1+C2+C3) * sourceNormSquare g L lam beta G0 U1 Ghalf Uthree ∧
    (c/2) * sourceNormSquare g L lam beta G0 U1 Ghalf Uthree ≤
      c * sourceNormSquare g L lam beta G0 U1 Ghalf Uthree -
        threeSpectralErrorForm g L lam epsilon beta G0 phi A1 A2 A3 j := by
  have hpoint (x : R3) :
      |(beta x)⁻¹ * ⟪A1 x,G0 x j⟫_ℝ + ⟪A2 x,phi x⟫_ℝ + beta x * ⟪A3 x,phi x⟫_ℝ| ≤
      (C1+C2+C3) * sourceNormSquareIntegrand (beta x) (G0 x) (U1 x) (Ghalf x) (Uthree x) := by
    have hp := abs_principal_spectral_form_le_sourceNormSquareIntegrand
      hO hD (beta x) C1 (hbeta x) hC1 (w1 x) (hw1 x) (G0 x) (Ghalf x)
      (U1 x) (Uthree x) (A1 x) i j (hA1 x) (hhalf x)
    have hm := abs_mixed_spectral_form_le_sourceNormSquareIntegrand
      hO hD (beta x) C2 (hbeta x) hC2 (w2 x) (hw2 x) (G0 x) (Ghalf x)
      (phi x) (U1 x) (Uthree x) (A2 x) i (hA2 x) (hhalf x i) (hthree x)
    have hz := abs_zero_spectral_form_le_sourceNormSquareIntegrand
      hO hD (beta x) C3 (hbeta x) hC3 (w3 x) (hw3 x) (G0 x) (Ghalf x)
      (phi x) (U1 x) (Uthree x) (A3 x) (hA3 x) (hthree x)
    calc
      _ ≤ |(beta x)⁻¹ * ⟪A1 x,G0 x j⟫_ℝ + ⟪A2 x,phi x⟫_ℝ| +
          |beta x * ⟪A3 x,phi x⟫_ℝ| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ (|(beta x)⁻¹ * ⟪A1 x,G0 x j⟫_ℝ| + |⟪A2 x,phi x⟫_ℝ|) +
          |beta x * ⟪A3 x,phi x⟫_ℝ| := add_le_add (abs_add_le _ _) le_rfl
      _ ≤ (C1 * sourceNormSquareIntegrand (beta x) (G0 x) (U1 x) (Ghalf x) (Uthree x) +
          C2 * sourceNormSquareIntegrand (beta x) (G0 x) (U1 x) (Ghalf x) (Uthree x)) +
          C3 * sourceNormSquareIntegrand (beta x) (G0 x) (U1 x) (Ghalf x) (Uthree x) :=
        add_le_add (add_le_add hp hm) hz
      _ = _ := by ring
  have hbound := abs_integral_form_le_sourceNormSquare g L lam epsilon (C1+C2+C3)
    hepsilon beta G0 Ghalf U1 Uthree
    (fun x => (beta x)⁻¹ * ⟪A1 x,G0 x j⟫_ℝ + ⟪A2 x,phi x⟫_ℝ + beta x * ⟪A3 x,phi x⟫_ℝ)
    hN ((hf1.add hf2).add hf3) hpoint
  change |threeSpectralErrorForm g L lam epsilon beta G0 phi A1 A2 A3 j| ≤ _ at hbound
  refine ⟨hbound,?_⟩
  have hN0 : 0 ≤ sourceNormSquare g L lam beta G0 U1 Ghalf Uthree :=
    integral_nonneg (fun x => sourceNormSquareIntegrand_nonneg (beta x) (hbeta x).le
      (G0 x) (U1 x) (Ghalf x) (Uthree x))
  have hbudget := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsmall hN0
  have hupper := le_abs_self (threeSpectralErrorForm g L lam epsilon beta G0 phi A1 A2 A3 j)
  linarith

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SectionFiveErrorForms

``````

## Calderon.CovariantHarmonicEnergy

SHA256 `b9e4eacbf02786004a46eb599fc05d4aad573118a0d2ded01cf55f179c3e33e2`.

``````lean
import Calderon.FiniteHarmonicEnergy
import Calderon.SmoothSphereRotationProjection

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory MvPolynomial
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.CovariantHarmonicEnergy
open SphereHarmonic SphereHilbertDecomposition SpectralCoreRegularity
  SmoothSphereRotationProjection FischerConnectionTransport MovingFrameConnection
  SmoothMetricFrame FrameCurvaturePolynomial FiniteHarmonicEnergy
  MetricFiberCovectorTransport MetricFiberMeasure MetricFiberFischer
  FiniteProfileNormComparison ConformalDepth RadiusProfile MetricOperator ReferenceDensityBounds
variable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]

/-- The actual probability-sphere realization of a finite coefficient family. -/
def finitePolynomialSphereMap (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    (ι → ℝ) →L[ℝ] SphereL2 :=
  ∑ j, (ContinuousLinearMap.proj j).smulRight (polynomialSphereL2 (b j))

lemma finitePolynomialSphereMap_apply (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (x : R3) :
    finitePolynomialSphereMap b (c x) = polynomialSphereL2 (finitePolynomialField b c x) := by
  simp [finitePolynomialSphereMap,finitePolynomialField,map_sum,map_smul]

lemma contDiff_polynomialSphereL2_finite (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => polynomialSphereL2 (finitePolynomialField b c x)) := by
  simpa only [Function.comp_def,finitePolynomialSphereMap_apply] using
    (finitePolynomialSphereMap b).contDiff.comp hc

lemma fderiv_polynomialSphereL2_finite (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (x X : R3) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun y => polynomialSphereL2 (finitePolynomialField b c y)) x X =
      polynomialSphereL2 (finitePolynomialFieldDerivative b c x X) := by
  have h := ((finitePolynomialSphereMap b).hasFDerivAt.comp x
    (hc.differentiable (by simp) x).hasFDerivAt).fderiv
  have heq : (fun y => finitePolynomialSphereMap b (c y)) =
      fun y => polynomialSphereL2 (finitePolynomialField b c y) := by
    funext y; exact finitePolynomialSphereMap_apply b c y
  change fderiv ℝ (fun y => finitePolynomialSphereMap b (c y)) x = _ at h
  rw [heq] at h
  rw [h,ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
  simp [finitePolynomialSphereMap,finitePolynomialFieldDerivative,map_sum,map_smul]

/-- The true reference connection on the actual degree-k harmonic image. -/
def referenceHarmonicCovariantDerivative (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ) (k : ℕ)
    (U : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace k) (x X : R3) : harmonicSphereSubspace k :=
  fderiv ℝ U x X + (1/2:ℝ) •
    ∑ a : Fin 3, ∑ b : Fin 3,
      referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient g L lam x X a b •
        harmonicSphereRotation k a b (U x)

lemma polynomialSphereL2_finite_derivative_eq (k : ℕ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (c : R3 → ι → ℝ)
    (U : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace k) (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c)
    (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U)
    (hrep : ∀ x, polynomialSphereL2 (finitePolynomialField b c x) = (U x : SphereL2))
    (x X : R3) :
    polynomialSphereL2 (finitePolynomialFieldDerivative b c x X) =
      (fderiv ℝ U x X : SphereL2) := by
  have heq : (fun y => polynomialSphereL2 (finitePolynomialField b c y)) =
      fun y => (U y : SphereL2) := funext hrep
  rw [← fderiv_polynomialSphereL2_finite b c hc x X,heq]
  have h := ((harmonicSphereSubspace k).subtypeL.hasFDerivAt.comp x
    (hU.differentiable (by simp) x).hasFDerivAt).fderiv
  exact congrArg (fun A : R3 →L[ℝ] SphereL2 => A X) h

lemma polynomialSphereL2_rotation_eq (k : ℕ) (i j : Fin 3)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hp : p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k)
    (v : harmonicSphereSubspace k) (hrep : polynomialSphereL2 p = (v : SphereL2)) :
    polynomialSphereL2 (polynomialRotation i j p) =
      (harmonicSphereRotation k i j v : SphereL2) := by
  have hv : harmonicPolynomialSphereMap k ⟨p,hp⟩ = v := by
    apply Subtype.ext; exact hrep
  rw [← hv,harmonicSphereRotation_apply_image]
  rfl

theorem polynomialSphereL2_referenceCovariantDerivative (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (k : ℕ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hb : ∀ j, b j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (U : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace k)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U)
    (hrep : ∀ x, polynomialSphereL2 (finitePolynomialField b c x) = (U x : SphereL2))
    (x X : R3) :
    polynomialSphereL2 (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x X) =
      (referenceHarmonicCovariantDerivative g L lam k U x X : SphereL2) := by
  rw [referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative,map_add,
    polynomialSphereL2_finite_derivative_eq k b c U hc hU hrep x X,
    referenceFrameAngularPolynomial_eq_half_smul g hg L lam x X,map_smul]
  have hrot (a d : Fin 3) := polynomialSphereL2_rotation_eq k a d
    (finitePolynomialField b c x) (finitePolynomialField_harmonicHomogeneous k b hb c x)
    (U x) (hrep x)
  simp only [polynomialRotationCombination,map_sum,← smul_eq_C_mul,map_smul,hrot,
    referenceHarmonicCovariantDerivative,Submodule.coe_add,Submodule.coe_smul,
    Submodule.coe_sum]

lemma referenceFiberCovectorPair_self_norm (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (x : R3) (q : Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    referenceFiberCovectorPair g hg L lam x q q =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, ‖polynomialSphereL2 (q i)‖^2 := by
  simp only [referenceFiberCovectorPair,metricFrameCovectorPair_eq_sum,
    metricFramePolynomial_fiber_integral_pair,real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]

/-- Exactly the manuscript's four-term single-mode energy in its genuine Gram frame. -/
def referenceHarmonicModeEnergyDensity (g : MatrixField) (lam δ R L : ℝ)
    (p k : ℕ) (U : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace k) (x : R3) : ℝ :=
  let V := ‖U x‖^2
  let G := ∑ i : Fin 3, ‖referenceHarmonicCovariantDerivative g L lam k U x
    (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i)‖^2
  let beta := referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x
  G+beta^2*(1+(k:ℝ))^2*V+beta⁻¹*(1+(k:ℝ))*G+beta*(1+(k:ℝ))^3*V

def referenceHarmonicModeEnergy (g : MatrixField) (lam δ R L : ℝ)
    (p k : ℕ) (U : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace k) : ℝ :=
  ∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*
    referenceHarmonicModeEnergyDensity g lam δ R L p k U x

theorem referenceHarmonicModeEnergyDensity_eq_polynomial (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (lam δ R L : ℝ) (p k : ℕ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hb : ∀ j, b j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (U : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace k)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U)
    (hrep : ∀ x, polynomialSphereL2 (finitePolynomialField b c x) = (U x : SphereL2))
    (x : R3) :
    referenceHarmonicModeEnergyDensity g lam δ R L p k U x =
      referenceProfileModeEnergyDensity g hg lam δ R L p k b c x := by
  simp only [referenceHarmonicModeEnergyDensity,referenceProfileModeEnergyDensity,
    referenceFiberPolynomialSquare_norm,referenceFiberCovectorPair_self_norm,
    polynomialSphereL2_referenceCovariantDerivative g hg L lam k b hb c U hc hU hrep,
    hrep,Submodule.norm_coe]

theorem referenceHarmonicModeEnergy_eq_polynomial (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (lam δ R L : ℝ) (p k : ℕ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hb : ∀ j, b j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (U : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace k)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U)
    (hrep : ∀ x, polynomialSphereL2 (finitePolynomialField b c x) = (U x : SphereL2)) :
    referenceHarmonicModeEnergy g lam δ R L p k U =
      referenceProfileModeEnergy g hg lam δ R L p k b c := by
  unfold referenceHarmonicModeEnergy referenceProfileModeEnergy
  simp_rw [referenceHarmonicModeEnergyDensity_eq_polynomial g hg lam δ R L p k b hb c U hc hU hrep]

theorem integrable_referenceHarmonicModeEnergy (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (lam δ R L : ℝ) (p k : ℕ)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hR : 0 < R) (hL : 0 < L) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hb : ∀ j, b j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (U : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace k)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c) (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U)
    (hrep : ∀ x, polynomialSphereL2 (finitePolynomialField b c x) = (U x : SphereL2)) :
    Integrable (fun x => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*
      referenceHarmonicModeEnergyDensity g lam δ R L p k U x) := by
  simp_rw [referenceHarmonicModeEnergyDensity_eq_polynomial g hg lam δ R L p k b hb c U hc hU hrep]
  exact (referenceProfileModeEnergy_integrable_and_eq hF g hg lam δ R L p k
    hδ hR hL hp hk b hb c hc hcompact).1

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.CovariantHarmonicEnergy

## Calderon.CovariantProjectedEnergy

SHA256 `c36392fede97aad1c0f04e02a78751c75be01560bb09c2bb76d9d67d7d3597c5`.

``````lean
import Calderon.CovariantHarmonicEnergy

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory MvPolynomial
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.CovariantProjectedEnergy
open SphereHarmonic SphereHilbertDecomposition SpectralCoreRegularity
  CovariantHarmonicEnergy FischerConnectionTransport FiniteProfileNormComparison
  ReferenceDensityBounds RadiusProfile

/-- Coordinates and covariant energy equality are derived for the actual projection. -/
theorem exists_coordinates_covariant_sphereHarmonicCoordinate
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (lam δ R L : ℝ) (p k : ℕ)
    (U : R3 → SphereL2) (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U)
    (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) (hzero : ∀ x ∉ K, U x = 0) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∃ b : Fin n → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ, ∃ c : R3 → Fin n → ℝ,
      (∀ j, b j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k) ∧ ContDiff ℝ ∞ c ∧ HasCompactSupport c ∧
      (∀ x ∉ K, c x = 0) ∧
      (∀ x, polynomialSphereL2 (finitePolynomialField b c x) =
        (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (U x) : SphereL2)) ∧
      (∀ x X, polynomialSphereL2 (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x X) =
        (referenceHarmonicCovariantDerivative g L lam k
          (fun y => sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (U y)) x X : SphereL2)) ∧
      (∀ x, referenceHarmonicModeEnergyDensity g lam δ R L p k
        (fun y => sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (U y)) x =
          referenceProfileModeEnergyDensity g hg lam δ R L p k b c x) ∧
      referenceHarmonicModeEnergy g lam δ R L p k
        (fun y => sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (U y)) =
          referenceProfileModeEnergy g hg lam δ R L p k b c := by
  obtain ⟨n,b,c,hb,hc,hcompact,hrep,hcz⟩ :=
    exists_smooth_compact_coordinates_sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k U hU K hK hzero
  have hproj := contDiff_sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k U hU
  refine ⟨n,b,c,hb,hc,hcompact,hcz,hrep,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · intro x X
    exact polynomialSphereL2_referenceCovariantDerivative g hg L lam k b hb c _ hc hproj hrep x X
  · intro x
    exact referenceHarmonicModeEnergyDensity_eq_polynomial g hg lam δ R L p k b hb c _ hc hproj hrep x
  · exact referenceHarmonicModeEnergy_eq_polynomial g hg lam δ R L p k b hb c _ hc hproj hrep

theorem integrable_referenceHarmonicModeEnergy_projection
    (hF : SphereFischerInner) (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (lam δ R L : ℝ) (p k : ℕ)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hR : 0 < R) (hL : 0 < L) (hp : 1 ≤ p) (hk : 1 ≤ k)
    (U : R3 → SphereL2) (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U)
    (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) (hzero : ∀ x ∉ K, U x = 0) :
    Integrable (fun x => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*
      referenceHarmonicModeEnergyDensity g lam δ R L p k
        (fun y => sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (U y)) x) := by
  obtain ⟨n,b,c,hb,hc,hcompact,hrep,hcz⟩ :=
    exists_smooth_compact_coordinates_sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k U hU K hK hzero
  exact integrable_referenceHarmonicModeEnergy hF g hg lam δ R L p k hδ hR hL hp hk
    b hb c _ hc hcompact (contDiff_sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k U hU) hrep

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.CovariantProjectedEnergy

``````lean
import Calderon.CovariantProjectedEnergy
import Calderon.SphereDerivativeAdjoint
import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Adjoint

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MvPolynomial
open scoped InnerProductSpace
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.HarmonicDerivativeOperator
open SphereHarmonic SmoothSphereRotationProjection SphereDerivativeAdjoint SphereHilbertDecomposition

local instance (k : ℕ) : CompleteSpace (harmonicSphereSubspace k) :=
  completeSpace_harmonicSphereSubspace k

def harmonicPolynomialDerivativeMap (m : ℕ) (i : Fin 3) :
    harmonicHomogeneous (m+1) →ₗ[ℝ] harmonicSphereSubspace m where
  toFun p := ⟨polynomialSphereL2 (pderiv i (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)),
    polynomialSphereL2_mem m _ (pderiv_harmonicHomogeneous_succ m i p p.property)⟩
  map_add' p q := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change polynomialSphereL2 (pderiv i ((p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)+q)) = _
    rw [map_add,map_add]
    rfl
  map_smul' c p := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change polynomialSphereL2 (pderiv i (c • (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ))) =
      c • polynomialSphereL2 (pderiv i (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ))
    rw [smul_eq_C_mul,pderiv_C_mul,← smul_eq_C_mul,map_smul]

lemma harmonicPolynomialSphereMap_ker_le_derivative (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (m : ℕ) (i : Fin 3) :
    LinearMap.ker (harmonicPolynomialSphereMap (m+1)) ≤
      LinearMap.ker (harmonicPolynomialDerivativeMap m i) := by
  intro p hp
  have hz : polynomialSphereL2 (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) = 0 :=
    congrArg Subtype.val (LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hp)
  have hpz := (polynomialSphereL2_eq_zero_iff hF (m+1) p p.property).mp hz
  apply LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr
  apply Subtype.ext
  change polynomialSphereL2 (pderiv i (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)) = 0
  rw [hpz,map_zero,map_zero]

def harmonicDerivativeLinear (hF : SphereFischerInner) (m : ℕ) (i : Fin 3) :
    harmonicSphereSubspace (m+1) →ₗ[ℝ] harmonicSphereSubspace m :=
  (harmonicPolynomialSphereMap (m+1)).liftOfSurjective
    (harmonicPolynomialSphereMap_surjective (m+1))
    ⟨harmonicPolynomialDerivativeMap m i,harmonicPolynomialSphereMap_ker_le_derivative hF m i⟩

lemma harmonicDerivativeLinear_apply_image (hF : SphereFischerInner) (m : ℕ) (i : Fin 3)
    (p : harmonicHomogeneous (m+1)) :
    harmonicDerivativeLinear hF m i (harmonicPolynomialSphereMap (m+1) p) =
      harmonicPolynomialDerivativeMap m i p := by
  unfold harmonicDerivativeLinear
  exact LinearMap.equivOfSurjective_apply (harmonicPolynomialSphereMap_surjective (m+1))
    (harmonicPolynomialSphereMap_ker_le_derivative hF m i)

/-- Genuine ambient differentiation of the harmonic extension on one positive degree. -/
def harmonicDerivative (hF : SphereFischerInner) (m : ℕ) (i : Fin 3) :
    harmonicSphereSubspace (m+1) →L[ℝ] harmonicSphereSubspace m := by
  letI := finiteDimensional_harmonicSphereSubspace (m+1)
  exact (harmonicDerivativeLinear hF m i).toContinuousLinearMap

lemma harmonicDerivative_apply_image (hF : SphereFischerInner) (m : ℕ) (i : Fin 3)
    (p : harmonicHomogeneous (m+1)) :
    harmonicDerivative hF m i (harmonicPolynomialSphereMap (m+1) p) =
      harmonicPolynomialDerivativeMap m i p := harmonicDerivativeLinear_apply_image hF m i p

def harmonicPolynomialDerivativeAdjointMap (k : ℕ) (i : Fin 3) :
    harmonicHomogeneous k →ₗ[ℝ] harmonicSphereSubspace (k+1) where
  toFun p := ⟨polynomialSphereL2 (sphereDerivativeAdjoint k i p),
    polynomialSphereL2_mem (k+1) _ (sphereDerivativeAdjoint_harmonicHomogeneous k i p p.property)⟩
  map_add' p q := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change polynomialSphereL2 (sphereDerivativeAdjoint k i ((p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)+q)) = _
    rw [sphereDerivativeAdjoint_add,map_add]
    rfl
  map_smul' c p := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change polynomialSphereL2 (sphereDerivativeAdjoint k i (c • (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ))) =
      c • polynomialSphereL2 (sphereDerivativeAdjoint k i (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ))
    rw [smul_eq_C_mul,sphereDerivativeAdjoint_C_mul,← smul_eq_C_mul,map_smul]

lemma harmonicPolynomialSphereMap_ker_le_derivativeAdjoint (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (k : ℕ) (i : Fin 3) :
    LinearMap.ker (harmonicPolynomialSphereMap k) ≤
      LinearMap.ker (harmonicPolynomialDerivativeAdjointMap k i) := by
  intro p hp
  have hz : polynomialSphereL2 (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) = 0 :=
    congrArg Subtype.val (LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hp)
  have hpz := (polynomialSphereL2_eq_zero_iff hF k p p.property).mp hz
  apply LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr
  apply Subtype.ext
  change polynomialSphereL2 (sphereDerivativeAdjoint k i (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)) = 0
  rw [hpz,sphereDerivativeAdjoint_zero,map_zero]

def harmonicDerivativeAdjointLinear (hF : SphereFischerInner) (k : ℕ) (i : Fin 3) :
    harmonicSphereSubspace k →ₗ[ℝ] harmonicSphereSubspace (k+1) :=
  (harmonicPolynomialSphereMap k).liftOfSurjective (harmonicPolynomialSphereMap_surjective k)
    ⟨harmonicPolynomialDerivativeAdjointMap k i,harmonicPolynomialSphereMap_ker_le_derivativeAdjoint hF k i⟩

lemma harmonicDerivativeAdjointLinear_apply_image (hF : SphereFischerInner) (k : ℕ) (i : Fin 3)
    (p : harmonicHomogeneous k) :
    harmonicDerivativeAdjointLinear hF k i (harmonicPolynomialSphereMap k p) =
      harmonicPolynomialDerivativeAdjointMap k i p := by
  unfold harmonicDerivativeAdjointLinear
  exact LinearMap.equivOfSurjective_apply (harmonicPolynomialSphereMap_surjective k)
    (harmonicPolynomialSphereMap_ker_le_derivativeAdjoint hF k i)

/-- Actual probability-sphere adjoint, constructed before proving its adjoint identity. -/
def harmonicDerivativeAdjoint (hF : SphereFischerInner) (k : ℕ) (i : Fin 3) :
    harmonicSphereSubspace k →L[ℝ] harmonicSphereSubspace (k+1) := by
  letI := finiteDimensional_harmonicSphereSubspace k
  exact (harmonicDerivativeAdjointLinear hF k i).toContinuousLinearMap

lemma harmonicDerivativeAdjoint_apply_image (hF : SphereFischerInner) (k : ℕ) (i : Fin 3)
    (p : harmonicHomogeneous k) :
    harmonicDerivativeAdjoint hF k i (harmonicPolynomialSphereMap k p) =
      harmonicPolynomialDerivativeAdjointMap k i p := harmonicDerivativeAdjointLinear_apply_image hF k i p

theorem inner_harmonicDerivativeAdjoint (hF : SphereFischerInner) (k : ℕ) (i : Fin 3)
    (u : harmonicSphereSubspace k) (v : harmonicSphereSubspace (k+1)) :
    ⟪harmonicDerivativeAdjoint hF k i u,v⟫_ℝ = ⟪u,harmonicDerivative hF k i v⟫_ℝ := by
  rcases harmonicPolynomialSphereMap_surjective k u with ⟨p,rfl⟩
  rcases harmonicPolynomialSphereMap_surjective (k+1) v with ⟨q,rfl⟩
  rw [harmonicDerivativeAdjoint_apply_image,harmonicDerivative_apply_image]
  exact sphereDerivativeAdjoint_inner_adjoint hF k i p q p.property q.property

theorem harmonicDerivativeAdjoint_eq_adjoint (hF : SphereFischerInner) (k : ℕ) (i : Fin 3) :
    harmonicDerivativeAdjoint hF k i = ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (harmonicDerivative hF k i) := by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro u
  apply ext_inner_right ℝ
  intro v
  rw [inner_harmonicDerivativeAdjoint,ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left]

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.HarmonicDerivativeOperator

``````

## Calderon.HarmonicRaisingModel

SHA256 `6c01518a4dd36f5f7f636f774255c5ffedfa641e483df642223eefff76b80176`.

``````lean
import Calderon.HarmonicDerivativeOperator

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory MvPolynomial
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.HarmonicRaisingModel
open SphereHarmonic SmoothSphereRotationProjection HarmonicDerivativeOperator
  CovariantHarmonicEnergy FischerConnectionTransport WeightedFischerSquare
  FiniteRaisingEnergy SmoothMetricFrame ReferenceDensityBounds SphereDerivativeAdjoint
  SphereHilbertDecomposition AngularPolynomial
variable {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]

lemma sphereRaising_eq_sum_sphereDerivativeAdjoint (m : ℕ)
    (q : Fin 3 → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) :
    sphereRaising m q = ∑ i : Fin 3, sphereDerivativeAdjoint (m+1) i (q i) := by
  simp_rw [sphereDerivativeAdjoint_eq_raisingComponent (m+1) (by omega)]
  simp only [raisingComponent,Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  rw [← sphereRaising_sum_family]
  congr 1
  funext j
  simp [Pi.single_apply]

def referenceWeightedHarmonicDerivative (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ) (k : ℕ)
    (U : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace k) (f : R3 → ℝ) (s : ℝ) (x X : R3) :
    harmonicSphereSubspace k :=
  s • referenceHarmonicCovariantDerivative g L lam k U x X +
    ((k:ℝ)*fderiv ℝ f x X) • U x

lemma polynomialSphereL2_referenceWeightedDerivative (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (k : ℕ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hb : ∀ j, b j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous k)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (U : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace k)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U)
    (hrep : ∀ x, polynomialSphereL2 (finitePolynomialField b c x) = (U x : SphereL2))
    (f : R3 → ℝ) (s : ℝ) (x X : R3) :
    polynomialSphereL2 (referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c f k s x X) =
      (referenceWeightedHarmonicDerivative g L lam k U f s x X : SphereL2) := by
  simp only [referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative,referenceWeightedHarmonicDerivative,
    ← smul_eq_C_mul,map_add,map_smul,
    polynomialSphereL2_referenceCovariantDerivative g hg L lam k b hb c U hc hU hrep,
    hrep,Submodule.coe_add,Submodule.coe_smul]

/-- The source T restricted to one genuine positive harmonic input. -/
def referenceHarmonicRaising (hF : SphereFischerInner) (g : MatrixField)
    (L lam : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (U : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace (m+1))
    (f : R3 → ℝ) (x : R3) : harmonicSphereSubspace ((m+1)+1) :=
  ∑ i : Fin 3, harmonicDerivativeAdjoint hF (m+1) i
    (referenceWeightedHarmonicDerivative g L lam (m+1) U f 1 x
      (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i))

/-- The source Tflat; its full base adjoint identification is a separate obligation. -/
def referenceHarmonicLowering (hF : SphereFischerInner) (g : MatrixField)
    (L lam : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (U : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace (m+1))
    (f : R3 → ℝ) (x : R3) : harmonicSphereSubspace m :=
  ∑ i : Fin 3, harmonicDerivative hF m i
    (referenceWeightedHarmonicDerivative g L lam (m+1) U f (-1) x
      (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i))

theorem polynomialSphereL2_referenceRaisedField (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hb : ∀ j, b j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (m+1))
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (U : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace (m+1))
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U)
    (hrep : ∀ x, polynomialSphereL2 (finitePolynomialField b c x) = (U x : SphereL2))
    (f : R3 → ℝ) (x : R3) :
    polynomialSphereL2 (referenceRaisedPolynomialField g L lam b c f m x) =
      (referenceHarmonicRaising hF g L lam m U f x : SphereL2) := by
  let q := referenceWeightedFramePolynomialField g L lam b c f (m+1) 1 x
  have hq (i : Fin 3) : q i ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (m+1) :=
    referenceWeightedFramePolynomialField_harmonicHomogeneous g hg L lam m b hb c f 1 x i
  have himage (i : Fin 3) : harmonicPolynomialSphereMap (m+1) ⟨q i,hq i⟩ =
      referenceWeightedHarmonicDerivative g L lam (m+1) U f 1 x
        (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change polynomialSphereL2 (q i) =
      (referenceWeightedHarmonicDerivative g L lam (m+1) U f 1 x
        (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) : SphereL2)
    simpa only [q,referenceWeightedFramePolynomialField,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one] using
      polynomialSphereL2_referenceWeightedDerivative g hg L lam (m+1) b hb c U hc hU hrep f 1 x
        (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i)
  change polynomialSphereL2 (sphereRaising m q) = _
  rw [sphereRaising_eq_sum_sphereDerivativeAdjoint,map_sum]
  unfold referenceHarmonicRaising
  rw [Submodule.coe_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [← himage i,harmonicDerivativeAdjoint_apply_image]
  rfl

theorem polynomialSphereL2_referenceLoweredField (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hb : ∀ j, b j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (m+1))
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (U : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace (m+1))
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U)
    (hrep : ∀ x, polynomialSphereL2 (finitePolynomialField b c x) = (U x : SphereL2))
    (f : R3 → ℝ) (x : R3) :
    polynomialSphereL2 (referenceLoweredPolynomialField g L lam b c f m x) =
      (referenceHarmonicLowering hF g L lam m U f x : SphereL2) := by
  let q := referenceWeightedFramePolynomialField g L lam b c f (m+1) (-1) x
  have hq (i : Fin 3) : q i ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (m+1) :=
    referenceWeightedFramePolynomialField_harmonicHomogeneous g hg L lam m b hb c f (-1) x i
  have himage (i : Fin 3) : harmonicPolynomialSphereMap (m+1) ⟨q i,hq i⟩ =
      referenceWeightedHarmonicDerivative g L lam (m+1) U f (-1) x
        (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    change polynomialSphereL2 (q i) =
      (referenceWeightedHarmonicDerivative g L lam (m+1) U f (-1) x
        (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) : SphereL2)
    simpa only [q,referenceWeightedFramePolynomialField,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one] using
      polynomialSphereL2_referenceWeightedDerivative g hg L lam (m+1) b hb c U hc hU hrep f (-1) x
        (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i)
  change polynomialSphereL2 (∑ i : Fin 3, pderiv i (q i)) = _
  rw [map_sum]
  unfold referenceHarmonicLowering
  rw [Submodule.coe_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [← himage i,harmonicDerivative_apply_image]
  rfl

def referenceHarmonicRaisingEnergy (hF : SphereFischerInner) (g : MatrixField)
    (L lam : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (U : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace (m+1)) (f : R3 → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*‖referenceHarmonicRaising hF g L lam m U f x‖^2

def referenceHarmonicLoweringEnergy (hF : SphereFischerInner) (g : MatrixField)
    (L lam : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (U : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace (m+1)) (f : R3 → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*‖referenceHarmonicLowering hF g L lam m U f x‖^2

theorem referenceHarmonicRaisingEnergy_eq_polynomial (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hb : ∀ j, b j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (m+1))
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (U : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace (m+1))
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U)
    (hrep : ∀ x, polynomialSphereL2 (finitePolynomialField b c x) = (U x : SphereL2))
    (f : R3 → ℝ) :
    referenceHarmonicRaisingEnergy hF g L lam m U f = referenceRaisingEnergy g L lam b c f m := by
  unfold referenceHarmonicRaisingEnergy referenceRaisingEnergy
  simp_rw [polynomialSphereL2_referenceRaisedField hF g hg L lam m b hb c U hc hU hrep,Submodule.norm_coe]

theorem referenceHarmonicLoweringEnergy_eq_polynomial (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hb : ∀ j, b j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (m+1))
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (U : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace (m+1))
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U)
    (hrep : ∀ x, polynomialSphereL2 (finitePolynomialField b c x) = (U x : SphereL2))
    (f : R3 → ℝ) :
    referenceHarmonicLoweringEnergy hF g L lam m U f = referenceLoweringEnergy g L lam b c f m := by
  unfold referenceHarmonicLoweringEnergy referenceLoweringEnergy
  simp_rw [polynomialSphereL2_referenceLoweredField hF g hg L lam m b hb c U hc hU hrep,Submodule.norm_coe]

theorem integrable_referenceHarmonicRaising (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hb : ∀ j, b j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (m+1))
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (U : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace (m+1))
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c) (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U)
    (hrep : ∀ x, polynomialSphereL2 (finitePolynomialField b c x) = (U x : SphereL2))
    (f : R3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) :
    Integrable (fun x => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*
      ‖referenceHarmonicRaising hF g L lam m U f x‖^2) := by
  have h := integrable_referenceRaisingEnergy hF g hg L lam m b hb c f hc hf hcompact
  simpa only [polynomialSphereL2_referenceRaisedField hF g hg L lam m b hb c U hc hU hrep,
    Submodule.norm_coe] using h

theorem integrable_referenceHarmonicLowering (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hb : ∀ j, b j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (m+1))
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (U : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace (m+1))
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c) (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U)
    (hrep : ∀ x, polynomialSphereL2 (finitePolynomialField b c x) = (U x : SphereL2))
    (f : R3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) :
    Integrable (fun x => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)*
      ‖referenceHarmonicLowering hF g L lam m U f x‖^2) := by
  have h := integrable_referenceLoweringEnergy hF g hg L lam m b hb c f hc hf hcompact
  simpa only [polynomialSphereL2_referenceLoweredField hF g hg L lam m b hb c U hc hU hrep,
    Submodule.norm_coe] using h

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.HarmonicRaisingModel

## Calderon.HarmonicProjectedCoercivity

SHA256 `77ef40c65371bb7c1d12d0b269474c48c8f3544c266c4e8e3c67be0ac9c71696`.

``````lean
import Calderon.HarmonicRaisingModel
import Calderon.CovariantProjectedEnergy

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory MvPolynomial
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.HarmonicProjectedCoercivity
open SphereHarmonic SphereHilbertDecomposition SpectralCoreRegularity
  CovariantHarmonicEnergy CovariantProjectedEnergy HarmonicRaisingModel
  FiniteProfileNormComparison RadiusProfile ReferenceDensityBounds ConformalDepth

/-- The common geometric gain for actual harmonic projections of smooth sphere fields. -/
theorem exists_referenceHarmonicProjection_uniform_coercivity (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ L cRaise : ℝ, 0 < L ∧ 0 < cRaise ∧
      ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ p : ℕ, 2 ≤ p ∧ ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧
        (∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 → ∀ x ∈ K,
          ‖fderiv ℝ (referenceRadius δ R p L) x‖ ≤ ε ∧
          referenceRadius δ R p L x * referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x^2 ≤ ε) ∧
        ∀ (hF : SphereFischerInner) (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
          (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics),
          ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 →
          ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ U : R3 → SphereL2, ContDiff ℝ ∞ U →
          (∀ x ∉ K, U x = 0) →
          cRaise * referenceHarmonicModeEnergy g lam δ R L p (m+1)
            (fun x => sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (m+1) (U x)) ≤
            referenceHarmonicRaisingEnergy hF g L lam m
              (fun x => sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (m+1) (U x))
              (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) -
            referenceHarmonicLoweringEnergy hF g L lam m
              (fun x => sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (m+1) (U x))
              (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) := by
  obtain ⟨L,cRaise,hL,hcRaise,hgain⟩ :=
    exists_referenceProfileModeEnergy_uniform_coercivity.{0} g hg K hK
  refine ⟨L,cRaise,hL,hcRaise,?_⟩
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨p,hp,R,hR,hprofile,hfinite⟩ := hgain ε hε
  refine ⟨p,hp,R,hR,hprofile,?_⟩
  intro hF hO hD lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 m U hU hzero
  obtain ⟨n,b,c,hb,hc,hcompact,hrep,hpolyZero⟩ :=
    exists_smooth_compact_polynomial_sphereHarmonicCoordinate hF hO hD (m+1)
      U hU K hK hzero
  have hproj := contDiff_sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (m+1) U hU
  have hineq := hfinite (Fin n) hF lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 m b hb c hc hcompact hpolyZero
  rw [← referenceHarmonicModeEnergy_eq_polynomial g hg lam δ R L p (m+1)
      b hb c _ hc hproj hrep,
    ← referenceHarmonicRaisingEnergy_eq_polynomial hF g hg L lam m
      b hb c _ hc hproj hrep,
    ← referenceHarmonicLoweringEnergy_eq_polynomial hF g hg L lam m
      b hb c _ hc hproj hrep] at hineq
  exact hineq

theorem integrable_referenceHarmonicProjection_energies
    (hF : SphereFischerInner) (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (lam δ R L : ℝ) (p m : ℕ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hR : 0 < R)
    (hL : 0 < L) (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (U : R3 → SphereL2) (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U)
    (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) (hzero : ∀ x ∉ K, U x = 0) :
    Integrable (fun x => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      referenceHarmonicModeEnergyDensity g lam δ R L p (m+1)
        (fun y => sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (m+1) (U y)) x) ∧
    Integrable (fun x => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      ‖referenceHarmonicRaising hF g L lam m
        (fun y => sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (m+1) (U y))
        (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) x‖^2) ∧

      ‖referenceHarmonicLowering hF g L lam m
        (fun y => sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (m+1) (U y))
        (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) x‖^2) := by
  obtain ⟨n,b,c,hb,hc,hcompact,hrep,hcz⟩ :=
    exists_smooth_compact_coordinates_sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (m+1)
      U hU K hK hzero
  have hproj := contDiff_sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (m+1) U hU
  have hf := contDiff_log_referenceRadius δ R p L hδ hR
  exact ⟨integrable_referenceHarmonicModeEnergy hF g hg lam δ R L p (m+1)
      hδ hR hL hp (by omega) b hb c _ hc hcompact hproj hrep,
    integrable_referenceHarmonicRaising hF g hg L lam m
      b hb c _ hc hcompact hproj hrep _ hf,
    integrable_referenceHarmonicLowering hF g hg L lam m
      b hb c _ hc hcompact hproj hrep _ hf⟩

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.HarmonicProjectedCoercivity
````````

# Full upfront expansion: reference-volume raising adjunction

`section5-raising-base-adjoint-author`. Author owns only this directory. ROOT
