## Authority and selected scope

The frozen selected target is unchanged `OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.main` at
`d1205fb493b3fbe04e55f72b76c6ff0761fb5a03`. This packet proves a necessary
original Section 5 bridge, not main and not the full coercivity or P estimate.
The authority for the bridge is selected original `05-angular-estimate.tex`,
labels `angular:T-definition` and `angular:Z-definition`, with the geometry
from `04-shrinking-balls.tex`, `balls:normalization`. Reference measure is
`dV_gamma d sigma`, each fiber being the actual probability sphere measure.
Source specifies a parallel fiber derivative with all tensor slots retained.

Ordinary ABR sphere Fischer, harmonic orthogonality and density interfaces
remain explicit parameters hF, hO, hD where used; no new analytic premise,
axiom, desired adjunction, coercivity, transport, or frame-divergence identity
is assumed. Human ratification of literature interfaces remains pending.
Alternate decomposition is authorized. Only positive degrees are selected:
input degree k=m+1 for m a natural number. This is the mean-zero sector used
by coercivity. Degree-zero raising, infinite angular sums, adjoint domains,
P errors and coercivity are outside this packet.

## Inventory of reusable checked statements

1. `HarmonicDerivativeOperator.harmonicDerivative hF k i` is the genuine
ambient derivative H_(k+1) -> H_k, descended from pderiv. Its independent
fiber adjoint is `harmonicDerivativeAdjoint hF k i`; it is proved to be the
continuous Hilbert adjoint. The polynomial formula is
(2k+3) [X_i p - |z|^2/(2k+1) pderiv_i p]. Normalization is probability sphere,
not bare Fischer multiplication. `inner_harmonicDerivativeAdjoint` proves
fiber adjunction. `HarmonicRaisingModel.sphereRaising_eq_sum_sphereDerivativeAdjoint`
identifies existing source raising polynomials in positive degree.

2. `CovariantHarmonicEnergy.referenceHarmonicCovariantDerivative` is the
actual derivative dU(X) plus the skew connection rotation
(1/2) sum_(a,b) omega_(ab)(X) R_(ab) U. Its image theorem
`polynomialSphereL2_referenceCovariantDerivative` identifies this with the
full reference covariant polynomial derivative in the actual Gram frame.
`HarmonicRaisingModel` already identifies true T and Tflat with polynomials.

3. `FischerDensityIntegration.compact_weighted_scalar_variable_adjoint`
proves integration by parts with div(rho X), retaining the density and
variable direction. Covariant Fischer compatibility is proved from the
actual skew metric frame connection.

4. `MetricFrameDivergence.reference_weightedCoordinateDivergence_gramFrame`
proves div(rho e_i) = rho sum_a omega_(a i)(e_a).
`ContractedFischerAdjunction.frame_connection_trace_cancellation` proves
sum_i div(e_i) P_i = -sum_(i,a) omega_(a i)(e_i) P_a.
Thus the divergence correction combines with the old covector slot.

5. `ScalarContractedAdjunction.compact_reference_contracted_weighted_covector_fischer_adjoint`
proves, for smooth finite scalar polynomial fields u and covector w_i,
compact support of u, any smooth f, real k,s, actual reference density rho,

  integral rho sum_i F(s nabla_(e_i) u + k f_i u, w_i)
  = integral rho sum_i F(u, -s nabla^(covector)_(e_i) w_i + k f_i w_i).

It explicitly retains density and all moving-frame terms; it is the main
full base adjunction ingredient, not a desired T adjunction premise.

6. `PolynomialSlotCompatibility.referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative_partial`
and its weighted extension prove
nabla^(covector)_(X)(pderiv_i v) = pderiv_i(nabla_X v), including
- sum_a omega_(a i)(X) pderiv_a v. No old slot is dropped.
`WeightedFiberSquare.referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative_harmonicHomogeneous_all`
allows the weight coefficient to differ from the polynomial degree.

7. `SpectralCoreRegularity.exists_smooth_compact_coordinates_sphereHarmonicCoordinate`
constructs smooth compact finite coefficients for every true harmonic
projection. For a given actual H_k field its projection equals itself by
`sphereHarmonicCoordinate_subtype`; no representation premise is added.
The new redundant HilbertHarmonicCoordinates probe was read as inventory
but will NOT be imported or duplicated, per ROOT direction.

## Exact objects and quantified statements

Fix arbitrary admissible smooth metric g, arbitrary real L,lam, smooth real
f:R3->R, actual Gram frame e_i(x)=referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i,
rho(x)=referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x), and m:N. Put k=m+1.
No smallness, profile concavity, beta lower bound, positivity L/lam or radius
parameter restriction is needed for this formal identity.

Existing T_k U = sum_i A_i^* (nabla_(e_i) U + k f_i U), for U in H_k.
Existing Tflat_(k+1) V = sum_i A_i (-nabla_(e_i) V + (k+1) f_i V).
Here f_i=d f(e_i), A_i:H_(k+1)->H_k and A_i^*:H_k->H_(k+1).

Construct the candidate full adjoint differential expression independently:

  Tdagger_(k+1) V := sum_i A_i (-nabla_(e_i) V + k f_i V).
  Z_(k+1) V := sum_i f_i A_i V.

Do NOT define Tdagger as Tflat-Z. The integrated theorem proves why the
constructed expression is the formal adjoint. The exact defect is then
proved as an equality of actual H_k vectors at each base point:

  Tflat_(k+1) V(x) - Tdagger_(k+1) V(x) = Z_(k+1) V(x).

The polynomial candidate corresponding to Tdagger is
sum_i pderiv_i[-nabla_(e_i) v + k f_i v], with v degree k+1.
A finite-polynomial theorem quantifies arbitrary finite index types,
fixed harmonic homogeneous b_j of degree k, d_a of degree k+1, smooth
coefficients c,z, compact support of c, smooth f, and actual g,L,lam:

  integral rho inner_sphere(T_k u,v)
  = integral rho inner_sphere(u,Tdagger_(k+1) v).

A finite representation bridge identifies the candidate polynomial adjoint
with the independently defined true harmonic operator.
The final actual-field theorem quantifies arbitrary smooth U:R3->H_k,
V:R3->H_(k+1), compact supports for both, smooth f, arbitrary admissible g,
L,lam,m,hF,hO,hD, and concludes

  integral rho inner(T_k U,V)
  = integral rho inner(U,Tdagger_(k+1) V).

Compact support of both is a domain choice exactly matching smooth compact
harmonic fields; it is not an added mathematical authority premise. The
finite intermediate theorem only needs compact support of U coefficients.
If needed, choose compact K=tsupport of the SphereL2 inclusion, so all
actual-field representation/support conditions are proved.

Also prove integrability of the actual pairing integrands (smooth compact
fields, f smooth) using finite polynomial coefficients and existing compact
Fischer pairing lemmas, or smoothness/compact-support preservation of the
true derivative/operator. This prevents a vacuous nonintegrable integral
from serving as a formal-adjoint assertion.

## Complete proof steps

A. Fiber adjunction first gives pointwise
inner(T_k u,v) = sum_i inner(D_i^+u,pderiv_i v).
The sphere star has the correct 2k+3 coefficient. Both inner factors on
this side have degree k. Rewrite hF k to Fischer inner / N_k, where
N_k=sphereNormalization 3 k. Finite sum division and base integration
commute; no scalar N_(k+1) is substituted incorrectly.

B. Apply the existing weighted scalar contracted covector adjunction with
w_i=pderiv_i v, weight coefficient k and sign +1. It retains div(rho e_i)
and the full covector derivative. The Gram trace/skew cancellation already
proved in that theorem turns the density derivative into the old slot.

C. Apply the weighted partial-slot compatibility to each i. Its result is
pderiv_i[-nabla_(e_i)v+k f_i v]. Each term has degree k. Sum, divide by
N_k, and use hF k to recover inner_sphere(u,Tdagger v). This proves the
finite integrated identity against the actual probability fibers.

D. Use polynomialSphereL2 image theorems for true covariant derivatives
and harmonicDerivative. The candidate has coefficient k on a degree k+1
input; prove its image directly by linearity (not using the existing
weighted image with incorrect degree). Thus the polynomial adjoint is the
true constructed Tdagger expression. Existing raising image identifies T.

E. For arbitrary smooth compact true harmonic U,V, include them into
SphereL2 using the continuous subtype maps. Apply the existing audited
finite-coordinate theorem to these inclusions; their own-degree projection
is themselves by sphereHarmonicCoordinate_subtype. Extract b,c and d,z;
use finite integrated identity and image equalities. No finite coefficient
representation remains in the final hypotheses.

F. Establish compact smooth pairing integrability explicitly. Existing
finite smooth coefficient and compact support facts plus reference density
provide integrability of every covariant derivative and weighted pair;
normalized Fischer division by N_k preserves integrability. Alternatively
prove the true operator continuous and compactly supported and apply the
same continuous compact support integral lemma.

G. Expand the independently defined Tflat and Tdagger. Linearity of Ai
and (k+1)-k=1 give sum_i fi Ai V, pointwise. This algebra uses the already
proved formal adjunction; no definition identifies flat and dagger.

## Correspondence and boundaries

Source `angular:T-definition` maps to existing HarmonicRaisingModel T,
Tflat, and the degree-specific harmonic fields. Source full dagger
(dV_gamma d sigma) maps to the finite integrated theorem and final true

The proof route uses checked scalar-contracted Fischer adjunction instead

# Complete upfront expansion: the degree-zero T / degree-one dagger endpoint

Saved before endpoint Lean authoring. Author detected the exact scope boundary
of EXPANSION-v001 and informed ROOT: its T input has degree m+1 and therefore
its dagger/defect input has degree m+2. The source mean-zero sector includes
H1. Its full dagger lands in H0, so omitting this case would not establish
`angular:Z-definition` on every positive source mode. ROOT explicitly directed
this separately expanded endpoint; earlier positive modules/snapshots remain
unchanged except the already requested proof-only redundant-simp deletion.

## Exact source and all objects

Use the same selected original Sections 04/05, actual gamma Gram frame e_i,
reference density rho, actual probability sphere Hilbert spaces H0 and H1.
The independently already constructed A_i:H1->H0 and A_i^*:H0->H1 use
`harmonicDerivative hF 0 i` and `harmonicDerivativeAdjoint hF 0 i`.
The sphere formula is coefficient 3 times X_i times a constant, and its true
fiber adjunction at degree zero is already proved. There is no division by
2k-1 and no positive-degree-only raising formula at this endpoint.

For every arbitrary admissible g, real L,lam, U:R3->H0 and V:R3->H1, define

  T0 U(x) = sum_i A_i^* nabla_(e_i) U(x).
  Tdagger1 V(x) = sum_i A_i (-nabla_(e_i) V(x)).
  Z1 V(x) = sum_i f_i(x) A_i V(x).

These are actual fields using the existing full covariant harmonic derivative.
The source B vanishes on H0, so T0 has no f term. Source Tflat on H1 is the

## Chosen statements and full derivation, fixed before Lean authoring

Universally quantify hF, hO, hD as above, i in Fin 3, all natural degrees, all
u,v in actual SphereL2, and all real s in the following mathematical assertions.
Lean authoring is staged; a partial checked subset must be reported as such.

1. For every m>=0 and q in H(m+1),
   sum_i ||dm,i q||^2=(m+1)(3+2m)||q||^2. Choose a genuine harmonic homogeneous
   polynomial p of degree m+1 representing q. The descent application theorem
   identifies dm,i q with polynomialSphereL2(pderiv i p). The Fischer Euler identity
   gives sum_i Fischer(pderiv_i p,pderiv_i p)=(m+1)Fischer(p,p).
   Divide by Nm and use N(m+1)=(3+2m)Nm; Nm>0. The result applies at m=0 as
   well, where linear harmonics differentiate to constants. Hence each squared
   derivative norm is <=4(m+1)^2||q||^2, and ||dm,i q||<=2(m+1)||q||.
   The nonnegative square-root argument yields ||dm,i||<=2(m+1).
   Isometry of the Hilbert adjoint gives ||rm,i||<=2(m+1), hence
   ||rm,i q||<=2(m+1)||q|| for q in Hm. This is a proved uniform first-order
   bound, not finite-dimensional continuity treated as a uniform estimate.

2. Define the maximal all-degree derivative graph GD,i by
   (u,v) in GD,i iff for every m>=0, vm=dm,i u(m+1).
   Define the maximal all-degree raising graph GR,i by
   (u,v) in GR,i iff v0=0 and for every m>=0, v(m+1)=rm,i um.
   These are linear submodules of SphereL2 x SphereL2. All coordinate maps and
   fixed-degree operators are continuous, so the graphs are intersections of
   closed equalizers and are closed. Completeness of coordinates proves output
   uniqueness. GD ignores the constant input but retains constant output; GR
   annihilates only its output-zero coordinate, not the constant input.

3. Their exact domains are not assumed mapping properties:
   u in Dom(GD,i) iff sum_m ||dm,i u(m+1)||^2 is finite;
   u in Dom(GR,i) iff sum_m ||rm,i um||^2 is finite.
   In each direction use Mem-lp iff squared norms summable and reconstruct the
   actual sphere output by E.symm; raising has zero coordinate 0. Conversely
   Parseval for the graph output gives the summability. These definitions are
   maximal coordinate realizations of the genuine operators.

4. With Hs={u: sum_k ws(k)^2||uk||^2 finite}, exact ws is the existing Bessel
   graph domain. For all s, adjacent weights satisfy
   ws(m)<=2^|s| ws(m+1), ws(m+1)<=2^|s| ws(m).
   For s>=0 use base monotonicity and m+2<=2(m+1); for s<0 use inverses of
   the same bounds for -s. Also w(s+1)(k)=ws(k)(k+1).
   Therefore
   ws(m)||dm,i u(m+1)||<=2*2^|s| w(s+1)(m+1)||u(m+1)||,
   ws(m+1)||rm,i um||<=2*2^|s| w(s+1)(m)||um||.
   Square, dominate by the summable input budget and use shifted summability;
   output belongs to Hs and each squared Hs norm is <=4*2^(2|s|) times the
   squared H(s+1) norm. On the natural first-order common domain H1 these give
   actual GD/GR outputs (s=0). On the common spectral smooth domain
   Hinf=intersection_{n in Nat} Hn, both operators preserve every Hn with one
   additional input order. This core is defined by exact harmonic decay, not by
   an arbitrary desired derivative-mapping hypothesis. Equivalence of Hinf with
   source C-infinity sphere functions remains a separate open step.

5. Let Pn be the existing sum of degrees 0,...,n-1. If (u,v) in GD then
   (P(n+1)u,Pn v) in GD. If (u,v) in GR then
   (Pn u,P(n+1)v) in GR. This follows coordinate by coordinate; check the boundary
   m=n explicitly. Both pairs converge in SphereL2 x SphereL2. They have finite
   harmonic support, so the finite harmonic graph is a core for each maximal

6. All-degree adjunction: if (u,Du) in GD and (v,Rv) in GR then

# Upfront domain correction before weighted Lean

This addendum corrects item 4 of expanded-v001.md, which remains preserved as
history. ROOT identified the issue while reading that author proposal, before
weighted Lean was authored. This is not an independent review verdict.

The neighbor-weight inequalities and pointwise weighted coefficient inequalities
are valid for all real s. However, Hs was defined there inside SphereL2. For
s<0 the weighted square sum can be finite without the unweighted output square
sum being finite; one cannot reconstruct a SphereL2 derivative merely from
u in H(s+1). In particular s<=-1 permits all L2 inputs, whose derivatives need
not belong to L2. The original all-real existence conclusion was therefore an
author-proposal gap, and is withdrawn.

Correct chosen theorem: for every real s>=0, every u in the exact SphereL2
Bessel domain H(s+1) has a unique maximal derivative graph output and a unique
maximal raising graph output, each in the exact Hs domain, with the stated uniform
weighted coefficient/norm bounds. The unweighted output is summable because
ws(k)>=1 for s>=0. On a pre-existing maximal graph pair the all-real coefficient
bound remains valid, but a completed negative Sobolev space is outside this unit.

The common domain Hinf=intersection over n in Nat of Hn and finite harmonic core
use only nonnegative orders, so this correction leaves their intended construction
unchanged. Equivalence with source intrinsic C-infinity and base smooth weighted
density remain explicitly open. No source counterexample or target modification
is inferred from the correction.

For actual real scalar coefficients c_i,d_i at a fixed base point, sum_i c_i C_i + sum_i d_i C_i* is a genuine bounded CLM, with norm at most 4 sum_i |c_i| + 2 sum_i |d_i|. On genuine smooth/core graph outputs this finite combination is precisely the balanced corresponding angular combination. This allows actual Gram-frame coefficients once the concrete smooth frame construction supplies those scalar values. It proves no pseudodifferential symbol class or trace-remainder estimate.

For scalar symmetric a^(ij)=r Q^(ij), let S=s^k partial_k be a scalar first-base differential part (s^k may be a fixed angular CLM coefficient commuting with a). The second-base coefficient in [S,a^(ij)partial_i partial_j] is s^k partial_k a^(ij) - a^(kj)partial_k s^i - a^(ik)partial_k s^j. After contracting against the symmetric second derivative and relabeling dummy indices, this is s^k partial_k a^(ij) - 2 a^(ij) partial_i s^k with the derivative indices relabeled consistently. The cubic-base terms cancel solely because a is a base scalar commuting with the angular coefficient; no derivative of Q is introduced in the definition of P. Product differentiation gives partial_k a^(ij)=(partial_k r)Q^(ij)+r partial_k Q^(ij). For r=exp f this becomes r[(partial_k f)Q^(ij)+partial_k Q^(ij)]. A future adapter must supply the actual source s, the actual normalized Q, their frame/connection derivative coefficients and beta/radius bounds before concluding epsilon beta^(-1) times a uniformly bounded balanced coefficient. The present universal angular maps are sufficient components for that adapter, but generic coefficients do not establish the source Psi^1 coefficient.

## Calderon.ReferenceRaisingAdjunction

SHA256 `d519b4453cfb9864ccc03f424fb5b6740fc754ddc0ddd46bbbd2820caf97284d`.

``````lean
import Calderon.HarmonicRaisingModel
import Calderon.ScalarContractedAdjunction
import Calderon.WeightedFiberSquare
import Calderon.SpectralCoreRegularity
import Mathlib.Tactic.Module

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 10
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory MvPolynomial
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.ReferenceRaisingAdjunction
open SphereHarmonic SphereHilbertDecomposition SpectralCoreRegularity
  SmoothSphereRotationProjection SphereDerivativeAdjoint HarmonicDerivativeOperator
  CovariantHarmonicEnergy HarmonicRaisingModel FischerConnectionTransport
  WeightedFischerSquare WeightedFiberSquare FiniteRaisingEnergy
  ScalarContractedAdjunction ContractedFischerAdjunction PolynomialSlotCompatibility
  WeightedIndexedCurvature MovingFrameConnection SmoothMetricFrame
  ReferenceDensityBounds AngularPolynomial FischerDensityIntegration
  FischerCovectorAdjunction BaseDensityAdjoint

variable {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]

/-- The independently constructed adjoint expression has the lower degree's weight. -/
def referenceAdjointHarmonicInput (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (V : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace ((m+1)+1)) (f : R3 → ℝ) (x X : R3) :
    harmonicSphereSubspace ((m+1)+1) :=
  (-1 : ℝ) • referenceHarmonicCovariantDerivative g L lam ((m+1)+1) V x X +
    (((m+1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * fderiv ℝ f x X) • V x

/-- Candidate full base/fiber adjoint; the integral identity below proves the name. -/
def referenceHarmonicRaisingAdjoint (hF : SphereFischerInner) (g : MatrixField)
    (L lam : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (V : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace ((m+1)+1))
    (f : R3 → ℝ) (x : R3) : harmonicSphereSubspace (m+1) :=
  ∑ i : Fin 3, harmonicDerivative hF (m+1) i
    (referenceAdjointHarmonicInput g L lam m V f x
      (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i))

def referenceHarmonicRaisingDefect (hF : SphereFischerInner) (g : MatrixField)
    (L lam : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (V : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace ((m+1)+1))
    (f : R3 → ℝ) (x : R3) : harmonicSphereSubspace (m+1) :=
  ∑ i : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ f x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) •
    harmonicDerivative hF (m+1) i (V x)

def referenceAdjointPolynomialField (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ)
    (d : κ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (z : R3 → κ → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (m : ℕ) (x : R3) : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ :=
  ∑ i : Fin 3, pderiv i (referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative g L lam d z f
    (m+1) (-1) x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i))

lemma polynomialSphereL2_harmonicDerivative (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (k : ℕ) (i : Fin 3) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hp : p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (k+1)) (v : harmonicSphereSubspace (k+1))
    (hrep : polynomialSphereL2 p = (v : SphereL2)) :
    polynomialSphereL2 (pderiv i p) = (harmonicDerivative hF k i v : SphereL2) := by
  have hv : harmonicPolynomialSphereMap (k+1) ⟨p,hp⟩ = v := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hrep
  rw [← hv,harmonicDerivative_apply_image]
  rfl

lemma polynomialSphereL2_referenceAdjointInput (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (d : κ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ j, d j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous ((m+1)+1))
    (z : R3 → κ → ℝ) (V : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace ((m+1)+1))
    (hz : ContDiff ℝ ∞ z) (hV : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V)
    (hrep : ∀ x, polynomialSphereL2 (finitePolynomialField d z x) = (V x : SphereL2))
    (f : R3 → ℝ) (x X : R3) :
    polynomialSphereL2 (referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative g L lam d z f
      (m+1) (-1) x X) = (referenceAdjointHarmonicInput g L lam m V f x X : SphereL2) := by
  simp only [referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative,referenceAdjointHarmonicInput,
    ← smul_eq_C_mul,map_add,map_smul,
    polynomialSphereL2_referenceCovariantDerivative g hg L lam ((m+1)+1) d hd z V hz hV hrep,
    hrep,Submodule.coe_add,Submodule.coe_smul,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one]

theorem polynomialSphereL2_referenceAdjointField (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (d : κ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ j, d j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous ((m+1)+1))
    (z : R3 → κ → ℝ) (V : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace ((m+1)+1))
    (hz : ContDiff ℝ ∞ z) (hV : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V)
    (hrep : ∀ x, polynomialSphereL2 (finitePolynomialField d z x) = (V x : SphereL2))
    (f : R3 → ℝ) (x : R3) :
    polynomialSphereL2 (referenceAdjointPolynomialField g L lam d z f m x) =
      (referenceHarmonicRaisingAdjoint hF g L lam m V f x : SphereL2) := by
  simp only [referenceAdjointPolynomialField,referenceHarmonicRaisingAdjoint,
    map_sum,Submodule.coe_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  exact polynomialSphereL2_harmonicDerivative hF (m+1) i _
    (referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative_harmonicHomogeneous_all g hg L lam ((m+1)+1)
      d hd z f (m+1) (-1) x _) _
    (polynomialSphereL2_referenceAdjointInput g hg L lam m d hd z V hz hV hrep f x _)

/-- Full reference-volume adjunction on finite actual harmonic polynomial fields.
The base lemma retains the density, moving frame, and the pderiv covector slot. -/
theorem compact_reference_raising_polynomial_adjoint (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (d : κ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ j, b j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (m+1))
    (hd : ∀ j, d j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous ((m+1)+1))
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (z : R3 → κ → ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hz : ContDiff ℝ ∞ z) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c) :
    (∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      ⟪polynomialSphereL2 (referenceRaisedPolynomialField g L lam b c f m x),
        polynomialSphereL2 (finitePolynomialField d z x)⟫_ℝ) =
    (∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      ⟪polynomialSphereL2 (finitePolynomialField b c x),
        polynomialSphereL2 (referenceAdjointPolynomialField g L lam d z f m x)⟫_ℝ) := by
  let e := fun x => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x)
  let a := fun x i => referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c f (m+1) 1 x (e x i)
  let q := fun x i => referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative g L lam d z f (m+1) (-1) x (e x i)
  let N := sphereNormalization 3 (m+1)
  have ha (x : R3) (i : Fin 3) : a x i ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (m+1) :=
    referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative_harmonicHomogeneous_all g hg L lam (m+1)
      b hb c f (m+1) 1 x (e x i)
  have hv (x : R3) : finitePolynomialField d z x ∈ harmonicHomogeneous ((m+1)+1) :=
    finitePolynomialField_harmonicHomogeneous _ d hd z x
  have hq (x : R3) (i : Fin 3) : q x i ∈ harmonicHomogeneous ((m+1)+1) :=
    referenceWeightedPolynomialDerivative_harmonicHomogeneous_all g hg L lam ((m+1)+1)
      d hd z f (m+1) (-1) x (e x i)
  have hleft (x : R3) :
      ⟪polynomialSphereL2 (referenceRaisedPolynomialField g L lam b c f m x),
        polynomialSphereL2 (finitePolynomialField d z x)⟫_ℝ =
      (∑ i : Fin 3, fischerInner (a x i)
        (finitePolynomialField (fun j => pderiv i (d j)) z x)) / N := by
    change ⟪polynomialSphereL2 (sphereRaising m (a x)),
      polynomialSphereL2 (finitePolynomialField d z x)⟫_ℝ = _
    rw [sphereRaising_eq_sum_sphereDerivativeAdjoint,map_sum,sum_inner]
    calc
      _ = ∑ i : Fin 3, normalizedFischerInner (m+1) (a x i)
          (pderiv i (finitePolynomialField d z x)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        rw [sphereDerivativeAdjoint_inner_adjoint hF (m+1) i _ _ (ha x i) (hv x)]
        exact hF (m+1) _ _ (ha x i)
          (pderiv_harmonicHomogeneous_succ (m+1) i _ (hv x))
      _ = _ := by
        simp only [normalizedFischerInner,Fintype.card_fin,N,
          finitePolynomialField_partial,Finset.sum_div]
  have hright (x : R3) :
      ⟪polynomialSphereL2 (finitePolynomialField b c x),
        polynomialSphereL2 (referenceAdjointPolynomialField g L lam d z f m x)⟫_ℝ =
      (∑ i : Fin 3, fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x)
        (referenceWeightedCovectorPolynomialDerivative g L lam
          (fun j i => pderiv i (d j)) z f (m+1) (-1) x (e x i) i)) / N := by
    change ⟪polynomialSphereL2 (finitePolynomialField b c x),
      polynomialSphereL2 (∑ i : Fin 3, pderiv i (q x i))⟫_ℝ = _
    rw [map_sum,inner_sum]
    calc
      _ = ∑ i : Fin 3, normalizedFischerInner (m+1)
          (finitePolynomialField b c x) (pderiv i (q x i)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        exact hF (m+1) _ _ (finitePolynomialField_harmonicHomogeneous _ b hb c x)
          (pderiv_harmonicHomogeneous_succ (m+1) i _ (hq x i))
      _ = _ := by
        simp only [normalizedFischerInner,Fintype.card_fin,N,q,
          referenceWeightedCovectorPolynomialDerivative_partial,Finset.sum_div]
  have hbase := compact_reference_contracted_weighted_covector_fischer_adjoint g hg L lam
    b (fun j i => pderiv i (d j)) c z f (m+1) 1 hc hz hf hcompact
  have hscaled := congrArg (fun t : ℝ => t / N) hbase
  simp_rw [hleft,hright,← mul_div_assoc]
  rw [integral_div,integral_div]
  exact hscaled

/-- Exact degree-shift defect; flat and dagger are distinct differential expressions. -/
theorem referenceHarmonicLowering_sub_adjoint (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (V : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace ((m+1)+1)) (f : R3 → ℝ) (x : R3) :
    referenceHarmonicLowering hF g L lam (m+1) V f x -
      referenceHarmonicRaisingAdjoint hF g L lam m V f x =
      referenceHarmonicRaisingDefect hF g L lam m V f x := by
  unfold referenceHarmonicLowering referenceHarmonicRaisingAdjoint referenceHarmonicRaisingDefect
  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  simp only [referenceWeightedHarmonicDerivative,referenceAdjointHarmonicInput,
    map_add,map_smul,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one]
  module

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.ReferenceRaisingAdjunction
``````

``````lean
import Calderon.ReferenceRaisingAdjunction

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 10
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory MvPolynomial
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.ReferenceHarmonicRaisingAdjunction
open SphereHarmonic SphereHilbertDecomposition SpectralCoreRegularity
  SmoothSphereRotationProjection HarmonicDerivativeOperator CovariantHarmonicEnergy
  HarmonicRaisingModel ReferenceRaisingAdjunction MovingFrameConnection
  SmoothMetricFrame ReferenceDensityBounds FischerCovectorAdjunction

/-- Smoothness of the genuine connection on a variable smooth base direction. -/
lemma contDiff_referenceHarmonicCovariantDerivative (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (k : ℕ)
    (U : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace k) (X : R3 → R3)
    (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => referenceHarmonicCovariantDerivative g L lam k U x (X x)) := by
  unfold referenceHarmonicCovariantDerivative
  apply ContDiff.add
  · exact (hU.fderiv_right (m := ∞) (by simp)).clm_apply hX
  · apply ContDiff.smul
      (contDiff_const : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun _ : R3 => (1/2 : ℝ)))
    apply ContDiff.sum
    intro a _
    apply ContDiff.sum
    intro b _
    exact (contDiff_referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient_variable g hg L lam X hX a b).smul
      ((harmonicSphereRotation k a b).contDiff.comp hU)

lemma contDiff_referenceHarmonicWeightedExpression (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (k : ℕ)
    (U : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace k) (X : R3 → R3) (f : R3 → ℝ) (w s : ℝ)
    (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => s • referenceHarmonicCovariantDerivative g L lam k U x (X x) +
      (w * fderiv ℝ f x (X x)) • U x) := by
  exact ((contDiff_const : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun _ : R3 => s)).smul
      (contDiff_referenceHarmonicCovariantDerivative g hg L lam k U X hU hX)).add
    (((contDiff_const : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun _ : R3 => w)).mul
      ((hf.fderiv_right (m := ∞) (by simp)).clm_apply hX)).smul hU)

lemma referenceHarmonicCovariantDerivative_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport
    (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (U : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace k)
    (x X : R3) (hx : x ∉ tsupport U) :
    referenceHarmonicCovariantDerivative g L lam k U x X = 0 := by
  simp only [referenceHarmonicCovariantDerivative,
    fderiv_of_notMem_tsupport (𝕜 := ℝ) hx,image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hx,
    ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply,map_zero,smul_zero,Finset.sum_const_zero,add_zero]

lemma referenceHarmonicWeightedExpression_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport
    (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ) (k : ℕ) (U : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace k)
    (f : R3 → ℝ) (w s : ℝ) (x X : R3) (hx : x ∉ tsupport U) :
    s • referenceHarmonicCovariantDerivative g L lam k U x X +
      (w * fderiv ℝ f x X) • U x = 0 := by
  rw [referenceHarmonicCovariantDerivative_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport g L lam k U x X hx,
    image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hx]
  simp

theorem contDiff_referenceHarmonicRaising (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (U : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace (m+1)) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (referenceHarmonicRaising hF g L lam m U f) := by
  unfold referenceHarmonicRaising
  apply ContDiff.sum
  intro i _
  apply (harmonicDerivativeAdjoint hF (m+1) i).contDiff.comp
  exact contDiff_referenceHarmonicWeightedExpression g hg L lam (m+1) U _ f ((m+1 : ℕ) : ℝ) 1
    hU (contDiff_referenceMetricGramFrame_slice g hg L lam i) hf

theorem contDiff_referenceHarmonicRaisingAdjoint (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (V : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace ((m+1)+1)) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (hV : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (referenceHarmonicRaisingAdjoint hF g L lam m V f) := by
  unfold referenceHarmonicRaisingAdjoint
  apply ContDiff.sum
  intro i _
  apply (harmonicDerivative hF (m+1) i).contDiff.comp
  exact contDiff_referenceHarmonicWeightedExpression g hg L lam ((m+1)+1) V _ f
    ((m+1 : ℕ) : ℝ) (-1) hV (contDiff_referenceMetricGramFrame_slice g hg L lam i) hf

theorem hasCompactSupport_referenceHarmonicRaising (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (U : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace (m+1)) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (hcompact : HasCompactSupport U) :
    HasCompactSupport (referenceHarmonicRaising hF g L lam m U f) := by
  apply hcompact.mono'
  intro x hx
  by_contra hnot
  simp only [Function.mem_support] at hx
  apply hx
  unfold referenceHarmonicRaising referenceWeightedHarmonicDerivative
  simp only [referenceHarmonicWeightedExpression_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport
      g L lam (m+1) U f ((m+1 : ℕ) : ℝ) 1 x _ hnot,map_zero,Finset.sum_const_zero]

theorem hasCompactSupport_referenceHarmonicRaisingAdjoint (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (V : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace ((m+1)+1)) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (hcompact : HasCompactSupport V) :
    HasCompactSupport (referenceHarmonicRaisingAdjoint hF g L lam m V f) := by
  apply hcompact.mono'
  intro x hx
  by_contra hnot
  simp only [Function.mem_support] at hx
  apply hx
  unfold referenceHarmonicRaisingAdjoint referenceAdjointHarmonicInput
  simp only [referenceHarmonicWeightedExpression_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport
      g L lam ((m+1)+1) V f ((m+1 : ℕ) : ℝ) (-1) x _ hnot,map_zero,Finset.sum_const_zero]

lemma hasCompactSupport_real_inner_left {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] (U V : R3 → E) (hcompact : HasCompactSupport U) :
    HasCompactSupport (fun x => ⟪U x,V x⟫_ℝ) := by
  apply hcompact.mono
  intro x hx
  simp only [Function.mem_support] at hx ⊢
  contrapose! hx
  simp [hx]

/-- The two full pairing integrands are ordinary integrable functions. -/
theorem integrable_referenceHarmonicRaising_pairings (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (U : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace (m+1))
    (V : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace ((m+1)+1)) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U) (hV : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hcompact : HasCompactSupport U) :
    Integrable (fun x => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      ⟪referenceHarmonicRaising hF g L lam m U f x,V x⟫_ℝ) ∧
    Integrable (fun x => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      ⟪U x,referenceHarmonicRaisingAdjoint hF g L lam m V f x⟫_ℝ) := by
  have hr : Continuous (fun x : R3 => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)) :=
    ((contDiff_referenceDensityFamily g hg L).comp
      ((contDiff_const : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun _ : R3 => lam)).prodMk
        (contDiff_id : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : R3 => x)))).continuous
  have hT := contDiff_referenceHarmonicRaising hF g hg L lam m U f hU hf
  have hA := contDiff_referenceHarmonicRaisingAdjoint hF g hg L lam m V f hV hf
  exact ⟨(hr.mul (hT.continuous.inner hV.continuous)).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
      (hasCompactSupport_real_inner_left _ _
        (hasCompactSupport_referenceHarmonicRaising hF g L lam m U f hcompact)).mul_left,
    (hr.mul (hU.continuous.inner hA.continuous)).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
      (hasCompactSupport_real_inner_left _ _ hcompact).mul_left⟩

/-- Genuine full reference-volume/probability-sphere formal adjunction on all
smooth compact actual harmonic fields in two adjacent positive degrees.
Finite representations are constructed in the proof, not hypotheses. -/
theorem compact_referenceHarmonicRaising_adjoint
    (hF : SphereFischerInner) (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (U : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace (m+1))
    (V : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace ((m+1)+1)) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U) (hV : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hcompactU : HasCompactSupport U) (hcompactV : HasCompactSupport V) :
    (∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      ⟪referenceHarmonicRaising hF g L lam m U f x,V x⟫_ℝ) =
    (∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      ⟪U x,referenceHarmonicRaisingAdjoint hF g L lam m V f x⟫_ℝ) := by
  have hUi : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => (U x : SphereL2)) :=
    (harmonicSphereSubspace (m+1)).subtypeL.contDiff.comp hU
  have hVi : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => (V x : SphereL2)) :=
    (harmonicSphereSubspace ((m+1)+1)).subtypeL.contDiff.comp hV
  obtain ⟨n,b,c,hb,hc,hcompactc,hrepc,_⟩ :=
    exists_smooth_compact_coordinates_sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (m+1)
      (fun x => (U x : SphereL2)) hUi (tsupport U) hcompactU
      (fun x hx => by rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hx]; rfl)
  obtain ⟨n',d,z,hd,hz,hcompactz,hrepz,_⟩ :=
    exists_smooth_compact_coordinates_sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD ((m+1)+1)
      (fun x => (V x : SphereL2)) hVi (tsupport V) hcompactV
      (fun x hx => by rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hx]; rfl)
  have hrepU (x : R3) : polynomialSphereL2 (FischerConnectionTransport.finitePolynomialField b c x) =
      (U x : SphereL2) := by
    simpa only [sphereHarmonicCoordinate_subtype] using hrepc x
  have hrepV (x : R3) : polynomialSphereL2 (FischerConnectionTransport.finitePolynomialField d z x) =
      (V x : SphereL2) := by
    simpa only [sphereHarmonicCoordinate_subtype] using hrepz x
  have h := compact_reference_raising_polynomial_adjoint hF g hg L lam m b d hb hd c z f
    hc hz hf hcompactc
  simp_rw [polynomialSphereL2_referenceRaisedField hF g hg L lam m b hb c U hc hU hrepU,
    polynomialSphereL2_referenceAdjointField hF g hg L lam m d hd z V hz hV hrepV,
    hrepU,hrepV] at h
  exact h

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.ReferenceHarmonicRaisingAdjunction
``````

``````lean
import Calderon.ReferenceHarmonicRaisingAdjunction

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 10
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory MvPolynomial
open scoped ContDiff InnerProductSpace Topology
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.ReferenceRaisingAdjunctionEndpoint
open SphereHarmonic SphereHilbertDecomposition SpectralCoreRegularity
  HarmonicDerivativeOperator CovariantHarmonicEnergy HarmonicRaisingModel
  ReferenceRaisingAdjunction ReferenceHarmonicRaisingAdjunction
  FischerConnectionTransport ScalarContractedAdjunction PolynomialSlotCompatibility
  AllDegreeCovectorTransport MovingFrameConnection SmoothMetricFrame
  ReferenceDensityBounds AngularPolynomial

/-- Source T on the constant angular degree; B acts as zero. -/
def referenceHarmonicConstantRaising (hF : SphereFischerInner) (g : MatrixField)
    (L lam : ℝ) (U : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace 0) (x : R3) : harmonicSphereSubspace 1 :=
  ∑ i : Fin 3, harmonicDerivativeAdjoint hF 0 i
    (referenceHarmonicCovariantDerivative g L lam 0 U x
      (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i))

/-- The independent full-adjoint expression on H1 takes values in H0. -/
def referenceHarmonicDegreeOneRaisingAdjoint (hF : SphereFischerInner) (g : MatrixField)
    (L lam : ℝ) (V : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace 1) (x : R3) : harmonicSphereSubspace 0 :=
  ∑ i : Fin 3, harmonicDerivative hF 0 i
    (-referenceHarmonicCovariantDerivative g L lam 1 V x
      (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i))

def referenceHarmonicDegreeOneRaisingDefect (hF : SphereFischerInner) (g : MatrixField)
    (L lam : ℝ) (V : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace 1) (f : R3 → ℝ) (x : R3) :
    harmonicSphereSubspace 0 :=
  ∑ i : Fin 3, fderiv ℝ f x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) •
    harmonicDerivative hF 0 i (V x)

variable {ι κ : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Fintype κ]

/-- Intermediate representations are discharged in the actual-field theorem below. -/
theorem compact_referenceHarmonicConstantRaising_adjoint_of_representation
    (hF : SphereFischerInner) (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (b : ι → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (d : κ → MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ)
    (hb : ∀ j, b j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous 0) (hd : ∀ j, d j ∈ harmonicHomogeneous 1)
    (c : R3 → ι → ℝ) (z : R3 → κ → ℝ)
    (U : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace 0) (V : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace 1)
    (hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ c) (hz : ContDiff ℝ ∞ z)
    (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U) (hV : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V) (hcompact : HasCompactSupport c)
    (hrepU : ∀ x, polynomialSphereL2 (finitePolynomialField b c x) = (U x : SphereL2))
    (hrepV : ∀ x, polynomialSphereL2 (finitePolynomialField d z x) = (V x : SphereL2)) :
    (∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      ⟪referenceHarmonicConstantRaising hF g L lam U x,V x⟫_ℝ) =
    (∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      ⟪U x,referenceHarmonicDegreeOneRaisingAdjoint hF g L lam V x⟫_ℝ) := by
  let e := fun x => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x)
  have hleft (x : R3) :
      ⟪referenceHarmonicConstantRaising hF g L lam U x,V x⟫_ℝ =
      ∑ i : Fin 3, fischerInner
        (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam b c x (e x i))
        (finitePolynomialField (fun j => pderiv i (d j)) z x) := by
    unfold referenceHarmonicConstantRaising
    rw [sum_inner]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [inner_harmonicDerivativeAdjoint]
    change ⟪(referenceHarmonicCovariantDerivative g L lam 0 U x (e x i) : SphereL2),
      (harmonicDerivative hF 0 i (V x) : SphereL2)⟫_ℝ = _
    rw [← polynomialSphereL2_referenceCovariantDerivative g hg L lam 0 b hb c U hc hU hrepU,
      ← polynomialSphereL2_harmonicDerivative hF 0 i _
        (finitePolynomialField_harmonicHomogeneous 1 d hd z x) (V x) (hrepV x)]
    rw [hF 0 _ _
      (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_harmonicHomogeneous_all g hg L lam 0 b hb c x _)
      (pderiv_harmonicHomogeneous_succ 0 i _
        (finitePolynomialField_harmonicHomogeneous 1 d hd z x))]
    simp only [normalizedFischerInner,sphereNormalization_zero,div_one,finitePolynomialField_partial]
  have hright (x : R3) :
      ⟪U x,referenceHarmonicDegreeOneRaisingAdjoint hF g L lam V x⟫_ℝ =
      -(∑ i : Fin 3, fischerInner (finitePolynomialField b c x)
        (pderiv i (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative g L lam d z x (e x i)))) := by
    unfold referenceHarmonicDegreeOneRaisingAdjoint
    rw [inner_sum,← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i _
    rw [map_neg,inner_neg_right]
    change -⟪(U x : SphereL2),(harmonicDerivative hF 0 i
      (referenceHarmonicCovariantDerivative g L lam 1 V x (e x i)) : SphereL2)⟫_ℝ = _
    rw [← hrepU x,← polynomialSphereL2_harmonicDerivative hF 0 i _
      (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_harmonicHomogeneous_all g hg L lam 1 d hd z x _)
      _ (polynomialSphereL2_referenceCovariantDerivative g hg L lam 1 d hd z V hz hV hrepV x _)]
    rw [hF 0 _ _ (finitePolynomialField_harmonicHomogeneous 0 b hb c x)
      (pderiv_harmonicHomogeneous_succ 0 i _
        (referenceCovariantPolynomialDerivative_harmonicHomogeneous_all g hg L lam 1 d hd z x _))]
    simp only [normalizedFischerInner,sphereNormalization_zero,div_one]
  have hbase := compact_reference_contracted_covector_fischer_adjoint g hg L lam
    b (fun j i => pderiv i (d j)) c z hc hz hcompact
  simp_rw [referenceCovectorPolynomialDerivative_partial] at hbase
  simp_rw [hleft,hright,mul_neg]
  rw [integral_neg]
  exact hbase

theorem contDiff_referenceHarmonicConstantRaising (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (U : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace 0) (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (referenceHarmonicConstantRaising hF g L lam U) := by
  unfold referenceHarmonicConstantRaising
  apply ContDiff.sum
  intro i _
  exact (harmonicDerivativeAdjoint hF 0 i).contDiff.comp
    (contDiff_referenceHarmonicCovariantDerivative g hg L lam 0 U _ hU
      (contDiff_referenceMetricGramFrame_slice g hg L lam i))

theorem contDiff_referenceHarmonicDegreeOneRaisingAdjoint (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (V : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace 1) (hV : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (referenceHarmonicDegreeOneRaisingAdjoint hF g L lam V) := by
  unfold referenceHarmonicDegreeOneRaisingAdjoint
  apply ContDiff.sum
  intro i _
  exact (harmonicDerivative hF 0 i).contDiff.comp
    (contDiff_referenceHarmonicCovariantDerivative g hg L lam 1 V _ hV
      (contDiff_referenceMetricGramFrame_slice g hg L lam i)).neg

theorem hasCompactSupport_referenceHarmonicConstantRaising (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ) (U : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace 0)
    (hcompact : HasCompactSupport U) :
    HasCompactSupport (referenceHarmonicConstantRaising hF g L lam U) := by
  apply hcompact.mono'
  intro x hx
  by_contra hnot
  simp only [Function.mem_support] at hx
  apply hx
  unfold referenceHarmonicConstantRaising
  simp only [referenceHarmonicCovariantDerivative_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport
    g L lam 0 U x _ hnot,map_zero,Finset.sum_const_zero]

theorem hasCompactSupport_referenceHarmonicDegreeOneRaisingAdjoint (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ) (V : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace 1)
    (hcompact : HasCompactSupport V) :
    HasCompactSupport (referenceHarmonicDegreeOneRaisingAdjoint hF g L lam V) := by
  apply hcompact.mono'
  intro x hx
  by_contra hnot
  simp only [Function.mem_support] at hx
  apply hx
  unfold referenceHarmonicDegreeOneRaisingAdjoint
  simp only [referenceHarmonicCovariantDerivative_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport
    g L lam 1 V x _ hnot,neg_zero,map_zero,Finset.sum_const_zero]

theorem integrable_referenceHarmonicConstantRaising_pairings (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (U : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace 0) (V : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace 1)
    (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U) (hV : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V) (hcompact : HasCompactSupport U) :
    Integrable (fun x => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      ⟪referenceHarmonicConstantRaising hF g L lam U x,V x⟫_ℝ) ∧
    Integrable (fun x => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      ⟪U x,referenceHarmonicDegreeOneRaisingAdjoint hF g L lam V x⟫_ℝ) := by
  have hr : Continuous (fun x : R3 => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x)) :=
    ((contDiff_referenceDensityFamily g hg L).comp
      ((contDiff_const : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun _ : R3 => lam)).prodMk
        (contDiff_id : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : R3 => x)))).continuous
  have hT := contDiff_referenceHarmonicConstantRaising hF g hg L lam U hU
  have hA := contDiff_referenceHarmonicDegreeOneRaisingAdjoint hF g hg L lam V hV
  exact ⟨(hr.mul (hT.continuous.inner hV.continuous)).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
      (hasCompactSupport_real_inner_left _ _
        (hasCompactSupport_referenceHarmonicConstantRaising hF g L lam U hcompact)).mul_left,
    (hr.mul (hU.continuous.inner hA.continuous)).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
      (hasCompactSupport_real_inner_left _ _ hcompact).mul_left⟩

/-- Full reference-volume endpoint adjunction, with no representation hypotheses. -/
theorem compact_referenceHarmonicConstantRaising_adjoint
    (hF : SphereFischerInner) (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (U : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace 0) (V : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace 1)
    (hU : ContDiff ℝ ∞ U) (hV : ContDiff ℝ ∞ V)
    (hcompactU : HasCompactSupport U) (hcompactV : HasCompactSupport V) :
    (∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      ⟪referenceHarmonicConstantRaising hF g L lam U x,V x⟫_ℝ) =
    (∫ x : R3, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      ⟪U x,referenceHarmonicDegreeOneRaisingAdjoint hF g L lam V x⟫_ℝ) := by
  have hUi : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => (U x : SphereL2)) :=
    (harmonicSphereSubspace 0).subtypeL.contDiff.comp hU
  have hVi : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => (V x : SphereL2)) :=
    (harmonicSphereSubspace 1).subtypeL.contDiff.comp hV
  obtain ⟨n,b,c,hb,hc,hcompactc,hrepc,_⟩ :=
    exists_smooth_compact_coordinates_sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD 0
      (fun x => (U x : SphereL2)) hUi (tsupport U) hcompactU
      (fun x hx => by rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hx]; rfl)
  obtain ⟨n',d,z,hd,hz,hcompactz,hrepz,_⟩ :=
    exists_smooth_compact_coordinates_sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD 1
      (fun x => (V x : SphereL2)) hVi (tsupport V) hcompactV
      (fun x hx => by rw [image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hx]; rfl)
  apply compact_referenceHarmonicConstantRaising_adjoint_of_representation hF g hg L lam
    b d hb hd c z U V hc hz hU hV hcompactc
  · intro x
    simpa only [sphereHarmonicCoordinate_subtype] using hrepc x
  · intro x
    simpa only [sphereHarmonicCoordinate_subtype] using hrepz x

/-- The source defect on H1 includes its constant output. -/
theorem referenceHarmonicLowering_zero_sub_adjoint (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ) (V : R3 → harmonicSphereSubspace 1)
    (f : R3 → ℝ) (x : R3) :
    referenceHarmonicLowering hF g L lam 0 V f x -
      referenceHarmonicDegreeOneRaisingAdjoint hF g L lam V x =
      referenceHarmonicDegreeOneRaisingDefect hF g L lam V f x := by
  unfold referenceHarmonicLowering referenceHarmonicDegreeOneRaisingAdjoint
    referenceHarmonicDegreeOneRaisingDefect
  rw [← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  simp only [referenceWeightedHarmonicDerivative,Nat.zero_add,Nat.cast_one,
    map_add,map_smul,map_neg]
  module

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.ReferenceRaisingAdjunctionEndpoint
``````

## Calderon.HarmonicDerivativeBounds

``````lean
import Calderon.HarmonicDerivativeOperator
import Calderon.SphereRotationCore

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MvPolynomial
open scoped InnerProductSpace
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.HarmonicDerivativeBounds
open SphereHarmonic SphereHilbertDecomposition HarmonicDerivativeOperator
  SmoothSphereRotationProjection SphereDerivativeAdjoint AngularPolynomial

local instance (k : ℕ) : CompleteSpace (harmonicSphereSubspace k) :=
  completeSpace_harmonicSphereSubspace k

/-- The probability-sphere gradient identity also includes linear harmonics. -/
lemma sum_norm_sq_polynomialDerivative (hF : SphereFischerInner) (m : ℕ)
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin 3) ℝ) (hp : p ∈ harmonicHomogeneous (m+1)) :
    (∑ i : Fin 3, ‖polynomialSphereL2 (pderiv i p)‖^2) =
      (((m:ℝ)+1)*(3+2*(m:ℝ))) * ‖polynomialSphereL2 p‖^2 := by
  simp_rw [polynomialSphereL2_norm_sq hF m _
    (pderiv_harmonicHomogeneous_succ m _ p hp)]
  rw [polynomialSphereL2_norm_sq hF (m+1) p hp]
  unfold normalizedFischerSquare normalizedFischerInner
  rw [← Finset.sum_div,sum_fischerInner_pderiv_self hp.1,
    sphereNormalization_succ]
  have hN : sphereNormalization 3 m ≠ 0 :=
    ne_of_gt (sphereNormalization_pos (by norm_num) m)
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin,Nat.cast_ofNat,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one]
  have hc : (3:ℝ)+2*(m:ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  field_simp [hN,hc]
  <;> ring

lemma sum_norm_sq_harmonicDerivative (hF : SphereFischerInner) (m : ℕ)
    (u : harmonicSphereSubspace (m+1)) :
    (∑ i : Fin 3, ‖harmonicDerivative hF m i u‖^2) =
      (((m:ℝ)+1)*(3+2*(m:ℝ))) * ‖u‖^2 := by
  rcases harmonicPolynomialSphereMap_surjective (m+1) u with ⟨p,rfl⟩
  simp_rw [harmonicDerivative_apply_image]
  exact sum_norm_sq_polynomialDerivative hF m p p.property

attribute [local irreducible] harmonicDerivative harmonicDerivativeAdjoint

lemma norm_harmonicDerivative_apply_le (hF : SphereFischerInner) (m : ℕ)
    (i : Fin 3) (u : harmonicSphereSubspace (m+1)) :
    ‖harmonicDerivative hF m i u‖ ≤ (2*((m:ℝ)+1))*‖u‖ := by
  have hs : ‖harmonicDerivative hF m i u‖^2 ≤
      ∑ j : Fin 3, ‖harmonicDerivative hF m j u‖^2 :=
    Finset.single_le_sum (s := Finset.univ)
      (f := fun j : Fin 3 => ‖harmonicDerivative hF m j u‖^2)
      (fun j _ => sq_nonneg ‖harmonicDerivative hF m j u‖) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  rw [sum_norm_sq_harmonicDerivative] at hs
  have hc : ((m:ℝ)+1)*(3+2*(m:ℝ)) ≤ (2*((m:ℝ)+1))^2 := by
    nlinarith [show (0:ℝ) ≤ (m:ℝ) from Nat.cast_nonneg m]
  have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc (sq_nonneg ‖u‖)
  have hn : 0 ≤ (2*((m:ℝ)+1))*‖u‖ := by positivity
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (harmonicDerivative hF m i u)]

lemma norm_harmonicDerivative_le (hF : SphereFischerInner) (m : ℕ) (i : Fin 3) :
    ‖harmonicDerivative hF m i‖ ≤ 2*((m:ℝ)+1) := by
  apply (harmonicDerivative hF m i).opNorm_le_bound (by positivity)
  exact norm_harmonicDerivative_apply_le hF m i

lemma norm_harmonicDerivativeAdjoint_le (hF : SphereFischerInner) (m : ℕ) (i : Fin 3) :
    ‖harmonicDerivativeAdjoint hF m i‖ ≤ 2*((m:ℝ)+1) := by
  rw [harmonicDerivativeAdjoint_eq_adjoint,
    ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint.norm_map]
  exact norm_harmonicDerivative_le hF m i

lemma norm_harmonicDerivativeAdjoint_apply_le (hF : SphereFischerInner) (m : ℕ)
    (i : Fin 3) (u : harmonicSphereSubspace m) :
    ‖harmonicDerivativeAdjoint hF m i u‖ ≤ (2*((m:ℝ)+1))*‖u‖ :=
  (harmonicDerivativeAdjoint hF m i).le_of_opNorm_le
    (norm_harmonicDerivativeAdjoint_le hF m i) u

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.HarmonicDerivativeBounds

``````

## Calderon.AngularShiftGraph

SHA256 `1888a58f33763ebf4ba0697ce67c6d1d7e4901578768fb2992cda8e7a99909d8`.

``````lean
import Calderon.HarmonicDerivativeBounds
import Calderon.SpectralWeightedGraph
import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.InfiniteSum.NatInt

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open Filter Set
open scoped Topology ENNReal InnerProductSpace
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.AngularShiftGraph
open SphereHarmonic SphereHilbertDecomposition SpectralCoreRegularity
  SpectralWeightedGraph HarmonicDerivativeOperator

attribute [local irreducible] harmonicDerivative harmonicDerivativeAdjoint
  sphereHarmonicDecomposition

/-- The maximal actual harmonic-extension derivative, including its constant output. -/
def sphereDerivativeGraph (hF : SphereFischerInner) (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3) : Submodule ℝ (SphereL2 × SphereL2) where
  carrier := {z | ∀ m, sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD m z.2 =
    harmonicDerivative hF m i (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (m+1) z.1)}
  zero_mem' := by intro m; simp
  add_mem' := by
    intro z z' hz hz' m
    simp only [Prod.fst_add,Prod.snd_add,map_add]
    rw [hz m,hz' m]
  smul_mem' := by
    intro c z hz m
    change sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD m (c • z.2) =
      harmonicDerivative hF m i (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (m+1) (c • z.1))
    rw [map_smul,map_smul,map_smul,hz m]

/-- The maximal actual sphere adjoint. The constant input is retained. -/
def sphereRaisingGraph (hF : SphereFischerInner) (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3) : Submodule ℝ (SphereL2 × SphereL2) where
  carrier := {z | sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD 0 z.2 = 0 ∧ ∀ m,
    sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (m+1) z.2 =
      harmonicDerivativeAdjoint hF m i (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD m z.1)}
  zero_mem' := by simp
  add_mem' := by
    intro z z' hz hz'
    constructor
    · simp only [Prod.snd_add,map_add,hz.1,hz'.1,add_zero]
    · intro m
      simp only [Prod.fst_add,Prod.snd_add,map_add]
      rw [hz.2 m,hz'.2 m]
  smul_mem' := by
    intro c z hz
    constructor
    · change sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD 0 (c • z.2) = 0
      rw [map_smul,hz.1,smul_zero]
    · intro m
      change sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (m+1) (c • z.2) =
        harmonicDerivativeAdjoint hF m i (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD m (c • z.1))
      rw [map_smul,map_smul,map_smul,hz.2 m]

lemma sphereDerivativeGraph_output_unique (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (u v v' : SphereL2) (hv : (u,v) ∈ sphereDerivativeGraph hF hO hD i)
    (hv' : (u,v') ∈ sphereDerivativeGraph hF hO hD i) : v = v' := by
  apply (sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD).injective
  apply lp.ext
  funext m
  exact (hv m).trans (hv' m).symm

lemma sphereRaisingGraph_output_unique (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (u v v' : SphereL2) (hv : (u,v) ∈ sphereRaisingGraph hF hO hD i)
    (hv' : (u,v') ∈ sphereRaisingGraph hF hO hD i) : v = v' := by
  apply (sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD).injective
  apply lp.ext
  funext m
  cases m with
  | zero => exact hv.1.trans hv'.1.symm
  | succ m => exact (hv.2 m).trans (hv'.2 m).symm

lemma isClosed_sphereDerivativeGraph (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3) :
    IsClosed (sphereDerivativeGraph hF hO hD i : Set (SphereL2 × SphereL2)) := by
  change IsClosed {z : SphereL2 × SphereL2 | ∀ m,
    sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD m z.2 =
      harmonicDerivative hF m i (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (m+1) z.1)}
  simp_rw [ofPred_forall]
  apply isClosed_iInter
  intro m
  exact isClosed_eq ((sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD m).continuous.comp continuous_snd)
    ((harmonicDerivative hF m i).continuous.comp
      ((sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (m+1)).continuous.comp continuous_fst))

lemma isClosed_sphereRaisingGraph (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3) :
    IsClosed (sphereRaisingGraph hF hO hD i : Set (SphereL2 × SphereL2)) := by
  change IsClosed {z : SphereL2 × SphereL2 | sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD 0 z.2 = 0 ∧
    ∀ m, sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (m+1) z.2 =
      harmonicDerivativeAdjoint hF m i (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD m z.1)}
  rw [setOf_and]
  apply IsClosed.inter
  · exact isClosed_eq ((sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD 0).continuous.comp continuous_snd)
      continuous_const
  · simp_rw [ofPred_forall]
    apply isClosed_iInter
    intro m
    exact isClosed_eq ((sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (m+1)).continuous.comp continuous_snd)
      ((harmonicDerivativeAdjoint hF m i).continuous.comp
        ((sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD m).continuous.comp continuous_fst))

def derivativeCoordinateSequence (hF : SphereFischerInner) (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3) (u : SphereL2) :
    (m : ℕ) → harmonicSphereSubspace m :=
  fun m => harmonicDerivative hF m i (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (m+1) u)

def raisingCoordinateSequence (hF : SphereFischerInner) (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3) (u : SphereL2) :
    (m : ℕ) → harmonicSphereSubspace m
  | 0 => 0
  | m+1 => harmonicDerivativeAdjoint hF m i (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD m u)

lemma exists_sphereDerivativeGraph_iff_summable (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3) (u : SphereL2) :
    (∃ v : SphereL2, (u,v) ∈ sphereDerivativeGraph hF hO hD i) ↔
      Summable (fun m : ℕ =>
        ‖harmonicDerivative hF m i (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (m+1) u)‖^2) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v,hv⟩
    change ∀ m, sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD m v =
      harmonicDerivative hF m i (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (m+1) u) at hv
    have hs := (lp.memℓp (sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD v)).summable
      (show 0 < (2 : ℝ≥0∞).toReal by norm_num)
    simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_ofNat,Real.rpow_two,← sphereHarmonicCoordinate_apply,hv] using hs
  · intro hs
    have hp : Memℓp (derivativeCoordinateSequence hF hO hD i u) 2 := by
      apply (memℓp_gen_iff (show 0 < (2 : ℝ≥0∞).toReal by norm_num)).mpr
      simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_ofNat,Real.rpow_two,derivativeCoordinateSequence] using hs
    let q : lp (fun m : ℕ => harmonicSphereSubspace m) 2 :=
      ⟨derivativeCoordinateSequence hF hO hD i u,hp⟩
    refine ⟨(sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD).symm q,?_⟩
    intro m
    rw [sphereHarmonicCoordinate_apply,LinearIsometryEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
    rfl

lemma exists_sphereRaisingGraph_iff_summable (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3) (u : SphereL2) :
    (∃ v : SphereL2, (u,v) ∈ sphereRaisingGraph hF hO hD i) ↔
      Summable (fun m : ℕ =>
        ‖harmonicDerivativeAdjoint hF m i (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD m u)‖^2) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨v,hv⟩
    have hs := (lp.memℓp (sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD v)).summable
      (show 0 < (2 : ℝ≥0∞).toReal by norm_num)
    have ht := (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mpr hs
    simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_ofNat,Real.rpow_two,← sphereHarmonicCoordinate_apply,hv.2] using ht
  · intro hs
    have ht : Summable (fun m : ℕ => ‖raisingCoordinateSequence hF hO hD i u m‖^2) := by
      apply (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mp
      simpa only [raisingCoordinateSequence] using hs
    have hp : Memℓp (raisingCoordinateSequence hF hO hD i u) 2 := by
      apply (memℓp_gen_iff (show 0 < (2 : ℝ≥0∞).toReal by norm_num)).mpr
      simpa only [ENNReal.toReal_ofNat,Real.rpow_two] using ht
    let q : lp (fun m : ℕ => harmonicSphereSubspace m) 2 :=
      ⟨raisingCoordinateSequence hF hO hD i u,hp⟩
    refine ⟨(sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD).symm q,?_,?_⟩
    · rw [sphereHarmonicCoordinate_apply,LinearIsometryEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
      rfl
    · intro m
      rw [sphereHarmonicCoordinate_apply,LinearIsometryEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
      rfl

lemma sphereDerivativeGraph_partialSum (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (u v : SphereL2) (hv : (u,v) ∈ sphereDerivativeGraph hF hO hD i) (n : ℕ) :
    (sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD (n+1) u,sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n v) ∈
      sphereDerivativeGraph hF hO hD i := by
  intro m
  simp_rw [sphereHarmonicCoordinate_partialSum]
  by_cases hm : m < n
  · simpa only [if_pos hm,if_pos (show m+1 < n+1 by omega)] using hv m
  · simp only [if_neg hm,if_neg (show ¬ m+1 < n+1 by omega),map_zero]

lemma sphereRaisingGraph_partialSum (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (u v : SphereL2) (hv : (u,v) ∈ sphereRaisingGraph hF hO hD i) (n : ℕ) :
    (sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n u,sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD (n+1) v) ∈
      sphereRaisingGraph hF hO hD i := by
  constructor
  · simpa only [sphereHarmonicCoordinate_partialSum,
      if_pos (show 0 < n+1 by omega)] using hv.1
  · intro m
    simp_rw [sphereHarmonicCoordinate_partialSum]
    by_cases hm : m < n
    · simpa only [if_pos hm,if_pos (show m+1 < n+1 by omega)] using hv.2 m
    · simp only [if_neg hm,if_neg (show ¬ m+1 < n+1 by omega),map_zero]

/-- The same finite harmonic support condition is used for both genuine operators. -/
def finiteHarmonicPair (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) :
    Set (SphereL2 × SphereL2) :=
  {z | ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ k : ℕ, n ≤ k →
    sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k z.1 = 0 ∧ sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k z.2 = 0}

lemma finiteHarmonicPair_partialSum (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (u v : SphereL2) (n n' : ℕ) :
    (sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n u,sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n' v) ∈
      finiteHarmonicPair hO hD := by
  refine ⟨max n n',?_⟩
  intro k hk
  simp only [sphereHarmonicCoordinate_partialSum,
    if_neg (show ¬ k < n by omega),if_neg (show ¬ k < n' by omega),and_self]

lemma closure_finite_sphereDerivativeGraph (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3) :
    closure ((sphereDerivativeGraph hF hO hD i : Set (SphereL2 × SphereL2)) ∩
      finiteHarmonicPair hO hD) = (sphereDerivativeGraph hF hO hD i : Set (SphereL2 × SphereL2)) := by
  apply Subset.antisymm
  · exact closure_minimal (fun _ hz => hz.1) (isClosed_sphereDerivativeGraph hF hO hD i)
  · intro z hz
    have ht := ((tendsto_sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD z.1).comp
      (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1)).prodMk_nhds (tendsto_sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD z.2)
    exact isClosed_closure.mem_of_tendsto ht (Eventually.of_forall (fun n => subset_closure
      ⟨sphereDerivativeGraph_partialSum hF hO hD i z.1 z.2 hz n,
        finiteHarmonicPair_partialSum hO hD z.1 z.2 (n+1) n⟩))

lemma closure_finite_sphereRaisingGraph (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3) :
    closure ((sphereRaisingGraph hF hO hD i : Set (SphereL2 × SphereL2)) ∩
      finiteHarmonicPair hO hD) = (sphereRaisingGraph hF hO hD i : Set (SphereL2 × SphereL2)) := by
  apply Subset.antisymm
  · exact closure_minimal (fun _ hz => hz.1) (isClosed_sphereRaisingGraph hF hO hD i)
  · intro z hz
    have ht := (tendsto_sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD z.1).prodMk_nhds
      ((tendsto_sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD z.2).comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat 1))
    exact isClosed_closure.mem_of_tendsto ht (Eventually.of_forall (fun n => subset_closure
      ⟨sphereRaisingGraph_partialSum hF hO hD i z.1 z.2 hz n,
        finiteHarmonicPair_partialSum hO hD z.1 z.2 n (n+1)⟩))

/-- Adjunction on the maximal all-degree graphs, proved using genuine sphere Parseval. -/
lemma sphereDerivativeGraph_inner_adjoint (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (u du v rv : SphereL2) (hdu : (u,du) ∈ sphereDerivativeGraph hF hO hD i)
    (hrv : (v,rv) ∈ sphereRaisingGraph hF hO hD i) :
    ⟪du,v⟫_ℝ = ⟪u,rv⟫_ℝ := by
  have hsum : Summable (fun m : ℕ =>
      ⟪sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD u m,
        sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD rv m⟫_ℝ) :=
    lp.summable_inner (𝕜 := ℝ) (G := fun k : ℕ => harmonicSphereSubspace k)
      (sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD u) (sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD rv)
  have hcoord : Summable (fun m : ℕ =>
      ⟪sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD m u,sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD m rv⟫_ℝ) := by
    simpa only [sphereHarmonicCoordinate_apply] using hsum
  rw [inner_sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD u rv]
  change ⟪du,v⟫_ℝ = ∑' m : ℕ,
    ⟪sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD m u,sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD m rv⟫_ℝ
  rw [hcoord.tsum_eq_zero_add]
  rw [hrv.1,inner_zero_right,zero_add,inner_sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD du v]
  apply tsum_congr
  intro m
  change ⟪sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD m du,sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD m v⟫_ℝ = _
  rw [hdu m,hrv.2 m,real_inner_comm,← inner_harmonicDerivativeAdjoint,real_inner_comm]

lemma sphereDerivativeGraph_single (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (k : ℕ) (a : harmonicSphereSubspace (k+1)) :
    ((a : SphereL2),(harmonicDerivative hF k i a : SphereL2)) ∈
      sphereDerivativeGraph hF hO hD i := by
  intro m
  simp only [sphereHarmonicCoordinate_apply,sphereHarmonicDecomposition_subtype]
  by_cases hm : m = k
  · subst m; simp
  · have hm' : m+1 ≠ k+1 := by omega
    simp [lp.single_apply,hm,hm',map_zero]

lemma sphereDerivativeGraph_constant (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (a : harmonicSphereSubspace 0) :
    ((a : SphereL2),0) ∈ sphereDerivativeGraph hF hO hD i := by
  intro m
  simp [sphereHarmonicCoordinate_apply,sphereHarmonicDecomposition_subtype,
    lp.single_apply,show m+1 ≠ 0 by omega]

lemma sphereRaisingGraph_single (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (k : ℕ) (a : harmonicSphereSubspace k) :
    ((a : SphereL2),(harmonicDerivativeAdjoint hF k i a : SphereL2)) ∈
      sphereRaisingGraph hF hO hD i := by
  constructor
  · simp [sphereHarmonicCoordinate_apply,sphereHarmonicDecomposition_subtype,
      lp.single_apply,show (0:ℕ) ≠ k+1 by omega]
  · intro m
    simp only [sphereHarmonicCoordinate_apply,sphereHarmonicDecomposition_subtype]
    by_cases hm : m = k
    · subst m; simp
    · have hm' : m+1 ≠ k+1 := by omega
      simp [lp.single_apply,hm,hm',map_zero]

lemma sphereDerivativeGraph_polynomial (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (m : ℕ) (p : harmonicHomogeneous (m+1)) :
    (polynomialSphereL2 p,polynomialSphereL2 (MvPolynomial.pderiv i p)) ∈
      sphereDerivativeGraph hF hO hD i := by
  have h := sphereDerivativeGraph_single hF hO hD i m
    (SmoothSphereRotationProjection.harmonicPolynomialSphereMap (m+1) p)
  rw [harmonicDerivative_apply_image] at h
  exact h

lemma sphereRaisingGraph_polynomial (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (m : ℕ) (p : harmonicHomogeneous m) :
    (polynomialSphereL2 p,polynomialSphereL2
      (SphereDerivativeAdjoint.sphereDerivativeAdjoint m i p)) ∈
      sphereRaisingGraph hF hO hD i := by
  have h := sphereRaisingGraph_single hF hO hD i m
    (SmoothSphereRotationProjection.harmonicPolynomialSphereMap m p)
  rw [harmonicDerivativeAdjoint_apply_image] at h
  exact h

/-- Any two genuine graph outputs can use the same finite harmonic input. -/
lemma sphereDerivativeRaisingGraph_common_partialSum (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (u du ru : SphereL2) (hdu : (u,du) ∈ sphereDerivativeGraph hF hO hD i)
    (hru : (u,ru) ∈ sphereRaisingGraph hF hO hD i) (n : ℕ) :
    (sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD (n+1) u,sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n du) ∈
        sphereDerivativeGraph hF hO hD i ∧
      (sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD (n+1) u,sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD ((n+1)+1) ru) ∈
        sphereRaisingGraph hF hO hD i :=
  ⟨sphereDerivativeGraph_partialSum hF hO hD i u du hdu n,
    sphereRaisingGraph_partialSum hF hO hD i u ru hru (n+1)⟩

/-- The maximal derivative graph is characterized by testing the actual raising graph. -/
lemma mem_sphereDerivativeGraph_iff_inner (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (u du : SphereL2) :
    (u,du) ∈ sphereDerivativeGraph hF hO hD i ↔
      ∀ v rv : SphereL2, (v,rv) ∈ sphereRaisingGraph hF hO hD i →
        ⟪du,v⟫_ℝ = ⟪u,rv⟫_ℝ := by
  constructor
  · intro hdu v rv hrv
    exact sphereDerivativeGraph_inner_adjoint hF hO hD i u du v rv hdu hrv
  · intro ht m
    let q : harmonicSphereSubspace m := sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD m du -
      harmonicDerivative hF m i (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (m+1) u)
    have he := ht (q : SphereL2) (harmonicDerivativeAdjoint hF m i q : SphereL2)
      (sphereRaisingGraph_single hF hO hD i m q)
    rw [inner_sphereHarmonicCoordinate_right hO hD m du q,
      inner_sphereHarmonicCoordinate_right hO hD (m+1) u
        (harmonicDerivativeAdjoint hF m i q)] at he
    have hi : ⟪sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (m+1) u,
        harmonicDerivativeAdjoint hF m i q⟫_ℝ =
        ⟪harmonicDerivative hF m i (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (m+1) u),q⟫_ℝ := by
      rw [real_inner_comm,inner_harmonicDerivativeAdjoint,real_inner_comm]
    rw [hi] at he
    have hq : ⟪q,q⟫_ℝ = 0 := by
      dsimp only [q]
      rw [inner_sub_left]
      exact sub_eq_zero.mpr he
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((inner_self_eq_zero).mp hq)

/-- The maximal raising graph is the Hilbert-adjoint graph, including degree zero. -/
lemma mem_sphereRaisingGraph_iff_inner (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (u ru : SphereL2) :
    (u,ru) ∈ sphereRaisingGraph hF hO hD i ↔
      ∀ v dv : SphereL2, (v,dv) ∈ sphereDerivativeGraph hF hO hD i →
        ⟪ru,v⟫_ℝ = ⟪u,dv⟫_ℝ := by
  constructor
  · intro hru v dv hdv
    calc
      ⟪ru,v⟫_ℝ = ⟪v,ru⟫_ℝ := real_inner_comm _ _
      _ = ⟪dv,u⟫_ℝ :=
        (sphereDerivativeGraph_inner_adjoint hF hO hD i v dv u ru hdv hru).symm
      _ = ⟪u,dv⟫_ℝ := real_inner_comm _ _
  · intro ht
    constructor
    · let q : harmonicSphereSubspace 0 := sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD 0 ru
      have he := ht (q : SphereL2) 0 (sphereDerivativeGraph_constant hF hO hD i q)
      rw [inner_sphereHarmonicCoordinate_right hO hD 0 ru q,inner_zero_right] at he
      exact (inner_self_eq_zero).mp he
    · intro m
      let q : harmonicSphereSubspace (m+1) := sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (m+1) ru -
        harmonicDerivativeAdjoint hF m i (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD m u)
      have he := ht (q : SphereL2) (harmonicDerivative hF m i q : SphereL2)
        (sphereDerivativeGraph_single hF hO hD i m q)
      rw [inner_sphereHarmonicCoordinate_right hO hD (m+1) ru q,
        inner_sphereHarmonicCoordinate_right hO hD m u (harmonicDerivative hF m i q),
        ← inner_harmonicDerivativeAdjoint] at he
      have hq : ⟪q,q⟫_ℝ = 0 := by
        dsimp only [q]
        rw [inner_sub_left]
        exact sub_eq_zero.mpr he
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((inner_self_eq_zero).mp hq)

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.AngularShiftGraph

``````
