``````lean
import Calderon.AngularShiftGraph

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open Filter Set
open scoped Topology ENNReal InnerProductSpace
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.AngularWeightedCore
open SphereHarmonic SphereHilbertDecomposition SpectralCoreRegularity
  SpectralWeightedGraph HarmonicDerivativeOperator HarmonicDerivativeBounds AngularShiftGraph

attribute [local irreducible] harmonicDerivative harmonicDerivativeAdjoint

lemma besselWeight_add_one (s : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
    besselWeight (s+1) k = besselWeight s k * (1+(k:ℝ)) := by
  unfold besselWeight
  rw [Real.rpow_add (by positivity),Real.rpow_one]

lemma one_le_besselWeight (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (k : ℕ) :
    1 ≤ besselWeight s k := by
  apply Real.one_le_rpow _ hs
  have hk : (0:ℝ) ≤ (k:ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg k
  linarith

lemma besselWeight_le_succ (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (k : ℕ) :
    besselWeight s k ≤ besselWeight s (k+1) := by
  unfold besselWeight
  apply Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity) _ hs
  push_cast
  linarith

lemma besselWeight_succ_le (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (k : ℕ) :
    besselWeight s (k+1) ≤ (2:ℝ)^s * besselWeight s k := by
  unfold besselWeight
  calc
    (1+((k+1:ℕ):ℝ))^s ≤ (2*(1+(k:ℝ)))^s := by
      apply Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity) _ hs
      push_cast
      nlinarith [show (0:ℝ) ≤ (k:ℝ) from Nat.cast_nonneg k]
    _ = _ := Real.mul_rpow (by norm_num) (by positivity)

lemma weighted_norm_harmonicDerivative_le (hF : SphereFischerInner) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (m : ℕ) (i : Fin 3) (q : harmonicSphereSubspace (m+1)) :
    besselWeight s m * ‖harmonicDerivative hF m i q‖ ≤
      2 * besselWeight (s+1) (m+1) * ‖q‖ := by
  have hd : ‖harmonicDerivative hF m i q‖ ≤ (2*((m:ℝ)+2))*‖q‖ :=
    (norm_harmonicDerivative_apply_le hF m i q).trans
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (norm_nonneg q))
  calc
    _ ≤ besselWeight s (m+1) * ((2*((m:ℝ)+2))*‖q‖) :=
      mul_le_mul (besselWeight_le_succ s hs m) hd
        (norm_nonneg _) (le_of_lt (besselWeight_pos s (m+1)))
    _ = _ := by
      rw [besselWeight_add_one]
      push_cast
      ring

lemma weighted_norm_harmonicDerivativeAdjoint_le (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (m : ℕ) (i : Fin 3) (q : harmonicSphereSubspace m) :
    besselWeight s (m+1) * ‖harmonicDerivativeAdjoint hF m i q‖ ≤
      (2 * (2:ℝ)^s) * besselWeight (s+1) m * ‖q‖ := by
  calc
    _ ≤ ((2:ℝ)^s * besselWeight s m) * ((2*((m:ℝ)+1))*‖q‖) :=
      mul_le_mul (besselWeight_succ_le s hs m)
        (norm_harmonicDerivativeAdjoint_apply_le hF m i q)
        (norm_nonneg _)
        (mul_nonneg (Real.rpow_nonneg (show (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 by norm_num) s)
          (besselWeight_pos s m).le)
    _ = _ := by rw [besselWeight_add_one]; ring

lemma weighted_sq_harmonicDerivative_le (hF : SphereFischerInner) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (m : ℕ) (i : Fin 3) (q : harmonicSphereSubspace (m+1)) :
    besselWeight s m^2 * ‖harmonicDerivative hF m i q‖^2 ≤
      4 * (besselWeight (s+1) (m+1)^2 * ‖q‖^2) := by
  have h := pow_le_pow_left₀ (show 0 ≤ besselWeight s m *
      ‖harmonicDerivative hF m i q‖ from
        mul_nonneg (besselWeight_pos s m).le (norm_nonneg _))
    (weighted_norm_harmonicDerivative_le hF s hs m i q) 2
  simpa only [mul_pow,show (2:ℝ)^2 = 4 by norm_num,mul_assoc] using h

lemma weighted_sq_harmonicDerivativeAdjoint_le (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (m : ℕ) (i : Fin 3) (q : harmonicSphereSubspace m) :
    besselWeight s (m+1)^2 * ‖harmonicDerivativeAdjoint hF m i q‖^2 ≤
      (2 * (2:ℝ)^s)^2 * (besselWeight (s+1) m^2 * ‖q‖^2) := by
  have h := pow_le_pow_left₀ (show 0 ≤ besselWeight s (m+1) *
      ‖harmonicDerivativeAdjoint hF m i q‖ from
        mul_nonneg (besselWeight_pos s (m+1)).le (norm_nonneg _))
    (weighted_norm_harmonicDerivativeAdjoint_le hF s hs m i q) 2
  simpa only [mul_pow,mul_assoc] using h

/-- Exact nonnegative-order Bessel domain already defined by the genuine diagonal graph. -/
def hasSphereBesselWeight (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (s : ℝ) (u : SphereL2) : Prop := ∃ w : SphereL2, (u,w) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD s

lemma hasSphereBesselWeight_iff_summable (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (s : ℝ) (u : SphereL2) :
    hasSphereBesselWeight hO hD s u ↔
      Summable (fun k : ℕ => besselWeight s k^2 * ‖sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k u‖^2) := by
  simpa only [hasSphereBesselWeight,sphereBesselGraph,
    abs_of_pos (besselWeight_pos s _)] using
    exists_spectralGraph_iff_summable hO hD (besselWeight s) u

lemma summable_weighted_derivativeCoordinates (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (u : SphereL2)
    (hu : hasSphereBesselWeight hO hD (s+1) u) :
    Summable (fun m : ℕ => besselWeight s m^2 *
      ‖harmonicDerivative hF m i (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (m+1) u)‖^2) := by
  have hb := (hasSphereBesselWeight_iff_summable hO hD (s+1) u).mp hu
  have ht := ((summable_nat_add_iff 1).mpr hb).mul_left (4:ℝ)
  exact Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun m => by positivity)
    (fun m => weighted_sq_harmonicDerivative_le hF s hs m i _) ht

lemma summable_weighted_raisingCoordinates (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (u : SphereL2)
    (hu : hasSphereBesselWeight hO hD (s+1) u) :
    Summable (fun m : ℕ => besselWeight s (m+1)^2 *
      ‖harmonicDerivativeAdjoint hF m i (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD m u)‖^2) := by
  have hb := (hasSphereBesselWeight_iff_summable hO hD (s+1) u).mp hu
  exact Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun m => by positivity)
    (fun m => weighted_sq_harmonicDerivativeAdjoint_le hF s hs m i _)
    (hb.mul_left ((2 * (2:ℝ)^s)^2))

/-- The derivative output is constructed, rather than assumed to lie in a desired domain. -/
lemma exists_sphereDerivativeGraph_hasWeight (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (u : SphereL2)
    (hu : hasSphereBesselWeight hO hD (s+1) u) :
    ∃ du : SphereL2, (u,du) ∈ sphereDerivativeGraph hF hO hD i ∧
      hasSphereBesselWeight hO hD s du := by
  have hw := summable_weighted_derivativeCoordinates hF hO hD i s hs u hu
  have hd : Summable (fun m : ℕ =>
      ‖harmonicDerivative hF m i (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (m+1) u)‖^2) := by
    apply Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun m => sq_nonneg _) _ hw
    intro m
    have hweight := one_le_besselWeight s hs m
    have hsq : (1:ℝ) ≤ besselWeight s m^2 := by nlinarith
    simpa only [one_mul] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsq
      (sq_nonneg ‖harmonicDerivative hF m i (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (m+1) u)‖)
  obtain ⟨du,hdu⟩ := (exists_sphereDerivativeGraph_iff_summable hF hO hD i u).mpr hd
  refine ⟨du,hdu,(hasSphereBesselWeight_iff_summable hO hD s du).mpr ?_⟩
  have hcoord : ∀ m : ℕ, sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD m du =
      harmonicDerivative hF m i (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (m+1) u) := hdu
  simpa only [hcoord] using hw

lemma exists_sphereRaisingGraph_hasWeight (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (u : SphereL2)
    (hu : hasSphereBesselWeight hO hD (s+1) u) :
    ∃ ru : SphereL2, (u,ru) ∈ sphereRaisingGraph hF hO hD i ∧
      hasSphereBesselWeight hO hD s ru := by
  have hw := summable_weighted_raisingCoordinates hF hO hD i s hs u hu
  have hr : Summable (fun m : ℕ =>
      ‖harmonicDerivativeAdjoint hF m i (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD m u)‖^2) := by
    apply Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun m => sq_nonneg _) _ hw
    intro m
    have hweight := one_le_besselWeight s hs (m+1)
    have hsq : (1:ℝ) ≤ besselWeight s (m+1)^2 := by nlinarith
    simpa only [one_mul] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hsq
      (sq_nonneg ‖harmonicDerivativeAdjoint hF m i (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD m u)‖)
  obtain ⟨ru,hru⟩ := (exists_sphereRaisingGraph_iff_summable hF hO hD i u).mpr hr
  refine ⟨ru,hru,(hasSphereBesselWeight_iff_summable hO hD s ru).mpr ?_⟩
  apply (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mp
  have hcoord : ∀ m : ℕ, sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (m+1) ru =
      harmonicDerivativeAdjoint hF m i (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD m u) := hru.2
  simpa only [hcoord] using hw

lemma norm_sq_sphereBesselGraph_output (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (s : ℝ) (u w : SphereL2)
    (hw : (u,w) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD s) :
    ‖w‖^2 = ∑' k : ℕ, besselWeight s k^2 * ‖sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k u‖^2 := by
  simpa only [abs_of_pos (besselWeight_pos s _)] using
    norm_sq_spectralGraph_output hO hD (besselWeight s) u w hw

lemma norm_sq_weighted_derivative_le (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (u wu du wdu : SphereL2)
    (hwu : (u,wu) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD (s+1))
    (hdu : (u,du) ∈ sphereDerivativeGraph hF hO hD i)
    (hwdu : (du,wdu) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD s) :
    ‖wdu‖^2 ≤ 4 * ‖wu‖^2 := by
  have hb := (hasSphereBesselWeight_iff_summable hO hD (s+1) u).mp ⟨wu,hwu⟩
  have ht := (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mpr hb
  have hd := summable_weighted_derivativeCoordinates hF hO hD i s hs u ⟨wu,hwu⟩
  have hbound := hd.tsum_le_tsum
    (fun m => weighted_sq_harmonicDerivative_le hF s hs m i
      (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (m+1) u)) (ht.mul_left (4:ℝ))
  have htail : (∑' m : ℕ, besselWeight (s+1) (m+1)^2 *
      ‖sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (m+1) u‖^2) ≤
      ∑' m : ℕ, besselWeight (s+1) m^2 * ‖sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD m u‖^2 := by
    rw [hb.tsum_eq_zero_add]
    exact le_add_of_nonneg_left (by positivity)
  rw [norm_sq_sphereBesselGraph_output hO hD s du wdu hwdu,
    norm_sq_sphereBesselGraph_output hO hD (s+1) u wu hwu]
  have hcoord : ∀ m : ℕ, sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD m du =
      harmonicDerivative hF m i (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (m+1) u) := hdu
  simp_rw [hcoord]
  rw [tsum_mul_left] at hbound
  exact hbound.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left htail (by norm_num))

lemma norm_sq_weighted_raising_le (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (u wu ru wru : SphereL2)
    (hwu : (u,wu) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD (s+1))
    (hru : (u,ru) ∈ sphereRaisingGraph hF hO hD i)
    (hwru : (ru,wru) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD s) :
    ‖wru‖^2 ≤ (2 * (2:ℝ)^s)^2 * ‖wu‖^2 := by
  have hb := (hasSphereBesselWeight_iff_summable hO hD (s+1) u).mp ⟨wu,hwu⟩
  have hr := summable_weighted_raisingCoordinates hF hO hD i s hs u ⟨wu,hwu⟩
  have hbound := hr.tsum_le_tsum
    (fun m => weighted_sq_harmonicDerivativeAdjoint_le hF s hs m i
      (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD m u)) (hb.mul_left ((2 * (2:ℝ)^s)^2))
  have hwr := (hasSphereBesselWeight_iff_summable hO hD s ru).mp ⟨wru,hwru⟩
  rw [norm_sq_sphereBesselGraph_output hO hD s ru wru hwru,
    norm_sq_sphereBesselGraph_output hO hD (s+1) u wu hwu,hwr.tsum_eq_zero_add]
  have hzero : sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD 0 ru = 0 := hru.1
  have hcoord : ∀ m : ℕ, sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (m+1) ru =
      harmonicDerivativeAdjoint hF m i (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD m u) := hru.2
  simp only [hzero,norm_zero,show (0:ℝ)^(2:ℕ) = 0 by norm_num,mul_zero,zero_add]
  simp_rw [hcoord]
  simpa only [tsum_mul_left] using hbound

/-- A genuine common domain defined by exact harmonic decay, with no mapping premise. -/
def sphereSmoothWeightedCore (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) :
    Set SphereL2 := {u | ∀ n : ℕ, hasSphereBesselWeight hO hD (n:ℝ) u}

lemma sphereSmoothWeightedCore_derivative (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (u : SphereL2) (hu : u ∈ sphereSmoothWeightedCore hO hD) :
    ∃ du : SphereL2, (u,du) ∈ sphereDerivativeGraph hF hO hD i ∧
      du ∈ sphereSmoothWeightedCore hO hD := by
  obtain ⟨du,hdu,_⟩ := exists_sphereDerivativeGraph_hasWeight hF hO hD i 0 (by norm_num) u
    (by simpa using hu 1)
  refine ⟨du,hdu,?_⟩
  intro n
  obtain ⟨dn,hdn,hn⟩ := exists_sphereDerivativeGraph_hasWeight hF hO hD i (n:ℝ)
    (Nat.cast_nonneg n) u (by simpa only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one] using hu (n+1))
  have he := sphereDerivativeGraph_output_unique hF hO hD i u du dn hdu hdn
  simpa only [he] using hn

lemma sphereSmoothWeightedCore_raising (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (u : SphereL2) (hu : u ∈ sphereSmoothWeightedCore hO hD) :
    ∃ ru : SphereL2, (u,ru) ∈ sphereRaisingGraph hF hO hD i ∧
      ru ∈ sphereSmoothWeightedCore hO hD := by
  obtain ⟨ru,hru,_⟩ := exists_sphereRaisingGraph_hasWeight hF hO hD i 0 (by norm_num) u
    (by simpa using hu 1)
  refine ⟨ru,hru,?_⟩
  intro n
  obtain ⟨rn,hrn,hn⟩ := exists_sphereRaisingGraph_hasWeight hF hO hD i (n:ℝ)
    (Nat.cast_nonneg n) u (by simpa only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one] using hu (n+1))
  have he := sphereRaisingGraph_output_unique hF hO hD i u ru rn hru hrn
  simpa only [he] using hn

lemma hasSphereBesselWeight_of_finite (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (s : ℝ) (u : SphereL2) (n : ℕ)
    (hu : ∀ k : ℕ, n ≤ k → sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k u = 0) :
    hasSphereBesselWeight hO hD s u := by
  apply (hasSphereBesselWeight_iff_summable hO hD s u).mpr
  apply summable_of_ne_finset_zero (s := Finset.range n)
  intro k hk
  have hkn : n ≤ k := by simpa only [Finset.mem_range,not_lt] using hk
  rw [hu k hkn]
  simp

lemma sphereHarmonicPartialSum_mem_sphereSmoothWeightedCore
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (n : ℕ) (u : SphereL2) :
    sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n u ∈ sphereSmoothWeightedCore hO hD := by
  intro s
  apply hasSphereBesselWeight_of_finite hO hD (s:ℝ) _ n
  intro k hk
  simp only [sphereHarmonicCoordinate_partialSum,if_neg (not_lt.mpr hk)]

/-- Finite common-core approximants converge in each exact Bessel graph. -/
lemma sphereBesselGraph_common_core_partialSum (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (s : ℝ) (u wu : SphereL2)
    (hwu : (u,wu) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD s) (n : ℕ) :
    (sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n u,sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n wu) ∈
        sphereBesselGraph hO hD s ∧
      sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n u ∈ sphereSmoothWeightedCore hO hD :=
  ⟨spectralGraph_partialSum hO hD (besselWeight s) (u,wu) hwu n,
    sphereHarmonicPartialSum_mem_sphereSmoothWeightedCore hO hD n u⟩

lemma dense_sphereSmoothWeightedCore (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) : Dense (sphereSmoothWeightedCore hO hD) := by
  intro u
  exact isClosed_closure.mem_of_tendsto (tendsto_sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD u)
    (Eventually.of_forall (fun n => subset_closure
      (sphereHarmonicPartialSum_mem_sphereSmoothWeightedCore hO hD n u)))

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.AngularWeightedCore

``````

## Calderon.AmbientSmoothWeightedCore

SHA256 `c429cd6a4f21084bf361123947d52a735990dac5eaea71203b8dc9d0fc2b44b0`.

``````lean
import Calderon.AngularWeightedCore
import Calderon.SmoothAmbientAngularCasimir
import Calderon.SpectralWeightComparison
import Calderon.SmoothMovingFrameFields

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open scoped ContDiff Topology ENNReal
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.AmbientSmoothWeightedCore
open SphereHarmonic SpectralCoreRegularity SpectralWeightedGraph SpectralWeightComparison
  SmoothSphereFields SmoothAmbientAngularCasimir SmoothMovingFrameFields
  AngularShiftGraph AngularWeightedCore

/-- The exact natural Bessel weight is dominated by enough true Casimir iterates. -/
lemma besselWeight_nat_le_casimirWeight_pow (n k : ℕ) :
    |besselWeight (n:ℝ) k| ≤ |casimirWeight k ^ n| := by
  rw [abs_of_pos (besselWeight_pos (n:ℝ) k),
    abs_of_nonneg (pow_nonneg (casimirWeight_pos k).le n)]
  change (1+(k:ℝ)) ^ (n:ℝ) ≤ casimirWeight k ^ n
  rw [Real.rpow_natCast]
  apply pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) _ n
  unfold casimirWeight
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (k:ℝ)]

/-- The graph output is an actual smooth field formed from angular derivatives. -/
lemma ambientSphereL2_mem_casimirPowerGraph (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (m : ℕ) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ)
    (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (x : R3) :
    (ambientSphereL2 G hG x,
      ambientSphereL2 (ambientShiftedAngularCasimirIterate m G)
        (contDiff_ambientShiftedAngularCasimirIterate m G hG) x) ∈
      spectralGraph hO hD (fun k => casimirWeight k ^ m) := by
  intro k
  simpa only [casimirWeight] using
    sphereHarmonicCoordinate_angularCasimirLift hO hD m k G hG x

/-- Bessel outputs are reconstructed from a proved graph pair, with no decay premise. -/
lemma hasSphereBesselWeight_ambientSphereL2 (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (n : ℕ) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ)
    (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (x : R3) :
    hasSphereBesselWeight hO hD (n:ℝ) (ambientSphereL2 G hG x) := by
  have hw : ∀ k : ℕ, |besselWeight (n:ℝ) k| ≤ 1 * |casimirWeight k ^ n| :=
    fun k => by simpa only [one_mul] using besselWeight_nat_le_casimirWeight_pow n k
  exact exists_spectralGraph_of_weight_le hO hD (besselWeight (n:ℝ))
    (fun k => casimirWeight k ^ n) 1 (by norm_num) hw (ambientSphereL2 G hG x)
    (ambientSphereL2 (ambientShiftedAngularCasimirIterate n G)
      (contDiff_ambientShiftedAngularCasimirIterate n G hG) x)
    (ambientSphereL2_mem_casimirPowerGraph hO hD n G hG x)

lemma norm_besselOutput_ambientSphereL2_le_angularCasimirLift
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (n : ℕ)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (x : R3) (b : SphereL2)
    (hb : (ambientSphereL2 G hG x,b) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD (n:ℝ)) :
    ‖b‖ ≤ ‖ambientSphereL2 (ambientShiftedAngularCasimirIterate n G)
      (contDiff_ambientShiftedAngularCasimirIterate n G hG) x‖ := by
  have hw : ∀ k : ℕ, |besselWeight (n:ℝ) k| ≤ 1 * |casimirWeight k ^ n| :=
    fun k => by simpa only [one_mul] using besselWeight_nat_le_casimirWeight_pow n k
  simpa only [one_mul] using
    norm_spectralGraph_output_le hO hD (besselWeight (n:ℝ))
      (fun k => casimirWeight k ^ n) 1 (by norm_num) hw
      (ambientSphereL2 G hG x) b
      (ambientSphereL2 (ambientShiftedAngularCasimirIterate n G)
        (contDiff_ambientShiftedAngularCasimirIterate n G hG) x) hb
      (ambientSphereL2_mem_casimirPowerGraph hO hD n G hG x)

/-- Forward smooth-to-core membership for a genuine ambient smooth representative. -/
lemma ambientSphereL2_mem_sphereSmoothWeightedCore (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (x : R3) :
    ambientSphereL2 G hG x ∈ sphereSmoothWeightedCore hO hD := by
  intro n
  exact hasSphereBesselWeight_ambientSphereL2 hO hD n G hG x

lemma ambientSphereL2_derivative_mem_sphereSmoothWeightedCore (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (x : R3) :
    ∃ du : SphereL2, (ambientSphereL2 G hG x,du) ∈ sphereDerivativeGraph hF hO hD i ∧
      du ∈ sphereSmoothWeightedCore hO hD :=
  sphereSmoothWeightedCore_derivative hF hO hD i (ambientSphereL2 G hG x)
    (ambientSphereL2_mem_sphereSmoothWeightedCore hO hD G hG x)

lemma ambientSphereL2_raising_mem_sphereSmoothWeightedCore (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (x : R3) :
    ∃ ru : SphereL2, (ambientSphereL2 G hG x,ru) ∈ sphereRaisingGraph hF hO hD i ∧
      ru ∈ sphereSmoothWeightedCore hO hD :=
  sphereSmoothWeightedCore_raising hF hO hD i (ambientSphereL2 G hG x)
    (ambientSphereL2_mem_sphereSmoothWeightedCore hO hD G hG x)

/-- The actual base derivative is eligible for the same angular operators. -/
lemma fderiv_ambientSphereL2_mem_sphereSmoothWeightedCore (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (X : R3 → R3) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (x : R3) :
    fderiv ℝ (ambientSphereL2 G hG) x (X x) ∈ sphereSmoothWeightedCore hO hD := by
  rw [← ambientSphereL2_baseDirectional X hX G hG x]
  exact ambientSphereL2_mem_sphereSmoothWeightedCore hO hD (ambientBaseDirectional X G)
    (contDiff_ambientBaseDirectional X hX G hG) x

lemma frameHorizontalLift_mem_sphereSmoothWeightedCore (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (C : R3 → Fin 3 → Fin 3 → ℝ)
    (hC : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => C x i j)) (X : R3 → R3)
    (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (x : R3) :
    ambientSphereL2 (ambientFrameHorizontal C X G)
      (contDiff_ambientFrameHorizontal C hC X hX G hG) x ∈ sphereSmoothWeightedCore hO hD :=
  ambientSphereL2_mem_sphereSmoothWeightedCore hO hD (ambientFrameHorizontal C X G)
    (contDiff_ambientFrameHorizontal C hC X hX G hG) x

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.AmbientSmoothWeightedCore
``````

## Calderon.AmbientReferenceCovariantCore

SHA256 `d26b0d325e1d2a3aafb152bdeb4e8972037e657bdb09678e0dd90e06111a20cb`.

``````lean
import Calderon.AmbientSmoothWeightedCore
import Calderon.CovariantHarmonicEnergy

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open scoped ContDiff Topology ENNReal
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.AmbientReferenceCovariantCore
open SphereHarmonic SpectralCoreRegularity SmoothSphereFields SmoothMovingFrameFields
  AngularWeightedCore AmbientSmoothWeightedCore CovariantHarmonicEnergy
  MovingFrameConnection SmoothMetricFrame MetricOperator ConformalDepth RadiusProfile

attribute [local irreducible] referenceMetricGramFrame referenceConnectionFamily
  metricOperatorField referenceMetric dilatedMetric referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient
  referenceHarmonicCovariantDerivative

/-- Smoothness is proved for the source's actual reference coefficients. -/
lemma contDiff_referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient_field (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (X : R3 → R3) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X)
    (i j : Fin 3) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient g L lam x (X x) i j) := by
  have hpair : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y : R3 => (lam,y)) := contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id
  have hM : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L)) :=
    (contDiff_referenceMetricOperator_joint g hg L).comp hpair
  have hΓ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun y => referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,y)) :=
    (contDiff_referenceConnectionFamily g hg L).comp hpair
  simpa only [referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient] using
    contDiff_frameConnectionCoefficient_field
      (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L))
      (fun y => referenceConnectionFamily g L (lam,y))
      (fun y => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y)) hM hΓ
      (fun a => contDiff_referenceMetricGramFrame_slice g hg L lam a) X hX i j

lemma referenceFrameHorizontalLift_mem_sphereSmoothWeightedCore
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (X : R3 → R3) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ)
    (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (x : R3) :
    ambientSphereL2
      (ambientFrameHorizontal (fun y => referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient g L lam y (X y)) X G)
      (contDiff_ambientFrameHorizontal _
        (fun i j => contDiff_referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient_field g hg L lam X hX i j)
        X hX G hG) x ∈ sphereSmoothWeightedCore hO hD :=
  frameHorizontalLift_mem_sphereSmoothWeightedCore hO hD _
    (fun i j => contDiff_referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient_field g hg L lam X hX i j)
    X hX G hG x

/-- Exact reference covariant coordinates for an actual smooth field, in every degree. -/
lemma sphereHarmonicCoordinate_referenceFrameHorizontal
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (k : ℕ)
    (X : R3 → R3) (hX : ContDiff ℝ ∞ X) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ)
    (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (x : R3) :
    sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k
      (ambientSphereL2
        (ambientFrameHorizontal (fun y => referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient g L lam y (X y)) X G)
        (contDiff_ambientFrameHorizontal _
          (fun i j => contDiff_referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient_field g hg L lam X hX i j)
          X hX G hG) x) =
      referenceHarmonicCovariantDerivative g L lam k
        (fun y => sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (ambientSphereL2 G hG y)) x (X x) := by
  simpa only [referenceHarmonicCovariantDerivative] using
    sphereHarmonicCoordinate_frameHorizontal hO hD k _
      (fun i j => contDiff_referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient_field g hg L lam X hX i j)
      (fun y i j => referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient_skew g hg L lam y (X y) i j)
      X hX G hG x

/-- The actual source Gram-frame directions give smooth fields in the exact core. -/
lemma referenceGramFrameHorizontalLift_mem_sphereSmoothWeightedCore
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (i : Fin 3)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (x : R3) :
    ambientSphereL2
      (ambientFrameHorizontal
        (fun y => referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient g L lam y
          (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y) i))
        (fun y => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,y) i) G)
      (contDiff_ambientFrameHorizontal _
        (fun a b => contDiff_referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient_field g hg L lam _
          (contDiff_referenceMetricGramFrame_slice g hg L lam i) a b)
        _ (contDiff_referenceMetricGramFrame_slice g hg L lam i) G hG) x ∈
      sphereSmoothWeightedCore hO hD :=
  referenceFrameHorizontalLift_mem_sphereSmoothWeightedCore hO hD g hg L lam _
    (contDiff_referenceMetricGramFrame_slice g hg L lam i) G hG x

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.AmbientReferenceCovariantCore
``````

## Calderon.BoundedAngularShift

SHA256 `c0af2b7293ce8faf28d8c6394770361852d91acefe2ebb93745ffe96796378a5`.

``````lean
import Calderon.AngularWeightedCore
import Calderon.BoundedSpectralMultiplier

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open scoped Topology ENNReal InnerProductSpace
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.BoundedAngularShift
open SphereHarmonic SphereHilbertDecomposition SpectralCoreRegularity
  SpectralWeightedGraph AngularShiftGraph AngularWeightedCore BoundedSpectralMultiplier

def inverseDegreeWeight (k : ℕ) : ℝ := (1+(k:ℝ))⁻¹

lemma abs_inverseDegreeWeight_le_one (k : ℕ) : |inverseDegreeWeight k| ≤ 1 := by
  have hk : (1:ℝ) ≤ 1+(k:ℝ) := by
    linarith [(Nat.cast_nonneg k : (0:ℝ) ≤ (k:ℝ))]
  rw [inverseDegreeWeight,abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr (by positivity))]
  exact (inv_le_one₀ (by positivity)).mpr hk

/-- The bounded inverse of the exact source Sobolev weight 1+B. -/
def inverseDegreeMultiplier (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) :
    SphereL2 →L[ℝ] SphereL2 :=
  boundedSpectralMultiplier hO hD inverseDegreeWeight 1 (by norm_num)
    abs_inverseDegreeWeight_le_one

lemma inverseDegreeMultiplier_coordinate (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (u : SphereL2) (k : ℕ) :
    sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (inverseDegreeMultiplier hO hD u) =
      inverseDegreeWeight k • sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k u :=
  boundedSpectralMultiplier_mem hO hD inverseDegreeWeight 1 (by norm_num)
    abs_inverseDegreeWeight_le_one u k

lemma inverseDegreeMultiplier_besselGraph (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (u : SphereL2) :
    (inverseDegreeMultiplier hO hD u,u) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD 1 := by
  intro k
  rw [inverseDegreeMultiplier_coordinate,smul_smul]
  simp [besselWeight,inverseDegreeWeight,Real.rpow_one,
    show (1+(k:ℝ)) ≠ 0 by positivity]

lemma inverseDegreeMultiplier_of_besselGraph (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (u w : SphereL2)
    (hw : (u,w) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD 1) :
    inverseDegreeMultiplier hO hD w = u := by
  apply (sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD).injective
  apply lp.ext
  funext k
  change sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (inverseDegreeMultiplier hO hD w) =
    sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k u
  rw [inverseDegreeMultiplier_coordinate,hw k,smul_smul]
  simp [besselWeight,inverseDegreeWeight,Real.rpow_one,
    show (1+(k:ℝ)) ≠ 0 by positivity]

lemma sphereBesselGraph_zero_order (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (u : SphereL2) :
    (u,u) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD 0 := by
  intro k
  simp only [besselWeight_zero_order,one_smul]

lemma exists_normalizedDerivative (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (u : SphereL2) :
    ∃ v : SphereL2, (inverseDegreeMultiplier hO hD u,v) ∈
      sphereDerivativeGraph hF hO hD i := by
  obtain ⟨v,hv,_⟩ := exists_sphereDerivativeGraph_hasWeight hF hO hD i 0 (by norm_num)
    (inverseDegreeMultiplier hO hD u)
    ⟨u,by simpa using inverseDegreeMultiplier_besselGraph hO hD u⟩
  exact ⟨v,hv⟩

lemma exists_normalizedRaising (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (u : SphereL2) :
    ∃ v : SphereL2, (inverseDegreeMultiplier hO hD u,v) ∈
      sphereRaisingGraph hF hO hD i := by
  obtain ⟨v,hv,_⟩ := exists_sphereRaisingGraph_hasWeight hF hO hD i 0 (by norm_num)
    (inverseDegreeMultiplier hO hD u)
    ⟨u,by simpa using inverseDegreeMultiplier_besselGraph hO hD u⟩
  exact ⟨v,hv⟩

def normalizedDerivativeOutput (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (u : SphereL2) : SphereL2 := (exists_normalizedDerivative hF hO hD i u).choose

def normalizedRaisingOutput (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (u : SphereL2) : SphereL2 := (exists_normalizedRaising hF hO hD i u).choose

lemma normalizedDerivativeOutput_graph (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (u : SphereL2) :
    (inverseDegreeMultiplier hO hD u,normalizedDerivativeOutput hF hO hD i u) ∈
      sphereDerivativeGraph hF hO hD i :=
  (exists_normalizedDerivative hF hO hD i u).choose_spec

lemma normalizedRaisingOutput_graph (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (u : SphereL2) :
    (inverseDegreeMultiplier hO hD u,normalizedRaisingOutput hF hO hD i u) ∈
      sphereRaisingGraph hF hO hD i :=
  (exists_normalizedRaising hF hO hD i u).choose_spec

lemma normalizedDerivativeOutput_add (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (u v : SphereL2) :
    normalizedDerivativeOutput hF hO hD i (u+v) =
      normalizedDerivativeOutput hF hO hD i u + normalizedDerivativeOutput hF hO hD i v := by
  apply sphereDerivativeGraph_output_unique hF hO hD i (inverseDegreeMultiplier hO hD (u+v))
  · exact normalizedDerivativeOutput_graph hF hO hD i (u+v)
  · have h := (sphereDerivativeGraph hF hO hD i).add_mem
      (normalizedDerivativeOutput_graph hF hO hD i u)
      (normalizedDerivativeOutput_graph hF hO hD i v)
    change (inverseDegreeMultiplier hO hD u + inverseDegreeMultiplier hO hD v,
      normalizedDerivativeOutput hF hO hD i u + normalizedDerivativeOutput hF hO hD i v) ∈
        sphereDerivativeGraph hF hO hD i at h
    rw [← map_add] at h
    exact h

lemma normalizedRaisingOutput_add (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (u v : SphereL2) :
    normalizedRaisingOutput hF hO hD i (u+v) =
      normalizedRaisingOutput hF hO hD i u + normalizedRaisingOutput hF hO hD i v := by
  apply sphereRaisingGraph_output_unique hF hO hD i (inverseDegreeMultiplier hO hD (u+v))
  · exact normalizedRaisingOutput_graph hF hO hD i (u+v)
  · have h := (sphereRaisingGraph hF hO hD i).add_mem
      (normalizedRaisingOutput_graph hF hO hD i u)
      (normalizedRaisingOutput_graph hF hO hD i v)
    change (inverseDegreeMultiplier hO hD u + inverseDegreeMultiplier hO hD v,
      normalizedRaisingOutput hF hO hD i u + normalizedRaisingOutput hF hO hD i v) ∈
        sphereRaisingGraph hF hO hD i at h
    rw [← map_add] at h
    exact h

lemma normalizedDerivativeOutput_smul (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (c : ℝ) (u : SphereL2) :
    normalizedDerivativeOutput hF hO hD i (c • u) =
      c • normalizedDerivativeOutput hF hO hD i u := by
  apply sphereDerivativeGraph_output_unique hF hO hD i (inverseDegreeMultiplier hO hD (c • u))
  · exact normalizedDerivativeOutput_graph hF hO hD i (c • u)
  · have h := (sphereDerivativeGraph hF hO hD i).smul_mem c
      (normalizedDerivativeOutput_graph hF hO hD i u)
    change (c • inverseDegreeMultiplier hO hD u,
      c • normalizedDerivativeOutput hF hO hD i u) ∈ sphereDerivativeGraph hF hO hD i at h
    rw [← map_smul] at h
    exact h

lemma normalizedRaisingOutput_smul (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (c : ℝ) (u : SphereL2) :
    normalizedRaisingOutput hF hO hD i (c • u) =
      c • normalizedRaisingOutput hF hO hD i u := by
  apply sphereRaisingGraph_output_unique hF hO hD i (inverseDegreeMultiplier hO hD (c • u))
  · exact normalizedRaisingOutput_graph hF hO hD i (c • u)
  · have h := (sphereRaisingGraph hF hO hD i).smul_mem c
      (normalizedRaisingOutput_graph hF hO hD i u)
    change (c • inverseDegreeMultiplier hO hD u,
      c • normalizedRaisingOutput hF hO hD i u) ∈ sphereRaisingGraph hF hO hD i at h
    rw [← map_smul] at h
    exact h

lemma norm_normalizedDerivativeOutput_le (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (u : SphereL2) : ‖normalizedDerivativeOutput hF hO hD i u‖ ≤ 2 * ‖u‖ := by
  have h := norm_sq_weighted_derivative_le hF hO hD i 0 (by norm_num)
    (inverseDegreeMultiplier hO hD u) u
    (normalizedDerivativeOutput hF hO hD i u) (normalizedDerivativeOutput hF hO hD i u)
    (by simpa using inverseDegreeMultiplier_besselGraph hO hD u)
    (normalizedDerivativeOutput_graph hF hO hD i u)
    (sphereBesselGraph_zero_order hO hD _)
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (normalizedDerivativeOutput hF hO hD i u),norm_nonneg u]

lemma norm_normalizedRaisingOutput_le (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (u : SphereL2) : ‖normalizedRaisingOutput hF hO hD i u‖ ≤ 2 * ‖u‖ := by
  have h := norm_sq_weighted_raising_le hF hO hD i 0 (by norm_num)
    (inverseDegreeMultiplier hO hD u) u
    (normalizedRaisingOutput hF hO hD i u) (normalizedRaisingOutput hF hO hD i u)
    (by simpa using inverseDegreeMultiplier_besselGraph hO hD u)
    (normalizedRaisingOutput_graph hF hO hD i u)
    (sphereBesselGraph_zero_order hO hD _)
  norm_num at h
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (normalizedRaisingOutput hF hO hD i u),norm_nonneg u]

/-- Genuine A_i (1+B)^{-1}, constructed from exact coordinates and their proved estimate. -/
def normalizedDerivative (hF : SphereFischerInner) (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3) : SphereL2 →L[ℝ] SphereL2 :=
  LinearMap.mkContinuous
    ({ toFun := normalizedDerivativeOutput hF hO hD i
       map_add' := normalizedDerivativeOutput_add hF hO hD i
       map_smul' := normalizedDerivativeOutput_smul hF hO hD i } : SphereL2 →ₗ[ℝ] SphereL2)
    2 (norm_normalizedDerivativeOutput_le hF hO hD i)

/-- Genuine A_i* (1+B)^{-1}; the constant input has not been discarded. -/
def normalizedRaising (hF : SphereFischerInner) (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3) : SphereL2 →L[ℝ] SphereL2 :=
  LinearMap.mkContinuous
    ({ toFun := normalizedRaisingOutput hF hO hD i
       map_add' := normalizedRaisingOutput_add hF hO hD i
       map_smul' := normalizedRaisingOutput_smul hF hO hD i } : SphereL2 →ₗ[ℝ] SphereL2)
    2 (norm_normalizedRaisingOutput_le hF hO hD i)

lemma normalizedDerivative_graph (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (u w : SphereL2) (hw : (u,w) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD 1) :
    (u,normalizedDerivative hF hO hD i w) ∈ sphereDerivativeGraph hF hO hD i := by
  rw [← inverseDegreeMultiplier_of_besselGraph hO hD u w hw]
  exact normalizedDerivativeOutput_graph hF hO hD i w

lemma normalizedRaising_graph (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (u w : SphereL2) (hw : (u,w) ∈ sphereBesselGraph hO hD 1) :
    (u,normalizedRaising hF hO hD i w) ∈ sphereRaisingGraph hF hO hD i := by
  rw [← inverseDegreeMultiplier_of_besselGraph hO hD u w hw]
  exact normalizedRaisingOutput_graph hF hO hD i w

lemma norm_normalizedDerivative_le (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3) :
    ‖normalizedDerivative hF hO hD i‖ ≤ 2 :=
  (normalizedDerivative hF hO hD i).opNorm_le_bound (by norm_num)
    (norm_normalizedDerivativeOutput_le hF hO hD i)

lemma norm_normalizedRaising_le (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3) :
    ‖normalizedRaising hF hO hD i‖ ≤ 2 :=
  (normalizedRaising hF hO hD i).opNorm_le_bound (by norm_num)
    (norm_normalizedRaisingOutput_le hF hO hD i)

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.BoundedAngularShift

``````

## Calderon.AmbientAngularShift

SHA256 `ff56ae92c3946316194d5e14fd77b1f5f9814b9a55a346c7bfac37d0afeb7a07`.

``````lean
import Calderon.BoundedAngularShift
import Calderon.SmoothAngularApplication

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set Filter
open scoped ContDiff Topology ENNReal
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.AmbientAngularShift
open SphereHarmonic SmoothSphereFields SmoothAngularApplication
  SpectralCoreRegularity SpectralWeightedGraph AngularShiftGraph
  BoundedAngularShift WeightedBaseSpectral WeightedAngularConvergence

def ambientDerivativeField (hF : SphereFischerInner) (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ)
    (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) : R3 → SphereL2 :=
  fun x => normalizedDerivative hF hO hD i
    (ambientBesselField hO hD 1 (by norm_num) G hG x)

def ambientRaisingField (hF : SphereFischerInner) (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ)
    (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) : R3 → SphereL2 :=
  fun x => normalizedRaising hF hO hD i
    (ambientBesselField hO hD 1 (by norm_num) G hG x)

/-- A_i of the actual smooth probability-sphere field exists, with its full endpoint. -/
lemma ambientDerivativeField_graph (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (x : R3) :
    (ambientSphereL2 G hG x,ambientDerivativeField hF hO hD i G hG x) ∈
      sphereDerivativeGraph hF hO hD i :=
  normalizedDerivative_graph hF hO hD i _ _
    (ambientBesselField_graph hO hD 1 (by norm_num) G hG x)

/-- A_i* of the actual smooth field exists; it also acts on constant input. -/
lemma ambientRaisingField_graph (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (x : R3) :
    (ambientSphereL2 G hG x,ambientRaisingField hF hO hD i G hG x) ∈
      sphereRaisingGraph hF hO hD i :=
  normalizedRaising_graph hF hO hD i _ _
    (ambientBesselField_graph hO hD 1 (by norm_num) G hG x)

lemma contDiff_ambientDerivativeField (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (ambientDerivativeField hF hO hD i G hG) :=
  (normalizedDerivative hF hO hD i).contDiff.comp
    (contDiff_ambientBesselField hO hD 1 (by norm_num) G hG)

lemma contDiff_ambientRaisingField (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (ambientRaisingField hF hO hD i G hG) :=
  (normalizedRaising hF hO hD i).contDiff.comp
    (contDiff_ambientBesselField hO hD 1 (by norm_num) G hG)

lemma ambientDerivativeField_eq_zero (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (K : Set R3)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x,theta.val)=0) (x : R3) (hx : x ∉ K) :
    ambientDerivativeField hF hO hD i G hG x = 0 := by
  unfold ambientDerivativeField
  rw [ambientBesselField_eq_zero hO hD 1 (by norm_num) G hG K hz x hx,map_zero]

lemma ambientRaisingField_eq_zero (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (K : Set R3)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x,theta.val)=0) (x : R3) (hx : x ∉ K) :
    ambientRaisingField hF hO hD i G hG x = 0 := by
  unfold ambientRaisingField
  rw [ambientBesselField_eq_zero hO hD 1 (by norm_num) G hG K hz x hx,map_zero]

lemma hasCompactSupport_ambientDerivativeField (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x,theta.val)=0) :
    HasCompactSupport (ambientDerivativeField hF hO hD i G hG) :=
  HasCompactSupport.intro hK
    (fun x hx => ambientDerivativeField_eq_zero hF hO hD i G hG K hz x hx)

lemma hasCompactSupport_ambientRaisingField (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x,theta.val)=0) :
    HasCompactSupport (ambientRaisingField hF hO hD i G hG) :=
  HasCompactSupport.intro hK
    (fun x hx => ambientRaisingField_eq_zero hF hO hD i G hG K hz x hx)

lemma integrable_ambientDerivativeField_norm_sq (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (i : Fin 3)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x,theta.val)=0) :
    Integrable (fun x => ReferenceDensityBounds.referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      ‖ambientDerivativeField hF hO hD i G hG x‖^2) :=
  integrable_referenceBase_norm_sq g hg L lam _
    (contDiff_ambientDerivativeField hF hO hD i G hG).continuous
    (hasCompactSupport_ambientDerivativeField hF hO hD i G hG K hK hz)

lemma integrable_ambientRaisingField_norm_sq (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (i : Fin 3)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x,theta.val)=0) :
    Integrable (fun x => ReferenceDensityBounds.referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      ‖ambientRaisingField hF hO hD i G hG x‖^2) :=
  integrable_referenceBase_norm_sq g hg L lam _
    (contDiff_ambientRaisingField hF hO hD i G hG).continuous
    (hasCompactSupport_ambientRaisingField hF hO hD i G hG K hK hz)

lemma ambientDerivativeField_partialSum_graph (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (n : ℕ) (x : R3) :
    (sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD (n+1) (ambientSphereL2 G hG x),
      sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n (ambientDerivativeField hF hO hD i G hG x)) ∈
        sphereDerivativeGraph hF hO hD i :=
  sphereDerivativeGraph_partialSum hF hO hD i _ _
    (ambientDerivativeField_graph hF hO hD i G hG x) n

lemma ambientRaisingField_partialSum_graph (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (i : Fin 3)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (n : ℕ) (x : R3) :
    (sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n (ambientSphereL2 G hG x),
      sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD (n+1) (ambientRaisingField hF hO hD i G hG x)) ∈
        sphereRaisingGraph hF hO hD i :=
  sphereRaisingGraph_partialSum hF hO hD i _ _
    (ambientRaisingField_graph hF hO hD i G hG x) n

theorem tendsto_referenceBaseLift_ambientDerivativeField
    (hF : SphereFischerInner) (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (i : Fin 3)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x,theta.val)=0) :
    let V := ambientDerivativeField hF hO hD i G hG
    let hV := (contDiff_ambientDerivativeField hF hO hD i G hG).continuous
    let hc := hasCompactSupport_ambientDerivativeField hF hO hD i G hG K hK hz
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => referenceBaseLift g hg L lam
      (fun x => sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n (V x))
      ((sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n).continuous.comp hV)
      (hc.comp_left (map_zero _))) atTop (𝓝 (referenceBaseLift g hg L lam V hV hc)) :=
  tendsto_referenceBaseLift_sphereHarmonicPartialSum g hg L lam hO hD _
    (contDiff_ambientDerivativeField hF hO hD i G hG).continuous
    (hasCompactSupport_ambientDerivativeField hF hO hD i G hG K hK hz)

theorem tendsto_referenceBaseLift_ambientRaisingField
    (hF : SphereFischerInner) (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (i : Fin 3)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x,theta.val)=0) :
    let V := ambientRaisingField hF hO hD i G hG
    let hV := (contDiff_ambientRaisingField hF hO hD i G hG).continuous
    let hc := hasCompactSupport_ambientRaisingField hF hO hD i G hG K hK hz
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => referenceBaseLift g hg L lam
      (fun x => sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n (V x))
      ((sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n).continuous.comp hV)
      (hc.comp_left (map_zero _))) atTop (𝓝 (referenceBaseLift g hg L lam V hV hc)) :=
  tendsto_referenceBaseLift_sphereHarmonicPartialSum g hg L lam hO hD _
    (contDiff_ambientRaisingField hF hO hD i G hG).continuous
    (hasCompactSupport_ambientRaisingField hF hO hD i G hG K hK hz)

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.AmbientAngularShift
``````

## Calderon.AmbientReferenceRaising

SHA256 `84a1ff0f7f430fc47f021df70378aa39861e92b5193d80a70cbe65268f47a449`.

``````lean
import Calderon.AmbientAngularShift
import Calderon.AmbientReferenceCovariantCore
import Calderon.HarmonicRaisingModel
import Calderon.PositiveSpectralCore
import Mathlib.Tactic.Module

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set Filter
open scoped ContDiff Topology ENNReal
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.AmbientReferenceRaising
open SphereHarmonic SphereHilbertDecomposition SmoothSphereFields SmoothAngularApplication
  SmoothMovingFrameFields AmbientReferenceCovariantCore SmoothMetricFrame MovingFrameConnection
  SpectralCoreRegularity SpectralWeightedGraph AngularShiftGraph BoundedAngularShift
  WeightedBaseSpectral WeightedAngularConvergence HarmonicRaisingModel CovariantHarmonicEnergy
  PositiveSpectralCore

def referenceHorizontalAmbient (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ) (i : Fin 3)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) : R3 × R3 → ℝ :=
  ambientFrameHorizontal
    (fun x => referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient g L lam x
      (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i))
    (fun x => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) G

lemma contDiff_referenceHorizontalAmbient (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (i : Fin 3) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (referenceHorizontalAmbient g L lam i G) :=
  contDiff_ambientFrameHorizontal _
    (fun a b => contDiff_referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient_field g hg L lam _
      (contDiff_referenceMetricGramFrame_slice g hg L lam i) a b)
    _ (contDiff_referenceMetricGramFrame_slice g hg L lam i) G hG

def referenceHorizontalField (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (i : Fin 3) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :
    R3 → SphereL2 :=
  ambientSphereL2 (referenceHorizontalAmbient g L lam i G)
    (contDiff_referenceHorizontalAmbient g hg L lam i G hG)

def referenceHorizontalBesselField (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam s : ℝ) (hs : s ≤ 2) (i : Fin 3)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) : R3 → SphereL2 :=
  ambientBesselField hO hD s hs (referenceHorizontalAmbient g L lam i G)
    (contDiff_referenceHorizontalAmbient g hg L lam i G hG)

lemma referenceHorizontalAmbient_sphere_zero (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (i : Fin 3) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G)
    (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x,theta.val)=0) :
    ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, referenceHorizontalAmbient g L lam i G (x,theta.val)=0 :=
  ambientFrameHorizontal_sphere_zero _
    (fun x a b => referenceFrameConnectionCoefficient_skew g hg L lam x
      (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) a b)
    _ G hG K hK.isClosed hz

lemma contDiff_referenceHorizontalField (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (i : Fin 3) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (referenceHorizontalField g hg L lam i G hG) :=
  contDiff_ambientSphereL2 _ (contDiff_referenceHorizontalAmbient g hg L lam i G hG)

lemma contDiff_referenceHorizontalBesselField (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam s : ℝ) (hs : s ≤ 2) (i : Fin 3)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (referenceHorizontalBesselField hO hD g hg L lam s hs i G hG) :=
  contDiff_ambientBesselField hO hD s hs _
    (contDiff_referenceHorizontalAmbient g hg L lam i G hG)

lemma referenceHorizontalField_coordinate (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (i : Fin 3) (k : ℕ) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ)
    (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (x : R3) :
    sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (referenceHorizontalField g hg L lam i G hG x) =
      referenceHarmonicCovariantDerivative g L lam k
        (fun y => sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (ambientSphereL2 G hG y)) x
        (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) :=
  sphereHarmonicCoordinate_referenceFrameHorizontal hO hD g hg L lam k _
    (contDiff_referenceMetricGramFrame_slice g hg L lam i) G hG x

lemma referenceHorizontalBesselField_graph (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam s : ℝ) (hs : s ≤ 2) (i : Fin 3)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (x : R3) :
    (referenceHorizontalField g hg L lam i G hG x,
      referenceHorizontalBesselField hO hD g hg L lam s hs i G hG x) ∈
        sphereBesselGraph hO hD s :=
  ambientBesselField_graph hO hD s hs _
    (contDiff_referenceHorizontalAmbient g hg L lam i G hG) x

/-- The actual source B=k, represented through its exact 1+B graph output. -/
def ambientDegreeField (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) : R3 → SphereL2 :=
  fun x => ambientBesselField hO hD 1 (by norm_num) G hG x - ambientSphereL2 G hG x

lemma ambientDegreeField_coordinate (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G)
    (k : ℕ) (x : R3) :
    sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (ambientDegreeField hO hD G hG x) =
      (k:ℝ) • sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (ambientSphereL2 G hG x) := by
  rw [ambientDegreeField,map_sub,ambientBesselField_graph hO hD 1 (by norm_num) G hG x k]
  simp only [besselWeight,Real.rpow_one]
  module

lemma contDiff_ambientDegreeField (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (ambientDegreeField hO hD G hG) :=
  (contDiff_ambientBesselField hO hD 1 (by norm_num) G hG).sub
    (contDiff_ambientSphereL2 G hG)

def referenceFrameDerivative (g : MatrixField) (L lam : ℝ) (i : Fin 3)
    (f : R3 → ℝ) (x : R3) : ℝ :=
  fderiv ℝ f x (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i)

lemma contDiff_referenceFrameDerivative (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (i : Fin 3) (f : R3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (referenceFrameDerivative g L lam i f) :=
  (hf.fderiv_right (m := ∞) (by simp)).clm_apply
    (contDiff_referenceMetricGramFrame_slice g hg L lam i)

/-- Exact D_i^s=s ∇_i+f_i B on actual all-degree fields. -/
def referenceWeightedInputField (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam s : ℝ) (i : Fin 3) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) : R3 → SphereL2 :=
  fun x => s • referenceHorizontalField g hg L lam i G hG x +
    referenceFrameDerivative g L lam i f x • ambientDegreeField hO hD G hG x

/-- Its genuine 1+B output, constructed using actual Casimir-derived fields. -/
def referenceWeightedBesselField (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam s : ℝ) (i : Fin 3) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) : R3 → SphereL2 :=
  fun x => s • referenceHorizontalBesselField hO hD g hg L lam 1 (by norm_num) i G hG x +
    referenceFrameDerivative g L lam i f x •
      (ambientBesselField hO hD 2 (by norm_num) G hG x -
        ambientBesselField hO hD 1 (by norm_num) G hG x)

lemma contDiff_referenceWeightedInputField (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam s : ℝ) (i : Fin 3) (f : R3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (referenceWeightedInputField hO hD g hg L lam s i f G hG) :=
  ((contDiff_referenceHorizontalField g hg L lam i G hG).const_smul s).add
    ((contDiff_referenceFrameDerivative g hg L lam i f hf).smul
      (contDiff_ambientDegreeField hO hD G hG))

lemma contDiff_referenceWeightedBesselField (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam s : ℝ) (i : Fin 3) (f : R3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (referenceWeightedBesselField hO hD g hg L lam s i f G hG) :=
  ((contDiff_referenceHorizontalBesselField hO hD g hg L lam 1 (by norm_num) i G hG).const_smul s).add
    ((contDiff_referenceFrameDerivative g hg L lam i f hf).smul
      ((contDiff_ambientBesselField hO hD 2 (by norm_num) G hG).sub
        (contDiff_ambientBesselField hO hD 1 (by norm_num) G hG)))

lemma referenceWeightedInputField_coordinate (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam s : ℝ) (i : Fin 3) (f : R3 → ℝ) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ)
    (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (k : ℕ) (x : R3) :
    sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k
      (referenceWeightedInputField hO hD g hg L lam s i f G hG x) =
        referenceWeightedHarmonicDerivative g L lam k
          (fun y => sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (ambientSphereL2 G hG y)) f s x
          (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam,x) i) := by
  rw [referenceWeightedInputField,map_add,map_smul,map_smul,
    referenceHorizontalField_coordinate,ambientDegreeField_coordinate]
  simp only [referenceWeightedHarmonicDerivative,referenceFrameDerivative,smul_smul]
  congr 1
  congr 1
  ring

lemma referenceWeightedBesselField_graph (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam s : ℝ) (i : Fin 3) (f : R3 → ℝ) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ)
    (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (x : R3) :
    (referenceWeightedInputField hO hD g hg L lam s i f G hG x,
      referenceWeightedBesselField hO hD g hg L lam s i f G hG x) ∈
        sphereBesselGraph hO hD 1 := by
  intro k
  simp only [referenceWeightedBesselField,referenceWeightedInputField,ambientDegreeField,
    map_add,map_smul,map_sub]
  rw [referenceHorizontalBesselField_graph hO hD g hg L lam 1 (by norm_num) i G hG x k,
    ambientBesselField_graph hO hD 2 (by norm_num) G hG x k,
    ambientBesselField_graph hO hD 1 (by norm_num) G hG x k]
  simp only [besselWeight,Real.rpow_one,Real.rpow_two]
  module

lemma referenceWeightedBesselField_eq_zero (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam s : ℝ) (i : Fin 3) (f : R3 → ℝ) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ)
    (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x,theta.val)=0) (x : R3) (hx : x ∉ K) :
    referenceWeightedBesselField hO hD g hg L lam s i f G hG x = 0 := by
  have hH := ambientBesselField_eq_zero hO hD 1 (by norm_num)
    (referenceHorizontalAmbient g L lam i G)
    (contDiff_referenceHorizontalAmbient g hg L lam i G hG) K
    (referenceHorizontalAmbient_sphere_zero g hg L lam i G hG K hK hz) x hx
  simp only [referenceWeightedBesselField,referenceHorizontalBesselField,hH,
    ambientBesselField_eq_zero hO hD 2 (by norm_num) G hG K hz x hx,
    ambientBesselField_eq_zero hO hD 1 (by norm_num) G hG K hz x hx,
    smul_zero,sub_self,add_zero]

def referenceAllModeRaising (hF : SphereFischerInner) (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :
    R3 → SphereL2 :=
  fun x => ∑ i : Fin 3, normalizedRaising hF hO hD i
    (referenceWeightedBesselField hO hD g hg L lam 1 i f G hG x)

def referenceAllModeLowering (hF : SphereFischerInner) (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :
    R3 → SphereL2 :=
  fun x => ∑ i : Fin 3, normalizedDerivative hF hO hD i
    (referenceWeightedBesselField hO hD g hg L lam (-1) i f G hG x)

lemma contDiff_referenceAllModeRaising (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (referenceAllModeRaising hF hO hD g hg L lam f G hG) :=
  ContDiff.sum (fun i _ => (normalizedRaising hF hO hD i).contDiff.comp
    (contDiff_referenceWeightedBesselField hO hD g hg L lam 1 i f hf G hG))

lemma contDiff_referenceAllModeLowering (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (referenceAllModeLowering hF hO hD g hg L lam f G hG) :=
  ContDiff.sum (fun i _ => (normalizedDerivative hF hO hD i).contDiff.comp
    (contDiff_referenceWeightedBesselField hO hD g hg L lam (-1) i f hf G hG))

lemma referenceAllModeRaising_coordinate_zero (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (x : R3) :
    sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD 0 (referenceAllModeRaising hF hO hD g hg L lam f G hG x) = 0 := by
  rw [referenceAllModeRaising,map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro i _
  exact (normalizedRaising_graph hF hO hD i _ _
    (referenceWeightedBesselField_graph hO hD g hg L lam 1 i f G hG x)).1

lemma referenceAllModeRaising_coordinate (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (m : ℕ) (x : R3) :
    sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD ((m+1)+1)
      (referenceAllModeRaising hF hO hD g hg L lam f G hG x) =
        referenceHarmonicRaising hF g L lam m
          (fun y => sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (m+1) (ambientSphereL2 G hG y)) f x := by
  rw [referenceAllModeRaising,map_sum]
  unfold referenceHarmonicRaising
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [(normalizedRaising_graph hF hO hD i _ _
    (referenceWeightedBesselField_graph hO hD g hg L lam 1 i f G hG x)).2 (m+1)]
  rw [referenceWeightedInputField_coordinate]

lemma referenceAllModeLowering_coordinate (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (m : ℕ) (x : R3) :
    sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD m
      (referenceAllModeLowering hF hO hD g hg L lam f G hG x) =
        referenceHarmonicLowering hF g L lam m
          (fun y => sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (m+1) (ambientSphereL2 G hG y)) f x := by
  rw [referenceAllModeLowering,map_sum]
  unfold referenceHarmonicLowering
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  rw [normalizedDerivative_graph hF hO hD i _ _
    (referenceWeightedBesselField_graph hO hD g hg L lam (-1) i f G hG x) m]
  rw [referenceWeightedInputField_coordinate]

lemma referenceAllModeRaising_coordinate_one_of_meanZero (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G)
    (hmean : ∀ y, sphereMean (ambientSphereL2 G hG y)=0) (x : R3) :
    sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD 1
      (referenceAllModeRaising hF hO hD g hg L lam f G hG x) = 0 := by
  have hz : (fun y => sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD 0 (ambientSphereL2 G hG y)) =
      (fun _ : R3 => (0 : harmonicSphereSubspace 0)) := by
    funext y
    exact (sphereHarmonicCoordinate_zero_eq_zero_iff hO hD _).mpr (hmean y)
  have hzx : sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD 0 (ambientSphereL2 G hG x) = 0 :=
    congrFun hz x
  have hdf : fderiv ℝ
      (fun y => sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD 0 (ambientSphereL2 G hG y)) x = 0 := by
    rw [hz]
    exact fderiv_const_apply (0 : harmonicSphereSubspace 0)
  rw [referenceAllModeRaising,map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro i _
  have hr := (normalizedRaising_graph hF hO hD i _ _
    (referenceWeightedBesselField_graph hO hD g hg L lam 1 i f G hG x)).2 0
  rw [referenceWeightedInputField_coordinate] at hr
  rw [hr]
  simp [referenceWeightedHarmonicDerivative,referenceHarmonicCovariantDerivative,hdf,hzx]

lemma referenceAllModeRaising_eq_zero (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x,theta.val)=0) (x : R3) (hx : x ∉ K) :
    referenceAllModeRaising hF hO hD g hg L lam f G hG x = 0 := by
  unfold referenceAllModeRaising
  simp only [referenceWeightedBesselField_eq_zero hO hD g hg L lam 1 _ f G hG K hK hz x hx,
    map_zero,Finset.sum_const_zero]

lemma referenceAllModeLowering_eq_zero (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x,theta.val)=0) (x : R3) (hx : x ∉ K) :
    referenceAllModeLowering hF hO hD g hg L lam f G hG x = 0 := by
  unfold referenceAllModeLowering
  simp only [referenceWeightedBesselField_eq_zero hO hD g hg L lam (-1) _ f G hG K hK hz x hx,
    map_zero,Finset.sum_const_zero]

lemma hasCompactSupport_referenceAllModeRaising (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x,theta.val)=0) :
    HasCompactSupport (referenceAllModeRaising hF hO hD g hg L lam f G hG) :=
  HasCompactSupport.intro hK
    (fun x hx => referenceAllModeRaising_eq_zero hF hO hD g hg L lam f G hG K hK hz x hx)

lemma hasCompactSupport_referenceAllModeLowering (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x,theta.val)=0) :
    HasCompactSupport (referenceAllModeLowering hF hO hD g hg L lam f G hG) :=
  HasCompactSupport.intro hK
    (fun x hx => referenceAllModeLowering_eq_zero hF hO hD g hg L lam f G hG K hK hz x hx)

lemma integrable_referenceAllModeRaising_norm_sq (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x,theta.val)=0) :
    Integrable (fun x => ReferenceDensityBounds.referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      ‖referenceAllModeRaising hF hO hD g hg L lam f G hG x‖^2) :=
  integrable_referenceBase_norm_sq g hg L lam _
    (contDiff_referenceAllModeRaising hF hO hD g hg L lam f hf G hG).continuous
    (hasCompactSupport_referenceAllModeRaising hF hO hD g hg L lam f G hG K hK hz)

lemma integrable_referenceAllModeLowering_norm_sq (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x,theta.val)=0) :
    Integrable (fun x => ReferenceDensityBounds.referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      ‖referenceAllModeLowering hF hO hD g hg L lam f G hG x‖^2) :=
  integrable_referenceBase_norm_sq g hg L lam _
    (contDiff_referenceAllModeLowering hF hO hD g hg L lam f hf G hG).continuous
    (hasCompactSupport_referenceAllModeLowering hF hO hD g hg L lam f G hG K hK hz)

theorem tendsto_referenceBaseLift_referenceAllModeRaising
    (hF : SphereFischerInner) (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G)
    (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x,theta.val)=0) :
    let V := referenceAllModeRaising hF hO hD g hg L lam f G hG
    let hV := (contDiff_referenceAllModeRaising hF hO hD g hg L lam f hf G hG).continuous
    let hc := hasCompactSupport_referenceAllModeRaising hF hO hD g hg L lam f G hG K hK hz
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => referenceBaseLift g hg L lam
      (fun x => sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n (V x))
      ((sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n).continuous.comp hV)
      (hc.comp_left (map_zero _))) atTop (𝓝 (referenceBaseLift g hg L lam V hV hc)) :=
  tendsto_referenceBaseLift_sphereHarmonicPartialSum g hg L lam hO hD _
    (contDiff_referenceAllModeRaising hF hO hD g hg L lam f hf G hG).continuous
    (hasCompactSupport_referenceAllModeRaising hF hO hD g hg L lam f G hG K hK hz)

theorem tendsto_referenceBaseLift_referenceAllModeLowering
    (hF : SphereFischerInner) (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G)
    (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x,theta.val)=0) :
    let V := referenceAllModeLowering hF hO hD g hg L lam f G hG
    let hV := (contDiff_referenceAllModeLowering hF hO hD g hg L lam f hf G hG).continuous
    let hc := hasCompactSupport_referenceAllModeLowering hF hO hD g hg L lam f G hG K hK hz
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => referenceBaseLift g hg L lam
      (fun x => sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n (V x))
      ((sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD n).continuous.comp hV)
      (hc.comp_left (map_zero _))) atTop (𝓝 (referenceBaseLift g hg L lam V hV hc)) :=
  tendsto_referenceBaseLift_sphereHarmonicPartialSum g hg L lam hO hD _
    (contDiff_referenceAllModeLowering hF hO hD g hg L lam f hf G hG).continuous
    (hasCompactSupport_referenceAllModeLowering hF hO hD g hg L lam f G hG K hK hz)

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.AmbientReferenceRaising
``````

## Calderon.WeightedSpectralEnergy

SHA256 `b698525afe9bbe96b8fedfa0fa826f875dc4c861e2483cd9a7ea7a2ae3dfd97e`.

``````lean
import Calderon.WeightedAngularConvergence
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.DominatedConvergence

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set Filter
open scoped ContDiff Topology ENNReal InnerProductSpace
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.WeightedSpectralEnergy
open SphereHarmonic SphereHilbertDecomposition SpectralCoreRegularity PositiveSpectralCore
  SpectralWeightedGraph WeightedBaseSpectral WeightedAngularConvergence ReferenceDensityBounds

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
lemma norm_harmonicCoordinate_sum_sq (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (s : Finset ℕ) (u : SphereL2) :
    ‖∑ k ∈ s, (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k u : SphereL2)‖^2 =
      ∑ k ∈ s, ‖sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k u‖^2 := by
  change ‖∑ k ∈ s, (harmonicSphereSubspace k).subtypeₗᵢ
      ((sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD u) k)‖^2 =
    ∑ k ∈ s, ‖(sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD u) k‖^2
  exact (orthogonalFamily_harmonicSphereSubspaces hO).norm_sum
    (fun k : ℕ => (sphereHarmonicDecomposition hO hD u) k) s

lemma norm_spherePositivePartialSum_sq (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (n : ℕ) (u : SphereL2) :
    ‖spherePositivePartialSum hO hD n u‖^2 =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, ‖sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (k+1) u‖^2 := by
  classical
  have hi : Set.InjOn (fun k : ℕ => k+1) (Finset.range n) :=
    fun a _ b _ h => Nat.add_right_cancel h
  have hs := norm_harmonicCoordinate_sum_sq hO hD
    ((Finset.range n).image (fun k : ℕ => k+1)) u
  rw [Finset.sum_image hi,Finset.sum_image hi] at hs
  simpa only [spherePositivePartialSum_apply,sphereHarmonicCoordinate_apply] using hs

/-- A finite sum over consecutive genuine output degrees, including j=0. -/
def sphereShiftPartialSum (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (j n : ℕ) (u : SphereL2) : SphereL2 :=
  ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (k+j) u : SphereL2)

lemma norm_sphereShiftPartialSum_sq (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (j n : ℕ) (u : SphereL2) :
    ‖sphereShiftPartialSum hO hD j n u‖^2 =
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, ‖sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (k+j) u‖^2 := by
  classical
  have hi : Set.InjOn (fun k : ℕ => k+j) (Finset.range n) :=
    fun a _ b _ h => Nat.add_right_cancel h
  have hs := norm_harmonicCoordinate_sum_sq hO hD
    ((Finset.range n).image (fun k : ℕ => k+j)) u
  rw [Finset.sum_image hi,Finset.sum_image hi] at hs
  exact hs

lemma norm_sphereShiftPartialSum_le (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (j n : ℕ) (u : SphereL2) :
    ‖sphereShiftPartialSum hO hD j n u‖ ≤ ‖u‖ := by
  classical
  have hi : Set.InjOn (fun k : ℕ => k+j) (Finset.range n) :=
    fun a _ b _ h => Nat.add_right_cancel h
  have hs := norm_sum_sphereHarmonicCoordinates_le hO hD
    ((Finset.range n).image (fun k : ℕ => k+j)) u
  rw [Finset.sum_image hi] at hs
  exact hs

lemma sphereShiftPartialSum_eq_sub (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (j n : ℕ) (u : SphereL2) :
    sphereShiftPartialSum hO hD j n u =
      sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD (j+n) u - sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD j u := by
  unfold sphereShiftPartialSum
  rw [sphereHarmonicPartialSum_apply,sphereHarmonicPartialSum_apply,
    Finset.sum_range_add,add_sub_cancel_left]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro k _
  change (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (k+j) u : SphereL2) =
    (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (j+k) u : SphereL2)
  exact congrArg (fun l : ℕ => (sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD l u : SphereL2))
    (Nat.add_comm k j)

lemma sphereHarmonicPartialSum_eq_zero_of_coordinates (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (j : ℕ) (u : SphereL2)
    (hu : ∀ k < j, sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k u=0) :
    sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD j u=0 := by
  rw [sphereHarmonicPartialSum_apply]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro k hk
  simpa only [sphereHarmonicCoordinate_apply,Submodule.coe_zero] using
    congrArg (fun v : harmonicSphereSubspace k => (v : SphereL2))
      (hu k (Finset.mem_range.mp hk))

lemma tendsto_sphereShiftPartialSum (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (j : ℕ) (u : SphereL2)
    (hu : ∀ k < j, sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k u=0) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => sphereShiftPartialSum hO hD j n u) atTop (𝓝 u) := by
  simp_rw [sphereShiftPartialSum_eq_sub,
    sphereHarmonicPartialSum_eq_zero_of_coordinates hO hD j u hu,sub_zero]
  simpa only [Nat.add_comm,Function.comp_def] using
    (tendsto_sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD u).comp (tendsto_add_atTop_nat j)

lemma continuous_sphereShiftPartialSum (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (j n : ℕ) (U : R3 → SphereL2) (hU : Continuous U) :
    Continuous (fun x => sphereShiftPartialSum hO hD j n (U x)) := by
  simp_rw [sphereShiftPartialSum_eq_sub]
  exact ((sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD (j+n)).continuous.comp hU).sub
    ((sphereHarmonicPartialSum hO hD j).continuous.comp hU)

lemma integrable_referenceBase_weighted_norm_sq (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (a : R3 → ℝ) (ha : Continuous a)
    (U : R3 → SphereL2) (hU : Continuous U) (hc : HasCompactSupport U) :
    Integrable (fun x => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * a x * ‖U x‖^2) := by
  have hnorm : HasCompactSupport (fun x => ‖U x‖^2) :=
    hc.comp_left (g := fun u : SphereL2 => ‖u‖^2) (by simp)
  have hprod : HasCompactSupport
      (fun x => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * a x * ‖U x‖^2) := hnorm.mul_left
  exact (((continuous_referenceBaseDensity g hg L lam).mul ha).mul
    (hU.norm.pow 2)).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hprod

/-- Proved weighted-square convergence on actual compact fields and exact output degrees. -/
theorem tendsto_integral_sphereShiftPartialSum_sq
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (a : R3 → ℝ) (ha : Continuous a) (U : R3 → SphereL2) (hU : Continuous U)
    (hc : HasCompactSupport U) (j : ℕ)
    (hz : ∀ x k, k < j → sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (U x)=0) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ∫ x, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * a x *
      ‖sphereShiftPartialSum hO hD j n (U x)‖^2) atTop
      (𝓝 (∫ x, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * a x * ‖U x‖^2)) := by
  have hnorm : HasCompactSupport (fun x => ‖U x‖^2) :=
    hc.comp_left (g := fun u : SphereL2 => ‖u‖^2) (by simp)
  have hprod : HasCompactSupport
      (fun x => |referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * a x| * ‖U x‖^2) := hnorm.mul_left
  have hb : Integrable (fun x => |referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * a x| * ‖U x‖^2) :=
    ((((continuous_referenceBaseDensity g hg L lam).mul ha).abs).mul
      (hU.norm.pow 2)).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hprod
  apply tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence
    (fun x => |referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * a x| * ‖U x‖^2)
  · intro n
    exact ((((continuous_referenceBaseDensity g hg L lam).mul ha).mul
      ((continuous_sphereShiftPartialSum hO hD j n U hU).norm.pow 2))).aestronglyMeasurable
  · exact hb
  · intro n
    apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
    intro x
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_mul (referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * a x)
        (‖sphereShiftPartialSum hO hD j n (U x)‖^2),
      abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg ‖sphereShiftPartialSum hO hD j n (U x)‖)]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      ((sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mpr
        (norm_sphereShiftPartialSum_le hO hD j n (U x))) (abs_nonneg _)
  · apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
    intro x
    exact ((tendsto_sphereShiftPartialSum hO hD j (U x) (hz x)).norm.pow 2).const_mul
      (referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * a x)

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.WeightedSpectralEnergy

``````
