## Calderon.FourTermProfileEnergy

SHA256 `9da892d25f7fe709657333df6d5e9a4aaf8a5913af3322a4fb2827dd748ebda9`.

``````lean
import Calderon.WeightedSpectralEnergy

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set Filter
open scoped ContDiff Topology ENNReal
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.FourTermProfileEnergy
open SphereHarmonic SpectralCoreRegularity WeightedBaseSpectral WeightedSpectralEnergy
  ReferenceDensityBounds

/-- The precise manuscript four terms, on constructed fields. -/
def fourTermEnergyDensity (beta : R3 → ℝ) (H : Fin 3 → R3 → SphereL2)
    (U1 : R3 → SphereL2) (Hhalf : Fin 3 → R3 → SphereL2)
    (Uthree : R3 → SphereL2) (x : R3) : ℝ :=
  (∑ i : Fin 3, ‖H i x‖^2) + beta x^2 * ‖U1 x‖^2 +
    (beta x)⁻¹ * (∑ i : Fin 3, ‖Hhalf i x‖^2) + beta x * ‖Uthree x‖^2

def fourTermCutDensity (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (n : ℕ) (beta : R3 → ℝ) (H : Fin 3 → R3 → SphereL2)
    (U1 : R3 → SphereL2) (Hhalf : Fin 3 → R3 → SphereL2)
    (Uthree : R3 → SphereL2) : R3 → ℝ :=
  fourTermEnergyDensity beta
    (fun i x => sphereShiftPartialSum hO hD 1 n (H i x))
    (fun x => sphereShiftPartialSum hO hD 1 n (U1 x))
    (fun i x => sphereShiftPartialSum hO hD 1 n (Hhalf i x))
    (fun x => sphereShiftPartialSum hO hD 1 n (Uthree x))

lemma continuous_fourTermEnergyDensity (beta : R3 → ℝ) (hb : Continuous beta)
    (hbi : Continuous (fun x => (beta x)⁻¹))
    (H : Fin 3 → R3 → SphereL2) (hH : ∀ i, Continuous (H i))
    (U1 : R3 → SphereL2) (h1 : Continuous U1)
    (Hhalf : Fin 3 → R3 → SphereL2) (hh : ∀ i, Continuous (Hhalf i))
    (Uthree : R3 → SphereL2) (h3 : Continuous Uthree) :
    Continuous (fourTermEnergyDensity beta H U1 Hhalf Uthree) :=
  ((((continuous_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ => (hH i).norm.pow 2)).add
    ((hb.pow 2).mul (h1.norm.pow 2))).add
    (hbi.mul (continuous_finsetSum Finset.univ (fun i _ => (hh i).norm.pow 2)))).add
    (hb.mul (h3.norm.pow 2)))

lemma fourTermEnergyDensity_nonneg (beta : R3 → ℝ)
    (H : Fin 3 → R3 → SphereL2) (U1 : R3 → SphereL2)
    (Hhalf : Fin 3 → R3 → SphereL2) (Uthree : R3 → SphereL2)
    (x : R3) (hb : 0 ≤ beta x) : 0 ≤ fourTermEnergyDensity beta H U1 Hhalf Uthree x := by
  unfold fourTermEnergyDensity
  positivity

lemma fourTermCutDensity_le (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (n : ℕ) (beta : R3 → ℝ) (H : Fin 3 → R3 → SphereL2) (U1 : R3 → SphereL2)
    (Hhalf : Fin 3 → R3 → SphereL2) (Uthree : R3 → SphereL2)
    (x : R3) (hb : 0 ≤ beta x) :
    fourTermCutDensity hO hD n beta H U1 Hhalf Uthree x ≤
      fourTermEnergyDensity beta H U1 Hhalf Uthree x := by
  have hn (u : SphereL2) : ‖sphereShiftPartialSum hO hD 1 n u‖^2 ≤ ‖u‖^2 :=
    (sq_le_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)).mpr
      (norm_sphereShiftPartialSum_le hO hD 1 n u)
  exact add_le_add
    (add_le_add
      (add_le_add (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hn (H i x)))
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hn (U1 x)) (sq_nonneg _)))
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hn (Hhalf i x)))
        (inv_nonneg.mpr hb)))
    (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hn (Uthree x)) hb)

lemma fourTermEnergyDensity_eq_zero (beta : R3 → ℝ)
    (H : Fin 3 → R3 → SphereL2) (U1 : R3 → SphereL2)
    (Hhalf : Fin 3 → R3 → SphereL2) (Uthree : R3 → SphereL2) (x : R3)
    (hH : ∀ i, H i x=0) (h1 : U1 x=0) (hh : ∀ i, Hhalf i x=0) (h3 : Uthree x=0) :
    fourTermEnergyDensity beta H U1 Hhalf Uthree x=0 := by
  simp only [fourTermEnergyDensity,hH,h1,hh,h3,norm_zero,zero_pow (by omega : 2≠0),
    Finset.sum_const_zero,mul_zero,add_zero]

lemma fourTermCutDensity_eq_zero (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (n : ℕ) (beta : R3 → ℝ) (H : Fin 3 → R3 → SphereL2) (U1 : R3 → SphereL2)
    (Hhalf : Fin 3 → R3 → SphereL2) (Uthree : R3 → SphereL2) (x : R3)
    (hH : ∀ i, H i x=0) (h1 : U1 x=0) (hh : ∀ i, Hhalf i x=0) (h3 : Uthree x=0) :
    fourTermCutDensity hO hD n beta H U1 Hhalf Uthree x=0 := by
  unfold fourTermCutDensity
  apply fourTermEnergyDensity_eq_zero
  all_goals simp [sphereShiftPartialSum,hH,h1,hh,h3]

lemma tendsto_fourTermCutDensity (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (beta : R3 → ℝ) (H : Fin 3 → R3 → SphereL2) (U1 : R3 → SphereL2)
    (Hhalf : Fin 3 → R3 → SphereL2) (Uthree : R3 → SphereL2) (x : R3)
    (hzH : ∀ i, sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD 0 (H i x)=0)
    (hz1 : sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD 0 (U1 x)=0)
    (hzh : ∀ i, sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD 0 (Hhalf i x)=0)
    (hz3 : sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD 0 (Uthree x)=0) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => fourTermCutDensity hO hD n beta H U1 Hhalf Uthree x)
      atTop (𝓝 (fourTermEnergyDensity beta H U1 Hhalf Uthree x)) := by
  have ht (u : SphereL2) (hu : sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD 0 u=0) :
      Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ‖sphereShiftPartialSum hO hD 1 n u‖^2) atTop (𝓝 (‖u‖^2)) :=
    (tendsto_sphereShiftPartialSum hO hD 1 u (by
      intro k hk
      have hk0 : k=0 := by omega
      subst k
      exact hu)).norm.pow 2
  exact (((tendsto_finset_sum Finset.univ (fun i _ => ht (H i x) (hzH i))).add
    ((ht (U1 x) hz1).const_mul (beta x^2))).add
    ((tendsto_finset_sum Finset.univ (fun i _ => ht (Hhalf i x) (hzh i))).const_mul (beta x)⁻¹)).add
      ((ht (Uthree x) hz3).const_mul (beta x))

/-- Actual compact fields imply the complete four-term limit; no convergence premise. -/
theorem tendsto_integral_fourTermCutDensity
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (beta : R3 → ℝ) (hb : Continuous beta) (hpos : ∀ x, 0 < beta x)
    (H : Fin 3 → R3 → SphereL2) (hH : ∀ i, Continuous (H i))
    (U1 : R3 → SphereL2) (h1 : Continuous U1)
    (Hhalf : Fin 3 → R3 → SphereL2) (hh : ∀ i, Continuous (Hhalf i))
    (Uthree : R3 → SphereL2) (h3 : Continuous Uthree)
    (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, (∀ i, H i x=0) ∧ U1 x=0 ∧ (∀ i, Hhalf i x=0) ∧ Uthree x=0)
    (hz0 : ∀ x, (∀ i, sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD 0 (H i x)=0) ∧
      sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD 0 (U1 x)=0 ∧
      (∀ i, sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD 0 (Hhalf i x)=0) ∧
      sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD 0 (Uthree x)=0) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => ∫ x, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      fourTermCutDensity hO hD n beta H U1 Hhalf Uthree x) atTop
      (𝓝 (∫ x, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * fourTermEnergyDensity beta H U1 Hhalf Uthree x)) := by
  have hbi : Continuous (fun x => (beta x)⁻¹) := hb.inv₀ (fun x => (hpos x).ne')
  have hE := continuous_fourTermEnergyDensity beta hb hbi H hH U1 h1 Hhalf hh Uthree h3
  have hEc : HasCompactSupport (fourTermEnergyDensity beta H U1 Hhalf Uthree) :=
    HasCompactSupport.intro hK (fun x hx =>
      fourTermEnergyDensity_eq_zero beta H U1 Hhalf Uthree x (hz x hx).1
        (hz x hx).2.1 (hz x hx).2.2.1 (hz x hx).2.2.2)
  have hI : Integrable (fun x => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      fourTermEnergyDensity beta H U1 Hhalf Uthree x) :=
    ((continuous_referenceBaseDensity g hg L lam).mul hE).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport hEc.mul_left
  apply tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence
    (fun x => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * fourTermEnergyDensity beta H U1 Hhalf Uthree x)
  · intro n
    exact ((continuous_referenceBaseDensity g hg L lam).mul
      (continuous_fourTermEnergyDensity beta hb hbi _
        (fun i => continuous_sphereShiftPartialSum hO hD 1 n (H i) (hH i)) _
        (continuous_sphereShiftPartialSum hO hD 1 n U1 h1) _
        (fun i => continuous_sphereShiftPartialSum hO hD 1 n (Hhalf i) (hh i)) _
        (continuous_sphereShiftPartialSum hO hD 1 n Uthree h3))).aestronglyMeasurable
  · exact hI
  · intro n
    apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
    intro x
    have hn : 0 ≤ fourTermCutDensity hO hD n beta H U1 Hhalf Uthree x :=
      fourTermEnergyDensity_nonneg beta _ _ _ _ x (hpos x).le
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs,abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (referenceDensityFamily_pos g hg L (lam,x)).le hn)]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (fourTermCutDensity_le hO hD n beta H U1 Hhalf Uthree x (hpos x).le)
      (referenceDensityFamily_pos g hg L (lam,x)).le
  · apply Filter.Eventually.of_forall
    intro x
    exact (tendsto_fourTermCutDensity hO hD beta H U1 Hhalf Uthree x
      (hz0 x).1 (hz0 x).2.1 (hz0 x).2.2.1 (hz0 x).2.2.2).const_mul
        (referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x))

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.FourTermProfileEnergy
``````

## Calderon.AmbientReferenceProfileEnergy

SHA256 `70526d2a2c28a4f09f995fe4c78b8f5eae9eb194443464cc8fde1237ea277313`.

``````lean
import Calderon.AmbientReferenceRaising
import Calderon.FourTermProfileEnergy
import Calderon.HarmonicProjectedCoercivity

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set Filter
open scoped ContDiff Topology ENNReal
namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.AmbientReferenceProfileEnergy
open SphereHarmonic SphereHilbertDecomposition SmoothSphereFields SmoothAngularApplication
  SpectralCoreRegularity SpectralWeightedGraph PositiveSpectralCore AmbientReferenceRaising
  WeightedBaseSpectral WeightedSpectralEnergy FourTermProfileEnergy HarmonicProjectedCoercivity
  CovariantHarmonicEnergy SmoothMetricFrame RadiusProfile ReferenceDensityBounds
  WeightedRaisingBounds ConformalDepth

lemma besselWeight_half_sq (k : ℕ) : besselWeight (1/2:ℝ) k^2=1+(k:ℝ) := by
  unfold besselWeight
  rw [← Real.rpow_mul_natCast (by positivity) (1/2:ℝ) 2]
  norm_num

lemma besselWeight_three_half_sq (k : ℕ) :
    besselWeight (3/2:ℝ) k^2=(1+(k:ℝ))^3 := by
  unfold besselWeight
  rw [← Real.rpow_mul_natCast (by positivity) (3/2:ℝ) 2]
  norm_num [Real.rpow_natCast]

lemma ambientBesselField_coordinate (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (s : ℝ) (hs : s ≤ 2)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (k : ℕ) (x : R3) :
    sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (ambientBesselField hO hD s hs G hG x) =
      besselWeight s k • sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k (ambientSphereL2 G hG x) :=
  ambientBesselField_graph hO hD s hs G hG x k

lemma referenceHorizontalBesselField_coordinate (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam s : ℝ) (hs : s ≤ 2) (i : Fin 3)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (k : ℕ) (x : R3) :
    sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k
      (referenceHorizontalBesselField hO hD g hg L lam s hs i G hG x) =
        besselWeight s k • sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD k
          (referenceHorizontalField g hg L lam i G hG x) :=
  referenceHorizontalBesselField_graph hO hD g hg L lam s hs i G hG x k

lemma referenceHorizontalField_eq_zero (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (i : Fin 3) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G)
    (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x,theta.val)=0) (x : R3) (hx : x ∉ K) :
    referenceHorizontalField g hg L lam i G hG x=0 :=
  ambientSphereL2_eq_zero _ (contDiff_referenceHorizontalAmbient g hg L lam i G hG) x
    (referenceHorizontalAmbient_sphere_zero g hg L lam i G hG K hK hz x hx)

lemma referenceHorizontalBesselField_eq_zero (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam s : ℝ) (hs : s ≤ 2) (i : Fin 3) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ)
    (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x,theta.val)=0) (x : R3) (hx : x ∉ K) :
    referenceHorizontalBesselField hO hD g hg L lam s hs i G hG x=0 :=
  ambientBesselField_eq_zero hO hD s hs _
    (contDiff_referenceHorizontalAmbient g hg L lam i G hG) K
    (referenceHorizontalAmbient_sphere_zero g hg L lam i G hG K hK hz) x hx

lemma referenceHorizontalField_coordinate_zero_of_meanZero
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (i : Fin 3)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G)
    (hmean : ∀ x, sphereMean (ambientSphereL2 G hG x)=0) (x : R3) :
    sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD 0 (referenceHorizontalField g hg L lam i G hG x)=0 := by
  have hz : (fun y => sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD 0 (ambientSphereL2 G hG y)) =
      (fun _ : R3 => (0 : harmonicSphereSubspace 0)) := by
    funext y
    exact (sphereHarmonicCoordinate_zero_eq_zero_iff hO hD _).mpr (hmean y)
  rw [referenceHorizontalField_coordinate,hz]
  simp [referenceHarmonicCovariantDerivative]

/-- Exactly N(phi)^2's four source terms for the actual reference covariant field. -/
def referenceAllModeProfileEnergyDensity (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (lam δ R L : ℝ) (p : ℕ) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) : R3 → ℝ :=
  fourTermEnergyDensity (referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L)
    (fun i => referenceHorizontalField g hg L lam i G hG)
    (ambientBesselField hO hD 1 (by norm_num) G hG)
    (fun i => referenceHorizontalBesselField hO hD g hg L lam (1/2:ℝ) (by norm_num) i G hG)
    (ambientBesselField hO hD (3/2:ℝ) (by norm_num) G hG)

def referenceAllModeProfileEnergy (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (lam δ R L : ℝ) (p : ℕ) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) : ℝ :=
  ∫ x, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
    referenceAllModeProfileEnergyDensity hO hD g hg lam δ R L p G hG x

def referenceAllModeProfileCutDensity (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (lam δ R L : ℝ) (p n : ℕ) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) : R3 → ℝ :=
  fourTermCutDensity hO hD n (referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L)
    (fun i => referenceHorizontalField g hg L lam i G hG)
    (ambientBesselField hO hD 1 (by norm_num) G hG)
    (fun i => referenceHorizontalBesselField hO hD g hg L lam (1/2:ℝ) (by norm_num) i G hG)
    (ambientBesselField hO hD (3/2:ℝ) (by norm_num) G hG)

def referenceAllModeProfileCutEnergy (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (lam δ R L : ℝ) (p n : ℕ) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) : ℝ :=
  ∫ x, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
    referenceAllModeProfileCutDensity hO hD g hg lam δ R L p n G hG x

lemma continuous_referenceAllModeProfileEnergyDensity (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (lam δ R L : ℝ) (p : ℕ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hR : 0 < R) (hL : 0 < L) (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :
    Continuous (referenceAllModeProfileEnergyDensity hO hD g hg lam δ R L p G hG) :=
  continuous_fourTermEnergyDensity _
    (continuous_referenceProfileNorm g hg lam δ R L p hδ hR)
    (continuous_referenceProfileNorm_inv g hg lam δ R L p hδ hR hL hp) _
    (fun i => (contDiff_referenceHorizontalField g hg L lam i G hG).continuous) _
    (contDiff_ambientBesselField hO hD 1 (by norm_num) G hG).continuous _
    (fun i => (contDiff_referenceHorizontalBesselField hO hD g hg L lam
      (1/2:ℝ) (by norm_num) i G hG).continuous) _
    (contDiff_ambientBesselField hO hD (3/2:ℝ) (by norm_num) G hG).continuous

lemma referenceAllModeProfileEnergyDensity_eq_zero (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (lam δ R L : ℝ) (p : ℕ) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G)
    (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x,theta.val)=0) (x : R3) (hx : x ∉ K) :
    referenceAllModeProfileEnergyDensity hO hD g hg lam δ R L p G hG x=0 :=
  fourTermEnergyDensity_eq_zero _ _ _ _ _ x
    (fun i => referenceHorizontalField_eq_zero g hg L lam i G hG K hK hz x hx)
    (ambientBesselField_eq_zero hO hD 1 (by norm_num) G hG K hz x hx)
    (fun i => referenceHorizontalBesselField_eq_zero hO hD g hg L lam
      (1/2:ℝ) (by norm_num) i G hG K hK hz x hx)
    (ambientBesselField_eq_zero hO hD (3/2:ℝ) (by norm_num) G hG K hz x hx)

theorem integrable_referenceAllModeProfileEnergyDensity (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (lam δ R L : ℝ) (p : ℕ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hR : 0 < R) (hL : 0 < L) (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x,theta.val)=0) :
    Integrable (fun x => referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
      referenceAllModeProfileEnergyDensity hO hD g hg lam δ R L p G hG x) :=
  ((continuous_referenceBaseDensity g hg L lam).mul
    (continuous_referenceAllModeProfileEnergyDensity hO hD g hg lam δ R L p hδ hR hL hp G hG)).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
    ((HasCompactSupport.intro hK (fun x hx =>
      referenceAllModeProfileEnergyDensity_eq_zero hO hD g hg lam δ R L p G hG K hK hz x hx)).mul_left)

lemma referenceAllModeProfileEnergy_nonneg (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (lam δ R L : ℝ) (p : ℕ) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hR : 0 < R) (hL : 0 < L) (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :
    0 ≤ referenceAllModeProfileEnergy hO hD g hg lam δ R L p G hG := by
  apply integral_nonneg
  intro x
  exact mul_nonneg (referenceDensityFamily_pos g hg L (lam,x)).le
    (fourTermEnergyDensity_nonneg _ _ _ _ _ x
      (referenceProfileNorm_pos g hg lam δ R L p hδ hR hL hp x).le)

lemma referenceAllModeProfileCutDensity_eq_sum_modes (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (lam δ R L : ℝ) (p n : ℕ) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (x : R3) :
    referenceAllModeProfileCutDensity hO hD g hg lam δ R L p n G hG x =
      ∑ m ∈ Finset.range n, referenceHarmonicModeEnergyDensity g lam δ R L p (m+1)
        (fun y => sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (m+1) (ambientSphereL2 G hG y)) x := by
  unfold referenceAllModeProfileCutDensity fourTermCutDensity fourTermEnergyDensity
  simp only [norm_sphereShiftPartialSum_sq]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm (s := Finset.univ) (t := Finset.range n)]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm (s := Finset.univ) (t := Finset.range n)]
  simp only [Finset.mul_sum,← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro m _
  simp only [referenceHarmonicModeEnergyDensity]
  simp_rw [ambientBesselField_coordinate,referenceHorizontalBesselField_coordinate,
    norm_smul,Real.norm_eq_abs,mul_pow,sq_abs,
    besselWeight_half_sq,besselWeight_three_half_sq,referenceHorizontalField_coordinate]
  simp only [besselWeight,Real.rpow_one]
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
  ring

theorem referenceAllModeProfileCutEnergy_eq_sum_modes
    (hF : SphereFischerInner) (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (lam δ R L : ℝ) (p n : ℕ)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hR : 0 < R) (hL : 0 < L) (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x,theta.val)=0) :
    referenceAllModeProfileCutEnergy hO hD g hg lam δ R L p n G hG =
      ∑ m ∈ Finset.range n, referenceHarmonicModeEnergy g lam δ R L p (m+1)
        (fun y => sphereHarmonicCoordinate hO hD (m+1) (ambientSphereL2 G hG y)) := by
  have hi (m : ℕ) := (integrable_referenceHarmonicProjection_energies hF hO hD
    g hg lam δ R L p m hδ hR hL hp (ambientSphereL2 G hG)
    (contDiff_ambientSphereL2 G hG) K hK
    (fun x hx => ambientSphereL2_eq_zero G hG x (hz x hx))).1
  unfold referenceAllModeProfileCutEnergy
  simp_rw [referenceAllModeProfileCutDensity_eq_sum_modes,Finset.mul_sum]
  exact integral_finsetSum _ (fun m _ => hi m)

theorem tendsto_referenceAllModeProfileCutEnergy
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (lam δ R L : ℝ) (p : ℕ)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hR : 0 < R) (hL : 0 < L) (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x,theta.val)=0)
    (hmean : ∀ x, sphereMean (ambientSphereL2 G hG x)=0) :
    Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => referenceAllModeProfileCutEnergy hO hD g hg lam δ R L p n G hG)
      atTop (𝓝 (referenceAllModeProfileEnergy hO hD g hg lam δ R L p G hG)) := by
  apply tendsto_integral_fourTermCutDensity g hg L lam hO hD _
    (continuous_referenceProfileNorm g hg lam δ R L p hδ hR)
    (fun x => referenceProfileNorm_pos g hg lam δ R L p hδ hR hL hp x) _
    (fun i => (contDiff_referenceHorizontalField g hg L lam i G hG).continuous) _
    (contDiff_ambientBesselField hO hD 1 (by norm_num) G hG).continuous _
    (fun i => (contDiff_referenceHorizontalBesselField hO hD g hg L lam
      (1/2:ℝ) (by norm_num) i G hG).continuous) _
    (contDiff_ambientBesselField hO hD (3/2:ℝ) (by norm_num) G hG).continuous K hK
  · intro x hx
    exact ⟨fun i => referenceHorizontalField_eq_zero g hg L lam i G hG K hK hz x hx,
      ambientBesselField_eq_zero hO hD 1 (by norm_num) G hG K hz x hx,
      fun i => referenceHorizontalBesselField_eq_zero hO hD g hg L lam
        (1/2:ℝ) (by norm_num) i G hG K hK hz x hx,
      ambientBesselField_eq_zero hO hD (3/2:ℝ) (by norm_num) G hG K hz x hx⟩
  · intro x
    have hU0 := (sphereHarmonicCoordinate_zero_eq_zero_iff hO hD _).mpr (hmean x)
    have hH0 (i : Fin 3) := referenceHorizontalField_coordinate_zero_of_meanZero
      hO hD g hg L lam i G hG hmean x
    refine ⟨hH0,?_,?_,?_⟩
    · rw [ambientBesselField_coordinate,hU0,smul_zero]
    · intro i
      rw [referenceHorizontalBesselField_coordinate,hH0 i,smul_zero]
    · rw [ambientBesselField_coordinate,hU0,smul_zero]

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.AmbientReferenceProfileEnergy
``````

``````lean
def referenceAllModeRaisingEnergy (hF : SphereFischerInner) (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)

    (L lam : ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) : ℝ :=
  ∫ x, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
    ‖referenceAllModeRaising hF hO hD g hg L lam f G hG x‖^2

def referenceAllModeLoweringEnergy (hF : SphereFischerInner) (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
    (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics) (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (L lam : ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) : ℝ :=
  ∫ x, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) *
    ‖referenceAllModeLowering hF hO hD g hg L lam f G hG x‖^2

def referenceAllModeRaisingCutEnergy (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (n : ℕ) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) : ℝ :=
  ∫ x, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * ‖sphereShiftPartialSum hO hD 2 n
    (referenceAllModeRaising hF hO hD g hg L lam f G hG x)‖^2

def referenceAllModeLoweringCutEnergy (hF : SphereFischerInner)
    (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (n : ℕ) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) : ℝ :=
  ∫ x, referenceDensityFamily g L (lam,x) * ‖sphereShiftPartialSum hO hD 0 n
    (referenceAllModeLowering hF hO hD g hg L lam f G hG x)‖^2

theorem referenceAllModeRaisingCutEnergy_eq_sum_modes
    (hF : SphereFischerInner) (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (lam δ R L : ℝ) (p n : ℕ)
    (hδ : 0 < δ) (hR : 0 < R) (hL : 0 < L) (hp : 1 ≤ p)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)

    (contDiff_ambientSphereL2 G hG) K hK

    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)

theorem tendsto_referenceAllModeRaisingCutEnergy
    (hF : SphereFischerInner) (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G)
    (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K)

theorem tendsto_referenceAllModeLoweringCutEnergy
    (hF : SphereFischerInner) (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics) (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics)
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ) (f : R3 → ℝ)

  have ht := tendsto_integral_sphereShiftPartialSum_sq g hg L lam hO hD

/-- Genuine all-mode raising gain on actual ambient smooth representatives, with exact N.
The constants precede every cutoff, field, scale and shrinking radius. -/
theorem exists_referenceAllMode_uniform_coercivity (g : MatrixField)
    (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ L cRaise : ℝ, 0 < L ∧ 0 < cRaise ∧
      ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ p : ℕ, 2 ≤ p ∧ ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧
        (∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 → ∀ x ∈ K,
          ‖fderiv ℝ (referenceRadius δ R p L) x‖ ≤ ε ∧
          referenceRadius δ R p L x * referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x^2 ≤ ε) ∧
        ∀ (hF : SphereFischerInner) (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
          (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics),
          ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 →
          ∀ G : R3 × R3 → ℝ, ∀ hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G,
          (∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x,theta.val)=0) →
          (∀ x, sphereMean (ambientSphereL2 G hG x)=0) →
          cRaise * referenceAllModeProfileEnergy hO hD g hg lam δ R L p G hG ≤
            referenceAllModeRaisingEnergy hF hO hD g hg L lam (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) G hG -
              referenceAllModeLoweringEnergy hF hO hD g hg L lam (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) G hG := by
  obtain ⟨L,cRaise,hL,hcRaise,hgain⟩ :=
    exists_referenceHarmonicProjection_uniform_coercivity g hg K hK
  refine ⟨L,cRaise,hL,hcRaise,?_⟩
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨p,hp,R,hR,hprofile,hmode⟩ := hgain ε hε
  refine ⟨p,hp,R,hR,hprofile,?_⟩
  intro hF hO hD lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 G hG hz hmean
  have hU := contDiff_ambientSphereL2 G hG
  have hzero : ∀ x ∉ K, ambientSphereL2 G hG x=0 :=
    fun x hx => ambientSphereL2_eq_zero G hG x (hz x hx)
  have hfinite (n : ℕ) :
      cRaise * referenceAllModeProfileCutEnergy hO hD g hg lam δ R L p n G hG ≤
        referenceAllModeRaisingCutEnergy hF hO hD g hg L lam (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) n G hG -
          referenceAllModeLoweringCutEnergy hF hO hD g hg L lam (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) n G hG := by
    rw [referenceAllModeProfileCutEnergy_eq_sum_modes hF hO hD g hg lam δ R L p n

      referenceAllModeRaisingCutEnergy_eq_sum_modes hF hO hD g hg lam δ R L p n
        hδ hR hL (by omega) G hG K hK hz,
      referenceAllModeLoweringCutEnergy_eq_sum_modes hF hO hD g hg lam δ R L p n
        hδ hR hL (by omega) G hG K hK hz,
      Finset.mul_sum,← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun m _ =>
      hmode hF hO hD lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 m (ambientSphereL2 G hG) hU hzero)
  have hf := contDiff_log_referenceRadius δ R p L hδ hR
  exact le_of_tendsto_of_tendsto
    ((tendsto_referenceAllModeProfileCutEnergy hO hD g hg lam δ R L p hδ hR hL
``````

## Calderon.LocallySmoothExtension

SHA256 `b3330092c472655b8bb0f7feb02356248af667ec50c6e29aae26844c60b1a534`.

``````lean
import Mathlib.Geometry.Manifold.PartitionOfUnity
import Mathlib.Geometry.Manifold.ContMDiff.NormedSpace

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open Filter Set
open scoped ContDiff Topology Manifold

namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SmoothSphereExtension

/-- Local scalar representatives on a closed set glue to a globally smooth scalar function.
The hypothesis requires smoothness only on actual neighbourhoods, not global representatives. -/
lemma exists_contDiff_eqOn_of_locally_contDiffOn
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] {s : Set E} (hs : IsClosed s) (f : E → ℝ)
    (hloc : ∀ x ∈ s, ∃ U ∈ 𝓝 x, ∃ g : E → ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U ∧ EqOn g f (U ∩ s)) :
    ∃ g : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ g ∧ EqOn g f s := by
  classical
  let t : E → Set ℝ := fun x => if x ∈ s then {f x} else univ
  have ht : ∀ x, Convex ℝ (t x) := by
    intro x
    dsimp [t]
    split
    · exact convex_singleton (f x)
    · exact convex_univ
  have htloc : ∀ x : E, ∃ U ∈ 𝓝 x, ∃ g : E → ℝ,
      ContMDiffOn 𝓘(ℝ, E) 𝓘(ℝ) ∞ g U ∧ ∀ y ∈ U, g y ∈ t y := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ s
    · rcases hloc x hx with ⟨U, hU, g, hg, heq⟩
      refine ⟨U, hU, g, hg.contMDiffOn, ?_⟩
      intro y hy
      by_cases hys : y ∈ s
      · simpa only [t, if_pos hys, mem_singleton_iff] using heq ⟨hy, hys⟩
      · simp only [t, if_neg hys, mem_univ]
    · refine ⟨sᶜ, hs.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hx, 0, contMDiffOn_const, ?_⟩
      intro y hy
      simp only [t, if_neg hy, mem_univ]
  obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := exists_contMDiffMap_forall_mem_convex_of_local
    (𝓘(ℝ, E)) (n := (⊤ : ℕ∞)) ht htloc
  refine ⟨g, g.contMDiff.contDiff, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  simpa only [t, if_pos hx, mem_singleton_iff] using hg x

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SmoothSphereExtension

``````

## Calderon.SphereFieldExtension

SHA256 `238f7ca6e3b6ec615178f2df3f208fc12c3a14e3722641bacc62baa50bc59e76`.

``````lean
import Calderon.LocallySmoothExtension
import Calderon.SmoothSphereFields

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open Filter Set MeasureTheory
open scoped ContDiff Topology Manifold

namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SmoothSphereExtension
open SphereHarmonic SmoothSphereFields

/-- Actual local ambient representatives, smooth only on their neighbourhoods.
This condition does not require or define a globally smooth ambient extension. -/
def HasLocalSphereRepresentativesOn (Y : Set R3) (f : R3 × UnitSphere → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ x ∈ Y, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, ∃ U ∈ 𝓝 (x, theta.val), ∃ g : R3 × R3 → ℝ,
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U ∧
      ∀ y : R3, ∀ eta : UnitSphere, (y, eta.val) ∈ U → g (y, eta.val) = f (y, eta)

/-- Auxiliary total scalar function prescribing the sphere values. -/
def sphereAmbientField (f : R3 × UnitSphere → ℝ) (z : R3 × R3) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact if h : z.2 ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : R3) 1 then f (z.1, ⟨z.2, h⟩) else 0

lemma sphereAmbientField_apply (f : R3 × UnitSphere → ℝ) (x : R3) (theta : UnitSphere) :
    sphereAmbientField f (x, theta.val) = f (x, theta) := by
  simp only [sphereAmbientField, dif_pos theta.property]

/-- Compact base support closes the local-to-global boundary across the edge of Y. -/
lemma exists_contDiff_sphere_extension_of_local
    (Y K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKY : K ⊆ Y)
    (f : R3 × UnitSphere → ℝ) (hf : HasLocalSphereRepresentativesOn Y f)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, f (x, theta) = 0) :
    ∃ G : R3 × R3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ G ∧
      ∀ x : R3, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x, theta.val) = f (x, theta) := by
  classical
  let S : Set (R3 × R3) := univ ×ˢ Metric.sphere (0 : R3) 1
  have hS : IsClosed S := isClosed_univ.prod Metric.isClosed_sphere
  have hloc : ∀ z ∈ S, ∃ U ∈ 𝓝 z, ∃ g : R3 × R3 → ℝ,
      ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U ∧ EqOn g (sphereAmbientField f) (U ∩ S) := by
    rintro ⟨x, v⟩ hxv
    change x ∈ (univ : Set R3) ∧ v ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : R3) 1 at hxv
    have hv : v ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : R3) 1 := hxv.2
    let theta : UnitSphere := ⟨v, hv⟩
    by_cases hxY : x ∈ Y
    · obtain ⟨U, hU, g, hg, heq⟩ := hf x hxY theta
      refine ⟨U, hU, g, hg, ?_⟩
      rintro ⟨y, w⟩ ⟨hyw, hys⟩
      let eta : UnitSphere := ⟨w, hys.2⟩
      change g (y, eta.val) = sphereAmbientField f (y, eta.val)
      rw [sphereAmbientField_apply]
      exact heq y eta hyw
    · have hxK : x ∉ K := fun hx => hxY (hKY hx)
      let U : Set (R3 × R3) := Prod.fst ⁻¹' Kᶜ
      have hU : IsOpen U := hK.isClosed.isOpen_compl.preimage continuous_fst
      refine ⟨U, hU.mem_nhds hxK, 0, contDiffOn_const, ?_⟩
      rintro ⟨y, w⟩ ⟨hyw, hys⟩
      let eta : UnitSphere := ⟨w, hys.2⟩
      change 0 = sphereAmbientField f (y, eta.val)
      rw [sphereAmbientField_apply]
      exact (hz y hyw eta).symm
  obtain ⟨G, hG, heq⟩ := exists_contDiff_eqOn_of_locally_contDiffOn
    (E := R3 × R3) (s := S) hS (sphereAmbientField f) hloc
  refine ⟨G, hG, ?_⟩
  intro x theta
  have hzS : (x, theta.val) ∈ S := ⟨mem_univ x, theta.property⟩
  have hpoint : G (x, theta.val) = sphereAmbientField f (x, theta.val) := heq hzS
  exact hpoint.trans (sphereAmbientField_apply f x theta)

/-- A smooth representative with full ambient base support in a compact neighbourhood of K
inside the prescribed open base Y. Its sphere values still have their original support K. -/
lemma exists_contDiff_sphere_extension_compact_base_of_local
    (Y K : Set R3) (hY : IsOpen Y) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKY : K ⊆ Y)
    (f : R3 × UnitSphere → ℝ) (hf : HasLocalSphereRepresentativesOn Y f)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, f (x, theta) = 0) :
    ∃ K' : Set R3, IsCompact K' ∧ K ⊆ K' ∧ K' ⊆ Y ∧
      ∃ G : R3 × R3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ G ∧
        (∀ x : R3, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x, theta.val) = f (x, theta)) ∧
        (∀ x ∉ K', ∀ v : R3, G (x, v) = 0) := by
  obtain ⟨G, hG, heq⟩ := exists_contDiff_sphere_extension_of_local Y K hK hKY f hf hz
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hKV, hVY, hVc⟩ := exists_open_between_and_isCompact_closure hK hY hKY
  have hd : Disjoint Vᶜ K := by
    rw [disjoint_left]
    intro x hxV hxK
    exact hxV (hKV hxK)
  obtain ⟨b, hbzero, hbone, _⟩ := exists_contMDiffMap_zero_one_of_isClosed
    (𝓘(ℝ, R3)) (n := (⊤ : ℕ∞)) hV.isClosed_compl hK.isClosed hd
  let H : R3 × R3 → ℝ := fun z => b z.1 * G z
  have hH : ContDiff ℝ ∞ H :=
    (b.contMDiff.contDiff.comp contDiff_fst).mul hG
  refine ⟨closure V, hVc, hKV.trans subset_closure, hVY, H, hH, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x theta
    dsimp [H]
    rw [heq x theta]
    by_cases hxK : x ∈ K
    · rw [hbone hxK, Pi.one_apply, one_mul]
    · rw [hz x hxK theta, mul_zero]
  · intro x hx v
    have hxV : x ∈ Vᶜ := fun hxV => hx (subset_closure hxV)
    dsimp [H]
    rw [hbzero hxV, Pi.zero_apply, zero_mul]

/-- Equality of representatives preserves the exact probability fibre mean. -/
lemma integral_sphere_extension_eq
    (f : R3 × UnitSphere → ℝ) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ)
    (heq : ∀ x : R3, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x, theta.val) = f (x, theta)) (x : R3) :
    (∫ theta : UnitSphere, G (x, theta.val) ∂sphereProbability) =
      ∫ theta : UnitSphere, f (x, theta) ∂sphereProbability := by
  congr 1
  funext theta
  exact heq x theta

lemma hasCompactSupport_ambientSphereL2_of_sphere_extension
    (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) (f : R3 × UnitSphere → ℝ)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, f (x, theta) = 0)
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G)
    (heq : ∀ x : R3, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x, theta.val) = f (x, theta)) :
    HasCompactSupport (ambientSphereL2 G hG) := by
  apply hasCompactSupport_ambientSphereL2 G hG K hK
  intro x hx theta
  rw [heq x theta]
  exact hz x hx theta

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SmoothSphereExtension

``````

## Calderon.IntrinsicSphereExtension

``````lean
import Calderon.SphereFieldExtension
import Mathlib.Geometry.Manifold.Instances.Sphere
import Mathlib.Geometry.Manifold.Algebra.SMul

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open Filter Set Function
open scoped ContDiff Topology Manifold

namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SmoothSphereExtension
open SphereHarmonic

/-- The punctured fibre ambient space is an actual open submanifold. -/
def puncturedSphereAmbient : TopologicalSpace.Opens (R3 × R3) :=
  ⟨{z : R3 × R3 | z.2 ≠ 0}, isOpen_ne_fun continuous_snd continuous_const⟩

/-- Radial normalization into the native unit-sphere manifold. -/
def sphereNormalization (z : puncturedSphereAmbient) : UnitSphere :=
  ⟨‖z.val.2‖⁻¹ • z.val.2, by
    rw [mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_inv, abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _), inv_mul_cancel₀]
    exact norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr z.property⟩

lemma contMDiff_sphereNormalization :
    ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, R3 × R3) (𝓡 2) ∞ sphereNormalization := by
  haveI : Fact (Module.finrank ℝ R3 = 2 + 1) := ⟨by simp [R3]⟩
  have hv : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, R3 × R3) 𝓘(ℝ, R3) ∞
      (fun z : puncturedSphereAmbient => z.val.2) :=
    contDiff_snd.contMDiff.comp contMDiff_subtype_val
  have hn : ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, R3 × R3) 𝓘(ℝ) ∞
      (fun z : puncturedSphereAmbient => ‖z.val.2‖) := by
    intro z
    have hnorm : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun v : R3 => ‖v‖) z.val.2 :=
      contDiffAt_norm ℝ z.property
    exact hnorm.comp_contMDiffAt
      (f := fun w : puncturedSphereAmbient => w.val.2) (x := z) hv.contMDiffAt
  have hi := hn.inv₀ (fun z => norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr z.property)
  exact (hi.smul hv).codRestrict_sphere (n := 2) (fun z => (sphereNormalization z).property)

/-- Smooth radial retraction into the native product manifold R3 times S2. -/
def sphereProductRetraction (z : puncturedSphereAmbient) : R3 × UnitSphere :=
  (z.val.1, sphereNormalization z)

lemma contMDiff_sphereProductRetraction :
    ContMDiff 𝓘(ℝ, R3 × R3) ((𝓘(ℝ, R3)).prod (𝓡 2)) ∞ sphereProductRetraction :=
  (contDiff_fst.contMDiff.comp contMDiff_subtype_val).prodMk contMDiff_sphereNormalization

lemma sphereNormalization_unit (x : R3) (theta : UnitSphere) :
    sphereNormalization ⟨(x, theta.val), ne_zero_of_mem_unit_sphere theta⟩ = theta := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change ‖theta.val‖⁻¹ • theta.val = theta.val
  rw [norm_eq_of_mem_sphere theta, inv_one, one_smul]

/-- Native local sphere smoothness yields actual ambient local representatives.
The representative is obtained by radial retraction on an open punctured ambient domain. -/
lemma hasLocalSphereRepresentativesOn_of_contMDiffOn
    (Y : Set R3) (hY : IsOpen Y) (f : R3 × UnitSphere → ℝ)
    (hf : ContMDiffOn ((𝓘(ℝ, R3)).prod (𝓡 2)) 𝓘(ℝ) ∞ f (Y ×ˢ univ)) :
    HasLocalSphereRepresentativesOn Y f := by
  let H : puncturedSphereAmbient → ℝ := fun z => f (sphereProductRetraction z)
  let G : R3 × R3 → ℝ := Subtype.val.extend H 0
  let U : Set (R3 × R3) := Y ×ˢ {v : R3 | v ≠ 0}
  have hU : IsOpen U := hY.prod (isOpen_ne_fun continuous_id continuous_const)
  have hG : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G U := by
    intro z hz
    let p : puncturedSphereAmbient := ⟨z, hz.2⟩
    have hp : sphereProductRetraction p ∈ Y ×ˢ (univ : Set UnitSphere) :=
      ⟨hz.1, mem_univ _⟩
    have hfAt : ContMDiffAt ((𝓘(ℝ, R3)).prod (𝓡 2)) 𝓘(ℝ) ∞ f
        (sphereProductRetraction p) :=
      hf.contMDiffAt ((hY.prod isOpen_univ).mem_nhds hp)
    have hHAt : ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, R3 × R3) 𝓘(ℝ) ∞ H p :=
      hfAt.comp p contMDiff_sphereProductRetraction.contMDiffAt
    have hrestrict : ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, R3 × R3) 𝓘(ℝ) ∞
        (fun p : puncturedSphereAmbient => G p.val) p := by
      change ContMDiffAt 𝓘(ℝ, R3 × R3) 𝓘(ℝ) ∞
        ((Subtype.val.extend H 0) ∘ Subtype.val) p
      rw [Function.extend_comp Subtype.val_injective]
      exact hHAt
    exact (contMDiffAt_subtype_iff.mp hrestrict).contDiffAt.contDiffWithinAt
  intro x hx theta
  have ht : theta.val ≠ 0 := ne_zero_of_mem_unit_sphere theta
  refine ⟨U, hU.mem_nhds ⟨hx, ht⟩, G, hG, ?_⟩
  intro y eta hy
  have he : eta.val ≠ 0 := ne_zero_of_mem_unit_sphere eta
  have hvalue := Subtype.val_injective.extend_apply H (0 : R3 × R3 → ℝ)
    (⟨(y, eta.val), he⟩ : puncturedSphereAmbient)
  change G (y, eta.val) = f (y, eta)
  rw [show G (y, eta.val) = H ⟨(y, eta.val), he⟩ from hvalue]
  change f (y, sphereNormalization ⟨(y, eta.val), he⟩) = f (y, eta)
  rw [sphereNormalization_unit]

/-- The intrinsic local-Y compact sphere field is eligible for the exact global ambient operators. -/
lemma exists_contDiff_sphere_extension_of_contMDiffOn
    (Y K : Set R3) (hY : IsOpen Y) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKY : K ⊆ Y)
    (f : R3 × UnitSphere → ℝ)
    (hf : ContMDiffOn ((𝓘(ℝ, R3)).prod (𝓡 2)) 𝓘(ℝ) ∞ f (Y ×ˢ univ))
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, f (x, theta) = 0) :
    ∃ K' : Set R3, IsCompact K' ∧ K ⊆ K' ∧ K' ⊆ Y ∧
      ∃ G : R3 × R3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ G ∧
        (∀ x : R3, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x, theta.val) = f (x, theta)) ∧
        (∀ x ∉ K', ∀ v : R3, G (x, v) = 0) :=
  exists_contDiff_sphere_extension_compact_base_of_local Y K hY hK hKY f
    (hasLocalSphereRepresentativesOn_of_contMDiffOn Y hY f hf) hz

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SmoothSphereExtension

``````

## Calderon.SourceSphereCutoffExtension

``````lean
import Calderon.IntrinsicSphereExtension

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open Filter Set Function MeasureTheory
open scoped ContDiff Topology Manifold

namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SmoothSphereExtension
open SphereHarmonic SmoothSphereFields

/-- The source's open sphere bundle after its smooth reference Gram-frame trivialization. -/
def sourceSphereDomain (Y : TopologicalSpace.Opens R3) :
    TopologicalSpace.Opens (R3 × UnitSphere) :=
  ⟨(Y : Set R3) ×ˢ univ, Y.isOpen.prod isOpen_univ⟩

/-- The actual source cutoff field, extended by zero only outside its open base domain. -/
def cutoffSphereZeroExtension (Y : TopologicalSpace.Opens R3) (chi : R3 → ℝ)
    (psi : sourceSphereDomain Y → ℝ) : R3 × UnitSphere → ℝ :=
  Subtype.val.extend
    (fun p : sourceSphereDomain Y => chi p.val.1 * (psi p - 1)) 0

lemma cutoffSphereZeroExtension_apply
    (Y : TopologicalSpace.Opens R3) (chi : R3 → ℝ) (psi : sourceSphereDomain Y → ℝ)
    (p : sourceSphereDomain Y) :
    cutoffSphereZeroExtension Y chi psi p.val = chi p.val.1 * (psi p - 1) :=
  Subtype.val_injective.extend_apply _ _ p

lemma contMDiffOn_cutoffSphereZeroExtension
    (Y : TopologicalSpace.Opens R3) (chi : R3 → ℝ) (hchi : ContDiff ℝ ∞ chi)
    (psi : sourceSphereDomain Y → ℝ)
    (hpsi : ContMDiff ((𝓘(ℝ, R3)).prod (𝓡 2)) 𝓘(ℝ) ∞ psi) :
    ContMDiffOn ((𝓘(ℝ, R3)).prod (𝓡 2)) 𝓘(ℝ) ∞
      (cutoffSphereZeroExtension Y chi psi) ((Y : Set R3) ×ˢ univ) := by
  let H : sourceSphereDomain Y → ℝ := fun p => chi p.val.1 * (psi p - 1)
  have hc : ContMDiff ((𝓘(ℝ, R3)).prod (𝓡 2)) 𝓘(ℝ) ∞
      (fun p : sourceSphereDomain Y => chi p.val.1) :=
    hchi.contMDiff.comp (contMDiff_fst.comp contMDiff_subtype_val)
  have hH : ContMDiff ((𝓘(ℝ, R3)).prod (𝓡 2)) 𝓘(ℝ) ∞ H :=
    hc.mul (hpsi.sub contMDiff_const)
  intro z hz
  let p : sourceSphereDomain Y := ⟨z, hz⟩
  have hrestrict : ContMDiffAt ((𝓘(ℝ, R3)).prod (𝓡 2)) 𝓘(ℝ) ∞
      (fun p : sourceSphereDomain Y => cutoffSphereZeroExtension Y chi psi p.val) p := by
    change ContMDiffAt ((𝓘(ℝ, R3)).prod (𝓡 2)) 𝓘(ℝ) ∞
      ((Subtype.val.extend H 0) ∘ Subtype.val) p
    rw [Function.extend_comp Subtype.val_injective]
    exact hH.contMDiffAt
  exact (contMDiffAt_subtype_iff.mp hrestrict).contMDiffWithinAt

lemma cutoffSphereZeroExtension_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport
    (Y : TopologicalSpace.Opens R3) (chi : R3 → ℝ) (psi : sourceSphereDomain Y → ℝ)
    (x : R3) (hx : x ∉ tsupport chi) (theta : UnitSphere) :
    cutoffSphereZeroExtension Y chi psi (x, theta) = 0 := by
  have hchi : chi x = 0 := image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hx
  by_cases hxY : x ∈ (Y : Set R3)
  · let p : sourceSphereDomain Y := ⟨(x, theta), ⟨hxY, mem_univ theta⟩⟩
    have hvalue := cutoffSphereZeroExtension_apply Y chi psi p
    change cutoffSphereZeroExtension Y chi psi (x, theta) = chi x * (psi p - 1) at hvalue
    rw [hchi, zero_mul] at hvalue
    exact hvalue
  · have hnone : ¬ ∃ p : sourceSphereDomain Y, p.val = (x, theta) := by
      rintro ⟨p, hp⟩
      have hpY : p.val.1 ∈ (Y : Set R3) := p.property.1
      have hpx : p.val.1 = x := congrArg Prod.fst hp
      exact hxY (hpx ▸ hpY)
    exact Function.extend_apply' _ _ _ hnone

def sourceSphereSlice (Y : TopologicalSpace.Opens R3)
    (psi : sourceSphereDomain Y → ℝ) (x : R3) (hx : x ∈ (Y : Set R3)) : UnitSphere → ℝ :=
  fun theta => psi ⟨(x, theta), ⟨hx, mem_univ theta⟩⟩

lemma continuous_sourceSphereSlice
    (Y : TopologicalSpace.Opens R3) (psi : sourceSphereDomain Y → ℝ)
    (hpsi : Continuous psi) (x : R3) (hx : x ∈ (Y : Set R3)) :
    Continuous (sourceSphereSlice Y psi x hx) :=
  hpsi.comp ((continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id).subtype_mk
    (fun theta => (show (x, theta) ∈ sourceSphereDomain Y from ⟨hx, mem_univ theta⟩)))

/-- Supplied probability normalization implies scalar mean zero for the actual cutoff field. -/
lemma integral_cutoffSphereZeroExtension_eq_zero
    (Y : TopologicalSpace.Opens R3) (chi : R3 → ℝ) (psi : sourceSphereDomain Y → ℝ)
    (hpsi : Continuous psi)
    (hnormalized : ∀ x : R3, ∀ hx : x ∈ (Y : Set R3),
      (∫ theta : UnitSphere, sourceSphereSlice Y psi x hx theta ∂sphereProbability) = 1)
    (x : R3) :
    (∫ theta : UnitSphere, cutoffSphereZeroExtension Y chi psi (x, theta) ∂sphereProbability) = 0 := by
  by_cases hx : x ∈ (Y : Set R3)
  · have hi : Integrable (sourceSphereSlice Y psi x hx) sphereProbability :=
      (continuous_sourceSphereSlice Y psi hpsi x hx).integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
        (HasCompactSupport.intro isCompact_univ (fun theta ht => (ht (mem_univ theta)).elim))
    have heq : (fun theta : UnitSphere => cutoffSphereZeroExtension Y chi psi (x, theta)) =
        (fun theta : UnitSphere => chi x * (sourceSphereSlice Y psi x hx theta - 1)) := by
      funext theta
      exact cutoffSphereZeroExtension_apply Y chi psi ⟨(x, theta), ⟨hx, mem_univ theta⟩⟩
    rw [heq, integral_const_mul, integral_sub hi (integrable_const (1 : ℝ)), hnormalized x hx]
    simp
  · have heq : (fun theta : UnitSphere => cutoffSphereZeroExtension Y chi psi (x, theta)) = 0 := by
      funext theta
      have hnone : ¬ ∃ p : sourceSphereDomain Y, p.val = (x, theta) := by
        rintro ⟨p, hp⟩
        have hpY : p.val.1 ∈ (Y : Set R3) := p.property.1
        have hpx : p.val.1 = x := congrArg Prod.fst hp
        exact hx (hpx ▸ hpY)
      exact Function.extend_apply' _ _ _ hnone
    rw [heq]
    exact integral_zero' UnitSphere ℝ

/-- A native source density on local Y with its actual compact cutoff has a global ambient
representative eligible for ambientSphereL2, preserving the original source formula. -/
lemma exists_contDiff_cutoff_sphere_extension
    (Y : TopologicalSpace.Opens R3) (chi : R3 → ℝ) (hchi : ContDiff ℝ ∞ chi)
    (hchiCompact : HasCompactSupport chi) (hchiY : tsupport chi ⊆ (Y : Set R3))
    (psi : sourceSphereDomain Y → ℝ)
    (hpsi : ContMDiff ((𝓘(ℝ, R3)).prod (𝓡 2)) 𝓘(ℝ) ∞ psi) :
    ∃ K' : Set R3, IsCompact K' ∧ tsupport chi ⊆ K' ∧ K' ⊆ (Y : Set R3) ∧
      ∃ G : R3 × R3 → ℝ, ∃ hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G,
        (∀ x : R3, ∀ theta : UnitSphere,
          G (x, theta.val) = cutoffSphereZeroExtension Y chi psi (x, theta)) ∧
        (∀ x ∉ K', ∀ v : R3, G (x, v) = 0) ∧
        (∀ p : sourceSphereDomain Y,
          G (p.val.1, p.val.2.val) = chi p.val.1 * (psi p - 1)) ∧
        HasCompactSupport (ambientSphereL2 G hG) := by
  let f := cutoffSphereZeroExtension Y chi psi
  have hf : ContMDiffOn ((𝓘(ℝ, R3)).prod (𝓡 2)) 𝓘(ℝ) ∞ f
      ((Y : Set R3) ×ˢ univ) := contMDiffOn_cutoffSphereZeroExtension Y chi hchi psi hpsi
  have hz : ∀ x ∉ tsupport chi, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, f (x, theta) = 0 :=
    fun x hx theta => cutoffSphereZeroExtension_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport Y chi psi x hx theta
  obtain ⟨K', hK', hKK', hK'Y, G, hG, heq, hzero⟩ :=
    exists_contDiff_sphere_extension_of_contMDiffOn (Y : Set R3) (tsupport chi)
      Y.isOpen hchiCompact hchiY f hf hz
  refine ⟨K', hK', hKK', hK'Y, G, hG, heq, hzero, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro p
    rw [heq p.val.1 p.val.2]
    exact cutoffSphereZeroExtension_apply Y chi psi p
  · exact hasCompactSupport_ambientSphereL2_of_sphere_extension
      (tsupport chi) hchiCompact f hz G hG heq

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SmoothSphereExtension

``````

## Calderon.SphereExtensionL2

``````lean
import Calderon.IntrinsicSphereExtension
import Calderon.SphereMeanZero

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped ContDiff Topology Manifold InnerProductSpace

namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SmoothSphereExtension
open SphereHarmonic SmoothSphereFields

/-- The exact actual L2 mean is the scalar probability fibre integral. -/
lemma sphereMean_ambientSphereL2
    (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (x : R3) :
    sphereMean (ambientSphereL2 G hG x) =
      ∫ theta : UnitSphere, G (x, theta.val) ∂sphereProbability := by
  rw [sphereMean, innerSL_apply_apply]
  change ⟪ContinuousMap.toLp 2 sphereProbability ℝ (polynomialSphere (MvPolynomial.C 1)),
    ContinuousMap.toLp 2 sphereProbability ℝ (ambientSphereSection G hG x)⟫_ℝ = _
  simpa only [polynomialSphere, ambientSphereSection,
    CompactParameterSmoothness.compactPullback_apply, unitSphereInclusion,
    ContinuousMap.coe_mk, MvPolynomial.eval_C,
    starRingEnd_apply, star_trivial, mul_one] using
    ContinuousMap.inner_toLp sphereProbability
      (polynomialSphere (MvPolynomial.C 1)) (ambientSphereSection G hG x)

lemma sphereMean_ambientSphereL2_eq_zero_of_sphere_extension
    (f : R3 × UnitSphere → ℝ) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G)
    (heq : ∀ x : R3, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x, theta.val) = f (x, theta))
    (hmean : ∀ x : R3, (∫ theta : UnitSphere, f (x, theta) ∂sphereProbability) = 0) (x : R3) :
    sphereMean (ambientSphereL2 G hG x) = 0 := by
  rw [sphereMean_ambientSphereL2, integral_sphere_extension_eq f G heq x]
  exact hmean x

lemma ambientSphereL2_ae_of_sphere_extension
    (f : R3 × UnitSphere → ℝ) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G)
    (heq : ∀ x : R3, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x, theta.val) = f (x, theta)) (x : R3) :
    ambientSphereL2 G hG x =ᵐ[sphereProbability] (fun theta : UnitSphere => f (x, theta)) := by
  filter_upwards [ambientSphereL2_ae G hG x] with theta htheta
  exact htheta.trans (heq x theta)

/-- The actual L2 base field is independent of the chosen ambient representative. -/
lemma ambientSphereL2_eq_of_sphere_extension
    (f : R3 × UnitSphere → ℝ) (G H : R3 × R3 → ℝ)
    (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (hH : ContDiff ℝ ∞ H)
    (heqG : ∀ x : R3, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x, theta.val) = f (x, theta))
    (heqH : ∀ x : R3, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, H (x, theta.val) = f (x, theta)) :
    ambientSphereL2 G hG = ambientSphereL2 H hH := by
  funext x
  have hs : ambientSphereSection G hG x = ambientSphereSection H hH x := by
    ext theta
    exact (heqG x theta).trans (heqH x theta).symm
  change ContinuousMap.toLp 2 sphereProbability ℝ (ambientSphereSection G hG x) =
    ContinuousMap.toLp 2 sphereProbability ℝ (ambientSphereSection H hH x)
  rw [hs]

lemma fderiv_ambientSphereL2_eq_of_sphere_extension
    (f : R3 × UnitSphere → ℝ) (G H : R3 × R3 → ℝ)
    (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (hH : ContDiff ℝ ∞ H)
    (heqG : ∀ x : R3, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x, theta.val) = f (x, theta))
    (heqH : ∀ x : R3, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, H (x, theta.val) = f (x, theta)) (x : R3) :
    fderiv ℝ (ambientSphereL2 G hG) x = fderiv ℝ (ambientSphereL2 H hH) x := by
  rw [ambientSphereL2_eq_of_sphere_extension f G H hG hH heqG heqH]

lemma integral_sphere_extension_eq_zero
    (f : R3 × UnitSphere → ℝ) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ)
    (heq : ∀ x : R3, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x, theta.val) = f (x, theta))
    (hmean : ∀ x : R3, (∫ theta : UnitSphere, f (x, theta) ∂sphereProbability) = 0) (x : R3) :
    (∫ theta : UnitSphere, G (x, theta.val) ∂sphereProbability) = 0 := by
  rw [integral_sphere_extension_eq f G heq x]
  exact hmean x

/-- Native compact local sphere fields give exactly the smooth compact Banach fields required
by the actual ambientSphereL2 operators, with their original scalar values almost everywhere. -/
lemma exists_contDiff_compact_ambientSphereL2_of_contMDiffOn
    (Y K : Set R3) (hY : IsOpen Y) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKY : K ⊆ Y)
    (f : R3 × UnitSphere → ℝ)
    (hf : ContMDiffOn ((𝓘(ℝ, R3)).prod (𝓡 2)) 𝓘(ℝ) ∞ f (Y ×ˢ univ))
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, f (x, theta) = 0) :
    ∃ G : R3 × R3 → ℝ, ∃ hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G,
      (∀ x : R3, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x, theta.val) = f (x, theta)) ∧
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (ambientSphereL2 G hG) ∧ HasCompactSupport (ambientSphereL2 G hG) ∧
      (∀ x : R3, ambientSphereL2 G hG x =ᵐ[sphereProbability]
        (fun theta : UnitSphere => f (x, theta))) := by
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, G, hG, heq, _⟩ :=
    exists_contDiff_sphere_extension_of_contMDiffOn Y K hY hK hKY f hf hz
  exact ⟨G, hG, heq, contDiff_ambientSphereL2 G hG,
    hasCompactSupport_ambientSphereL2_of_sphere_extension K hK f hz G hG heq,
    ambientSphereL2_ae_of_sphere_extension f G hG heq⟩

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SmoothSphereExtension
``````

``````lean
  · exact ambientBesselField_graph hO hD s hs G hG x
  · rw [hU]
``````

## Calderon.IntrinsicReferenceCoercivity

SHA256 `fdadd091aee02289483fe7fdf1b8af6f2eae8a7f198635b37f88132d1dc3946b`.

``````lean
import Calderon.SphereRepresentativeOperators
import Calderon.SourceSphereCutoffExtension

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory Set
open scoped ContDiff Topology Manifold ENNReal

namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SmoothSphereExtension
open SphereHarmonic SmoothSphereFields AmbientReferenceCoercivity AmbientReferenceProfileEnergy
  ReferenceDensityBounds RadiusProfile ConformalDepth

/-- The genuine all-mode gain applies to native local-Y compact sphere fields.
Every representative gives the same energies; existence makes that universal statement nonvacuous.
Constants retain the original order before every field, shrinking scale, radius and cutoff. -/
theorem exists_referenceAllMode_uniform_coercivity_of_contMDiffOn
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (K : Set R3) (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ L cRaise : ℝ, 0 < L ∧ 0 < cRaise ∧
      ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ p : ℕ, 2 ≤ p ∧ ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧
        (∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 → ∀ x ∈ K,
          ‖fderiv ℝ (referenceRadius δ R p L) x‖ ≤ ε ∧
          referenceRadius δ R p L x * referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x^2 ≤ ε) ∧
        ∀ (hF : SphereFischerInner) (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
          (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics),
          ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 →
          ∀ Y : Set R3, IsOpen Y → K ⊆ Y → ∀ phi : R3 × UnitSphere → ℝ,
          ContMDiffOn ((𝓘(ℝ, R3)).prod (𝓡 2)) 𝓘(ℝ) ∞ phi (Y ×ˢ univ) →
          (∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, phi (x, theta) = 0) →
          (∀ x : R3, (∫ theta : UnitSphere, phi (x, theta) ∂sphereProbability) = 0) →
          ∃ G : R3 × R3 → ℝ, ∃ hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G,
            (∀ x : R3, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x, theta.val) = phi (x, theta)) ∧
            ∀ H : R3 × R3 → ℝ, ∀ hH : ContDiff ℝ ∞ H,
              (∀ x : R3, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, H (x, theta.val) = phi (x, theta)) →
              cRaise * referenceAllModeProfileEnergy hO hD g hg lam δ R L p H hH ≤
                referenceAllModeRaisingEnergy hF hO hD g hg L lam (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) H hH -
                  referenceAllModeLoweringEnergy hF hO hD g hg L lam (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) H hH := by
  obtain ⟨L, cRaise, hL, hcRaise, hgain⟩ := exists_referenceAllMode_uniform_coercivity g hg K hK
  refine ⟨L, cRaise, hL, hcRaise, ?_⟩
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨p, hp, R, hR, hprofile, hmode⟩ := hgain ε hε
  refine ⟨p, hp, R, hR, hprofile, ?_⟩
  intro hF hO hD lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 Y hY hKY phi hphi hz hmean
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, G, hG, heqG, _⟩ :=
    exists_contDiff_sphere_extension_of_contMDiffOn Y K hY hK hKY phi hphi hz
  have hzG : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x, theta.val) = 0 := by
    intro x hx theta
    rw [heqG x theta]
    exact hz x hx theta
  have hmeanG : ∀ x : R3, sphereMean (ambientSphereL2 G hG x) = 0 :=
    sphereMean_ambientSphereL2_eq_zero_of_sphere_extension phi G hG heqG hmean
  have hgainG := hmode hF hO hD lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 G hG hzG hmeanG
  refine ⟨G, hG, heqG, ?_⟩
  intro H hH heqH
  have hU := ambientSphereL2_eq_of_sphere_extension phi G H hG hH heqG heqH
  rw [← referenceAllModeProfileEnergy_eq_of_ambientSphereL2_eq hO hD G H hG hH
      g hg lam δ R L p hU,
    ← referenceAllModeRaisingEnergy_eq_of_ambientSphereL2_eq hO hD G H hG hH
      hF g hg L lam (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) hU,
    ← referenceAllModeLoweringEnergy_eq_of_ambientSphereL2_eq hO hD G H hG hH
      hF g hg L lam (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) hU]
  exact hgainG

/-- For the actual phi=chi(psi-1), native smoothness and supplied probability normalization
suffice for the intrinsic all-mode gain; the density construction and normalization remain inputs. -/
theorem exists_referenceAllMode_uniform_coercivity_cutoff
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g)
    (Y : TopologicalSpace.Opens R3) (chi : R3 → ℝ) (hchi : ContDiff ℝ ∞ chi)
    (hchiCompact : HasCompactSupport chi) (hchiY : tsupport chi ⊆ (Y : Set R3)) :
    ∃ L cRaise : ℝ, 0 < L ∧ 0 < cRaise ∧
      ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ p : ℕ, 2 ≤ p ∧ ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧
        (∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 → ∀ x ∈ tsupport chi,
          ‖fderiv ℝ (referenceRadius δ R p L) x‖ ≤ ε ∧
          referenceRadius δ R p L x * referenceProfileNorm g lam δ R p L x^2 ≤ ε) ∧
        ∀ (hF : SphereFischerInner) (hO : OrthogonalSphereHarmonics)
          (hD : DenseSphereHarmonics),
          ∀ lam ∈ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1 →
          ∀ psi : sourceSphereDomain Y → ℝ,
          ContMDiff ((𝓘(ℝ, R3)).prod (𝓡 2)) 𝓘(ℝ) ∞ psi →
          (∀ x : R3, ∀ hx : x ∈ (Y : Set R3),
            (∫ theta : UnitSphere, sourceSphereSlice Y psi x hx theta ∂sphereProbability) = 1) →
          ∃ G : R3 × R3 → ℝ, ∃ hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G,
            (∀ x : R3, ∀ theta : UnitSphere,
              G (x, theta.val) = cutoffSphereZeroExtension Y chi psi (x, theta)) ∧
            ∀ H : R3 × R3 → ℝ, ∀ hH : ContDiff ℝ ∞ H,
              (∀ x : R3, ∀ theta : UnitSphere,
                H (x, theta.val) = cutoffSphereZeroExtension Y chi psi (x, theta)) →
              cRaise * referenceAllModeProfileEnergy hO hD g hg lam δ R L p H hH ≤
                referenceAllModeRaisingEnergy hF hO hD g hg L lam (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) H hH -
                  referenceAllModeLoweringEnergy hF hO hD g hg L lam (referenceLogRadius δ R p L) H hH := by
  obtain ⟨L, cRaise, hL, hcRaise, hgain⟩ :=
    exists_referenceAllMode_uniform_coercivity_of_contMDiffOn g hg (tsupport chi) hchiCompact
  refine ⟨L, cRaise, hL, hcRaise, ?_⟩
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨p, hp, R, hR, hprofile, hmode⟩ := hgain ε hε
  refine ⟨p, hp, R, hR, hprofile, ?_⟩
  intro hF hO hD lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 psi hpsi hnormalized
  exact hmode hF hO hD lam hlam δ hδ hδ1 (Y : Set R3) Y.isOpen hchiY
    (cutoffSphereZeroExtension Y chi psi)
    (contMDiffOn_cutoffSphereZeroExtension Y chi hchi psi hpsi)
    (fun x hx theta => cutoffSphereZeroExtension_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport Y chi psi x hx theta)
    (integral_cutoffSphereZeroExtension_eq_zero Y chi psi hpsi.continuous hnormalized)

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SmoothSphereExtension
``````

## Calderon.PhysicalSphereExtension

SHA256 `d5ceaf2e85ce4a3f5bb5527f7dafaed9fd902852b243c1598a9ddb51394de936`.

``````lean
import Calderon.SphereFieldExtension
import Calderon.MetricFiberMeasure

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open Filter Set
open scoped ContDiff Topology InnerProductSpace ENNReal

namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SmoothSphereExtension
open SphereHarmonic MetricFiberMeasure SmoothMetricFrame MetricOperator RadiusProfile ConformalDepth

/-- Local representatives on the actual embedded metric-unit sphere bundle. -/
def HasLocalMetricSphereRepresentativesOn (Y : Set R3) (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3)
    (F : R3 × R3 → ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ x ∈ Y, ∀ v ∈ metricUnitFiber (M x), ∃ U ∈ 𝓝 (x, v), ∃ G : R3 × R3 → ℝ,
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ G U ∧
      ∀ y w : R3, (y, w) ∈ U → w ∈ metricUnitFiber (M y) → G (y, w) = F (y, w)

/-- Actual smooth frame synthesis as a function on the ambient product. -/
def frameSynthesisAmbient (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3) (z : R3 × R3) : R3 × R3 :=
  (z.1, ∑ i : Fin 3, z.2 i • e z.1 i)

lemma contDiff_frameSynthesisAmbient (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3)
    (he : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => e x i)) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (frameSynthesisAmbient e) := by
  apply contDiff_fst.prodMk
  apply ContDiff.sum
  intro i hi
  have hcoord : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : R3 × R3 => z.2 i) :=
    (contDiff_piLp_apply (p := (2 : ℝ≥0∞)) (i := i) :
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : R3 => z i)).comp contDiff_snd
  exact hcoord.smul ((he i).comp contDiff_fst)

lemma frameSynthesisAmbient_sphere
    (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3)
    (horth : ∀ x, IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (M x) (e x)) (x : R3) (theta : UnitSphere) :
    frameSynthesisAmbient e (x, theta.val) =
      (x, metricFrameSphereMap (M x) (e x) (horth x) theta) := by
  simp only [frameSynthesisAmbient, metricFrameSphereMap, metricFrameSynthesis_apply]

def frameSpherePullback (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3) (F : R3 × R3 → ℝ) :
    R3 × UnitSphere → ℝ := fun z => F (frameSynthesisAmbient e (z.1, z.2.val))

lemma hasLocalSphereRepresentativesOn_frameSpherePullback
    (Y : Set R3) (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3)
    (he : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => e x i))
    (horth : ∀ x, IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (M x) (e x))
    (F : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hF : HasLocalMetricSphereRepresentativesOn Y M F) :
    HasLocalSphereRepresentativesOn Y (frameSpherePullback e F) := by
  intro x hx theta
  let v := metricFrameSphereMap (M x) (e x) (horth x) theta
  have hv : v ∈ metricUnitFiber (M x) := metricFrameSphereMap_mem_metricUnitFiber _ _ _ theta
  obtain ⟨U, hU, G, hG, heq⟩ := hF x hx v hv
  let A := frameSynthesisAmbient e
  have hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A := contDiff_frameSynthesisAmbient e he
  have hpre : A ⁻¹' U ∈ 𝓝 (x, theta.val) := by
    apply hA.continuous.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds
    simpa only [A, frameSynthesisAmbient_sphere M e horth x theta] using hU
  refine ⟨A ⁻¹' U, hpre, G ∘ A, hG.comp hA.contDiffOn (mapsTo_preimage A U), ?_⟩
  intro y eta hy
  change G (A (y, eta.val)) = F (A (y, eta.val))
  rw [show A (y, eta.val) =
    (y, metricFrameSphereMap (M y) (e y) (horth y) eta) from frameSynthesisAmbient_sphere M e horth y eta]
  apply heq y _
  · simpa only [A, Set.mem_preimage, frameSynthesisAmbient_sphere M e horth y eta] using hy
  · exact metricFrameSphereMap_mem_metricUnitFiber _ _ _ eta

lemma frameSpherePullback_eq_zero_of_metric_sphere_support
    (K : Set R3) (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3)
    (horth : ∀ x, IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (M x) (e x)) (F : R3 × R3 → ℝ)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ v ∈ metricUnitFiber (M x), F (x, v) = 0) :
    ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, frameSpherePullback e F (x, theta) = 0 := by
  intro x hx theta
  rw [frameSpherePullback, frameSynthesisAmbient_sphere M e horth x theta]
  exact hz x hx _ (metricFrameSphereMap_mem_metricUnitFiber _ _ _ theta)

/-- The physical local smooth sphere class has an actual global reference ambient representative. -/
lemma exists_contDiff_frame_sphere_extension
    (Y K : Set R3) (hY : IsOpen Y) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKY : K ⊆ Y)
    (M : R3 → R3 →L[ℝ] R3) (e : R3 → Fin 3 → R3)
    (he : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x => e x i))
    (horth : ∀ x, IsMetricOrthonormalFrame (M x) (e x))
    (F : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hF : HasLocalMetricSphereRepresentativesOn Y M F)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ v ∈ metricUnitFiber (M x), F (x, v) = 0) :
    ∃ K' : Set R3, IsCompact K' ∧ K ⊆ K' ∧ K' ⊆ Y ∧
      ∃ G : R3 × R3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ G ∧
        (∀ x : R3, ∀ theta : UnitSphere,
          G (x, theta.val) = F (x, metricFrameSphereMap (M x) (e x) (horth x) theta)) ∧
        (∀ x ∉ K', ∀ v : R3, G (x, v) = 0) := by
  obtain ⟨K', hK', hKK', hK'Y, G, hG, heq, hzero⟩ :=
    exists_contDiff_sphere_extension_compact_base_of_local Y K hY hK hKY
      (frameSpherePullback e F)
      (hasLocalSphereRepresentativesOn_frameSpherePullback Y M e he horth F hF)
      (frameSpherePullback_eq_zero_of_metric_sphere_support K M e horth F hz)
  refine ⟨K', hK', hKK', hK'Y, G, hG, ?_, hzero⟩
  intro x theta
  rw [heq x theta, frameSpherePullback, frameSynthesisAmbient_sphere M e horth x theta]

/-- Specialization to the literal true Gram frame of the actual reference metric. -/
lemma exists_contDiff_referenceMetric_sphere_extension
    (g : MatrixField) (hg : IsAdmissibleMetric g) (L lam : ℝ)
    (Y K : Set R3) (hY : IsOpen Y) (hK : IsCompact K) (hKY : K ⊆ Y)
    (F : R3 × R3 → ℝ)
    (hF : HasLocalMetricSphereRepresentativesOn Y
      (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L)) F)
    (hz : ∀ x ∉ K, ∀ v ∈ metricUnitFiber
      (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x), F (x, v) = 0) :
    ∃ K' : Set R3, IsCompact K' ∧ K ⊆ K' ∧ K' ⊆ Y ∧
      ∃ G : R3 × R3 → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ G ∧
        (∀ x : R3, ∀ theta : UnitSphere,
          G (x, theta.val) = F (x, metricFrameSphereMap
            (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L) x)
            (referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam, x))
            (referenceMetricGramFrame_isMetricOrthonormalFrame g hg L (lam, x)) theta)) ∧
        (∀ x ∉ K', ∀ v : R3, G (x, v) = 0) := by
  exact exists_contDiff_frame_sphere_extension Y K hY hK hKY
    (metricOperatorField (referenceMetric (dilatedMetric g lam) L))
    (fun x => referenceMetricGramFrame g L (lam, x))
    (contDiff_referenceMetricGramFrame_slice g hg L lam)
    (fun x => referenceMetricGramFrame_isMetricOrthonormalFrame g hg L (lam, x)) F hF hz

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SmoothSphereExtension

``````

## Calderon.SphereSmoothClassEquivalence

SHA256 `ee63ac41ff9d2730e9493ae99bc15ee57fe203b0b51cc27f5fd0d4e8719a1a64`.

``````lean
import Calderon.IntrinsicSphereExtension

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open Filter Set Function
open scoped ContDiff Topology Manifold

namespace OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SmoothSphereExtension
open SphereHarmonic

/-- The literal inclusion of the native sphere product into the ambient product. -/
def sphereProductInclusion (z : R3 × UnitSphere) : R3 × R3 := (z.1, z.2.val)

lemma contMDiff_sphereProductInclusion :
    ContMDiff ((𝓘(ℝ, R3)).prod (𝓡 2)) 𝓘(ℝ, R3 × R3) ∞ sphereProductInclusion := by
  haveI : Fact (Module.finrank ℝ R3 = 2 + 1) := ⟨by simp [R3]⟩
  have hbase : ContMDiff ((𝓘(ℝ, R3)).prod (𝓡 2)) 𝓘(ℝ, R3) ∞
      (Prod.fst : R3 × UnitSphere → R3) := contMDiff_fst
  have htheta : ContMDiff ((𝓘(ℝ, R3)).prod (𝓡 2)) (𝓡 2) ∞
      (Prod.snd : R3 × UnitSphere → UnitSphere) := contMDiff_snd
  have hcoe : ContMDiff (𝓡 2) 𝓘(ℝ, R3) ∞ (fun theta : UnitSphere => theta.val) :=
    contMDiff_coe_sphere (n := 2) (E := R3)
  exact hbase.prodMk_space (hcoe.comp htheta)

/-- Actual local representatives imply native smoothness through the embedded inclusion. -/
lemma contMDiffOn_of_hasLocalSphereRepresentativesOn
    (Y : Set R3) (f : R3 × UnitSphere → ℝ)
    (hf : HasLocalSphereRepresentativesOn Y f) :
    ContMDiffOn ((𝓘(ℝ, R3)).prod (𝓡 2)) 𝓘(ℝ) ∞ f (Y ×ˢ univ) := by
  rintro ⟨x, theta⟩ hx
  obtain ⟨U, hU, G, hG, heq⟩ := hf x hx.1 theta
  have hrep : ContMDiffAt ((𝓘(ℝ, R3)).prod (𝓡 2)) 𝓘(ℝ) ∞
      (G ∘ sphereProductInclusion) (x, theta) :=
    (hG.contDiffAt hU).contMDiffAt.comp (x, theta)
      contMDiff_sphereProductInclusion.contMDiffAt
  have hpre : sphereProductInclusion ⁻¹' U ∈ 𝓝 (x, theta) :=
    contMDiff_sphereProductInclusion.continuous.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds hU
  have hactual : ContMDiffAt ((𝓘(ℝ, R3)).prod (𝓡 2)) 𝓘(ℝ) ∞ f (x, theta) := by
    apply hrep.congr_of_eventuallyEq
    filter_upwards [hpre] with p hp
    exact (heq p.1 p.2 hp).symm
  exact hactual.contMDiffWithinAt

/-- On an open base, native sphere-product smoothness is exactly the genuine local class. -/
lemma contMDiffOn_iff_hasLocalSphereRepresentativesOn
    (Y : Set R3) (hY : IsOpen Y) (f : R3 × UnitSphere → ℝ) :
    ContMDiffOn ((𝓘(ℝ, R3)).prod (𝓡 2)) 𝓘(ℝ) ∞ f (Y ×ˢ univ) ↔
      HasLocalSphereRepresentativesOn Y f :=
  ⟨hasLocalSphereRepresentativesOn_of_contMDiffOn Y hY f,
    contMDiffOn_of_hasLocalSphereRepresentativesOn Y f⟩

/-- Restriction of a global smooth ambient representative is native smooth. -/
lemma contMDiff_of_sphere_extension
    (f : R3 × UnitSphere → ℝ) (G : R3 × R3 → ℝ) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G)
    (heq : ∀ x : R3, ∀ theta : UnitSphere, G (x, theta.val) = f (x, theta)) :
    ContMDiff ((𝓘(ℝ, R3)).prod (𝓡 2)) 𝓘(ℝ) ∞ f := by
  have hfun : f = G ∘ sphereProductInclusion := by
    funext p
    exact (heq p.1 p.2).symm
  rw [hfun]
  exact hG.contMDiff.comp contMDiff_sphereProductInclusion

end OAI.AnisotropicCalderon.SmoothSphereExtension

``````
